job.title: KSL NewsRadio Talk/News Host (Full-time)
job.description:
Our company is committed to being trusted voices of light and truth reaching hundreds of millions of people worldwide.

Who We Are

KSL is Utah’s leading local news source across digital and broadcast platforms, delivering trusted, award‑winning journalism through KSL NewsRadio, KSL.com and KSL‑TV. We provide in‑depth local reporting, investigative journalism, and up‑to‑the‑minute coverage that serves communities across the state. Committed to being a trusted voice of light and knowledge, KSL helps Utahns stay informed, connected, and engaged with the issues that matter most.

Position Overview

Perform/create informative and engaging news show content either live or on a pre-recorded basis for KSL NewsRadio. Management will assign responsibilities on a regular and/or rotating basis depending upon need and proven capabilities and the need to provide expertise for the future.

Note: Work configurations are subject to change based on business needs and at company discretion.

  • This position is an on-site role that requires the employee to regularly work at our Salt Lake City site.

What You Will Do:

Primary job duties will include, but are not limited to:

  • Select and develop story ideas for on-air presentation
  • Collaborate with a show producer to create performance ideas and audio opportunities
  • Capture the attention of an audience with a unique and informed perspective
  • Develop an on-air presence and a professional demeanor that exudes confidence
  • Discuss current events in a conversational manner
  • Demonstrate spontaneity and flair while simultaneously showing depth, good judgment and sensitivity
  • Enunciate clearly, speak confidently, and interpret and read written copy fluently
  • Execute format philosophy and work with a team of other professionals while creating a distinctive sound
  • Ability to operate studio, recording and editing equipment as needed
  • Desire to innovate show segments and develop creative new performance ideas
  • Accept direction and critique and incorporate feedback into future programs
  • Work in a fast and concise manner under pressure
  • Present live, unscripted and breaking information with continuity, meaning and clarity
  • Other duties as assigned

Skills and Experience We Are Looking For:

  • Minimum of 5 years experience working in a newsroom environment.  Minimum of 2 years on-air show experience preferred. 
  • News judgement.
  • News writing experience
  • Passion for news and current affairs.
  • Experience in radio news hosting.
  • Aggressive attitude with a strong desire to advance in the broadcasting media.
  • Ability to use humor.
  • Spends time researching topics.
  • Ability to be respected by newsmakers during interviews.
  • Strong desire to work at the state’s largest and most respected radio station. 
  • Multi-tasking pro.  Ability to be organized with the capability to concentrate on more than one event at a time, able to follow written and verbal instructions under moderate supervision.
  • Proven ability to work under pressure to meet daily/weekly deadlines. 
  • Willing to be active in the community, on video and on social media.
  • Self-starter with the ability to assure accuracy in on-air product.  Errors may incur financial time loss.
  • Monitor news on a daily basis. 
  • Computer skills.

Physical Demands

  • Receive, process, and maintain information through oral and/or written communication effectively.
  • Manual dexterity and fine motor skills to operate computer keys and general office equipment. Ability to work on a computer for prolonged periods of time.
  • Sit and/or stand for extended periods of time.
  • Lift, move, and carry up to 35 pounds on occasion

Compensation

Salary to be determined by multiple factors including but not limited to evaluation of the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant along with internal equity and alignment with market data.

What We Offer You: Check Out Our KSL Benefits!

Employees at KSL can enjoy a broad offering of benefits, including:

  • Robust, affordable medical, dental and vision coverage with no wait period for enrollment
  • Paid leave for new parents under our Medical Maternity and Parental Leave policies
  • Opportunities to apply for tuition reimbursement
  • Paid time off for vacation and sick leave in addition to paid company holidays
  • 401(k) with Company match, fully vested from day one
  • Paid time off for volunteering
  • Employer-funded retirement account, fully vested from day one
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) services
  • Access to an entire team of free financial planners
  • Matches on contributions to charitable organizations after one year of service
  • Continuous growth and development opportunities
  • Dynamic team culture that values teamwork, having fun, and collaboration

KSL is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by law. Minority/female/disability PWDNET/veteran are encouraged to apply.

job.title: Senior Counsel, Intellectual Property
job.description:
Who We Are:

WWE® is the global leader in sports entertainment. The company creates and delivers original content 52 weeks a year to a global audience. WWE is committed to family-friendly entertainment on its television programming, Premium Live Events, digital media, and publishing platforms. WWE's TV-PG programming can be seen in more than 1 billion households worldwide in more than 20 languages through world-class distribution partners including Netflix, ESPN, NBCUniversal, USA Network and The CW. WWE is part of TKO Group Holdings (NYSE: TKO). Additional information on WWE can be found at wwe.com and corporate.wwe.com. TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

Working Conditions:

  • Stamford based role

  • Mon-Fri, 9am-5pm

About the Role

WWE is seeking a skilled and proactive Corporate Counsel to join our Business & Legal Affairs team and report into the WWE - Senior Vice President, Deputy General Counsel and TKO - Head of Intellectual Property and Licensing. The ideal candidate will have approximately 6-8 years of legal experience, focused on intellectual property clearance, prosecution, enforcement and protection as well as drafting and negotiating corporate agreements. This position offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of law, business strategy, and entertainment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive clearance searches and provide risk assessments for new brands, products, character names, corporate logos, and apparel slogans.

  • Monitor and enforce the company’s intellectual property portfolio (trademarks, copyrights, trade secrets), including drafting and sending cease-and-desist letters, managing takedowns, filing UDRP actions, managing third party enforcement vendors and supporting litigation if necessary.

  • Develop and institute best practices for IP enforcement and protection for infringements, counterfeit and video piracy strategies.

  • Advise on copyright, domain name and related brand protection issues.

  • Support IP enforcement, including monitoring, cease and desist letters, opposition and related disputes. 

  • Collaborate with external counsel and IP offices globally on enforcement.  Work closely with internal business units on a wide variety of intellectual property related matters.

  • Stay current on relevant legal developments, including changes in IP law and technology affecting brand owners’ ability to monitor and enforce proactively.

  • Draft a broad range of contracts relating to sports and entertainment, including intellectual property settlement and coexistence agreements, license agreements, product placement agreements, independent contractor agreements and NDAs.

  • Work closely, collaboratively and enthusiastically with other members of the Business & Legal Affairs team of WWE, WWE affiliates, as well as corresponding business clients.

  • Provide comprehensive legal advice and counsel to internal business units.

  • Provide real-time analysis and advice on business and legal issues, including questions of contract interpretation and enforcement.

  • Participate in special projects and other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • J.D. from an accredited law school and admission to at least one U.S. state bar, and the ability to register as Connecticut authorized in-house counsel.

  • Strong background in trademark clearance, prosecution and enforcement.

  • Experience drafting and negotiating corporate contracts.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with strong attention to detail.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

  • Knowledge or willingness to watch current and historical WWE programming.

Required Skills

  • Working and recent knowledge and experience with clearance search work as well as U.S. trademark prosecution (including all filings with the U.S. Trademark Office).

  • Familiarity with domestic and international IP enforcement strategies.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary and bonus structure

  • Equity/stock options (if applicable)

  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401(k) with company match

WWE makes employment decisions based on merit and qualifications, without considering an employee’s or applicant’s race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, marital status, veteran status, or any other basis prohibited under federal, state or local laws governing non-discrimination in employment in every location in which the Company has facilities. job.title: Social Media Marketing Manager
job.description:
Job Description :

The New York Post provides readers with the best in News, Sports, Pop Culture, and Entertainment – with signature wit, irreverence, and authority averaging 90 million unique monthly viewers. Over the past 225 years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television, and commerce.

The New York Post Digital Network seeks a commercially minded and proactive Social Media Marketing Manager who is passionate about creative, commerce-first lifestyle or commerce creative experience to join our expanding commerce division.

We are looking for a creative and experienced candidate to play a pivotal role in conceptualizing, designing, and overseeing visual elements that enhance the overall impact and engagement of our commerce-related social media content. You will collaborate closely with our commerce editorial, design, marketing, and product teams to ensure a cohesive and engaging visual experience for our followers.

Reporting to the Senior Commerce Social Media Marketing Manager, you will have a significant impact on the success of our growing digital commerce division.

Responsibilities:

● Collaborate with social and commerce teams, leveraging established and emerging platforms for cutting-edge social media strategies that align with the New York Post Digital Network’s commerce goals, driving content engagement, link clicks and sales.

● Innovate content presentation on social media, experimenting with formats and interactive elements for engaging graphics and videos that showcase commerce-related content.

● Work seamlessly with editorial, design, marketing, and product teams (NY Post, Page Six, Decider, NYPostSports, California Post) to align visual content, enhancing individual brand initiatives.

● Maintain up-to-date proficiency in social media tech and best practices, adapting to tools, algorithms, and platform advancements.

● Manage social media inquiries from sales and branded content teams, ensuring timely responses.

● Execute strategies promoting NY Post and Page Six merchandise across social platforms.

● Track and report on internet trends, particularly in the shopping sphere, social commerce specific trends.

● Proactively engage the audience with timely, trend-inspired content that resonates within the commerce realm.

● Convey ideas adeptly to both internal and external stakeholders, fostering productive collaboration.

Qualifications:

● Extensive experience managing multiple social media accounts, preferably with a large following.

● Knowledge of micro and macro digital media trends and emerging platforms

● Proven ability to think strategically and translate strategic goals into actionable social media plans that drive commerce-focused results.

● Ability to multitask, balance priorities and thrive in a fast-paced environment, quickly adapting to changing trends and leveraging them to enhance social media strategies.

● Proficiency in metrics-based decision-making with an emphasis on reading and interpreting data.

● Adept at analyzing social media data to identify trends, make informed decisions, and refine strategies for optimal engagement.

● Experience collaborating with e-commerce platforms or commerce-related brands, translating product offerings into engaging social media content.

● Ability to be both a self-starter and team player who exhibits strong interpersonal and communication skills.

● Photo and video editing experience in Canva, Capcut, Premium and Adobe Suite

● Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail.

job.title: Editorial Page Assistant Editor
job.description:
Job Description :

The New York Post delivers the best in News, Sports, Entertainment and Pop Culture with wit, irreverence, and authority. Over the past 225 years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce.


The Post’s Editorial Page is where bold ideas meet razor-sharp commentary. As one of the country’s most recognized opinion sections, our team tackles the most pressing local, national, and global issues — delivering sharp, fearless takes in the distinct voice that defines the Post. From holding public officials accountable to weighing in on global conflicts, we cut through the noise with clarity, wit, and purpose.


We’re looking for a nimble, thoughtful, and fast-moving Editorial Page Assistant Editor to join our Opinion team. This writer will contribute impactful editorials daily — helping shape the voice of our institutional stance — while also crafting occasional bylined opinion columns. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of the Post’s signature tone: smart, punchy, skeptical of orthodoxy, and unafraid to challenge both sides of the aisle. This role is key to helping our readers make sense of a fast-changing world and will contribute to both our print and digital platforms.


Responsibilities:

  • Write timely, engaging, and factually sound unsigned editorials under tight deadlines, aligned with the Post’s voice and editorial stance
  • Occasionally contribute bylined opinion columns on topics of expertise or general interest
  • As our video products develop, contribute on-camera opinion on topics of expertise or general interest
  • Pitch compelling editorial ideas that respond to breaking news or trends in politics, policy, and culture
  • Collaborate closely with the editorial team to shape daily and long-term coverage priorities
  • Monitor current events across a wide range of topics including New York City and state politics, national affairs, foreign policy and broader cultural issues
  • Join in team preparation of copy for both digital publication (using WordPress and other CMS tools) and print.
  • Help amplify opinion content’s reach (including via social media) with sharp headlines and an eye toward engagement
  • Represent the editorial board externally as needed, including occasional interviews, panels, or media appearances
     

Requirements:

  • At least 3 years of experience in political commentary, editorial writing, or a related field
  • Deep understanding of New York politics and national political dynamics
  • Exceptional writing skills: clear, direct, and persuasive prose under deadline
  • Strong editorial judgment and a keen news sense
  • Comfort with delivering on-camera content, preferably non-teleprompter
  • Comfort with WordPress or similar content management systems
  • Familiarity with SEO best practices and social media strategy
  • A sharp eye for narrative, logic, and tone — especially attuned to the Post’s unique voice

job.title: Associate Producer - Schein Daily Sports Video Show
job.description:
Job Description :

The New York Post is the nation’s oldest newspaper with the youngest, most ambitious video department. We want to make our mark in digital video and create memorable work and new watching habits among our audience. The legacy of the great headlines conveys the attributes of our videos: bold, irreverent, judgmental, confident and clever. We want to make videos that surprise viewers. We seek someone who appreciates serious and quirky stories. Let’s talk! 

The New York Post video team is seeking an Associate Producer for “Schein Time” with Adam Schein, a new daily live sports show that is national in scope. This AP will play a key role in assisting all aspects of the daily production process and be responsible for creating compelling, shareable videos and disseminating the show across social platforms. These clips will help drive in tune-in and be content worth watching. 

The candidate we seek has deep knowledge of and interest in a wide range of sports, including NFL, MLB, NBA/WNBA, College Sports, NHL, emerging sports, gambling, fantasy, and current New York/California sports news.
  
Per our publication’s mantra, you agree that news doesn’t have to be boring and you appreciate the odd and unconventional stories as well as important ones.  

This is an opportunity to join an iconic media brand as it continues exponential digital growth. The New York Post has garnered more than a billion video views across various platforms in the past year. 

Responsibilities:

  • Assist in all aspects of daily production for a nationally distributed live sports show

  • Produce compelling, shareable short-form video clips to drive tune-in and audience engagement

  • Lead the creation of thumbnails, headlines, and other visual/packaging elements optimized for digital and social platforms

  • Manage and execute interactive promotion of show content across social media channels

  • Socialize show clips strategically to maximize reach, viewership, and engagement

  • Ensure smooth day-to-day production workflows while juggling multiple simultaneous tasks

  • Collaborate with producers and team members to generate ideas and contribute to daily show brainstorming

  • Support the production of digitally native video content tailored to platform-specific audiences

  • Apply deep knowledge of sports—including major leagues, emerging sports, gambling, esports, and fantasy—to content creation and promotion

  • Identify and help elevate unconventional, entertaining, and newsworthy sports stories in line with the publication’s brand voice

 

QUALIFICATIONS: 

  •  Minimum 2 years of experience in a digital/sports newsroom environment

  • Encyclopedic sports knowledge including upstart sports, fantasy, and esports. 

  • Ability to pitch, produce, and script

  • Ability to polish on camera talent

  • Ability to work closely with internal stakeholders and reporters. 

  • Excellent communication and people skills

  • Experience creating video for social platforms like YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, Snapchat, X and more a plus

job.title: Associate Commerce Editor
job.description:
Job Description :

About The Post: The New York Post delivers the best in news, sports, entertainment, pop culture and shopping, with wit, irreverence and authority across print, digital, video, audio, app and commerce.


The Role: We’re hiring an Associate Commerce Editor for the revenue-generating commerce team. This is not a business reporting role. In this dynamic, expanded position, you will balance daily writing with foundational editing responsibilities, serving as a critical bridge between our reporting and editing desks. You will be responsible for writing a minimum of two short-form deal stories per day, continuing to publish fast, useful shopping stories that drive revenue and taking ownership of editing daily deals, updating evergreen posts and stepping up to manage larger packages when needed.


This role is ideal for a prolific commerce reporter ready to hone their editorial judgment, refine their packaging skills and take on emerging leadership responsibilities across the New York Post Digital Network.


What You’ll Do:
● Write a baseline of 2–3 commerce stories per shift (deals, explainers, how-tos and buyer’s guides) that drive conversions, ensuring consistent daily revenue-generating output.

job.title: Identity Access Management (IAM) Engineer – Identity Governance and Administration
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Job Summary 

We are currently seeking an Identity & Access Management Engineer with specialization in Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) to join UMG’s global Tech Security & Identity organization. Reporting to the VP, Tech Security & Identity, this is a hands-on engineering role responsible for designing, implementing, and operating enterprise IGA capabilities across a complex, global environment. 

This engineer will play a critical role in governing digital identities, access entitlements, and lifecycle processes for employees, contractors, and non-employee populations. The role emphasizes strong engineering execution, automation, and operational discipline, partnering closely with security, HR, infrastructure, and application teams to ensure access is provisioned appropriately, reviewed regularly, and removed in a timely manner. The ideal candidate brings deep experience with modern IGA platforms, strong understanding of access governance controls, and the ability to operate at scale in a regulated enterprise. 

Job Functions 

Design, engineer, deploy, and operate Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) solutions across the enterprise. 

Implement and manage identity lifecycle processes including joiner, mover, and leaver (JML) workflows for employees and non-employee identities. 

Engineer and maintain access request, approval, and provisioning workflows integrated with HR systems, directories, and enterprise applications. 

Design and operate access governance controls including role models, entitlement catalogs, access certifications, and periodic access reviews. 

Partner with application owners and platform teams to onboard applications into IGA and remediate access governance gaps. 

Develop and maintain automation and integrations for IGA workflows using scripting, APIs, and infrastructure-as-code approaches (e.g., PowerShell, Python). 

Support segregation of duties (SoD) controls, access policy enforcement, and audit readiness activities. 

Troubleshoot and resolve complex identity lifecycle, provisioning, and access-related issues across integrated systems. 

Collaborate with Security, HR, Compliance, and Infrastructure teams to ensure identity governance controls align with security policies and regulatory requirements. 

Maintain technical documentation, configuration standards, and operational runbooks to support scalable and repeatable IGA operations. 

Continuously identify opportunities to improve access governance maturity, reduce manual effort, and enhance user experience through automation and platform enhancements. 

Job Requirements 

Essential Qualifications 

5+ years of hands-on experience in Identity & Access Management or Security Engineering roles, with a strong focus on Identity Governance & Administration. 

Demonstrated experience implementing and operating enterprise IGA platforms (e.g., Saviynt, SailPoint, or equivalent). 

Strong understanding of identity lifecycle management, access provisioning, role-based access control (RBAC), and entitlement governance. 

Hands-on experience designing and supporting access certification campaigns and remediation processes. 

Experience integrating IGA solutions with HR systems, Active Directory / Entra ID, and enterprise applications. 

Proficiency in scripting and automation using tools such as PowerShell or Python. 

Experience working in hybrid and cloud environments (Azure and/or AWS) with IAM integrations. 

Ability to independently own complex technical deliverables while collaborating effectively within a global organization. 

Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills. 

Desirable Qualifications 

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Engineering, or a related technical discipline. 

Experience with advanced IGA capabilities such as role mining, access analytics, or policy-based provisioning. 

Familiarity with compliance and audit frameworks such as SOX, ISO 27001, NIST, or similar. 

Professional certifications such as Saviynt Certified Professional, SailPoint Certified IdentityIQ Engineer, Security+, or CISSP. 

Experience operating IAM or identity governance platforms within a large, global, or highly regulated enterprise environment.

job.title: Globe Sync Agent (Advertising) - New York, New York
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Globe 

Who we are  

Globe is the award-winning creative and partnerships division of Universal Music Group in the UK. We work together with our artists and labels, operating at the intersection of music, film, television, brands and creative partners. 

We specialise in placing music to picture across film, TV, advertising, gaming and streaming alongside crafting standout brand partnerships and original content. Our work sits at the heart of an artist’s marketing strategy, driving cultural relevance, audience reach and long-term impact. 

Our team  

Globe is made up of passionate and knowledgeable experts who thrive on collaboration and creativity. We work closely with artists from the moment they sign, helping shape their journey across all stages of their career. Our team approaches every campaign with pace and precision, moving fast like an F1 pit crew, but with the deep creative care of the engineers behind the scenes. 

We’re building a new sync presence on the ground in the USA, and we’re looking for dynamic self-starters who can identify and unlock opportunities others might miss. We believe in the power of teamwork, cultural fluency, and mutual respect and we’re united by our love of music. 

Our impact  

Globe plays a key role in the long-term success of our artists. We secure impactful placements that elevate an artist’s profile and fanbase, whether it’s a global film franchise, a soundtrack moment in a streaming hit, or a culture-shaping ad campaign. Each sync is a chance to deepen engagement, build brand value, and create timeless connections between music and audience. 

Our work helps shape perception and drive discovery. We create opportunities that align with artist narratives and bring a new level of visibility to Universal Music Group’s UK world-class repertoire. 

The Role  

A day in the life of  

As Sync Agent, Globe USA (Advertising – East Coast), you’ll lead Globe’s advertising-focused sync strategy from New York. Your remit will centre on identifying, developing and executing licensing opportunities that maximise the commercial and creative impact of Universal Music UK’s frontline and catalogue repertoire. 

You’ll work with advertising agencies, music supervisors, brands and creative partners to build long-lasting relationships and drive new and repeat business. Working closely with our UK labels and A&R teams, you’ll curate and deliver music responses that cut through creatively and deliver commercially. 

On any given day you could be: 

  • Pitching music to advertising agencies, brands, and creative studios for upcoming campaigns 

  • Collaborating with A&R to develop custom or tailored musical responses to client briefs 

  • Meeting with key contacts in the advertising industry to deepen relationships and understand trends 

  • Negotiating sync deals, overseeing licensing, clearances and financial tracking 

  • Monitoring campaign performance and sync usage to inform future activity 

  • Attending brand showcases, award shows, and industry events to grow Globe’s US network 

  • Working closely with colleagues in the UK to align sync activity with artist campaigns and priorities 

Your impact in role 

You will play a critical role in helping UK artists break into the US advertising sync market. Your placements will provide meaningful profile and commercial wins for our artists, increase catalogue performance, and expand our footprint in the creative industries. 

By maintaining strong relationships and securing high-value opportunities, you’ll directly support the growth of Universal Music UK’s presence in the US sync space, particularly within the influential advertising and branding sectors. 

This role is ideal for you if 

  • You are deeply connected within the advertising sync and music supervision space 

  • You have a strong understanding of how music, brands and storytelling intersect 

  • You’re confident balancing creative ambition with commercial delivery 

  • You enjoy spotting new opportunities and shaping long-term client relationships 

  • You’re excited by building something new and being part of a fast-moving, collaborative team 

  • You’re adaptable, solutions-focused, and thrive on delivering impactful results 

Key responsibilities  

  • Lead Globe NY’s sync strategy, focused on advertising-driven opportunities 

  • Work to accountable commercial targets and KPIs, aligned with artist and label goals 

  • Cultivate, grow and maintain relationships with brands, agencies and music supervision teams 

  • Respond creatively and commercially to sync briefs, pitching music from our full repertoire 

  • Negotiate, close and execute sync deals including clearance, licensing and payments 

  • Collaborate with UK labels and A&R to develop bespoke creative responses 

  • Deliver artist showcases, client engagement moments and in-market activations 

  • Track sync activity and catalogue performance to provide actionable insights to internal teams 

  • Stay ahead of sync, advertising and content trends to identify new revenue opportunities 

Our ideal candidate  

  • 8+ years’ experience in creative sync, advertising music supervision, or licensing 

  • Extensive network of advertising industry contacts and creative agency partners 

  • Proven success in pitching and closing advertising sync deals 

  • Strong understanding of music copyright, licensing and legal frameworks 

  • Commercially astute with excellent negotiation and communication skills 

  • Organised, strategic and able to manage multiple priorities and client needs 

  • Familiarity with key platforms including Microsoft Office, Salesforce, DISCO and music analytics tools 

  • Based in the New York area with the ability to travel as required 

  • A passion for music across all genres, and an appreciation of UK repertoire, is a plus 

Why join Globe  

  • Be part of a pioneering new sync expansion in the USA 

  • Play a central role in breaking UK artists globally 

  • Represent one of the most exciting catalogues in music, from emerging icons to legendary acts 

  • Work within a collaborative, inclusive and values-driven creative team 

  • Help shape the future of sync in one of the world’s most important media markets 

  • Make a lasting impact on artists, on culture, and on the business 

Reward and Benefits 

  • Be part of an entrepreneurial, global organization that values authenticity, drive, creativity, relationships, and a competitive spirit 

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and FSA options, as well as:

Job Title: Coordinator, Business and Legal Affairs 

  

A little bit about our team: 

WMG Global Catalog/Rhino Entertainment is the catalog division of Warner Music Group responsible for advancing the legacy of Warner’s iconic artists and optimizing the performance of Warner’s recorded music catalog, including that of legacy artists and current superstars. Rhino’s dynamic Business and Legal Affairs team shares a passion for music, values hard work, and brings a creative, problem-solving mindset. We focus on innovative deals with and for WMG artists across recorded music, brand licensing, and ancillary exploitation. We work cross-functionally with A&R, marketing, fan engagement, commerce, and finance to structure deals and further strengthen relationships with our artists. We also field inquiries regarding the U.S. catalog repertoire, handle pre-litigation claims and litigation in coordination with WMG’s corporate litigation in-house counsel, and implement WMG’s rights in connection with the same. We collaborate closely with our affiliated labels, Atlantic, Elektra, and Warner Records, as well as with WMG’s corporate teams.

A key player on the team, this individual will support the Head of Business & Legal Affairs and other top executives and senior management within the Business & Legal Affairs department at Rhino Entertainment.  In addition, this role will handle the calendar and scheduling for the CFO, Rhino & Global Catalog.  As the point person for the Business Affairs team, you will collaborate closely with a wide range of departments at WMG, as well as with many other record labels within the company. Want to develop a one-of-a-kind, behind-the-scenes understanding of the Music Industry while supporting a leader in the field? This could be the right role for you!

  • Facilitate the end-to-end contract execution process, routing deal memos and agreements for signature, and entering key rights data into WMG’s administration database

  • Streamline departmental finances by processing invoices, managing travel and entertainment expenses, setting up new vendors, and handling payments for all agreements

  • Handle critical communications, drafting and routing polished internal and external correspondence on behalf of the department

  • Maintain organization and security across the team, keeping digital and physical filing systems immaculate while safeguarding confidential information

  • Produce presentations, reports, and charts as needed

job.title: Director, App Security
job.description:
Who We Are:

TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

Overview

We are looking for a hands-on Director, Application Security Engineering to strengthen our cybersecurity posture and partner directly with teams building software across web, mobile, data, and AI-enabled workflows. This role will embed security into delivery practices, improve how we prevent and remediate risk, and communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

This Director will work across software engineering, platform, DevOps, architecture, QA, infrastructure, compliance, and security teams to mature secure SDLC (i.e., SSDLC) practices, expand developer-friendly guardrails, and improve application and agent security. They should be comfortable moving between code review, tooling configuration, threat modeling, vulnerability management, automation, security enablement, and emerging AI security considerations.  This is a hybrid role (3 days/week in-office). Preference given to candidates near a TKO office, including NYC, Stamford, Orlando, Austin, or Las Vegas.

The Role and What You’ll Do

The Director, Application Security Engineering will:

  • Own and evolve application security practices across the SSDLC, emphasizing scalable, developer-aligned, shift-left controls
  • Operate and improve SAST, SCA, secret scanning, code scanning, repository protections, and related controls across repositories and CI/CD pipelines
  • Develop secure development enablement for citizen developers, vibe coding, and AI-assisted development, including practical guidance for tooling, code assurance, identity, observability, and enterprise standards
  • Review application and code-level vulnerabilities, validate findings, reduce noise, and drive risk-based remediation plans
  • Conduct threat modeling and security design reviews for new systems, major changes, integrations, APIs, and high-risk workflows
  • Advise teams on secure coding, authentication and authorization, session management, secrets handling, logging, encryption, dependency hygiene, and data protection
  • Improve security guardrails for build pipelines, containers, APIs, third-party components, and deployment practices across modern and legacy environments
  • Mature risk-based vulnerability management across intake, validation, prioritization, remediation guidance, exception handling, and reporting
  • Support secure adoption of AI-assisted development and agentic systems by assessing trust boundaries, data exposure paths, prompt and tool-invocation risks, and misuse scenarios
  • Develop pragmatic standards, playbooks, reference architectures, documentation, and office-hour support that improve consistency without slowing teams down unnecessarily
  • Track recurring weaknesses, recommend structural fixes, and help leadership understand where engineering investment will reduce risk most effectively
  • Use AI productively and responsibly to accelerate analysis, triage, documentation, coding support, and security review while maintaining strong human judgment

Required Skills and Experience

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in application security, product security, DevSecOps, and security engineering or a closely related software security role
  • Proven experience working directly with engineering teams in fast-moving delivery environments
  • Hands-on experience configuring, tuning, and operationalizing SAST, SCA, and related tooling such as SonarQube, Dependabot, GitHub, GitHub Advanced Security, or comparable platforms
  • Ability to interpret and reason about code, identify meaningful risk, and provide specific, implementable remediation guidance to engineers
  • Practical experience with SSDLC and shift-left practices, including automated code review support, threat modeling, security design review, and vulnerability management
  • Strong understanding of application and API security, including common software weaknesses, authN/authZ, secrets handling, dependency risk, injection, deserialization, and data protection
  • Experience integrating reliable, scalable, and minimally disruptive security controls into CI/CD pipelines and developer workflows
  • Hands-on familiarity with cloud and modern software delivery patterns, including containers, IaC, and Git-based workflows
  • Strong judgment in vulnerability triage, balancing severity, exploitability, business impact, and engineering realities
  • Ability to write clear guidance, standards, and technical documentation for technical and non-technical audiences
  • Bias toward automation, simplification, and scalable solutions over manual heroics
  • Broad DevSecOps mindset across code, pipelines, dependencies, platforms, deployment, and operations
  • Experience using AI tools responsibly to improve engineering and security outcomes

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Experience securing AI agents, LLM-enabled applications, copilots, or agentic workflows in production or near-production environments
  • Experience with DAST, API security testing, penetration testing coordination, red-team support, or adversarial testing of application and AI systems
  • Experience with policy-as-code, IaC scanning, container/image security, software supply-chain security, SBOMs, provenance, attestation, and secrets management
  • Familiarity with cloud security across AWS and/or GCP and the application-layer implications of cloud-native architectures
  • Experience in regulated, audit-sensitive, or event-critical environments where evidence, controls, and operational rigor matter
  • Experience building metrics, dashboards, or reporting that show AppSec posture and remediation progress
  • Experience mentoring engineers and influencing secure engineering culture without direct people management responsibility

What Good Looks Like in This Role

  • Engineering teams get faster, clearer, and more actionable security guidance as well as assistance with implementation and mechanics for a "teach a person to fish" approach
  • Security tooling produces more trustworthy signals and leads to better adoption, not just more alerts
  • Teams catch and remediate issues earlier in design and development rather than late in release cycles
  • Application and agent-security risks are surfaced in practical terms with concrete mitigation paths
  • Standards, playbooks, and tooling make secure delivery easier and more consistent
  • Security becomes more embedded in day-to-day engineering execution and technical operations, and less dependent on last-minute security scrambles and efforts,

Per local requirements and in the interest of transparency, the hourly rate shown below reflects the prevalent current hiring range for this position. Hiring pay rates are based on a number of factors, including location and may vary depending on job-related qualifications, knowledge, skills and experience. The company strives to provide locally competitive rewards packages, which include base rate along with, as applicable, short- and long-term incentives, growth and developmental opportunities, and robust benefits, such as health care, retirement, vacation and other paid time off, and additional offerings.

job.description:
Job Title

Senior Product Manager, Privacy & Trust

Job Description

About The Position | Major goals and objectives and location requirements 

 

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to take charge of our data privacy and platform strategy. You will be the point person for balancing our business needs, like audience growth and personalization, with the reality of global privacy regulations. This role is a mix of high-level roadmap planning and deep-in-the-weeds technical problem solving, specifically regarding our Data Subject Request (DSR) platform.

 

Hybrid 3x a week- (New York, NY) 

In-office Expectations: This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week.

 

About The Team:

At People Inc., we treat reader trust as our most valuable asset. This role is not just building a platform; this role is building the infrastructure that allows our readers to trust us with their data. This team solves hard, "real-world" technical problems that have a tangible impact. 

About The Positions Contributions:

 

Weight % | Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results

20% | Own the DSR Platform

  • Our current DSR process needs work. You will lead the roadmap to evolve this from a compliance checkbox into a scalable, automated system that handles access, deletion, and portability requests across all our data silos.

20% | Balance Privacy & Product

  • You’ll define how we manage data and identity. The goal is to stay fully compliant (GDPR, CCPA/CPRA) without sacrificing the user experience or our ability to deliver relevant content.

20% | Build the Foundation

  • Partner with engineering to modernize our data architecture. You need to understand our data lineage, governance, and security well enough to guide architectural decisions across different business units.

20% | Make Privacy User-Friendly

  • Stop treating privacy as a legal chore. You will design transparent, user-centric flows that actually help our readers understand their data, which in turn builds long-term brand trust.

20% | Cross-Functional Strategy

  • You’ll be the bridge between Legal, AdTech, and Engineering. You need to be able to explain the technical risk to legal, and the regulatory requirements to our engineering leads.


The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements

Education: Bachelor’s degree is preferred and/or equivalent experience.

 

Experience:

  • 5+ years in product management owning backend platforms. A candidate who has worked in data-heavy environments or managed compliance-related products or identity systems is required. 

 

Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities:

  • DSR Platform Expertise: Experience developing or expanding DSR systems. You understand the friction involved in verifying identities and synchronizing data across disconnected stacks and have a vision for automation.

job.title: Audience Editor, NYT Wirecutter
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

About the Role, Mission or Department Overview

Wirecutter is seeking an editor to lead programming and personalization for our ecommerce initiatives, with a particular emphasis on the Wirecutter Store. You will be the editorial lead for how we talk about the Store — crafting language, frameworks, and campaigns that invite readers in, explain what the Store is, and bring them back during major editorial moments throughout the year.

As audience editor for ecommerce, programming, and personalization, you will focus on three core areas: messaging, copy, and alignment with stakeholders around big editorial moments; audience strategy, lifecycle flows, and personalization rooted in our standards; and editorial programming and email support that tightly links our journalism to new platforms.

As an audience editor, you will report to Wirecutter's deputy director of newsletters and programming, and collaborate closely with colleagues across newsletters and programming, audience at large, Wirecutter's newsroom, as well as our commerce, marketing, product, and analytics teams.

You will drive the editorial voice of Store-related messaging, build and maintain a unified promo calendar, and design tests and experiments to deepen engagement while valuing Wirecutter's standards for independence and trust.

You'll bring thoughtful editorial judgment, comfort working with data, and a sense of how lifecycle messaging, personalization, and on-site experiences can work together to serve readers.

This role has the potential to be remote, though New York City–based applicants are preferred.

Responsibilities:

  • Drive the voice and editorial quality of Wirecutter Store-related messaging across channels: Write and line-edit copy for newsletters, lifecycle flows, push, SMS, on-site promos, and Wirecutter Store entry points with deep editorial rigor and collaboration across partner teams.
  • Support the editorial quality of product detail pages (PDPs) on the Wirecutter Store:
  • Create messaging frameworks for major Store moments (launches, tentpoles, seasonal pushes) so readers understand what the Store is and why they should trust it.
  • Partner with marketing to ensure users are engaged at every touchpoint in the lifecycle, from acquisition campaigns to transactional emails and targeted promos.
  • Create and maintain a Store messaging style guide that aligns with Wirecutter's voice and company-wide Store goals, including guidelines for CTAs, subject lines, and promotional framing.
  • Contribute to overall Wirecutter newsletters and programming responsibilities — especially during major moments where it connects to the Store (i.e. gifting season; deal events).
  • Work closely with product and data to understand how we are engaging readers across surfaces, and design editorial experiments to better reach and engage with them based on behaviors — particularly in inboxes
  • Continuously test and optimize messaging (subject lines, CTAs, timing, sequencing) to improve engagement while staying rooted in our standards and reporting.
  • Maintain a unified Store messaging and promo calendar that's integrated with Wirecutter's broader editorial, promotional, and major deal events strategy, rather than running on a separate track.
  • Work closely with edit leadership and in collaboration with cross-functional teams like marketing and product to design reader journeys that connect journalism to the Store to follow-ups in a way that feels personal, useful, and closely connected to overall editorial reader journeys.
  • Perform related work as assigned.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.
  • You will report to the Deputy Director, Newsletters and Programming, NYT Wirecutter.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years in a newsroom, audience, or editorial marketing role with substantial experience in writing, editing, or programming for digital audiences.
  • Demonstrated experience with email newsletters, lifecycle or CRM programs, or other audience-led messaging channels; familiarity with ecommerce or product-focused journalism.
  • Excellent editorial judgment, line-editing skills, and a strong sense of how to translate rigorous reporting into clear, compelling, and trustworthy copy.
  • Proven ability to use analytics, A/B testing, and audience insights to inform messaging decisions and iterate on subject lines, CTAs, timing, and personalization.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Comfort working cross-functionally with product, marketing, commerce, data, and creative partners, and an ability to advocate for reader-first, journalism-informed decisions.
  • Strong organizational and project-management skills, including experience maintaining calendars, managing complex campaigns, and keeping multiple stakeholders aligned.
  • A deep interest in Wirecutter's mission and a commitment to upholding our standards for independence, rigor, and service journalism in all Store-related communications.

This position is represented by the NewsGuild of NY.

job.description:
Who We Are

We are an award-winning independent creative solutions company that aspires to be the most culturally-influential company in the world. We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges. As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone can never do.

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence. We’re unapologetically ambitious!

We are seeking a Business Supervisor to support an exciting account. This role is hybrid and requires 4 days a week in our Brooklyn office, with 1 day remote. 

Position Summary

The Business Supervisor (BS) is the day-to-day client partnership lead, responsible for managing client communication, translating business needs into actionable direction, and ensuring clarity across internal teams. Serving as the critical connection point between Business Leadership and Program Management, the Business Supervisor helps create exceptional client experiences while enabling efficient delivery.

This role operates with guidance while independently managing day-to-day client relationships and workstreams. Business Supervisors build trusted client partnerships, drive alignment across disciplines, proactively manage expectations, and help ensure every engagement is strategically grounded and executionally set up for success.

What You'll Do

Client Partnership & Communication

  • Own day-to-day client relationships and communication across assigned workstreams.
  • Lead routine client meetings, status calls, working sessions, and follow-up communications.
  • Build trust through proactive communication, responsiveness, and thoughtful partnership.
  • Ensure every client interaction is organized, productive, and aligned against business objectives.

Translation & Alignment

  • Translate client needs, feedback, and business objectives into clear direction for internal teams.
  • Partner closely with Strategy, Context, Creative, and Business Directors to develop and refine creative briefs.
  • Ensure cross-functional teams understand priorities, expectations, success metrics, and next steps.
  • Create alignment between client goals and agency recommendations throughout the life of a project.

Creative Development Support

  • Prepare clients for presentations and key decision-making moments.
  • Help articulate strategic and creative rationale in a clear, compelling, and client-ready manner.
  • Anticipate client feedback and guide internal teams on effective responses.
  • Support creative development by ensuring work remains aligned to client objectives and approved strategy.

Risk & Expectation Management

  • Proactively identify risks, ambiguities, or changing client needs before they become issues.
  • Manage client expectations through transparent communication and thoughtful problem solving.
  • Resolve day-to-day challenges independently, escalating only when appropriate.
  • Ensure alignment between what clients expect and what teams are prepared to deliver.

Team Contribution & Development

  • Mentor junior Business Leadership team members in client communication, relationship management, and presentation skills.
  • Support Business Directors in strengthening client relationships and identifying opportunities for organic growth.
  • Foster a collaborative, accountable, and positive team environment across disciplines.
  • Model strong judgment, professionalism, and ownership in client-facing situations.

Partnership with Program Management

  • Partner closely with Program Management to ensure alignment between client expectations and delivery plans.
  • Support scope definition by helping clarify client objectives, priorities, and desired outcomes.
  • Maintain awareness of timelines, budgets, and executional progress while allowing Program Management to lead delivery.
  • Work collaboratively to ensure clients receive a seamless experience from strategy through execution.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in advertising, marketing, consulting, or related client leadership roles.
  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted client relationships and manage day-to-day business communications.
  • Strong strategic thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
  • Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams including Strategy, Creative, Production, Context, and Program Management.
  • Ability to balance multiple priorities while maintaining exceptional organization and attention to detail.
  • Experience mentoring junior team members and contributing to a collaborative team culture.
  • Strong understanding of integrated marketing, creative development, and client service best practices.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, or a related field preferred.

 

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Job Title:  Executive Producer - WFTV Orlando

 

Position Overview

The Executive Producer at WFTV in Orlando, FL will manage a team of TV producers and writers while working with, anchors, reporters, photographers, editors, and directors to create dynamic newscasts in one of the top newsrooms in the country. The EP crafts the look of the shows, manages story count, flow and placement of every story. They set the coverage expectation and manage repetition. The EP manages breaking news and the speed and style in which we get it on the air whenever news breaks. The person in this job must be a quick-moving innovator who can lead the team in a changing media environment. The EP assists in all aspects of leading and managing a team such as establishing schedules, goal setting, and employee relations and works closely with fellow managers to craft and execute successful strategies and newscasts.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Newscast & Brand Management – 90%

  • Ensure product stays on brand.
  • Manage breaking news.
  • Copy edits stories in newscasts to ensure they are on target with research objectives.
  • Manages story count and placement. Must be intimate with the rundown. Manage story count vs. big story coverage.
  • Set the coverage expectation by holding meetings with producers and conducting newscast critiques.
  • Manage repetition within newscasts and from newscast to newscast.
  • Ensures the product stays on brand. Holds producers accountable on story selection and ensures anchors and meteorologists stay on target with delivery.
  • Manages breaking news. Ensures that we are on the air quickly. Monitors the execution in the control room. Facilitates drills to ensure talent is up to speed.
  • Innovate to match research as viewing behavior changes.
  • Executes live-streaming strategy to encourage viewership on mobile and on other digital platforms.
  • Works closely with talent on social posts to encourage viewership of the newscast.
  • Crafts newscasts look by working with the Creative Services Department.
  • Holds writing seminars and trains new employees.
  • Must fill in line producer as needed

 

Administrative – 10%

  • The EP leads and manages a team of TV and digital producers, writers, anchors, reporters, photographers, editors, and directors.
  • Assists in establishing schedules, goal setting, and employee relations. 

 

Physical Demands:

  • A combination of physical work (standing, walking, lifting and carrying items such as laptop computers, pulling file drawers.
  • Document review and computer use, including ability to manipulate fingers to operate computer keyboard and mouse.
  • Expected to work under deadline constraints and meet precise deadlines (including self-imposed deadlines). 
  • Routine interruptions and unforeseen assignments are to be expected.
  • The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate. 

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5 or more years of newsroom experience required 
  • Must be a quick leading innovator who can lead a team in a changing media environment 
  • Must understand and be able to execute on evolving digital platforms 
  • Must be a good teacher and leader 
  • Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. 
  • Must be well read on current affairs and have a wide range of working knowledge and understanding of general interest subjects. 
  • Must be able to understand research and execute on the findings. 
  • Ability to work well with others and deal with employee issues appropriately. 

Preferred Qualifications

  • B.A. Degree in Journalism, Communications, or other field of study preferred 
  • Large market experience preferred

In this role, you’ll work alongside a team of passionate colleagues and with a high-achieving culture, committed to delivering results, marketing excellence and unwavering customer service. Best of all, you’ll receive best-in-class training, incentives and benefits from Audacy, a scaled, multi-platform audio content and entertainment organization with the country’s best radio broadcasting group. Job Title: Multimedia Journalist

 

Department: Programming

 

Reporting To: TWIN Traffic Operations Manager

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

Work Arrangement: On-Site

 

Overview:

NewsRadio 1080 KRLD, Dallas-Fort Worth and Texas State Networks is looking for its next full-time Multimedia Journalist. The ideal candidate is an upbeat, positive, and motivated news junkie who thrives in a fast-paced environment where content is driven by audience demands, breaking news, severe weather, and coverage of major traffic incidents.

 

In this unique and exciting role as a multimedia journalist, you will serve as an editor, anchor, reporter, digital and social content creator for NewsRadio 1080 KRLD’s multiple distribution platforms, including Texas State Networks. The skills utilized may be different each day, based on staffing, content, and audience demands.

 

This full-time position would include a Monday through Friday schedule and may include on-call duties as needed.

 

Please note: This is a pipeline posting. We are always on the lookout for exceptional talent to join our dynamic team. While we may not have an immediate opening, we are continuously building a pipeline of talented individuals who are interested in becoming a part of our organization when opportunities arise. By submitting your application, you will become part of our talent pool. When we have a hiring need that matches your profile, we will reach out to you directly to discuss the opportunity. We appreciate your interest in joining our team and look forward to reviewing your application. 

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Stay up to date on current affairs and content planning for the day/week.
  • Gather, write, record, edit and deliver news, traffic & weather content, including live coverage from the studio or from the field on KRLD, Texas State Networks, or associated distribution platforms.
  • Identify great audio, write and edit urgent and compelling copy for stories.
  • Assemble/stack, and edit newscasts delivered by another anchor and/or by you, free of any political or social biases. 
  • Anchor multi-hour news shifts on KRLD and/or Texas State Networks.
  • Interview newsmakers and news reactors, including the general public.
  • Development and research of potential news stories, using all newsroom resources, including non-traditional and social media, to identify potential news stories relevant to KRLD’s strategy and target audience.
  • Organize, develop, and coordinate assignments with reporters during hours associated with Editing.
  • Communicate and coordinate with KRLD meteorologist and/or traffic teams during changing weather conditions, severe weather, and significant traffic incidents.
  • Creatively pursue new ways of presenting stories so that they have the most impact on the audience.
  • Contribute to team editorial meetings with story ideas.
  • Learn, understand, and be able to follow and implement KRLD strategy and Audacy policy and procedures.
  • Alert management to content that is questionable or that may be in violation of FCC, corporate or station policies and regulations.
  • Other duties as required by management.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Have a passion for the process of news and news story development.
  • Understanding of newsroom ethical and legal guidelines and restrictions that govern broadcast media.
  • Excellent editorial judgment and deep understanding of current events, politics and news.
  • Keen awareness of the current socio-political landscape, and the ability to separate personal political and social views from influencing story selection and presentation.
  • Contemporary sound and excellent on-air delivery and storytelling skills.
  • Write for both styles of distribution (on-air and digital) and include audio and/or video.
  • Thrive under pressure, especially during breaking news, severe weather, and unrelenting news deadlines.
  • Comfort with on-camera work for social and digital distribution.
  • Fully utilize all the tools of broadcast and social media in the field (Twitter, Facebook, live and recorded video and audio equipment, etc.) 
  • Technical proficiency of audio and video recording equipment and editing software.
  • Proficiency in editing and packaging news sound and interviews.
  • Possess strong multi-tasking skills, and the ability to quickly pivot and produce content spontaneously based on changing news, breaking news, severe weather, etc.
  • Positive and effective communication with team members, advertisers, newsmakers, stringers and network counterparts, listeners and the general public.
  • Understanding of target demographics, and target topics/beats for news coverage.
  • Proficient with basic computer software skills, including Gmail and Slack.

 

Preferred:

  • Familiarity with the Dallas-Fort Worth news environment.
  • 4 year degree in journalism.
  • 1+ years of experience in an active newsroom environment.
  • 1+ years anchoring or reporting news for broadcast or digital media.
  • Burli or (similar news content management system) experience.
  • Experience updating stories on digital CMS platforms (i.e. - WordPress, etc)
  • Ability to edit video, overlay graphics and/or subtitles, etc.
  • Graphic editing skills, and use of products for visual storytelling, such as Canva.

Overview:

 

Audacy Richmond seeks a Promotions Technician for outside field broadcast work. This position is for a versatile utility player capable of performing entry level tasks in the Promotions and Programming departments and maintaining readiness of our branding equipment and vehicle fleet.

The anticipated starting salary range for Virginia-based individuals expressing interest in this position is $21.00/Hr... 

Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

 

This is an evergreen job post, which we refresh approximately every 90 days to maintain an active pool of candidates. While we may not have an immediate opening, we continuously build connections with professionals interested in future opportunities. By submitting your application, you’ll become part of our talent community. We will reach out directly to explore the fit. We appreciate your interest and look forward to reviewing your application!

 

 

Responsibilities

Responsibilities:

  • Maintain readiness of all promotional equipment and station vehicles.
  • Develop and maintain organizational procedures for broadcast equipment.
  • Engineer and execute live remote broadcasts utilizing IP technology.
  • Facilitate, attend, set-up and operate a live performance studio as FOH sound engineer.
  • Be the go-to person for remote broadcast vans equipped with generators and pneumatic masts
  • Assist with setup and repair of broadcast gear, sound equipment (mobile audio, video, and transmission equipment), office equipment and furniture.
  • Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned.

 

Additional considerations:

 

A Promotions Technician for outside field broadcast work is a specialized field engineer who sets up, operates, and maintains mobile audio, video, and transmission equipment on-site for live sports, news, and entertainment events. Overview:

Build Your Business. Grow Your Clients. Grow Your Income.

 

Audacy Houston is looking for a motivated, creative and driven Account Executive to join our sales team.

 

This is an opportunity for someone who wants to build a business, not just manage a list of accounts. You’ll work with local, regional and national businesses to understand their goals, uncover opportunities and create marketing solutions that help them grow.

 

You’ll have access to one of the most powerful media portfolios in the market, including iconic radio brands, streaming audio, podcasts, digital marketing solutions, video, OTT, social, events, sponsorships and original content. You’ll also have the opportunity to sell campaigns beyond Houston through Audacy’s extensive national footprint.

 

If you’re competitive, curious, persistent and motivated by the opportunity to make money based on your success, we want to meet you.

 

Why Join Audacy Houston?

 

The opportunity to sell a powerful combination of radio, streaming, podcasts, digital, video, events, sponsorships and content

The ability to build campaigns for local, regional and national advertisers

Access to major Houston events and opportunities, including Houston Texans programming, Rodeo, Radio Row, and more.

Ongoing coaching, training and development to help you become a better salesperson

A collaborative sales environment where ideas, creativity and teamwork matter

The tools, research and resources you need to prospect, sell and grow your business

Competitive base salary plus commission and bonus opportunities, including additional earning potential beyond quota attainment

The opportunity to bring creative marketing ideas to life and see the impact they have on your clients' businesses

  • Ability to learn and confidently present new products and marketing solutions
  • Valid driver's license and satisfactory completion of a motor vehicle record check. Reliable transportation and valid insurance is required.

 

The Bottom Line

 

If you’re someone who wants to build relationships, create opportunities, win new business and control your earning potential, this could be the opportunity for you.

Department: Technical

Employment Type: Full-Time

Overview:

Audacy is seeking a talented Regional Staff Engineer to join our Houston-based engineering team. This hands-on role is ideal for a proactive professional with robust radio broadcast engineering skills and the flexibility to provide support and travel to multiple markets.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Maintain, inspect, and repair all broadcast radio station equipment, including high power FM + HD, AM, digital audio & audio streaming, studio equipment, automation systems, remote control equipment, remote broadcast equipment, satellite downlinks, network infrastructure, generators, backup power systems, and related equipment in keeping with good engineering practices.
  • Support studio operations by managing AOIP networks, studio hardware, UPS systems, remote control equipment, and VOIP/telephone systems.
  • Ensure regulatory compliance by reviewing weekly transmitter and studio logs, EAS tests, and tower lighting requirements per F.C.C. regulations.
  • Install and troubleshoot broadcast IT systems, including WideOrbit and Axia, at both studio and transmitter sites.
  • Oversee critical infrastructure maintenance, including generator testing, fueling, and UPS system supervision.
  • Collaborate with the Corporate Networking Team and vendors to manage ISP/Networking circuits and service calls.
  • Assist in the technical planning and development of facilities, including data networks and backup power systems.
  • Develop instructional materials and provide training for operators on technical equipment and systems.
  • Provide 24/7 emergency support for equipment failures, including availability for weekends and holidays as required.
  • Maintain broadcast IT systems at studios and transmitter sites, such as WideOrbit and Axia 
  • Assist in planning and development of all aspects of technical facilities including studios, transmitters, AOIP, VOIP, satellite, STL, computers and data networks
  • Create instructional materials and teach operators to use technical equipment and systems
  • Handle ISP/Networking problems and service calls. Work with Corp Networking Team, Vendor Technicians to install and troubleshoot circuits.

  • Effectively communicate and partner with programming staff as well as outside partners.

Required:

job.description:
Overview

Job Title: Sales Assistant

 

Department: Sales

 

Reporting To: SVP Sales

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Work Arrangement: In Office

 

 

Job Description:

 

Audacy is seeking a dynamic, detail-oriented, and driven Sales Assistant to support our growing media and sales team. This is an ideal role for someone looking to build a career in media sales. You will work closely with Account Executives to ensure flawless execution of advertising campaigns across multiple platforms including radio, digital, social, podcast, and streaming and more.

You will play a key role in supporting strategic planning, media proposals, and account management to help deliver and drive new business growth.

 

Audacy offers full time employees with a comprehensive benefits package to include:  health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, vacation, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, discounted employee stock purchase, student loan payment assistance program, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

 

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

 

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Support & Campaign Execution:

 

  • Research target companies, industry news, and business trends to uncover insights that support sales outreach.
  • Develop value-based research(VBR) points that align with prospect needs and position our solutions effectively.
  • Assist Account Executives in preparing proposals and building strategic media plans
  • Track emerging industry themes and competitor activity to keep the sales team apprised of market developments.
  • Maintain organized research notes within Salesforce/CRM to ensure insights are actionable and easily accessible.

Client Communication & Relationship Management:

  • Serve as a liaison between clients and internal departments to ensure campaign objectives and timelines are met.
  • Help manage day-to-day communication and support requests from clients and internal departments such as marketing, and brand managers.
  • Coordinate with the Traffic Department on creative assets, instructions, and troubleshooting.

 Administrative & Reporting Tasks:

  • Create and update sales presentations, media kits, and one-sheets.
  • Consolidate and analyze campaign data to support strategic recommendations and reporting.
  • Maintain organized research notes within Salesforce/CRM to ensure insights are actionable and easily accessible.

Team Collaboration & Learning:

  • Participate in sales meetings, trainings, and client events as needed.
  • Stay up to date on new media products including podcasting, streaming, OTT, email, SEO/SEM, and social advertising.
  • Proactively identify opportunities to enhance processes and client offerings.

Qualifications

Desired Skills & Qualifications:

Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or related field.
  • 1–3 years of experience in media, advertising, marketing, or sales support.
  • Familiarity with paid social platforms (Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok) and digital marketing best practices.
  • Strong organizational, multitasking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong research and analytical skills with attention to detail.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, Google Workspace, and CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce).
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to translate business news and trends into meaningful sales insights.
  • Self-starter with curiosity about industries, companies, and market drivers.

Audacy Rochester seeks a Promotions Technician for outside field work. This position is for a versatile utility player capable of performing entry level tasks in the Promotions and Programming departments and maintaining readiness of our branding equipment and vehicle fleet.

The anticipated starting salary range for New York-based individuals expressing interest in this position is $21.00/Hr...
