job.title: Newsroom Operations Manager
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The Role

The New York Times is looking for an operational owner and highly organized self-starter to join our Newsroom Operations team as an Operations Manager. You will provide hands-on support and oversight of numerous logistics involved in the smooth daily operation of several assigned department(s) – News Platforms and Data, T Magazine and others.

We are looking for a quick learner and creative problem solver who is capable of handling the ever-changing demands of a fast-paced newsroom environment. You will guide tasks across the finish line for the desks in the newsroom. Key to this will be supporting members of our masthead and our journalists with a variety of daily responsibilities and short- and long-term projects. This includes being at the center of on-the-ground coordination of both in-office and offsite events, ensuring execution of on-site logistics and meals for key news coverage events, ensuring that administrative operational tasks are completed by internal deadlines so that operations on the desk run continually and uninterrupted. You will report directly to a Senior Manager of Newsroom Operations.

This role will be Hybrid, with a required in-office presence of 4 days a week. The schedule of these 4 days can fluctuate based on the needs of the desks, and during some peak news cycles, you may be required to be on site for 5 days during those weeks.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary, accountable operational contact for members of the masthead, department heads, and journalists, resolving operational roadblocks independently.
  • Responsible for on-site setup of various in-office events including mock elections, team all hands gatherings of staff from around the country, team lunches and various similar events, and also serving as a production coordinator for all such events. including live coverage setups, catering logistics, seating arrangements, and equipment deployment during breaking news cycles.
  • Oversee complex equipment setups for assigned desks, special coverage teams, and events, ensuring that all hardware, workstation, and specialized technical configurations in real-time to ensure journalists have fully functioning tools.
  • Work with the Newsroom Finance team to help create annual budgets and provide oversight of those budgets, including monthly closes, supplying additional financial reports.
  • Manage work and vacation schedules and maintain accurate time banks in Workday, and work with Payroll to verify time banks for transfers, departures, and annual payouts.
  • Manage a travel calendar and be sure anyone traveling on assignment is properly set up on the company's business travel accident insurance.
  • Approve expenses and travel costs in Workday.
  • Manage and process freelancers and vendors' payments, working with the Contracts Manager
  • Oversee accounts payable and accounts receivable for assigned departments
  • Work with HR and recruiting teams to assist with position management transactions
  • Facilitate Workday management, including onboarding new employees and helping them to get the training, equipment, and information they need
  • Keep staffing lists, org charts, and various email distribution lists up to date with any staffing changes in the department
  • Purchase supplies and equipment, keep track of all departmental expenses, including capital spending and outside vendor spending
  • Work in Zip for independent contractor onboarding, sourcing events and purchasing
  • Be available for a variety of tasks that come up, often urgently, including troubleshooting, assisting writers and editors,with on-site and off-site needs, etc.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience in an operational or administrative role
  • Ability to drive projects forward
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Experience dealing with detailed and confidential and private concerns
  • You can work and keep an optimistic attitude while maintaining a keen sense of urgency
  • Be accessible after hours or on weekends when circumstances require
  • Impeccable organizational and time management skills; ability to multitask, prioritize and work under deadline pressure
  • Ability to work with all levels of management and staff and manage the needs of a team of 100+ employees and leaders

job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

About the Role, Mission or Department Overview

The Research Director, Content Insights will have a critical role informing the creation, iteration and measurement of video and video products at the New York Times. You will lead all video measurement research to inform our understanding of how video content performs across platforms, surfaces, and audience segments. You will oversee the end-to-end measurement of video effectiveness, from individual videos to longer-form recurring concepts, and translate data into relevant strategies that inform production, distribution, and editorial decisions. You will also work with product, design, and editorial teams to improve on-platform video experiences.

You will report to the Managing Director, News Products on the Audience Insights Team and will collaborate with partners across the Newsroom. You understand how to blend market research and user research methods and practices into actionable insights for an entire mission.

This is a hybrid role based in our New York City headquarters. You can typically expect to come into the office 3 days per week.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop audience research to support the creation and growth of video franchises and recurring shows. Drawing on research methods used by production studios and streaming networks, you'll conduct research that can inform greenlight decisions — including concept testing, pilot testing, audience appetite studies, and competitive landscape analysis.
  • Partner with video leadership to evaluate whether a format, host, or editorial premise has the demand to sustain an audience over time. For existing shows, help build longitudinal tracking that monitors audience health: loyalty, satisfaction, and reasons for churn.
  • Help build a video performance tracking program grounded in survey-based measurement, tracking metrics like awareness, recall, engagement, and sentiment among defined audience segments over time.
  • Working alongside analytics teams, you'll help establish benchmarks, monitor performance across all surfaces where video is published (owned and operated, social, streaming), and develop a consistent cadence of reporting that gives editorial, product, and business stakeholders a reliable read on how our videos are landing with audiences.
  • Lead quantitative and qualitative research among target audiences to support video strategy and format development (e.g., format preference studies, thumbnail and title concept tests, viewer satisfaction studies). Partner with video producers and editors to understand their needs and scope appropriate methodologies, from brief development through questionnaire design, survey launch, and insight delivery.
  • Manage multiple research projects and ad-hoc requests simultaneously, developing timelines and planning resources.
  • Partner or lead research on other editorial projects and franchises, such as newsletters, podcasts, or other emerging products
  • Collaborate with research partners, analytics teams, and company partners.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the quality, speed, and effect of video measurement, including recommending new vendors, tools, and methodologies.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 10+ years of experience in market research, user research, or consumer insights, with an emphasis on multimodal and product research.
  • Proficiency in both qualitative and quantitative research methodologies and experience with continuous improvement and new ideas.
  • Experience leading all facets of a tracking program, including vendor relationships, questionnaire development, data mining, and reporting.
  • Fluency in analyzing large datasets, identifying insights, and creating clear reports.
  • Experience developing timelines across multiple projects, applying project management skills.
  • Experience managing external research partners/vendors.
  • Experience with visualization tools and creating compelling presentations.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • B.A./B.S. degree.

job.description:
Job Title

Security Operations Supervisor

Job Description

About The Position | Major Goals and Objectives and Location Requirements:

People Inc. is seeking an experienced Security Operations Supervisor to serve as a visible, hands-on uniformed leader supporting daily enterprise security operations. Reporting to the Manager, Security Operations, this position works alongside in-house and contracted security personnel across reception, patrol, events, incident response, and workplace security operations.

The Supervisor also works closely with the Manager, GSOC & Intelligence to assist with GSOC personnel and operations, coordinate field response, and maintain effective communication and situational awareness during incidents, special events, and periods of increased activity. The ideal candidate leads by example, remains calm under pressure, and is equally comfortable assisting employees, directing security personnel, and coordinating with executives, vendors, and public safety agencies.

Schedule Requirements:

Full In-Office

In-office Expectations: This position is a fully in-office role due to the nature of the work being done.
 

About The Team | The Team and/or Brand:

The Security team at People Inc. is responsible for ensuring the safety and security of employees, facilities, and assets across all office site locations. The team partners closely with contracted security staff, reception, facilities, event teams, and law enforcement agencies to deliver a consistent and resilient security program.

About The Position’s Contributions:

Weight % Accountabilities, Actions, and Expected Measurable Results

Operational Leadership

  • Provide visible, hands-on operational leadership and work alongside in-house and contracted security personnel during daily operations.

  • Coordinate reception, patrol, event security, contract personnel, and other operational resources during assigned shifts.

  • Ensure post orders, procedures, access-control requirements, and service standards are followed; inspect operations and help correct deficiencies.

Incident and Emergency Response

  • Serve as the senior uniformed operational resource during incidents, emergencies, and critical events until relieved by Security Management.

  • Direct field response, deploy resources, coordinate with the GSOC, and ensure required notifications, incident reports, and after-action documentation are completed.

  • Respond to medical incidents, evacuations, suspicious activity, workplace violence concerns, executive incidents, and other security events; coordinate with law enforcement, fire, EMS, and property management as needed.

GSOC Support and Coordination

  • Work closely with the Manager, GSOC & Intelligence to assist with GSOC personnel and daily operations.

  • Provide operational guidance and support during major incidents, special events, after-hours activity, and periods of elevated demand.

  • Coordinate field operations with GSOC monitoring, communications, incident documentation, enterprise notifications, and situational-awareness functions.

Physical Security and Event Operations

  • Support access control, visitor management, reception, patrol, alarm response, CCTV operations, facility inspections, and other physical security functions.

  • Assist with planning and on-site execution of internal meetings, executive events, corporate venue activities, and major public-facing events.

  • Direct event security staffing and deployment and coordinate with vendors, venue personnel, law enforcement, and emergency responders while maintaining a professional and welcoming environment.

Leadership, Training, and Operational Support

  • Coach and mentor security and GSOC personnel through daily guidance, real-time feedback, onboarding support, drills, and hands-on instruction.

  • Provide Security Management with objective feedback regarding performance, training needs, staffing concerns, and opportunities for improvement.

  • Assist with shift coverage, daily assignments, operational documentation, special projects, audits, and other duties as assigned.

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Education: 

Bachelor's degree in criminal justice, security management, emergency management, or a related field; equivalent professional experience will be considered.

job.title: VP, Recruiting
job.description:
Who We Are:

TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

TKO Group Holdings | Stamford, CT

ABOUT TKO

TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns and operates UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization, WWE, the recognized global leader in sports entertainment, Professional Bull Riders (PBR), the world’s premier bull riding organization, IMG, a global leader in sports, events, media, and fashion, and On Location, a premium experiential hospitality business. Together, these brands and businesses produce hundreds of live events annually, serve partners across the globe, and reach hundreds of millions of fans worldwide.

POSITION SUMMARY

TKO is looking for a VP, Recruiting to lead talent acquisition for UFC, WWE, Professional Bull Riders (PBR), and Zuffa Boxing. Reporting to the SVP, Global Recruiting and based in Stamford, CT, this leader will manage a team of three recruiters, oversee strategic search as well as TKO’s early careers internship program.

This is a role for someone who takes immense pride in their work, brings high standards, and earns a reputation as a trusted partner across the business. The VP, Recruiting will be just as comfortable building relationships on the floor of a live event as they are driving process and strategy from their desk. Presence and proximity to the businesses matter here. This person will be in Stamford 3–4 days per week, visit the NYC office frequently, and travel regularly to Las Vegas and Fort Worth to stay immersed in each business, know its leaders and employees, and maintain a pulse on the candidate market.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the team. Manage, develop, and inspire a team of three. Set high standards. Create an environment where the team does their best work, holds themselves accountable, and takes pride in the quality and consistency of what they deliver.

  • Set recruiting strategy. Develop and deliver recruiting strategies that align with the priorities of each business. Translate what UFC, WWE, PBR, and Zuffa Boxing need to grow into a clear, actionable talent plan. Revisit and adapt that plan as business needs evolve.

  • Partner with the business. Serve as the primary recruiting partner for UFC, WWE, PBR, and Zuffa Boxing. Build strong, trusted relationships with hiring managers and business leaders. Stay connected to each business’s culture, priorities, and talent needs. Show up, be present, and be known.

  • Drive results. Manage a high volume of searches without sacrificing quality. Fill roles efficiently, with the right candidates, and deliver a consistent hiring manager and candidate experience. Be measured by client feedback and satisfaction, and by the success of the people you place once they are in the building.

  • Build programs that scale. Lead the development and adoption of a referral program across UFC, WWE, PBR, and Zuffa Boxing. Drive meaningful usage of AI recruiting tools including Findem and Paradox. Strengthen TKO’s employer brand externally and internally.

  • Develop talent pipelines. Know the candidate market. Build and maintain relationships with top talent before the need arises. Think ahead of the business, not behind it.

  • Lead early careers. Oversee TKO’s early careers internship program with the same rigor and client-service mindset applied to all other recruiting activity.

  • Recruit for senior roles. In addition to leading the team, personally lead searches for senior and critical positions across the portfolio.

REQUIREMENTS

  • 10+ years of recruiting experience, with a proven track record leading teams and managing full-cycle searches across multiple business units or brands

  • A client-service mentality. You are responsive, proactive, and treat every hiring manager interaction as an opportunity to build trust and deliver value

  • Strong follow-up and follow-through. You close loops, update stakeholders without being asked, and never let things fall through the cracks

  • A reputation builder. The way you work and the quality of your output speak for themselves

  • Genuine curiosity about the businesses you support. You want to understand how UFC, WWE, PBR, Zuffa Boxing operate, who makes them run, and what talent they need to grow

  • Experience building or significantly scaling referral programs

  • Hands-on experience with AI recruiting tools and a drive to lead adoption across your team and business partners (experience with Findem and/or Paradox a plus)

  • A creative problem-solving approach. You find solutions, not obstacles

  • The ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment without letting quality slip

  • Comfort with regular travel to Las Vegas, NV and Fort Worth, TX

  • A bias toward presence. You understand that relationships are built in person and you show up accordingly

LOCATION

Stamford, CT (3–4 days per week in office), with frequent visits to the NYC office and regular travel to Las Vegas, NV and Fort Worth, TX.

job.title: Breaking News Politics Reporter (DC-Based)
job.description:
Job Description :

The New York Post provides readers with the best in News, Sports, Pop Culture, and Entertainment – with signature wit, irreverence, and authority, averaging 90 million unique monthly viewers. Over the past 225 years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television, and commerce.

Politics is core to who we are — and nobody covers it like The Post. We break big stories, stir the pot, and shine a light on what’s really going on in the nation’s capital. From policy drama and power grabs to scandals and backstabbing, we’re looking for someone who gets the whole DC circus and can help lead the way in breaking news.

The New York Post is seeking an enterprising DC-based Breaking News Politics Reporter (Sunday - Thursday) to join our growing DC team and cover the fast-moving world of Washington politics. This reporter will write about the big political stories of the day, spot trending news, and bring readers sharp, authoritative coverage of how decisions in the capital shape the nation.

Responsibilities:

  • Report and write breaking news and enterprise stories on DC politics and government actions.

  • Spot news from political interviews, speeches and social media postings

  • Land interviews with power brokers in DC politics 

  • Cover legislative battles, policy shifts, elections, and key political figures.

  • Break exclusive stories and find fresh angles on widely covered issues.

  • Build and maintain a strong network of sources, from lawmakers and lobbyists to administration and campaign officials. 

  • Stay on top of political developments in real time and file timely, accurate copy.

  • Use public records, FOIA requests, and social media to surface and verify stories.

  • Work closely with editors and colleagues to produce fast, engaging coverage across digital and social platforms.

Requirements:

  • Minimum three years of newsroom reporting experience, with a focus on DC or political coverage.

  • Experience writing about the White House and Congress and building sources within the Trump administration

  • Fast, accurate and efficient, high-impact reporting

  • Strong editorial judgment and writing skills under tight deadlines.

  • Available to work Sunday to Thursday 

  • Flexibility to work evenings and irregular hours as news demands.

job.title: Product Manager, Commerce Platform & Channels
job.description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses: 

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 

  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

A little bit about our team:

WMX, Warner Music Group’s culture-driving media, creative content, and artist services’ division, sets a new standard for artists, advertisers, and fans through world class experiences, award-winning creative content, and industry leading audience insights. At WMX (Warner Music Experience) we’re building the music industry’s most dynamic artist and fan-centric organization, creating fans and influencing culture through engaging content and best-in-class experiences. We partner with acclaimed brands and emerging artists to create innovative, authentic, world-class consumer experiences.

Ecommerce and Commerce Channels has grown to be a thriving business for artists and brands. Our team partners with artists, labels and executives to develop engaging artist stores, social activations, sales channel extensions and memorable customer experiences.  We develop best in class tools and processes to help internal teams efficiently deliver products and services to fans around the world.

 

Your role:

We're looking for a Product Manager to support development of the business strategy, roadmap, and execution for Warner Music's third-party commerce channels as an extension of our current eCommerce network of Shopify stores. This role will help expand how fans discover and purchase artist products beyond our standard storefronts by enabling scalable commerce experiences across social platforms, third-party marketplaces, emerging AI-powered shopping experiences, and future sales channels.

Working closely with ecommerce operations, merchandising, marketing, analytics, label / artist teams and external platform partners, you'll support opportunities to increase reach, improve operational efficiency, and drive incremental revenue through innovative commerce capabilities.

Here you’ll get to:

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for third-party commerce channels that extend our Shopify storefronts, catalogs and customer reach
  • Support the evaluation and implementation of new Shopify apps, platform capabilities, and third-party sales channel  integrations that improve the fan experience and business performance
  • Define requirements, and success metrics; support product delivery from discovery through launch and continuous optimization
  • Partner with internal stakeholders and external technology providers to successfully launch and optimize new commerce capabilities
  • Stay informed on emerging commerce trends, including AI-powered shopping, agentic commerce and new digital sales channels and share ideas that enhance the fan experience and support business growth
  • Educate stakeholders on current and developing capabilities and establish best practices for re-use of mature capabilities across our roster of artists and stores
  •  

About you:

  • 2-3 years of Product Management experience, with a background in eCommerce or digital commerce
  • Experience supporting products or integrations that drive online commerce, marketplaces, social commerce or digital sales channels
  • Experience working with Shopify or similar eCommerce platforms
  • Understanding of product catalogs, inventory, order management and third-party integrations
  • Proven ability to work cross-functionally with development, design, operations, marketing and external partners
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with stakeholders at all levels

We’d love it if you also had:

  • Comfortable using data to prioritize product decisions and measure business impact
  • Experience owning a product area with measurable revenue, conversion, or customer growth goals
  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

CBS News and Stations is dedicated to providing the highest quality journalism under standards it pioneered and continues to set in today’s digital age. CBS News earns more prestigious journalism awards than any other broadcast news division.  

 

Project Overview

The CBS News & Stations archive is one of the world’s largest and most valuable collections of its kind. Housing millions of original assets dating back to before the 1950s, it represents an extraordinary record of American history, journalism, culture, and broadcast media.

 

CBS News & Stations has launched a major initiative to digitize, catalog, and enrich more than 3 million film reels, videotapes, and audio reels. This initiative includes one of the largest robotic tape digitization operations in existence, paired with cloud-based systems and AI-supported metadata workflows operating at significant scale.

 

SAMMA is CBS News Archives’ robotic tape digitization system. It is used to migrate legacy videotape formats into digital files as part of the broader preservation and access initiative.

 

Position Summary

CBS News Archives is seeking SAMMA Digitization Operators to support this large-scale archive digitization initiative. These roles are part of the end-to-end digitization workflow, with an initial emphasis on preparing archival videotape media for migration through SAMMA digitization systems.

 

Primary responsibilities will initially include tape preparation, barcode application, tape identification, metadata entry, sorting, staging, workflow tracking, and ensuring a steady supply of prepared tapes for digitization. As operational needs evolve and training progresses, SAMMA Digitization Operators may also be assigned to operate SAMMA digitization systems, monitor ingest workflows, troubleshoot routine workflow issues, perform quality-control checks, and support related archive digitization activities, including film preparation and film digitization workflows.

 

The ideal candidates are detail-oriented, reliable, comfortable following specific workflows, and able to work carefully with physical media and metadata entry. Prior experience with broadcast archives, videotape formats, film handling, digitization, media asset management systems, or production operations is helpful, but not required if candidates are organized, trainable, and consistent.

 

Location, Hours, and Compensation

  • These positions are based onsite at the CBS News Archives facility in Metropark/Iselin, NJ.
  • Expected schedule is 40 hours per week. Hours may include nights and weekends depending on operational needs.

Job Title

Director, Data Science

Job Description

About The Position | Major Goals and Objectives and Location Requirements:

People Inc. is America’s largest print and digital publisher, reaching tens of millions of readers every day. We’re hiring a Director of Data Science to lead customer intelligence and personalization for our entertainment brands, helping shape products and experiences that inform, engage, and inspire our audiences.

In this role, you’ll build a deeper understanding of our customers across product engagement, marketing response, and lifecycle behavior. You’ll partner closely with Product, Marketing, and Editorial teams to turn data into actionable insights that drive growth, while working with Data Operations and Engineering to ensure our models, measurement systems, and insights can scale effectively.

You’ll apply statistical modeling and machine learning to product and marketing challenges across customer segmentation, acquisition, engagement, retention, and lifetime value, with a particular focus on mobile app experiences. You’ll own models and analyses that support personalization, automated marketing, attribution, experimentation, and lifecycle optimization across apps, newsletters, and other customer touchpoints, translating complex audience behavior into clear recommendations and measurable business impact.

Schedule Requirements:

In-office Expectations:

This position is fully remote with no in-office requirements, (might require coming into an office periodically for team meetings, etc.)

About The Team | The Team and/or Brand:

People Inc. is the largest premium publisher in the world. Every day, tens of millions of people come to us for help and inspiration. Our library of hundreds of thousands of articles helps our users understand how to deal with day-to-day challenges. You will work with a team of data scientists, collaborating with cross-functional groups to leverage this incredible dataset to understand both our content and our users' needs. This knowledge will be used to identify and build out new products that leverage the behavioral information within our extensive data.

About The Position’s Contributions:

Weight % Accountabilities, Actions, and Expected Measurable Results

  • Lead and grow a data science team to develop predictive models that estimate customer lifetime value using advanced statistical and machine learning techniques.

  • Analyze and understand customer interactions across app, web, social media, and email touchpoints to identify and optimize engagement opportunities.

  • Own product funnel and engagement analysis, including onboarding completion, feature adoption, feature stickiness, and session behavior, as distinct from marketing-funnel metrics such as acquisition and retention.

  • Leverage data-driven insights to build customer segmentation models, identifying high-value users and informing content and product recommendations.

  • Partner with Product and Editorial teams to translate user understanding into differentiated experiences across the app, newsletters, and other customer interactions, feeding insights directly into the product development cycle. This includes the sizing of opportunities and assessment of product success.

  • Design online A/B testing experiments to measure the impact of product changes, personalization, and full-funnel marketing interventions.

  • Ensure effective collaboration between data science teams and other departments.

  • Advocate for resources and tools to advance data capabilities.

  • Align data initiatives with company objectives.

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements:

PhD or advanced degree in Data Science, Economics, Business Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics, or similar quantitative field, or equivalent experience.

Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience leading a team of data scientists.

  • Experience working with large-scale analytics platforms (e.g., BigQuery).

  • Advanced experimentation techniques, including multivariate testing, factorial designs, and CUPED.

  • Experience with Bayesian statistical methods for inference and decision-making under uncertainty.

  • Experience with forecasting models and advanced lifecycle or retention modeling.

job.description:
Job Title

Senior Data Scientist

Job Description

 

About The Position |

As a Senior Data Scientist for personalization, you will own the science behind the recommendation engine that powers each user’s personalized product feed. Starting from our user-saved product signals and a live catalog ingested from thousands of retailer feeds, you will design, build, evaluate, and continuously improve the models that learn each user’s taste across brand, category, color, price point, and fit.

 

This is a hands-on, full-cycle role. You will take a recommendation problem from raw data all the way to a production model running on our existing MLOps stack — you own the model layer, not the infrastructure. Our platform team already operates the feature store, serving, and autoscaling; your job is to decide what to model, prove it works through rigorous offline and online experimentation, ship it, and iterate as behavioral signals accumulate.

 

A defining challenge of this role is cold-start. We are launching with a small behavioral dataset and a catalog scaling from hundreds of thousands of products toward tens of millions. You will need strong commerce and product-data intuition to produce high-quality recommendations before rich click data exists — and the experimental discipline to keep improving them as it arrives. This is a foundational hire that will shape how millions of users discover products they love.

 

Remote or Hybrid 3x a week NYC

In-office Expectations: This position offers remote work flexibility; however, if you reside within a commutable distance our offices in New York, the expectation is to work from the office three days per week.

 

About The Team: |

_______________________________________________________________________________

Our next-generation product discovery platform connects shoppers with the things they love across thousands of retail partners. Users save, organize, and share products they're excited about — and our platform turns those signals into a deeply personalized shopping experience. We ingest live product feeds from thousands of retailers and use a rich understanding of each user's taste to surface the right product at the right moment.

 

We're building the recommendation engine at the heart of this shopping experience — a system that understands not just what people save, but why they save it. This is a foundational hire that will shape how millions of users discover products they love.

About The Positions Contributions:

  • 35% Recommendation & Personalization Modeling

    Own the design and development of the core recommendation models that turn user-saved product data into a personalized feed. Develop multi-signal models spanning brand affinity, category, color/visual attributes, fit and sizing, price sensitivity, and trend. Select and justify approaches across collaborative filtering, matrix factorization, content-based, and hybrid/neural methods (e.g., two-tower and other embedding models), and know when each applies. Build product and user embeddings that capture semantic similarity across the catalog and power candidate generation and retrieval. Design cold-start strategies that produce high-quality recommendations for new users and newly ingested products with little or no behavioral history.

    25% Experimentation & Measurement

    Define what “good” personalization means and how it is measured. Establish rigorous offline evaluation (ranking and relevance metrics, sound holdout design) and connect it to online outcomes. Design, run, and read out A/B and multivariate experiments, and translate results into clear product and business decisions. Bring statistical discipline — sound experiment design, awareness of bias and confounding, and honest interpretation — so the team can trust which changes actually move engagement.

    20% Data, Signals & Feature Understanding

    Develop deep intuition for Picksy’s product catalog and user signals. Turn implicit behavior (saves, clicks, dwell, shares) and catalog attributes into meaningful model features, writing SQL against BigQuery to pull, join, and shape raw data into training/evaluation datasets. Apply NLP and computer-vision techniques — including modern embedding and LLM-based approaches — to extract structured attributes (category, color, material, fit) from unstructured product descriptions and imagery, and to enrich sparse catalog data. Partner with data engineering on data quality, freshness, and coverage as the catalog scales from hundreds of thousands toward tens of millions of products.

    20% Full-Cycle Ownership & Productionization

    Take models from prototype to production yourself. Write clean, production-quality code and deploy into the existing MLOps pipeline (feature store, training, serving, monitoring) rather than building infrastructure from scratch. Own model performance in production: instrument it, watch for drift and degradation, and iterate as behavioral signals accumulate. Document models, features, and decisions clearly, and collaborate closely with the MLOps, engineering, and product teams to integrate the model layer into the live product.

Education:

Master's degree or higher in Computer Science, Statistics, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative field; or equivalent practical experience.

Experience:

You combine the modeling depth of an applied/data scientist with the pragmatism to ship end-to-end. You bring:

  • Strong data science fundamentals: statistics, experimental design, and evaluation methodology, with the analytical ability to turn model results into clear product and business decisions.

  • Demonstrated ownership of the full A/B testing lifecycle: designing experiments, running them, reading them out, and deciding; not just reporting offline metrics.

  • Experience designing, training, and deploying embedding models and vector retrieval (e.g., Milvus, Pinecone, or Vertex AI Vector Search) for product or content similarity at catalog scale.

  • Direct experience with cold-start / sparse-signal personalization: building useful recommendations from a new catalog, new users, or both. This is a core, day-one challenge of the role.

  • Strong Python and modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX) plus the standard scientific stack (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn). You write production-quality code, not just notebooks.

  • Strong SQL: hands-on experience querying large datasets in a cloud data warehouse (BigQuery preferred) to pull, join, and assemble the training and evaluation datasets that feed your models. This is a daily part of the role.

  • Experience deploying and serving models on a cloud ML platform: GCP Vertex AI strongly preferred (SageMaker or equivalent acceptable) and you are comfortable owning the full model lifecycle: training, deployment, versioning, and monitoring.

  • Commerce intuition: you’ve worked with product catalogs and understand merchandising, category, and PM concerns. It shows up in how you talk about catalogs and taste, not just models.

  • Curiosity and pragmatism about emerging AI, particularly LLMs and modern retrieval/ranking, with a track record of bringing new techniques into real production use.

  • Strong written and verbal communication; able to explain technical tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 

Nice to have:

  • Applied NLP and/or computer vision for extracting structured attributes from product text and imagery.

  • Experience with adaptive recommendation and experimentation methods; multi-armed or contextual bandits.

  • Public writing or conference talks on recommendation, personalization, or ranking work.

  • Early-stage or commerce experience where you wore multiple hats and shipped against real business metrics (e.g., commerce SaaS or a vertical commerce startup).

job.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Content Engineering
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

  Overview   We are seeking a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to lead the development of our multimodal embedding and retrieval systems that power content discovery across Paramount's video library. In this role, you will own the full lifecycle of multi-modal embedding systems, optimized for text and video understanding, from generation, ingestion and indexing, to retrieval — directly impacting how millions of users discover and engage with short-form clips.   You will partner with product leadership, Content and Personalization engineering teams, mentor engineers and serve as a senior technical voice shaping how the platform "sees" and retrieves video clip content at scale.   The ideal candidate will be:
  • A hands-on systems builder who takes full ownership of pipelines that enable storing, indexing, and querying high-dimensional vector embeddings
  • Skilled at designing hybrid retrieval systems that combine vector similarity, lexical search, and reranking
  • Invested in multimodal video understanding as the foundation for meaningful content representations
  • Skilled at translating embedding system tradeoffs — latency, recall, cost — into product-relevant context that drives cross-functional decisions
  • Committed to mentoring and knowledge sharing with engineering resources
  • Effective at operating in a dynamic environment and comfortable taking ownership of project outcomes end-to-end


Responsibilities

Video Understanding & Multimodal Embedding

  • Design and build embedding pipelines for video content metadata and clip-level representation
  • Design collection and vector schemas to shape data structure, indexing behavior, and retrieval performance under scale and modality complexity
  • Lead the transition from traditional feature engineering to a vector-centric "context-first" architecture, through compositional queries and by designing high-dimensional hyper-vector representations that unify visual, textual, and behavioral signals
  • Design offline/online evaluation frameworks (e.g., nDCG, MRR, Recall@K) specifically for multimodal alignment, ensuring content embeddings match search intent
  Vector Search & Retrieval Infrastructure
  • Build hybrid retrieval systems that combine vector similarity search with lexical search and reranking layers to deliver fast, accurate, and scalable performance at production scale
  • Engineer the retrieval layer to capture nuanced user-content relationships that model training alone cannot surface, combining multimodal embeddings to improve recommendation depth at scale
  • Implement query-time optimizations including caching, filtering, and index sharding strategies
  • Tune vector quantization strategies (PQ, SQ, Binary Quantization) to reduce memory footprint and improve search throughput without compromising retrieval precision
  • Own performance SLAs and monitor retrieval systems for latency, throughput, recall, and cost efficiency
  Production Systems, Pipeline Engineering & APIs
  • Build and maintain scalable batch and streaming pipelines, with logging, metrics, and alerting to surface anomalies and maintain observability
  • Process content at scale using distributed frameworks such as Spark or Ray
  • Architect and build scalable integration layers on top of vector databases, exposing robust APIs and services for similarity search, hybrid retrieval, and metadata filtering
  • Own model versioning and embedding migration strategies, building compatibility tooling that prevents embedding drift from degrading retrieval quality across model upgrades
  • Collaborate with backend and platform teams to ensure interoperability with upstream data pipelines and integration with downstream personalization and discovery surfaces
  Cross-Functional Leadership & Collaboration
  • Communicate technical system behavior, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Mentor direct reports, providing technical guidance in multimodal ML, vector retrieval, and production systems design
  • Take ownership of project outcomes from scoping through delivery in a dynamic environment, proactively identifying and mitigating risks across video processing, metadata, and indexing workflows


Basic Qualifications

  • 5–8+ years of experience in machine learning engineering, with a focus on production ML systems
  • Expertise in multimodal ML, including experience with video, image, and/or audio embedding models
  • Deep knowledge of vector embedding generation, storage and retrieval, with preference for hands-on Qdrant experience (FAISS, Pinecone, Pgvector, AlloyDB or similar also considered)
  • Strong Python proficiency; Java is a plus
  • Demonstrated experience building and operating data pipelines at scale, including batch and streaming ingestion workflows
  • Solid understanding of hybrid retrieval systems: vector search, lexical search, and reranking
  • Proven ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and partner effectively with product and engineering teams
  • Track record of mentoring engineers and leading technical decisions in a team setting


Additional Qualifications

  • Experience with agentic systems and multi-agent orchestration
  • Knowledge of Diversity & Relevance algorithms such as Maximal Marginal Relevance (MMR) within the re-ranking phase
  • Background in video codecs, FFmpeg, or low-level video processing pipelines
  • Awareness with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems

job.title: Brand Designer, Video
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Application Deadline: Please submit your application by 5:00 pm EST on Friday, October 2nd, 2026.

Intro to Position

This is a union-represented role covered under the terms of a collective bargaining agreement with DMU.

The Brand Designer (Video) creates compelling visual stories that bring the NPR brand to life.

This role develops, produces, and edits existing video assets, as well as shooting original video content that supports NPR's communications, fundraising, executive communications, recruitment, employee engagement, events, and strategic initiatives. Working closely with creative, communications and marketing colleagues, the Brand Designer (Video) helps tell the story of NPR through thoughtful, audience-centered visual storytelling, and supports the objectives of marketing campaigns.

The ideal candidate is an experienced producer with strong creative instincts, excellent technical skills, and a passion for telling authentic stories. They are equally comfortable developing a concept, interviewing subjects, directing a shoot, editing the final piece, and collaborating with colleagues across the organization to produce work that reflects the quality and integrity of the NPR brand.

Responsibilities

Lead video storytelling

  • Develop original video concepts that communicate NPR's mission, impact, and institutional priorities.
  • Produce videos that support fundraising, executive communications, recruitment, internal communications, events, member station engagement, and other strategic initiatives.
  • Identify stories that highlight the people, partnerships, and work behind NPR's public service mission.
  • Collaborate with the creative team to translate organizational priorities into compelling visual stories.
  • Recommend creative approaches that strengthen audience engagement and understanding.

Manage productions from concept to completion

  • Lead every stage of the production process.
  • Develop concepts, scripts, interview approaches, production plans, and schedules.
  • Produce and direct interviews and field productions.
  • Capture high-quality video and audio in studio and on location.
  • Edit, color correct, mix audio, and deliver finished content optimized for multiple platforms.
  • Manage graphics, captions, music licensing, and other post-production elements.

Elevate the NPR brand through visual storytelling

  • Help establish a distinctive visual style for non-editorial video that reflects NPR's values and creative standards.
  • Maintain consistency in visual quality, tone, pacing, and storytelling across projects.
  • Experiment with new formats and production techniques while ensuring every piece serves a clear communications objective.
  • Balance creativity with accessibility and audience needs.

Manage production operations

  • Plan and coordinate multiple productions simultaneously.
  • Manage production schedules and logistics.
  • Coordinate freelancers, vendors, talent, and production partners when needed.
  • Maintain production equipment and recommend future investments.
  • Organize footage and production assets to support efficient collaboration and reuse.
  • Help improve production workflows and best practices across the creative team.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 3-5 years of professional video production experience.
  • Demonstrated experience producing, directing, shooting, and editing high-quality video content.
  • Strong portfolio showcasing documentary, institutional, branded, or mission-driven storytelling.
  • Advanced proficiency with Adobe Premiere Pro and other professional editing software.
  • Experience with lighting, audio recording, camera operation, and field production.
  • Excellent storytelling, interviewing, and project management skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a collaborative environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience producing executive communications, fundraising videos, or institutional storytelling.
  • Familiarity with motion graphics, animation, photography, or drone production.
  • Experience directing non-professional talent and conducting interviews.

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Strong visual storytelling instincts.
  • Excellent production planning and organizational skills.
  • Curiosity and empathy when working with interview subjects.
  • Creativity balanced with sound editorial judgment.
  • Strong collaboration and relationship-building skills.
  • Adaptability and comfort working in fast-moving environments.
  • Attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • A willingness to learn new tools, techniques, and technologies.
  • Sound judgment and professionalism in representing NPR.

Education Requirements

  • Equivalent hands-on experience, in lieu of a bachelor’s degree.

Work Location & Requirements

  • NPR Remote-Permitted: This is a remote-permitted role. This role is based out of our Washington, D.C. office, but the employee may choose to work on a remote basis from a location that NPR approves. You will have the option of working (a) remotely from a location of your choosing within the United States that is supported by NPR; (b) on-site at an NPR facility, based on the availability of desks and approval from NPR; or (c) a combination of both. Regardless of where you choose to work from, you may be expected to travel to other locations from time to time to perform the duties of your position.

Job Type

  • This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S.-based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $105,311.85 - $114,518.47 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

NPR Benefits: NPR provides comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees.

Inspiring People to Move Closer to Jesus

 

At K-LOVE, every role is ministry.

The Senior Campaign Manager is responsible for leading the planning, execution, and optimization of integrated, multi-channel marketing campaigns in support of assigned brand and product lines. job.description:
Hearst Television is seeking an experienced Senior Account Executive to join our corporate OTT team. You will be instrumental in expanding and driving national OTT business growth through strategic relationships with major holding companies and independent agencies, as well as direct brand partnerships. You have a proven track record in OTT/CTV sales, with a robust network of agency and client contacts nationwide. 

 

Key Responsibilities

  • National Sales Focus: 
    • Drive and close new business opportunities to meet and exceed revenue goals, focusing on national accounts within the OTT/CTV space
  • Agency & Brand Relationships: 
    • Leverage deep relationships with agency contacts and brand clients to foster new opportunities and manage existing accounts
  • Sales Strategy Execution: 
    • Develop and execute a comprehensive strategy for generating new business, with an emphasis on high-quality, solution-based selling for OTT products
  • Collaboration & Team Leadership: 
    • Work cross-functionally with product, account management, and ad operations teams to ensure seamless implementation and delivery of campaigns
  • Account Management: 
    • Oversee the complete sales cycle, from initial outreach through negotiation and campaign execution, ensuring client satisfaction and retention
  • Market Insights & Reporting: 
    • Stay current on industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitive landscape in OTT and CTV; provide regular reporting on sales metrics and market feedback

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 5 years of OTT/CTV sales experience with a history of meeting or exceeding sales goals
  • Established relationships with key decision-makers at both agencies and brands, with a focus on traditionally national accounts
  • Demonstrated expertise in consultative selling and ability to deliver complex solutions to a variety of clients
  • Exceptional written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Self-starter who is highly motivated, goal-oriented, and can thrive in a fast-paced environment
  • Must be based in or near New York City, with the ability to travel as needed for client meetings and industry events (approximately 25-40% travel)

Values in Action

At Hearst Television we tell stories every day. Stories about people of all backgrounds, perspective, and identities. job.title: Seasonal Senior Coordinator, Studio Technical Operations
job.description:
The Senior Coordinator, Operations provides hands-on technical and operational support to the Director of Production Operations, keeping control room, stage, and studio environments production-ready at all times. The role performs pre-production checks and first-line troubleshooting of router and comms panels, cameras, IFB and mic belt packs, stage lighting, replay, graphics, and audio systems, escalating unresolved faults to Engineering with documented detail. In partnership with Production Management, Scheduling, and Facilities, the Coordinator also confirms daily crew and resource readiness and manages equipment logistics, shipping, and staging for studio, remote, and tentpole productions. Administratively, the role maintains asset records, procurement and purchase order tracking, SOPs, and incident logs that support uninterrupted production. 

Responsibilities

  • Provide first-line troubleshooting and technical support for control room and stage equipment, including router panels, comms panels, cameras, IFB and mic belt packs, stage lighting, EVS systems, Vizrt graphics systems, and associated audio equipment.

Required Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in operations coordination, procurement, or asset management within a broadcast, media, or technical production environment.
  • Working knowledge of broadcast control room and stage systems, including router and comms panels, cameras, IFB and wireless mic belt packs, stage lighting, replay and graphics systems, and associated audio equipment.
  • Demonstrated ability to perform pre-production technical checks, isolate and troubleshoot equipment faults under live production conditions, and escalate unresolved issues to Engineering with clear, documented detail.
  • Advanced Microsoft Office 365 skills, including Excel, Outlook, Word, and Teams, with experience building and maintaining trackers, logs, and operational records.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and multitasking abilities in a fast-paced production setting.

Preferred Qualifications 

  • Prior experience in a broadcast facility, live event, or technical operations environment.
  • Hands-on experience with broadcast engineering equipment such as Evertz or Grass Valley routing, RTS or Clear-Com intercom and IFB systems, studio camera systems, EVS replay, Vizrt graphics, and digital audio consoles.
  • Experience with production management tools such as Media Pulse.
  • Experience using Oracle and ServiceNow for purchase orders, asset records, and ticket-based workflows.
  • Experience coordinating shipping, receiving, and equipment logistics for remote or tentpole productions.
  • Familiarity with SharePoint, Microsoft Forms, and Power Automate for request intake, tracking, and document management. 

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Composure and decisiveness under live production conditions, where equipment issues must be diagnosed and resolved quickly.
  • Proactive problem resolution; anticipates operational and technical needs before they affect production.
  • Sound operational judgment when prioritizing tasks, escalating faults, and balancing competing demands.
  • Cross-functional collaboration across Engineering, Production Management, Scheduling, Facilities, and Operations.
  • Precision and accountability; maintains meticulous equipment, procurement, and incident records with minimal oversight.
  • Safety-minded approach to equipment handling, cable management, and studio and stage work.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, time management, attention to detail, and ability to work under pressure. 

Physical Demands 

  • Ability to lift and transport equipment up to 50 lbs and to support equipment setup, strike, and staging.

job.title: Morning Anchor/MMJ, KGUN
job.description:
At KGUN, we believe local journalism makes a difference in people's lives every day. We're looking for a Morning Anchor who is much more than a presenter behind the desk. You'll be a storyteller, a reporter, and a visible presence in the Tucson community, helping our audience start their day informed and connected. This role is ideal for a journalist who loves uncovering original stories, building relationships, and being where the news is happening. If you're passionate about meaningful reporting and committed to journalism that serves the community, we'd love to hear from you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Anchor weekday morning newscasts with accuracy, urgency, and authenticity.
  • Report and deliver live coverage from breaking news scenes, major events, and community gatherings.
  • Research, gather, write, and develop compelling news content for broadcast, digital, and social platforms.
  • Cultivate sources and generate original story ideas that impact Southern Arizona viewers.
  • Produce enterprise journalism that goes beyond reading a teleprompter and drives meaningful conversations in the community.
  • Collaborate with producers, reporters, photographers, and newsroom leadership to deliver impactful coverage.
  • Conduct interviews and field reporting that provide context, accountability, and storytelling depth.
  • Represent the station at community events, charitable initiatives, and public appearances.
  • Serve as a master of ceremonies or host for station-sponsored and community-focused events.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned to support newsroom operations and audience engagement.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Three or more years of on-camera news experience preferred.
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and the ability to provide proof of insurance that meets company-required limits.
  • Ability and willingness to travel throughout the community to report stories and cover news events.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • A strong on-camera presence with the ability to connect with viewers and communicate with urgency when news demands it.
  • Demonstrated passion for reporting, storytelling, and enterprise journalism.
  • Ability to cultivate sources, uncover original stories, and continuously develop meaningful content ideas.
  • Strong news judgment and sound editorial decision-making skills.
  • Knowledge of newsroom computer systems, digital publishing tools, and news databases preferred.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management abilities.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with tight deadlines and changing priorities.
  • Strong understanding of journalistic ethics, accuracy standards, and libel law.
  • Clear, concise, and confident verbal communication skills.
  • A collaborative mindset and commitment to serving the community through trusted journalism.

job.description:

The role of Master Control Operator is responsible for operating the multi-channel and multi-brand control point for Sinclair Television Stations located in Pittsburgh, PA. Duties include, but are not limited to, Live event operations, graphics insertion, playlist manipulation, and monitoring on-air quality of the TV Station to ensure all content airs accurately and reflects the traffic and programming schedules.

job.title: AVP, Finance Transformation
job.description:
This position is On-site at our Hunt Valley, MD headquarters.

Sinclair is seeking an experienced, strategic, and hands-on Assistant Vice President, Finance Transformation to lead initiatives that modernize finance operations, improve business processes, and increase the value delivered by the company’s technology investments.

This role will partner closely with business leaders, department heads, Finance, and IT to identify opportunities to simplify, redesign, and standardize processes. The AVP will help shape practical solutions using Oracle Cloud Fusion, artificial intelligence tools such as ChatGPT, automation, analytics, and other enabling technologies. The ideal candidate combines strong finance and operational judgment with a collaborative approach to change leadership.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the finance transformation agenda, aligning initiatives with Sinclair’s strategic, operational, and financial priorities.
  • Partner with business leaders and department heads to assess current processes, identify pain points, and redesign workflows for greater efficiency, control, and service.
  • Establish a roadmap for process standardization, automation, systems optimization, and adoption of emerging technologies.
  • Work closely with IT to maximize the value, usability, and effectiveness of Oracle Cloud Fusion and related finance tools.
  • Identify and prioritize high-value use cases for AI, including generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, to improve analysis, reporting, documentation, workflow execution, and decision support.
  • Translate business needs into clear requirements, business cases, process designs, and implementation priorities.
  • Lead cross-functional transformation projects from opportunity assessment through implementation, adoption, and benefits realization.
  • Develop performance measures to track process efficiency, adoption, service levels, controls, and financial impact.
  • Partner with the Technology group to promote strong governance, data quality, internal controls, security, and appropriate use of AI and automation technologies.
  • Build change-management plans that prepare teams for new processes and tools, including stakeholder engagement, communications, training, and post-launch support.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leaders on finance operating-model improvements and technology-enabled transformation opportunities.
  • Stay current on finance technology, AI capabilities, and leading practices; bring pragmatic recommendations to Sinclair.

 

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, Information Systems, or a related field; advanced degree, CPA, CMA, or relevant transformation certification preferred.
  • 10+ years of progressive experience in finance, finance operations, transformation, consulting, enterprise systems, or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional process redesign or finance transformation initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of core finance processes, including planning, reporting, record-to-report, procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, and/or financial controls.
  • Experience with Oracle Cloud Fusion or comparable enterprise finance platforms strongly preferred.
  • Practical knowledge of automation, analytics, AI, and generative AI applications in a business or finance environment.
  • Proven ability to partner effectively with executive leaders, business stakeholders, finance teams, and IT organizations.
  • Strong program-management, communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to influence without direct authority, manage competing priorities, and drive measurable results in a changing environment.

 

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic thinker with a practical, execution-oriented mindset.
  • Collaborative and approachable partner who builds trust across functions.
  • Comfortable challenging existing practices constructively and guiding teams through change.
  • Strong judgment regarding risk, controls, data privacy, and responsible AI use.
  • Able to translate technical capabilities into clear business value.

 

Success in the Role

Success will be measured by improved process efficiency and effectiveness, increased adoption and value from Oracle Cloud Fusion and other technology investments, stronger business partnership, measurable automation and productivity gains, and sustained improvements in the way Finance supports Sinclair’s business leaders.

The base salary compensation range for this role is $225,000 - $240,000, plus eligibility for a performance based annual bonus. WAGA – FOX 5 Atlanta

Do you define yourself as a driven, results-oriented sales professional and a skillful relationship-builder? If so, you belong here. This is another statement we replace with the ‘hunter’ sentence above: We’re looking for an assertive professional who thrives on being in front of potential clients, forging long-term relationships, and helping local businesses grow. 

Leveraging the scale and resources of Fox Corporation and Fox Television Stations, we dominate the Atlanta, GA television market by broadcasting the highest volume of local news. Beyond our broadcast dominance, we provide sophisticated, best-in-class Digital offerings designed to be comprehensive marketing solutions, enabling partners to achieve measurable results at every stage of the advertising purchase funnel.

The FOX 5 Sales Team has an amazing opportunity for an experienced Account Executive to generate digital and broadcast advertising revenue for Atlanta’s top local television station.

Why Join Us?

  • Creative Environment: Work in a fast-paced culture where teamwork and ideas are valued.
  • Learn from the Best: Collaborate with accomplished media professionals to drive revenue.
  • State-of-the-Art Facilities: Operate from our cutting-edge studios in downtown Bethesda.

Job Summary

  • Generate Revenue by selling a suite of cutting-edge digital advertising solutions across our key brands, including FLX, FOX Local, TUBI, FOX Sports, and FOXNEWS.com, as well as unique multi-screen promotional sponsorships.
  • Drive Business Growth by developing and implementing sales strategies (independently and with sales management) to consistently grow revenue and exceed sales goals.
  • Cultivate Client Relationships by meeting and communicating regularly with clients and agencies to maintain strong partnerships and expedite the closing process.
  • Lead the Sales Process by presenting, negotiating, and developing unique and valuable advertising packages to new and existing clients.
  • Manage Accounts efficiently, including processing transactional business, developing advertising schedules with station personnel, and ensuring the timely completion of all administrative tasks.
  • Maintain a high level of communication with station and corporate management, sales staff, and internal station personnel.
  • Participate in sales training and meetings to stay current on product offerings, market trends, and other key information. 

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience & Education: A minimum of 2 years of professional experience in Video Advertising Business Development and Sales. A college degree is preferred.
  • Business Acumen: Digital ad sales savvy with a proven track record of developing new business and achieving measurable success in the digital space.
  • Client & Sales Skills: A skilled negotiator and motivator capable of managing complex deals and driving accounts from lead to close.
  • Communication & Technology: Possesses excellent organizational, time management, written & verbal communication skills. Must be proficient with computers and cloud-based communication applications. Experience with WideOrbit is a plus.

Benefits:

  • Comprehensive Package: Excellent health benefits, paid time off, and professional development opportunities. 401k with company match.

  • Must have or be willing to obtain reliable transportation and have a valid, local driver’s license.
  • Local travel and entertainment are required.
  • Flexibility to work varied hours and overtime as needed.

job.title: Digital Marketing Coordinator
job.description:
The Digital Marketing Coordinator is a key support role within the Digital Marketing & Audience Development team, providing hands-on assistance across artist and label campaigns. The role will work closely with Digital, Marketing, Social & Content, Influencer and wider label teams to support domestic and international artist campaigns across paid, owned and earned digital channels. The Coordinator will build and deliver email communications, support database growth and segmentation, and maintain CRM best practice. Alongside this, they will gain broad experience across digital marketing, including social media, content, creator campaigns, digital platforms, reporting and campaign coordination.

This is an ideal opportunity for someone who is highly organised, digitally savvy, creative and passionate about music and internet culture, and who is looking to develop a broad career in digital marketing.

What you'll do:

Digital Campaign Support

  • Serve as a key contact for the digital marketing team, collaborating with internal managers, artists, labels, and external partners to deliver domestic and international campaigns.
  • Manage day-to-day project workflows, including campaign timelines, tracking documents, asset folders, release links, and general digital housekeeping.
  • Support paid media execution, creator and influencer activations, fan acquisition pages, competitions, and pre-save campaigns

Social, Content & Owned Channels

  • Support the delivery and scheduling of social media plans across label-owned platforms, including TikTok and Instagram, while contributing to overall channel strategy.
  • Capture mobile-first content at live shows, events, and artist shoots, performing basic short-form video editing like cutting clips, subtitling, and adding trending audio.
  • Identify strategic opportunities across social channels and campaign touchpoints to convert social followers into owned channel audiences.

CRM & Audience Development

  • Build, schedule, and execute targeted email and SMS CRM campaigns for artist and label accounts, maintaining the master CRM calendar.
  • Grow first-party fan databases by managing data capture across websites, pre-saves, and competitions while maintaining CRM data hygiene and privacy compliance.
  • Develop, test, and optimise automated fan journeys, sign-up flows, and lifecycle messaging to improve overall campaign conversion.

Reporting & Insights

  • Collect and analyse campaign metrics across social, CRM, paid media, and UGC activity using internal and external reporting tools.
  • Consolidate performance data into regular reports and share actionable insights to inform future marketing strategy and campaign optimization.

Trends, Innovation & Team Development

  • Monitor emerging digital trends, platform updates, streaming features, and internet culture to identify creative opportunities for artists.
  • Prepare internal presentations, case studies, and educational updates for the broader marketing team and assist in key digital partner meetings

Who you are:

  • Passionate about music, digital culture, and how audiences engage with artists across social, streaming, and emerging platforms.
  • Creative, curious, and proactive, with an interest in audience development, CRM, and content strategy.
  • Data-literate, able to interpret campaign performance and turn insights into action.
  • Highly organised, adaptable, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • A strong communicator and collaborative team player who enjoys working with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Experience in digital marketing, CRM, social media, content, or the wider entertainment industry.
  • Strong project management and organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise competing deadlines.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, spreadsheets, reporting tools, and the ability to quickly learn new platforms and technologies.
  • Experience working within a record label, music company, creative agency, or similar environment.
  • Hands-on experience delivering social media campaigns, CRM communications, or short-form video content.
  • Familiarity with creative tools such as Canva, CapCut, Adobe Express, website CMS platforms, fan capture tools, and digital music marketing workflows

What we give you:

  • You join a global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day. 
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community. 
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt and create what happens next 
  • We give you the platform to champion positive change, with the opportunity to contribute to our social impact, diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives. 
  • We provide an excellent range of benefits like private health benefits, insurances, additional leave programs, Novated car leasing options plus loads of industry discounts & perks!

The Orchard is a leading full-service music distribution company operating in 50+ markets worldwide. The Orchard empowers creators and businesses to grow and evolve in the dynamic, global music industry.
