The Orchard’s comprehensive artist & label services offerings include marketing, sync licensing, premium video services, transparent data analysis, advertising, rights management, radio promotion, D2C, and more.

The Orchard focuses on providing a comfortable, social, and engaging environment to encourage productivity and creativity.

Our company is seeking a Manager, Solutions to join our dynamic team. As the Manager, Solutions, you will work closely with both Orchard clients and internal teams, overseeing key elements of the client experience, and synthesizing interactions across Orchard’s internal departments. You will be responsible for providing a centralized, solutions based voice in support of the Relationship Management team and supervising the comprehensive onboarding process, focusing on a positive first experience for clients. In addition, you will ensure a continued, positive client experience around all operational questions and concerns. This is a highly responsible role that requires proactive problem solving skills, a keen eye for detail, and a love for all types of music.

What you'll do:

  • Serve as the primary representative of Orchard’s administrative teams (including legal, finance, and operations) to Orchard clients, addressing issues, gathering feedback, and advocating for client needs within the organization

  • Focus on clear, solution based responses to internal and external queries regarding client questions

  • Ability to handle high volume inbound needs from labels and ensure they are being addressed in a timely manner

Who you are:

  • Effective communicator on phone, email, and in person

  • Multi-tasker with supreme attention to detail, follow-through and effective prioritization
  • Multilingual skills preferred, but not required
  • Prior experience with CRMs preferred, but not required
  • Fluent English proficiency required

job.title: Director/Senior Director, Deal Structuring & Valuation
job.description:
At Warner Chappell Music (WCM) - the global music publishing arm of Warner Music Group (WMG) - we shape the culture of songwriting and champion songs that resonate for generations by creating transformational opportunities for songwriters everywhere. Our people and culture are at the epicenter of our company, and we are looking for team members who share our service-oriented mindset and have a passion for looking after our songwriters.

A little bit about our team:

The deals office drives the evaluation and structure of all recorded music and music publishing deals to enable long-term growth. We partner with closely with global business leaders to assess opportunities that balance creativity with commercial value strengthening our market position and shareholder value

Your role:

The Director, Deal Structuring & Valuation will play a critical leadership role within the Deals Office, leading all aspects of the financial assessment, complex modeling, and strategic structuring of significant deals across recorded music and music publishing. This role demands deep industry knowledge, advanced analytical capabilities, and the ability to proactively identify deal structures that maximize shareholder returns while aligning with business strategy and artist-first values.

Here you’ll get to:

  • Lead the development and refinement of sophisticated financial models and valuation analyses for high-stakes deals (e.g., partnerships, artist/publishing catalog acquisitions, and frontline deals).

  • Drive the strategic structuring of deal economics and terms, collaborating closely with senior business, legal, and creative collaborators to ensure alignment with corporate objectives and growth plans.

  • Proactively identify and assess diverse deal structures to optimize financial returns and lead risk effectively.

  • Develop and implement global frameworks and best practices for deal valuation methodologies, financial forecasting, and scenario planning.

  • Manage adherence to deal budgets, forecast expenditures, and ensure adherence to cash targets and corporate return thresholds.

  • Prepare and present compelling financial analyses and deal recommendations to senior leadership.

  • Mentor and guide junior analysts/managers on financial modeling techniques, valuation best practices, and industry-specific deal nuances.

  • Stay abreast of industry trends, competitive landscape, and evolving monetization models to inform innovative deal structures and pricing strategies.

About you:

  • 7-10+ years of progressive experience in finance, corporate development, investment banking, or a similar deal-focused role, with significant experience in the music, entertainment, or media sectors.

  • Extensive expertise in advanced financial modeling, valuation techniques (DCF, precedent transactions, comparable company analysis), and deal structuring.

  • Proven track record of successfully leading financial analysis for complex commercial agreements.

  • Deep understanding of music rights, revenue streams, and the unique economic drivers of the music industry.

  • Exceptional analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving abilities.

  • Superior communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and negotiate at all levels.

  • Ability to thrive in a high-pressure, fast-paced, and dynamic environment.

  • MBA, CFA, or equivalent experience strongly preferred

About Us:

Before the fans and fame, the soundtracks and syncs, there is the song. And before the song comes the songwriter - the heart of an art form that defines generations, and the soul of our business. Songwriters are our inspiration; we are their partners, collaborators, and crusaders. Songwriters shape culture; and here at Warner Chappell Music we help hone their craft, build their careers, and protect their legacies. We value curiosity, collaboration, and commitment – which helps set us apart and helps us in our commitment and global service to our songwriters. We are Warner Chappell Music - where songwriters are heard.

As part of the larger Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses:

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 

  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Love this job and want to apply?

Click the “Apply” link at the top of the page, or apply directly with your LinkedIn. Applying with LinkedIn will import all of the information you put in your profile, but will still allow you to upload a resume and cover letter.

 

Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.

 

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.
 

This position requires a minimum of 4 days per week in the office. We value in-office collaboration, which is essential for talent development and strong working relationships. #LI-Onsite Salary Range: $165,000 to $175,000 Annually Salary ranges are included for job postings where required by law. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as work experience and business needs. The pay range is subject to change at any time dependent on a variety of internal and external factors.

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.

SiriusXM is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment, and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Stitcher, Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics, and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization, and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through Sirius XM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.

How you’ll make an impact:

The Audio Editor, DC Sports Newsroom (Part-Time) will coordinate feeds, acquire and edit sports sound, and operate broadcast and editing software. Work will include evenings, weekends, and holidays.

What you’ll do:

  • Edit live interviews/press conferences and identify and pull relevant soundbytes for updates/show use.
  • Edit live sports games, identify and pull relevant highlights for updates/show use.
  • Monitor the sports news cycle throughout the shift and bring relevant audio to support top sports stories.

What you’ll need:

  • Bachelor's degree or relevant experience.
  • 1-year experience with sound editing and sports newsroom operation in a fast-paced news-gathering atmosphere.
  • Deep understanding and knowledge of sports news across all major sports.
  • Excellent time management skills, with the ability to prioritize and multi-task, and work under shifting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and in a team environment.
  • Night/Weekend/Holiday availability is REQUIRED.
  • Experience with digital editing.
  • Experience with Adobe Audition, Zetta, and Galaxy a plus.
  • Thorough knowledge of MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access).
  • Experience with automation and/or AI tools such as chatGPT, Gemini, etc.
  • Must have legal right to work in the U.S.

At SiriusXM, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. job.title: Conflict Operations Editor
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The International Desk is seeking a Conflict Operations Editor. This is a dedicated newsroom role for a veteran journalist who has demonstrated sharp judgment and leadership working in security-sensitive assignments.  You will help guide our most ambitious and complicated newsgathering efforts, in close partnership with our security team.

You will work closely with the International Editor and the desk’s top leaders to navigate the challenges of reporting in conflict zones and other difficult environments and ensure that the safety and security of our staff is a top priority. You will direct correspondents in the field, serve as a partner to their editors and coordinate with our security advisers and newsroom leadership. You will assess risk and make tough calls while building systems to support our journalists around the world in an era of prolonged and changing war.

This is an in-office position preferably based in London, and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per departmental guidance. You will also be expected to deploy internationally as news events dictate.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and guide newsgathering operations: The primary goal of this position is to inform and ensure we’re making the right calls on assignments in security-sensitive locations.  With guidance and close partnership from our security experts, you will collaborate with senior editors to make the tough decisions on editorial necessity and safety to ensure the safety of our teams in the field. 
  • Leadership Briefings: Provide daily situation and staffing updates for newsroom editors and leadership. Investigate and analyze security incidents and issues to find vulnerabilities and enact corrective measures as needed so we are continuously improving our systems.
  • Establishing Conflict Bureaus: Deploy quickly to rapidly create or scale wartime bureaus. Work with security and the bureau chief to secure and vet critical local infrastructure and ensure our on-the-ground presence and operation supports safety and exceptional journalism.
  • Business continuity: Lead disaster recovery, evacuation planning and crisis management in partnership with our business continuity team.
  • Operational Security : Work in close partnership with the security operation to ensure teams have the specific gear and training required for their assignments, and that we’re following proper protocols to enable our journalists to stay safe while doing their jobs. 
  • Freelancer & Evacuee Support: In collaboration with Legal and Global Operations, coordinate support for our freelancers in conflict zones, and for Times journalists who have had to relocate or evacuate due to conflicts. 
  • Digital Security: Work with our information security team to ensure that journalists in sensitive environments have their data, devices and sources properly protected.
  • Journalistic values: Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

This role reports to the International Editor, based in New York.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Experience working with journalists in conflict zones
  • Experience in a role requiring high-level operational skills and crisis management.
  • Excellent news judgment and understanding of journalistic imperatives.
  • Strong communication skills, able to brief and advise leadership with clarity 
  • Strong collaboration skills, with experience working across a broad range of stakeholders and partners.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Extensive experience in journalism, including significant time as a correspondent or editor in security-sensitive places.
  • Demonstrated experience managing local teams (fixers, drivers, interpreters) in volatile or hostile environments.
  • Demonstrated organizational and process-management skills
  • Willingness to travel internationally, including to security-sensitive locations on short notice.
  • Experience developing safety protocols for complex newsgathering operations

job.title: Director, Editorial Booking
job.description:
The big picture: Axios is a modern media company dedicated to providing trustworthy, award-winning news content in an audience-first format. We are hiring a Director of Editorial Booking to lead editorial booking for Axios Live’s most high-profile events.

Why it matters: Axios Live stages are where leaders come to make news. Reporting to the Managing Editor of Axios Live, the Director, Editorial Booking will serve as a senior editorial representative working alongside the Managing Editor to book top-tier newsmakers, move quickly in breaking news moments, and ensure every conversation meets Axios’ editorial standards.

Go deeper: Axios Live events are among the most sought-after platforms for newsmakers. We’re looking for a seasoned editorial leader to own booking strategy for events that represent Axios to today’s key influencers, and lead editorial booking across Smart Brevity programming around the world. This role plays a critical leadership function across Axios Live programming and will:

  • Lead, manage, and mentor the associate director, setting clear expectations, workflows, and performance standards across Axios Live programming.
  • Collaborate with the managing director on editorial booking strategy for Axios Live’s portfolio of annual summits and franchise events, including flagship properties such as the Future of Health Summit.
  • Serve as a key talent manager across Axios Live, building trusted relationships with both external newsmakers and Axios newsroom talent to strengthen bookings, cultivate on-stage talent, and ensure reporters and leaders are thoughtfully deployed across live programming.
  • Work on editorial booking for Axios House and other Axios Live products at major global tentpoles, including Climate Week/UNGA, and other similar high-profile moments.
  • Secure senior newsmakers — including CEOs, elected officials, administration leaders, and global decision-makers — while delegating and guiding bookings across the team.
  • Serve as a liaison between Axios Live, the Axios newsroom, and Axios leadership to align booking priorities and programming strategy.
  • Exercise strong editorial judgment in fast-moving news environments, including making real-time decisions to pivot talent, framing, or programming in response to breaking news.
  • Ensure Axios Live programming meets Axios’ editorial standards, reflects diverse and compelling perspectives, and maintains editorial independence.
  • Oversee editorial preparation for live events, including interview prep, run-of-show development, scripts, stage cues, and briefing materials.
  • Guide collaboration on event language and marketing materials, ensuring accuracy, clarity, and Smart Brevity principles across platforms.
  • Provide guidance to senior newsroom leadership during live events, ensuring the team is coordinated, materials are accessible, and programming remains responsive to news developments.
  • Build and maintain long-term relationships with principals, chiefs of staff, communications teams, and senior influencers to support both immediate bookings and long-term Axios Live growth
  • Travel regularly to Axios Live events across the U.S. and internationally, providing on-site editorial leadership and supporting programming execution at major summits, franchise events, and global tentpoles.
  • Leverage AI and emerging tools to improve efficiency across research, booking, and production workflows, and to help scale best practices across the booking team.

Worthy of your time: We’re looking for a senior editorial leader who brings sound judgment, strong relationships, and a collaborative management style. Ideal candidates will have: 

  • 5+ years of editorial booking or media experience, with demonstrated experience leading or mentoring other bookers or producers.
  • A proven track record of owning booking strategy for large-scale editorial events, including recurring summits or franchise programming.
  • Experience booking and working with high-profile leaders, including senior executives, policymakers, and global influencers.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide clear editorial guidance and feedback.
  • Deep knowledge of the news cycle and emerging trends across politics, business, and technology.
  • Experience building full show programs, from concept through execution.
  • Strong organizational and people-management skills, with the ability to balance coaching, delegation, and execution.
  • Familiarity with Axios’ Smart Brevity style and editorial values.
  • Bonus points for experience or established networks in:
  • Health care and life sciences
  • Energy, climate, or sustainability
  • Defense, national security, or geopolitics
  • Media, technology, or communications
  • Background in media, Capitol Hill, government, or political campaigns is a plus.

Starting salary for this role is in the range of $110,000 - $130,000 and is dependent on numerous factors, including but not limited to location, work experience, and skills. This range does not include other compensation and benefits. Axios' compensation philosophy takes into account cost of labor differentials across the country. Because this is a remote-optional job posting, this salary range takes into account all possible locations within the United States, but candidates will only be eligible for the salary range for their location.

Axios is committed to embracing artificial intelligence as a core part of how we work. All team members are expected to actively develop AI literacy and use AI tools to enhance their productivity, creativity, and efficiency. We invest in ongoing learning to ensure every employee is equipped to responsibly and effectively integrate AI into their daily workflows.

  • Inclusive fertility, hormonal health and family forming benefits through Carrot Fertility

  • Increased work flexibility for parents and caretakers
  • Virtual company-sponsored social events
  • A strong and positive work environment
  • A commitment to an open, inclusive, and diverse work culture

What’s more, you can watch and stream for free on 10, 10 Drama, 10 Comedy and Nickelodeon, plus a vast array of Free Ad-Supported Streaming TV (FAST channels) as well as our subscription video on demand service Paramount+.    

 

 

 

 

We now have a permanent full-time role available in Sydney for an experienced Programmatic Operations Executive, working closely with our Ad Sales team and utilizing your deep understanding of programmatic revenue generation and data-based audience solutions. This role is responsible for driving Programmatic monetization of CTV video inventory across the AU market. 

   

Functions will include:    

  • Aid in the direction of open exchange, private exchange & Programmatic Guaranteed / Automated Guaranteed commercial strategy for video, display and mobile inventory.  
  • Identify, prioritise and translate key Programmatic business requirements into operational projects with the goal of increasing revenue, improving efficiency, reducing risk and improving inventory performance across multiple platforms.  
  • Cultivate an extensive understanding of Network 10 brands, products & commercial intelligence systems in order to provide the best sales solution to Programmatic buyers and their clients.  
  • Focused development of all Trading Desk / DSP/ client relationships to optimise revenue across all brands within the 10 network.  
  • Organisation & integration of all Programmatic platform’s / monetisation partners across the AU market e.g. various SSPs / Exchanges  
  • Co-ordinate data-based audience solutions via DMP partner for the APAC region, with a focus on creating commercial insights actionable via Programmatic platforms.  
  • Delivery of education & training on the use of Programmatic platforms, data-based opportunities & Programmatic strategy to internal stakeholders.  
  • Display organisational and leadership capabilities to track progress, execution and consistency of trading desk sales programs.  
  • Meet and exceed Programmatic revenue targets, contributing to Paramount’s overall performance and revenue targets across the AU market, with a core focus on Sydney-based business.  

 

What are we looking for in a Programmatic Operations Executive? What’s important?     

  • A solid 4+ years of experience in digital media 
  • Strong understanding of the Programmatic advertising space, specifically ad exchanges, RTB and Programmatic trading 
  • Demonstrated agency/buyer relationships and sound knowledge of trading desks, DSPs and buy-side ad tech 
  • Ability to structure and manage negotiations as well as managing forecasts & sales pipelines 
  • Outstanding communication and presentation skills 
  • Knowledge of the AU digital media landscape 
  • The ‘goes without saying’:- detail oriented, well organised, flexible to change, ability to multi-task, great problem-solving skills and an awesome team player

Hearst Digital Marketing Services is seeking a highly motivated and experienced seller to join our team. As a Digital Media Advisor, you will be responsible for developing and pitching digital media strategies to drive business growth for our SMB clients. This is an exciting opportunity to work with a dynamic team of professionals and collaborate with clients across various industries to achieve their marketing objectives. If you have a passion for digital media, a track record of success, and the ability to think creatively, this can be a great fit for you!  This position is also fully REMOTE!

  • Establishing strong connections with new businesses

  • Generating a robust client portfolio through various prospecting methods

  • Expertly presenting product insights to potential clients, showcasing how our solutions address their needs

  • Managing and growing existing accounts through upselling and cross-selling

  • First-year earnings between $95,000 and $105,000 on target

Job Title: News Anchor 

 

Department: News 

 

Reporting To: Assistant Brand Manager 

 

Employment Type: Part-Time 

 

Work Arrangement: On-Site 

 

Overview: 

KYW Newsradio, Philadelphia’s leading multimedia newsroom, is seeking an experienced, dynamic broadcast journalist to be a news anchor on a part-time basis. A qualified candidate must be news-savvy, full of fresh and relatable story ideas, willing to jump into the anchor chair at a moment’s notice, and available to work all dayparts, weekends, and holidays. She or he must be practiced and comfortable with conversational, compelling broadcast news writing and delivery. The ability to expertly ad-lib when the situation warrants is crucial. On-air experience and a working knowledge of the Philadelphia news environment are key. An audio demo must be included with the application.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Write and deliver half-hour and hour-long newscasts.
  • Assist the editor with the selection and production of stories.
  • Operate the audio console during newscasts.
  • Ensure station compliance with FCC regulations.

Qualifications

More About You:

 

Required & Preferred:

  • At least 3 years’ experience in an on-air role at a medium- or large-market news station.
  • A conversational, engaging delivery with or without a script.
  • Ability to interpret and simplify complex copy.
  • Ability to update copy on the fly as news warrants.
  • Ability to develop and effectively pitch story ideas.
  • Familiarity and experience covering news in the Philadelphia market.
  • Comfort with audio editing tools.
  • Knowledge of legal guidelines that govern broadcast media.
  • Ability to work flexible and irregular hours.
  • Employees of Audacy are required to be a minimum of 21 years of age to operate any vehicle, including Company-owned, leased, rented, or personal vehicles, when such operation is conducted on behalf of Audacy. Driving is an essential function of this role.
  • A valid driver’s license, satisfactory completion of a motor vehicle record check, and, if the position requires use of applicant’s own vehicle, proof of insurance, is required.

Audacy is a leading audio content and entertainment company. job.title: Senior Publicist, Lifestyle
job.description:
At Corus Entertainment, we’re shaping the future of media in Canada—home to the country’s biggest hits, most trusted news, and greatest value. Our mission is simple: to create engaging content, connect with audiences wherever they are, and drive meaningful growth.

Guided by our values—Think Boldly, Make a Positive Impact, Win as a Team, and Own the Outcome—we bring creativity and collaboration to everything we do.

If you’re ready to make an impact, there’s a place for you at Corus.

Division: Marketing & Publicity

Work Status: Full-time (Hybrid)

Location: Toronto, Ontario

About the Role

The Senior Publicist plays a leadership role on Corus' Lifestyle PR team, helping drive awareness, engagement, and audience growth for Home Network, Flavour Network, HISTORY, Slice, and each network’s portfolio of original and acquired programming and talent.

Reporting to the Publicity Manager, with the support of a Publicist and a Publicity Coordinator, the Senior Publicist is responsible for developing and executing integrated publicity campaigns that generate impactful earned media coverage, social conversation, and influencer engagement across platforms. This role leads strategic communications plans for priority series and initiatives, manages talent and media relationships, oversees publicity events and activations, and collaborates closely with internal stakeholders and external partners to support business objectives.

The Senior Publicist also provides day-to-day leadership and mentorship to the Publicist and Publicity Coordinator while contributing to broader team and departmental initiatives.

Does mouth-watering food content stop your scroll? Are you constantly saving home reno reveals and luxury home tours? Perhaps historical documentaries send you down a rabbit hole for hours. If your algorithm knows you this well, maybe it's time we did too.

You will contribute by:

• Lead strategic publicity campaigns for priority Lifestyle brands and series, developing creative communications plans that support audience growth, brand awareness, and corporate objectives.

• Develop and execute earned media, influencer, talent, and event strategies for Home Network, Flavour Network, HISTORY, Slice, and their programming portfolios.

• Cultivate and maintain strong relationships with entertainment, lifestyle, news, trade, and digital media outlets, as well as influencers and content creators across Canada.

• Manage media outreach and pitching efforts, securing high-impact coverage opportunities across broadcast, print, online, podcast, and social platforms.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with network talent, production partners, distributors, independent producers, and unit publicists to maximize promotional opportunities.

• Lead talent-related publicity initiatives, including media training support, interview opportunities, appearances, press tours, and promotional events.

• Develop, write, edit, and approve publicity materials, including press releases, media alerts, key messaging documents, biographies, press kits, show descriptions, briefing materials, presentations, and reports.

• Analyze media performance and campaign effectiveness, providing strategic recommendations and reporting on earned media and influencer results.

• Lead the planning and execution of publicity events, red carpets, press junkets, screenings, influencer activations, media experiences, and special events.

• Manage photography and promotional assets, including oversight of photo shoots, approvals, distribution, and organization of media materials.

• Collaborate closely with Marketing, Social Media, Programming, Creative Services, Research, Streaming, Sales, and Production teams to ensure integrated campaign execution.

• Identify innovative publicity opportunities and emerging media trends to keep Corus brands culturally relevant and top of conversation.

• Provide guidance, mentorship, and daily support to the Publicity Coordinator, helping develop their skills and career growth.

• Contribute to broader departmental initiatives and special projects as required.

Skills and experience you will bring:

• Undergraduate degree or diploma in Public Relations, Communications, Journalism, Media Studies, Marketing, or a related field.

• Minimum 5-7 years of experience in publicity, media relations, communications, or entertainment marketing, preferably within the broadcasting, media, or entertainment industries.

• Proven ability to develop and execute strategic communications plans that support business objectives and generate measurable results.

• Exceptional written, editing, presentation, and verbal communication skills.

• Strong media relations experience with an established network of contacts across Canadian lifestyle, entertainment, news, and trade media.

• Demonstrated success securing meaningful earned media coverage and developing innovative publicity campaigns.

• Experience managing influencer relations and creator partnerships.

• Strong understanding of talent relations and experience supporting talent-facing publicity initiatives.

• Experience planning and executing events, media experiences, launches, screenings, and press tours.

• Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, stakeholders, and deadlines simultaneously.

• Highly collaborative with exceptional relationship-building and stakeholder management skills.

• Proven ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

• Experience mentoring or supervising junior team members is considered an asset.

• Strong understanding of social media, digital content trends, and the evolving media landscape.

• Interest in and understanding of the Canadian broadcasting, media, and entertainment industries.

• Strong technical proficiency, including Microsoft Office and platforms such as Cision, Benchmark, MRP, WordPress, Meltwater, Canva, or similar tools.

Application Deadline: October 6, 2026

job.title: Vice President of Business Development
job.description:
iHeartMedia Markets

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. And we were just recognized as one of the Top Media Sales Organizations by The Myers Report! 

In fact, iHeart has: More #1 rated markets than the next two largest radio companies combined;

  • We’re the largest podcast publisher, with more monthly downloads than the second- and third-largest podcast publishers combined. Podcasting, the fastest-growing new media, today has more monthly users than streaming music services or Netflix;

  • iHeart is the home of many of the country’s most popular and trusted on-air personalities and podcast influencers, who build important connections with hundreds of communities across America;

  • We create and produce some of the most popular and well-known branded live music events in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour;

  • iHeartRadio is the #1 streaming radio digital service in America;

  • Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and

  • We have the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio, from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale.  As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.

Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!

If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

iHeartMedia is looking for a Vice President of Business Development. Great sales leaders don’t just hit goals; they build teams that consistently outperform them. In this role, you’ll lead and coach a team of Account Executives, drive new business, deepen client relationships, and shape the sales strategy for the market.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Manage local Account Executives with goal of meeting/exceeding station revenue, prospecting and new business targets.
  • Oversee advertising sales activities in your market; is accountable for achieving targeted advertising sales revenues and controlling sales expenses.
  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.
  • Translate market and station business strategies into specific actions to generate sales and revenue.
  • Direct sales activities and processes that generate new business and deepen existing relationships.
  • Set sales goals and guide subsequent goal-setting processes.
  • Prepare budgets and revenue forecasts.
  • Obtain, allocate and adjust operations resources to achieve sales and service goals.
  • Oversee management of available advertising inventory to drive most profitable sales.
  • Meet with key accounts.
  • Recruit, hire and ensure ongoing training and development of Account Executives.
  • Go on sales calls and conduct in-field coaching to develop Account Executives.
  • Review and adjust sales territories, product mix targets and assigned call lists.
  • Direct other functions such as marketing, advertising, production, traffic and sales operations.

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • Strong understanding of broadcasting, marketing, promotion, and collection standards.
  • Proven ability to grow new business and find new revenue opportunities.
  • Excellent leadership and coaching ability; can successfully coach others in sales practices.
  • Deep understanding of local markets, customers, and competitors to target needs.
  • Ability to create productive, long-term customer relationships.
  • Excellent communication and influencing skills.
  • 3+ years experience as an Account Executive or Sales Manager in media with proven track record of success.
  • College degree preferred, but not required.

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return

  • Accountability for sales results

  • Understanding of the business and how own area integrates with others to achieve sales goals

  • Strong understanding of broadcast, marketing, promotion and collection standards

  • Judgement to resolve customer and employee operational problems; critical thinking skills to understand the broader impact across the organization

  • Leadership skills to increase performance of the sales organization

  • Communication skills to succinctly convey information, set performance expectations and handle sensitive issues

  • Active listening skills with the ability to guide and influence others to adopt a broader point of view

  • Positive energy and the ability to manage stress and serve as a model for others in the sales practice

  • Skills to successfully coach and develop sellers

job.title: Sales and Marketing Specialist
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 


Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 


Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

Help Brands Thrive: 

Join our media sales team and play a pivotal role in helping brands and companies grow. By identifying new opportunities, building strong client relationships, and delivering impactful solutions, you'll showcase how our multi-media content platforms and digital assets can drive meaningful results for our partners. 


Your focus will be on helping clients achieve their goals, ensuring that every campaign is a success. When our clients win, we win—and we believe in celebrating those victories together! 

  

Make Connections: Embrace your powers of persuasion and make every handshake and meeting count! Every interaction is a chance to build a genuine connection and show clients how we can help them succeed. You're not just selling; you're building partnerships. You're helping businesses find the right audience in the right place at the right time. When we say One Partner, Endless Possibilities, we mean it! 

 

Be A Trusted Guide: In this role, you'll connect with clients on a human level, understand their unique needs, and craft tailored sales and marketing solutions that deliver results. As their trusted advisor, you'll help them navigate the ever-evolving marketing landscape, ensuring every step of the journey is planned with care and precision.  

 

Shake Things Up: Bring your creativity and fresh ideas to the table! We're looking for someone who challenges the status quo, embraces innovation, and finds new ways to connect with our audience. Your contributions will help elevate our brand and drive meaningful results for your clients.  

 

Join us and Conquer the Media Landscape: You'll be part of a dedicated team of A1 media sales professionals, committed to achieving market leadership. Together, we amplify our impact, deliver exceptional outcomes, and help our clients succeed in ways that truly matter. 

 

Identify Emerging Opportunities: It's about being able to see what others can't, anticipating market shifts, analyzing data and predicting the next big thing. Your insights will position our clients and AMP for long-term success.  

  

What We're Looking For 

Proven Sales Ability (or an Unstoppable Desire to Learn) 

Whether you're a seasoned sales professional or just getting started, we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 

 

Strong Communication Skills: You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 

 

A Passion for helping Others: You're committed to understanding clients' needs, providing top-notch customer service and making a difference. You're not just selling a product; you're providing a solution.  


A Competitive Spirit: Do you get a little boost when you achieve a goal (especially if it was a tough one)? We love that for you (and us)!  We want someone who's driven to excel but also knows how to celebrate the victories (big and small) with their team. That drive makes you a valuable part of our organization.  


A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.  

 

The Practical Stuff 

A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 

 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

 

Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.  

 

The Compensation Package: We offer a base salary, commission structure, and benefits package designed to support your success and well-being. Happy employees don't stage rebellions! ;) 

 

We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales specialist isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.) 

 

Top-Notch Training and Support: We're not the kind of company that hires you and then disappears into the corporate abyss. We carefully select candidates for a cohort-based training program, where you'll join a group of sales professionals from all over the country. From onboarding to ongoing mentorship, we invest in your success with training programs that set you up for long-term growth. 

 

Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, providing you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.  

 

Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise.   

 

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Assignment Desk Editor
job.description:
TelevisaUnivision is seeking a talented and driven Assignment Desk Editor based in Miami to join its news team. The ideal candidate will bring strong editorial judgment, production experience, and a passion for breaking news. This role is responsible for coordinating story development, securing high-profile guests, booking interviews, field producing, and ensuring coverage is compelling and relevant across broadcast, streaming, and digital platforms. The successful candidate will manage story assignments, coordinate logistics, support field crews, and follow up on daily newsroom workflows across multiple news programs and platforms. This individual must be a strategic and creative thinker, a self-starter, and a collaborative team player who thrives in a fast-paced newsroom environment.

YOUR DAY-DAY: (aka Responsibilities)

  • Constantly monitor and respond to breaking news and developing stories across multiple platforms.
  • Monitor news wires, social media, scanners, broadcasts, and online sources to quickly identify breaking news opportunities.
  • Generate, research, verify, plan, and develop story ideas for newscasts, digital platforms, and special coverage.
  • Coordinate daily story production with reporters, photographers, and multimedia journalists by gathering visual elements, securing video feeds, and arranging interviews relevant to assignments.
  • Secure high-profile guests, newsmakers, public figures, and subject matter experts.
  • Coordinate and manage live remotes, video feeds, live shots, and interview logistics under tight deadlines.
  • Coordinate field crews throughout the news gathering and production process, including scheduling interviews and providing accurate logistical information.
  • Continuously update stories with the latest developments and information.
  • Maintain the iNews system updated with crew locations, assignments, and timelines.
  • Monitor law enforcement, fire communications, scanners, wires, and beat checks for breaking news and spot coverage opportunities.
  • Assist writers, producers, editors, and digital teams with information gathering and story updates.
  • Arrange, download, and supervise incoming video feeds.
  • Participate in editorial meetings and communicate daily coverage plans and developments.
  • Assist with news production and special projects as assigned.
  • Field produce and travel as needed for major news coverage and special assignments.
  • Stay informed on national and international current events, legal developments, and culturally relevant topics.
  • Work effectively in a fast-paced environment while managing breaking news situations and adapting quickly to changes.
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet tight deadlines independently.
  • Be available to work nights, weekends, holidays, and extended hours during breaking news and continuous coverage situations.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by management.

YOU HAVE: (aka Qualifications)

  • BS/BA or MA in Communications, Journalism, New Media, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Fully bilingual in English and Spanish (written and verbal).
  • Minimum of 2 years of newsroom experience required.
  • At least 1 year of experience as a Producer and/or Assignment Editor preferred.
  • Strong editorial judgment and knowledge of current affairs.
  • Highly motivated, creative, assertive, detail-oriented, and organized.
  • Ability to multitask, prioritize assignments, and meet tight deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience managing multiple social media platforms.
  • Basic video editing knowledge.
  • Ability to monitor and record multiple video feeds simultaneously.
  • Experience working with non-linear editing and archive systems.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Outlook, iNews, Avid, live feed systems, and social media platforms.
  • Strong knowledge of city agencies, public safety operations, and key newsmakers preferred.
  • Must be willing to work onsite in Miami, FL.
  • Ability to stand, walk, bend, type, reach, and sit for up to 8 hours.
  • Employment and education verification required.
  • Must be willing to submit to a background investigation.
  • Applicants must be currently authorized to work full-time in the United States.

TelevisaUnivision believes that a happy, well-balanced employee is what makes our culture thrive. We offer a wide selection of perks and benefits including PTO; tuition reimbursement; wellness and employee support programs; 401K; and life and other insurance plans. This is all in addition to our comprehensive and competitive health benefits package featuring medical, dental and vision coverage options.

job.title: Manager, Insights & Analytics - Subscription
job.description:
FOX News Media is looking for a Manager, Insights & Analytics to support our growing portfolio of subscription products, anchored today by FOX Nation.

This is a hands-on analytics role. You will work across the full subscription lifecycle — how subscribers are acquired and retained, and what they actually do once they subscribe. Engagement and content consumption, marketing and activation, user journeys, churn and cohort behavior all sit within your scope. The common thread is SQL: we are looking for someone who can get to any subscription dataset, understand what it does and does not say, and turn it into an answer a business partner can use.

Because the role is scoped broadly rather than by function, it can flex as the portfolio grows. You may work across products alongside a marketing-focused counterpart, or take end-to-end analytics ownership of a single business unit depending on where the business needs depth. You will work closely with key operational stakeholders to understand how to best interpret data shifts day to day and identify trends to inform the business.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITES:

Subscriber & Engagement Reporting

  • Build and own engagement reporting for subscription products — active days, session frequency, content starts and completion, title and category performance, and platform mix across web, mobile app, CTV, and third-party platforms
  • Analyze subscriber acquisition, retention, churn (voluntary and involuntary), cancellations, and plan mix and their impact on engagement
  • Connect engagement to retention, identifying the early-tenure behaviors that separate subscribers who stay from those who churn, and translating that into onboarding, content, and lifecycle recommendations
  • Build and maintain dashboards tracking key subscription and engagement metrics, in partnership with Data Engineering
  • Maintain and evolve recurring performance comparisons (month-over-month, cohort-over-cohort, pre- and post-launch), proactively flagging anomalies such as app issues, tracking gaps, and data quality problems before they distort reporting
  • Provide guidance to finance on cost as it relates to engagement of programming and inform future content strategies and acquisitions

Hands-On Data & Query Work

  • Write and maintain SQL (Snowflake or comparable) against subscription, billing, engagement, campaign, and behavioral data — joins, aggregations, CTEs, and window functions against large and imperfect sources
  • Conduct cohort analysis to identify trends by acquisition channel, offer, plan type, tenure, platform, and content affinity
  • Troubleshoot data discrepancies across platforms and internal tracking (naming mismatches, missing records, deduplication logic) and resolve them at the query level
  • Support the transition from manual, on-demand reporting to self-service dashboards in partnership with Data Engineering

Marketing, Lifecycle & Campaign Measurement

  • Analyze campaign performance across marketing and CRM channels — email, push, in-app, SMS, and paid media — and connect activity to downstream subscriber acquisition, engagement, and retention
  • Support attribution analysis (e.g., first-touch) to measure the impact of campaigns on subscription conversion and migration efforts
  • Conduct segmentation analysis to surface engagement trends, at-risk segments, and personalization opportunities
  • Support experimentation and test design, helping isolate confounding variables (for example content quality versus message format, or seasonality versus offer effect) so results are interpretable

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Translate analysis into clear, digestible summaries and recommendations for Programming, Marketing, CRM, Content, Product, and Finance stakeholders, tailoring the narrative to each audience
  • Respond to ad hoc requests from senior stakeholders with quick turnaround, clear caveats, and accurate data
  • Flag data quality issues and tracking gaps to Data Engineering and Analytics Engineering partners, and follow through to resolution

WHAT YOU WILL NEED:

  • Strong SQL skills required — able to independently write and troubleshoot queries involving joins, aggregations, CTEs, and window functions against large datasets. This is a must-have and the core of the role
  • Experience in subscription, growth, product, marketing, or media analytics, or a related quantitative and reporting role
  • Genuine curiosity about the whole subscriber picture — comfort moving between a churn cohort, a content engagement question, and a campaign performance read in the same week
  • Experience analyzing or reporting on subscription and lifecycle metrics (acquisition, churn, cancellations, retention, LTV)
  • Comfort working in a BI or visualization tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Hex, or similar)
  • Strong Excel and Google Sheets skills for ad hoc analysis, including pivot tables
  • Good communication skills — able to explain data findings, and their limitations, clearly to non-technical stakeholders
  • Detail-oriented, with a track record of catching and resolving data quality issues before they reach leadership
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with recurring deadlines and frequent ad hoc requests
  • Experience with AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor
  • Familiarity with product analytics or engagement measurement tools (e.g., Adobe Analytics, Google Analytics 4, Amplitude) a plus
  • Familiarity with subscription billing platforms (e.g., Recurly, Zuora, Stripe Billing) a plus
  • Exposure to a CRM or lifecycle platform such as Braze a plus
  • Prior experience in media, streaming, publishing, or another content subscription business a plus
  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Math, Business Analytics) or equivalent practical experience

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.


Paramount Advertising is seeking a highly motivated, consultative sales professional to drive growth across Paramount’s vast portfolio through the integration of streaming, programmatic, advanced advertising, data, and convergent media solutions. The ideal candidate brings a sophisticated understanding of today’s evolving media landscape and excels at translating Paramount’s full range of capabilities into integrated solutions that deliver against advertisers’ business objectives—moving beyond traditional demo guarantees and delivery metrics.


As an Account Executive on the Advanced Advertising Team, you will serve as a strategic advisor to agencies and advertisers, helping them navigate and capitalize on the convergence of linear TV, streaming, digital video, programmatic, and data-driven advertising. You will leverage Paramount’s suite of audience, identity, optimization, attribution, measurement, programmatic, and advanced advertising solutions to develop holistic, outcome-oriented media strategies.


The ideal candidate understands how programmatic buying and activation intersect with premium streaming and traditional television, and can articulate the value of bringing these channels together through a unified approach. You will be expected to identify opportunities to expand relationships, drive incremental revenue, and position Paramount as a leading partner for clients seeking greater scale, precision, flexibility, and measurable business outcomes across the entire video ecosystem.


Success in this role requires a balance of revenue generation, executive presence, convergent selling expertise, analytical thinking, and cross-functional collaboration. You will work closely with agency investment and strategy teams, programmatic and digital leads, data and analytics partners, and Paramount’s broader sales organization to develop integrated solutions and unlock new sources of growth.


You thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment, are comfortable selling complex technology and data-enabled solutions, and can move fluidly between high-level business strategy and the details of media activation. You are equally effective influencing senior clients, educating agencies on emerging capabilities, partnering across internal teams, and turning sophisticated media solutions into measurable business results.

 

Results Driven 

  • Consistently meet or exceed established revenue targets on a quarterly and annual basis.
  • Proven capability to sell data-driven and optimized executions across linear and streaming.
  • Manage a Hold Co aligned Advanced Advertising sales pipeline—including forecasting, prospecting, pipeline management, reporting and long-term revenue growth.
  •  Identify and cultivate new Advanced Advertising opportunities across existing and prospective clients.
  • Leverage campaign performance, audience insights, and measurement outputs to uncover incremental revenue opportunities.
  • Establish and cultivate relationships with internal stakeholders and clients by conducting a high volume of face-to-face calls.

A Consultative Sales Executive

  • Collaborate across platforms within your Hold Co (including linear, streaming, and sports) to generate revenue across the Paramount portfolio product suite to deliver holistic client solutions.
  • Act as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert for both clients and internal counterparts.
  • Develop and present data-driven recommendations that improve campaign effectiveness and return on advertising investment.

Multi-platform Proficient

  • Understand the complementary value and nuance of representing all platforms and buy types, including programmatic, across a portfolio to execute a unified advertising strategy. 
  • Stay ahead of industry trends by actively engaging in events, training, and trade publications.
  • Confidently articulate the role of audience-first planning, cross-platform activation, and performance measurement in today's fragmented media landscape.
  • Maintain a deep understanding of the Advanced Advertising ecosystem and competitive marketplace.

 A Leader by Example

  • In partnership with AA Management, work closely with and mentor your Account Manager(s) to develop into future sales leadersCreate meaningful opportunities for Account Managers to participate in client-facing sales efforts and strategic conversations.
  • Deliver best-in-class client service throughout the campaign lifecycle, including onboarding, stewardship, optimization recommendations, and post-campaign reporting.
  • Foster strong collaboration with Planning, Data Solutions, Measurement, Product, Operations, and Sales teams to deliver seamless client experiences.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of advertising sales or agency experience, with a demonstrated understanding of how data flows throughout the ecosystem, and is applied in planning, execution, and measurement

 

Additional Qualifications: 

  • Strong relationship building skills and a collaborative nature.
  • High initiative, problem solving, adaptability and a growth mindset.
  • Proven ability to simplify complex technical and data concepts into compelling client narratives.
  • Well-developed presentation skills that demonstrate a command of our business, offerings and client needs.
  •  Ability to manage stress well, and balance multiple priorities at once.
  • BS/BA degree, or equivalent training and experience.

job.description:
|Current USA TODAY Co. Employees- Please ensure you are using our abbreviated process on the internal Careers site by logging into Dayforce through MyApps|

USA TODAY Co., Inc. is a diversified media company with expansive reach at the national and local level dedicated to empowering and enriching communities. We seek to inspire, inform, and connect audiences as a sustainable, growth focused media and digital marketing solutions company. Through our trusted brands, including the USA TODAY NETWORK, comprised of the national publication, USA TODAY, and local media organizations, including our network of local properties, in the United States, and Newsquest, a wholly-owned subsidiary operating in the United Kingdom, we provide essential journalism, local content, and digital experiences to audiences and businesses. We deliver high-quality, trusted content with a commitment to balanced, unbiased journalism, where and when consumers want to engage. Our digital marketing solutions brand, LocaliQ, supports small and medium-sized businesses with innovative digital marketing products and solutions. USA TODAY Co. open roles are featured on various external job boards. When applying to a position at USA TODAY Co., you should be completing an application on USA TODAY Co. Careers via Dayforce. Job postings directing you to complete an application on other external sites may not be valid. If you are a California resident, you acknowledge that by applying for a job with us, this California Job Applicant Privacy Notice will apply to our collection, use, and disclosure of your personal information. To connect with us, visit www.usatodayco.com

Inside Sales / Account Advisor – Remote Sales

100% Remote | Full-Cycle Sales | Uncapped Earnings

Company: LocaliQ, powered by the USA TODAY Network

Location: 100% Remote – Work from Anywhere

About LocaliQ

At LocaliQ, part of the USA TODAY Network, we help local businesses grow through powerful, data-driven marketing solutions. We bring together marketing expertise, technology, and the reach of a nationally recognized media network to help businesses connect with customers and achieve their goals.

As an Inside Sales / Account Advisor, you’ll work directly with small and mid-sized businesses to understand their needs and connect them with marketing solutions designed to help them grow. You’ll have the opportunity to sell across a broad portfolio of solutions, including SEM, SEO, Social Media, YouTube, OTT/CTV, Display, Websites, and more.

This is a high-activity sales environment where consistency, resilience, and a willingness to put in the work directly contribute to your success.

About the Role

Our Inside Sales / Account Advisor role is a full-cycle, high-activity sales position for someone who enjoys prospecting, building relationships, and owning their results.

You’ll be responsible for developing new business, growing existing accounts, and managing opportunities throughout the sales process. You’ll connect with business owners and decision-makers through outbound calls and virtual meetings, uncover their marketing needs, and recommend solutions that align with their goals.

This role provides the opportunity to operate with a high level of autonomy while having the support, training, technology, and resources of a nationally recognized organization behind you.

You’ll manage your pipeline in Salesforce, maintain consistent prospecting activity, conduct virtual client meetings, present tailored marketing solutions, and help ensure a smooth transition from sale to campaign launch.

In your first 90 days, you’ll participate in hands-on training, learn LocaliQ’s products and sales approach, build your pipeline, and develop the habits needed to succeed in a high-activity sales environment. As you ramp, you’ll take increasing ownership of your pipeline, client relationships, and revenue goals.

Why This Role Stands Out

• $40,000 base salary + uncapped commission, with an expected OTE of approximately $70K–$80K and top performers earning $100K+

• First 3-month earnings guarantee to support you while you ramp

• 100% remote work environment with the flexibility and autonomy to work from wherever you perform best

• Full-cycle sales ownership, from prospecting and discovery through close and post-sale support

• Opportunity to sell an extensive portfolio of digital and traditional marketing solutions

• Contests, incentives, and recognition programs for top performers

• Strong onboarding, training, coaching, and career development

• Career growth opportunities across the organization

• Backed by marketing expertise, Salesforce, and a nationally recognized brand

• Full benefits including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), PTO, and more

What You Will Do

• Drive new business and grow existing accounts through 50+ outbound calls per day and consistent prospecting

• Conduct virtual client meetings to uncover business needs, challenges, and growth opportunities

• Build and manage a strong sales pipeline in Salesforce

• Prospect for new business while identifying opportunities to grow existing accounts

• Recommend and sell bundled, multi-channel marketing solutions based on client goals

• Present marketing solutions across areas such as SEM, SEO, Social Media, YouTube, OTT/CTV, Display, Websites, and more

• Manage opportunities throughout the sales process and consistently work toward revenue goals

• Maintain accurate CRM activity, pipeline information, and follow-up

• Coordinate with internal teams on creative assets and campaign setup to help ensure a successful post-sale experience

• Consistently meet activity expectations and performance goals in a fast-paced, high-activity environment

Qualifications

• 2–5+ years of sales experience, with B2B or high-activity sales strongly preferred

• Confidence with outbound prospecting and engaging new clients

• Ability to manage a pipeline and consistently follow up with prospects and clients

• Strong communication, organization, and follow-through

• Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls and conducting virtual meetings

• Coachable mindset with a willingness to learn, adapt, and continuously improve

• Experience with Salesforce or other CRM tools is a plus

• Interest or exposure to digital marketing is helpful, but not required

• Ability to work independently and stay motivated in a fully remote environment

Who Thrives Here

Successful Account Advisors are consistent, resilient, self-motivated, organized, and driven to succeed. They’re comfortable picking up the phone, starting conversations with new prospects, handling rejection, and staying focused on the next opportunity.

You’ll thrive in this role if you enjoy a fast pace, like having clear goals to work toward, and take ownership of your results. The strongest performers understand that success comes from consistent daily activity, strong follow-through, coachability, and a willingness to keep improving.

You’ll have autonomy in your day-to-day work, but you won’t be on your own. LocaliQ provides the training, coaching, tools, and support needed to help you build your skills and grow your career.

What Success Looks Like

First 3 Months:

Participate in hands-on training, learn LocaliQ’s products and sales process, build your pipeline, establish consistent prospecting habits, and ramp toward goal.

6 Months:

Demonstrate strong product knowledge, maintain consistent activity, manage a healthy pipeline, and establish steady sales performance.

12 Months:

Operate at full productivity across multiple products, effectively manage your pipeline and book of business, and consistently deliver against revenue and activity goals.

Benefits

We believe strong performance should be supported through competitive compensation, development, and opportunities to grow.

• $40,000 base salary + uncapped commission

• Expected OTE of approximately $70K–$80K

• Top performers earning $100K+

• First 3-month earnings guarantee

• 401(k) with company match

• Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage options

• PTO and paid holidays

• 100% remote work environment

• Career progression opportunities

• Ongoing coaching and professional development

• Incentives, contests, and recognition programs

• Access to industry-leading sales and marketing tools

• Training and support from experienced sales leaders

Build Your Future with LocaliQ

If you’re motivated by earning potential, enjoy building relationships, and want the opportunity to own your success, LocaliQ offers a place to build your sales career.

You’ll help local businesses grow, develop valuable sales and marketing expertise, and have the autonomy to make an impact—all while working remotely.

If you’re ready to put your skills to work and grow with a winning team, we encourage you to apply.

#LI-JF1; #LI-Remote

The hourly rate for this role will range between $17.00 and $19.24. Base compensation reflects multiple factors, including (but not limited to) geographic market, education, skills, certifications, and experience. Note: variable compensation is not included in these figures and may apply depending on the role.

Public Notice Coordinator

Location: Green Bay, WI – Green Bay Press-Gazette

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM

Pay: $15.73/hour

Work Arrangement: In-office – off N. Broadway

Build Your Experience in a Stable Monday–Friday Role

Are you someone who is organized, dependable, and good at keeping track of the details? Do you enjoy helping people, working with computers, and having a role where every day has a clear purpose?

LocaliQ/USA TODAY is looking for a Public Notice Coordinator to join our team in Green Bay. This is a great opportunity for someone looking to build or grow their experience in administration, customer service, data entry, and office operations.

You'll help customers and internal teams make sure important public and legal notices are processed accurately and published on time. You'll have a variety of responsibilities throughout the day, including working with customers, responding to emails and phone calls, entering information into computer systems, and keeping up with important deadlines.

No previous experience in public notices is required. If you have the right attitude, are comfortable learning new systems, and take pride in doing things correctly, we'll provide the training you need to succeed.

What You'll Do

• Process public notices and advertisements, making sure information is accurate and deadlines are met

• Work with customers and sales representatives to answer questions and coordinate notice placement

• Respond to emails and phone calls and provide friendly, professional customer service

• Enter and maintain information across multiple computer systems

• Review proofs, reports, and other information for accuracy

• Coordinate with internal teams to resolve questions or issues

job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

We are seeking a Manager, Campaign Operations to join a newly established function at RCA Records. Campaign Operations is the connective tissue between departments — tracking, surfacing, and flagging cross-departmental activity across the full roster to ensure that when a decision gets made in one room, every other team knows what it means for them.

Reporting to the Campaign Operations Lead and sitting within the SVP Commercial Partnerships organization, this role will own the day-to-day operational relationship with a cluster of departments, monitoring their workflows, lead times, and deliverables across every active artist campaign. The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of how to work cross-functionally between departments, thrives in ambiguity, and brings the kind of diplomatic, low-ego energy that builds trust without creating friction.

What you'll do:

  • Department Relationship Management: Own the day-to-day operational relationship with an assigned cluster of departments. Learn their workflows, lead times, tools, and pain points. Become the person they trust to represent their status accurately.
