job.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer - Recommendations (Experience)
job.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is an artist-first platform empowering artists to build and grow their careers by providing them with the most progressive tools, services, and resources. With over 400+ million tracks from 40 million artists, the future of music is SoundCloud.

We are looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer to join our Recommendations Experience team, focusing on building ML-powered features that directly improve personalization, engagement, and satisfaction for our users. While this is an MLE role, you’ll bring strong engineering fundamentals and work across the full stack and end-to-end systems, from data pipelines to APIs to real-time serving, and everything in between. The Recommendations team ships ML-powered features that connect 200M+ users with music they'll love. 

You'll own features end-to-end: from understanding user needs with Product and Design, to architecting data pipelines processing billions of events, to building and shipping production ML systems that balance performance, cost, and user experience. This means working across BigQuery (trillion-row datasets), Airflow orchestration, real-time serving infrastructure (BigTable), APIs, and constant collaboration with Product, Design, Engineering, and Platform teams.

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Develop, test, and productionize ML and LLM-based systems serving real users
  • Design and build end-to-end ML pipelines, including data, features, training, and serving
  • Make technical decisions considering cost, latency, complexity, and maintainability 
  • Navigate distributed systems (BigQuery, BigTable, Airflow, DynamoDB) to build reliable, scalable solutions
  • Set up monitoring, A/B testing, and metrics frameworks to measure real user impact
  • Debug complex issues across data pipelines, ML models, and distributed systems
  • Contribute to technical strategy and team best practices
  • Leverage agentic workflows and AI-assisted engineering as a force multiplier to work at 10x the speed of traditional methods

Experience and Background:

  • 1-2+ years building ML systems in production - you understand the difference between a model that works in Jupyter and one that serves millions of users
  • 4+ years of software engineering experience - you write production code, not just notebooks
  • Strong Python and Scala (or Java/JVM) skills, with experience writing scalable, production code
  • Experience building and deploying ML models end-to-end (data, training, serving, monitoring)
  • Experience building and deploying LLM-based features in production
  • Familiarity with integrating LLMs into ML systems (e.g. retrieval-augmented generation, model serving)
  • Understanding of shared ML architecture across domains (e.g. search and recommendations)
  • Strong focus on data quality and correctness, and how upstream data impacts downstream models and user experience
  • Strong SQL skills for massive datasets (BigQuery, Spark)
  • Cloud platform experience (AWS/GCP) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Experience with distributed data processing and ETL pipelines (Airflow, Spark)
  • Familiarity with ML frameworks such as TensorFlow or PyTorch

job.title: On Air Personality & Content Creator
job.description:

This role combines exceptional on-air performance with digital content creation across broadcast, streaming, podcasts, social media, and live events. The ideal candidate is a storyteller, influencer, and content creator who understands how audiences consume media and can develop compelling, platform-first content that grows engagement and extends the station's Regional Mexican brand beyond traditional radio.

ABOUT YOU:

You are an energetic, interactive, and social media savvy media personality who understands that today's talent represents the station both on and off the air. You are equally comfortable entertaining listeners on the radio, engaging audiences on social media, creating digital first content, and helping shape the sound and strategy of a growing multimedia brand. You embrace emerging technologies and understand how to build meaningful audience connections across broadcast, streaming, podcasts, websites, mobile apps, video platforms, and social media.

YOUR DAY-TO-DAY:

  • Create engaging, audience-focused content across broadcast, digital, streaming, podcasts, video, and social media.
  • Build authentic audience relationships through compelling storytelling, creativity, and consistent brand representation.
  • Leverage audience insights, analytics, and emerging trends to optimize content performance and audience growth.
  • Collaborate across Programming, Digital, Promotions, Sales, Marketing, Production, and other internal teams to execute multi-platform initiatives.
  • Embrace new technologies, evolving platforms, and changing audience behaviors while maintaining the highest standards of professionalism and compliance.
  • Host and contribute to on-air programming while creating engaging content across digital, streaming, podcasts, video, and social media platforms.
  • Develop, produce, edit, and publish original multimedia content, including interviews, recurring series, promotions, livestreams, branded content, and audience engagement initiatives.
  • Serve as an on-camera personality representing the station across broadcast, digital platforms, community events, remote broadcasts, concerts, and promotional activations.
  • Cover local events, artists, entertainment, and cultural moments by creating timely, platform-specific content that drives audience engagement.
  • Write scripts, copy, interview questions, captions, voice-overs, promotional assets, sponsorship integrations, and other creative content supporting station initiatives.

  • Monitor social trends, audience insights, and performance analytics to identify content opportunities and optimize audience growth.
  • Collaborate with Programming, Promotions, Digital, Marketing, Sales, and Production teams to execute integrated content strategies and station campaigns.
  • Operate production equipment and content creation tools while maintaining compliance with FCC regulations, company policies, and broadcast standards.
  • Perform other duties and special projects as assigned.

YOU HAVE:

  • Experience as an on-air personality, digital content creator, influencer, or multimedia storyteller.
  • Be familiar with the Regional Mexican music format, as well as the groups or singers within the genre.
  • Strong storytelling, interviewing, writing, communication, and on-camera presentation skills.
  • Experience creating engaging content across broadcast, podcasts, streaming, video, and social media platforms.
  • Strong understanding of audience development, digital content strategy, social platforms, and emerging trends.
  • Experience shooting, editing, publishing, and optimizing video and multimedia content using mobile and professional production tools.
  • Ability to interpret audience insights and analytics to improve content performance and audience engagement.
  • Strong organizational, collaboration, project management, and time management skills.
  • Bilingual English and Spanish preferred.
  • Ability to work evenings, weekends, holidays, remote broadcasts, community events, and other schedules as business needs require.
  • Reliable transportation required.

job.title: Becario de Mercadotecnia o Publicidad en el área de Cumplimiento Publicitario
job.description:
¡TelevisaUnivision está en búsqueda de un Becario de Mercadotecnia o Publicidad en el área de Cumplimiento Publicitario. 

Ubicación:  Ciudad de México (Protele), Insurgentes. 

Forma parte del equipo de TelevisaUnivision, la empresa líder en el mundo de medios y contenido en español. TelevisaUnivision cuenta con la más extensa videoteca de contenido propio y es líder en capacidad de producción en el sector, lo que impulsa su contenido digital de streaming, televisión tradicional y plataformas de radio. 

Somos una empresa vibrante con más de 10,000 colaboradores en México, Colombia y EE. UU. Nos une la pasión por el entretenimiento, la creatividad y los grandes hitos. En TelevisaUnivision encontrarás un ambiente amigable y lleno de equidad para crecer personal y profesionalmente. 

Dirigido a estudiantes que desean cumplir con sus prácticas profesionales o servicio social en un entorno corporativo, esta experiencia representa una excelente oportunidad para aplicar tus conocimientos en la práctica.

¡Únete y sé parte de este gran equipo dinámico!

Como Becario de Mercadotecnia o Publicidad en el área de Cumplimiento Publicitario, participarás en proyectos enfocados en la mejora continua de procesos mediante Inteligencia Artificial, automatización, organización de información y desarrollo de entornos de prueba.

  Job Title: Lead Software Engineer in Test Team: Global Quality Engineering Location: New York City, Los Angeles, San Francisco   Overview Paramount Skydance Corp. is seeking a Staff Software Engineer in Test to design, architect, and deliver high-quality, scalable, and reliable automated testing solutions across our enterprise platforms. This senior technical role combines deep Java engineering expertise, advanced test automation, media/streaming domain knowledge, and modern CI/CD practices to accelerate quality, reduce risk, and ensure world-class customer experiences across CTV, SmartTV, mobile, and web. You will be a senior technical leader within the Global Quality Engineering (GQE) organization. You will use and enhance our existing departmental automation framework, define quality strategies, and mentor engineers across GQE to elevate testing maturity and engineering excellence. You will also drive AI-augmented development and testing practices using GitHub Copilot (in-IDE), Cursor, and similar tools.   Key Responsibilities   Automation Framework Architecture • Enhance and extend our existing Java-based departmental test automation framework supporting API, UI, Mobile, CTV/SmartTV, and integration testing; introduce reusable libraries, utilities, and patterns to improve stability and scale. • Establish scalable patterns for reusable test components, data management, assertions, parallelization, and distributed execution. • Integrate the framework deeply into CI/CD pipelines to support shift-left testing and continuous quality.   AI-Augmented Quality Engineering • Champion AI-assisted development and testing using tools such as GitHub Copilot (IDE), Cursor, and LLM-based assistants to improve developer productivity, test authoring velocity, code reviews, and defect triage. • Apply prompt engineering and retrieval techniques to accelerate test case generation, log/telemetry summarization, video-quality anomaly detection, and root-cause analysis. • Evaluate and integrate functional AI capabilities that measurably reduce flakiness, false positives, and triage time within the existing framework.   Media & Multi-Platform Quality • Expand automation coverage for video playback, streaming resiliency, DRM flows, SSAI/CSAI ad insertion, captions/subtitles, and content protection. • Validate QoE metrics (startup time, rebuffering ratio, frame drops, video/audio sync, error recovery) across Roku, Fire TV, Android TV/Google TV, Samsung Tizen, LG webOS, Apple TV, iOS/Android mobile apps, and modern web players. • Leverage media tooling such as ffmpeg/ffprobe, Charles/Fiddler, and player inspection APIs for diagnostics and validation. Quality Engineering Technical Leadership • Define technical strategy for automated testing across services, microservices, UIs, mobile apps, and OTT/CTV applications leveraging the departmental framework. • Ensure consistent adoption of engineering best practices, coding standards, and high-quality test development patterns. • Lead the evaluation and adoption of modern automation technologies and quality platforms.   Cross Functional Collaboration • Partner with Video Engineering, Playback/Player, Ads/Monetization, CDN/Streaming Operations, and Platform teams to ensure robust validation of streaming experiences and ad workflows. • Collaborate with Product to ensure test coverage aligns to business priorities and quality goals. • Work closely with Platform and Data Engineering to support scalable test environments, quality data, and telemetry.   Technical Execution • Design and implement complex automated test suites using Java, Selenium, Appium, JMeter, Locust, REST-Assured, TestNG/JUnit, and related tooling within the existing framework. • Build and optimize testing strategies including API/contract, integration, performance/reliability, and device-level testing for CTV/SmartTV, mobile, and web. • Diagnose and tackle issues related to automation reliability, environment instability, device fragmentation, and system integration.   Required Qualifications • 7+ years of experience in software engineering or quality engineering with robust Java development expertise. • Demonstrated experience using and enhancing an existing enterprise/departmental automation framework. • Deep expertise in common test automation tools (Selenium, Appium, Playwright, REST-Assured, TestNG, JUnit, Maven/Gradle). • AI experience (must-have): hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools. This includes tools like Claude Code, GitHub Copilot (IDE), Cursor, or similar. Candidates should also have useful prompt engineering skills for code and tests. LLMs are leveraged for tasks such as generating tests, suggesting code reviews, summarizing logs, and speeding up triage. • Strong knowledge of CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Argo, Spinnaker) and quality gates. • Proven experience testing media/streaming applications across CTV (Roku, Fire TV, Android TV/Google TV), SmartTV (Tizen/webOS), iOS/Android mobile, and web. • Hands-on validation of HLS/DASH, ABR, DRM, captions/subtitles, and QoE metrics. • Cloud experience (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). • Solid knowledge of software design patterns, data structures, and core engineering principles.   Preferred Qualifications • Experience mentoring engineers or leading cross-functional automation initiatives. • Familiarity with observability and APM tools (Grafana, Prometheus, NewRelic, DataDog) and media telemetry(Conviva, MUX, NPAW etc). • Experience with contract testing (PACT), service virtualization, or synthetic media test data. • Exposure to CTV/SmartTV automation stacks and remote device labs.   Key Competencies • Technical leadership – ability to guide teams and evolve automation coverage. • Quality mindset – commitment to reliability, maintainability, and continuous improvement. • AI fluency – judgment on where AI adds measurable value in testing. • Systems thinking – knowledge of distributed systems and complex media pipelines. • Ownership – ability to drive initiatives end-to-end with autonomy.   Success Metrics • Increased automation coverage across CTV/SmartTV, mobile, and web; reduced manual regression. • Measurable reduction in escaped defects and media playback incidents. • Improved stability and reliability of automated pipelines and device runs. • Faster release cycles through scalable, AI-augmented automation. • Broad adoption and consistent usage of the GQE test framework across teams

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?

Overview

 We're hiring a Senior Machine Learning Operations Engineer to own the operational layer around our personalization and recommendation Machine Learning (ML) systems. Our models retrain and deploy daily on automated pipelines. Your job is to make sure we can trust what's running, know when something is off, and fix it fast. You'll sit within DevOps and work closely with ML engineers, who own the models end-to-end. You won't be building infrastructure from scratch, you'll partner with DevOps and Platform Engineering to get the tooling you need, then own it day-to-day.

What You'll Do
  • Own model traceability: Every model in production should have clear lineage: what data trained it, what code produced it, what validation it passed, and how it's performing. Evaluate and recommend tooling for versioning, metadata, and model registry, and work with MLEs to drive adoption.
  • Build end-to-end monitoring: Monitor the full signal path: data arrival, feature distribution stability, model metrics, and serving latency against SLA. Own this individually, don't rely solely on upstream teams to catch their own issues.
  • Partner with Data Engineering on data quality: Collaborate to surface data quality issues, detect drift in upstream sources, and ensure features stay fresh and reliable.
  • Detect issues proactively: Track drift over weeks, flag slow degradation before it crosses a threshold, surface feature freshness problems before they cascade.
  • Build diagnostic tooling: When something goes wrong, get from "recommendations look off" to root cause in minutes. That means ensuring the right context is logged at each stage, candidates, features, serving context, and building the dashboards to tie it collectively.
  • Own incident response for ML systems: Maintain rollback playbooks and pre-defined hotfix strategies with quantified tradeoffs. Own automated gates that block bad deployments. Run post-mortems and close the gaps.
  • Coordinate on post-deployment metrics: Work with ML engineers, data engineers, and stakeholders to define what metrics to collect after deployment and why they matter.


Basic Qualifications
  • 5+ years in ML engineering, applied ML, or a related ML role, with demonstrated experience on the operational side of monitoring, reliability, deployment, or incident response
  • Has built or operated model registries, ML monitoring systems, or production ML pipelines
  • Understands ML systems end-to-end — not just the infra layer, but why a stale feature or a shifted distribution matters
  • Robust SQL skills and comfort digging into data distributions, feature health, and model behavior
  • Comfortable partnering with DevOps and Platform teams to define infrastructure needs without needing to own the infra yourself


Additional Qualifications

  • Experience operating recommendation or personalization systems at scale

In This Role You'll:


Paramount Tech is hiring a 403g Maintenance Technician responsible for maintenance and support of production and broadcast systems for the CBS Network and affiliated production units, providing critical 24x7 support for on-air and production infrastructure. This role covers hands-on troubleshooting and repair of routing systems, audio/video transport and IP media infrastructure (SDI and SMPTE 2110), production switchers, audio consoles, media file transfer and storage systems, video acquisition and playback servers, non-linear postproduction systems, production intercom, cameras, prompters, and other studio production systems, working to mitigate impact to production and on-air deadlines. This is a shift-based role covering rotating shifts including nights, weekends, and holidays, with on-call/callback responsibilities per the applicable collective bargaining agreement.

 

Basic Qualifications You Bring:

 

•    3+ years' experience working with professional television broadcast equipment, with demonstrated ability to troubleshoot to the component/system level under time pressure, in a live production environment.
•    Hands-on experience with broadcast test equipment (waveform monitors, vector-scopes, audio analyzers, cable/fiber test sets) and cable/fiber termination and testing.
•    In-depth knowledge in of the following: Video, Audio, Cameras, Control/Data Systems, RF, Fiber-Optics, and IP media distribution (SMPTE 2110/2059).
•    Working knowledge of IP networking fundamentals — VLANs, subnetting, multicast, and basic switch/router configuration — sufficient to troubleshoot IP-based media infrastructure.
•    Strong understanding of broadcast media systems design and signal flow; ability to read and work from schematics and as-built documentation.
•    Experience with Windows, Linux, and macOS workstation/server environments as used in broadcast and postproduction facilities.
•    Ability to communicate technical root-cause and status updates clearly to non-technical production staff (directors, TDs, producers) during live troubleshooting.
•    Ability to perform physical work associated with rack and machine room environments, including lifting equipment and working in confined or elevated spaces.

 

Bonus Skills:

 

•    Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Broadcast Engineering, or IT preferred.
•    Direct experience with SMPTE ST 2110 (2110-20/30/40) and ST 2059 PTP timing in a production environment.
•    Scripting/automation experience (Python, JSON) for diagnostics, monitoring, or system integration.
•    Experience with virtualized and cloud-based media systems, including container management.
•    Familiarity with NMOS control/discovery frameworks in an IP media environment.
•    Familiarity with Evertz, Grass Valley routing systems; RTS intercom, Sony switchers and cameras, EVS, Grass Valley AMPP video playout/record servers a plus.

The Director of Creative Music, Paramount Pictures serves as a key creative partner across Paramount Pictures’ theatrical slate, supporting filmmakers and creative leadership in the development and execution of music for feature films. Operating as an in-house music supervisor, this role oversees all creative music elements from early development through final delivery, ensuring that each film’s musical vision enhances storytelling and supports the filmmaker’s intent.   This position works closely with directors, producers, composers, artists, and internal studio partners to deliver high-quality, filmmaker-driven music for Paramount Pictures’ theatrical releases. This position is based at the historic Paramount Lot in Los Angeles.  

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Serve as a trusted creative collaborator to filmmakers and talent throughout pre-production, production, and post-production.
  • Advocate for the filmmaker’s creative vision while ensuring alignment with Paramount Pictures’ production goals and creative standards.
  • Act as the in-house music supervisor for assigned Paramount Pictures theatrical films.
  • Oversee all creative music elements including score, source music, needle drops, themes, and temp music.
  • Supervise spotting sessions, music reviews, and creative discussions with filmmakers and post-production teams.
  • Ensure music choices support narrative, tone, and emotional impact.
  • Identify, recommend, and help secure composers and music collaborators in partnership with filmmakers.
  • Guide composers creatively throughout the scoring process, maintaining clear communication between creative and post-production teams.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with composers, artists, music editors, and scoring partners.
  • Oversee music workflows through production and post-production, including scoring schedules, recording sessions, and final mixes.
  • Attend scoring sessions, dubbing sessions, and final mixes as appropriate.
  • Ensure all music is creatively approved, delivered on time, and ready for theatrical release.
  • Collaborate with internal Paramount Pictures teams including Production, Post-Production, Creative Affairs, Legal, Business Affairs, Finance, and Marketing.
  • Partner with music clearance and licensing teams to balance creative ambition with budgetary and legal requirements.
  • Support soundtrack, marketing, publicity, and awards initiatives tied to Paramount Pictures’ theatrical releases.

  • 8+ years of experience in music supervision, film music, or creative music roles within a theatrical film or studio environment.
  • Proven experience supervising music for feature films from development through post-production.
  • Strong creative instincts with deep knowledge of film scoring and source music.
  • Established relationships with composers, filmmakers, artists, and music industry partners.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple films simultaneously across a theatrical slate.

  • Prior in-house studio experience at a major theatrical studio.

Title: Account Executive

Join Hearst Connecticut Media Group to help deliver impactful media campaigns for our customers, leveraging our rich history, extensive audience reach, best-in-class advertising solutions, and the power of cutting-edge AI tools!

Role Overview: Hearst Newspapers is investing in its sales force, and we want you to be a part of it! We are looking for a digitally savvy, highly motivated Account Executive to join our advertising team at Hearst Connecticut Media Group. As an Account Executive, you will be responsible for developing and managing a sales pipeline and building new business relationships with local advertisers throughout the Connecticut area. You will work with your customers to promote compelling solutions that best fit their marketing needs. As an advocate for the customer within Hearst Connecticut Media Group, the role works in cooperation with other departments to ensure we can meet and exceed customer expectations both in performance and process. Hearst Newspapers operates on a hybrid work week schedule. 

Why Hearst Connecticut Media Group? 

Our people make the difference! Our diverse team is filled with passionate individuals who want to win. We offer an upbeat and collaborative working environment where challenging the norm is encouraged. With ample opportunities to learn new skills and advance within the organization, our team members are given the tools to learn and grow their careers.

Leverage Advanced AI for Maximum Efficiency and Earnings
Imagine having a personal assistant that never sleeps. Our state-of-the-art AI tools, including ChatGPT Enterprise and Gong.io, streamline your workflow, enabling you to close deals faster and manage your pipeline more effectively. 

This means more time to focus on what you love and a direct boost to your earnings potential.

Exclusive Partnership with OpenAI
Through our strategic content partnership with OpenAI and our exclusive ChatGPT Enterprise license, we have unparalleled access to the latest advancements in AI technology. 

This partnership provides us—and you—with a massive competitive edge in the market, ensuring you have the most powerful tools at your disposal to drive sales and exceed targets.

Personalized AI Tutors for Seamless Onboarding
Your success starts from day one. With our personalized AI tutors, every question you have, and every training need you encounter is met with instant, tailored support. 

These AI-driven mentors ensure you learn and sell as quickly and efficiently as possible, empowering you to hit the ground running and achieve your goals faster.

What will you do?

  • Drive Success with Innovative Tools: Utilize our AI-powered software to enhance every stage of the sales cycle, from prospecting and planning to presenting and closing deals.

  • Lead Generation: Call on local small to medium sized businesses to show the value of our suite of digital media advertising products from social media, display, video, programmatic, SEO/SEM to traditional advertisements. You will generate new leads through cold calling, networking, and prospecting, as well as staying aware of any new businesses opening in the area. You will own the sales cycle and will have the support of your local account management team to aid in continued support after the sale!
  • Product Expertise: Become an expert on our digital and print products/services. The first three weeks of hire, you will be provided with both global and local training to be fully educated before even going out on your own! You will also have full support throughout your career which includes continual learning and training to grow and achieves success as an Account Executive. 
  • Execute sales tactics: Implementing marketing strategies, delivering effective sales presentations with passion to consistently earn, retain and increase revenue.
  • Advertising Solutions: Create engaging advertising solutions to solve clients’ business needs.
  • Client Solutions: Recommend new products and promotional opportunities to current clients and handle objections efficiently. Be a large part of the local business community and boosting your clients’ businesses through multiple digital media channels.
  • Forecasting: Manage client pipeline and monthly revenue forecast in Salesforce.com.

 

What will it take to be successful?

  • Purposeful: You are direct and get things done quickly, with confidence, integrity, and determination.
  • Adaptable: You react and adjust to changing conditions and come up with practical ideas to deal with them.
  • Driven: You have self-assurance and competitive drive, delivering high-quality, organized, and repeatable results.
  • Communicator: You are a lively and intelligent person with a stimulating influence on others.
  • Trend-Savvy: you will keep informed of industry developments to ensure our digital advertising strategies remain cutting-edge and effective.

 

What we’re looking for:

  • Education: BA/BS degree in Advertising, Marketing, or Communications a plus or equivalent experience.
  • Experience: 2+ years of business-to-business outside sales in advertising or media, with a proven success in new business acquisition and exceeding revenue goals.
  • Skills: Superior presentation, interpersonal, and communication skills. Technically savvy with experience in Salesforce, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Mindset: Goal-oriented, competitive, and forward-thinking with strong business and financial acumen.

 

What we offer:

  • Dynamic Environment: A great work environment where it's never boring.
  • Comprehensive Training: Paid in-depth sales and product training.
  • Competitive Compensation: Competitive base salary with uncapped commissions for unlimited earning potential.
  • Collaborative Culture: Ideas and input are always welcome.

  • Learn more about Hearst Newspapers at www.joinhnp.com

     

Compensation: In accordance with applicable law, Hearst is required to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation for this role if hired in Connecticut. The reasonable estimate, if hired in Connecticut, is $50,000 - $60,000 base plus commissions with on-target earning potential of $90,000 - $120,000 annualized in the 1st year, based on individual performance, commissions are uncapped for unlimited earning potential. A final decision on the successful candidate’s starting salary will be based on a number of permissible, non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to skills and experience, training, certifications, and education.

Benefits: Eligible employees enjoy Health, dental, vision coverage, Health savings and/or flexible spending accounts, short & long-term disability insurance, 401k with company match, paid time off for vacation, sick days, company holidays and floating holidays.

The Finance Analyst supports the Finance team through joint venture and hybrid deal reporting, account reconciliations, physical sales reporting, month-end support, tax fillings and recurring financial analyses. The role is responsible for accurate and timely preparation of partner reporting, supporting schedules, and reconciliations, while maintaining clear documentation and escalating irregular items to the Senior Manager, Finance.

The Role

  • Prepare third-party label reporting, statements, and supporting schedules in accordance with contractual agreements.

  • Produce recurring sales, product mix, and financial reporting to support business planning and accounting processes.
  • Generate periodic reports using finance systems and provide ad hoc analysis and reporting support to Finance leadership.

  • Analyze financial and operational data to identify trends, variances, and opportunities for process improvement.

job.description:
Overview

Job Title: WCCO Producer

 

Department: Programming

 

Reporting To: Brand Manager

 

Employment Type: Full-Time

 

Location(s): Minneapolis, M.N. 

 

Work Arrangement: On-Site

 

Audacy offers employees who are eligible for benefits with a comprehensive benefits package which includes: a health care coordinator, medical, dental, vision, mental health, telemedicine, flexible spending accounts, health savings account, disability, life insurance, critical illness, hospital indemnity, accident insurance, paid time off (sick, flex-time away/vacation days, personal, parental, volunteer), 401(k) retirement plan, student loan payment assistance program, legal assistance, life assistance program, identity theft protection, discounted home and auto insurance, and pet insurance.

Overview:

Audacy Minneapolis' WCCO-AM, is searching for an experienced, full-time Producer. Duties include following station format, editing podcasts, assisting with remote talk broadcasts, handling live phone calls, sound effects, conceptualizing topics, arranging guest interviews, playing commercials and IDs according to the program and commercial logs, following applicable laws and FCC regulations and executing to the Program Director’s direction. Candidates must have prior radio experience and be familiar with control room operations. Applicants should have a minimum of three (3) years’ experience operating broadcast equipment and conceptualizing topics in a broadcast setting. Editing and production experience is preferred. The right candidate will be a team player, be computer savvy, and have the flexibility to work their assigned shift.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • One to three years as producer or on-air contributor
  • Passion for current events, news, pop culture and what’s happening around town
  • Comfortable running (and learning) multiple different board operating styles
  • Experience with radio clocks, logs and scheduling
  • Working knowledge of computer audio software, Adobe Audition, and Wide Orbit preferred
  • Demonstrated ability for using social media including, but not limited to, Facebook, YouTube, Twitter, and Instagram.
  • Willingness to learn new tools and how they can help content, distribution or sales
  • Willing to work in the office or on location.
  • Multi-task with a variety of duties
  • Ability to ad lib while on air and at appearances in a coherent manner in situations that can change quickly.
  • Project an appropriate professional appearance and demeanor.
  • Work in compliance with company and FCC policies and procedures.
  • Work established schedule and other hours as needed. Travel to and attend station promotional appearances including sales appearances.

Audacy’s Enterprise Team is looking to add to our Account Manager team. The Account Manager role is responsible for quarterbacking the post-sale process once a campaign has been sold, as well as helping strategize what we’re going to market with from a pre-sale perspective. The Account Manager oversees the entire Sales process, from the point of RFP to the final wrap report and must be familiar with each part in the process to ensure we’re going to market with the best service possible. The ideal candidate will possess exceptional client-facing skills, have a thorough understanding of marketing and integrated media channels, and be able to lead large-scale campaigns from start to finish while being the main point of contact for Audacy. You will have a knack for communicating efficiently and effectively under pressure to both internally & externally, and the detail orientation skills to ensure that the client’s needs are met.

Please note: This is a pipeline posting. We are always on the lookout for exceptional talent to join our dynamic team. While we may not have an immediate opening, we are continuously building a pipeline of talented individuals who are interested in becoming a part of our organization when opportunities arise. By submitting your application, you will become part of our talent pool. When we have a hiring need that matches your profile, we will reach out to you directly to discuss the opportunity. Overview

Job Title: Executive Producer - The Chris & Amy Show

 

Department: Programming

 

Reporting To: Brand Manager

Work Arrangement: On-Site

Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

Overview:

KMOX Radio, the legendary Voice of St. Louis, is looking for a modern, creative and digitally savvy Executive Producer to help take The Chris & Amy Show to the next level. We're looking for someone who understands that a great show can live far beyond the radio clock — on YouTube, social media, podcasts, video, digital platforms and wherever St. Louis audiences consume content. The Executive Producer will oversee the show's daily content strategy, preparation and execution while helping expand The Chris & Amy Show into a multi-platform St. Louis media brand. You'll work closely with Chris and Amy to develop ideas, create compelling conversations, find great guests and stories, and turn the best moments from the show into content that can reach new audiences. You should have a great ear for radio — but you should also have a great eye for content.

Responsibilities

What You'll Do:

  • Develop the daily content strategy and show rundown with Chris and Amy.
  • Identify the stories, conversations and personalities that will drive the show.
  • Create original features, recurring benchmarks, games, bits and listener-driven content.
  • Research for interviews, conversations and major topics.
  • Constantly look for ways to make the show more entertaining, surprising, relevant and local.
  • Running a live radio board and executing a show in real time.
  • Understanding clocks, formats, commercial breaks and station logs.
  • Editing and producing audio quickly and cleanly.
  • Booking and preparing guests.
  • Writing compelling intros, teases, promos and digital copy.
  • Managing live callers, interviews and breaking content.
  • Working with newsroom, traffic, weather and other station resources.
  • Making quick decisions when the show doesn't go according to plan.

Qualifications

More About You:

 

Required & Preferred:

But you also need to think beyond radio.

We're looking for someone who understands that the best moments on The Chris & Amy Show shouldn't end when the microphone is turned off.

You should be able to identify an on-air conversation and immediately see its potential as:

  • A YouTube video.
  • A short-form video.
  • A podcast segment.
  • A social clip.
  • A behind-the-scenes piece.
  • A digital-only conversation.
  • A community or live event opportunity.

The goal is not simply to produce a better radio show.  The goal is to build a bigger Chris & Amy audience — on the radio and everywhere else people consume content.

Expand the show beyond radio

  • Develop a daily content strategy that extends the show across YouTube, video, social media, podcasts and digital platforms.
  • Identify moments during the live show that have the potential to become compelling digital content.
  • Think proactively about content that should be created specifically for digital audiences.
  • Develop short-form video, social clips, interviews, behind-the-scenes content and other original digital features.

The ideal candidate is:

  • An experienced radio producer with a modern content mindset.
  • A strong writer and storyteller.
  • Someone who understands personality-driven radio.
  • Highly knowledgeable about digital video, social media and audience growth.
  • Comfortable creating and editing short-form video and digital content.
  • Someone who understands platforms such as YouTube, Instagram, TikTok and Facebook and knows that each platform requires a different approach.
  • Highly organized but not afraid to throw out the rundown when a great idea comes along.
  • Curious about culture, entertainment, sports, news and — most importantly — St. Louis.
  • Comfortable working with strong personalities.
  • An idea generator who is constantly thinking about "What more can I do?"

Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization.

 

Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

 

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

 

This is a hybrid position with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

 

This position can be based in Montreal, Toronto or Ottawa.


Your Role

 

The Data Governance Analyst operationalizes and drives the adoption of the enterprise data governance framework across the organization. This role acts as a critical bridge between the central Data Governance Office, domain-level data teams, and business stakeholders. The Analyst ensures that policies, data quality programs, and tooling (such as the enterprise data catalog) are seamless to adopt, clearly understood, and effectively tracked from the operational level up to executive council briefings.

 

Main Responsibilities:

  • Framework & Tool Deployment: Support the rollout of the enterprise data governance program, including frameworks, policies, and the implementation of the enterprise data catalog.
  • Manage the activities and artifacts (deliverables, documentations, reports) of the enterprise data governance office.
  • Drive the communication and adoption of data governance roles framework across domains, coordinate the activities of cross-domain working groups and communities of practice as needed.
  • Guiding and supporting data officers, stewards, and custodians by providing practical tools, templates, and guidance. Focus on designing user-friendly processes that make data compliance easier for teams to adopt.
  • Cross-Domain Facilitation: Manage regular communications and touchpoints with distributed business unit data teams to drive framework adoption, monitor progress, and ensure organizational consistency.
  • Roadmap & Milestone Tracking: Partner with data domains to communicate, track, and support the prioritization of data governance milestones within their respective roadmaps and planning cycles.
  • Organize and facilitate meetings, workshops, and working groups; take ownership of documenting, communicating, and tracking post-meeting action items to completion.
  • Stakeholder Education: Serve as an internal data governance advocate. Simplify complex data compliance, metadata, and role-and-responsibility concepts into clear, accessible language for non-technical stakeholders.
  • Maintain up-to-date repository of data governance documentation, standards, and best practices to ensure a single source of truth for the organization.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineering and BI teams to develop and maintain automated data governance dashboards and metrics, tracking overall program progress and compliance.
  • Support the planning, delivery, and reporting of data quality initiatives, including the definition of quality scores and the formal tracking of data quality issues.
  • Develop, synthesize, and deliver clear presentation materials and briefings for executive discussions, stakeholder communications, cross-domain data committees.

 

Qualifications, Experience and Skills:

 

Education:

  • Undergraduate degree in business, engineering, computer science, or quantitative discipline with 3+ years of relevant experience in data governance, management or analytics functions.

 

Experience (relevant to the role):

  • Experience in program development and using data governance tools and platforms such as Collibra, Microsoft, Databricks, Informatica, or similar platforms.
  • Working knowledge of data management concepts, processes, and tools (e.g., Collibra, JIRA, Confluence), with familiarity in SQL and cloud platforms.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Versatility and adaptability to handle diverse tasks.
  • Effective communication and documentation abilities.
  • Dashboard, reporting and data visualization tool experience an asset (eg: PowerBI, Tableau).
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate across business and technology teams.
  • Experience coordinating with data vendors is a plus.
  • Effective stakeholder engagement and relationship‑management skills, including the ability to prepare materials, brief senior leaders, and drive collaboration across diverse internal teams.

In an environment where data has become a critical strategic asset supporting decision-making, advanced analytics and artificial intelligence solutions, CBC/Radio-Canada is implementing an enterprise-wide data governance program. The creation of the Director, Enterprise Data Governance role is at the heart of this transformation and aims to establish the foundations required for the effective, secure and consistent management of information assets.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

Framework, Policies & Compliance

  • Develop, refine, and enforce enterprise-wide data governance policies, directives, and standards aligned with corporate priorities.
  • Work with Legal, InfoSec, and Data Engineering to establish data classification rules, access controls, and compliance monitoring.
  • Define core data concepts and maintain central governance documentation and artifacts.

 

Core Programs & Data Operations

  • Data Catalog & Metadata: Oversee the implementation of an enterprise data catalog and metadata management processes to ensure reporting mechanisms and datasets are clear and accessible.
  • Data Quality & Lineage: Stand up an enterprise data quality program and implement data lineage tracking to monitor how data moves across systems.
  • Usability & AI Readiness: Partner with technology and analytics teams to make sure data is clean and structured for BI, reporting, and AI/ML models.

 

Governance Bodies & Stakeholder Leadership

  • Manage the Enterprise Data Governance Steering Committee to align senior leadership on strategic priorities.
  • Lead the Enterprise Data Council (domain leads and Data Officers) to translate strategic directives into policies and actionable initiatives.
  • Drive the creation of cross-functional networks of data stewards, owners, custodians, and working groups as needed.

 

Data Literacy & Culture

  • Lead change management, training, and communication programs to improve overall data literacy across the corporation.
  • Influence senior executives and business stakeholders to adopt governance practices and understand their role in protecting and using data.
  • Build, mentor, and lead a small, high-impact data governance team.

 

Metrics, KPI Tracking & Reporting                       

  • Define, track, and report on core governance KPIs, including data quality, issue resolution, policy compliance, and user adoption.
  • Build and maintain executive dashboards to regularly report program progress and outcomes to leadership.

 

What You Bring

 

Qualifications, experience & skills

  • 5+ years of experience in data management, governance, or a related field.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.
  • Proven experience building and launching enterprise data governance programs.
  • Experience leading enterprise-grade data catalog / data governance tooling initiatives.
  • Experience developing and managing a business glossary.
  • Experience operating in a national, matrixed organization.
  • Bilingualism (English and French).

 

Technical:

  • Core Skills & Technical Proficiencies: Strong hands-on experience with SQL, data modeling, structured/unstructured data governance, and ETL/ELT logic. Profiency  withPython, Jira, and workflow mapping tools is a key asset.

  • Data Lifecycle & Quality Operations: Proven track record in building and validating data lineage, managing data quality validation/remediation, and creating or overseeing automated scripts for metadata harvesting and validation.
  • Architecture & Team Collaboration: Deep understanding of modern data architectures (cloud data platforms, BI/analytics, AI/ML pipelines) paired with a strong ability to collaborate across technical, product, vendor, and business teams.
  • Communication & Technical Translation: Exceptional ability to translate complex technical, architectural, and regulatory concepts into clear, actionable business language.
  • Nice-to-Have Technical Assets: Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and API-based metadata harvesting.

 

Non-technical:

  • Ability to manage cross-functional teams.
  • Business and technical requirements documentation skills.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Excellent communication and facilitation abilities.
  • Ability to lead by influence and work across teams and business units at varying levels of data governance maturity.

The Director, AI Governance and Adoption is responsible for driving the evolution of the enterprise AI governance framework, and facilitating the responsible adoption of artificial intelligence technologies across the organization. Acting as a strategic partner to executives and business teams, this individual supports the identification of opportunities, the integration of value-creating solutions and the development of an AI-literate culture. The incumbent also oversees the development of the practices, policies and governance mechanisms required to ensure the responsible and sustainable use of artificial intelligence technologies.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

Governance, Policy & Risk Management

  • Define and enforce corporate AI policies, directives, and guardrails across all business units.
  • Operationalize risk controls and decision accountabilities across the entire AI lifecycle (procurement, data retrieval, tool actions, and human oversight).
  • Build and maintain a central inventory of all internal and third-party AI assets to track systemic risk.

 

Shadow AI & Secure Experimentation

  • Audit unsanctioned AI tools ("shadow AI") across departments and facilitate the transition of use cases into secure enterprise environments.
  • Partner with tech teams to set safety guardrails for low-code/no-code tools, allowing employees to experiment safely.

 

Leadership, Committees & Alignment

  • Lead the AI Usage Oversight Committee and coordinate the enterprise AI Steering Committee.
  • Align AI initiatives with Legal, Privacy, InfoSec, Data Governance, and Journalistic Standards to ensure regulatory compliance.

 

Adoption, Enablement & Literacy

  • Develop training programs, playbooks, office hours, and champion networks to boost organization-wide AI literacy.
  • Help business units integrate deployed AI solutions into their everyday production workflows.

 

Workflow Re-Engineering & Value Tracking

  • Direct a cross-functional "Fusion Team" to help management re-engineer legacy workflows for native AI integration.
  • Define, track, and report performance and governance metrics to prove ROI and accountability.

 

Vendor Management & Industry Representation

  • Advise Procurement and Legal on standards for evaluating and onboarding third-party AI vendors.
  • Represent the organization (CBC/Radio-Canada) at national and international conferences, contributing to public media data provenance standards.

 

Internal Governance & Executive Alignment

  • Senior Advisory: Advise executives on AI strategy, run governance committees, and deliver executive leadership-level briefings when required.
  • Standards & Training: Roll out AI policies across all departments (Media, Tech, Business) and partner with L&D on staff training and literacy initiatives.

 

AI Adoption & Change Management

  • Fusion Team Leadership: Stand up and lead a cross-functional team of change management, training, and process optimization specialists.
  • Workflow Integration: Work with department heads and staff to resolve workflow pain points and drive adoption of approved AI tools.
  • Tracking & Reporting: Partner with Innovation Leads to establish ROI metrics and report adoption progress, blockers, and learnings to leadership.

 

External Relations & Industry Networks

  • Industry and Peer Collaboration: Partner with media organizations, industry groups (EBU, INMA), and analysts (Gartner) to benchmark best practices.
  • Thought Leadership: Share CBC/RC case studies and governance frameworks with external and public stakeholders.

Qualifications, experience & skills

  • 7+ years of technology leadership experience, with 3 years of supervisory experience required.
  • At least 5 years explicitly focused on operationalizing data or technology strategy, machine learning, technology risk management, or corporate governance programs.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required. A degree in Information Technology, Computer Systems Analysis, Engineering, or Management Information Systems is preferred.
  • Bilingualism (English and French).
  • Enterprise AI Governance: Proven track record building and managing AI oversight programs, governing models and agentic workflows, and developing policies, audits, and control documentation.
  • Strategy-to-Operations: Ability to turn high-level strategy into actionable standards, operational workflows, and scalable operating models.

job.description:
iHeartMedia Markets

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. And we were just recognized as one of the Top Media Sales Organizations by The Myers Report! 

In fact, iHeart has: More #1 rated markets than the next two largest radio companies combined;

  • We’re the largest podcast publisher, with more monthly downloads than the second- and third-largest podcast publishers combined. Podcasting, the fastest-growing new media, today has more monthly users than streaming music services or Netflix;

  • iHeart is the home of many of the country’s most popular and trusted on-air personalities and podcast influencers, who build important connections with hundreds of communities across America;

  • We create and produce some of the most popular and well-known branded live music events in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour;

  • iHeartRadio is the #1 streaming radio digital service in America;

  • Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and

  • We have the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio, from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale.  As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.

Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!

If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.  


Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!  

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return
  • General understanding of business principles and sales environment
  • Interest in developing knowledge of business operations and sales concepts and techniques
  • Individual accountability and understanding of when to seek guidance
  • Skills managing assigned projects to completion
  • Understanding to resolve problems using established guidelines and professional judgement
  • Ability to communicate information about iHeart products in a digestible manner and to apply active listening skills to validate understanding of customer needs
  • Understanding of impact of your own decisions
  • Goal orientation and the ability to focus and prioritize

KOAT, the ABC & CBS affiliates in Albuquerque, NM has an opening for an Investigative Producer who can dig deeper, break stories, work on special projects, and present heavily researched investigative pieces for both on-air and online.

 

You are a driven researcher and experienced journalist. You have a creative vision and have experience making decisions and communicating the plan. You know how to lead a team, win the big story, and dig deeper on breaking news. You must be highly organized and a self-starter who is adept at working ahead and meeting deadlines. You must be fast and able to play well in a room of same-minded pros. Accuracy is job one! You will report to the News Director.

 

Responsibilities

  • Must have a strong knowledge of local news, laws, and politics
  • Reveal, uncover, and expose hard news investigative pieces 
  • Copy edit with an acute eye for details, balance, ethics, and the law
  • Post stories to KOAT.com and upload content to KOAT social media
  • Produce special projects throughout the year as assigned
  • Select, research, and write content for live newscasts as needed to make the newscast an "experience" for viewers
  • Work with and guide investigative reporter in story production
  • Coordinate creative vision with news management 

 

Requirements

  • Experience working in a newsroom
  • Ability to coordinate scheduling and set up shoots both independently and in coordination with news management

  • Experience summarizing information into easy-to-understand components
  • Creative presentation style, and ability to showcase all resources and elements
  • Have and exhibit the highest journalistic integrity and ethical standards
  • Must be flexible with schedule to be available during breaking news
  • Related military experience will be considered
  • In-person attendance is required

job.title: Account Executive, KMVT - Twin Falls
job.description:
Are you a driven sales professional ready to help local businesses thrive? KMVT, the CBS affiliate serving Twin Falls, Idaho, is seeking an Account Executive who will partner with businesses to deliver powerful advertising solutions that drive real results. This is your opportunity to combine strategic thinking with creative problem-solving while building lasting relationships in a community that values hard work and authenticity.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Sell advertising solutions to local and regional businesses and advertising agencies.
  • Apply the Scripps Sales Process (SSP) to analyze current and prospective customer needs and apply customized advertising solutions that provide return on their investment.
  • In addition to television commercial airtime sales, facilitate the customer's ability to take advantage of the full array of digital marketing options available.
  • Independently prospect, secure appointments, perform needs analysis, develop customized solutions, present and close sales to develop and maintain new business from traditional and non-traditional advertisers.
  • Use ratings data, qualitative information and market trends to negotiate program ratings and advertising rates with advertising agencies in order to maximize revenue as well as develop custom solutions for new advertisers.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor with new and existing clients, provide best-in-class customer service, grow accounts, and gain additional business from referrals.
  • Perform client services, including but not limited to media avail negotiations, presentation preparation delivery and execution, copy writing, credit applications and collection of revenue due.
  • Effectively and proactively manage a sales funnel by way of Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems, monitoring and achieving key performance indicators and expected activity levels.
  • Contribute to the creative development of campaigns though client communication and needs analysis, storyboard and concept creation, and assistance in production aspects.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, which may include entertaining prospective and existing clients.
  • Perform routine administrative functions of a media salesperson including makegood resolution, continuous update of CRM system with activity, account information and pending revenue, and communication with sales leadership regarding the status of accounts.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.


WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally 2+ years of proven sales success preferred
  • Experience in strategic account management, broadcast ratings and digital execution preferred
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company required insurance limits.


WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Highly self-motivated and goal focused
  • Highly creative and innovative thinker
  • Strong influencing, selling and upselling skills
  • Effective teamwork and collaboration skills
  • Very strong analysis and data interpretation - able to translate needs and research data into sound marketing proposals
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills
  • Outstanding presentation abilities (in person/virtual, small/large groups, all levels)
  • Strong time management and organizational skills
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel and PowerPoint)
  • Working knowledge of Google Office (Sheets, Docs, Slides) and virtual conferencing platforms (E.g. Skype, WebEx, Zoom or MS Teams etc.)


WHAT WE'LL OFFER:

  • Uncapped sales commission
  • Monthly allowance for mileage and cell phone
  • Extensive Scripps Sales Process training
  • A career path to grow your professional experiences
  • Full medical, dental and vision benefits, as well as certain other health and wellness benefits
  • Retirement savings plan with company match
  • Other key company benefits include disability accident insurance, life insurance, ID protection, pet discount program, and employee assistance program. More details about timing and conditions of benefits eligibility and other plan terms and conditions will be provided upon hire.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY:

Twin Falls, Idaho offers an exceptional quality of life in the heart of the Magic Valley. This vibrant community of approximately 50,000 residents combines small-town charm with big-city amenities. The area is famous for the stunning Shoshone Falls, often called the "Niagara of the West," which plunges 212 feet into the Snake River Canyon—actually taller than Niagara Falls itself.

Outdoor enthusiasts will find endless recreation opportunities, from hiking and mountain biking along the canyon rim to world-class fly fishing, kayaking, and BASE jumping at the Perrine Bridge. The region's high desert climate delivers 300 days of sunshine annually, with four distinct seasons that include mild winters and warm, dry summers.

Twin Falls boasts a thriving local economy anchored by agriculture, food processing, and growing tech sectors. The downtown area features locally-owned restaurants, breweries, shops, and a vibrant farmers market. The College of Southern Idaho adds cultural and educational opportunities to the community. With affordable housing, excellent schools, and a strong sense of community, Twin Falls offers the perfect balance for professionals seeking both career growth and an outstanding lifestyle. Plus, you're just a few hours from Boise, Sun Valley, and some of the West's most spectacular national parks and wilderness areas.

This position offers a unique opportunity to produce content for multiple platforms and make a real impact in one of the fastest-growing markets in the nation.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Develop and organize newscasts or local programs.
  • Write story development and showcasing.
  • Collaborate with reporters, anchors, news managers and assignment editors to determine content needs.
  • Enhance content with graphics, video, research, and station branding.
  • Execute time sensitive decisions.

  • Perform desktop editing.
  • Post content to station's websites.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

  • Strong vision and ability to advance stories
  • Excellent interpersonal communicator

Boise, Idaho offers an unbeatable quality of life in one of America's most dynamic and fastest-growing cities. Nestled in the Treasure Valley along the Boise River and backed by the stunning Boise Foothills, this vibrant capital city perfectly balances urban sophistication with outdoor adventure. Downtown Boise features a thriving food and craft brewery scene, local boutiques, and a walkable city center, while the famous Boise Greenbelt provides 25 miles of scenic pathways for biking, running, and recreation.


Outdoor enthusiasts will find endless opportunities year-round, from world-class skiing at Bogus Basin just 16 miles from downtown to hiking, mountain biking, and rock climbing in the nearby foothills. job.title: Multimedia Journalist, KTNV
job.description:
KTNV, the ABC affiliate in Las Vegas, NV, owned by The E.W. Scripps Company, is looking for a creative and driven Multimedia Journalist.


The Multimedia Journalist is responsible for researching, writing, capturing visual content, and editing stories for multiple platforms. You would be joining a strong team of talented journalists with exceptional leadership. This position is ideal for an MMJ with some experience who wants to grow and excel in a dynamic, competitive market. Bring your dedication to solid journalism and your motivation to uncover stories that matter to our community and make viewers want to watch.


Las Vegas is one of the most exciting and fast-growing cities in the country, known for its world-class entertainment, thriving sports scene, diverse communities, and vibrant economy. From major events and tourism to significant local stories that impact Southern Nevada residents every day, Las Vegas offers journalists a unique opportunity to cover meaningful and memorable news. Join a team that's making a difference.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Receive assignments or evaluate news leads and news tips to develop story ideas.
  • Gather and verify factual information regarding stories through interviews, observation, and research.
  • Organize material, determine slant or emphasis, and write stories according to prescribed editorial style and format standards.
  • Shoot video and still photos to illustrate stories.
  • Edit, or assist in editing, videos for all multimedia platforms.
  • Appear on TV in live and pre-recorded stories.
  • Work cooperatively with the photographer assigned to the story, if one is assigned.
  • Assist news producers in preparing newscasts.
  • Assist digital staff in preparing multimedia stories and online content.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in a related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred.
  • Generally, 3+ years of experience in a related field preferred.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Computer literacy required, including newsroom computer systems.
  • Videography and non-linear editing experience preferred.
  • Knowledge of broadcast-quality camera equipment.
  • Edit video on Final Cut Pro editing systems, or similar equipment.
  • Strong broadcast and AP style writing skills.
  • Proficient at posting content to various digital and social media platforms.
  • Self-motivated and able to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds.
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance with the company's required insurance limits.

job.title: Executive Reporter, KMGH
job.description:
KMGH, The E.W. Scripps Company ABC affiliate in Denver, Colorado, is seeking an Executive Reporter who will lead our mission to enhance storytelling and inspire the next generation of journalists. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape the narrative of our community while mentoring talented reporters and MMJs to reach their full potential.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Lead, develop, and enhance the storytelling skill and abilities of all reporters and MMJs in the station.
  • Collaborate with other newsroom leaders to consistently execute the content strategy through authentic, meaningful storytelling.
  • Oversee the writing of stories for all platforms; provide timely feedback to foster continuous improvement.
  • Develop and supervise effective workflow strategies and procedures for multiple news programs and outlets.
  • Ensure that all content adheres to journalistic standards and ethical guidelines.
  • Deliver a vision and create trust among reporters, photographers and newsroom staff.
  • May provide on-air, multi-platform coverage for breaking news as needed.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • BS/BA in related discipline preferred, or equivalent years of experience
  • Generally, 7+ years of experience in a related field preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Demonstrated expertise in storytelling
  • Knowledge and demonstration of editorial judgment, journalistic ethics, and libel laws
  • Curiosity for the community, city, state, and world we report on daily
  • Deep understanding of content strategy
  • Ability to work a variety of shifts including nights, weekends, early mornings, and holidays

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY:

Denver, Colorado, combines big-market journalism opportunities with an unmatched outdoor lifestyle. As the Mile High City, Denver is one of the fastest-growing and most dynamic metropolitan areas in the country, offering journalists the chance to cover everything from rapid economic growth and innovation to government, transportation, education, public safety, and environmental issues that shape the future of the American West.


Situated at the foot of the Rocky Mountains, Denver provides year-round access to world-class skiing, hiking, mountain biking, camping, and countless outdoor adventures. The city features a thriving arts and culture scene, professional sports teams including the Broncos, Nuggets, Rockies, Avalanche, and Rapids, award-winning restaurants, and vibrant neighborhoods filled with unique stories and diverse perspectives.


KMGH is a trusted news leader serving one of the nation's most competitive and exciting media markets. With breathtaking scenery, an exceptional quality of life, and a community that values strong local journalism, Denver offers a remarkable place to build a meaningful career while making a lasting impact through storytelling.
