job.title: Master Control Hub Operator
job.description:
Are you ready to be at the heart of television broadcasting? The Scripps Master Control Hub in Indianapolis is seeking a skilled Master Control Hub Operator to manage and monitor multiple programming sources while providing critical master control support. In this essential role, you'll be the technical expert ensuring seamless programming delivery across our television stations, making split-second decisions that keep our content flowing flawlessly to viewers across the region.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Monitor several programming sources simultaneously, manage and switch sources for local television station programming, remotely from the Hub.

  • Monitor various levels and signals from multiple television sites.

  • Manage several live program logs and ensure accuracy.

  • Ensure the correct spots are aired during programming and note any discrepancies.

  • Solve problems and make judgment calls with business implications in mind regarding programming changes, commercials, special reports, and technical difficulties; this includes evaluating clock/timing to consider options with regard to programming as well as deciding when to escalate issues.

  • Make decisions and consult with internal customers regarding local transmitter parameters and operation.

  • Routinely collaborate with media prep technicians and traffic personnel to manage daily operations. Collaborate with other local news personnel as needed during breaking news situations.

  • Interact both verbally and in writing with internal Hub client stations in a manner that ensures all of our internal customers have a consistent experience. This includes sending alerts, responses to inquiries, collaboration on problem-solving, documentation, and/or resolution of issues.

  • Work with networks and live program providers, where required, to problem-solve issues.

  • Maintain current knowledge of and preparedness to execute disaster recovery procedures.

  • Perform quality assurance checks as required.

  • May require working overtime, holidays, and weekends with short notice when necessary.

  • Other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Associate's degree in a related discipline or equivalent years of experience preferred

  • Generally, 5+ years of experience in a related field is preferred

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Ability to problem solve and quickly take corrective action as necessary

  • High sense of responsibility and urgency regarding corrective action and customer service

  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision

  • Composure: Demonstrated ability to multitask in a fast, deadline-driven environment, and maintain calmness and accuracy of work

  • Strong organization skills

  • Highly detail-oriented

  • Quick mathematical skills, especially concerning timekeeping

  • Working knowledge of video servers, routing processes, and related equipment

  • Working knowledge of transmitter parameters and operations

  • Good communication skills, both verbal and written

  • Working knowledge of all functions and responsibilities of television master control

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:
 

Indianapolis is a thriving Midwestern city that offers the perfect blend of urban amenities and hometown hospitality. Known as the "Crossroads of America," Indianapolis boasts a revitalized downtown featuring world-class museums like the Indianapolis Museum of Art at Newfields, the iconic Indianapolis Motor Speedway, and a vibrant Mass Ave cultural district filled with theaters, galleries, and locally-owned restaurants. The city's Canal Walk provides a scenic escape in the heart of downtown, while neighborhoods like Broad

Ripple and Fountain Square offer eclectic shopping, live music venues, and craft breweries.

Sports enthusiasts will love cheering on the Colts at Lucas Oil Stadium and the Pacers at Gainbridge Fieldhouse, while the city's extensive greenway system and Eagle Creek Park offer abundant outdoor recreation opportunities. Indianapolis combines big-city career opportunities with an affordable cost of living, no traffic nightmares, and genuine Hoosier hospitality. With a growing tech sector, excellent healthcare systems, and a thriving food scene that goes far beyond racing day traditions, Indianapolis offers an exceptional quality of life where you can truly make an impact in your community.

job.title: News Photographer
job.description:
KABB/WOAI TV is seeking a creative and dedicated Broadcast Video Journalist/Photographer to join our dynamic newsroom team. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced environment, demonstrates strong technical and storytelling skills, and consistently goes above and beyond to support their team. The ideal candidate will have a passion for visual storytelling, a collaborative spirit, and a strong sense of responsibility.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Shoot and edit general assignment stories, including live shots and natural sound packages.
  • Integrate creative graphics and video layering effects to enhance storytelling.
  • Collaborate with reporters and producers to plan and execute compelling visual content.
  • Maintain and operate professional video and audio equipment, ensuring readiness and reliability.
  • Demonstrate strong planning and organizational skills, preparing footage and gear ahead of field assignments.
  • Support the team by working flexible hours, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, and holidays.
  • Maintain vehicle and equipment logs, ensuring timely submissions and upkeep.
  • Apply lighting and sound techniques to improve the quality of interviews and stand-ups.
  • Contribute to a positive team environment through effective communication and a proactive attitude.

Qualifications:

  • 1–2 years of experience in video journalism or related field.
  • Proficiency in non-linear editing systems (desktop and laptop).
  • Strong understanding of video/photo equipment and postproduction techniques.
  • Demonstrated creativity in graphics and visual effects.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills and a collaborative mindset.
  • Valid driver’s license and clean driving record.
  • Physically able to lift and carry 30 lbs. or more regularly.
  • Ability to work under tight deadlines and adapt to changing schedules.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience blending graphics with natural sound and video for enhanced storytelling.
  • Initiative in brainstorming and seeking feedback to improve story quality.

job.title: Sales and Marketing Specialist
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 


Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 


Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

Help Brands Thrive: 

Join our media sales team and play a pivotal role in helping brands and companies grow. By identifying new opportunities, building strong client relationships, and delivering impactful solutions, you'll showcase how our multi-media content platforms and digital assets can drive meaningful results for our partners. 


Your focus will be on helping clients achieve their goals, ensuring that every campaign is a success. When our clients win, we win—and we believe in celebrating those victories together! 

  

Make Connections: Embrace your powers of persuasion and make every handshake and meeting count! Every interaction is a chance to build a genuine connection and show clients how we can help them succeed. You're not just selling; you're building partnerships. You're helping businesses find the right audience in the right place at the right time. When we say One Partner, Endless Possibilities, we mean it! 

 

Be A Trusted Guide: In this role, you'll connect with clients on a human level, understand their unique needs, and craft tailored sales and marketing solutions that deliver results. As their trusted advisor, you'll help them navigate the ever-evolving marketing landscape, ensuring every step of the journey is planned with care and precision.  

 

Shake Things Up: Bring your creativity and fresh ideas to the table! We're looking for someone who challenges the status quo, embraces innovation, and finds new ways to connect with our audience. Your contributions will help elevate our brand and drive meaningful results for your clients.  

 

Join us and Conquer the Media Landscape: You'll be part of a dedicated team of A1 media sales professionals, committed to achieving market leadership. Together, we amplify our impact, deliver exceptional outcomes, and help our clients succeed in ways that truly matter. 

 

Identify Emerging Opportunities: It's about being able to see what others can't, anticipating market shifts, analyzing data and predicting the next big thing. Your insights will position our clients and AMP for long-term success.  

  

What We're Looking For 

Proven Sales Ability (or an Unstoppable Desire to Learn) 

Whether you're a seasoned sales professional or just getting started, we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 

 

Strong Communication Skills: You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 

 

A Passion for helping Others: You're committed to understanding clients' needs, providing top-notch customer service and making a difference. You're not just selling a product; you're providing a solution.  


A Competitive Spirit: Do you get a little boost when you achieve a goal (especially if it was a tough one)? We love that for you (and us)!  We want someone who's driven to excel but also knows how to celebrate the victories (big and small) with their team. That drive makes you a valuable part of our organization.  


A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.  

 

The Practical Stuff 

A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 

 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

 

Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.  

 

The Compensation Package: We offer a base salary, commission structure, and benefits package designed to support your success and well-being. Happy employees don't stage rebellions! ;) 

 

We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales specialist isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.) 

 

Top-Notch Training and Support: We're not the kind of company that hires you and then disappears into the corporate abyss. We carefully select candidates for a cohort-based training program, where you'll join a group of sales professionals from all over the country. From onboarding to ongoing mentorship, we invest in your success with training programs that set you up for long-term growth. 

 

Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, providing you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.  

 

Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise.   

 

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.  

 

EEO AND INCLUSIVITY

job.title: Regional Sales Assistant
job.description:

  • Primary function is data entry of national sales orders from national advertisers
  • Daily entry of National Sales orders into the traffic system with accuracy and complying to order contract, inventory, and scheduling constraints.

  • At least 1-2 years’ experience of administrative support preferred
  • A high level of organizational skills and the ability to prioritize and multi-task
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to handle multiple tasks under a deadline

  • Consistently comply with organizational directives and national standard operating procedures.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills for effective interaction with internal and external team members

  • Broadcast Sales, media buying, or agency experience is a plus
  • Maintain a positive demeanor and customer service focus

job.title: News Assignment Editor and Producer-Temp
job.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM:

TelevisaUnivision is seeking a talented Assignment Editor/Producer to support the News team. This position is responsible for monitoring breaking news, developing story ideas, coordinating field coverage, and managing the logistics of live crews and daily news assignments.

The Assignment Editor/Producer works closely with reporters, producers, photographers, and newsroom managers to identify and prioritize stories, gather information and video elements, and ensure timely and accurate coverage of developing and scheduled news events.


YOUR DAY-TO-DAY:

  • Monitor local, national, and international news for developing and breaking news stories.

job.title: Weather Producer
job.description:
Position Summary

The Weather Producer has editorial and meteorological responsibility and accountability for all weather content included in one of TWCs programs or
dayparts. They will ensure that each show covers relevant weather events through compelling stories and that those stories are told in the proper order
with visual components that are both accurate and meet (or exceed) TWC standards and style. The weather producer will work closely with on-camera
meteorologists to ensure that their weather storytelling is well-organized, well-prepared, and includes language that connects most effectively with our
target television audience(s). The Weather Producer will also be responsible for creating and updating daily weather graphics to support
TWC programming.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Conceive of and create new weather and science-based stories for the assigned program or day part
  • Stay aware of current meteorological pattern and contribute stories to the weather-content editorial process
  • Drive the inclusion and prioritization of weather stories in the assigned program or day part, creates graphics, and /or commissions the creation and/or acquisition of supporting visual content.
  • Mine all available resources, including social media, for possible weather story ideas & content
  • Coordinate with show producers and fellow weather producers to assure continuity in weather storytelling
  • Prepare content using multiple graphic platforms including TruVu Max, Google Earth, Vizrt, and Gibson Ridge
  • Produce weather blocks that are well-organized, well prepared and targets a television audience
  • Maintain proficiency with software changes to TruVu Max and other graphics systems. Ensure that TWC is first-to-air visually and verbally with all breaking weather information
  • Support coverage of significant weather events, including working extra hours and days outside of normally scheduled shifts
  • Create weather graphics that are meteorologically correct and tell an engaging weather story.

Education, Experience, Certification Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in meteorology, atmospheric science, design, or a related field
  • 3 years of meteorological experience to include 3 years of television or graphics building experience
  • 1 year experience using TruVu Max weather systems

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Extensive knowledge and understanding of TruVu Max weather systems
  • Thorough comprehension of numerical models 
  • Strong ability to communicate orally and verbally.  Ability to disseminate complex meteorological information in a useable and understandable manner
  • Possesses exceptional interpersonal and teamwork skills
  • Knowledge of social media and its role in the information and content gathering process
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, involving cross-functional teams, in an efficient manner
  • Exhibits creative problem solving skills and unique resourcefulness in order to complete tasks
  • Quickly learns and applies new technologies
  • Customer focused, innovative, and self-motivated
  • Receives feedback constructively and incorporates that feedback into work products and performance
  • Good multitasking and trouble-shooting skills
  • Displays strong collaborative skills and works effectively through conflict
  • Maintains high standards for product, performance, and ethics
  • Effectively contributes to team goals within a highly interactive, and at times, stressful environment
  • Dependable and flexible in a 24x7 operational environment
  • Experience using augmented reality production pipelines a plus
  • Experience using Photoshop, AfterEffects, and 3D modeling software is a plus

job.title: Director, Business Development
job.description:
Who We Are:

TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

The Role and What You’ll Do:

TKO Global Partnerships is looking for a driven, relationship-first sales executive to join one of the most dynamic commercial teams in sports and entertainment. As a Director of Sales, you will own new business development across UFC and/or WWE — two of the most recognized and emotionally powerful properties on the planet — delivering partnership and sponsorship solutions that create genuine value for brands, their agencies, and their customers.

This is a role for a closer who thrives in a consultative environment, builds trust quickly at the executive level, and knows how to turn a first conversation into a multi-year, seven-figure partnership. You will be on the front lines of revenue generation for TKO, prospecting aggressively, presenting compellingly, and delivering results that consistently exceed targets.

  • Build and manage a robust pipeline of qualified brand and agency prospects large enough to meet — and beat — your financial goals
  • Drive new business revenue through the sale of UFC and WWE media, sponsorship, and integrated partnership assets
  • Leverage deep knowledge of and relationships across the brand and agency landscape to identify and accelerate revenue opportunities
  • Understand client marketing objectives inside and out, and translate those needs into tailored UFC and WWE partnership solutions with clear, compelling value propositions
  • Guide clients from initial pitch through contract close, onboarding, and long-term strategic account growth
  • Host clients and prospects at UFC and WWE live events, creating immersive brand experiences that deepen relationships and accelerate deal cycles
  • Explore creative packaging and upsell opportunities, including co-sell structures with TKO's media distribution partners
  • Accurately forecast revenue, proactively identify risks, and bring solutions — not just problems
  • Contribute ideas that elevate the broader team's performance and reinforce TKO Global Partnerships as the premier destination for brand investment in sports and entertainment 

You Have These:

  • 10+ years of revenue development experience with a focus on partnership and sponsorship sales, ideally in sports, media, or entertainment
  • Proven track record closing six- and seven-figure deals with Fortune 500 brands and/or senior agency decision makers
  • Deep understanding of the sports sponsorship and media landscape — the players, the trends, the terminology, and the deals that matter
  • A hunter's mentality paired with a relationship-builder's instincts — you're equally comfortable cold-opening a C-suite conversation and deepening a decade-long partnership
  • Strong consultative selling skills with the ability to build custom solutions, not just pitch off a rate card
  • Robust analytical capability, including market strategy development and value-based selling
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills — you present with authority and follow up with precision
  • Highly organized with sharp attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously
  • Advanced negotiation skills and the confidence to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder deals
  • Motivated by a rewarding, performance-based compensation structure
  • Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays as dictated by the live event calendar
  • Ability to be based in or work across New York City and Stamford, CT
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly to support client and prospect engagement
  • Bachelor's degree required

Per local requirements and in the interest of transparency, the hourly rate shown below reflects the prevalent current hiring range for this position. Hiring pay rates are based on a number of factors, including location and may vary depending on job-related qualifications, knowledge, skills and experience. We are looking for an Acquisition Marketing Manager to own acquisition marketing operations across FOX One’s paid and owned & operated channels. This role will serve as the central point of organization and communication across campaigns and placements, ensuring creative, timelines, approvals, and execution remain aligned back to the FOX One strategy.

You will manage the day-to-day workflow with our agency partner, keeping paid acquisition campaigns on track from creative specifications through launch.   • Own the end-to-end trafficking process for owned & operated and synergy placements in partnership with FOX News, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, and Tubi
  • Partner with the brand and creative team to request, approve, and traffic assets, and steward creative alignment strategy across campaigns to ensure the right message reaches the right placement and audience
  • Coordinate with agencies, platforms, and vendors on campaign execution and optimization, and serve as a central point of contact providing clear status updates and proactively identifying and resolving execution issues
  • Build and maintain processes and tracking systems, including campaign documentation and trackers, that create visibility across campaigns, stakeholders, deliverables, and deadlines

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Helps coordinate detailed rollout plans across departments for specials, documentaries and other major news events, creating and executing a promotional plan (crafting push copy, prewriting articles and video heds/deks, etc.).

Job Title

Director, Executive Compensation

Job Description

The Director, Executive Compensation serves as the leader and subject matter expert for the company’s equity and executive compensation programs. This hands-on role is responsible for administering and optimizing the equity compensation program at People Incorporated and ensuring a seamless experience for all participants.  Reporting to the VP of Total Rewards, this role interacts with Finance, Legal, and HR. The ideal candidate will balance technical excellence in equity governance with the executive presence required to design, communicate, and execute competitive reward strategies across the company.

The position is based in the New York City corporate headquarters and is hybrid in-office with the ability to work remotely up to 2 days per week.

Equity Program Administration

  • Manage and process the full lifecycle of global equity awards: grant setup, vesting, releases, cancellations, terminations/retirement, and quarterly dividends across multiple jurisdictions and equity structures.

  • Manage and optimize the employee equity database. Maintain flawless data integrity, update employee records, and generate routine and ad-hoc reports.

  • Act as a trusted, accessible stock plan expert to all levels of the organization, including executives and board members, providing support and addressing inquiries with clarity, accuracy, and timeliness.

  • Coordinate with Payroll and Finance regarding equity vests and reporting. Provide guidance to HRBPs and Subsidiary companies as needed. 

  • Review, interpret, and optimize stock plan data. Track and report on critical equity metrics including share utilization, burn rate, overhang, and dilution to inform long-term budgeting and forecasting. Prepare projections and provide recommendations on budgets.

  • Exercise sound judgment to resolve complex stock plan participant matters and address evolving stock plan provisions, balancing business needs and employee experience considerations.

  • Proactively educate employees on their equity plans and grants. Prepare and review stock plan participant communications, statements, and educational materials, ensuring clarity and comprehension across diverse participant groups.

  • Own the strategic relationship and service level agreements (SLAs) with external stock plan administrators (e.g., Morgan Stanley), ensuring seamless platform optimization and flawless database data integrity.

  • Act as the technical advisor on the equity and compensation implications of corporate restructurings, subsidiary management, and Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A).

  • Oversee equity plan compliance, monitoring insider trading policies, managing pre-clearance lists, and enforcing corporate blackout periods in partnership with Legal.

Executive Compensation, Proxy & Governance

  • Partner directly with the VP of Total Rewards to strategize, draft, and deliver high-impact, Board-level materials and data visualizations for the quarterly Compensation Committee meetings.

  • Contribute to executive compensation-related regulatory filings and disclosures, including the Compensation Discussion & Analysis (CD&A) and related proxy statement content.

  • Monitor and interpret evolving investor expectations and proxy advisor perspectives, regulatory developments, firm strategy and market practices and translate these into practical implications for Total Rewards program design and disclosure.

  • Lead executive benchmarking, peer group selection, and competitive pay analysis for senior leadership.

  • Ensure regulatory compliance for Section 16 executive and Board members and assist in the preparation of SEC Form filings.

General Compensation & Projects

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to senior management by providing strategic guidance and execution support for Total Rewards programs, especially compensation programs impacting senior leadership.

  • Serve as a trusted partner to HR and  Finance with Compensation initiatives throughout the year.

  • Support the Compensation team by collaborating on Compensation philosophy and with the year-end compensation cycle.

The Role’s Minimum Qualifications and Job Requirements:

Education: Bachelor’s degree in HR, Finance, or Business. CCP certification is a plus.

Experience: 8+ years of progressive experience in compensation in a publicly traded, mid-to-large-sized company with specific experience in hands-on equity administration including stock options, restricted stock, and performance-based stock awards.

Specific Knowledge, Skills, Certifications and Abilities:

  • Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and quantitative skills with a focus on detail and data accuracy.

  • Advanced Sheets/Excel Capabilities: Mastery of advanced spreadsheet functions (lookups, index/match, pivot tables, complex data modeling) to manipulate and interpret large datasets.

  • Discretion & Judgment: A proven problem-solving mindset with the ability to think critically, exercise good judgment, and handle highly confidential executive data with total discretion.

  • Agility & Time Management: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, managing multiple competing priorities and tight deadlines seamlessly.

  • Communication: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to articulate complex equity and compensation topics clearly to both entry-level employees and executives.

  • Autonomy: A proactive, self-starter mentality who takes initiative and works independently while remaining a highly collaborative team player.

  • Continuous Improvement & Innovation: A forward-thinking mindset with a willingness to explore AI tools, automated workflows, and emerging technologies to streamline compensation processes and maximize efficiency. 

% Travel Required (Approximate): 0-5%

job.title: Huron Daily Tribune News Reporter
job.description:
News Reporter

The Huron Daily Tribune is a daily newspaper in Bad Axe, Michigan, seeks a digital-minded reporter to write for online and print publication with several deadlines throughout the day. As a reporter, you discover innovative ways to deliver quality and engaging content, collaborate with a diverse team and build authentic relationships with the community.

The position demands strong writing and reporting skills and good news judgment. A reporter needs to be able to self-assign, re-prioritize in real time and keep digital production first.

A reporter must strive to present an accurate, well-balanced explanation of the stories they cover, build an arsenal of contacts and make themselves known in the community for both breaking news items and more in-depth, enterprise stories.

The reporter submits stories daily and enriches stories with multimedia assets.

A reporter creates content to attract digital subscribers and to optimize content for digital audiences across web and social media platforms. A reporter is also responsible for finding news leads and further developing professional skills through company training.

Extensive knowledge of AP style writing is necessary in addition to trending style changes. Time management and basic knowledge of photography are a plus to the success of the position.

A reporter should have knowledge of social media platforms and ongoing events in addition to working in content management systems. Training available.

Staff meetings and communication for content planning purposes will occur.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Write a minimum of 10-15 bylines a week, at least one a day, enriched with multimedia assets.
  • Write a variety of stories, including content for newspaper subscribers and non-subscribers.
  • Write a minimum of one, well-researched enterprise story a quarter.
  • Attend at least one staff meeting or equivalent discussion a day for content planning purposes.
  • Shoot or attain photos or create other multimedia assets. Prepare and package content for online and print publication.
  • Ability to learn content management systems quickly and effectively with appropriate internal training and external knowledge.

What are the measures of success for this position?

  • Gather information, write and deliver news stories for print and online publication by seeking out leads, capitalizing on external knowledge and accepting assignments from the editor or associate editor.
  • Build a loyal digital subscriber base by engaging with readership online and in the community.
  • Explore alternate publishing strategies to enrich content and presentation (i.e., images, slideshows, specialized web templates, embedded content, timelines, hyperlinks, SEO writing and other multimedia assets).
  • Write effective digital headlines that help attract audiences. Write engaging social posts that attract audiences and encourage readers to interact with social content.
  • Revise work to meet editorial approval for publication-readiness, including clarity, fairness, legality, spelling, grammar, punctuation and style.
  • Participate in internally offered training and other development opportunities.
  • Use metrics to monitor real-time traffic, identify patterns and make informed content decisions.
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest current events and trends.
  • Communicate effectively with the newsroom and leadership both in-office and in the field.
  • Manage workflow to meet deadlines and work collaboratively with team to find solutions.

Qualifications:

  • The ideal candidate will have a bachelor’s in communications, journalism or equivalent in experience and/or education.
  • Strong news judgment, knowledge of AP style and SEO best practices.
  • Understand written sentences, paragraphs and headline writing in work related documents to communicate effectively as appropriate for the needs of the audience.
  • Follow the law, especially regarding the confidentiality and privacy of the people they interview or write about.

About Hearst Midwest Media Group

 

By joining the Manistee News Advocate, a publication of Hearst Midwest, a multimedia reporterbecomes a family member of a media group that produces news with a hyper-local purpose.

With one of the oldest news gathering media in Michigan and Illinois – Hearst Midwest Community Group – and our corresponding news websites, we have a serious journalistic commitment to provide local, watchdog and investigative reporting that impacts the areas we serve.

Hearst is one of the nation’s largest diversified media, information and services companies with more than 360 businesses. At Hearst, we offer all the industry’s leading benefits you need to both feel and be your best. From financial wellbeing to personal care, our programs are modern, flexible and designed to focus on the whole person. We want our employees to have a healthy, rewarding, balanced and meaningful experience — both at work and in life.

job.title: Audience Intern
job.description:
Audience Intern

Job Description

The Houston Chronicle is looking for a curious and versatile student journalist to join its Audience team for the summer 2027 internship program.

Audience journalists help determine how journalism reaches people — and what makes them want to come back. You’ll work alongside editors, reporters and audience strategists to help shape coverage, craft compelling headlines and social posts, engage readers across platforms and use data to understand what matters to our audience.

You’ll gain experience at the intersection of journalism, storytelling and digital strategy while helping the Chronicle reach hundreds of thousands of readers across Houston and beyond. You may help package breaking news, promote enterprise reporting, build newsletters, identify search opportunities, analyze reader behavior and develop new ways to connect with audiences. 

This position is designed for motivated student journalists who want to build careers in audience journalism and gain hands-on experience in a major newsroom. Past interns have gone on to full-time roles at the Chronicle as reporters, producers and editors across our newsroom and audience teams.

Responsibilities:

  • Monitor real-time analytics and identify patterns in what readers are viewing, sharing and returning to

  • Help editors and reporters frame stories for maximum clarity, relevance and impact
  • Write and refine headlines, social copy, push alerts and other promotional language with attention to SEO and news value
  • Create social posts and contribute to strategies for platforms including Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Reddit and more
  • Assist with newsletter planning, writing and audience-focused story selection
  • Help package stories for the homepage and other digital platforms
  • Research search trends, audience interests and emerging platforms
  • Pitch ideas for reaching new audiences and deepening connections with existing readers

  • Collaborate across the newsroom to translate Chronicle journalism into useful, compelling digital experiences

Requirements:

  • Juniors, seniors or recent graduates with prior experience at a college news publication or professional news organization.
  • A personal laptop and Wi-Fi or hotspot access.
  • Must obtain housing in Houston and work in the Chronicle’s office at least 3 days a week.

 

Internship Details:

  • 40 hours a week for 10 weeks, from early June and to early August. Interns will be paid $15 an hour. 
  • Interns will work Monday through Friday, with occasional weekend coverage based on news demands. 
  • The recruiting committee will assign all interns a mentor from the newsroom based on their interests.

 

Application details:

Interested candidates are invited to submit their applications, including the required documents, by October 25, 2026. 

Please submit a portfolio of 5 audience-related clips (social media posts, newsletters, alerts, etc.), a resume, and a 1-page cover letter addressed to the recruiting committee detailing your passion for journalism and what you hope to achieve through this internship.

About the Houston Chronicle:

The Houston Chronicle, recognized for its Pulitzer Prize-winning journalism, serves its 2.3 million residents with content and marketing solutions across two of Houston’s largest websites — HoustonChronicle.com and Chron.com, along with our magazine, television and newspaper brands.  Our mission is to spark conversations that inspire action to create a better Houston.  All our content and the innovative business solutions we provide invite Houstonians to join conversations about a community we’ve been committed to covering and helping prosper for more than 120 years. The community we all call home.

About Hearst Newspapers:

With 2,500 employees across the nation, HNP encompasses a network of 24 daily and 52 weekly publications, including the San Francisco Chronicle, Houston Chronicle, San Antonio Express-News and Albany Times Union, several top digital-only news and lifestyle sites, marketing services businesses, and entertainment businesses such as King Features Syndicate. 

At HNP, we are investing in new and innovative ways to tell stories – growing newsrooms, diversifying tools, evolving platforms – to support the millions of people who trust us each month to help them make decisions, take action and be inspired.  

Be a part of something bigger – your headline awaits.

Recognizing the diverse needs of our candidates, if you are interested in applying for employment and need assistance or an accommodation to use our website or regarding the application process, please contact us by email at hnpemployment@hearst.com.  Please do not use this email address to inquire about the status of applications. We will only respond to inquiries concerning requests for a reasonable accommodation through this email address.

job.title: Sports Account Executive, Ad Sales
job.description:
Job Description :

The New York Post is the Best Sports in Town.

From the voices fans know and trust to the stories you won’t find anywhere else, the New York Post brings sports to life with insider access both on and off the field. And we’re just getting started. Our sports business continues to grow across Post Sports, Post Action, Post Sports+ and original sports video, creating new and exciting ways for brands to connect with passionate, highly engaged audiences.


We’re looking for an Account Executive, Sports Ad Sales who knows how to sell, loves the thrill of the pitch and closing a deal, and genuinely lives and breathes sports. This is a great opportunity for a relationship driven, strategic seller who wants to build meaningful partnerships around some of the biggest sports stories, personalities and moments in New York.


You’ll bring a strong network across agencies and direct clients, a proven track record of opening doors and growing business, and the confidence to take a partnership from first conversation to close.


The ideal candidate has approximately 4 to 6 years of omni channel media sales experience in a major market, with experience working directly with clients and media agencies. Most importantly, you’re a smart, energetic seller who understands where sports, culture, media and brands intersect and knows how to turn that intersection into revenue.


This New York based role reports to the NYP Sports Ad Sales Director and will play a key role across the full sales cycle, from prospecting and pitching to closing, growing and retaining client partnerships.


What You’ll Do


  • Identify, prospect and develop new business opportunities across agencies and direct clients, turning conversations into meaningful, long term partnerships.
  • Leverage our sports content, audience, talent, platforms and premium opportunities to create compelling solutions for advertisers.
  • Manage opportunities from initial outreach and discovery through pitch, negotiation, close and ongoing partnership management.
  • Work closely with internal teams to develop creative, strategic and integrated solutions that help clients achieve their business goals.
  • Deliver compelling sales presentations and confidently communicate why the New York Post is the right partner for a brand.
  • Develop trusted relationships with clients and agency partners, providing responsive, thoughtful communication and an exceptional buyer experience.
  • Preserve and expand the existing customer base while consistently identifying opportunities for upsell, cross sell and deeper partnerships.
  • Consistently work toward and exceed established revenue goals with a proactive, results oriented approach.
  • Stay close to competitors, category trends, advertiser activity and the evolving sports and media landscape to uncover new opportunities.
  • Use research, prospecting tools and your own network to consistently build a strong pipeline of qualified opportunities.

What We’re Looking For


  • 4 to 6 years of experience in media sales, digital advertising or a similar client facing sales environment, preferably in a major market.
  • A proven track record of prospecting, winning new business and growing client relationships.
  • Strong agency and/or direct client relationships within the digital media and advertising ecosystem.
  • Experience selling omni channel or integrated media solutions across multiple platforms.
  • A genuine passion for sports and an understanding of the sports media landscape. You don’t have to be able to name every backup quarterback in the league, but you should be excited by sports, know what fans care about and understand why brands want to be part of the conversation.
  • A competitive, entrepreneurial sales mentality. You enjoy the chase, aren’t afraid to pick up the phone and get energized by opening new doors.
  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to confidently pitch ideas and build relationships at all levels.

Intro to Position

We are seeking a strategic, deal-driven SVP of Content Strategy & Business Development to lead the strategic expansion of our editorial reach and enterprise distribution. Reporting directly to the Chief Content Officer, this executive will serve as the primary architect and operator of our external partnership strategy. You will bridge the gap between our content production and revenue growth—identifying, negotiating, and executing strategic alliances with digital platforms, streaming networks, audio networks, and mission-aligned distribution partners.

In addition to structuring external partnerships, you will collaborate closely with enterprise stakeholders across the organization to standardize operational frameworks, direct the division’s OKR planning, and align resource allocation directly with Content’s overarching strategic objectives.

This is an NPR editorial role covered under the terms of the NPR Ethics Handbook. All editorial staff are bound by this guidance. Editorial staff is defined as staff members who play a role in shaping the journalistic or creative direction of NPR's content, including events.    

Responsibilities

Strategic Business Development & Monetization

  • Drive Partnership Revenue: Pitch, negotiate, and close high-value content distribution, co-production, and IP licensing deals for network content across platforms.
  • Expand Distribution Channels: Identify and secure deal structures with major digital news aggregators, streaming platforms, newsletter networks, and public media systems to scale audience reach and maximize revenue.
  • Innovate Business Models: Work alongside the CCO to design business models (e.g., enterprise member subscriptions, content licensing, revenue-share frameworks) that bring financial sustainability to NPR and the Network.

Partner Management & Strategic Alliances

  • Co-Production & Joint Ventures: Structure operational agreements for collaborative, multi-newsroom reporting initiatives to ensure partner alignment while protecting editorial standards.
  • Cross-Sector Alignment: Collaborate with executive leadership to identify grant-funded or corporate-sponsored distribution initiatives that support the organization's broader mission.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Execution

  • CCO & Newsroom Partnership: Partner with the Chief Content Officer and network editorial leads to ensure business development strategies protect editorial standards and elevate network priorities.
  • Deal Structuring & IP Oversight: Manage the contract lifecycle, intellectual property rights, licensing terms, and revenue-sharing mechanisms in collaboration with legal counsel.
  • Metrics & Strategy Iteration: Track partnership performance, audience expansion, and net revenue to regularly present actionable pipeline insights to the CCO and executive team.  

  Business Operations

  • Operational Excellence: Refine cross-departmental Content workflows to streamline project delivery and execution.
  • Financial Oversight & Governance: Partner with Finance to direct divisional budgets, track CapEx, and forecast resource needs to maintain fiscal discipline.
  • Workforce Strategy & Resource Allocation: Collaborate with People Team and Content leaders to drive organizational design, headcount planning and resource optimization.
  • Strategy Stewardship: Lead the definition, tracking, and execution of divisional OKRs to align daily operations with overarching company goals.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

  • 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in media business development, content licensing, distribution, or syndication within news or digital publishing.
  • Proven history of initiating, negotiating, and closing complex, revenue-generating content distribution and licensing partnerships.
  • An active network of media executives, syndicators, platform leads, and distribution decision-makers across digital and legacy media.
  • Deep appreciation for independent journalism and a strong understanding of how to balance revenue goals with editorial integrity.
  • Direct experience structuring IP licensing, copyright agreements, syndication contracts, and revenue-share models.
  • Deep familiarity with IP licensing, copyright frameworks, syndication contracts, and revenue-sharing mechanisms for collective/networked content.
  • Strong negotiation skills, analytical capability, and clear communication style when representing the organization externally.
  • Demonstrated experience collaborating with senior journalists, newsroom leadership, and legal teams to construct commercial partnerships that rigorously protect editorial independence.

job.title: Customer Service Representative - CCLI (Eastbourne)
job.description:
At CCLI (Christian Copyright Licensing International), we're passionate about helping churches focus on what matters most: worship and ministry. As a leading provider of church copyright licensing and worship solutions, we deliver innovative tools, trusted resources, and industry-leading services that enable churches to access and use worship content legally and confidently. Combining purpose-driven work with technology and creativity, CCLI supports worship communities around the world and empowers teams to serve with excellence.

THE OPPORTUNITY:

As a Customer Service Representative, you will play a key role in delivering exceptional customer experience by responding to enquiries, supporting customers with licensing and product solutions, and identifying opportunities to grow customer relationships. You will proactively engage customers through renewal and sales activities, process new and renewing licence applications across multiple channels, and maintain accurate customer records. Through every interaction, you will help churches and ministry organisations access the services they need while ensuring professional, efficient, and customer-focused experience.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Respond to customer enquiries via telephone, email, and written correspondence in a timely, professional, and customer-focused manner.
  • Develop and maintain a thorough understanding of CCLI's products, services, and licensing solutions through ongoing training, team meetings, and self-development.
  • Provide accurate, clear, and helpful information to customers regarding products, services, policies, and procedures, ensuring a consistently positive customer experience.
  • Maintain detailed and accurate records of customer interactions, account updates, transactions, and feedback within the company's CRM and communication systems.
  • Proactively contact prospective customers to introduce CCLI's products and services, identify customer needs, and promote appropriate solutions.
  • Support the onboarding of new customers through telephone and video consultations, including delivering product demonstrations and guidance where required.
  • Provide customer support through telephone and video calls, troubleshooting issues, resolving queries efficiently, and ensuring customer satisfaction.
  • Build strong relationships with customers, promoting engagement, retention, and long-term loyalty through proactive and responsive service.
  • Collaborate effectively with colleagues across the business to resolve customer issues, share feedback, and contribute to continuous service improvement.
  • Provide training, guidance, and support to colleagues as required, sharing knowledge and best practices to enhance team capability.
  • Undertake additional duties and responsibilities consistent with the nature and level of the role, as required by the business.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING:

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to build positive relationships and communicate confidently with a wide range of customers.
  • A customer-focused mindset with a genuine passion for delivering outstanding service and ensuring customer satisfaction.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, and Teams.
  • Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise workload, manage multiple tasks, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining accurate records and high standards of work.
  • Self-motivated and proactive, with the ability to work independently while contributing effectively as part of a collaborative team.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify customer needs and deliver practical, effective solutions.
  • Confidence in handling customer conversations via telephone, email, and video calls in a professional and engaging manner.
  • A willingness to learn new systems, products, and processes, and to continuously develop knowledge and skills.
  • An interest in, and general understanding of, Christian music, worship, and church culture, with an appreciation of the needs of churches and ministry organisations.

WHY JOIN CCLI?

  • Purpose-driven work that supports churches, ministries, and worship communities.
  • A collaborative and supportive team environment.
  • A customer-focused culture that values initiative, service, and continuous improvement.
  • The chance to work with industry-leading products and solutions that make a difference.

We welcome applications from candidates who are excited to be part of a collaborative, office-based team and able to work from our Eastbourne office five days a week. In return, we offer a competitive salary of up to £28,500, alongside a benefits package and leave policies that support your wellbeing and work-life balance.

The Orchard is a leading full-service music distribution company operating in 50+ markets worldwide. The Orchard empowers creators and businesses to grow and evolve in the dynamic, global music industry. We specialize in being Artist focused, blending industry expertise and technology, leveraging data to drive success, and providing streamlined digital and physical solutions. The Orchard’s comprehensive artist & label services offerings include marketing, sync licensing, premium video services, transparent data analysis, advertising, rights management, radio promotion, D2C, and more.

The Orchard focuses on providing a comfortable, social, and engaging environment to encourage productivity and creativity.

As a Jr. Manager, Marketing Strategy, your role is crucial in driving the success of our clients' releases through innovative marketing plans and strategies, and data-driven campaigns. You will serve as a key point of contact, keeping labels and artists ahead of industry trends, platform tools, and audience engagement with plans and best practices. Owning and nurturing strong relationships with clients and internal teams is essential to creating impactful activations, building fanbases, and achieving overall release objectives.

  • Collaborate with different The Orchard teams across the globe to identify and leverage cultural touchpoints for audience acquisition, engagement, and other label objectives.
  • Be proactive in identifying challenges and providing solutions to keep release campaigns on track. Demonstrate flexibility and balance in supporting label needs. Be nimble as priorities arise outside of standard processes, with the ability to act with urgency and strategic vision.

  • Partner closely with tour logistics to ensure seamless on-site execution

job.title: Senior Staff Portfolio Manager
job.description:
Who We Are:

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.

This is the place where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends alike come to share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically-acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. No matter their individual role, each of our employees plays a vital part in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life every day.


SiriusXM

SiriusXM is the leading audio entertainment company in North America, and the premier programmer and platform for subscription and digital advertising-supported audio products. SiriusXM’s platforms collectively reach approximately 150 million listeners, the largest digital audio audience across paid and free tiers in North America, and deliver music, sports, talk, news, comedy, entertainment and podcasts. Pandora, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the largest ad-supported audio entertainment streaming service in the U.S. SiriusXM's subsidiaries Simplecast and AdsWizz make it a leader in podcast hosting, production, distribution, analytics and monetization. The Company’s advertising sales organization, which operates as SiriusXM Media, leverages its scale, cross-platform sales organization and ad tech capabilities to deliver results for audio creators and advertisers. SiriusXM, through SiriusXM Canada Holdings, Inc., also offers satellite radio and audio entertainment in Canada. In addition to its audio entertainment businesses, SiriusXM offers connected vehicle services to automakers.


How you’ll make an impact:

The Senior Staff Portfolio Manager is a senior individual contributor on the Planning & Portfolio team, responsible for the operational integrity and strategic governance of SiriusXM's technology portfolio. This role owns executive reporting, financial data governance, program tooling, and cross-functional coordination across Lisa Garnett-Willis's engineering and technology organization. The role requires strong financial acumen, deep familiarity with portfolio tooling and data infrastructure, and the ability to partner directly with Finance, Engineering leadership, and senior TPM leads. In addition, this role defines and continuously improves portfolio governance standards (cadences, controls, and success metrics) that drive portfolio transparency, audit readiness, and delivery accountability across the organization.


What you’ll do:

  • Own quarterly capitalization and FP&A coordination, ensuring timesheet data and project classifications are accurate and audit-ready at the organizational level. This includes establishing classification standards, resolving ambiguous cases with Finance and Engineering leadership, and proactively surfacing capitalization risk and remediation actions.
  • Maintain and evolve the Team Resource Manager (TRM), EOS, and related portfolio data infrastructure by improving data models, integrations, and controls to ensure a trusted, scalable single source of truth for portfolio and financial reporting.
  • Drive executive reporting cycles including WBR inputs, OK2 gate review documentation, and exec dashboard maintenance and translate insights into clear decision-ready narratives, recommendations, and follow-through on actions.
  • Partner with TPM and Engineering leads on SDLC governance, initiative tracking, and Jira hierarchy compliance by defining standards, enabling adoption, and running periodic compliance/quality checks to ensure portfolio health is visible and actionable.
  • Manage 3P vendor SOWs and Jira Cloud migration deliverables in coordination with Legal and Engineering including scope governance, milestone tracking, vendor performance management, and risk/issue escalation.
  • Own portfolio documentation and process standards; ensure team knowledge is captured and scalable through playbooks, templates, and training that increase consistency and reduce dependency on tribal knowledge.
  • Provide senior portfolio management support for complex, cross-functional programs including escalation tracking and stakeholder reporting by driving alignment on scope, milestones, dependencies, and executive communications across multiple teams.
  • Help define and mature portfolio governance practices across the organization including the operating model for portfolio reviews, gates, and metrics, and the continuous improvement roadmap based on stakeholder feedback and data.

What you’ll need:

  • Typically requires a minimum of 8 years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 7 years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 5 years experience; or equivalent experience.
  • Strong financial acumen; direct experience with capitalization, CapEx tracking, or FP&A processes required
  • Vendor Management experience including SOW governance and delivery/financial performance management.
  • Proficiency with Jira, EOS or similar enterprise portfolio tooling, and Google Workspace with ability to define standards and improve data quality at scale.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently with senior stakeholders and drive cross-functional alignment in ambiguous environments with competing priorities.
  • Exceptional analytical skills and high bar for data quality and process rigor (controls, auditability, and repeatable operating cadences).
  • Experience shaping or maturing governance practices at the organizational level preferred
  • Experience with automation and/or AI tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, etc.
  • Must have legal right to work in the U.S.

At SiriusXM, we carefully consider a wide range of factors when determining compensation, including your background and experience. These considerations can cause your compensation to vary. We expect the base salary for this position to be in the range of $156,200 to $200,000 and will depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary short-term and long-term incentives. We encourage all interested candidates to apply.

It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

Wirecutter strives to be the most trusted product recommendation service on the internet. We obsessively test and report on thousands of items each year to recommend the best of everything. Our goal is to save you time and eliminate the stress of shopping, whether you’re looking for everyday gear or gifts for loved ones. We work with total editorial independence. That means nothing appears on the site as a recommendation unless our writers and editors have deemed it the best through our rigorous reporting and testing. Wirecutter was founded in September 2011 and acquired by The New York Times Company in October 2016. Wirecutter is mission-driven and reader-supported; learn more about us here.

About the Role

Wirecutter is looking for a strategic and operationally oriented partnerships leader who is passionate about driving performance-based results that provide the best buying experience on Wirecutter Picks. The Director, Commerce Partnerships reports directly to the Executive Director, Commerce and is the team leader responsible for business development, partnerships and affiliate operations.  You will emphasize building career development plans through active mentorship of the team, and working across the organization to achieve our goals and priorities. This role is open to remote hiring. This is a temporary role running from September 2026 - May 2027.

Responsibilities:

  • Oversee the strategic development of Wirecutter’s affiliate revenue growth strategies to meet EPC targets and diversification goals, and manages important strategic partners.
  • Stay up to date with industry insights to advise the Executive Director in identifying opportunities that impact revenue growth strategy and goals.
  • Partner with Data Insights, Product, and Editorial leadership to identify and implement action plans against headwinds and growth opportunities.
  • You serve as the strategic and operational partner to the Deputy Editors around coverage of tentpole moments and sale events.
  • You will foster Wirecutter’s relationships across agencies and networks and further our status as the gold standard in commerce content.
  • You will partner with the Executive Director to implement career development plans and mentor direct reports to develop and retain a high-performance team.
  • Attend affiliate conferences throughout the year.

job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The Role:

The New York Times is looking for someone to join our Newsroom Operations team. We are looking for someone who can handle the demands of a fast-paced news environment and can work under sometimes ambiguous circumstances. 

The Operations Manager will work with Shows and Visuals, but also assist other departments at the center of visual journalism at The Times. The work of these journalists — along with visual efforts across the newsroom — is a pillar of our reporting that has a large and engaged audience. You will help support these journalists with a variety of daily responsibilities and short- and long-term projects and coordinate with this group's other operations managers. You will be responsible for ensuring that day-to-day on-site operational tasks are completed in a timely manner to support the needs of department managers and staff.

The Operations Manager's work is critical in supporting the journalism produced at The New York Times and all tasks, whether daily, weekly or one-off are greatly valued. You will report to a senior manager of Newsroom Operations.

This role will be Hybrid, with a required in-office presence of 4 days a week. The schedule of these 4 days can fluctuate based on the needs of the desks, and during some peak news cycles, you may be required to be on site for 5 days during those weeks.

  • Support editors during breaking news and timely news events, ensuring that our journalists have what they need to work
  • Coordinate, and help plan and execute culture-building activities for the departments held both on and off site
  • Manage and approve staff expenses in Workday, communicating and observing policy limits, correcting categorizations and cost centers
  • Manage work and vacation schedules, maintain accurate time banks in Workday and work with Payroll to verify timebanks for transfers, departures and annual payouts
  • Oversee accounts payable and account receivable for the department
  • Be a move coordinator, working with Facilities and other departments on internal desk moves/assignments
  • Work with HR and Recruiting teams to assist with position management transactions
  • Facilitate Workday management, including onboarding new employees and helping them to get the training, equipment and information they need
  • Purchase supplies and equipment, keep track of all departmental expenses, including capital spending and outside vendor spending
  • Work in Zip for independent contractor onboarding, sourcing events and purchasing
  • Manage and pay freelancers and vendors
  • Hands-on management of a variety of tasks that come up: troubleshooting, assisting producers, visuals teams and editors
  • Manage set up of departmental special events, and on-site tasks to ensure events are set up properly
  • You will organize, prioritize, multitask and work under deadline pressure
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world

  • 3+ years of experience in an operational or administrative role
  • Work under deadline pressure and be accessible after hours or weekends as breaking news demands
  • Professional judgment with respect to detail and confidentiality
  • High energy working style and optimistic attitude, with a keen sense of urgency
  • Able to work with all levels of management and staff in a highly professional manner; ability to manage the various needs of a team of 100+ employees and leaders

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree, or equivalent combination of training and experience
  • Experience with Workday, Zip and the freelance payment system
  • Experience with G-Suite
  • Willingness to learn and support the team across all tasks.
  • Able to research resources, troubleshoot and solve problems

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service.  In fact, we have:

  • More #1 rated markets than the next two largest radio companies combined;

  • We create and produce some of the most popular and well-known branded live music events in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour;

  • iHeartRadio is the #1 streaming radio digital service in America;

  • Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and

job.title: Senior Engineer, Commerce
job.description:
Fox Tech desarrolla los productos digitales detrás de las marcas de deportes y entretenimiento de FOX. Nuestras aplicaciones funcionan en web, móvil y dispositivos de sala de estar, y millones de personas las usan, generalmente todas al mismo tiempo cuando comienza un partido. Esos picos de tráfico determinan cómo construimos todo.

Estamos contratando ingenieros para construir la próxima generación de nuestros productos de streaming.

Te unirás al equipo de Comercio, que es responsable de los sistemas que manejan el dinero: pagos, impuestos, facturación y suscripciones en todos nuestros productos directos al consumidor. Un error aquí cuesta dólares reales, y un checkout lento cuesta un suscriptor, por lo que el estándar de corrección y disponibilidad es más alto que en casi cualquier otra parte de la infraestructura.

La mayor parte del trabajo ocurre detrás de la interfaz de checkout: autorización y captura de pagos; reembolsos, disputas y reconciliación; el ciclo de vida de las suscripciones, incluyendo renovaciones, upgrades, downgrades, cancelaciones y todos los estados intermedios; idempotencia y procesamiento de webhooks contra APIs de proveedores que reintentan, llegan fuera de orden y a veces “mienten”; cálculo de impuestos a través de proveedores externos; y el alcance de PCI DSS, manteniendo los datos sensibles de los clientes donde deben estar.

Trabajarás con stakeholders de distintas áreas de negocio de FOX, que no todas venden de la misma forma ni al mismo público. Parte del trabajo consiste en construir capacidades de comercio que puedan reutilizarse entre ellas sin homogeneizar la experiencia de cada una.

El ecosistema de desarrollo ha cambiado drásticamente en los últimos dos años, y nosotros hemos cambiado con él. Nuestros ingenieros usan agentes de código y herramientas de IA generativa como parte de su flujo de trabajo normal, no como un experimento ocasional. Esperamos que llegues con fluidez real: que sepas en qué casos estas herramientas son confiables y en cuáles no lo son, y que ya tengas tus propios hábitos para revisar, probar y proteger lo que producen.

Las herramientas en sí seguirán cambiando. Lo que funcionaba hace seis meses ya está desactualizado, y lo que estandaricemos este trimestre probablemente no será lo que usemos el próximo año. Buscamos ingenieros que vean esto como algo normal y que estén dispuestos a seguir replanteando su propio flujo de trabajo.

Para ser claros sobre el estándar: las herramientas de IA elevan lo que esperamos de ti, no lo reducen. Tú eres responsable del código, de las decisiones de diseño y del comportamiento en producción, sin importar quién (o qué) escribió el primer borrador.

  • Liderar la dirección técnica de las principales capacidades de comercio, desde el diseño hasta la operación en producción.
  • Liderar discusiones de arquitectura y tomar las decisiones de compromiso entre confiabilidad, costo, seguridad y velocidad de entrega.
  • Escribir código de alta calidad con cobertura de pruebas significativa y automatización.
  • Asumir la responsabilidad de producción: respuesta a incidentes, análisis de causa raíz y el trabajo de seguimiento que evita que el mismo incidente vuelva a ocurrir.
  • Mentorear a otros ingenieros y elevar el estándar de ingeniería del equipo.
  • Evaluar tecnologías emergentes de pagos y comercio, y argumentar a favor de cambios que mejoren de forma medible la conversión, la confiabilidad o el costo operativo.
  • Comercio se mantiene estable durante los grandes eventos en vivo, cuando el tráfico llega todo de una vez.
  • Los cambios de pagos y suscripciones se lanzan de forma segura, y puedes señalar la métrica que se movió.
  • Otras áreas de negocio de FOX pueden construir sobre tu trabajo sin heredar el flujo de checkout de otro equipo.
  • Licenciatura en Ciencias de la Computación, o experiencia equivalente.
  • 5+ años de experiencia en ingeniería de software, con enfoque en APIs escalables y seguras, y sistemas basados en eventos.
  • Sólido dominio de Go. Nuestros servicios de comercio están escritos casi en su totalidad en Go, y necesitamos que empieces a escribir código de producción en este lenguaje desde el inicio.
  • Experiencia demostrable usando herramientas de IA generativa en desarrollo de software profesional. Puedes explicar dónde mejoraron tu flujo de trabajo, dónde introdujeron riesgos, y cómo revisas, pruebas y proteges el código asistido por IA.
  • Experiencia en el dominio de comercio. Has trabajado con Stripe, Adyen, Braintree o similares, y entiendes cómo se conectan las piezas entre sí.
  • Bases sólidas de ciencias de la computación e instintos fuertes de resolución de problemas.
  • Experiencia con decisiones de diseño y arquitectura de software a gran escala.
  • Sólida experiencia con SQL y NoSQL, idealmente DynamoDB y Redis.
  • Experiencia profesional con AWS u otro proveedor de nube.
  • Experiencia práctica con contenedores y Kubernetes.
  • Nuestros sistemas dan soporte a eventos en vivo y nuestro equipo está distribuido globalmente, por lo que el puesto implica algo de trabajo fuera del horario habitual: llamadas programadas entre regiones, además de respuesta a incidentes durante eventos importantes.
  • Aplicaciones de streaming, especialmente aquellas que manejan eventos en vivo a gran escala.
  • Comercio electrónico, particularmente tráfico de alta disponibilidad en eventos como Black Friday.
  • Gestión del ciclo de vida de suscripciones: renovaciones, upgrades, downgrades y cancelaciones.
  • Idempotencia, procesamiento de webhooks, reintentos y consistencia eventual.
  • Comercio integrado directamente en una experiencia de streaming de video. Si has explorado esto, nos gustaría saberlo.
