job.title: Manager, Technical Projects & Innovation
job.description:
FOX Sports Remote Engineering & Operations runs a standing portfolio of technical initiatives — private 5G at venues, in-helmet point-of-view cameras, camera tracking and augmented reality, connected-ball and player tracking, volumetric capture, and automated content moderation. Most of them are technically sound and short of hands. This role exists to move them.

This is a hands-on job. You will spend a real share of your week doing the work yourself — on-site testing, integration, writing specifications, chasing vendors to a decision. You will also be the person who makes sure the rest of it happens: that every project has a next milestone and a date, that equipment was specified early enough to actually be ordered, and that the people who needed to know were told before it affected them.

If you're looking for a role that sets technology strategy from a distance, this isn't it. If you want to ship things that end up on air across NFL, MLB, College Football, NASCAR, UFL, and International Soccer, it is.

Stated plainly so expectations are clear from the start: this role executes, recommends, and escalates. Cross-sport technical architecture and vendor strategy sit with our Director of Engineering; remote integration and the plant interface sit with our Remote Integration Engineering lead; capital authority sits with the SVP. You'll work as a peer to both — they set the technical direction, you carry it to completion. That division is deliberate, and it means you can be excellent at this job without having to be the deepest engineer in the department.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Drive our active technical initiatives to their next milestones — on-site tests and evaluations, vendor and partner coordination, and a live date on every card
  • Escalate the calls that need executive judgment quickly rather than letting a project sit while a decision waits
  • Produce specifications, equipment lists, and build calendars early enough that our integration and logistics function can procure and ship against real lead times rather than against deadlines
  • Support major capital projects from requirements through commissioning, in partnership with the teams that own integration and procurement
  • Apply and document the engineering standards our Director of Engineering sets, and hold new builds to them
  • When a property wants an exception, capture it, assess it, and raise it — rather than absorbing it quietly and letting the standard erode
  • Own the status reporting this function has been missing: where projects stand, what's at risk, what decisions are needed, and by when
  • Act as the Field Operations point of contact with our information security team, own the Field Operations security dashboard, and drive remediation items to closure under the security architecture our Director of Engineering owns
  • Give every initiative in the portfolio a next milestone and a date — and surface the stalled ones rather than letting them sit
  • Stand up status reporting that partners come to rely on
  • Get technical requirements to integration and logistics inside their lead times, every time.
  • Document the engineering standards as they exist today, with exceptions logged rather than absorbed.
  • Take the security dashboard fully in hand and bring remediation current
  • Take enough execution off our senior engineering staff that architecture and standards work can actually get done

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 5+ years in broadcast or live production engineering, with at least one or two leading projects or people
  • track record of getting technical projects across the line — including the unglamorous parts: vendor follow-through, lead times, and closing items out — we have deep technical expertise in the group; what we need alongside it is someone who converts decisions into finished work on a date.
  • Hands-on capability across IP video infrastructure (ST 2110, JPEG XS), RF and wireless camera systems, transmission, and remote production workflows — enough to earn credibility and do the work, without needing to be the deepest technical voice in the room
  • Judgment to work as a peer to senior technical colleagues: taking architectural direction from them while holding them to dates, and escalating rather than absorbing when the two conflict
  • Comfort working in a union environment
  • Written communication strong enough that people actually read your status and act on it
  • Willingness to travel and work event schedules, including nights, weekends, and holidays — expect heavier load during football season and around major events.

HOW WE'LL MEASURE SUCCESS

  • Every initiative in the portfolio has an owner, a milestone, and a date — and nothing sits stalled without being surfaced.
  • Partners describe communication from this function as predictable
  • Technical requirements reach integration and logistics within lead times
  • Projects delivered on schedule, with exceptions to standard logged rather than absorbed
  • Security remediation is current rather than accumulating
  • Measurably less execution work sitting with the Director of Engineering at year-end than at the start

CBS Sports is looking for a NFL-obsessed content creator who lives and breathes the sport of football. job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?  


We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU!  Apply to join our new platform initiative and take ownership of building a centralized performance testing automation platform for games development. In this role, you will collaborate with developers, designers, and QA teams to design and deliver a unified system that aggregates performance data from multiple game engines, processes results, and clearly highlights performance issues. 

 You will play a key role in defining the software architecture, database schemas, and overall system experience, while helping to track and visualize optimization progress over time. As this is a brand‑new platform with no prior internal equivalent, you’ll have a unique opportunity to shape its foundations and influence how performance testing is approached across our game development teams. 

 

 

What you will do: 

  • Develop and maintain a platform (applications, integrations and infrastructure) supporting gaming department

  • Partner closely with software architects, game developers, QA, and operations to remove bottlenecks and improve delivery 

  • Build and Maintain CI/CD Pipelines 

  • Script repetitive tasks and develop self-service tools for developers 

  • Design and manage infrastructure 

  • Implement and manage containers, stand up and manage VMs 

  • Implement logging, monitoring, and alerting 

  • Ensure infrastructure is scalable, secure, and reliable. 

 

We are looking for Engineers that: 

  • Are curious, with a desire to learn and the ambition to quickly become a self-reliant, top-notch software engineer,  

  • Value collaboration, knowledge sharing, and contributing to the team's overall effectiveness,  

  • Equally enjoys coding applications and managing infrastructure 

  • Keep up to date with modern web technologies,

  • Open to learn new programing languages, 

  • Enjoy working in a team,   

  • Easily and openly communicate in English.  

 

And on the technical side, we need: 

  • 3+ years of experience in software development, build automation, delivery and deployment 

  • Good understanding of concepts like CI/CD, GitOps, configuration management, cloud platforms, version control, automation, monitoring, analytics, containerization, and microservices architecture 

  • Comfortable coding in at least one programing language (preferred: Kotlin, Java, JavaScript, Python, C++/C#) 

  • Experienced in code collaboration in Git, 

  • Experienced in containers orchestration in Kubernetes, 

  • Good knowledge and practical experience managing Cloud infrastructure. OCI is a huge plus. 

  • Experience standing up and maintaining Windows and/or Linux VMs 

  • Bonus: hands-on experience with Unreal Engine 

  • Bonus: hands-on experience scripting in BuildGraph 

  • Bonus: hands-on experience in code collaboration using Perforce 

  

We keep our technologies up-to-date, and have a major impact on the tool set: 

  • CI/CD & Automation: Horde, Jenkins, ArgoCD 

  • Infrastructure & Platform: OCI, Terraform, Ansible 

  • Containers & Virtualization: Kubernetes, Podman, Proxmox, KVM 

  • Observability & Reliability: Prometheus, Grafana, New Relic 

  • Game Development: Unreal Engine 

  • Source Control Management: Perforce, Git

Job Title

GSOC Coordinator

Job Description

About The Position | Major Goals and Objectives and Location Requirements:

People Inc. is seeking an experienced GSOC Coordinator to serve as a trusted operational resource within the Global Security Operations Center. This position performs the full range of GSOC operator duties while also supporting advanced enterprise security work involving intelligence, investigations, travel security, executive protection, and crisis management.

Reporting to the Manager, GSOC & Intelligence, the Coordinator operates security systems, manages incidents and communications, conducts research and assessments, and supports sensitive security matters requiring sound judgment, discretion, strong writing, and independent decision-making.

Schedule Requirements:

Full In-Office

In-office Expectations: This position is a fully in-office role due to the nature of the work being done.
 

About The Team | The Team and/or Brand:

The Security team at People Inc. is responsible for ensuring the safety and security of employees, facilities, and assets across all office site locations. The team partners closely with contracted security staff, reception, facilities, event teams, and law enforcement agencies to deliver a consistent and resilient security program.

About The Position’s Contributions:

GSOC and Site Security Operations

  • Operate the GSOC and continuously monitor alarms, CCTV, access control, life-safety systems, and other enterprise security technologies.

  • Receive, assess, document, and coordinate the response to security incidents, emergencies, system alerts, and requests for assistance.

  • Dispatch security personnel, maintain communications with field operations, and ensure timely escalation to Security Management and appropriate business partners.

  • Prepare and distribute mass notifications, emergency communications, incident updates, and other enterprise security messages when authorized.

  • Support access-control administration, video review, incident documentation, daily logs, shift turnover, and security-system troubleshooting.

Intelligence and Investigative Support

job.title: Vice President, Strategy
job.description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses: 

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 

  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

Job Title: Vice President, Strategy


A little bit about our team:


The Global Strategy team is a cross-functional group working across Recorded Music and Music Publishing, sitting at the intersection of creative and corporate operations. The team serves as a trusted partner to senior leadership at WMG, focusing on high-impact strategic projects, data analysis, and execution.

 

We partner closely with senior leadership, label teams, and the central finance organization to shape the long-term direction of the business. This role will directly support the EVP, Global Head of Strategy, helping build the organization's strategic capabilities and ensuring commercial decisions are grounded in rigorous analysis and a deep understanding of the music industry landscape.


Your role:

Serve as a key member of the Global Strategy team, partnering with the EVP, Global Head of Strategy and senior leaders across Warner Music Group to drive the successful execution of company-wide strategic priorities and transformations.


Lead high-impact enterprise strategic initiatives that enhance business performance, operational excellence, and long-term value creation. This role involves collaborating with diverse departments globally and in multiple countries to build strategic direction. It ensures initiatives are accomplished and integrated across the organization. The position translates vision into actionable plans supported by clear decision frameworks, data-driven insights, and important metrics.


Success in this role requires exceptional analytical capabilities, robust program management skills, and outstanding communication. The ideal candidate will build trusted relationships, influence senior collaborators, secure agreement from business operators, and translate complex business challenges into practical, actionable solutions.


Here you’ll get to:


Have Strategic Impact

  • Partner with executive management to assist in the development and execution of Warner Music Group’s global strategic priorities.
  • Lead strategic analysis to evaluate business opportunities, organisational efficiency, organizational frameworks, and long-term growth initiatives.
  • Convert complex business challenges into clear, data-driven recommendations and arguments that support executive decision-making.
  • Lead cross-functional strategic programmes from planning through implementation, ensuring delivery against agreed objectives and measurable business outcomes.
  • Establish effective programme governance, delivery plans, milestones, risks, dependencies and success measures.
  • Design and evaluate target operating models, including organisational structures, functional design, role scoping and span-and-layer analysis, to support sustainable growth and organisational effectiveness.
  • Build alignment across global functions and international markets, influencing collaborators and securing agreement to ensure the effective implementation of pivotal initiatives.
  • Act as a trusted strategic partner, providing insight, challenge and recommendations to the highest levels of management.

Drive Operational Excellence

  • Drive an effective operating cadence across strategic initiatives, ensuring appropriate governance, accountability, and timely decision-making.
  • Support the development, tracking and reporting of strategic objectives, OKRs, KPIs and programme performance measures.
  • Partner with Business Intelligence, Finance and other functional teams to ensure reporting provides meaningful, actionable insights that support business decisions.
  • Coordinate cross-functional resources to ensure central initiatives are delivered efficiently and effectively.
  • Find opportunities to improve business processes, governance, operating models and overall organisational efficiency, enabling greater scalability across the organisation.
  • Promote consistency, collaboration and continuous improvement across project development and programme execution.



About you:

  • Have at least 8 years of relevant experience within a leading management consulting firm and/or a corporate strategy, strategic transformation, or business operations function.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional strategic programs within large, global, matrixed organizations.
  • Outstanding analytical and structured problem-solving skills, demonstrated through the ability to simplify complexity and translate insights into practical business recommendations.
  • Outstanding program management capabilities, with experience delivering multiple high-impact initiatives simultaneously.
  • Experience preparing executive-level presentations and communicating complex concepts to senior audiences.
  • Excellent communication, presentation and partner management skills, with a proven ability to influence senior leaders, establish reliable connections and build consensus across diverse business groups.

We’d love it if you also had:

  • Experience in music, media, entertainment, or another content-driven industry.
  • Familiarity with the music industry's commercial models and competitive landscape.
  • Familiarity with building AI tooling and automation


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.

 

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.

job.title: Staff Software Engineer
job.description:
1 big thing: Axios is a growth-focused media company helping people get smarter, faster, on what matters. We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer—a senior, hands-on individual contributor—to lead architecture and delivery for Axios’ core products across multiple teams using strong product-engineering and AI-native practices.

Why it matters: Axios delivers clear, trustworthy news to millions of readers. You’ll be anchored to a product area while shaping full-stack systems and technical direction across multiple teams and connected systems. This is not a people-management role.

AI is core to how we build. You’ll use coding agents throughout implementation, testing, review, debugging, documentation, and operations while remaining accountable for architecture, quality, security, and product outcomes. Staff impact comes from sustained scope, judgment, and results—not tool use alone.

You’ll work with product managers, designers, engineers, and leaders to shape plans, align dependencies, resolve ambiguity, build resilient systems, and help others make better technical decisions.

Responsibilities:

As a Staff Software Engineer, you’ll lead reliable product and platform work across Axios’ frontend and backend systems. You’ll remain hands-on while driving multi-quarter initiatives, improving technical coherence, and using agentic practices to accelerate delivery. Key responsibilities include:

  • Cross-team technical leadership: Lead mission-critical or high-risk initiatives spanning teams and connected systems. Frame problems, align ownership and dependencies, make tradeoffs explicit, and drive production adoption.
  • Architecture and design: Own architecture for a product area and scalable boundaries across frontend, APIs, data, and production systems. Lead design reviews and establish standards within your sphere of influence.
  • Hands-on system ownership: Own the technical direction and long-term evolution of key systems while writing and reviewing code, prototyping, debugging, leading migrations, and operating services in production.
  • AI-enabled product and engineering: Identify where models, agents, retrieval, or automation create value. Build reusable capabilities with measurable behavior, guardrails, and judgment about when conventional software is better.
  • Quality, reliability, and incident leadership: Improve testing, performance, observability, security, and operational readiness. Anticipate systemic risks, address technical debt, and help lead resolution and learning during critical production issues.
  • Technical leadership and mentorship: Mentor mid- and senior-level engineers across teams, spread systems thinking and design patterns, and build alignment through proposals, reviews, and influence without authority.
  • Product and technical strategy: Partner with product, design, and engineering leaders to shape the product-area roadmap, align dependencies, and connect technical investment to reader, editorial, and business outcomes.

Skills:

The ideal candidate is a staff-level engineer with sustained multi-team impact, deep expertise in a relevant domain, broad systems thinking, and a commitment to user experience, reliability, scalability, maintainable code, and effective AI-enabled practice. You should have:

  • Experience: Typically 7+ years in professional software development, or equivalent sustained Staff-level impact, including leading complex initiatives across multiple teams or systems.
  • AI-native development: Hands-on experience using agentic coding tools—such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or comparable tools—to complete meaningful, multi-step software work, rather than only generating snippets or using autocomplete.
  • Agent direction and context: Ability to write clear strategies, specifications, and acceptance criteria; provide context; scope complex work; decide what to delegate; and redirect incomplete or incorrect approaches.
  • Verification and engineering judgment: Ability to review AI-generated code critically, validate assumptions, identify security, scalability, and maintainability risks, and catch plausible but wrong solutions. You understand that AI raises the importance of sound architecture, testing, and human judgment.
  • Frontend development: Hands-on experience building production interfaces with JavaScript or TypeScript and React, preferably with Next.js, plus judgment to guide frontend architecture across teams.
  • Backend development: Hands-on experience building production services and APIs. Our backend systems use Go and Python, and you should be able to shape reliable service boundaries and work effectively in or learn either language.
  • Data fundamentals: Experience with relational databases, SQL, schema design, transactions, and migrations.
  • Quality and security: Experience with testing, accessibility, input validation, authentication, authorization, and web security practices, plus the ability to raise standards across teams.
  • Engineering judgment: Ability to operate independently in ambiguity, identify high-leverage problems, align teams, make sound tradeoffs, and connect decisions to product and business goals—including when AI is not the right tool.
  • Communication: Ability to build alignment through clear proposals and reasoning, communicate risks and tradeoffs across functions, and drive clarity during disagreement.
  • Continuous learning: Curiosity about changing models, tools, and practices, paired with an evidence-based approach. You share useful patterns, identify what fails, and make others more effective.

We’ll be even more excited if you have:

  • Experience building production AI-enabled features using model APIs, structured outputs, tool or function calling, retrieval, or agent workflows.
  • Experience evaluating and operating AI-enabled systems through regression tests, evaluation harnesses, tracing, feedback loops, model or prompt versioning, cost and latency monitoring, or human-review paths.
  • Experience extending AI development environments through MCP servers, agent tools, repository instructions, reusable skills or plugins, custom workflows, or automated code review.
  • Led a multi-team architecture, platform, migration, or modernization initiative from problem framing through production adoption.
  • Owned critical systems through incidents, scaling challenges, and long-term architectural evolution.
  • Drove adoption of technical standards, reusable tools, or platform capabilities across multiple teams.
  • Mentored experienced engineers and helped improve technical judgment beyond your immediate team.
  • Experience with CMS, publishing, media, subscription, search, or other consumer-facing products.
  • Production experience with Go or Python and distributed systems using gRPC, cloud infrastructure, containers, queues, CI/CD, or similar technologies.

What success looks like:

  • Cross-team delivery: You drive multi-quarter initiatives from problem framing through production adoption, aligning dependencies and ownership to produce durable outcomes.
  • Engineering leverage: Teams deliver more effectively because of the standards, tools, architecture, documentation, and context you create. You establish safe, repeatable AI patterns where they add value.
  • System health: Key systems become more reliable, scalable, secure, observable, and easier to change. You reduce systemic risk and improve incident prevention and response.
  • Product-area impact: Your decisions support Axios’ readers, products, editorial workflows, and business goals within the teams and systems you influence.
  • Organizational technical leadership: Engineers across teams make better decisions through your mentorship, proposals, reviews, and example. You remain a hands-on IC who multiplies others’ effectiveness.

 

Starting salary for this role is in the range of $165,000 - $215,000 and is dependent on numerous factors, including but not limited to location, work experience, and skills. This range does not include other compensation benefits. Axios' compensation philosophy takes into account the cost of labor differentials across the country. Because this is a remote-optional job posting, this salary range takes into account all possible locations within the United States, but candidates will only be eligible for the salary range for their location.

Axios is committed to embracing artificial intelligence as a core part of how we work. All team members are expected to actively develop AI literacy and use AI tools to enhance their productivity, creativity, and efficiency. We invest in ongoing learning to ensure every employee is equipped to responsibly and effectively integrate AI into their daily workflows.

What Axios brings to the table besides salary:

  • 401(k) with employer match
  • Robust PPO and High Deductible health insurance options on the Blue Cross Blue Shield network
  • Employer Health Savings Account (HSA) contribution for the high deductible health plan option
  • Dental and vision coverage
  • Primary caregiver 12-week paid leave
  • Birth-givers will have an additional 6-8 weeks depending on type of delivery, for a total of 18-20 weeks continuous leave
  • Generous vacation policy, plus holidays
  • One mental health day per quarter
  • Annual learning and development stipend
  • $100 monthly work-from-home stipend
  • Tele-mental health services through Headspace
  • OneMedical membership, including tele-health services
  • Personal health advocacy resources through HealthAdvocate
  • Inclusive fertility, hormonal health and family forming benefits through Carrot Fertility
  • Access to the Axios “Family Fund”, which was created to allow employees to request financial support when facing financial hardship or emergencies
  • Increased work flexibility for parents and caretakers
  • Virtual company-sponsored social events
  • A strong and positive work environment
  • A commitment to an open, inclusive, and diverse work culture

Equal Opportunity Employer Statement 

Axios is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, age, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. 

This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, leave of absence, compensation, benefits, training, and apprenticeship. Axios makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.

job.description: About Suno We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world. Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA). You'll set the technical direction for how we handle data and permissions across our platform, models, and agents — building the infrastructure that enforces policy at the point of use and verifies outcomes like retention and deletion. You'll partner closely with Legal and Product while hiring and growing your own engineering team to scale this work across the company. Design and operate governance controls across our products, data platforms, models, and agents, enforcing consent, access, and data-sharing rules. Deep experience in privacy engineering or data governance, including working familiarity with regulatory frameworks like GDPR and CCPA. Experience as an engineering manager who has maintained real technical depth, or as a Staff+ engineer ready to grow into people management. You will be an important element of our over-the-top platform team.   • Ensure the good performance of developed applications to handle high loads.
  • Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and application deployments.
  • Participate in code reviews and solution deployments.

  • University degree or equivalent experience.

  • Excellent grasp of REST API principles.
  • Knowledge of Git.
  • Knowledge of SQL Server, Entity Framework.
  • Knowledge of Redis is an asset.
  • Knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript is an asset.
  • Knowledge of Azure Data Lake is an asset.
  • Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and Azure cloud is an asset.
  • Knowledge of audio-video broadcasting on the web (streaming) is an asset.
  • Knowledge of other programming languages is an asset.
  • Knowledge of design patterns is an asset.
  • Good general knowledge and strong intellectual curiosity (to acquire and develop new knowledge and skills).
  • Critical thinking (to question and propose new ideas).
  • A keen interest in the major trends and challenges of the digital world.
  • Meticulousness, independence, and resourcefulness.
  • Excellent stress management and priority setting.
  • Analytical and conceptual thinking skills.
  • Flexibility, initiative, and dynamism.
  • Ability to work in a team, excellent communicator.
  • Bilingualism (English and French) spoken and written is mandatory.

job.description:
iHeartMedia

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service.  In fact, we have:

  • More #1 rated markets than the next two largest radio companies combined;

  • We’re the largest podcast publisher, with more monthly downloads than the second- and third-largest podcast publishers combined. Podcasting, the fastest-growing new media, today has more monthly users than streaming music services or Netflix;

  • iHeart is the home of many of the country’s most popular and trusted on-air personalities and podcast influencers, who build important connections with hundreds of communities across America;

  • We create and produce some of the most popular and well-known branded live music events in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour;

  • iHeartRadio is the #1 streaming radio digital service in America;

  • Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and

  • We have the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio, from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale.  As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.

Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!

If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

What You'll Need:

  • Understanding and passion for of digital media and advertising with a successful track recording successfully coaching others in digital practices

  • Proven track record managing production workflow, timelines and schedules

  • Ability to organize, prioritize and multi-task in a fast paced environment with tight deadlines along with an inclination to follow up until problems are fuly resolved

  • Experience using reporting and research tools to inform proposal development

  • Analytical ability to assess campaign performance data and deliver insights to advertisers

  • Knowledge of the latest industry trends and how digital advertising works with the ability to explain complicated technical concepts to others in a consumable way

  • Advanced Microsoft Office tools (PowerPoint, Excel, Word, Outlook) skills; knowledge of Google DoubleClick for Publishers (DFP) is a plus

*Non-Remote, In-Person Opportunity. * 

 

The Opportunity: 

Townsquare Media is looking for a bright, confident, driven individual to join our multimedia advertising sales team in Bozeman Montana.  Townsquare Media Bozeman is an industry leader in digital advertising and an accredited marketing partner of both Google and Meta as well as home to five top radio stations.   

 

At Townsquare Media Bozeman, we are a team of ambitious individuals who work together to push ourselves and those around us to grow personally and professionally. You can expect a dynamic and competitive work environment that fosters success, training, development, and an unlimited earning potential!

job.title: Business Development Representative
job.description:
Business Development Representative

*This is a full-time, in-office opportunity. *

 

This Isn't Another Sales Job. It's Your Chance to Build Something Bigger.

Let's be honest—there are thousands of sales jobs.
Most ask you to sell one product. Make cold calls. Hit a quota. Repeat.
This isn't one of them.

At Townsquare Media Grand Rapids, you'll help shape the success of local businesses while representing some of the most recognized brands in West Michigan. You'll have the backing of a company that combines the power of market-leading radio stations, streaming audio, live events, streaming TV, websites, social media, search marketing, programmatic advertising, SEO, websites, and cutting-edge digital solutions—all under one roof.

Every day is different. Every client is different. Every success story is yours to create.

If you're energized by competition, love solving business challenges, and want unlimited earning potential while working alongside an exceptional team, we'd love to meet you.

 

Why Townsquare Media Group?

Townsquare Media is one of America's largest and most innovative local media companies, operating 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets nationwide.

In Grand Rapids, we're more than a media company—we're woven into the fabric of the community. Our brands entertain, inform, and connect hundreds of thousands of people every week while helping businesses grow through powerful, measurable marketing solutions.

Our clients don't hire us to buy advertising.
They partner with us to grow their businesses.

job.description:
Multi-Media Advertising Strategist

*This is a full-time, in-office opportunity. *

 

Every now and then a great opportunity presents itself, that time is now, for you, at Townsquare Media in Bangor.  At Townsquare, we are a team of driven individuals who push ourselves and those around us to grow personally and professionally.  We have a current opening which includes an existing book of business that requires a strong marketing professional.  You can expect a dynamic and competitive work environment that fosters success, training, development, and above average pay. 

We have a rare opening for the right person to bring our best-in-class marketing solutions to local businesses in eastern and central Maine. We’re the number one local media company in each of the markets we serve. Our top-rated radio stations, our market exclusive digital media solutions and our exciting live events are a winning combination for you, and our customers.

 

Responsibilities:

  • determine strategy for identifying, connecting and closing new opportunities in the Bangor market.
  • prospect and identify potential clients using our proprietary data and analytics;
  • build and maintain close working relationships with internal teams to identify key accounts and build solution based strategic plans that help businesses grow.
  • responsible for bringing our premier marketing and advertising solutions to both local and regional businesses in eastern and central Maine.
  • diversifying our clients’ solutions through cross-selling a variety of marketing solutions including broadcast, digital (website design, SEO, SEM, Programmatic, Paid Search/Social, etc.), and live event sponsorship.

 

Qualifications:

  • B 2 B sales experience preferred
  • A strong business acumen
  • Outside sales experience in any field with a track record of success
  • General understanding digital advertising, broadcast media and event sponsorship
  • Goal-oriented, strong work ethic, and a desire to learn and grow a career in Sales

 

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation plan + UNCAPPED earning potential
  • 3 weeks PTO + 9 paid holidays (including 2 personal days)
  • Volunteer Time Off—give back to your community
  • Health, Dental, Vision, and Pet Insurance
  • 401(k) with company match + Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Company-provided laptop
  • Hands-on training and dedicated support from your leadership team
  • Real opportunities for career growth in a fast-moving multi-media organization

 

About Us

Townsquare is a community-focused digital media, digital marketing solutions, and radio company focused outside the Top 50 markets in the U.S. Our assets include Townsquare Interactive, a digital marketing services subscription business providing websites, search engine optimization, social platforms, and online reputation management for approximately 21,900 SMBs; Townsquare IGNITE, a proprietary digital programmatic advertising technology with an in-house demand and data management platform; and Townsquare Media, our portfolio of 322 local terrestrial radio stations in 67 cities with corresponding local news and entertainment websites and apps including legendary brands such as WYRK.com, WJON.com, and NJ101.5.com, along with a network of national music brands including XXLmag.com, TasteofCountry.com, UltimateClassicRock.com, and Loudwire.com.

job.description:
Working at QVC Group means joining a live social shopping company with incredible teams, ambitious projects and amazing careers. QVC Group, Inc. is a Fortune 500 company with six leading retail brands - QVC®, HSN®, Ballard Designs®, Frontgate®, Garnet Hill® and Grandin Road.

Your Opportunity, Your Team

Reporting to the Director, Platform Engineering, you will support QVC. In this role, you will transform how the organization understands, operates, and continuously improves its technology platforms. You will bridge the gap between engineering and operations, enabling a unified approach to platform health, performance, and reliability.


Where You'll Work

This role is remote; job seekers must reside in one of the following states to be considered: NJ, DE, PA. This role may require you to be on site at our West Chester, PA as needed. Relocation is not provided.


What You'll Do

  • Lead the design and evolution of modern IT Operations platforms, combining observability, event management, and service management into a cohesive ecosystem.·
  • Define enterprise-wide patterns for tools such as Dynatrace, ServiceNow, and Stonebranch, ensuring consistent and value-driven adoption across teams.
  • Drive the integration of operational tooling to enable end-to-end visibility, correlation, and actionable insight across services and user journeys.
  • Embed observability and operational requirements into platform and application design, shifting operations left within the delivery lifecycle.
  • Act as the senior technical authority for operational platforms, leading complex investigations and driving root cause and systemic improvements.
  • Design and implement intelligent alerting and event management strategies to significantly reduce noise and improve signal quality.
  • Lead the evolution of incident, problem, and change practices through automation and effective use of ServiceNow workflows and integrations.
  • Champion automation and self-healing capabilities, reducing manual intervention and enabling proactive and predictive operations.
  • Collaborate across engineering, SRE, and operations teams to align on reliability targets, service health metrics, and operational standards.
  • Mentor engineers and operational teams, building capability in modern observability, reliability engineering, and operational excellence practices.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • 10+ years of IT experience, including 5+ years in operations or platform engineering with hands-on expertise in monitoring, application development, and performance tuning.
  • 10+ years of experience mentoring and coaching technical teams, including conflict resolution and collaboration.
  • 10+ years of experience presenting complex technical concepts to diverse audiences, both verbally and in writing.
  • 10+ years of experience in road mapping, blueprinting, and risk assessment, leveraging emerging technologies to deliver business value.
  • Technical certifications such as Applications Development, Network/Cisco, Linux, Windows, etc., preferred.

job.title: Senior Director of News, KTNV
job.description:
Senior Director of News, KTNV


Are you a proven news leader ready to elevate one of the most dynamic newsrooms in the West? KTNV, The E.W. Scripps ABC affiliate in Las Vegas, Nevada, is seeking an experienced Senior Director of News to lead our newsroom and drive continued audience growth and journalistic excellence. This is your opportunity to lead a talented team of journalists committed to delivering critical community journalism that serves Las Vegas and Southern Nevada.


We're looking for a visionary leader who can inspire compelling storytelling, foster innovation, and navigate the rapidly evolving media landscape. If you're passionate about quality local journalism, digital innovation, developing great people, and building a positive, hard-charging newsroom culture, we want to hear from you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Create and implement strategic plans for audience growth and newsroom operations.
  • Develop and implement measurable strategies for audience growth while effectively managing news content delivered across multiple platforms.
  • Communicate a compelling and inspired vision consistent with company strategy.
  • Analyze and respond to trends affecting the industry and DMA.
  • Approve all newsroom personnel decisions.
  • Develop and control the annual budget in compliance with station guidelines.
  • Build and maintain key relationships to foster a positive news image within the Las Vegas community.
  • Monitor all on-air and online products for compliance with federal, state and local laws as well as First and Fourteenth Amendment requirements.
  • Work closely with other members of the station management team to develop and attain departmental and station goals.
  • Maintain knowledge of and proficiency in posting content to station websites.
  • Adapt current resources to emerging technology.
  • Supervise and provide regular feedback and yearly performance appraisals for direct reports, with ultimate responsibility for all newsroom personnel.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • At least 5 years of news management experience is required.
  • Bachelor's degree in journalism, communication or a related field preferred.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Demonstrated ability to track and select trending news stories.
  • Strong organizational skills.
  • Ability to lead and make sound decisions in a rapid, fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule, including nights, weekends and holidays.
  • Strong editorial judgment and knowledge of journalistic ethics and libel laws.
  • Ability to create tactics and strategies to increase audience performance in key target areas across multiple platforms.
  • Working knowledge of federal, state and local laws impacting operations.
  • Advanced oral and written communication skills.
  • Effectiveness in a variety of formal presentation settings, both inside and outside the organization.
  • Proven and effective leadership skills, including fostering open dialogue, empowering others, and addressing conflict quickly and directly.

WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK AND PLAY:

Las Vegas, Nevada offers far more than the world-famous Las Vegas Strip. The region combines the energy and entertainment of a major destination city with year-round outdoor recreation, a growing local community and easy access to some of the most striking landscapes in the Southwest.


Beyond the restaurants, entertainment and attractions that draw visitors from around the world, Las Vegas offers professional sports, arts and culture, and outdoor adventures throughout Southern Nevada. From exploring Red Rock Canyon and nearby desert landscapes to taking in major sporting events, concerts and entertainment, Las Vegas provides a unique blend of big-city excitement and Western outdoor living.


For a news leader, Las Vegas also offers the opportunity to serve a distinctive and active community. At KTNV, you'll lead a newsroom focused on delivering important local journalism to viewers across Las Vegas and Southern Nevada while helping shape how that journalism reaches audiences across platforms. KTNV is Scripps' ABC affiliate in Las Vegas.

As we expand our broadcast, cable, and digital distribution channels, we are embracing new technologies—including cloud-first solutions and artificial intelligence—to support a rapidly changing media environment.

As a Master Control Supervisor, you will support the playout and origination of 30+ CW, MeTV, MyNet, and independent television stations from our cloud-based Master Control platform. You will provide leadership, guidance, and development for a team of 20+ Master Control Operators, with a strong focus on training, skills development, operational consistency, and performance management.

Major Responsibilities

  • Supervise the day-to-day operations of the Media Operations Center.
  • Lead, train, and mentor new Master Control Operators, ensuring they are fully prepared to perform their responsibilities independently and consistently.
  • Provide ongoing training, refresher training, and skills development for current Master Control Operators.
  • Support the team during live local newscasts, breaking news, and local or network sports events.
  • Assist the Senior Manager of the Media Operations Center with developing, implementing, and training staff on new processes, workflows, and standard operating procedures.
  • Monitor operator performance and provide timely coaching, feedback, and corrective guidance when necessary.
  • Ensure completion of daily operational tasks and adherence to established workflows, policies, and procedures.
  • Serve as a liaison between the Media Operations Center and internal or external partners, including Station General Managers, Traffic, On-Air Promotion, Programming, Engineering, News, and other operational teams.
  • Perform Master Control Operator duties when operational needs require.
  • Assist with incident review, root-cause analysis, documentation, and corrective-action plans.
  • Support staffing needs, including attendance management, call-ins, shift coverage, and unscheduled absences.
  • Prepare and participate in employee performance evaluations and annual reviews.
  • Promote positive employee relations and maintain a professional, respectful, and accountable work environment.
  • Assist with special projects, reporting, and operational improvement initiatives as needed.
  • Approach operations, staffing, and process improvement with an agile and lean mindset.

 

Qualifications

job.title: Project Manager
job.description:
Who We Are:

WWE® is the global leader in sports entertainment. The company creates and delivers original content 52 weeks a year to a global audience. WWE is committed to family-friendly entertainment on its television programming, Premium Live Events, digital media, and publishing platforms. WWE's TV-PG programming can be seen in more than 1 billion households worldwide in more than 20 languages through world-class distribution partners including Netflix, ESPN, NBCUniversal, USA Network and The CW. WWE is part of TKO Group Holdings (NYSE: TKO). Additional information on WWE can be found at wwe.com and corporate.wwe.com. TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

Position Summary

The Project Manager is responsible for managing the flow of creative work from intake through final delivery across a high-volume, fast-paced environment supporting the AAA brand. This role coordinates creative requests, licensing submission support, merchandise initiatives, talent-related projects, logo development, and related brand deliverables across internal teams and external partners.


This position serves as a key operational partner to Creative, helping projects move efficiently from concept through completion while ensuring alignment on priorities, timelines, approvals, budgets, and deliverable requirements. The Project Manager works closely with designers, creative leads, licensing, merchandise, talent, marketing, production partners, and other stakeholders to keep work organized, on track, and executed to a high standard.


Key Responsibilities

Project Management & Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Establish and maintain strong working relationships across AAA and related business functions, including Creative, Licensing, Consumer Products, Merchandise, Talent, Marketing, Communications, Digital, Production, and other stakeholders.
  • Manage projects through all phases of the creative, approval, licensing, and production process to ensure timelines, budget requirements, and job specifications are met.
  • Coordinate project intake, timelines, milestones, deliverables, and approvals across multiple concurrent assignments, ensuring clear communication and accountability at every stage.
  • Partner closely with designers and creative leads to define project scope, deliverable requirements, production approaches, and workflow needs.
  • Maintain clear project documentation, status updates, schedules, and action items so stakeholders have visibility into priorities, next steps, risks, and dependencies.
  • Keep current with AAA programming, talent, events, brand priorities, merchandise needs, and business objectives to support informed planning and effective project coordination.

AAA Creative & Brand Support

  • Manage the intake and coordination of creative requests supporting the AAA brand across marketing, digital, social, events, merchandise, talent, licensing, and other business needs.
  • Help translate stakeholder requests into clear creative briefs, project plans, timelines, and deliverable lists.
  • Coordinate the development and review of AAA brand assets, including campaign creative, promotional materials, merchandise graphics, talent-related creative, logos, and other visual applications.
  • Partner with creative leads to ensure work is aligned with approved brand direction, usage requirements, project scope, and stakeholder expectations.
  • Track feedback and approvals, consolidate comments, and help drive timely decisions across internal teams and external partners.
  • Identify potential creative, operational, or approval issues early and help develop practical solutions that protect quality and delivery timelines.

Licensing Submission Support

  • Coordinate the preparation, organization, and routing of creative materials required for licensing submissions and approvals.
  • Maintain submission trackers, deadlines, asset requirements, status updates, and approval records for active licensing projects.
  • Partner with Licensing, Creative, Merchandise, Legal, and other stakeholders to confirm that submissions are complete, accurate, properly formatted, and delivered on time.
  • Help manage revisions, comments, and follow-up requests throughout the licensing review process.
  • Maintain organized records of approved assets, supporting materials, and final submission files.

Merchandise, Talent & Logo Development

  • Support project management for AAA merchandise initiatives from initial request through concept development, review, approval, production, and final delivery.
  • Coordinate creative needs related to talent, including asset requests, approvals, usage considerations, and time-sensitive deliverables.
  • Help organize and manage logo development projects, including creative briefs, exploratory concepts, review rounds, approvals, final files, and usage documentation.
  • Coordinate with designers, merchandise partners, talent representatives, licensing stakeholders, and vendors to keep projects moving and expectations aligned.
  • Track project-specific requirements, including artwork specifications, product applications, talent or partner approvals, production deadlines, and final deliverables.

Production Support & Execution

  • Obtain estimates and help secure vendors based on quality, cost, service, and turnaround time when outside production support is needed.
  • Interface with external vendors and production partners, staying current with industry practices and helping resolve production-related issues quickly and effectively.
  • Coordinate print, digital, merchandise, event, and other production deliverables as assigned.
  • Address potential production or execution issues before they impact delivery, helping teams stay ahead of risks and maintain momentum.
  • Help ensure final deliverables are produced accurately, on brand, on time, and within scope across a range of creative applications.

Workflow Optimization & AI-Enabled Organization

  • Use AI tools and workflow systems in practical ways to improve request intake, job organization, task tracking, status visibility, and overall project efficiency across the team.
  • Help the team adopt new tools and ways of working that improve project tracking, communication, and operational clarity without disrupting creative quality or delivery.
  • Support stronger visibility into project progress, next steps, approvals, and resource needs by maintaining accurate timelines, updates, and tracking systems.
  • Identify opportunities to simplify recurring processes, improve documentation, and create greater consistency across AAA creative workflows.

Qualifications

  • Fluency in Spanish is required.
  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in project management within an agency, in-house creative department, design studio, entertainment company, sports property, consumer products organization, licensing environment, or related fast-paced creative setting.
  • Thorough knowledge of creative project and production management principles and practices, with working knowledge of print, digital, merchandise, and brand asset workflows.
  • Proven experience establishing and maintaining schedules, budgets, approvals, and deliverables for multiple concurrent, deadline-driven projects through all phases of design, review, licensing, and production.
  • Experience supporting licensing submissions, merchandise creative, talent-related projects, logo development, or other brand asset development is strongly preferred.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, and project tracking or workflow management tools; familiarity with AI-assisted productivity tools is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Excellent organizational, negotiation, communication, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, including the ability to communicate effectively and persuasively with a wide range of internal and external partners.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, stay detail-oriented, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.
  • Reliable, punctual, self-directed, and flexible in responding to changing priorities and business needs.
  • A collaborative, solutions-oriented approach and a strong interest in supporting the AAA brand through thoughtful, organized, and high-quality creative execution.

job.title: Senior Union Payroll Associate
job.description:
The Senior Union Payroll Associate performs a variety of functions necessary for the accurate and timely processing of multi-state, multi-company, weekly and bi-weekly payrolls for union and non-union freelance employees. The Senior Union Payroll Associate coordinates, validates, and implements work procedures that require comprehensive operational knowledge of union collective bargaining agreements and federal and state regulations related to wage garnishment, taxation and wage‐hour law.


While there are no direct people responsibilities, the Senior Union Payroll Associate will coordinate independently with other associates, leaders, and teams outside of Payroll Shared Services to accomplish tasks, meet deadlines, champion process improvement initiatives, and enhance the employee experience.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Perform all duties necessary to ensure timely and accurate processing of multi-state, multi-company weekly and bi-weekly payrolls for union and non-union freelance employees in accordance with collective bargaining agreements and other contracts and in compliance with applicable FOX policies and federal, state, and local regulations
  • Process on demand payments, retroactive payments, one-time payments, tax adjustments, stop payments, void checks, direct deposit reversals, and overpayment collections in accordance with FOX policies, collective bargaining agreements, and in compliance with federal, state, and local regulations
  • Interpret and set up withholding orders for levies, garnishments, child support, and other involuntary wage assignment orders in the payroll system within the regulated period
  • Understand union pay and paid time off rules and the timekeeping system and address employee questions as needed

job.title: Host/Producer (Overnights), LiveNOW from FOX
job.description:
Schedule: Thursday – Monday

  • Weekends (Saturday & Sunday): 12:00 AM – 8:30 AM
  • Weekdays (Thursday, Friday & Monday): 11:00 PM – 7:30 AM

LiveNOW from FOX is looking for an Overnight Host/Producer to join FOX TV Stations’ national live streaming news offering. As the Overnight Host/Producer you will be part of the team that keeps viewers informed and engaged at all hours of the day! You’ll get the best of both worlds – hosting live, on-air coverage on some nights, and driving viewer engagement while supporting other hosts behind the scenes on others. This flexible role is ideal for a dynamic journalist who thrives both in front of the camera and behind the scenes. You’ll balance real-time coverage of what’s happening right now with forward-thinking content presentation and finding innovative ways to help viewers find the live events and latest updates they’re looking for.

LiveNOW brings viewers the most relevant and engaging live news coverage occurring right now across the country and the world. We are a team of passionate journalists and content producers seamlessly moving between the biggest events and stories as they happen to keep our audience informed. LiveNOW is always raw, live and unfiltered, with limited commentary and no opinion.

**Only applications with a reel will be considered for this position. Reels may be submitted in your application as a link or attachment.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Gather, produce, and present live coverage of breaking news and major events across digital, streaming, social, and broadcast platforms.
  • Host live streams, guiding viewers through developing stories in a clear, engaging, and informative manner.
  • Research, plan, and build editorial coverage, including booking guests, coordinating interviews, and preparing for upcoming news events.
  • Manage live video production elements including switching, graphics, and stream execution.
  • Monitor live feeds, wires, social media, and newsgathering tools to identify breaking news and emerging stories.
  • Execute and evolve the editorial plan, maintaining calendars and ensuring coverage is forward-looking and well-coordinated.
  • Collaborate with FOX O&O stations and internal/external partners to source live video, interviews, and content.
  • Pitch story ideas and contribute to editorial decision-making while upholding journalistic standards.
  • Monitor real-time analytics to inform coverage decisions and optimize content performance.
  • Support teammates across roles, including stepping in on-air or behind the scenes as needed.
  • Maintain strong relationships with key contacts and sources to support coverage.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Strong knowledge of current events and a deep understanding of how audiences consume news across digital platforms.
  • Proven ability to communicate clearly and confidently both on-air and behind the scenes in a fast-paced, unscripted breaking news environment.
  • Excellent editorial judgment, research skills, and attention to detail.
  • Experience with digital news production, live streaming workflows, and newsroom technologies (e.g., TriCaster or similar).
  • Strong organizational and planning skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and think several steps ahead.
  • Ability to thrive under pressure and pivot quickly as news develops.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Proficiency in newsgathering tools, social media, and digital analytics platforms.
  • On-camera hosting or reporting experience required.
  • Flexibility to work varied hours, weekends, and holidays as news demands.

Why Join LiveNOW from FOX?

At LiveNOW, you’ll be part of a team redefining how news is delivered in the digital era. We bring audiences live, unfiltered news and events from around the country in real time—no scripts, no anchors, just the story as it unfolds. With millions of viewers tuning in across multiple platforms, this is your chance to help shape the future of live digital journalism.

job.description:
The Manager, Accounting & Financial Reporting is an integral member of the Finance team supporting the Fox Digital & Technology organization. The Manager, Accounting & Financial Reporting is responsible for the financial integrity and operational oversight of the Digital & Technology P&L, managing monthly and quarterly close processes to ensure accurate, timely, and complete financial reporting. In addition, this role serves as a key business partner to operational stakeholders and external suppliers across all purchasing and invoicing activities. The Manager oversees the end-to-end Procure-to-Pay process, collaborating cross-functionally to drive financial discipline, process efficiency, and strong internal controls. This position plays a critical role in validating financial results, including reconciliation of the full Balance Sheet and P&L, investigating variances, and ensuring reported results align with business expectations.

The Manager exercises strong independent judgment in resolving issues, demonstrates ownership, and consistently delivers high-quality, timely results without the need for constant supervision.   • Partner with operational leaders and the FP&A team to investigate expense fluctuations, provide variance explanations, and support reporting deliverables

  • Perform and validate monthly reconciliation of key Balance Sheet accounts to ensure reported financial results are accurate, supported, and compliant with internal controls

job.title: Platform Ops & Delivery (Sr. SDET)
job.description:
La plataforma directa al consumidor (DTC) de FOX es una iniciativa nueva y visionaria dentro de Tubi Media Group que lleva el incomparable portafolio de contenido de FOX —noticias, deportes y entretenimiento— directamente a los consumidores a través de un innovador servicio de streaming por suscripción.

Impulsado por un equipo de liderazgo altamente experimentado, con trayectorias en la intersección de los medios, la tecnología, el streaming y el contenido, y respaldado plenamente por Fox Corporation, este proyecto combina energía emprendedora con un profundo conocimiento de la industria de los medios.

Nuestra visión es crear una experiencia de visualización unificada y moderna que ponga al consumidor en primer lugar, integrando de forma fluida el contenido en vivo y bajo demanda en todas las plataformas.

En la intersección entre la tecnología de vanguardia y la narrativa de confianza, esta es una oportunidad para dar forma al futuro del streaming en uno de los momentos más decisivos de la industria de los medios. Estamos formando un equipo de clase mundial para cumplir esa visión, y apenas estamos comenzando.

FOX ONE es la aplicación de streaming directa al consumidor de FOX Corporation, ya activa y en operación en Estados Unidos. FOX ONE se está expandiendo ahora a América Latina, y buscamos a un(a) Sr. Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) con base en la Ciudad de México para liderar la ingeniería de calidad de esa expansión. Este es un rol de ingeniería altamente técnico y práctico, para alguien que ve la calidad como una disciplina central de la ingeniería y que pueda definir cómo se construye, prueba, lanza y monitorea la versión de FOX ONE para LATAM.

Te asegurarás de que la calidad se diseñe dentro del trabajo de expansión a LATAM, en lugar de validarse al final. Al comprender el producto actual de FOX ONE, los requisitos del mercado de LATAM y la arquitectura de la plataforma, identificarás riesgos de forma proactiva, definirás estrategias de pruebas y construirás capacidades de automatización en paralelo con el desarrollo de funcionalidades para la región.

Extenderás la plataforma de ingeniería de calidad ya existente de FOX ONE para dar soporte a la expansión en LATAM, adaptando los frameworks y las herramientas construidas para el producto de EE. UU. de modo que funcionen de forma confiable en los distintos idiomas, monedas, dispositivos y entornos regulatorios de México. UU. para decidir qué se debe reutilizar y qué se debe reconstruir para la región.

job.title: Production Finance Supervisor
job.description:
We are seeking a proactive, highly organized, and analytical Production Finance Supervisor to join the FOX team in Mexico City. This role bridges the gap between high-level financial analysis and hands-on operational management. You will be responsible for the full lifecycle of production expenses, from reviewing and coding invoices to preparing month-end accruals and identifying cost-saving opportunities.

The ideal candidate possesses strong analytical skills, expertise in production accounting workflows, can manage high volumes of data independently, and possesses the analytical rigor to ensure all production schedules are accurate and compliant, fast-paced media environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Production Accounting Operations: Supervise daily production financial activities, including invoice coding, expense verification, GL alignment, and adherence to budget categories.
  • Month-End Close & Accruals: Lead and streamline monthly, quarterly, and annual closing schedules for production, preparing complex accruals for goods and services received, flash accruals, prepaid talent amortization, and balance sheet reconciliations.
  • Cost & Variance Analysis: Proactively analyze production costs to identify trends, potential budget overages, and opportunities for cost reductions. Conduct variance analysis comparing actual spend against forecasted budgets.

  • Collaboration & Leadership: Serve as a key liaison between Finance, Accounting, and operational stakeholders to resolve unusual items, and ensure multi-country production initiatives move forward smoothly.

Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in accounting or finance.

  • Language Skills: Professional proficiency in both English and Spanish (written and verbal) is required.
  • Technical Expertise: Strong knowledge of accrual-based accounting, multi-currency transactions, and regional tax/statutory requirements. Solid proficiency in local GAAP, US GAAP, and/or IFRS.
