El Director de Operaciones de Producto y Delivery es el enlace principal entre el negocio de FOX One México y las áreas centralizadas de Producto, Operaciones de Producto, Delivery e Ingeniería.

Este puesto existe por tres razones, en este orden:

  • México está migrando. FOX One México está migrando de extremo a extremo desde sus plataformas de proveedor actuales —aplicaciones, identidad, comercio, derechos de acceso (entitlements), playout y distribución— hacia el stack tecnológico de FOX DTC, con un lanzamiento de primera fase previsto para el 15 de febrero de 2027. El mercado necesita una contraparte operativa dedicada dentro de la organización que lo está construyendo.
  • Después hay que operar México. Tras el lanzamiento, la salud del producto y de la operación debe medirse de forma continua, convertirse en trabajo de producto priorizado y en optimización de procesos de negocio, y llevarse a través de Delivery hasta un resultado validado.
  • América Latina es el siguiente paso. México es la primera instancia de un modelo replicable, no un caso aislado. Este puesto construye el modelo operativo, los procesos y la automatización que hacen que los siguientes mercados sean más rápidos y económicos, y asegura que las necesidades locales se resuelvan configurando una plataforma multi-tenant en lugar de desarrollos específicos por mercado.

La posición está facultada para actuar con autonomía —identificar oportunidades, formarse un criterio propio e iniciar trabajo sin esperar una solicitud formal— acompañada de la colaboración y comunicación necesarias para alinear a los líderes y aplicar las mejores prácticas de la organización DTC en favor de la escala y la eficiencia.

Responsabilidades Principales

Liderazgo de la Operación y del Negocio

  • Ser el responsable operativo del día a día y el punto de contacto único de FOX One México dentro de la organización de tecnología.
  • Investigar incidencias, llegar a conclusiones e impulsar mejoras de forma independiente, presentando una recomendación y no solo un reporte.
  • Construir relaciones de confianza con la dirección del negocio local, merchandising, mercadotecnia, finanzas y atención al cliente, y con sus contrapartes centralizadas en Estados Unidos.
  • Responsabilizarse de la preparación del mercado durante la migración y el lanzamiento: habilitación de merchandising, preparación de atención al cliente, operaciones locales de finanzas y negocio, y operación del día del lanzamiento.
  • Representar la realidad operativa del mercado en la planeación central, incluyendo aquello que no puede posponerse sin impacto al cliente.

Salud del Producto y de la Operación

  • Definir y ser responsable del marco de salud de producto y operación: qué se mide, qué se considera un buen resultado y dónde se ubican los umbrales.
  • Asegurar que existan los dashboards, las alertas y las revisiones recurrentes para que la salud sea visible sin que nadie tenga que solicitarla, en colaboración con los equipos que las construyen.
  • Detectar de forma temprana deterioros y riesgos emergentes, asegurar el diagnóstico de la causa y convertirlo en una corrección operativa o en una mejora de producto definida.
  • Establecer la línea base de medición de cada nuevo mercado de LATAM desde el lanzamiento, en lugar de reconstruirla después.

Gestión de Producto y Mejoras

  • Traducir las necesidades del negocio y de la operación en planteamientos de problema y SOPs que Delivery e Ingeniería puedan ejecutar sin una reunión de aclaración.
  • Facilitar la recepción y priorización de iniciativas del mercado dentro del modelo operativo DTC, y negociar capacidad en el roadmap frente a otros mercados y productos.
  • Validar que las soluciones entregadas cumplieron el objetivo que las justificó, medido contra el marco de salud, y señalarlo con claridad cuando no haya sido así.

Mejora de Procesos y Automatización

  • Tratar el modelo operativo como un producto: identificar dónde los procesos son manuales, lentos, propensos a error o dependientes de una sola persona, y corregirlos.
  • Mejorar la recepción de solicitudes, la priorización, el seguimiento de la ejecución, la gestión de liberaciones, la atención de incidentes y los reportes, alineados a las prácticas de gestión de portafolio de DTC.
  • Automatizar el trabajo operativo y de reporteo recurrente junto con Ingeniería, Analytics y los equipos de herramientas internas. Lo que es aceptable hacer a mano para un mercado resulta inviable con varios.
  • Documentar el modelo operativo para que pueda transferirse a un nuevo mercado, a una nueva persona o a un equipo.

Coordinación de la Entrega (Delivery)

  • Dirigir la ejecución con los equipos centralizados de Delivery y los equipos de Ingeniería distribuidos: requerimientos, dependencias, secuenciación, riesgos y fechas.
  • Mantener la visión de ejecución, dependencias y riesgos como un documento vivo, con una persona responsable y un siguiente paso en cada punto abierto.
  • Administrar la ruta crítica y poder expresar en una sola frase qué está bloqueando el lanzamiento o la liberación.
  • Eliminar bloqueos de forma activa: escalar de manera temprana, convocar a las personas correctas y cerrar el ciclo por escrito el mismo día.
  • Responsabilizarse de la preparación para la liberación y el cutover: criterios de go/no-go, ensayos, operación del día del lanzamiento, plan de reversión (rollback) y comunicación de incidentes.
  • Hacer cumplir la disciplina operativa: decisiones registradas, cambios de alcance documentados y acuerdos verbales asentados por escrito.

Reportes y Comunicación

  • Ser responsable del ritmo operativo del mercado: señal operativa diaria, estatus semanal de ejecución y riesgos, y revisión mensual de negocio y plataforma.
  • Reportar salud de plataforma y producto, desempeño del negocio, riesgos y dependencias, incidentes con impacto al cliente y estado del pipeline — con análisis y recomendación, no volcados de datos.
  • Servir de puente entre Negocio, Producto, Operaciones de Producto, Delivery, Ingeniería, Atención al Cliente, Mercadotecnia y Finanzas, en dos idiomas y entre husos horarios.
  • Gestionar de forma bilingüe la comunicación de escalamientos e incidentes con impacto al cliente. Un retraso debe surgir desde esta posición antes de manifestarse como una fecha incumplida.

Expansión Regional (LATAM)

  • Convertir lo aprendido en México en un manual replicable de lanzamiento de mercados: preparación operativa, línea base de medición, atención al cliente, comercio y habilitación de merchandising.
  • Definir qué es genuinamente específico de cada mercado y qué debe resolverse configurando la plataforma multi-tenant, y cuestionar las propuestas de desarrollos aislados.
  • Responsabilizarse de la preparación operativa de los siguientes mercados de LATAM y hacer crecer la función regional conforme aumente el alcance.

job.title: Director, Media Workflows
job.description:
The Media Workflows department is the connective tissue of FOX Sports’ content operations — an umbrella group spanning post production, live studio playback, workflows from ingest to air for all of FOX Sports’ production and operations teams. FOX Sports produces a wide array of live sports as well as original studio and other programming for air on the FOX Broadcasting Channel, FS1 & FS2, and digital platforms such as FOX One and various social media channels.

As content volume, speed-to-air, and the number of distribution surfaces continue to grow, the department’s mandate is no longer only to keep these workflows running reliably — it is to continuously re-engineer them into a media supply chain that is increasingly software-defined, cloud-enabled, data-rich, and agent-assisted, without compromising the reliability that live production demands.

The Director, Media Workflows carries a deliberate dual mandate: to run today’s post production and live studio workflows and operations with uncompromising reliability, and to lead the transformation of those operations — introducing AI, automation, and orchestration as core, owned outcomes rather than experiments at the edges. This is a single leadership role that both operates the plant and changes it.

Reporting to the Vice President of Media Workflows, the Director oversees all facets of Post Production — managing media teams for post and live productions, technical operation of edit bays, live studio edit/playback systems, and capital projects for improvements across all areas.

Within the first 12–18 months, this Director will have kept live and post production reliably on-air while measurably advancing the department’s transformation: Agents and automation embedded into named workflows with tracked ROI; a metadata and content-as-data foundation in place; a repeatable innovation pipeline moving proofs-of-concept into production; and a workforce actively reskilled for automated/assisted operations. The measure is not that the workflows still run — it is that they are demonstrably faster, more discoverable, more automated, and more resilient than they were.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

Operations & Production Continuity

  • Oversee workflow practices across technical facilities — hardware, software, and personnel — to meet the creative and operational requirements of all shows and events
  • Architect and maintain content management and workflow systems at an enterprise level, spanning operational requirements for live and post production and administrative management
  • Maintain focus on high-level company objectives while managing the granular, interconnected dependencies of highly visible live production workflows; solves problems appropriately and escalates when necessary
  • Own capital planning and project delivery for improvements across all post production and media workflow areas, sequencing modernization against live-event and craft edit obligations

Automation & Workflow Orchestration

  • Design agentic and human-in-the-loop workflows that embed agents into production, defining where automation acts autonomously and where human review is required, with editorial quality and speed-to-air as the measured outcomes
  • Own the orchestration and automation layer connecting MAM/PAM, playback, and ingest systems —event-driven and API-first — treating these workflows as products with roadmaps rather than facilities to keep alive
  • Accountable for Innovation ROI: define success metrics, tracks adoption and cost-to-value, and retires tools that do not earn their place

Cloud, Hybrid & Distributed Production

  • Accountable for cloud and hybrid media workflows and for remote/distributed post production models, extending edit and playback beyond fixed on-prem facilities, exchanging content anywhere in the world
  • Partner with Engineering to define the reference architecture for where workloads run (on-prem, cloud, or hybrid) based on latency, cost, and reliability

Content Protection & Resilience

  • Accountable for content protection and resilience across a surface widened by cloud services and third-party vendors — partnering with Information Security on vendor and supply-chain risk
  • Ensure automated pipelines fail safely, with monitoring, fallbacks, and recovery paths appropriate to live, no-second-take production

Workforce Transformation & Change Leadership

  • Lead reskilling and role redefinition as automation reshapes media operations, defining how post and live-production roles evolve alongside automated workflows
  • Own management of NABET union freelancers — contract policy, workflow practices, scheduling, budget, and personnel matters — and navigates union relationships thoughtfully through operational and technological change.
  • Serve as change agent for the department, bringing team leads and frontline staff along through transformation with clear communication and prioritized, fluid information

Innovation Pipeline & Strategic Partnerships

  • Run innovation as a repeatable function — structured proofs-of-concept, an emerging-technology evaluation pipeline, and clear graduation criteria from pilot to production — rather than as ad hoc experimentation.
  • Manage strategic cloud, automation, and tooling partnerships, positioning Fox Sports to assert industry leadership in workflow and media-technology advances.

Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Maintain operational continuity and alignment across Fox Sports — other Operations groups, Production, Engineering, Media Management, technology groups, and Creative Services.
  • Sustain close relationships with production leads to understand evolving workflow needs, and with engineering and technical leaders to align strategy, technology trends, and vendor direction.
  • Further a culture of collaboration, operational excellence, and accountability within post production and, indirectly, across FOX Sports

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 8+ years of professional experience in network-level broadcast and/or post production environments.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud and hybrid media workflows and their operational and cost-governance implications for post-production or broadcast environments.
  • Experience deploying AI/ML into production workflows — not only fluency with tools (Gemini, Claude, ChatGPT, etc.), but hands-on experience integrating AI services, designing agentic or human-in-the-loop workflows, and evaluating outcomes. Understanding of machine-learning training and implementation
  • Expertise with post production tools across editorial and graphics applications, MAM/PAM solutions, media-centric file-based workflows, and digital file-transfer solutions
  • Strong background in leading technical teams, change management, and enterprise-level business initiatives, with the ability to build consensus and motivate staff across a large landscape
  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and documentation skills; proficiency across Google Workspace and collaboration tools (Slack, Zoom, Outlook); knowledge of both Mac and PC environments

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Education in TV Production, Broadcasting, Engineering, or a related communications field
  • 3+ years of enterprise-level management in a related field; supplemental education in business management
  • Direct or adjacent experience in product development / product management, software engineering, or DevOps — the disciplines behind treating workflows as products and automation as software
  • Familiarity with distributed / HRP (at-home) production models and cloud FinOps
  • Awareness of content-authenticity and provenance standards (e.g., C2PA) and the rights, likeness, and governance considerations around synthetic and AI-modified media
  • Exposure to observability/telemetry practices and defining operations by measured SLAs and quality

job.title: Accounting Supervisor
job.description:
We are seeking a proactive, highly organized, and detail-oriented Accounting Supervisor to join the FOX team in Mexico City. In this role, you will oversee day-to-day general accounting operations, manage AR workflows, and drive the month-end closing process across Mexico and Central America.

Serving as a crucial bridge between operational execution and managerial oversight, you will ensure total financial accuracy, regional tax compliance (including Mexican CFDI 4.0 and local tax/e-invoicing regulations across Central American countries), and strict alignment with US GAAP and local statutory standards.

The ideal candidate possesses strong analytical skills, expertise in multi-entity regional accounting, and proven experience guiding junior accounting staff within a dynamic, fast-paced multinational environment.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Regional Accounting Operations: Supervise daily accounting activities across Mexico and Central American entities, including general ledger maintenance, AR operational cycle, accruals, prepaid expenses, and fixed assets.
  • Month-End Close: Lead and streamline monthly, quarterly, and annual closing schedules for regional entities, preparing and reviewing complex journal entries, intercompany transactions, and balance sheet reconciliations.
  • Tax Compliance & Invoicing Standards: Ensure strict adherence to local tax regulations across all assigned jurisdictions (including Mexican CFDI 4.0, payment complements, and Central American e-invoicing and tax requirements).
  • Collaboration: Collaborate effectively with shared service centers, corporate finance, regional tax, and treasury teams.
  • Audit & Internal Controls: Maintain and enforce robust internal control policies across regional entities. Assist the Accounting Manager in coordinating internal and external audit deliverables for local and corporate audits.
  • Process Optimization: Actively identify opportunities to standardize and automate accounting processes across countries.
  • Stakeholder & Customer Management: Serve as a key escalation point for complex cross-border customer reconciliations, regional onboarding due diligence, and multi-country operational inquiries.

Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in accounting.
  • Experience: 5 years of progressive accounting experience, with at least 1–2 years supervising or mentoring accounting staff within a multinational corporate environment. Experience managing or supporting Central American entities is highly preferred.
  • Language Skills: Professional proficiency in both English and Spanish (written and verbal) is required.
  • Technical & Tax Expertise: Deep expertise in Mexican electronic invoicing/tax regulations (CFDI 4.0) and working knowledge of Central American tax and statutory requirements. Solid proficiency in local GAAP and working knowledge of US GAAP and/or IFRS.
  • Systems Experience: Hands-on experience with major ERP systems. Familiarity with multi-entity financial software and tools such as Workday, Coupa, or Graphite is highly desirable. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Leadership & Analytical Skills: Strong leadership capabilities, attention to detail, and a proactive problem-solving mindset with the ability to manage tight deadlines and multi-country priorities.

job.title: Vice President, Talent Strategy
job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

Reporting directly to the Chief Content Officer (CCO), the Vice President of Talent Strategy serves as the principal architect, relationship builder, and strategic scout for creative, journalistic, and host talent across NPR. In this role, you will work side-by-side with the CCO and editorial leadership to align talent acquisition, career stewardship, and creator partnerships directly with NPR’s long-term multimedia vision.

You will nurture trusted relationships with our established roster of award-winning journalists, hosts, and commentators while proactively identifying, evaluating, and attracting emerging voices from independent media, podcasts, newsletters, and digital platforms. Serving as an executive bridge across Content, People, Legal, and Member station network, you will champion a collaborative environment where exceptional storytellers can thrive and expand public media's reach across platforms.

This is an NPR editorial role covered under the terms of the NPR Ethics Handbook. All editorial staff are bound by this guidance. Editorial staff is defined as staff members who play a role in shaping the journalistic or creative direction of NPR's content, including events.

Responsibilities

  • Executive Talent Relationship Management: Serve as the primary executive liaison and trusted advisor to high-profile journalists, hosts, and creative contributors, cultivating sustainable career pathways and retention strategies in close collaboration with the CCO.
  • Talent Scouting & Pipeline Development: Design and lead a comprehensive discovery strategy across traditional broadcast, podcasting, newsletter platforms, social ecosystems, and independent journalism to build an ongoing, diverse pipeline of on-air and digital talent.
  • Cross-Functional Mediation & Advocacy: Act as the central connective tissue between creative talent, talent representatives (agents, managers, attorneys), and internal executive teams (People Team, Legal, Marketing, and Operations) to align individual goals with organizational priorities.
  • Complex Contract Structuring & Negotiations: In close coordination with the CCO, Legal, and People teams, oversee talent agreement frameworks, leading contract renewals, compensation structures, and rights agreements with precision and diplomatic finesse.
  • Editorial Standards & Mission Alignment: Ensure all talent recruitment, onboarding, and partner strategies rigorously reflect NPR’s core mission, journalistic ethics, and commitment to public service.
  • Audience Forecasting & Metric Analysis: Partner with Content Insights and divisional leadership to evaluate audience consumption trends and identify future talent requirements across evolving media such as video, episodic audio, and experiential storytelling.
  • DEI Talent Initiatives: Systematically embed diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into every phase of talent identification, pipeline cultivation, and retention.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications 

  • 12+ years of progressive executive leadership in talent management, talent relations, media recruiting, or creative talent strategy within news, podcasting, digital media, or broadcast entertainment.
  • Demonstrated, active network of professional relationships with journalists, creators, literary and talent agencies, management firms, and digital-first storytellers.
  • Proven track record of structuring and negotiating complex, multi-party talent contracts, intellectual property rights, and compensation agreements in compliance with organizational policies.
  • Demonstrated success building and sustaining diverse, multi-perspective talent rosters that engage cross-generational and culturally diverse audiences.
  • Substantive experience acting as a trusted mediator in high-stakes creative environments, resolving interpersonal, contractual, or operational friction with discretion and high emotional intelligence.
  • Unwavering commitment to editorial independence, high-integrity journalism, and the civic mission of public media.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience navigating talent relations within a federated, public service, or non-profit media network operating alongside union collective bargaining agreements (e.g., SAG-AFTRA).
  • Proven experience executing creator-led co-productions, live podcast tours, or multi-platform distribution partnerships.
  • Familiarity with the commercial and sponsorship frameworks unique to digital audio, podcast monetization, and multi-market station networks.

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Executive Relationship Building: Exceptional diplomatic presence with the proven ability to build trust quickly with high-profile personalities, agents, and senior internal stakeholders.
  • Contractual & Negotiation Acumen: Strong fluency with creative intellectual property rights, talent deal points, non-disclosure terms, and talent contract structuring.
  • Audience & Format Vision: Forward-looking creative perspective capable of identifying how emerging digital storytellers can translate their voices to public radio and multimedia platforms.
  • Strategic Collaboration: Demonstrated ability to lead complex cross-functional alignments involving Legal, Finance, People, and creative stakeholders without friction.
  • Crisis Management & Discretion: Exceptional judgment, confidentiality, and composure when navigating sensitive personnel or creative matters under public or time pressure.

Education Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, Media Studies, Business Administration, or a related field, or equivalent practical work experience demonstrating equivalent executive capability.

Work Location & Requirements

  • Hybrid Permitted: This is a hybrid permitted role. The employee will be required to be in the office at the Washington, D.C. or the New York City location at least 3 days a week. The employee must also reside in Washington, D.C. / Maryland / Virginia / New York City.

Job Type

  • This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S.-based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $243,000 - $290,000 plus benefits. The displayed range reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to offer new hires for the position across all U.S. locations.

NPR Benefits: NPR provides comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees.

job.title: Editor at Large, Opinion, A.I.
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

The New York Times Opinion department is seeking a sophisticated editorial leader to spearhead our coverage of one of the most consequential shifts of our time: the rise of artificial intelligence. This role is designed for an editor with a deep background in intellectual history, policy and narrative journalism — someone capable of moving beyond the daily news cycle to deliver definitive enterprise work that explains how AI is reshaping society, labor and the human experience.

The ideal candidate will combine the intellectual rigor of a long-form editor with the tactical agility required to edit and manage high-profile columnists and drive a department-wide coverage strategy.

Work at CBC/Radio-Canada

Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians.

Your role 

CBC Olympics has built a reputation for “best in class” content and sport production.  We’ve identified the need for a temporary Senior Analyst position (working title Unit Production Manager) reporting to the Senior Director - Sports. 

Responsible for the production & financial management of features & branded content produced for the LA28 Olympics and Paralympics.  Responsibilities include planning, budgeting, forecasting, reporting and overseeing all production logistics.  Collaborates with National and International Organizing Sports Committees to ensure efficient content production.

In this role they will work directly with the CBC Sports Executive Producers and Unit Production Managers for each CBC Sports component.

Key Tasks

  • Creates production plans and budgets for sports features in collaboration with the production teams (CBC and Radio-Canada), sales and marketing team and program area senior management.

  • Controls and authorises program expenditures.  Evaluates financial status on a continuous basis.  Analyses budget variances and recommends a course of action to maintain budget integrity.

  • Determines which suppliers and personnel best meet production requirements.  Determines level of spending for each production component according to overall budgetary restrictions.

  • Coordinates and oversees all aspects of pre-production, post production and production including all remote location and logistics.  

  • Negotiates for the acquisition of goods and services for the production for both internal and external sources.  

  • Coordinates staff and delegates responsibility, in conjunction with the Producers, to ensure the smooth operation of the program unit.  Hires freelancers as required.  Counsels production unit, performers, crew and staff.  Contributes to the cohesiveness of crew.

  • In consultation with senior production personnel, hires freelance personnel who are best suited to production and its budgetary parameters.

  • Decides accountability of staff personnel recommended for assignment to the program, in conjunction with the Producers.

  • Coordinates crew travel.  Interprets and applies talent and labour agreements, CBC policies and CBC/industry business practices.  Initiates and liaises with Business Affairs department for the preparation of contracts. 

  • Administers contracts to ensure adherence to agreed terms.  Ensures compliance with sound business practice on a per case basis

  • Decides how to achieve optimum deployment of personnel and services.  Daily operational decisions required for production and unit.

  • Prepares financial reports of the Olympic Features & Branded Content file at month-end, quarter-end and year-end including commitments report and accrual calculations.

  • Decides allocation of expenditures within an Olympic feature.

  • Analyses program budget proposals for productions and recommends alternatives.

  • This position is one of constant change and multiple priorities while juggling many productions and details.  This is a unique position within a production unit and requires the ability to work without supervision.  

We are looking for a candidate with the following: 

  • University degree in Business/Finance or equivalent work experience.

  • A thorough understanding of the production planning process, production needs and workflow.

  • At least five years' experience of which three must involve work in features production or a closely related industry, which is directly related to the area of assignment.

  • The ability to interpret labour and talent agreements, CBC Policies, Business Practices and CBC Corporate Structure.  

  • A high degree of facility with Financial Systems (general ledger, resource planning, scheduling and tracking tools).  

  • The ability to provide financial information in a manner that meets the needs of production and of senior management

  • Strong computer skills are important, particularly the Google suite of products and a high degree of efficiency with Microsoft Excel.

  • A creative and solution driven approach to keep the production on schedule and on budget

  • Must be highly articulate and be able to listen, empathise, support and challenge others.  Interaction with others is a daily requirement.  

  • Advise management on the intricacies of production for the purposes of corporation progress and change.

  • Must be able to maintain concentration, accuracy and control of the production which requires an individual who can exercise good judgement, initiatives, problem solving skills and decision making capabilities.

  • Bilingualism (French) is an asset.

  • Excellent negotiating, communication, interpersonal and  multi-tasking skills, along with proven judgement and tact.

  • Open to new ideas and approaches.

  • Extremely motivated self-starter.

  • Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings, overtime and weekends as required. (for example, during the Olympics or other international sporting events).

What we bring:

  • CBC Sports offers a creative and dynamic work environment, where your ideas and contributions can be heard, valued and respected.

  • A supportive management team committed to upholding the highest standards of diversity and inclusivity. 

  • Opportunities for continued learning and professional development.

  • Mentorship opportunities, where you can learn from the best in the industry and help coach new talent. 

  • An environment which favours collaboration, inclusion, creativity and innovation.

  • Hybrid work opportunities.

  • Flexibility in work schedules to help contribute to a healthy work/life balance.

Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media organization.

Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation’s technology and infrastructure. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people and places. We are the space in between.

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology — not just in Canada but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force, and we are the team making it happen.

This is a hybrid position with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

Your Role

At CBC/Radio-Canada, the Technology & Infrastructure Rapid Innovation Pod is an agile, cross-functional unit dedicated to accelerating the co-development of emerging technologies. Our mission is to explore technology pathways critical to our strategic goals and drive knowledge sharing across flagship projects.

As a Senior Analyst, you are the technical engine of our Innovation Pod. Your primary focus is validating new concepts through active experimentation — building test beds, running thorough evaluations, developing prototypes and conducting proofs of concept (PoCs). Working directly with emerging technologies, you will configure lab environments and document findings with precision. Your analytical rigour provides the critical insights needed to validate or disprove technical hypotheses, ensuring both speed and excellence for our innovation initiatives.

Your Responsibilities

Technical Execution, Prototyping and Test Beds

  • Technology Deployment: Configure test beds, deploy hardware and software, and evaluate emerging cloud technologies to assess their impact on live and near-live production environments.
  • Experimentation: Lead PoCs, lab trials and technical demonstrations while capturing performance metrics.
  • Automation and Scripting: Prepare, code and document test scripts, lab configurations and deployment guidelines for prototype systems.
  • Collaborative Design: Actively contribute to researching and architecting practical, innovative solutions for complex technical challenges.

Data Analysis, Reporting and Agile Tracking

  • Hypothesis Validation: Meticulously record test results, isolate bugs and develop workarounds to rapidly validate or rule out technical hypotheses.
  • Experimentation Velocity: Track technical milestones across test sprints, identify deviations or blockers against sprint goals and report them promptly.

Collaboration and Knowledge Sharing

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Meet regularly with colleagues, system designers and project leads to review technical requirements, present experimental data and explore potential solutions.
  • Technology Handoffs: Support transition and implementation phases by providing direct technical guidance to delivery and operations teams.
  • Knowledge Base Maintenance: Maintain clear technical documentation (Confluence, wikis) to inform future architecture standards and operational best practices across the organization.

Minimum Requirements

  • University degree in computer science, software engineering, data science or a related field.
  • One to three years of hands-on technical experience in software development, system administration or systems integration within an R&D or lab environment.
  • Curiosity and Learning Agility: Proven ability to quickly master emerging tech stacks, software architectures and development tools.
  • Collaborative Skills: Proven ability to work within cross-functional teams and explain complex technical concepts.

Preferred Qualifications (Assets)

  • Experience with DevOps practices and modern systems administration.
  • Solid background in structured testing and validation methodologies.
  • Practical experience working in Agile environments (Scrum, Kanban).
  • Strong interest in technical innovation within the media, audiovisual production and creative tech sectors.
  • Active contributions to open-source projects or technical communities of practice.

job.title: Scripps Sports Partnership Lead, WSFL
job.description:
Scripps Sports is looking for a passionate, experienced sports sales professional to help drive revenue growth for the Florida Panthers TV Broadcasts on Scripps Sports, one of the NHL's premier franchises. As a Scripps Sports Partnership Lead, you'll leverage the power of live sports and the strength of the Panthers-Scripps partnership to develop strategic sponsorships, build lasting client partnerships, and create innovative linear and digital advertising and marketing solutions for regional and national advertisers. If you're a proven seller who thrives on developing new business, exceeding revenue goals, and delivering winning solutions, this is an exciting opportunity to make an immediate impact with a growing sports media organization.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Prospect and develop relationships with regional and national accounts to generate new business opportunities.
  • Conduct needs analyses and create customized sports sponsorship and advertising solutions that align with client objectives.
  • Secure appointments, present recommendations, negotiate agreements, and close sales to achieve revenue goals.
  • Create and sell sponsorship packages utilizing acquired league and team-controlled sports inventory, with a primary focus on Florida TV Panthers partnership opportunities.
  • Leverage the strength and visibility of the Florida Panthers brand to develop creative, integrated marketing solutions that deliver measurable results for clients.
  • Collaborate with Scripps national and local Account Executives on strategic sports sponsorship opportunities.
  • Participate in internal planning meetings to establish sales strategies, revenue targets, and growth initiatives.
  • Build long-term client partnerships through exceptional service, retention efforts, and referral generation.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to new and existing clients while identifying opportunities to expand partnerships and drive incremental revenue.
  • Prepare and deliver compelling presentations, sponsorship pitches, and partnership recommendations to clients and stakeholders.
  • Manage all aspects of client service, including media negotiations, proposal development, campaign execution, collections, reporting, and account retention activities.
  • Entertain prospective and existing clients through sporting events and other business development opportunities.
  • Maintain accurate client activity, pipeline, forecasting, account information, and revenue projections within CRM systems.
  • Resolve makegoods and other sales-related issues while ensuring client satisfaction.
  • Communicate regularly with sales leadership regarding account status, revenue performance, and business opportunities.
  • Travel up to 25% as needed to support client meetings, sponsorship opportunities, sporting events, and business development activities.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Sports Management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in sports, media, sponsorship, advertising, partnership sales, or a related industry.
  • Proven track record of success achieving and exceeding revenue goals in a highly accountable sales environment.
  • Valid driver's license, satisfactory driving record, and proof of insurance meeting company requirements.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • Strong understanding of sports sponsorships, media sales, and integrated marketing solutions.
  • Ability to identify client needs and develop strategic, customized partnership programs.
  • Exceptional prospecting, relationship-building, negotiating, and closing skills.
  • Proven ability to influence decision-makers and uncover new revenue opportunities.
  • Experience using CRM platforms and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Knowledge of media sales platforms and advertising solutions.
  • Outstanding verbal, written, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to confidently present to executives and audiences of all sizes in both virtual and in-person settings.
  • Strong organizational and time management capabilities.
  • Excellent attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively across teams and departments.
  • Self-motivated, results-oriented approach with a strong sense of accountability.
  • Entrepreneurial spirit with a passion for sports, partnership development, and revenue generation.
  • Ability to effectively represent the Florida Panthers and Scripps Sports brands in the marketplace.

WHAT WE'LL OFFER

  • Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission opportunity.
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision benefits.
  • Retirement savings opportunities, including company matching.
  • Generous paid time off and holidays.
  • Employee wellness programs and resources.
  • Professional development and career growth opportunities.
  • The opportunity to represent one of the most exciting brands in professional sports while helping clients connect with passionate fans.
  • A dynamic, collaborative culture where your contributions directly impact business growth and success.

Step inside the newsroom where stories break, voices matter, and information moves at the speed of now.

We’re looking for a passionate, curious, and driven News Intern to join our team for Fall 2026. As part of a forward-thinking media organization, you won’t just observe—you’ll actively contribute to the storytelling that informs and connects our community across platforms.

From breaking news to digital-first storytelling, this is your opportunity to experience what modern journalism really looks like.

What You’ll Do

  • Create & Contribute: Assist in researching, writing, and producing news stories for broadcast and digital platforms
  • Be Where the Action Is: Work alongside reporters, anchors, producers, and photographers—both in the newsroom and out in the field

What You’ll Gain

  • Hands-on experience in modern, multi-platform journalism
  • A deeper understanding of how today’s newsrooms operate—from broadcast to digital and social
  • Opportunities to build a professional portfolio with published or produced work
  • Mentorship from experienced journalists who know the industry inside and out
  • Valuable connections to jumpstart your career in media

  • Be available to work on-site at WPEC in West Palm Beach, FL approximately 15 hours per week for 10 weeks
  • Be able to start between August 24th - September 14th 
  • Have reliable transportation (housing/relocation is not provided)
  • Be passionate about local news, storytelling, and community impact

All candidates must apply through our careers portal and complete pre-employment requirements.

Why Join Us

Because journalism in 2026 is more dynamic than ever—and this is your chance to be part of it.

Join a team that values accuracy, creativity, and impact. Help tell stories that matter, develop skills that translate across platforms, and take your first step into a career in news.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist
job.description:
KOMO News is seeking an energetic, enterprise-driven Multimedia Journalist to expand our sports coverage across broadcast, digital, social, streaming and audio platforms.

This journalist will help lead coverage of the mega-successful sports brands that define Seattle, including the Seahawks, Mariners and Seattle Storm. The position will play an important role in maximizing KOMO’s partnerships while delivering smart, visual and original coverage that connects with fans throughout Western Washington.

The successful candidate is a strong visual storyteller who can report, shoot, write, edit and publish compelling sports content independently and collaborate closely with KOMO’s Sports Director, newsroom, digital and sales teams to grow audience and create sponsorship opportunities.
 

Key Responsibilities

  • Report, shoot, write and edit original sports stories for KOMO newscasts, KOMO News.com, social platforms, streaming and podcasts.
  • Cover breaking news, games, major events, athlete features and enterprise stories involving the Seahawks, Mariners, Seattle Storm and other key Pacific Northwest teams.
  • Help maximize KOMO’s Seattle Storm partnership through distinctive reporting, features, digital content and promotional opportunities.
  • Develop stories that go beyond scores and highlights, bringing perspective, accountability and strong local relevance to sports coverage.
  • Create digital-first video, articles and social content that reaches fans throughout the day.
  • Work with the Sports Director and newsroom producers to ensure sports stories are positioned prominently when they are meaningful to the broader community.
  • Contribute to and help grow KOMO sports franchises, podcasts and special-event coverage, including sponsored content opportunities where appropriate.
  • Build and maintain relationships with teams, athletes, coaches, community leaders and fans.
  • Represent KOMO professionally at games, events and in the community.
  • Meet daily deadlines while maintaining strong editorial judgment, accuracy and fairness.
  • Work a flexible schedule that includes nights, weekends, holidays and travel as sports coverage requires.
  • Assist with general news coverage and other newsroom assignments on an occasional, as-needed basis.

 

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications or a related field preferred, or equivalent professional experience.
  • At least two years of reporting, shooting and editing experience preferred; sports reporting experience strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to tell memorable stories on television, digital and social platforms.
  • Strong writing, live reporting, interviewing and editorial judgment.
  • Proficiency with non-linear editing, mobile journalism tools, content-management systems and social publishing.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Deep knowledge of Seattle and Pacific Northwest sports culture is preferred.
  • Valid driver’s license and a good driving record required.

 

KOMO News is an equal opportunity employer.

job.title: Sales and Marketing Specialist
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 

 

Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 

 

Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

Help Brands Thrive: 

Join our media sales team and play a pivotal role in helping brands and companies grow. By identifying new opportunities, building strong client relationships, and delivering impactful solutions, you'll showcase how our multi-media content platforms and digital assets can drive meaningful results for our partners. 

 

Your focus will be on helping clients achieve their goals, ensuring that every campaign is a success. When our clients win, we win—and we believe in celebrating those victories together! 

  

Make Connections: Embrace your powers of persuasion and make every handshake and meeting count! Every interaction is a chance to build a genuine connection and show clients how we can help them succeed. You're not just selling; you're building partnerships. You're helping businesses find the right audience in the right place at the right time. When we say One Partner, Endless Possibilities, we mean it! 

 

Be A Trusted Guide: In this role, you'll connect with clients on a human level, understand their unique needs, and craft tailored sales and marketing solutions that deliver results. As their trusted advisor, you'll help them navigate the ever-evolving marketing landscape, ensuring every step of the journey is planned with care and precision.  

 

Shake Things Up: Bring your creativity and fresh ideas to the table! We're looking for someone who challenges the status quo, embraces innovation, and finds new ways to connect with our audience. Your contributions will help elevate our brand and drive meaningful results for your clients.  

 

Join us and Conquer the Media Landscape: You'll be part of a dedicated team of A1 media sales professionals, committed to achieving market leadership. Together, we amplify our impact, deliver exceptional outcomes, and help our clients succeed in ways that truly matter. 

 

Identify Emerging Opportunities: It's about being able to see what others can't, anticipating market shifts, analyzing data and predicting the next big thing. Your insights will position our clients and AMP for long-term success.  

  

What We're Looking For 

Proven Sales Ability (or an Unstoppable Desire to Learn) 

Whether you're a seasoned sales professional or just getting started, we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 

 

Strong Communication Skills: You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 

 

A Passion for helping Others: You're committed to understanding clients' needs, providing top-notch customer service and making a difference. You're not just selling a product; you're providing a solution.  

 

A Competitive Spirit: Do you get a little boost when you achieve a goal (especially if it was a tough one)? We love that for you (and us)!  We want someone who's driven to excel but also knows how to celebrate the victories (big and small) with their team. That drive makes you a valuable part of our organization.  

 

A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.  

 

The Practical Stuff 

A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 

 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

 

Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.  

 

The Compensation Package: We offer a base salary, commission structure, and benefits package designed to support your success and well-being. Happy employees don't stage rebellions! ;) 

 

We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales specialist isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.) 

 

Top-Notch Training and Support: We're not the kind of company that hires you and then disappears into the corporate abyss. We carefully select candidates for a cohort-based training program, where you'll join a group of sales professionals from all over the country. From onboarding to ongoing mentorship, we invest in your success with training programs that set you up for long-term growth. 

 

Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, providing you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.  

 

Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise.   

 

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.  

 

EEO AND INCLUSIVITY 

Sinclair is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and a drug free workplace. Employment practices will not be inﬂuenced or aﬀected by virtue of an applicant's or employee's race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military or veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. 

The base salary compensation range for this role is $36,192-$40,640. This position is also eligible to earn commissions, which are 2.5%-12% of sales the employee closes that meet the definition of ‘earned’.  Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidates’ relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, sick leave, vacation time, personal time, parental leave and employee stock purchase plan.

job.title: Live Events Operations Coordinator
job.description:
Who We Are:

WWE® is the global leader in sports entertainment. The company creates and delivers original content 52 weeks a year to a global audience. WWE is committed to family-friendly entertainment on its television programming, Premium Live Events, digital media, and publishing platforms. WWE's TV-PG programming can be seen in more than 1 billion households worldwide in more than 20 languages through world-class distribution partners including Netflix, ESPN, NBCUniversal, USA Network and The CW. WWE is part of TKO Group Holdings (NYSE: TKO). Additional information on WWE can be found at wwe.com and corporate.wwe.com. TKO Group Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: TKO) is a premium sports and entertainment company. TKO owns iconic properties including UFC, the world’s premier mixed martial arts organization; WWE, the global leader in sports entertainment; and PBR, the world’s premier bull riding organization. Together, these properties reach 1 billion households across 210 countries and territories and organize more than 500 live events year-round, attracting more than three million fans. TKO also services and partners with major sports rights holders through IMG, an industry-leading global sports marketing agency; and On Location, a global leader in premium experiential hospitality.

The Live Event Operations Coordinator is a dynamic, strategic, and detail-oriented leader responsible for overseeing and optimizing all aspects of departmental business operations within the Live Events division. This role blends operational priorities, creative project management, and revenue strategy, requiring a proactive problem-solver who can manage day-to-day functions, lead cross-functional creative initiatives, and drive high-impact projects that enhance profitability, operational efficiency, brand execution, and fan experience. The coordinator serves as a key liaison between stakeholders, ensuring creative concepts are effectively planned, executed, and aligned with organizational goals while maintaining seamless event operations.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the project lifecycle for creative and promotional initiatives tied to live events — building timelines, managing deliverables, and keeping cross-functional teams aligned through the event life cycle

  • Track open action items, decisions, and approvals across multiple simultaneous projects

  • Serve as the primary intake and traffic manager for promotional asset requests originating from the Live Events team — briefing projects clearly, setting realistic timelines, and managing the feedback and revision process

  • Facilitate reviews and approval workflows, keeping stakeholders engaged and decisions moving without bottlenecks

  • Support the planning and execution of live event promotional campaigns across local markets, working to ensure consistent messaging and timely asset delivery

  • Assist in the development of promotional toolkits and market-facing materials that local promoters and venue partners can execute against

  • Support the development and maintenance of dashboards tracking KPIs across the Live Events portfolio

  • Experience in business operations, project management, sports/entertainment administration, or a related field

  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities across simultaneous events

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to interface confidently with internal stakeholders and external partners

  • Genuine passion for live entertainment, sports, or media

  • Strong creative sensibility — understand brand, fan experience, and storytelling, and you can contribute meaningfully to those conversations, not just manage around them

  • Experience in a creative traffic or project management capacity, with comfort briefing creative teams and managing revision cycles

  • Proficiency in project management tools (Smartsheet, Asana, Monday.com, or similar); PMP or equivalent a plus

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Communications, Marketing, Entertainment, Business, or related field

  • Experience working within or alongside a creative department in a fast-paced entertainment environment

  • Familiarity with WWE programming, live event structure, or professional sports operations

job.title: KFSN-TV (ABC30) Newsroom Intern, Spring 2027
job.description:
About the Role & Program

KFSN-TV (ABC30) is the Disney/ABC Owned TV station in Fresno, California. Our main newsroom is located in Downtown Fresno. Our website, ABC30.com, is the number one news website in Central California, complementing the legacy of excellence established by Action News, which is consistently the highest-rated local newscast in the region!


The internship program is designed to provide you with an educational experience that complements your academic studies and an opportunity to participate in developmental programming and contribute to daily operations of a major market television station. As part of our team at ABC30, you will rotate through our various departments and get an exciting look at how everyone works together in our newsroom!


The approximate dates of this internship are January 2027 through early June 2027.


What You Will Do

  • Assist the assignment desk, answer phones, conduct beat checks, and transcribe news interviews
  • Research news topics (including online/social media news research)
  • Assist in the planning of news series and promotional campaigns
  • Observe editors, reporters, writers, producers, directors, and technical crews as well as attend editorial and production meetings
  • Travel with marketing department, news reporters and field crews for stories and live remotes on occasion

 

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Major or previous coursework in Broadcast Journalism, Communications, Marketing or related field
  • Experience with Microsoft Office
  • High attention to detail and experience multitasking in a fast-paced environment

 

Preferred Qualifications  

  • Experience using social media for news gathering and/or to post content
  • Previous experience (academic or internship) in journalism (print and/or broadcast); television, news and news media production; and/or television news script writing
  • Previous coursework in producing, writing, or editing

 

Education

  • Junior or Senior year preferred

Eligibility Requirements & Internship Information

Candidates for this opportunity MUST meet all of the below requirements:

  • Be enrolled in an accredited college/university pursuing a degree taking at least one class at time of application posting OR currently participating in a Disney College Program or Disney Internship​
  • Be at least 18 years of age​
  • Possess unrestricted work authorization​
  • Have not completed one year of continual employment on a Disney internship or Disney College Program

 

Additional Information

  • Able to have a consistent, reliable work schedule throughout the internship
  • The approximate dates of this internship are January 2027 through early June 2027
  • Fully available to work 20 hours per week during a Monday through Sunday schedule (hours and days to be determined by your supervisor and could include nights and/or weekends)
  • Able to provide own housing for the duration of the internship program​ in the Fresno, California area
  • Able to provide/have reliable transportation to/from work​


The pay rate for this role in California is $17.75 per hour. Select benefits may be provided as part of the compensation package, such as medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. To learn more about our benefits visit: https://jobs.disneycareers.com/benefits.

job.description:
The Media Planning Team at ESPN develops innovative media plans that drive awareness, consumption, subscriptions, and brand affinity across all properties and platforms to affect the ESPN business.  

  

The Media Planning Manager will focus on planning the holistic media strategy for key properties and DTC products across owned and paid media. The Manager will be responsible for understanding the various marketing challenges that our business faces and thinking creatively and strategically about how owned and paid media can be used to drive results. This position will report to the Associate Director, Media Planning & Buying. This position is based in New York, New York.

  • Lead media plan development and execution of media campaigns across multiple sports and digital products 
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams and frequently play a consultative role – by offering media insights to inform strategy, best practices, targeting recommendations, optimization suggestions and recaps where necessary 
  • Manage day-to-day work and timely communication with internal and external teams while also providing direction, feedback and input to team on documents  
  • Champion new and innovative approaches, fostering a culture of continuous learning 
  • Provide feedback and guide junior team members to inspire their growth and development

  • Understanding of all media channels and experience coordinating across multiple media disciplines with a heavy focus on TV/CTV/Social/Digital for full funnel marketing plans

job.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

FOX is seeking a Senior Staff Orchestration Engineer to serve as a senior individual contributor driving the architecture and delivery of advanced enterprise orchestration and AI-first technical solutions. This role sits at the intersection of software engineering, artificial intelligence, enterprise architecture, and business operations, solving complex, cross-functional problems by building the intelligent orchestration layer that connects systems, data, AI capabilities, and people across FOX.

As a Senior Staff Orchestration Engineer, you will operate beyond individual workflow implementation to define technical direction, establish architectural patterns, and solve some of the organization’s most ambiguous and technically challenging automation problems. You will design solutions that combine enterprise APIs, event-driven architectures, orchestration platforms, custom software, and emerging AI capabilities—including large language models and agentic workflows—to fundamentally rethink how work gets done.

You will act as a hands-on technical leader and forward-deployed engineer, working directly with business and technology leaders to understand complex operational challenges, rapidly prototype solutions, and translate successful concepts into secure, resilient, reusable enterprise capabilities. You will influence engineering practices and architecture across teams while remaining deeply involved in design, coding, integration, and delivery.

Your work will help evolve FOX from manual and ticket-driven processes toward an AI-first, automation-first operating model in which intelligent systems can coordinate work across applications, automate complex decisions and actions, and enable employees to accomplish more through self-service experiences.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role for an engineer who thrives on ambiguity, moves fluidly between architecture and implementation, and can turn emerging technologies into practical enterprise solutions with measurable business impact.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Architect and deliver sophisticated, end-to-end orchestration solutions spanning enterprise applications, APIs, data, events, automation platforms, and AI services
  • Define the technical architecture and engineering patterns for enterprise orchestration, establishing reusable approaches that enable solutions to scale beyond individual workflows or business units
  • Design and build AI-first workflows and agentic solutions that combine large language models, enterprise data, APIs, tools, and deterministic business logic to automate complex knowledge and operational work
  • Evaluate where AI, traditional software engineering, workflow orchestration, RPA, or a combination of approaches provides the most effective solution to a business problem
  • Serve as a hands-on, forward-deployed technical leader, partnering directly with stakeholders to decompose ambiguous business challenges and rapidly design, prototype, and productionize solutions
  • Build robust integrations across collaboration, HR, finance, procurement, project management, content, data, and other enterprise platforms using APIs, webhooks, events, and custom services
  • Develop custom services, integration components, and orchestration logic using technologies such as Python, JavaScript, or Node.js when platform capabilities alone are insufficient
  • Design AI solutions with appropriate grounding, tool use, context management, evaluation, observability, and human-in-the-loop controls for enterprise environments
  • Transform manual, ticket-driven, and multi-system processes into intelligent, event-driven and self-service experiences that materially reduce cycle time and operational friction
  • Establish technical standards for orchestration architecture, integration design, reliability, observability, testing, versioning, deployment, and lifecycle management
  • Design reusable frameworks, connectors, abstractions, templates, and reference architectures that accelerate automation and AI solution development across FOX
  • Identify architectural bottlenecks and systemic opportunities where shared orchestration capabilities can eliminate duplicated engineering effort across teams
  • Rapidly prototype emerging AI and automation technologies, determine their enterprise applicability, and translate promising concepts into production-grade solutions
  • Partner with security, privacy, enterprise architecture, infrastructure, and application teams to ensure solutions meet FOX requirements for security, governance, resilience, and scalability
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers and power users, raising engineering quality and enabling teams to build safely on shared orchestration capabilities
  • Influence technology strategy and architectural decisions across organizational boundaries through technical expertise, prototypes, reference implementations, and demonstrated business outcomes

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Typically, 8+ years experience designing and delivering complex enterprise software, integration, automation, or orchestration solutions at scale
  • Demonstrated ability to operate as a senior technical individual contributor, owning architecture and technical direction for complex initiatives spanning multiple systems, teams, and business domains
  • Deep expertise in API-driven system integration, including REST APIs, webhooks, event-driven patterns, authentication and authorization, JSON payloads, error handling, resiliency, and distributed system considerations
  • Strong software engineering skills in Python, TypeScript, Node.js, or comparable technologies, with the ability to move comfortably between architectural design and hands-on implementation
  • Experience architecting solutions using workflow orchestration, integration, automation, or low-code/no-code platforms while understanding when custom engineering is required
  • Hands-on experience applying AI technologies to real-world technical or business problems, including integrating large language models or AI services into applications and workflows
  • Strong understanding of modern AI application patterns such as retrieval and grounding, tool/API invocation, structured outputs, workflow-based agents, evaluation, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop design
  • Experience designing production systems with appropriate security, observability, reliability, testing, versioning, deployment, and operational controls
  • Ability to decompose highly ambiguous, cross-functional business problems into clear technical architectures and pragmatic implementation strategies
  • Demonstrated success rapidly prototyping complex solutions and evolving them into maintainable, scalable production capabilities
  • Strong architectural judgment and the ability to make thoughtful tradeoffs across speed, complexity, extensibility, reliability, security, and business value
  • Experience influencing engineering practices and technical decisions across teams without relying on direct reporting authority
  • Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to engineers, architects, business stakeholders, and senior leaders
  • Strong systems thinking and a track record of identifying reusable platform capabilities rather than solving each automation problem independently
  • A builder mindset with curiosity about emerging technologies and the judgment to distinguish meaningful enterprise capabilities from technology trends
  • Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace a minimum of 3 days per week is an essential function of the position. Selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.

NICE TO HAVE, BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Experience designing or deploying agentic AI systems that coordinate models, tools, APIs, enterprise data, and human approvals
  • Experience with enterprise AI platforms, LLM APIs, retrieval-augmented generation, vector search, model evaluation, or AI observability technologies
  • Experience establishing enterprise automation, AI, or orchestration architecture standards and governance frameworks
  • Familiarity with major enterprise systems across HR, finance, procurement, collaboration, identity, IT service management, or project management
  • Experience with event-driven architectures, message queues, serverless computing, cloud-native services, or integration-platform architecture
  • Familiarity with RPA and browser-based automation for systems where APIs are unavailable or insufficient
  • Experience building internal developer platforms, reusable integration frameworks, or shared automation capabilities used by multiple engineering teams
  • Experience enabling technical and non-technical power users while establishing appropriate platform guardrails and governance
  • Background in enterprise transformation, process modernization, or large-scale operational automation

Req - 46420

 

Overview and Responsibilities

 

Paramount Streaming is a division of Paramount that encompasses both free, paid, and premium streaming services including Paramount+ and Pluto TV.

We are the Global Content and Lifecycle Analytics team, part of the Paramount Streaming, Data & Insights Group (DIG) team.

DIG is a key connector among the Paramount Streaming verticals. The group includes experts who create and improve data systems and products. They evaluate, combine, and analyze data. They develop insights and stories from both qualitative and quantitative data. Their work helps stakeholders make decisions. It also helps them understand performance and receive business recommendations.

 

Role Details

 

In this important role, you will develop and maintain scalable data pipelines. You will build reliable core business reasoning. You will ensure high data quality standards for content metadata. This includes titles, rights, taxonomy, and catalog data that support Paramount's streaming business.

You will work closely with analysts, data engineers, content operations, programming, licensing, and product teams. Your goal is to convert basic metadata feeds and content data into reliable datasets, dashboards, and insights. These will support decision-making for Paramount+, Pluto TV, and other Paramount streaming services.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of engineering and analytics and wants to drive data excellence at scale. This role has people management responsibilities.

 

Responsibilities

 

Pipeline Ownership: Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines. These pipelines will manage content metadata like titles, rights and licensing windows, genres, talent, franchise or series hierarchies, and availability. You will work with data engineering and analytics teams. Content Metadata Modeling: Develop and improve reliable data models. These models will unify content metadata from different sources. This includes ingest, catalog management, licensing, and rights management systems. They will support detailed reporting. This reporting will be at the title, franchise, and window levels.

Data Quality: Collaborate with software and data engineering teams. Make sure the metadata is complete, precise, and consistent. This involves identifying issues such as duplicate titles, missing or conflicting rights windows, incorrect genre or talent tagging, and misclassified territories.

Performance Monitoring: Contribute to anomaly detection systems and operational dashboards that track content catalog health, metadata completeness, and data quality KPIs. Collaboration across functions is important. You will work closely with analysts. Collaborate with content operations, programming teams, licensing, and product managers. You will translate business needs into technical data solutions. Tooling & Enablement: Build scalable, performant datasets in platforms such as Databricks, Looker, and Snowflake to enable self-service analytics for content stakeholders. Documentation & Standards: Lead the creation and maintenance of clear technical documents. Set coding standards and practices for data governance. Focus on metadata taxonomy standards and ensure compliance with content rights.

 

Basic Qualifications

 

Bachelor’s degree in economics, Statistics, Analytics, Computer Science, MIS, Data Engineering, or related field. 7+ years of experience in analytical engineering, data engineering, or data analytics with solid SQL and data modeling expertise.

Deep knowledge of ETL/ELT principles, data architecture, and performance optimization. Proven experience building scalable data products and pipelines using tools such as Databricks, Airflow, Spark, or similar platforms. You should have direct experience with modeling and maintaining content metadata pipelines. This includes working with title catalogs, rights and windowing data. You should also be acquainted with genre and talent taxonomies, or similar structured data in entertainment or media. Proficient ability to collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders to deliver high-impact data solutions.

Fluency in building and maintaining production-grade datasets in cloud-based data environments (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery). Proficiency with BI tools such as Looker and Tableau, including building curated data layers and performance tuning. Solid data hygiene practices, including version control, code reviews, unit testing, and documentation. Exemplary problem-solving skills and attention to detail, especially when reconciling metadata inconsistencies across systems.

 

Additional Qualifications

 

Experience working with content rights and licensing data, including availability windows, territory restrictions, and content lifecycle management. Knowledge with content taxonomy and classification systems used in entertainment or media. Proficiency in Python or another scripting language for data transformation or orchestration.

Knowledge with streaming media or direct-to-consumer digital products.

Experience implementing anomaly detection systems or contributing to root cause investigations for metadata issues. Knowledge of data governance and compliance best practices as they relate to licensed content.

CBS Sports is expanding its Golazo soccer social media team and is looking for a football-obsessed content producer who lives and breathes the sport. The ideal candidate loves working behind-the-scenes and has a deep understanding of the global football landscape—from the UEFA Champions League to the men’s and women’s domestic leagues across Europe, the U.S. and beyond.
You must be a football fan and have a strong grasp of best practices across Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, and Twitter/X—as demonstrated by your portfolio of work.
