●    Partner with Legal, Privacy, and regional stakeholders to ensure international merchandising experiences meet regulatory and compliance requirements.

job.description:

Sr. Manager Analytics Engineer, Content Data

 

46421

 

Overview and Responsibilities:

 

Paramount Streaming is a division of Paramount that encompasses both free, paid, and premium streaming services including Paramount+ and Pluto TV.

We are the Global Content and Lifecycle Analytics team, part of the Paramount Streaming, Data & Insights Group (DIG) team. DIG is a key connector among the Paramount Streaming verticals. The group has subject matter experts. They prototype, build, and scale data infrastructure and products. They assess, aggregate, and analyze data. They also create qualitative and quantitative narratives and insights. This work helps stakeholders make decisions, understand performance, and get business recommendations.

 

Role Details

 

In this role you will develop and maintain scalable data pipelines. You will also build reliable core business reasoning. Additionally, you will ensure high data quality standards for content metadata. This includes titles, rights, taxonomy, and catalog data that support Paramount's streaming business.

You will work closely with analysts, data engineers, content operations, programming, licensing, and product teams. Your goal is to turn raw metadata feeds and content telemetry into consistent datasets, dashboards, and insights. These resources will support decision-making for Paramount+, Pluto TV, and Paramount's larger streaming portfolio. This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of engineering and analytics and wants to drive data excellence at scale. This role has people management responsibilities.

 

Responsibilities

Pipeline Ownership: Design, build, and maintain robust data pipelines. These pipelines will oversee content metadata, including titles, rights, licensing windows, genres, talent, franchise or series hierarchies, and availability. You will work closely with data engineering and analytics teams. Content Metadata Modeling: Develop and refine reliable data models. These models will unify content metadata from different sources. This includes ingest, catalog management, licensing, and rights management systems. This will help with precise reporting at the title, franchise, and window levels.

Data Quality: Work with software and data engineering teams. Ensure that metadata is complete and reliable. This includes catching issues such as duplicate titles, missing or conflicting rights windows, incorrect genre or talent tagging, and misclassified territories.

Performance Monitoring: Contribute to anomaly detection systems and operational dashboards that track content catalog health, metadata completeness, and data quality KPIs. Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with analysts. Collaborate on projects. Share insights. Collaborate with the content operations team. Work with programming teams, licensing, and product managers. Your goal is to turn business needs into technical data solutions.

Tooling & Enablement: Build scalable, performant datasets in platforms such as Databricks, Looker, and Snowflake to enable self-service analytics for content stakeholders. Documentation and Standards: We support creating and maintaining clear technical documents. Set coding standards and data governance practices. Focus on metadata taxonomy standards and ensure content rights compliance.

 

 

Basic Qualifications

 

Bachelor’s degree in economics, Statistics, Analytics, Computer Science, MIS, Data Engineering, or related field.

 7+ years of experience in analytical engineering, data engineering, or data analytics with solid SQL and data modeling expertise.

Deep knowledge of ETL/ELT principles, data architecture, and performance optimization. Proven experience building scalable data products and pipelines using tools such as Databricks, Airflow, Spark, or similar platforms. You should have direct experience in modeling and maintaining content metadata pipelines. This involves managing title catalogs, rights data, windowing data, and genre or talent taxonomies. Experience with similar structured data in entertainment or media is also acceptable. Solid ability to collaborate with both technical and non-technical stakeholders to deliver high-impact data solutions. Fluency in building and maintaining production-grade datasets in cloud-based data environments (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, Big Query). Proficiency with BI tools such as Looker and Tableau, including building curated data layers and performance tuning. Proficient data hygiene practices, including version control, code reviews, unit testing, and documentation. Exemplary problem-solving skills and attention to detail, especially when reconciling metadata inconsistencies across systems.

 

Additional Qualifications

 

Experience working with content rights and licensing data, including availability windows, territory restrictions, and content lifecycle management.

Knowledge with content taxonomy and classification systems used in entertainment or media. Proficiency in Python or another scripting language for data transformation or orchestration.

Knowledge with streaming media or direct-to-consumer digital products. Experience implementing anomaly detection systems or contributing to root cause investigations for metadata issues. Knowledge of data governance and compliance best practices as they relate to licensed content

Job Title

Senior Marketing Manager, Style

Job Description

I. Job Summary:

About the Position | Major goals and objectives and location requirements

People Inc. is seeking a Senior Marketing Manager to join the Beauty & Style vertical, contributing to the growth of brands including InStyle, Byrdie, PEOPLE, Entertainment Weekly, and more.

In close partnership with the Style Marketing team, this role will manage day-to-day proposal development, partner closely with Sales and cross-functional teams, and play an integral role in supporting advertising revenue growth across Beauty and Style. The role will primarily support Style Marketing.

This marketer will report to the VP of Style, Marketing and work to ensure alignment across shared priorities, workload allocation, and revenue-driving initiatives.

As a key contributor to the pitch process, this role understands advertiser business goals, applies audience insights to business challenges, and recommends the most effective People Inc. product solutions to help achieve client objectives. This role also supports the development of brand-led opportunities and plays a proactive role in monetizing key initiatives with advertising partners.

Hybrid 3x a week- (NYC, NY) 
This position is hybrid in-office in New York City, with the ability to work remotely for up to 2 days per week. 

About the Team | The Team and/or Brand

The Beauty & Style Marketing team develops advertising narratives, client-facing materials, and revenue-driving opportunities across People Inc.’s beauty and style portfolio. Working closely with Sales, Account Strategy, Research, Design, Production, and Editorial, the team creates strategic proposals and market-facing materials that connect advertiser goals with People Inc.’s brands, audiences, and ad solutions.

II. About the Position’s Contributions:

Weight % Accountabilities, Actions and Expected Measurable Results

35%

Proposal Development and Sales Enablement: Lead the development of strategic, insight-driven proposals and pitch decks for advertising partners across the Beauty & Style portfolio. Partner closely with Sales, Research, Account Strategy, and Design to ensure proposals are delivered on time and clearly communicate People Inc.’s value proposition. Translate advertiser objectives into compelling recommendations that align brand strengths, audience insights, and product solutions.

20%

Ensure materials are polished, client-relevant, and aligned with marketplace needs and campaign objectives.

15%

Cross-Functional Partnership: Develop strong relationships with Sales, Account Strategy, Research, Design, Production, and Editorial teams. Support internal and client-facing conversations as needed, align stakeholders throughout the pitch process, and help ensure recommended programs are executable and strategically sound.

15%

Support the rollout of new brand-driven opportunities, tentpoles, franchises, and cross-portfolio initiatives to Sales and Marketing teams.

10%

Data and Insight Application: Use audience insights, category knowledge, marketplace intelligence, and past campaign performance to inform partnership strategies and strengthen sales recommendations. Apply data thoughtfully to support persuasive business storytelling.

5%

Partner with internal teams to identify new ways to monetize brand initiatives and equip sales teams with relevant materials for market activation.

100%

  • Ability to use audience insights and campaign performance data to inform strategic recommendations

  • Strong collaboration skills and comfort working across Sales, Research, Account Strategy, Design, Production, and Editorial teams

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

job.title: Director - Accounting
job.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists, tastemakers and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is a creator-first platform helping artists build and grow their careers by providing them with the most advanced tools, services, and resources. With over 4x the music catalog of every other major streaming platform, spanning 40+ million artists across 190+ countries, SoundCloud is where emerging artists find their sound, hidden gems are discovered, and music culture is shaped in real time.

SoundCloud is looking for a Director of Accounting, someone with a passion for numbers, to join our great finance team. Joining our Accounting & Tax department in Berlin, you will serve as the senior accounting leader locally  and directly to the VP Group Controller. As an ambitious and driven team member, you bring enthusiasm to make a significant impact across multiple areas. You will hold genuine accountability from day one, with the autonomy to elevate our financial group reporting standard.

You will take full ownership of group consolidation, IFRS financial reporting, German local statutory reporting (HGB), intercompany accounts, and technical accounting positions. Additionally, you will guide the annual audit process and direct the local accounting team and serve as a counterpart to the Berlin-Based Tax Team.

This position combines strategic enhancement with core stewardship. While financial consolidation currently relies on Oracle Fusion and spreadsheets, you will lead the selection and roll-out of a dedicated platform. You will collaborate closely with key stakeholders across US accounting leadership, Treasury, Tax, and external partners.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Prepare consolidated IFRS financial statements and related Notes
  • Manage monthly consolidated reporting packages
  • Oversee German HGB statutory financial filings and directing local audits
  • Drive end-to-end management, reconciliation, and settlement of intercompany activity across all subsidiaries
  • Evaluate complex technical accounting developments under IFRS, drafting technical memorandums, and offering guidance across business functions
  • Serve as primary liaison for external auditors during annual group audits, ensuring high-quality audit deliverables and prompt issue resolution
  • Mentor and expand the local Berlin accounting team, overseeing AP, procurement operations and reconciliation of VAT/Sales Tax accounts in cooperation with the Tax Team
  • Lead the evaluation and implementation of a new software solution for group financial consolidation
  • Partner closely with US finance leadership to align accounting policies and improve group-wide close efficiency

Experience and Background:

  • 8+ years of relevant experience within top-tier audit firms or corporate group accounting environments
  • Fully certified professional credentials (such as CPA, Steuerberater, Wirtschaftsprüfer, ACCA, or an equivalent designation)
  • Practical, hands-on background in IFRS multi-entity consolidation, with demonstrated experience preparing or auditing full consolidated statements and disclosures across foreign currencies
  • Solid understanding of German HGB statutory framework, local compliance, and tax audit procedures
  • Proven supervisory leadership, managing and nurturing the professional development of accounting personnel
  • Fluency in written and spoken English and German, paired with strong, constructive interpersonal skills
  • Advanced capabilities in Excel and familiarity navigating modern systems across ERP, financial close, and procurement technologies
  • Exceptional problem-solving abilities, high self-motivation, and a collaborative mindset
  • Thriving in a dynamic, high-growth environment focused on high performance and tangible impact
  • Prior involvement in implementing financial consolidation platforms is a plus
  • Familiarity with Oracle Fusion tools is preferred
  • Background in tech, digital media, music, or subscription businesses, including specialized royalty and intellectual property accounting, is desirable

About us:

  • We are a multinational company with offices in the US (New York and Los Angeles), Germany (Berlin), and the UK (London)
  • We provide a flexible work culture that offers the opportunity to collaborate and connect in person at our offices as well as accommodating work from home
  • We are deeply committed to ensuring diversity, equity and inclusion at all levels of our organization and fostering a community where everyone’s voice, perspective and experience is respected and heard
  • We believe a strong team is made by investing in employees through mentorship, workshops and enrichment opportunities

Benefits:

  • Not located in Berlin? No worries, we offer extensive relocation support including allowances, one way flights, temporary accommodation and, by partnering with Startcon, on the ground support on arrival
  • Interested in a gym membership, photography course or book? We have a Creativity and Wellness benefit!
  • Employee Equity Plan
  • Generous professional development allowance
  • Flexible vacation and public holiday policy where you can take up to 35 days of PTO annually
  • We offer free German courses at beginning, intermediate and advanced
  • Various snacks, goodies, and 2 free lunches weekly when at the office

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at SoundCloud

SoundCloud is for everyone. Diversity and open expression are fundamental to our organization; they help us lead what’s next in music by understanding and empowering our creators and fans, no matter their identity. We acknowledge the challenges in the music industry, and strive to influence an inclusive culture where everyone can contribute respectfully and thrive, especially the historically marginalized communities that many of our creators, fans and SoundClouders identify with. We are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment at SoundCloud for everyone, regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, migration background, national origin, age, disability status, or care-giver status.

At SoundCloud you can find your community or elevate your allyship by joining a Diversity Resource Group. Diversity Resource Groups are employee-organized groups focused on supporting and promoting the interests of a particular underrepresented community in order to build a more inclusive culture at SoundCloud. Anyone can join, whether you share the identity or strive to be an ally.

You will take technical ownership of the tools that help artists understand their audiences, grow their careers, and help the music industry discover its next stars. You will work within a high-performing, multi-disciplinary squad across our frontend (React, iOS, and Android) and backend (GraphQL, TypeScript) services, focused on strategic Artist Success products including the A&R Dashboard, Fan Insights, and artist-facing growth and insights experiences. This is an IC-heavy role for a technical expert who wants to drive architecture and execution while maintaining a hands-on presence in the code.

The ideal candidate has a track record of building and evolving complex, high-quality products across frontend, API, backend, and data systems. You are a generalist who can navigate user-facing application logic, service architecture, data-intensive systems, or infrastructure bottlenecks with equal ease.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Work closely with engineers, Product Managers, Designers, and other partners to shape the technical direction and roadmap across Artist Success products, including the A&R Dashboard, Fan Insights, and related artist-facing experiences. You'll help the team make thoughtful architectural decisions and build scalable, secure systems that support large datasets and high-performance user experiences
  • Act as a senior technical contributor for a small, expert squad. You will contribute through architectural clarity, rigorous peer reviews, and a focus on maintaining high execution momentum
  • Work as a peer to Product Managers and Designers to define requirements across Artist Success. You'll turn vague business "wants" into concrete technical "hows," ensuring the team builds the right things in the most efficient way
  • Ensure high technical standards across frontend and backend disciplines. While the team is highly capable, you are responsible for contributing to the overall technical health, consistency, and long-term sustainability of the codebase
  • Own the infrastructure and health of your domain. You'll manage deployment patterns, infrastructure as code using Terraform, and ensure we adhere to modern security standards
  • Leverage agentic workflows and AI-assisted engineering as a force multiplier while keeping the needs, judgment, and experience of the people using and building our products at the center of the work

Experience and Background:

  • 4-6+ years of experience with React and modern frontend development, with the ability to influence architectural decisions and drive best practices; experience with native iOS or Android applications is a plus
  • Strong proficiency in GraphQL and TypeScript for building reliable APIs and services, with familiarity in Golang or Scala, and a strong understanding of storage, querying, and data-intensive systems such as BigQuery and SQL
  • Strong capability in Infrastructure as Code, particularly Terraform, and container orchestration
  • Ability to explain complex technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate effectively across engineering, product, design, and data
  • Demonstrated ability to leverage modern AI and agentic tools to improve quality and velocity, while applying sound judgment around when human expertise is essential and maintaining code quality, product standards, maintainability, and user experience

The salary range for this role is $160,000 - $190,000 annually. The final salary offered will be determined based on relative experience, skills, internal equity, and location. We also offer a generous total rewards program - read more about additional benefits and perks below! 

About us:

  • We are a multinational company with offices in the US (New York and Los Angeles), Germany (Berlin), and the UK (London)
  • We provide a flexible work culture that offers the opportunity to collaborate and connect in person at our offices as well as accommodating work from home
  • We are deeply committed to ensuring diversity, equity and inclusion at all levels of our organization and fostering a community where everyone’s voice, perspective and experience is respected and heard
  • We believe a strong team is made by investing in employees through mentorship, workshops and enrichment opportunities

  • Robust 401k program

  • Interested in a gym membership, photography course or book? We have a Creativity and Wellness benefit!

  • 16 paid weeks for all parents (birthing and non-birthing), regardless of gender, to welcome newborns, adopted and foster children

Digital Sales Manager

*This is a full-time, in-office opportunity. *

 

Why Townsquare Media Group & Townsquare Ignite:

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets, including trusted Tuscaloosa Stations..

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

Founded in 2010, Townsquare Ignite is the fastest-growing revenue and profit driver of Townsquare Media, offering a powerful suite of digital solutions that includes owned and operated digital properties, a proprietary programmatic advertising platform, and an in-house demand and data management platform powered by first-party data. Our all-in-one 360° advertising technology and DSP-agnostic trade desk provide access to all major ad exchanges and more than 250 billion impressions per day. Campaigns run across desktop, mobile, apps, connected TV, search, and social—supported by advanced targeting, white-glove service, and a full-service in-house creative team—giving sellers the tools, scale, and support to win and grow digital business.

 

The Digital Sales Manager Opportunity:

Do you love helping businesses grow through modern, results-driven marketing? Are you a sales leader who thrives in digital and knows how to elevate teams through strategy, coaching, and execution? This is a rare opportunity to lead a local market as a Digital Sales Manager, owning digital revenue growth while also leading and supporting broadcast sales performance.

 

At Townsquare, we are redefining local media by combining the power of trusted radio brands with industry-leading digital marketing solutions. We’re looking for a hands-on leader with deep digital sales expertise to accelerate growth across Townsquare Ignite and Amped (digital on our owned and operated properties), while maintaining strong broadcast fundamentals.

 

The Digital Sales Manager serves as the senior revenue leader for the market, responsible for driving total market performance with a digital-first mindset. This role blends digital strategy, team leadership, and client-facing sales execution. You will act as the market’s digital authority—guiding sellers, partnering with clients, and leading complex, integrated deals—while also overseeing broadcast sales activity.

 

Responsibilities:

Digital & Revenue Leadership

  • Own and drive digital revenue growth for the market, with a strong emphasis on Townsquare Ignite and Amped solutions
  • Develop and execute a digital-forward sales strategy that aligns broadcast and digital into integrated, results-based programs
  • Set, track, and hold the team accountable to digital and total revenue goals, pipeline activity, and KPIs
  • Lead by example in selling complex digital and integrated campaigns, assisting Account Executives with high-impact opportunities
  • Drive new business development while expanding and retaining key accounts

Digital Strategy & Expertise

  • Serve as the digital subject matter expert for the market
  • Lead adoption and mastery of full-funnel digital solutions including Programmatic, Search, Social, Video, OTT/CTV, and Owned & Operated digital
  • Analyze campaign performance and reporting to guide optimization, renewals, and incremental revenue growth
  • Translate performance data into clear, compelling insights for clients and sellers

Team Leadership & Development

  • Recruit, retain, and develop top-performing sales talent
  • Coach and train new and existing Account Executives on consultative selling, digital strategy, and solution-based presentations
  • Maintain a strong in-field presence, participating in client and prospect meetings alongside sellers
  • Set and enforce daily, weekly, and monthly activity, pipeline, and performance standards

Market & Community Leadership

You don’t need to come from radio. Your experience may be in a digital newsroom, social or video team, local media company, creator-led organization, or another digital-first environment. Part-Time Sales Associate

Seize the Deal | Townsquare Media

 

The Opportunity:

Townsquare Media Tuscaloosa is seeking a driven and detail-oriented Part-Time Seize the Deal Sales Associate  to own and grow our local deal advertising program. In this role, you will be the dedicated engine behind our Seize the Deal platform — connecting local businesses with our audience through compelling offers, and helping advertisers maximize their return on investment. This is a fantastic opportunity for a self-starter with a passion for local media, sales, and community engagement.

 

Why Townsquare Media Group?

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Tuscaloosa stations.

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

Our Seize the Deal program is a cornerstone of our local advertising offerings, connecting consumers with exclusive deals from businesses across dining, retail, services, and entertainment. We take pride in building meaningful relationships with local advertisers and delivering measurable results.

 

What You’ll Do:

As a Part-Time Sales Associate, you will:

  • Prospect, pitch, and close new Seize the Deal advertising partnerships (including Dining Deals, Deal of the Week and our Auctions) with local and regional businesses
  • Manage the full sales cycle from initial outreach through contract execution and campaign launch
  • Coordinate with clients to develop compelling deal offers that drive consumer engagement and merchant results
  • Monitor campaign performance and provide advertisers with clear, actionable reporting and renewal conversations
  • Maintain an organized pipeline of prospects, active campaigns, and renewal opportunities
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for Seize the Deal advertisers, delivering outstanding client service
  • Identify opportunities to upsell and cross-sell additional Townsquare Media advertising solutions

 

What You’ll Be Selling:

Seize the Deal

Discounted promotional offers that create urgency and drive immediate revenue for local businesses — promoted across our radio, digital, email, and social channels.

 

What You’ll Bring to Thrive Here:

  • 1–3 years of experience in sales, advertising, or marketing — local media or digital advertising experience is a plus
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to build lasting client relationships
  • Self-motivated and results-driven with excellent time management and organizational abilities
  • Comfortable working independently with minimal oversight while meeting revenue targets
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and comfort learning CRM and digital platforms
  • Knowledge of the Tri-State business community is highly desirable
  • Experience with deal or voucher platforms, QR codes, or digital advertising programs is a plus
  • Valid driver's license, auto insurance, and vehicle (required)

What’s In It for You?

We know your time is valuable—so when you choose to bring your experience to Townsquare, we make it count. As a Part-Time Account Executive, you’ll enjoy:

  • Competitive Commission Plan tied to performance
  • Flexible schedule with a supportive, collaborative team environment
  • Access to Townsquare Media's established audience across radio, digital, and event platforms
  • Company-provided sales tools, including laptop and CRM access
  • Professional training and mentorship from a national network of Seize the Deal markets
  • Make an impact in your community by helping local businesses thrive
  • Opportunity for growth within Townsquare Media's Tuscaloosa operation

 

Ready to Build Something?

If you’re energized by the idea of controlling your income, helping local businesses grow, and representing a respected media brand in your community, we want to talk.

Apply today and tell us why you’re a natural revenue generator.

*This position requires you to work in-office and on-site as needed. * 

 

Launch Your Career in Local Media:

Are you looking to get your foot in the door of the media industry and gain real, hands-on experience? At Townsquare Media Group, we’re seeking a dependable, team-oriented Part-Time Board Operator who’s eager to learn, grow, and support our on-air, digital, and event operations.

This is an entry-level, part-time role ideal for someone with a flexible schedule who enjoys variety, fast-paced environments, and being part of live broadcasts and community events. You’ll work behind the scenes in the studio, out in the community as a brand ambassador, and alongside multiple departments as you build foundational media experience.

 

Why Townsquare Media?

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including trusted Tri-Cities – Richland/Kennewick/Pasco stations.

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

 

What You’ll Do:

As a Part-Time Board Operator, you’ll support daily broadcast operations and live events while helping protect the quality and integrity of our stations. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Operating control boards for in-studio and remote programming
  • Regulating program timing, playing commercials, and running syndicated content
  • Monitoring the technical quality and accuracy of incoming and outgoing on-air programming
  • Protecting the station’s license by following FCC guidelines and censoring prohibited content when necessary
  • Processing time-out programming to ensure accurate playback
  • Identifying and reporting technical issues to Engineering to maintain broadcast quality
  • Screening incoming phone calls and selecting callers for on-air talent and talk shows
  • Handling emergency inserts such as breaking news, alerts, and system tests
  • Assisting with basic administrative and operational tasks as needed
  • Representing the station at on-site promotions, live remotes, and community events
  • Setting up, operating, and breaking down audio and promotional equipment
  • Recording live events through photos, video, audio, and social content for station promotions
  • Transporting and handling promotional materials and event equipment

 

What You’ll Bring:

  • Strong desire to learn, grow, and build a career in media
  • Positive attitude, reliability, and a strong work ethic
  • Ability to work independently while exercising sound judgment
  • Comfort multitasking and taking on responsibilities beyond a single job function
  • Flexibility to work days, nights, weekends, and varying shifts based on business needs
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills
  • Willingness to take ownership of tasks from start to finish
  • High School Diploma (required); college coursework or BA/BS degree (preferred)
  • Valid driver's license, auto insurance, and vehicle (required)

 

What’s In It for You?

This role offers hands-on experience and a path to growth within Townsquare:

  • Pay rate: $17.13 per hour
  • Real-world experience in radio, digital media, and live events
  • Training alongside experienced broadcast and operations professionals
  • Opportunities to build skills across multiple departments
  • A collaborative, fast-paced, and supportive team environment
  • Flexible, part-time scheduling
  • A foot-in-the-door opportunity with a leading multi-media organization

About Townsquare Media:

Travel & Transportation:

  • Maintain a valid driver's license and reliable transportation

  • Travel between sites safely and efficiently, navigating to locations without assistance

Technical Operations:

  • Manage activities for a goal of 100% uptime of station on-air and streaming products
  • Inspect, repair, and maintain all broadcast radio station equipment, including transmitters, antennas, satellite downlinks, automation systems, studio equipment, remote equipment, generators, telephone systems, and related equipment
  • Install and maintain AoIP and automation systems (Zetta and Wheatstone experience preferred)
  • Maintain and troubleshoot AM directional antenna systems
  • Maintain EAS systems, logging compliance, and related equipment
  • Maintain personal computers, servers, printers, and software; perform updates as needed

  • Diagnose equipment issues and make real-time decisions to restore broadcast operations
  • Write routine reports and correspondence
  • Speak effectively with programming staff, management, and other employees to achieve operational goals
  • Interface with Senior Vice President of Engineering and Senior Vice President, Information Technology, as well as other Corporate Technical Staff to ensure current guidance and best practices are followed.

Qualifications:

  • Technical training school, or two to four years related experience and/or training, or equivalent combination of education and experience (required)
  • SBE or computer-related certification helpful but not required
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Windows (all versions), Microsoft Office, networking concepts, computer hardware, and wireless/handheld devices

  • Ability to interpret instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form

 

Work Schedule:

This position serves as the sole technical authority for market-level engineering operations and is responsible for the planning, analysis, and independent decision-making that governs broadcast continuity, FCC compliance, and infrastructure strategy across all assigned stations.   • Ability and willingness to serve as Chief Operator under FCC rules, with independent authority to ensure station compliance with all applicable technical regulations
  • Conduct root cause analysis of equipment failures and develop technical solutions to prevent recurrence
  • Evaluate and optimize broadcast transmission infrastructure and technical systems to ensure operational continuity and regulatory compliance
  • Develop technical operating standards for market engineering operations

  • Information Technology, and other Corporate Technical Staff to ensure current guidance and best practices are followed

Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated ability to exercise independent technical judgment in high-pressure, time-sensitive environments

job.title: Director, Sales and Marketing
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales and marketing solutions team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 

Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 

 

Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

o Help Us Thrive: You'll be at the forefront of our efforts to amplify our sales and marketing strategy. Your main mission will be to amplify our market presence while ensuring we hit our ambitious sales targets. Your success is our success, and we believe in celebrating wins!

 

o Results-Driven: Amplify our media sales efforts by leading the sales team to implement local sales and marketing strategies to attract, grow and retain business, showcase opportunities and deliver results across our multi-media content platforms and digital assets.

 

o Strategic Planning: You'll develop and implement innovative sales and marketing strategies that will amplify our sales performance. You'll be the mastermind behind tactics that not only meet but exceed our sales goals.

 

o Team Development:  Leading, mentoring, and inspiring a team of sales professionals is no small feat! Your ability to motivate and enhance their skills will be crucial in driving performance and achieving success together.

 

o Market Analysis: Dive deep into market trends, data, and customer needs. By understanding what drives our clients, you'll identify new opportunities for expansion and growth, ensuring we stay ahead of the competition.

 

o Authentic Relationships: Building strong, lasting relationships with key clients and stakeholders is crucial. You'll be the driving force behind our brand, amplifying customer satisfaction and loyalty through excellent service.

 

What We're Looking For 

o Proven Sales Ability: We're looking for someone with experience as a Sales Director or other sales management and leadership roles, ideally in a media-related industry. We value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 

 

o High-Impact: A passion for achieving sales goals, amplifying growth and a results-driven mindset will set you apart. We want someone who's excited to push boundaries in a digital first environment and make an impact.

 

o Analytical Mindset: Strong analytical skills to assess market data and trends. Your insights will help guide our sales and marketing strategies.

 

o Strong Communication Skills:  You're a natural at building relationships, negotiating and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 

 

o A Passion for Leading Others: You should be able to inspire your team, amplify their strengths while guiding them toward our collective goals, foster a collaborative environment and make a difference.

 

o A Willingness to Grow:  Do you thrive in unified environments? The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.

 

The Practical Stuff 

o A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 

 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

o Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a bold team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.

 

o The Compensation Package: Enjoy competitive base salary with an enticing results-based bonus structure that rewards your hard work. Our people love our benefits package.

 

o We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales team isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.)

 

o Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, to provide you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.

 

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.

This executive will set the partnership and activation strategy, lead and develop the team, personally drive the organization’s most important brand, agency, league, team, talent, and rights-holder relationships, and turn AMP Sports’ podcasts, digital video, social reach, creators, original storytelling, live experiences, and Sinclair scale into distinctive programs for partners and fans. The VP will be both a builder and an operator: someone who can create the commercial vision, sell the idea, and ensure the activation delivers from concept through measurement.

What You’ll Do

  • Own AMP Sports’ sports-partnership and activation strategy, annual revenue plan, sales targets, pipeline health, forecasting, and performance accountability.
  • Build a differentiated portfolio of integrated programs across podcasts and audio, digital video, social, talent and creator partnerships, branded content, sponsorships, live events, fan experiences, and other experiential opportunities.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing partnerships and activations team; establish clear expectations, account priorities, operating rhythms, and a culture of creativity, collaboration, and accountability.
  • Serve as executive sponsor and hands-on seller for the largest opportunities, building trusted relationships with senior brand marketers, agency executives, leagues, teams, talent representatives, rights holders, and other sports-industry partners.
  • Create activation platforms around tentpole events, sports seasons, original franchises, talent, cultural moments, and audience passions that can scale across brands and distribution channels.
  • Lead the full activation lifecycle—from insight, concept, packaging, and pitch through contracting, production, launch, on-site or digital execution, measurement, renewal, and expansion.
  • Partner with content, production, marketing, social, research, ad operations, experiential, finance, legal, and corporate sales teams to ensure programs are creative, executable, brand-safe, rights-compliant, and financially sound.
  • Guide packaging, pricing, sponsorship architecture, inventory strategy, activation budgets, and commercial policies to support revenue growth, market competitiveness, and healthy margins.
  • Lead executive-level proposal development and negotiations for complex, high-value agreements, balancing client objectives, fan experience, creative ambition, talent and usage rights, operational requirements, risk, and profitability.
  • Establish clear activation governance, ownership, timelines, approval processes, and cross-functional handoffs to deliver every partner commitment at a high standard.
  • Create a measurement approach that connects audience reach and engagement with brand objectives, activation performance, client satisfaction, renewal, and account growth.
  • Identify and pursue new opportunities involving events, hospitality, commerce, licensing, creators, talent, distribution, and emerging sports or fan-engagement platforms.
  • Represent AMP Sports at client meetings, agency summits, sports and advertising conferences, live events, and other major marketplace moments.

What You’ll Bring

  • 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in sports partnerships, sponsorships, experiential marketing, branded content, sports media, integrated sales, or a related field.
  • 5+ years leading and developing sales, partnerships, sponsorship, experiential, or activation teams, with a record of setting strategy and improving performance.
  • A sustained track record of meeting or exceeding significant revenue goals and personally closing complex, high-value, multi-platform sports partnerships.
  • Demonstrated experience taking major activations from concept through execution, including management of stakeholders, budgets, timelines, talent or rights considerations, and measurement.
  • Deep relationships and executive credibility with major brands, agencies, leagues, teams, rights holders, talent organizations, and relevant sports-industry partners.
  • Strong understanding of sports audiences, fandom, live and digital experiences, branded entertainment, podcast and creator monetization, social platforms, and integrated measurement.
  • Executive-level commercial and operational judgment, including fluency in pricing, forecasting, activation budgets, deal structure, margins, and revenue operations.
  • Ability to connect business strategy, consumer insight, creative storytelling, live experiences, and platform capabilities into an actionable partnership plan.
  • Exceptional leadership, communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to influence senior internal and external stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building or scaling a sports-partnership or activation function, launching a new commercial offering, or repositioning a sports media portfolio in the market.
  • Experience working directly with sports talent, creators, leagues, teams, venues, rights holders, live events, or original sports programming.
  • Experience with seven-figure-plus partnerships, multi-year agreements, custom content production, live activations, hospitality, and complex rights or usage structures.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience; advanced degree is a plus.

How Success Will Be Measured

  • Achievement of annual revenue, profitability, pipeline coverage, and forecast-accuracy goals.
  • Growth and diversification of AMP Sports’ brand, agency, league, team, talent, and rights-holder relationships.
  • Development of distinctive, scalable sports partnerships and activation platforms.
  • On-time, on-budget, brand-safe delivery of activation commitments and strong fan engagement.
  • Performance, engagement, and development of the partnerships and activations team.
  • Partner retention, renewal, expansion, and executive-level satisfaction.
  • Effective collaboration across AMP Sports and Sinclair from concept through execution and measurement.

About AMP Sports

AMP Sports brings together sports, culture, storytelling, and fandom across podcasts, digital video, social platforms, creator-led content, and live or experiential opportunities. As part of Sinclair, AMP Sports can pair the agility and authenticity of emerging media with the reach, relationships, and resources of a diversified media company. We build ideas with brands—not simply placements—creating partnerships that feel relevant to audiences and deliver meaningful business results for advertisers.

Are you excited about the possibilities of AI and interested in helping an organization turn those possibilities into practical solutions? If so, we want to hear from you.

Sinclair is hiring a Manager, AI Enablement to help identify, understand, and clearly frame the operational problems facing our teams and the business. This highly visible role works across every business function to surface AI opportunities and regularly informs C-suite discussions.

AI Enablement owns the AI opportunity pipeline at Sinclair: capturing, evaluating, and prioritizing opportunities across the business, and deciding which become approved-for-build projects. This role helps run that pipeline day to day and translates approved-for-build opportunities to the AI Product and Delivery team. Through ongoing conversations with employees and leaders, you will uncover pain points, examine processes closely, and contribute your judgment on whether an opportunity calls for AI, process improvement, or another solution. We do not layer AI on top of broken processes.

We are looking for a thoughtful, natural connector who listens closely, recognizes patterns in what people say and do, and sees potential value before the numbers are fully developed. You do not need to be a technical AI expert. You do need to be able to walk into any part of the business with curiosity, ask great questions, earn trust quickly, and leave with a sharper picture of what is possible.

What You Will Do

Business Discovery and Relationship Building

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with employees and leaders across departments to surface opportunities and support AI adoption.
  • Engage with business teams across the organization to observe how work happens, ask questions that surface friction and inefficiency, and identify problems worth solving.
  • Understand the problem first, then examine the underlying process. Only when the process is sound should the question of AI come into play.

Pipeline, Prioritization, and Translation

  • Manage the intake path for AI-related opportunities from every source: the Champions Program, direct conversations, business partner requests, and escalations. Keep requesters informed of status and next steps.
  • Help run the AI Enablement opportunity pipeline: capture, evaluate, prioritize, and scope opportunities across Sinclair, and support the decision on which are ready to hand off as approved-for-build projects to AI Product and Delivery. 
  • Partner on business case development for opportunities as they move through the pipeline.
  • Translate approved-for-build opportunities into clear project briefs that carry the problem framing, the current state, open decisions, and the people involved, with sources for the facts so the receiving team can build with confidence.
  • Stay connected through evaluation, build, and delivery as an ongoing point of contact for the business partner. Answer questions, correct misunderstandings, maintain momentum, and keep the work anchored to the original business need.
  • Partner with AI Product and Delivery through the handoff and into build, so the problem framing, current state, and stakeholder context stay with the work as it moves to the technical partners who build it.
  • Partner with department leaders during opportunity evaluation, so technology fit, feasibility, and solution design shape an opportunity before it becomes an approved project.

AI Enablement and Adoption

  • Help run the ChatGPT Champions Program: working sessions, ongoing engagement, recognition, follow-through, and connecting champions with the resources and support they need.
  • Help employees understand practical ways AI can support their work by sharing successful use cases and supporting training, demonstrations, and other enablement activities.
  • Use AI actively in your own work and build working fluency through experimentation. You are not expected to be an expert; you are learning alongside our employees, and that shared experience is what makes you credible with them.
  • Stay current on what available AI tools can and cannot do so you can recognize relevant opportunities and provide practical guidance. Over time, use that fluency to help others prototype and improve workflows.

Reporting, Impact, and Communications

  • Analyze AI usage and engagement data, identify trends, and work with business teams to document time savings, productivity improvements, and other evidence of impact.
  • Prepare and contribute to briefings, reports, dashboards, Quarterly Business Reviews, and monthly updates that show what the AI Enablement function is finding, where value is showing up, and where the portfolio is headed.
  • Surface meaningful workflow patterns, employee stories, and progress through the Champions Dashboard and other leadership reporting.
  • Partner with Corporate Communications by providing the content, context, and examples needed to develop clear and accurate employee-facing messaging about AI initiatives.

 

What Success Looks Like in the First Six Months

  • You have built trusted relationships with champions and key business leaders across every division at Sinclair, and you are the person they call when something on their team is worth a closer look.
  • You have moved a first set of opportunities through the pipeline to approved-for-build, with clean project briefs handed off to the AI Product and Delivery team.
  • You have contributed to a Quarterly Business Review and a monthly leadership update, with material that showed the AI Enablement function's findings and where value is showing up.
  • You have built at least one AI agent or small solution to strengthen your own work, and you use AI actively enough to speak credibly with the champions you support.
  • You have supported the Champions Program's operating rhythm through multiple working sessions, and you have been the ongoing point of contact for at least one project moving through build.

 

Who You Are

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Communications, Technology, Marketing, Human Resources, or a related field.
  • Minimum of four years of professional experience within a large, complex organization.
  • Intellectual curiosity that keeps you learning, questioning, and connecting ideas.
  • Comfort with ambiguity, and a willingness to shape unclear problems rather than wait for them to clarify.
  • Track record of building trusted relationships across functions and levels, from individual contributors to senior leaders.
  • Strong writing and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain unfamiliar or complex ideas clearly.
  • Strong project-management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives and stakeholders without dropping threads.
  • Proficiency in Excel and general data literacy, including the ability to organize data, identify trends, and explain the story behind the information.
  • Understanding of how business operations translate into value. You do not need to build financial models.
  • Comfort learning new technology and developing fluency independently.

Preferred

  • Foundational familiarity with generative AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or similar tools, along with a working sense of what they can and cannot do.
  • Experience supporting a champions network, community of practice, peer adoption program, or similar engagement model.
  • Experience with technology adoption, organizational change, process improvement, or cross-functional program work.
  • Prior experience in broadcast, media, or a similarly distributed, multi-site organization.
  • Experience with opportunity discovery, intake and triage, or project pipeline management.

job.title: AI Product & Delivery Coordinator
job.description:
About The Role

Sinclair is building a practical AI Product and Delivery function that makes AI tools and solutions useful in the real world. The team owns the employee-facing AI product experience and supports the AI product strategy: listening to what employees need, developing the right signals into a focused product portfolio, and moving priority work through execution, delivery, launch, and improvement.

The AI Product and Delivery Coordinator is a hands-on product and delivery partner to the Director, AI Product. You will help run the day-to-day product experience for ChatGPT Enterprise and other AI tools, keep the backlog and roadmap well informed, and help move priority work from a real employee or business problem to a delivered and supported solution.

This is an early-career role for someone who likes turning ambiguity into momentum. You will not be expected to write code or carry out technical administration. You will be expected to walk into conversations with people across the company, ask good questions, understand what matters, and help the group leave with a clear next step. We are looking for judgment, confidence, follow-through, and the ability to be a positive business partner as much as we are looking for a conventional product background.

What You Will Do

Employee Requests And Product Support

  • Manage the day-to-day flow of employee questions, requests, access needs, change requests, and support signals for approved AI tools.

  • Talk with employees to understand the need behind a request; provide timely guidance when a question can be resolved directly and route actionable work to the right administrative, support, or delivery partner.

  • Keep requests moving and employees informed, making sure ownership, context, and next steps are clear across the teams involved.

  • Identify patterns in employee needs, recurring friction, and requests that should become a product improvement, a release consideration, or a new product opportunity.

AI Tool Releases And Employee Education

  • Help plan and coordinate the release of new features, functions, and AI tools, including the intended audience, timing, access and provisioning needs, product messaging, and learning materials.

  • Create clear, useful employee-facing guidance that explains what is new, why it matters, and how to use it responsibly and effectively.

  • Work with enablement, communications, training, and administrative partners to make releases understandable, well-supported, and ready for employees.

  • Collect early feedback and issues after a release, then turn that input into improvements, updated guidance, or follow-up product work.

Product Discovery Backlog And Roadmap

  • Help maintain the AI product backlog and portfolio, with clear opportunity records, status, owners, business context, dependencies, decisions, and expected outcomes.

  • Support discovery with business partners and employees to understand users, workflows, pain points, constraints, and the value a solution needs to create.

  • Turn problems, requests, ideas, and other signals into concise product briefs, requirements, user stories, workflow documentation, and recommended next steps.

  • Prepare the product and workflow context that helps technology partners evaluate solution options and delivery paths.

  • Support the Director in preparing roadmap recommendations and portfolio priority decisions with current business context, delivery information, and clear documentation.

Solution Delivery And Product Improvement

  • Coordinate priority product work from approved concept through build, pilot, release, and ongoing support with internal and external delivery partners.

  • Maintain delivery plans, milestones, dependencies, risks, decisions, and readiness activities; surface issues early and help keep the work moving.

  • Translate approved product direction into clear documentation and requirements for technology, administrative, implementation, and business partners.

  • Manage post-launch follow-through for selected solutions, including feedback collection, change needs, release-material updates, adoption signals, and enhancement backlog items.

  • Synthesize product usage, employee feedback, requests, and delivery learnings into clear updates and practical recommendations for the Director and cross-functional partners.

How You Work

  • Build productive working relationships with AI Technology Strategy, AI Operations and Enablement, IT, Engineering, Security, Legal, Communications, and business teams.

  • Bring the right people together at the right time, recognize when specialized review or implementation is needed, and make sure each partner has the context to move the work forward.

  • Be a thoughtful, credible representative of the AI Product team with everyone from frontline employees to executive leadership.

Who You Are

  • Two to four years of experience in product operations, product management, project or program delivery, strategy and operations, consulting, transformation, or a comparable cross-functional role.

  • A confident, clear communicator who can have a useful conversation with anyone in the organization, from a frontline employee to an executive leader.

  • Strong business acumen and the ability to quickly understand a team’s priorities, ask the right questions, and communicate a credible point of view.

  • A natural instinct for getting work done: you can turn a conversation into a plan, keep commitments visible, and follow through without damaging relationships.

  • Product instincts: you can understand users and workflows, distinguish a request from the underlying problem, write clearly, and think about adoption and success measures.

  • Strong organization and comfort managing a high volume of requests, details, handoffs, and competing priorities without losing the human side of the work.

  • A collaborative, positive working style. You know how to manage competing priorities, bring people along, and be direct without being difficult.

  • Comfort learning new technology, including generative AI tools, and applying practical judgment without needing to be the technical implementer.

  • Manage the configuration of Capital Projects. This includes setting up rules for asset generation and capitalization (CIP). You will also oversee retirement costs and Fixed Assets. This involves managing Asset Books, Categories, and Depreciation Methods.

  • Mitigate System Risks: Proactively identify and fix failure modes unique to agentic systems (e.g., tool-use loops or context window overflows).

The Merchandise Manager is responsible for owning and executing the financial targets for the RAGBRAI merchandise program. This role drives product mix, planning, and buying strategies to improve product quality, operational efficiency, and overall profitability.

The Merchandise Manager oversees the merchandise program, including management of the Shopify storefront, live events, the RAGBRAI HQ retail space product launches, and online inventory. This role works closely with Marketing and Creative teams to develop compelling merchandise assortments, coordinate product launches, and ensure brand consistency across both online and on-site retail channels.

Merchandise Planning and Financial Management

• Analyze historical sales data, leverage registration trends, and use market insights to set revenue targets and inventory strategy.

• Partner with Event Director to align financial goals by building and managing detailed merchandise budgets and forecasts.

• Manage the purchasing process from order placement through production and delivery timelines.

• Develop analytical and data-driven financial models to track sales performance and refine projections and forecasts.

• Own post-event financial recaps, including SKU-level sales analysis, margin performance, and year-over-year comparisons.

• Identify opportunities to improve inventory efficiency and reduce excess inventory.

• Maintain clean, organized financial documentation for all merchandise orders to support Accounting & Finance processes.

• Develop and manage the annual merchandise calendar, aligning product drops and campaigns with the broader marketing schedule.

Product Sourcing, Development and Buying

• Build product orders and collaborate with the Creative team to develop assortments that align with event brand identity, customer demand, and profitability targets.

• Determine product mix, pricing strategy, and inventory depth, ensuring cost and budget projections are updated as needed.

• Source products that meet desired aesthetic direction, quality standards, trends and cost targets.

• Work with Creative team to develop merchandise concepts, artwork applications, and product specifications.

• Manage product development timelines and production calendars for events and ecommerce program

• Research and source new vendors, and maintain strong relationships with an established vendor base.

Ecommerce & Digital Merchandising

• Manage the online merchandise store through the Shopify platform, including product listings, inventory updates, pricing, and promotions.

• Ensure product pages are optimized with accurate descriptions, size charts, imagery, and inventory availability.

• Coordinate product launches with marketing campaigns and event calendar.

• Monitor ecommerce performance metrics and identify opportunities to improve conversion rates and online sales.

• Works with Expo Event Ops Coordinator to secure placement in each location

• Responsible for managing a team of contractors or volunteer staff facilitate quick and smooth point-of-sale transactions

• Perform physical duties as required by the role, such as moving equipment or transferring merchandise between locations

• Inventory management, assisting guests with purchases, and overseeing sales transactions while maintaining a positive atmosphere

• Implement dynamic event retail activations and strategies to maximize sales growth and improve customer experience

• Assist with operational tasks and contribute to a positive shopping experience through merchandise upkeep and customer engagement

• Act as a brand ambassador for RAGBRAI, its local sponsors and venues

Merchandise Marketing & Collaboration

• Partner with the Marketing team to promote merchandise through email, social media, and digital campaigns.

• Collaborate with Creative and graphic design teams to develop artwork, product concepts, and branded merchandise collections.

• Support merchandise storytelling and promotional initiatives that drive both online and event-based sales.

• Provide product insights and sales trends to inform future merchandise and marketing strategies.

• 3–4 years of experience in retail merchandising, planning, or buying.

• Experience in revenue optimization, product development, and merchandising strategy.

• Deep understanding of merchandising and marketing strategies within a retail environment.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word.

job.description:
Title: Account Executive

Join Hearst Connecticut Media Group to help deliver impactful media campaigns for our customers, leveraging our rich history, extensive audience reach, best-in-class advertising solutions, and the power of cutting-edge AI tools!

Role Overview:  Hearst Newspapers is investing in its sales force, and we want you to be a part of it! We are looking for a digitally savvy, highly motivated Account Executive to join our advertising team at Hearst Connecticut Media Group. As an Account Executive, you will be responsible for developing and managing a sales pipeline and building new business relationships with local advertisers throughout the Connecticut area. You will work with your customers to promote compelling solutions that best fit their marketing needs. As an advocate for the customer within Hearst Connecticut Media Group, the role works in cooperation with other departments to ensure we can meet and exceed customer expectations both in performance and process. Hearst Newspapers operates on a hybrid work week schedule. 

Why Hearst Connecticut Media Group? 

Our people make the difference! Our diverse team is filled with passionate individuals who want to win. We offer an upbeat and collaborative working environment where challenging the norm is encouraged. With ample opportunities to learn new skills and advance within the organization, our team members are given the tools to learn and grow their careers.

Leverage Advanced AI for Maximum Efficiency and Earnings
Imagine having a personal assistant that never sleeps. Our state-of-the-art AI tools, including ChatGPT Enterprise and Gong.io, streamline your workflow, enabling you to close deals faster and manage your pipeline more effectively. 

This means more time to focus on what you love and a direct boost to your earnings potential.

Exclusive Partnership with OpenAI
Through our strategic content partnership with OpenAI and our exclusive ChatGPT Enterprise license, we have unparalleled access to the latest advancements in AI technology. 

This partnership provides us—and you—with a massive competitive edge in the market, ensuring you have the most powerful tools at your disposal to drive sales and exceed targets.

Personalized AI Tutors for Seamless Onboarding
Your success starts from day one. With our personalized AI tutors, every question you have, and every training need you encounter is met with instant, tailored support. 

These AI-driven mentors ensure you learn and sell as quickly and efficiently as possible, empowering you to hit the ground running and achieve your goals faster.

What will you do?

  • Drive Success with Innovative Tools: Utilize our AI-powered software to enhance every stage of the sales cycle, from prospecting and planning to presenting and closing deals.

  • Lead Generation: Call on local small to medium sized businesses to show the value of our suite of digital media advertising products from social media, display, video, programmatic, SEO/SEM to traditional advertisements. You will generate new leads through cold calling, networking, and prospecting, as well as staying aware of any new businesses opening in the area. You will own the sales cycle and will have the support of your local account management team to aid in continued support after the sale!
  • Product Expertise: Become an expert on our digital and print products/services. The first three weeks of hire, you will be provided with both global and local training to be fully educated before even going out on your own! You will also have full support throughout your career which includes continual learning and training to grow and achieves success as an Account Executive. 
  • Execute sales tactics: Implementing marketing strategies, delivering effective sales presentations with passion to consistently earn, retain and increase revenue.
  • Advertising Solutions: Create engaging advertising solutions to solve clients’ business needs.
  • Client Solutions: Recommend new products and promotional opportunities to current clients and handle objections efficiently. Be a large part of the local business community and boosting your clients’ businesses through multiple digital media channels.
  • Forecasting: Manage client pipeline and monthly revenue forecast in Salesforce.com.

 

What will it take to be successful?

  • Purposeful: You are direct and get things done quickly, with confidence, integrity, and determination.
  • Adaptable: You react and adjust to changing conditions and come up with practical ideas to deal with them.
  • Driven: You have self-assurance and competitive drive, delivering high-quality, organized, and repeatable results.
  • Communicator: You are a lively and intelligent person with a stimulating influence on others.
  • Trend-Savvy: you will keep informed of industry developments to ensure our digital advertising strategies remain cutting-edge and effective.

 

What we’re looking for:

  • Education: BA/BS degree in Advertising, Marketing, or Communications a plus or equivalent experience.
  • Experience: 2+ years of business-to-business outside sales in advertising or media, with a proven success in new business acquisition and exceeding revenue goals.
  • Skills: Superior presentation, interpersonal, and communication skills. Technically savvy with experience in Salesforce, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Mindset: Goal-oriented, competitive, and forward-thinking with strong business and financial acumen.

 

What we offer:

  • Dynamic Environment: A great work environment where it's never boring.
  • Comprehensive Training: Paid in-depth sales and product training.
  • Competitive Compensation: Competitive base salary with uncapped commissions for unlimited earning potential.
  • Collaborative Culture: Ideas and input are always welcome.
  • Learn more about Hearst Newspapers at www.joinhnp.com

 

Our Benefits: At Hearst Newspapers we not only support our employees through personal and professional development, but we also believe in promoting each individual’s physical, financial and emotional wellbeing (and that of their family).  Our industry-leading benefits include:

  • Physical Wellbeing: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage to keep you and your family healthy.
  • Invest for the Future: Competitive retirement plan with matching program in most markets.
  • Generous Paid Time Off: Recharge with ample time off, including holidays and vacation.
  • Paid Parental Leave: Support for growing families, with paid leave for new parents.
  • Monthly Child & Dependent Care Reimbursement: Financial support for the care of your loved ones.
  • Emotional Wellbeing: Be your best self with our mental wellness benefits.
  • LGBTQ+ & Inclusive Health Services: Inclusive healthcare designed for every individual’s unique needs.
  • Fertility Coverage & Menopause Support: Helping you along every step of your family journey.
  • Pet Wellness Reimbursement & Rover Credits: We care about your pets, too – helping you keep them happy and healthy.
  • And more, click here for additional benefits and details.

 

Join us at Hearst Connecticut Media Group and become part of a team that values innovation, collaboration, and customer success. Apply now to make an impact in the Connecticut advertising market!

job.title: Houston Chronicle Visuals Internship
job.description:
The Houston Chronicle is looking for a creative and ambitious student journalist to join its Visuals team for the summer 2027 internship program

The position is designed for motivated student journalists who want to build careers in visual journalism and gain hands-on experience producing photography and video in a major newsroom. The intern will help produce compelling still photography and short-form video for the Chronicle’s website and social platforms, including TikTok, Instagram and YouTube Shorts. They will have the opportunity to collaborate across the newsroom to tell visually driven stories that capture Houston’s people, culture and breaking news moments.

Our summer interns are integral members of the newsroom, producing work that reaches hundreds of thousands of readers and viewers. Past interns have gone on to full-time roles at the Chronicle as reporters, producers and editors across our newsroom and audience teams.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Photograph and film daily and enterprise assignments in coordination with editors and reporters

  • Pitch, shoot, edit and publish short-form videos optimized for social platforms

  • Identify visual storytelling opportunities across beats and social trends

  • Edit and caption photos and videos with attention to accuracy, tone and engagement

  • Collaborate with reporters, editors and the audience team to translate Chronicle journalism into visual stories

  • Contribute ideas for visual storytelling that strengthen the Chronicle’s reach and connection with audiences

Requirements:

  • Juniors, seniors or recent graduates with prior experience at a college news publication or professional news organization.
  • Valid driver's license and access to a car.
  • Must obtain housing in Houston and work in the Chronicle’s office at least 3 days a week.

     

Internship Details:

  • 40 hours a week for 10 weeks, from early June to early August. Interns will be paid $15 an hour.

  • Interns will work Monday through Friday, with occasional weekend coverage based on news demands.

  • The recruiting committee will assign all interns a mentor from the newsroom based on their interests.

     

Application details:

Interested candidates are invited to submit their applications, including the required documents, by October 25, 2026. 

Please submit a portfolio of 5 visuals clips (portfolio websites are acceptable), a resume, and a 1-page cover letter addressed to the recruiting committee detailing your passion for journalism and what you hope to achieve through this internship.

About the Houston Chronicle:

The Houston Chronicle, recognized for its Pulitzer Prize-winning journalism, serves its 2.3 million residents with content and marketing solutions across two of Houston’s largest websites — HoustonChronicle.com and Chron.com, along with our magazine, television and newspaper brands.  Our mission is to spark conversations that inspire action to create a better Houston.  All our content and the innovative business solutions we provide invite Houstonians to join conversations about a community we’ve been committed to covering and helping prosper for more than 120 years. You’ll gain experience at the intersection of journalism, storytelling and digital strategy while helping the Chronicle reach hundreds of thousands of readers across Houston and beyond.
