job.title: Coordinator, BLA and A&R Admin - Masterworks
job.description:
About Sony Music Entertainment

At Sony Music Entertainment, we fuel the creative journey. We’ve played a pioneering role in music history, from the first-ever music label to the invention of the flat disc record. We’ve nurtured some of music’s most iconic artists and produced some of the most influential recordings of all time.

Today, we work in more than 70 countries, supporting a diverse roster of international superstars, developing and independent artists, and visionary creators. From our position at the intersection of music, entertainment, and technology, we bring imagination and expertise to the newest products and platforms, embrace new business models, employ breakthrough tools, and provide powerful insights that help our artists push creative boundaries and reach new audiences. In everything we do, we’re committed to artistic integrity, transparency, and entrepreneurship.

Sony Music Entertainment is a member of the Sony family of global companies.

SONY MUSIC MASTERWORKS is a multi-faceted worldwide entertainment business specializing in recorded music and live events.

On the music side, SONY MUSIC MASTERWORKS is comprised of the label imprints Masterworks, Sony Classical, Milan Records, XXIM Records, and Masterworks Broadway which collectively, specialize in instrumental music (classical, neo-classical and classical crossover), soundtracks (film & television, video games, anime) and Broadway cast albums.  

MASTERWORKS LIVE! is comprised of fourteen innovative live event businesses, which as a collective conceives, builds, presents and promotes original and IP-based events and experiences in Music, Theater, TV, Film, Gaming, Anime, Sports Entertainment and more.  The division encompasses Backyard Cinema Black Ink Presents, Black Sky Creative, Culture Creative, GEA Live, The Luna Entertainment Group, MAC Global, Proactiv Entertainment, RG Live, RoadCo Entertainment, Roast Productions, Seaview Productions, Senbla, Ltd. and Terrapin Station Entertainment.

Sony Music Masterworks is seeking a Coordinator to provide essential administrative support to business and legal affairs and A&R administration for both recorded music and live. The position is based in Sony Music’s NYC headquarters, but the role is global in scope, requiring frequent contact with our colleagues in Los Angeles, the UK, Europe, Australia and Japan. This position offers a tremendous opportunity to learn, contribute and grow within a team-oriented environment.

The Coordinator, BLA & A&R Admin reports to the Senior Director of Business & Legal Affairs and the A&R Administration Department of Masterworks. This position will liaise with the various departments within the worldwide Sony Music Masterworks Division and Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Inter-Company Accounting, Release Planning, Royalties, Label Artists, their management, and recording studios.

We’re looking for candidates with a passion for the entertainment business as a whole, but with particular interest in music, live events and technology.  Meticulous organizational skills and the ability to pay close attention to detail are a must.  Candidates must also have the proven ability to manage a variety of tasks in a fast-paced environment, excellent oral and written communication skills, and the ability to work both autonomously and collaboratively across departments in a proactive and professional manner.

What you'll do:

  • Manage the core administrative needs of the Business and Legal Affairs department. This will include:
    • Circulating contracts internally and externally for execution.
    • Creating and maintaining workflows within Adobe Sign for purposes of securing deal memo approvals.
    • Mailing hard copies of notices when required.
    • Ensuring fully executed contracts and any other important documents or correspondence are submitted to the records department and uploaded to the CARMA database.
    • Generating updates, reports, spreadsheets and presentations for key internal stakeholders and external partners as directed.                          
  • Communicate with A&R, Business & Legal Affairs, Finance, Marketing, Royalties, JV Accounting, to properly administer artist contracts, licenses, and various other legal documents, including:
    • Administering A&R-related budgets and reviewing artist agreements to assess and enforce contractual obligations with respect to recording.
    • Assisting with creation of royalty accounts.
    • Liaising with release planning to ensure proper sub-project code setups.
    • Helping with union obligations for any relevant release.
    • Booking studio and travel for Artist Services.
  • Assist with ad hoc reports needed internally or externally.
  • Communicate with artist attorneys and managers about contractual issues, vendors, proper payments, and tax information.
  • Assist in day-to-day operations such as:
    • Administration of recording projects.
    • Tracking projects to ensure proper payment and budgeting.
    • Creation of recording and marketing budgets, including distinguishing between recoupable and non-recoupable costs for accurate statement rendering.
    • Issuing purchase orders.
    • Facilitating prompt invoice payment.
    • Reconciling BTA "ghost" card.
    • Setting up vendors in the Sony system, along with any relevant artist portal access.
  • Work with live businesses.
    • Create budgets and pay expenses.
    • Assist with customer and vendor onboarding.
    • Prepare billing requests and wire transfers.

Who you are:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience is required.
  • 1+ years of prior entertainment industry experience (including internships and extracurricular activities) highly encouraged, particularly in the areas of business and legal affairs, marketing, communications or business administration.
  • Highly organized, analytical, detail-oriented with exceptional follow-up skills, capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced, multi-priority global environment.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.
  • Skilled in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook, and especially PowerPoint) and Adobe Sign.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Premiere, Illustrator, inDesign) or equivalent supremely helpful, including light video and photo editing.
  • Active engagement in music, theater, film, television, videogames, anime and general pop culture a plus.
  • Must be able to accept changes readily, both in job responsibilities as well as in the work environment
  • Ability to multitask, solve problems and prioritize across multiple time zones.
  • Excellent time management skills.
  • Professional, confident, positive and calm demeanor.
  • A team player, who is both ambitious and able to take initiative and see projects through independently
  • Able to communicate effectively with internal staff, artists/creatives, managers/agents, and external contacts.
 

What we give you:

  • You join an inclusive, collaborative and global community where you have the opportunity to channel your passion every day

job.title: Graphics Multimedia Editor, Open-source Reporting
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. The New York Times Graphics team is looking for a reporter with extensive open-source and investigative reporting skills to turn raw evidence into impactful visual stories. You have a track record for uncovering exclusive information off the news.

The Graphics team is a leader in using spatial and visual techniques on investigative stories, and we're looking for someone who is passionate about accountability journalism using cutting-edge reporting techniques.

Below are a few examples of the kinds of stories that you will be a part of:
  • An exclusive look at the failed columns of the Midtown Manhattan near-collapse
  • A 3-D analysis of why firefighters' lines of sight were limited in the deadly LaGuardia Crash
  • An investigation into the mass graves in Syria
  • An investigation into the causes of a Miami building collapse
  • A spatial investigation into a deadly fire in the Bronx
  • A forensic analysis of an apartment building collapse in the Turkey earthquake
Working with journalists on the Graphics team and across the newsroom, you will play an important role in shaping visual reconstructions and investigations that rely on spatial analysis or use 3-D modeling. You will gather and analyze evidence for stories across a wide range of topics for both quick-turn stories as well as longer-term enterprise.

You will be expected to take the initiative in leading major storylines, with the goal of uncovering new or exclusive findings across multiple visual story formats. You should be curious and driven, and be comfortable with moving between solo deep dives and fast-paced, cross-desk collaborations.

This is an in-office position based in New York and includes regular attendance in the office four days a week.

Responsibilities:
  • Bring core OSINT fluency to the desk's coverage: geolocation, chronolocation, satellite/aerial imagery analysis, audio-video research, and more.
  • Analyze a variety of data sources, including satellite and aerial imagery, flight/vessel tracking data, social media platforms and radio scanner data.
  • Vet and build relationships with a network of sources on stories.
  • Generate ideas that help the team develop custom tooling to automate open-source reporting for analyzing and visualizing evidence.
  • Find new ways to report beyond the standard OSINT toolkit, by using computational techniques, including through machine learning, computer vision and approved AI tools.
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.
  • You will report to an Assistant Editor on the Graphics desk.
Basic Qualifications:
  • 5+ years of relevant experience as an investigative reporter, open-source researcher or forensic expert.
  • Proven experience conducting open-source investigations by sourcing audio and visual evidence across a variety of platforms.
  • Experience producing accountability journalism, with a strong portfolio.
  • Experience producing clear copy about the visual evidence on tight deadlines.
  • Experience verifying user-generated content from social media for authenticity.
  • Skilled in building timelines using a variety of sources, including official statements and metadata from user-generated content.
  • Familiarity with open-source intelligence tools and techniques like Google Earth, satellite imagery platforms, scanner audio data, flight or vessel tracking, or similar.
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Experience working both independently and collaboratively while managing multiple research threads.
  • Experience with advanced tools for reporting, such as QGIS, Blender for 3-D scene reconstructions, data analysis methods, audio and image forensics tools.
  • Adept at creating clear, visual explainers piecing together complex findings.
  • Familiarity with programming and custom tool development.
  • Familiarity with Adobe Suite and Figma.
  • Experience with web scraping tools and working with APIs.
  • Experience using command line tools.
  • Willingness and flexibility to work evenings and weekends as needed.

job.title: Director of Editorial, Axios Live
job.description:
1 big thing: The Director of Editorial, Axios Live will oversee editorial content, event framing, and strategic list building for Axios Live programming, leading a small team to ensure Axios’ editorial standards, Smart Brevity style, and journalistic integrity are upheld across all public-facing materials, roundtable discussions, and editorial products, including recap articles. 

Why it matters: As Axios Live expands across live convenings and executive roundtables, this role serves as the crucial editorial compass. You will be a high-caliber editorial leader and manager who applies sharp news judgment to shape timely event concepts, curate high-level editorial rooms, take an active role in real-time coverage of Axios’ biggest live event moments, and deliver post-event recaps that read as sharp journalism.

Go deeper: Axios Live events are among the most sought-after convenings in business, policy, and technology. Reporting to the Head of Editorial Live, the Editorial Director will ensure that our events portfolio reflects our editorial standards, diverse points of view, and help Axios stay at the forefront of news.

In this role, you will:

  • Oversee the drafting, editing, and approval of public-facing live event materials, including event concepts, registration pages, Axios webpages, social coverage, and post-event recap articles using Axios Smart Brevity.
  • Oversee the curation and tiering of editorial participants for Axios Roundtables. Ensure tables feature balanced, expert perspectives across sectors while maintaining editorial control over seating charts and participant mix.
  • Lead, coach, and manage a small, high-performing team of editorial writers and coordinators; set clear priorities, assign events, review deliverables, and foster a collaborative environment.
  • Manage coverage assignments and collaboration with the newsroom around covering some of Axios Live’s biggest stages including our Summit and House products. 
  • Own day-of editorial coverage for assigned live events, serving as the primary liaison to reporters and the newsroom, coordinating quick-turn coverage, leading live social reporting, and writing post-event recaps.
  • Work in close alignment with the Head of Editorial Live, newsroom SMEs/reporters, events operations, pre-sale, sales, and client leads to ensure seamless event execution and brand alignment.
  • Manage real-time editorial flow during live events, brief moderators, ensure all event materials are easily/immediately accessible for breaking news moments, and resolve and be the lead voice of editorial judgement for live editorial issues on the ground.
  • Guide the team in utilizing approved AI tools and custom GPTs to streamline initial research, concept brainstorming, and list discovery while rigorously enforcing accuracy and Smart Brevity standards.

Worthy of your time: Ideal candidates will embody an entrepreneurial spirit, possess exceptional news judgment, and bring the following skills:

  • 6–8+ years of journalism, editorial editing, live-event content creation, or public policy/media experience, ideally within a fast-paced newsroom or live news setting.
  • Proven people management experience, with a track record of coaching editorial team members and reviewing high-volume written deliverables under tight deadlines.
  • Sharp editorial and news judgment, with a deep understanding of policy, business, and tech trends, alongside a strong command of Axios Smart Brevity.
  • Demonstrated expertise in room curation and list strategy, with an understanding of how to build senior, balanced executive tables (C-suite, policymakers, operators, subject-matter experts).
  • Experience navigating commercial/client partnerships while maintaining editorial independence, neutrality, and journalistic red lines.
  • Exceptional writing, line-editing, and copy-editing skills, with the ability to develop sharp, audience-facing event concepts and language, distill complex ideas into clear editorial framing, and produce concise, high-value recap articles.
  • High operational rigor to manage overlapping deadlines across event concept pipelines, guest lists, seating charts, and post-event publications.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted research and editing tools, balancing efficiency with journalistic verification.
  • Ability to travel for major Axios Live events and activations as needed.

Starting salary for this role is in the range of $110,000 - $130,000 and is dependent on numerous factors, including but not limited to location, work experience, and skills. This range does not include other compensation benefits. Axios' compensation philosophy takes into account cost of labor differentials across the country. Because this is a remote-optional job posting, this salary range takes into account all possible locations within the United States, but candidates will only be eligible for the salary range for their location.

Axios is committed to embracing artificial intelligence as a core part of how we work. All team members are expected to actively develop AI literacy and use AI tools to enhance their productivity, creativity, and efficiency. We invest in ongoing learning to ensure every employee is equipped to responsibly and effectively integrate AI into their daily workflows.

job.description: About Suno We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world. Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA). Founded in 2023 by Harvard alumni with a shared passion for music, Suno has quickly grown to 250 employees while empowering more than 100 million people to create original songs. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination. About the Role Suno’s growth runs on paid social, and paid social runs on creative. This is a hands-on motion design role for someone who builds motion that stops the scroll on Instagram, Facebook, and TikTok. You’ll take our brand team’s polished motion and rework it into performance-native ad variants, and you’ll build original motion from scratch for paid: kinetic type, animated text and captions, logo, product, and UI motion, the pieces that carry a hook when there’s no live footage. This is a craft role with real creative latitude. You won’t be handed a finished board and told to render it. You’ll bring your own ideas for how motion can earn attention and drive a click, then move fast to test, iterate, and find what wins. Great work here is measured by performance, and you’ll see the results of your work quickly enough to act on them. If you live in After Effects, think in hooks and hold rates as much as keyframes, and want your motion in front of a massive global audience within days, this one is for you. Check out the song we made about it: https://suno.com/s/dDrWV7XNe6I5mJax What You’ll Do Rework the brand team’s motion into performance-native ad variants for Meta and TikTok. Build original motion from scratch for paid: kinetic type, animated captions, logo, product, and UI motion. Design motion that carries the hook in the first second, especially where there’s no live footage. Produce multiple iterations of winning concepts to feed continuous creative testing. Adapt motion across formats and placements (9:16, 1:1, 4:5) for Stories, Reels, and Feed. Bring original concepts and angles to the table, not just execute against a board. Hold brand coherence while pushing what actually works for performance. Turn performance signals into sharper motion, doubling down on what’s working. What You’ll Need A strong portfolio of motion built for short-form video ads on Meta and/or TikTok, or comparable performance work. Senior-level command of Adobe After Effects, plus Premiere for assembly and CapCut for fast cuts. A real grasp of direct-response creative: hooks, angles, pacing, and why motion wins or loses, not just how it looks. Proven ability to produce a high volume of variants at pace without dropping quality. A proactive, self-directed working style. You spot what’s missing and bring ideas without being asked. Comfort extending an existing brand system while building net-new motion for performance. Nice-to-Haves Experience at a consumer subscription app, a growth agency running paid social, or a DTC/ecommerce brand. Comfort reading performance metrics such as hook rate, hold rate, and CTR, and adjusting creative accordingly. Working knowledge of Illustrator, Photoshop, and Figma for prepping and adapting assets. Comfort folding AI tools into a motion workflow to move faster. A love of music and an eye for culture. Compensation This is a contract role paying $70 to $90 per hour, depending on experience, at roughly 20 to 40 hours per week. Additional Notes Applicants must be eligible to work in the US. job.title: Director - Internal Communications
job.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists, tastemakers and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is a creator-first platform helping artists build and grow their careers by providing them with the most advanced tools, services, and resources. With over 4x the music catalog of every other major streaming platform, spanning 40+ million artists across 190+ countries, SoundCloud is where emerging artists find their sound, hidden gems are discovered, and music culture is shaped in real time.   THIS IS A CONTRACT (12 MONTH) TO PERM POSITION BASED IN OUR NEW YORK CITY OFFICE.

SoundCloud is looking for a Director of Internal Communications to lead the strategy and execution of our global internal communications program. Based in New York, this role will partner with senior leadership and teams across the company to strengthen how SoundCloud informs, engages, and connects our global workforce.

A key priority for this role will be leading the successful migration and launch of SoundCloud’s next-generation intranet. You will serve as the communications and program lead for a large, cross-functional team spanning People & Culture, IT and Cybersecurity, Brand, Communications, Finance and SoundCloud’s Webflow owners. You will establish the project’s governance and roadmap, align stakeholders, oversee content strategy and migration, and drive employee adoption of the new platform.

This role is crucial to fostering a strong culture of collaboration, inclusion, and connectivity by ensuring employees have timely access to clear, useful, and engaging information.

If you are a strategic leader, skilled storyteller, and experienced change communicator who is passionate about creating a best-in-class employee experience, and you know how to bring complex, cross-functional programs from strategy through implementation, keep reading.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and oversee a comprehensive internal communications strategy serving employees across SoundCloud’s global offices, including New York, Los Angeles, Berlin and London, setting the strategic direction in close partnership with the executive team
  • Lead SoundCloud’s intranet migration from planning through launch and adoption, including platform governance, stakeholder alignment, information architecture, content strategy, content auditing and migration, testing, training and ongoing optimization
  • Serve as the central program lead for a cross-functional intranet working group spanning People & Culture, IT, Brand, Finance and more, establishing clear roles, milestones, decision-making processes and accountability
  • Partner with technical and business stakeholders to ensure the new intranet meets employee needs while aligning with SoundCloud’s brand, security, privacy, accessibility and operational requirements
  • Partner with Chief of Staff to produce agenda, content, and coordination of speakers for internal events, including monthly company-wide All Hands 
  • Counsel executives and senior leaders on communications that provide employees with clarity, context, and connection to SoundCloud’s business priorities
  • Identify and manage opportunities to elevate SoundCloud and its executives through relevant industry awards and recognition programs, including developing and submitting compelling nominations
  • Oversee SoundCloud’s internal editorial calendar, delivering timely communications related to company strategy, People initiatives, organizational change and workplace culture
  • Align internal messaging, employee experience and employer branding with SoundCloud’s mission, core behaviors and product positioning
  • Partner with the Talent Acquisition team to develop employer-branding strategies that position SoundCloud as a best-in-class employer and help attract a diverse pool of candidates on Linkedin, Glassdoor and beyond.
  • Manage and continually improve SoundCloud’s internal communications channels, including the intranet and employee newsletters, using engagement data and employee feedback to assess effectiveness
  • Partner with People and Workplace teams to develop communications strategies that increase engagement and enhance the employee experience
  • Collaborate with the DEI team and Diversity Resource Groups to promote initiatives and programming through messaging that fosters understanding, inclusion, and engagement across the organization
  • Monitor trends and emerging practices in internal communications, employee engagement, and workplace technology, providing guidance and new ideas to internal stakeholders

Experience and Background:

  • 8+ years of internal communications experience within a global company or agency environment
  • Demonstrated experience leading a large-scale intranet implementation, migration or digital workplace transformation involving multiple business and technical functions
  • Strong program and project-management skills, including experience establishing governance, coordinating complex workstreams, managing competing priorities and holding stakeholders accountable to deadlines
  • Experience leading change-management and employee-adoption programs for new platforms, systems or ways of working
  • Ability to translate business, technical, security and employee-experience requirements into a clear strategy and executable plan
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively across cultures, functions and levels of seniority
  • Experience developing and executing internal communications strategies within a global organization
  • Confidence working with and providing counsel, guidance and constructive feedback to senior executives
  • Exceptional design and branding acumen, with experience developing presentations, videos and creative collateral
  • Strong sense of ownership, accountability and attention to detail
  • Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, adapt quickly and prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment
  • Proven ability to build alignment, navigate differing stakeholder perspectives and move complex cross-functional initiatives forward
  • Experience using data, analytics, and employee feedback to assess communications effectiveness and improve engagement

The salary range for this role is $160,000 - $175,000 annually. The final salary offered will be determined based on relative experience, skills, internal equity, and location. We also offer a generous total rewards program - read more about additional benefits and perks below! 

About us:

  • We are a multinational company with offices in the US (New York and Los Angeles), Germany (Berlin), and the UK (London)
  • We provide a flexible work culture that offers the opportunity to collaborate and connect in person at our offices as well as accommodating work from home
  • We are deeply committed to ensuring diversity, equity and inclusion at all levels of our organization and fostering a community where everyone’s voice, perspective and experience is respected and heard
  • We believe a strong team is made by investing in employees through mentorship, workshops and enrichment opportunities

Benefits:

  • Comprehensive health benefits including medical, dental, and vision plans, as well as mental health resources
  • Robust 401k program
  • Generous professional development allowance
  • Interested in a gym membership, photography course or book? We have a Creativity and Wellness benefit!
  • Various snacks, goodies, and 2 free lunches weekly when at the office

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at SoundCloud

SoundCloud is for everyone. Diversity and open expression are fundamental to our organization; they help us lead what’s next in music by understanding and empowering our creators and fans, no matter their identity. We acknowledge the challenges in the music industry, and strive to influence an inclusive culture where everyone can contribute respectfully and thrive, especially the historically marginalized communities that many of our creators, fans and SoundClouders identify with. We are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment at SoundCloud for everyone, regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, migration background, national origin, age, disability status, or care-giver status.

We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Candidates must be based in Bentonville, AR!

 

Overview:

The Senior Manager, Retail Development, Global Products & Experiences is in charge of executing retail strategies that drive sell-in of licensed merchandise across key retail partners. This role manages day-to-day relationships with retailers and licensees, ensures robust in-store execution, and supports the growth of the brands through compelling consumer product offerings.

 

Responsibilities:

  • Manage relationships with retail partners, especially Walmart

    • Work with licensees to boost sales of licensed products

    • Focus on important categories such as Toys, Sporting Goods, Home, Accessories, Food & Beverage, and Essentials & Beauty

  • Execute retail strategies across category responsibilities

  • Monitor retail performance and identify opportunities to increase sales and distribution 

  • Partner with licensing category teams to support product launches and retail activations in partnership with licensees 

  • Ensure brand consistency and compliance across all licensed products and retail placements 

  • Conduct store visits and retail audits to ensure merchandising standards are met and identify new opportunities

  • Analyze sales data, market trends, and competitive activity 

  • Collaborate with internal teams (marketing, category, franchise) to support campaigns 

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Must be based in the Bentonville, AR area

  • Bachelor’s degree

  • 8+ years of experience in retail, licensing, consumer products, or business development

  • Robust written and verbal communication skills

  • Ability to work autonomously with solid organizational skills, attention to detail and follow-up

  • Deep knowledge of retail environments and merchandising strategies

  • Exemplary relationship management and communication skills

  • Analytical mindset with experience using sales data to drive decisions

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Experience working with licensed brands or retail partnerships preferred 

  • Working knowledge of entertainment, categories and/or retail industry a plus

 

Paramount Skydance Corporation (NASDAQ: PSKY) is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Driven by iconic studios, networks and streaming services, Paramount's portfolio of consumer brands includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, and Pluto TV, among others. Paramount delivers the largest share of the U.S. television audience and boasts one of the industry's most important and extensive libraries of TV and film titles. In addition to offering innovative streaming services and digital video products, the company provides powerful capabilities in production, distribution and advertising solutions.

 

What We Offer:
  • Attractive compensation and comprehensive benefits packages. Check out our full list of benefits here: https://www.paramount.com/careers/benefits
  • Generous paid time off.
  • An exciting and fulfilling opportunity to be part of one of Paramount’s most dynamic teams.
  • Opportunities for both on-site and virtual engagement events.
  • Unique opportunities to make meaningful connections and build a vibrant community, both inside and outside the workplace.
  • Explore life at Paramount: https://www.paramount.com/careers/life-at-paramount

  Senior Software Engineer, CMS Platform Paramount Streaming • Technology & Engineering   Location: Burbank, CA / New York, NY/ San Francisco, CA • Full-Time (onsite)  

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer, CMS to build and own the web experiences at the heart of our content management platform - shipping high-quality code across a polyglot stack that powers Paramount+, Pluto TV, and CBS.com. This is a frontend-leaning full-stack role: you'll spend most of your time crafting fast, resilient, server-rendered React applications, and you'll own features end to end - from the component layer down through the APIs and data model that back them; along with event driven messaging for external integrations.

 

Motivational Fit

 

·You'll become the person the team turns to on frontend architecture and web performance, lead small-to-medium projects from design through production, and mentor other engineers.

·You care about how things feel for users and how maintainable they are for the engineers who come after you.

·You are driven to improve code quality, developer experience and team processes

 

Responsibilities

 

•     Build and evolve server-rendered React applications: design high-quality, accessible, performant UIs with Next.js and modern React, with server-side rendering (SSR) at the core of how we deliver fast first-load experiences at streaming scale.

•     Own component architecture: establish and champion clean, reusable component patterns and shared design conventions that scale across the codebase and keep the team moving quickly.

•     Drive web performance: measure and improve Core Web Vitals, rendering strategy, bundle size, caching, and load performance — and set the standards other engineers follow.

•     Deliver features end to end: design complete solutions that span the frontend and the services behind it — building and evolving REST APIs in Java/Spring Boot and modeling the data with PostgreSQL (entities, schema, migrations) that power those experiences.

•     Develop the API and data layer: build the Node.js and Spring Boot service layers that connect the frontend to the platform, with an eye to clean contracts and clear boundaries that also supports external clients through messaging.

•     Improve developer experience and quality: raise the bar on testing, observability, tooling, and team processes — making the whole team faster, the codebase healthier and reduce technical debt

•     Ownership: take ownership of small to medium projects from design through production, coach colleagues, and help codify expertise — including clear, agent-readable docs and conventions — so both people and AI agents can ramp quickly.

•     Mentorship: mentor engineers through code reviews, pairing and knowledge sharing including effective AI-augmented workflows

•     Collaboration: collaborate with stakeholders and partner teams to ensure seamless integrations and cohesive experiences

•     Participate in on-call rotations, incident resolution and RCAs

•     Help grow the team through interviewing and onboarding new members


Required Qualifications

 

 

•     BS in Comp Science or related field, or equivalent applicable experience

•     5+ years of professional software engineering experience

•     Strong React expertise, with production experience building server-rendered applications (SSR) using Next.js or a similar framework.

•     Deep frontend fundamentals: component architecture, TypeScript, state management, and a genuine command of web performance and accessibility.

•     Full-stack range: comfort building the services behind the UI — Node.js and/or Java/Spring Boot REST APIs — and modeling data in a relational database such as PostgreSQL (entities, schema design, migrations).

•     End-to-end ownership: a track record of taking features from design through production, and the judgment to make sound architectural tradeoffs across the stack.

•     Senior-level collaboration: strong communication, a habit of mentoring, and the ability to set patterns others adopt.

•     Technical writing: comfort producing clear design documentation and conventions.

 

Preferred

 

•     Strong exposure to cloud platforms (GCP, AWS etc.)

•     Good experience with container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes) and DevOps/CICD practices & tools

•     Experience with message brokers (Kafka, GCP Pub/Sub) / event driven messaging systems

•     Experience with search tools like Solr and Elasticsearch

 

Nice-to-Have

 

     Familiarity with content management domains, media/streaming, or other high-traffic consumer platforms.

 

How We Work

 

AI is part of how we build every day, and we expect our engineers to be fluent with it. This is core to the role, not a bonus.

 

Required:

 

•     Daily fluency with AI coding tools (e.g., Claude, Cursor, Copilot — we provide licenses). Agents draft, you direct and review. You know how to prompt effectively, when to trust the output, and how to catch what it gets wrong.

•     Judgment over autopilot: you review agent-generated code critically, hold the quality bar, and can explain your reasoning. As a senior engineer, you'll help shape how the team uses these tools well — encoding conventions, setting review patterns for agent-generated code, and mentoring juniors on           judgment.

•     Exposure to building agentic workflows developing systems where AI agents take on multi-step tasks with the right guardrails.

•     Familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar approaches for connecting AI agents to tools, data, and services.

•     Exposure to multi-agent orchestration and emerging agentic patterns.

 

Why Join

 

You'll work on web experiences seen by millions, on a team that pairs a strong frontend craft culture with real full-stack ownership and an AI-native way of building. We provide the tools, the licenses, and the room to shape how modern web engineering is done at one of the industry's most recognizable brands.

About The Position:

The Commercial Counsel is a key member of People Inc's Legal team, serving as a trusted legal advisor to the business and leading the review, negotiation, and implementation of the company's commercial contracting processes. This role partners closely with Sales, Product, Marketing, Technology, Finance, Procurement, and executive leadership to support strategic initiatives while balancing legal risk with business objectives.

The Commercial Counsel is responsible for negotiating complex commercial agreements, developing scalable contracting processes, and providing practical, business-oriented legal guidance that accelerates deal execution and enables growth. Description

  

Market Manager – Myrtle Beach

Dick Broadcasting Company | Myrtle Beach, South Carolina
Full-Time | Exempt

Dick Broadcasting Company is looking for an entrepreneurial leader to lead our Myrtle Beach market.

This is not a caretaker position.

We are looking for someone who wants to build — a great team, strong brands, lasting client relationships, revenue, and a successful business. You will lead a four-station operation and its growing digital business with significant autonomy and direct responsibility for the market’s results.

For more than 72 years, Dick Broadcasting Company has built successful local media brands by remaining committed to the communities we serve. As a family-owned company, we believe local leadership matters. Our Market Managers are given the freedom to identify opportunities, make decisions, try new things, develop people, solve problems, and grow their business.

This position is based in Myrtle Beach, South Carolina, one of the Southeast’s most dynamic and rapidly growing markets. Beyond being a world-class tourism destination, Myrtle Beach offers a strong local business community, tremendous population growth, beaches, golf, entertainment, and an outstanding quality of life.

If you are a successful Local Sales Manager, General Sales Manager, Digital Sales Manager, small-market General Manager, or another proven media leader ready for greater responsibility, this could be your opportunity to lead a market.

What You’ll Do

Build and lead a great team.
Recruit, develop, coach, and retain talented people. Create an environment where people enjoy coming to work, know what is expected of them, celebrate wins together, and are continually challenged to get better.

Grow the business.
Lead the market’s revenue strategy across broadcast and digital, with a strong emphasis on local-direct new business, account growth, and finding new opportunities for DBC and our clients.

Develop people.
Spend time with your team. Coach sales leaders and sellers in the field, brainstorm with programming and content teams, provide regular feedback, recognize great work, and help good people become even better at what they do.

Be part of the sales effort.
Participate in key client meetings and help create a sales culture where prospecting, discovery, presenting solutions, following up, and closing business happen consistently. Be a resource for the sales team without becoming the sales team.

Know what is happening in the business.
Establish clear expectations and strong operating rhythms. Use financial results, sales activity, CRM data, ratings, digital performance, and other key metrics to recognize momentum, identify opportunities, and address problems early.

Be part of the Myrtle Beach community.
Build relationships with advertisers, agencies, community organizations, and business leaders. Be visible in the market and help ensure our brands continue to be an important part of the communities we serve.

Protect and grow our brands.
Work closely with programming and content leaders to keep our stations entertaining, relevant to listeners, valuable to advertisers, and connected to Myrtle Beach.

Manage the P&L.
Take responsibility for the financial performance of the market, including revenue growth, profitability, forecasting, expense discipline, and annual operating and capital budgets.

Lead the entire operation.
Oversee programming, sales, digital, technical operations, human resources, and business administration while ensuring the stations remain compliant with applicable FCC rules and regulations.


Requirements

 What We’re Looking For

We are less interested in a particular title than we are in finding the right leader. The successful candidate will bring:

  • A  demonstrated ability to grow revenue and develop new business.
  • Proven  experience leading, coaching, motivating, and developing people.
  • Strong  business judgment and an understanding of budgets, forecasting, expenses, and profitability.
  • The ability to set clear expectations and hold themselves and others  accountable while building a positive team culture.
  • An  understanding of digital advertising and how broadcast and digital solutions can work together to solve client problems.
  • Curiosity,  creativity, and a willingness to try new things.
  • Strong communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
  • The confidence to make decisions and the humility to listen to other ideas.
  • An entrepreneurial mindset and a desire to find opportunities rather than wait for them to appear.
  • Knowledge of FCC regulations and broadcast operations, or the ability and willingness to quickly develop that knowledge.
  • A  college degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • A  valid driver’s license.

Who Will Thrive Here

This opportunity is best suited for someone who loves building something with a team.

We are looking for a leader who enjoys being around people — coaching sellers, brainstorming ideas with programmers, getting out in the community, celebrating wins, solving problems, and helping good people become even better at what they do.

You should also be comfortable setting clear expectations, making decisions, having difficult conversations when necessary, meeting with clients, and understanding the financial performance of the business.

At DBC, our Market Managers have significant autonomy to lead their markets. With that freedom comes accountability, but also the opportunity to try things, move quickly, and make a real impact.A leader who genuinely cares about people while maintaining high expectations for performance will thrive here — someone who celebrates wins, addresses problems quickly, and believes that developing a successful team and building a successful business go hand in hand.If you are looking for an opportunity to build a great team, grow a business, have some fun along the way, and lead one of DBC’s key markets, we would like to hear from you.


Benefits

  • Paid Time Off (Vacation, Personal and Sick)
  • Medical, Dental, Vision, Disability, and Life Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Account
  • 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan

job.title: Digital Sales Manager
job.description:
WPTZ/WNNE, Hearst Television’s NBC affiliates serving the Burlington, VT / Plattsburgh, NY market, are seeking a Digital Sales Manager to lead and expand our digital revenue. This is a strategic leadership role for a results-driven sales professional who thrives in a fast-evolving, digital-first environment and is passionate about developing teams and driving measurable client outcomes.

This role offers the opportunity to strengthen digital revenue in a dynamic market, leveraging Hearst’s industry-leading tools, data, and cross-platform capabilities. You will contribute to sales strategy, mentor team members, and help evolve how we support client success.

At Hearst Television, you will work alongside passionate professionals who take pride in delivering high-quality content and marketing solutions. You will also be part of a team-oriented culture where your digital expertise and leadership will help drive success in a digital-first environment.

About the Burlington–Plattsburgh Market
Burlington, Vermont, located along the shores of Lake Champlain, is a vibrant city known for its thriving arts scene, innovative business community, and exceptional quality of life. Residents enjoy true four-season living, with opportunities for sailing and kayaking in the summer, world-class skiing in the winter, and some of the most beautiful fall foliage in the country. The area offers a more balanced and accessible lifestyle than larger metropolitan areas, with short commute times and easy access to nature.

Plattsburgh, New York, offers a welcoming, close-knit community with a revitalized downtown featuring restaurants, shops, and cultural venues. Located on the western shore of Lake Champlain, Plattsburgh provides convenient access to both Burlington and Montreal, allowing residents to enjoy the benefits of a smaller community with access to a broader mix of cultural and economic experiences. 

Job Responsibilities

Sales Leadership and Strategy

  • Lead the strategy and execution of digital revenue growth in support of station sales goals
  • Partner with the Local Sales Manager to support weekly, quarterly, and annual sales strategies and planning
  • Foster a performance-oriented culture by setting clear expectations and supporting team accountability

 

Team Development and Performance

  • Coach, support, and mentor Account Executives (AEs) through regular one-on-one and team sessions to strengthen digital expertise and sales effectiveness
  • Evaluate seller performance, identify development opportunities, and provide ongoing coaching to improve results
  • Deliver digital training and education to both local and national sales teams to build capability and confidence

 

Revenue Growth and Client Strategy

  • Identify and support new digital revenue opportunities, including non-traditional and emerging solutions
  • Support negotiation of digital advertising opportunities, ensuring strong positioning and alignment with client goals
  • Develop strategic responses to client and agency RFPs, with a focus on driving new and incremental business
  • Build and maintain client and agency relationships to drive retention and growth
  • Partner with AEs to develop and deliver integrated digital marketing solutions

 

Operational Excellence and Accountability

  • Support digital revenue forecasting and maintain visibility into performance
  • Manage budgets related to digital initiatives with attention to efficiency and outcomes
  • Review insertion orders and sales documentation to ensure accuracy and consistency

 

Experience Requirements

  • Strong understanding of digital marketing and cross-platform media, including television and digital solutions
  • Experience generating revenue through new business development and account growth across multiple platforms
  • Ability to create persuasive presentations, respond to RFPs, and align solutions to client goals
  • Knowledge of pricing strategy and inventory management to maximize revenue opportunities
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with sound business judgment
  • Effective communication and relationship-building skills with clients, agencies, and internal teams
  • Ability to coach, support, and collaborate with sellers to drive team performance
  • Experience supporting negotiations and contributing to successful client agreements
  • Ability to manage priorities, support forecasting, and contribute to revenue growth
  • Proficiency with WideOrbit, Kantar, and One Domain or WO Media Office
  • Valid driver’s license and reliable automobile
  • Related military experience will be considered

 

Salary

The estimated base salary range for this role is $90,000 to $110,000. The actual base pay offered will depend on several factors, including transferable skills, work experience, business needs, and other factors permitted by law, and may vary from the stated range where appropriate.  The base pay range is subject to change.

job.title: Digital Creative Content Strategist (freelance)
job.description:
Digital Creative Content Strategist (freelance)

 

Hearst Media Production Group (HMPG) is seeking a Digital Creative Content Strategist to support digital content strategies, creative concepts, and original digital series across HMPG broadcast series, digital originals, and upcoming business opportunities. This individual contributor role has no direct reports, though it may help guide editors, freelancers, producers, and production partners on specific executions.

 

Working closely with the Digital Director and Digital Content Strategy Manager, this role helps shape content from strategy through execution, including building strategy decks, contributing to platform and channel recommendations, ideating digital activations, supporting digital original production planning, working with talent and creators, and occasionally traveling to shoots to capture content. The role also provides creative guidance to producers and editors through post-production. Final creative approval sits with the Digital Director and Digital Content Strategy Manager.

 

This position reports to the Digital Content Strategy Manager and is based in Glendale, CA, four days per week.

 

Responsibilities

  • Support the development of content strategies by researching platforms, identifying audience trends, drafting content pillars, and preparing first-pass strategic materials. 
  • Contribute platform-specific recommendations that help define what content belongs on each channel, how it should be formatted, audience fit and how it supports marketing goals. 
  • Work with editors, producers, and creative teams to help define the visual look and feel of original digital content, including pacing, graphics, recurring formats, captions, voice, and platform-native treatments.
  • Support business development by ideating digital activations, social extensions, creator integrations, talent ideas, original formats, audience engagement strategies, and practical production approaches for proposed broadcast and digital productions.
  • Support productions and their planning by gathering inputs related to various production departments and timelines.
  • Assist digital productions by preparing shoot agendas, shoot priorities, run-of-show documents, production notes, and creative briefs. May lead to smaller-scale digital shoots or content captures with oversight.
  • Travel to select shoots to support digital capture, production oversight, talent direction, and real-time creative decision-making; capture behind-the-scenes footage, social-first clips, interviews, talent moments, and supplemental assets when needed.
  • Research and recommend digital creators, influencers, editors, freelancers, and production partners.
  • Provide editors and producers with clear creative direction, pacing guidance, platform formatting direction, and visual references.

 

Internet Fluency and Cultural Judgment

  • Live natively on TikTok, YouTube, and Instagram as both a viewer and participant. This person does not need platform behavior explained to them and should bring informed opinions about what is working now, backed by real examples. 
  • Be chronically online in the best sense: consuming a high volume of content, developing strong taste, and knowing how to separate signal from noise. 
  • Bring sharp instincts for what feels current versus dated, forced, or unnecessary trend chasing. Understand creator culture, meme cycles, comment behavior, fandom dynamics, and each platform’s tone. 
  • Apply critical judgment to trends, copy, and strategy. This person should eliminate corporate, algorithmic, or AI-generated language, push back constructively, and flag ideas that may look good in a deck but will not connect with a real audience.

 

Experience

  • 3+ years of experience in digital media, entertainment, branded content, social video, digital originals, creator-led production, or broadcast-adjacent content development.
  • Proven ability to create content strategy decks, pitch materials, client-facing presentations, creative proposals, or social content plans.
  • Hands-on background developing or producing digital original content, including short-form and long-form formats.
  • Practical knowledge of production planning, shoot logistics, budgeting, staffing, talent coordination, set workflows, and post-production processes.

  • Experience working with editors, producers, creators, influencers, talent, production teams, clients, and cross-functional stakeholders. Experience with educational, family-friendly, youth, lifestyle, sports, or mission-driven programming is preferred.

 

Qualifications

  • Strong understanding of social platforms, digital video formats, audience behavior, creator culture, and platform-specific creative strategy.
  • Comfortable discussing digital analytics, audience growth, engagement, video performance, retention, content optimization, and platform trends.
  • Strong writing skills, including strategic positioning, captions, tone of voice, creative copy, pitch language, and presentation copy.
  • Ability to guide editors and producers on visual style, pacing, structure, graphics, format, and storytelling approach.
  • Familiarity with digital production equipment and workflows, including DSLR or cinema-style cameras, lighting, sound, lavaliers, and field production tools.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, organization, and time-management skills; able to manage multiple shows, deadlines, priorities, and stakeholders at once.
  • Candidates must possess a valid passport with at least 18 months of remaining validity at the time of hire and must be willing and able to travel as needed.

 

Portfolio Requirement

Applicants must provide a portfolio or work samples that demonstrate digital content strategy, social-first creative ideas, campaign examples, writing samples, digital video work, or platform-specific content execution. Link documents or upload PDF with links to samples.

 

Education

  • Related experience and/or training will be considered as well as a combination of education and experience.

  • HMPG is a proud supporter of military veterans. Related military training and experience will be considered. 

 

Values in Action

At Hearst Television we tell stories every day. Stories about people of all cultures, backgrounds, perspectives, and identities. That's why, behind the scenes, we believe in being an organization as diverse and varied as the audience we reach, ensuring that the content we create is more compassionate, and more representative of the communities we serve.

 

Benefits

Eligible employees will have access to enroll in health coverage through our partnership with Entertainment Partners’ EP Cares program. 

  • Medical

  • Dental

  • Vision

  • Emotional Wellness Support

  • Additional benefits to meet your and your family's needs

 

The estimated base range for this role is $41.00 to $46.00 per hour. The actual base pay offered is dependent upon many factors, such as transferable skills, work experience, business needs, market demands and conditions, including geographic location where the work will be performed, and other factors permitted by law. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

 

About Company

Hearst Media Production Group(HMPG), a business unit of Hearst Television, is an independent producer and distributor of original programming for TV stations, broadcast and cable networks and streaming services. HMPG produces hundreds of hours of Emmy® Award-winning programming annually across linear, streaming, digital and social media platforms for domestic and international distribution in 100 countries. Its popular weekly educational/informational (E/I) programming blocks air weekends nationwide including “Weekend Adventure,” on ABC stations; “CBS WKND,” on the CBS Network; “The More You Know,” on the NBC Network; “One Magnificent Morning,” on the CW Network; “Mi Telemundo” on the Telemundo Network and “Go Time” on independent stations. HMPG also produces and/or distributes a diverse slate of other programming and content including the company’s dedicated FAST channels Xplore, The Jack Hanna Channel, Rovr Pets, and Lucky Dog Channel, available on some of the most popular smart TVs and streaming platforms. HMPG has offices in New York, Los Angeles, and Charlotte. HMPG is represented by United Talent Agency.

job.title: Lead Software Engineer
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Job Title: Lead Software Engineer, AI Tooling & Quality Engineering Platforms

Team: Global Quality Engineering (GQE)

Location: New York, Burbank, CA (Onsite)

 

OVERVIEW

Paramount Skydance Corp. is seeking a Lead Software Engineer to architect, lead, and deliver enterprise-scale AI tooling and internal platforms that transform how Global Quality Engineering operates. This is not an "in test" role — you will be building foundational AI platforms, internal developer tools, and intelligent automation systems used across multiple brands and engineering pillars.

You will define technical direction, lead complex initiatives, and build systems that accelerate automation, triage, and analysis at scale.

 

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Architect large-scale AI platforms, RAG systems, and intelligent automation services that support GQE.
  • Lead the design of internal developer tools, micro-platforms, and APIs that integrate AI into core engineering workflows.
  • Build systems that automatically evaluate failures, classify flakiness, detect patterns, and recommend fixes.
  • Partner with the QE executive team to define long-term AI strategy and roadmap, ensuring alignment with Platform Engineering, Data Engineering, Playback/Video Engineering, and Product teams.
  • Mentor engineers across GQE and elevate engineering maturity through best practices and architectural guidance.
  • Evaluate and integrate emerging AI technologies that deliver measurable productivity and quality improvements.

 

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 6+ years of software engineering experience with deep backend and architectural expertise.
  • Proven experience building and scaling production AI systems, including LLM integrations and RAG pipelines.
  • Solid systems thinking and ability to design platforms used across multiple teams and brands.
  • Expertise in cloud platforms, distributed systems, and container orchestration.
  • Demonstrated management in technical strategy, platform design, and cross-functional influence.
  • Great communication skills and ability to drive alignment across engineering organizations.

 

KEY COMPETENCIES

  • Organization-level technical leadership.
  • Ability to define platform strategy and long-term architecture.
  • Deep AI fluency and realistic judgment on where AI adds value.
  • Strong mentorship and influence across teams.

 

SUCCESS METRICS

  • Enterprise-wide adoption of AI tooling with measurable improvements in productivity and quality.
  • Significant reduction in triage time, flakiness, and manual analysis through intelligent automation.
  • Clear architectural direction and roadmap for AI-enabled quality engineering.
  • Strong uplift in engineering excellence across GQE.

 

#L1-VA1

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?

Lead Machine Learning Operations Engineer
Personalization & Recommendation Systems


Overview
We’re hiring a Lead Machine Learning Operations Engineer to own the operational excellence, observability, reliability, and governance layer around our personalization and recommendation ML systems. 

Our recommendation models retrain and deploy frequently. You will define how we detect model behavior changes, diagnose issues quickly, and prevent bad deployments from reaching customers.


This is a lead-level IC role: you’ll set technical direction and drive adoption across ML Engineering, DevOps, Platform Engineering, Data Engineering, and Product.


Sitting within ML Platform and Infrastructure, you’ll partner closely with ML engineers who own model development. You’re not expected to build infrastructure from scratch, but you’ll define what good looks like, evaluate tooling, and own the day-to-day operational layer.


What You’ll Do

Own ML production reliability strategy

  • Define and lead the operational strategy for production ML systems, including monitoring, traceability, deployment safety, incident response, and post-deployment validation.

  • Set the standards ML teams use to assess model health, performance, and trustworthiness in production.

Own model traceability and governance

  • Ensure every production model has clear lineage (data, features, code, artifacts, validation, deployment history) and drive adoption of model registry and metadata tooling across ML teams.

Build end-to-end ML observability

  • Design and implement monitoring across the full ML signal path: data arrival, feature freshness, distribution stability, candidate generation, ranking behavior, model metrics, serving latency, and SLA performance.

Define production health metrics

  • Partner with ML, data, product, and business stakeholders to define post-deployment metrics covering model quality, system reliability, business guardrails, and degradation indicators.

Detect drift and degradation proactively

  • Detect data drift, feature drift, model behavior changes, and silent failures before they impact customers via thresholding, alerting, anomaly detection, and release-over-release monitoring.

Lead diagnostic tooling and root-cause analysis

  • Build dashboards, logs, and diagnostic workflows that progress quickly from “recommendations look off” to root cause, with context captured across candidates, features, scores, ranking decisions, and downstream outcomes.

Own ML deployment safety

  • Define and operate automated gates that prevent bad models or bad data from being promoted to production. Partner with MLEs to establish validation checks, rollback criteria, canary strategies, shadow testing, and release health reviews.

Lead ML incident response

  • Own incident response practices for ML systems, including rollback playbooks, hotfix strategies, severity definitions, tradeoff frameworks, communications, and post-mortems. Drive closure of systemic gaps after incidents rather than only resolving the immediate issue.

Partner across ML Platform, Data, and ML

  • Partner with DevOps/Platform on infrastructure and observability needs; with Data Engineering on data quality, drift, and freshness; and with ML Engineering to embed operational requirements into development and deployment workflows.

Set standards and mentor others

  • Act as the technical lead for ML operations: establish reusable patterns, playbooks, and standards, and mentor engineers on reliability, observability, and operational rigor.


Basic Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in machine learning engineering, ML platform, applied ML, MLOps, data platform, reliability engineering, or a related technical role.

  • Demonstrated experience operating production ML systems, including monitoring, deployment, incident response, model validation, data quality, or reliability ownership.

  • Experience leading technical initiatives across multiple engineering teams, especially where success required influencing architecture, tooling, standards, or adoption.

  • Hands-on experience with model registries, feature stores, ML metadata systems, production monitoring, model deployment pipelines, or ML observability platforms.

  • Solid knowledge of end-to-end ML systems, including training data, features, model artifacts, offline validation, online serving, post-deployment metrics, and business outcome measurement.

  • Ability to reason about ML operational failure modes: stale features, distribution shift, training-serving skew, delayed labels, and offline-online metric gaps.

  • Solid SQL skills and comfort investigating data quality, feature distributions, model outputs, pipeline behavior, and production anomalies.

  • Track record of cross-functional collaboration with Platform, Data, and ML Engineering to deliver production-grade operational capabilities.

  • Solid written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain ML system health, risks, incidents, and tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Additional Qualifications

  • Experience operating recommendation, personalization, ranking, search, ads, content discovery, or marketplace ML systems at scale.

  • Experience with real-time or near-real-time model serving systems.

  • Experience with feature stores, model registries, metadata stores, experiment tracking, data quality tools, lineage systems, or observability platforms.

  • Experience designing automated validation gates, canary deployments, rollback strategies, shadow deployments, or progressive delivery workflows for ML systems.

  • Experience with A/B testing, experiment guardrails, counterfactual evaluation, or offline-to-online metric alignment.

  • Experience with cloud-native production environments, distributed data pipelines, orchestration frameworks, or streaming systems.

  • Experience leading incident reviews, post-mortems, reliability programs, or operational excellence initiatives.

  • Experience defining standards, playbooks, or governance frameworks for production ML systems.


What Success Looks Like

  • Within the first 90 days, you will have assessed the current production ML operational landscape, identified the highest-risk gaps, and established a prioritized roadmap for observability, traceability, deployment safety, and incident response.

  • Within six months, our production recommendation systems will have clearer model lineage, stronger monitoring coverage, better diagnostic workflows, and more reliable deployment gates.

  • Within one year, ML operations will be a repeatable, trusted function: teams will know what is running, why it was promoted, how it is performing, when something is wrong, and how to recover quickly.

 

Leveling Signal
The right candidate defines strategy, leads cross-functional execution, and sets engineering standards while staying hands-on enough to investigate production issues directly.

job.title: Reporter
job.description:
Title: General Assignment Reporter

Are you a curious, ambitious journalist with a passion for telling stories that matter? Do you thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced newsroom? Join our team at The Telegraph in Alton, Illinois, and help strengthen local news coverage with impactful, community-focused reporting.

Why The Telegraph?

Located in suburban St. Louis on the Illinois side — with a stunning view of the Mississippi River right from our newsroom — The Telegraph is a leader in covering the Metro East suburbs. Our team is committed to journalism that informs, engages, and holds institutions accountable. We offer a supportive environment where reporters can grow, experiment, and create meaningful work.

Job Description

We are seeking an energetic, versatile General Assignment Reporter to join our newsroom. The ideal candidate is eager to pursue a mix of daily reporting, enterprise work, and accountability journalism. This role will focus on local government and business coverage, while also contributing to breaking news, quick-turn stories, and longer-term investigative pieces. The person in this position should have strong news judgment, an ability to spot compelling stories, and a desire to learn and grow in a collaborative newsroom.

What will you do?

  • Report and Write: Cover key local issues with a focus on government, business, and community impact. Produce clear, engaging stories for digital and print platforms.
  • Enterprise & Investigative Reporting: Develop deeper, context-rich stories that go beyond the news of the day to explain why issues matter and how they affect local readers.
  • Breaking News: Jump on breaking news as needed, providing timely, accurate reporting and updates.
  • Quick-Turn Meeting Coverage: Cover evening or nighttime public meetings periodically, filing clean, quick-turn stories on tight deadlines.
  • Crime Coverage: Report on crime and public safety stories as needed, ensuring accuracy, context, and sensitivity.
  • Digital Storytelling: Use photos, videos, live updates, and other digital tools to enhance coverage and engage audiences.
  • Collaboration:  Work closely with editors, writers, and other newsroom teams to produce impactful journalism.
  • Audience Awareness: Monitor local and regional news, social media trends, and reader interests to identify strong story opportunities.

What will it take to be successful?

  • Published Work: A portfolio of published stories (student publications or professional outlets accepted).
  • Writing Skills: Ability to write with clarity, accuracy, and authority.
  • News Judgment: Strong sense of what makes a compelling local story that resonates with readers.
  • Initiative:  A self-starter eager to learn, pitch ideas, and pursue stories independently.
  • Collaboration:  Willingness to work with editors and peers in a fast-paced, evolving newsroom.
  • Education:  A bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications, or a related field preferred, but equivalent experience and published work will also be considered.
  • Technical Skills: Familiarity with digital publishing, multimedia tools, and social media is a plus.
  • Location: Must be based in the region or willing to relocate.

Our Benefits

At Hearst Newspapers, we support employees through personal and professional development and believe in promoting physical, financial, and emotional well-being — for you and your family. Our industry-leading benefits include:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
  • Competitive retirement plan with employer match in most markets
  • Generous Paid Time Off, including holidays and vacation
  • Paid Parental Leave for new parents
  • Monthly Child & Dependent Care Reimbursement
  • Mental wellness benefits
  • LGBTQ+ & inclusive health services
  • Fertility coverage & menopause support
  • Pet wellness reimbursement & Rover credits
  • And more — click here for full benefits details.

     

About The Telegraph

Founded in 1836, The Telegraph has long served the Metro East region as a trusted, award-winning source of local journalism. With deep roots in the community, we cover the people, policies, and issues shaping life in and around Alton, Madison County, and the broader Metro East area.

About Hearst Newspapers

Hearst Newspapers has 2,500 employees nationwide and includes 28 daily and 50 weekly publications, including the San Francisco Chronicle, Houston Chronicle, San Antonio Express-News, and Albany Times Union. We continue to invest in innovative ways to tell stories — growing newsrooms, evolving platforms, and expanding the tools journalists use to serve millions of readers.

 

In accordance with applicable law, Hearst is required to include a reasonable estimate of the compensation for this role if hired in the state of Illinois. The reasonable estimate, if hired in Illinois is $35,360. Please note this information is specific to those hired in Illinois. If this role is open to candidates outside of Illinois, the salary range would be aligned to that specific location. A final decision on the successful candidate’s starting salary will be based on a number of permissible, non-discriminatory factors, including but not limited to skills and experience, training, certifications, and education.
