job.title: Finance Accountant
job.description:
Sony Music Entertainment is currently looking for an experienced Financial Accountant to join our Finance team. You will be looking after our Malaysia and Singapore entities. Reporting to the Finance Director, you will be an integral member of the Sony Music Finance team and will be responsible for ensuring all reporting completed accurately and on time. 

What you'll do 

Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable

  • Manage end-to-end accounts payable processes, including purchase requests, purchase orders, supplier invoice verification, three-way matching, invoice processing, and payment workflows in accordance with company policies and approval requirements.
  • Review payment proposals prepared by shared services teams and ensure payment instructions are accurate and properly approved.
  • Manage accounts receivable activities including client invoicing, collections follow-up, cash application, receipting, and resolution of billing discrepancies.
  • Maintain accurate supplier and customer master data, supporting documentation, and respond to internal and external stakeholder enquiries in a timely manner.

General Ledger, Financial Close & Reporting

  • Prepare and post month-end journal entries, including accruals, prepayments, reclassifications, provisions, and other accounting adjustments.
  • Perform monthly balance sheet and general ledger reconciliations, including bank accounts, accounts payable, receivables, accruals, provisions, and other assigned accounts, ensuring timely investigation and resolution of outstanding items.
  • Prepare management accounts and support the interface between local statutory ledgers and corporate reporting ledgers, including US GAAP reporting requirements.
  • Manage monthly, quarterly, and year-end financial closing activities, ensuring all transactions are accurately recorded within reporting deadlines.
  • Maintain accurate accounting records and documentation to support financial integrity, audit readiness, and compliance with US GAAP, IFRS, and company accounting policies.

Financial Planning & Business Support

  • Support monthly forecasting and annual budgeting processes using global reporting and planning tools.
  • Assist in financial analysis and provide insights to support business decision-making and operational planning.
  • Monitor financial performance against budgets and forecasts, highlighting key variances and trends to stakeholders.

Tax Compliance & Reporting

  • Assist with tax compliance activities across Singapore and Malaysia, ensuring timely and accurate submission of required tax filings and reporting obligations.
  • Support periodic withholding tax filings, VAT/GST filings, annual corporate income tax returns, and other statutory tax submissions in accordance with local regulations.
  • Prepare and coordinate group tax reporting packages, including information required for corporate tax consolidation and global reporting requirements.
  • Assist with non-resident withholding tax (NRWT) compliance, including review of applicable requirements, supporting documentation, and timely submission of filings.
  • Maintain accurate tax records and supporting documentation while liaising with internal stakeholders, external tax advisors, and tax authorities to resolve queries and ensure compliance.

Audit, Governance & Internal Controls

  • Support year-end statutory audits by preparing audit schedules, reconciliations, and supporting documentation for external auditors.
  • Ensure compliance with internal controls, accounting policies, tax requirements, and regulatory obligations.
  • Identify opportunities to improve finance processes, strengthen controls, and enhance operational efficiency.

Royalty & Special Projects

  • Prepare royalty statements and financial reporting for joint venture deals, licensing arrangements, and other commercial agreements.
  • Support finance transformation initiatives, process improvement projects, and other ad hoc assignments as required.

Who you are

Key Skills & Competencies

  • Strong knowledge of accounts payable, general ledger, reconciliation processes, and financial close activities.
  • Detail-oriented and process-driven with strong analytical and problem-solving skills to investigate discrepancies and maintain financial accuracy.
  • Ability to manage multiple entities, currencies, and deadlines while working effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders and finance teams.
  • Ability to work independently while contributing positively to a collaborative finance team environment.

Education and Qualifications

  • Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, Business, Economics, or a related discipline, with CA/CPA qualification or progress towards professional qualification preferred.
  • 5 years of experience in accounts payable, general ledger accounting, financial accounting, or a similar finance operations role within a multinational or fast-paced environment.
  • Hands-on experience in invoice processing, purchase order workflows, payment runs, journal entries, month-end closing, and balance sheet reconciliations.
  • Experience with SAP ERP, Business Warehouse (BW), or other financial systems is preferred, with strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial reporting tools.
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial reporting processes, and internal controls, with experience managing multiple priorities and meeting tight deadlines.

What we give you

 

  • You join a vibrant global community with the opportunity to channel your passion every day 
  • A modern office environment designed for you, empowering you to bring your best 
  • Investment in your professional growth and development enabling you to thrive in our vibrant community 
  • The space to accelerate progress, positively disrupt and create what happens next 
  • We give you the platform to champion positive change, with the opportunity to contribute to our social impact, diversity, equity and inclusion initiatives

Equal Opportunities:

As an active part of a culturally and socially diverse society, Sony Music’s aim is that our workforce is diverse and inclusive. Sony Music is an equal opportunity employer and supports workforce diversity.
We employ, retain, promote and otherwise treat all employees and job applicants according to their merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We apply this policy without regard to any individual’s sex, race, religion, origin, age, sexual orientation, marital status, medical condition or disability.

Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses: 

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 

  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

Your role:

While creative teams focus on finding talent and building campaigns, you will be the engine ensuring our financial and procurement workflows run without a hitch. By managing purchase orders, tracking vendor onboarding, verifying payments, and delivering accurate budget reporting, you keep our operations compliant and our vendors paid on time.

Here you’ll get to:

  • Deliver excellent client service: Provide prompt and accurate support to internal and external inquiries. Occasionally join external partners meetings to review matters of your competence.

About you:

  • Laser-Focused Attention to Detail: High precision when inputting data, cross-checking figures, and auditing line items.

  • Comfort with Repetitive Work: Strong work ethic and high consistency when performing routine daily and weekly transactional tasks.

  • Agility & Smart Problem-Solving: Ability to navigate corporate systems quickly, track down missing information, and follow up proactively.

  • Clear Communication: Polite, firm, and clear verbal and written communication skills when dealing with external vendors and internal department heads.

  • Tech Literacy: Proficiency in Google Workspace, and comfort working with ERP/finance software (e.g., SAP, Oracle, or Coupa).

We’d love it if you also had:

  • Prior experience in an entry-level administrative, procurement, or finance support role.

  • Familiarity with corporate purchase order systems and accounts payable workflows.

  • A passion for music or entertainment operations.

  • An interest in leveraging modern tools (including AI assistants and automation tools) to simplify repetitive workflows, automate manual reporting, and improve daily operational efficiency.


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

job.title: Senior Principal Software Architect
job.description:
Who We Are:

SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, SiriusXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connect) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners – in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices. Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are. 

This is where a diverse group of emerging talent and legends share authentic and purposeful songs, stories, sounds and insights through some of the best programming and technology in the world. Our critically acclaimed, industry-leading audio entertainment encompasses music, sports, comedy, news, talk, live events, and podcasting. Regardless of their role, each of our employees is vital in bringing SiriusXM’s vision to life daily.

SiriusXM Media is the gateway for marketers to North America's most prominent digital audio advertising ecosystem. As the combined advertising revenue organization of SiriusXM Holdings Inc., SiriusXM Media spans across leading owned and operated audio platforms Pandora and SiriusXM; innovative ad tech solutions powered by AdsWizz; sonic creative consultancy Studio Resonate; and an extended content network featuring exclusive monetization agreements with Audiochuck, NBC Universal, SoundCloud, and many more. Reaching more than 150 million listeners each month, SiriusXM Media delivers audiences the tailored brand experiences they crave while putting creators first, making it easy for every marketer to produce, plan, buy and measure across its entire audio universe.

About AdsWizz

AdsWizz, a subsidiary of SiriusXM, is the leading global provider of digital audio and podcast advertising solutions. AdsWizz is the underlying monetization solution for well-known music platforms, podcasts, and broadcasting groups worldwide, giving advertisers of all sizes unprecedented access to premium and niche audio content. Through dynamic ad insertion, advanced programmatic platforms, and innovative audio formats, AdsWizz efficiently connects buyers and sellers for digital audio and podcast advertising. AdsWizz is a global company with a presence in over 40 countries and a Technology Development Hub in Bucharest, Romania.

How you’ll make an impact:

As a Senior Principal Software Engineer, you will join a highly performing-team of engineers who architect, and design podcast and ad-delivery services that are robust, scalable and secure. You will collaborate with cross-continent teams and execute initiatives while providing insights so AdsWizz technology infrastructure evolves with business objectives.

What you’ll do:

  • Design and build high-performance, stable, scalable AdsWizz systems that will be deployed in an enterprise setting.

  • Define and execute technology roadmap for Simplecast, Podcast monetization, Ad / Podcast delivery services.

  • Stay updated on the latest IAB standards for Podcast/Ad measurements, and modern protocols in the Ad Serving ecosystems, like oRTB, VASTadopt them onto AdsWizz services.

  • Establish and drive the evolution of AdsWizz audio and video transcoding features by integrating cutting-edge codecs and modern media formats.

  • Develop and maintain enterprise architecture frameworks that guide the technology investments across AdsWizz.

  • Lead high-level architecture discussions and planning sessions.

  • Collaborate with senior leadership to ensure that the AdsWizz’s technology roadmap are inline with its strategic objectives

  • Work with various teams of engineers building software in a collaborative development process.

  • Execute tasks with utmost clarity and precision, demonstrating a strong sense of ownership and providing clear direction to drive projects forward effectively.

  • Serve as a mentor, foster a collaborative environment and encourage and guide team members by being honest and direct.

  • Collaborate with the Product team to clarify the scope of the projects.

  • Collaborate with the Dev/Cloud Operations teams to ensure flawless production deployments and support the Incident Management team.

  • Contribute to the growth of various teams, by participating in interviewing and recruiting activities.

What you’ll need:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Computer Science/Mathematics or a similar field

  • Expertise in various concepts in digital ad serving, like forecasting, pacing models, real time bidding

  • Experience with advertising related protocols like openRTB and related data models.

  • Experience with Podcast technologies including delivering audio, and video assets via protocols like HLS

  • Strong understanding of engineering software processes, lifecycle methodology, configuration management, release management, and system verification and testing.

  • Ability to work independently and oversee entire projects or significant parts, focusing on completing the tasks on time.

  • Ability to collaborate with cross timezone teams, and negotiate design tradeoffs based on organizational goals and priorities.

  • Ability to collaborate across functions and communicate progress of large initiatives to senior leadership teams.

  • Proven ability to research and become proficient in new technologies

  • Experience identifying and debugging performance bottlenecks

  • Good understanding of RESTful API design principles, API security standards, and best practices in API versioning and management

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with meticulous attention to detail and a dedication to continuous improvement.

  • Proficiency in constructing detailed software architecture diagrams

  • Interpersonal skills and ability to interact and work with staff at all levels.

  • 15+ years of software engineering experience in Java programming language (preferably latest version of JDK), including 7+ years of experience crafting microservices and scalable products, utilizing diverse cloud platforms, ideally AWS. Proficient in implementing industry best practices and design patterns tailored for microservices-driven applications.

  • Strong technical expertise in the following areas:

    • REST API-based microservices using SpringBoot / Dropwizard and Hibernate.

    • Developing microservices that are large scale, high availability with circuit breakers & fault tolerant design.

    • Designing and maintaining Public APIs, with best practice version control, and backwards compatibility

    • IAB defined protocols like oRTB, VAST.

    • Proficiency with media containers such as Mp3 and Mp4, alongside audio-video codecs including H264, AAC/AAC+, and MPEG.

    • Deep technical knowledge of HLS streaming technologies and delivery protocols.

    • Hands-on experience with media processing tools like FFmpeg and AWS Elemental for advanced transcoding.

    • Relational Databases (preferably MariaDB or MySQL), NoSQL databases knowledge is a plus (e.g., Druid, DynamoDB, MongoDB)

    • Caching implementations (like Redis, Memcached, etc)

    • Messaging platforms (preferably Kafka, AWS EventBus)

    • Security basics (e.g., OAuth2 standard)

    • Working with containers (Docker, Kubernetes)

    • AWS Cloud Services, e.g., S3, Lambda, API Gateway, ElasticCache, CloudTrail, Athena, Kinesis, SQS, EKS, Cognito, etc.

    • Automated integration testing frameworks and tools, like Wiremock, Cucumber and Playwright.

    • Observability tools like Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack

    • Collaboration tools like Lucidchart, Jira and Confluence

 Additional preferred qualifications and technical proficiencies include:

  • Hands-on exposure to streaming server technologies such as Wowza, Icecast, or Shoutcast.

  • Working knowledge of polyglot programming, specifically with languages like Python and Go.

Our offer – what’s in it for you:

  • Casual & friendly working environment with opportunities to impact the company with your ideas and involvement

  • Technology diversity, interesting technical exposure in building the best ad-tech product on the market

  • Corporate annual bonus system to celebrate personal and company wins 

  • Individual training budget to use as you like for skill improvement

  • Sports bonus for activities such as gym, biking, and yoga

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we all have a story to tell. What’s yours?

 

If you share our passion for Canadian storytelling and you wish to help us engage with individuals and communities across our various digital platforms, this is where you’ll want to be!

 

Every day, you’ll have an opportunity to shape the way in which Canadians see themselves reflected in our digital services. Your work will have a direct impact on how millions of Canadians from various communities connect with our products, with one another and with the diverse voices that make our country so unique.

 

You’ll have the opportunity to play a part in enlightening and entertaining Canadians through our innovative work in building the mediums that deliver our content. We’re an innovative hub, where the talented professionals we work with are respected and valued for their contributions. Our product teams are vibrant, and our work culture strives to achieve the highest standards of diversity and inclusion. We believe that hiring people with different career paths and backgrounds is fundamental in our shared success and in building healthy, high-performing teams. When you join our mission, you’re not only shaping the vision of CBC/Radio-Canada, but the future of our country.

 

We know that commitment to equity, inclusion and diversity is essential to creating content that mirrors and resonates with the rich and evolving makeup of our country. We’re also committed to reaching out and connecting with our audience on multiple platforms; this includes creating virtual places where communities can come together.


This is a hybrid role with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

 

Why This Role Matters

 

You will be a core member of our software development team. Working closely with product managers and developers, your mission is to champion product quality from day one by embedding a shift-left testing strategy.

 

Rather than testing only at the end of the release pipeline, you will collaborate from the initial requirements and design phases to prevent defects, establish clear acceptance criteria and help shape our test architecture. You will drive comprehensive testing strategies — spanning automated, exploratory and regression testing — to ensure smooth, frequent and reliable releases while advancing adherence to quality standards and industry best practices.

 

Our team is responsible for the OHdio ecosystem, Radio-Canada’s flagship French-language audio platform. By joining this cross-platform initiative (covering iOS and Android mobile apps, web, connected car systems like CarPlay and Android Auto, and smart devices), you will directly impact the daily listening experience of hundreds of thousands of users. From live radio streams and original podcasts to audiobooks and curated playlists, you will ensure continuous stability, high performance and top-tier quality for a premier digital product.

 

Our Evolving Quality Culture

 

The OHdio team is actively transitioning to an integrated quality engineering culture. You won't be stepping into a rigid, pre-established framework; you will play a hands-on role in building it. You will help drive our shift-left practices, structure our automated testing stack (Playwright, Appium, TestRail) and define the engineering standards that will guide our team for years to come. If you want to make a lasting impact on how we build and ship digital products, this role is for you.


Perks you can look forward to:

  • Flexible work schedules, allowing you to prioritize yourself, your family and your work.
  • Work from home opportunities.
  • Competitive total rewards package.
  • Opportunities to work with cutting edge technology.
  • Opportunities for continued learning and professional development.
  • Opportunities to become a member of our Employee Resource Groups.
  • Pair programming and mentorship opportunities, where you can learn from the best in the industry and help coach new talent.
  • A creative and dynamic work environment, where your ideas and contributions can be heard, valued and respected.
  • A supportive management team committed to upholding the highest standards of diversity and inclusivity.
  • An environment which favours experimentation and an iterative approach in order to achieve the highest form of technical innovation.

 

How You Will Make an Impact

  • Actively participate in design sessions to identify acceptance criteria, edge cases, risks and functional ambiguities before development begins.
  • Act as a quality gatekeeper to ensure features meet all readiness criteria before entering the development workflow.
  • Draft and maintain structured test cases (BDD/steps) in TestRail, prioritizing them as the product evolves.
  • Define feature-level test strategies alongside developers, determining the appropriate test types (unit, integration, snapshot, E2E, manual) across each layer.
  • Identify and prepare necessary test data for validation.
  • Collaborate with developers during sprints to clarify acceptance criteria and resolve ambiguous technical behaviours.
  • Perform incremental validations throughout the sprint to catch defects early.
  • Document defects with clear, reproducible steps so developers can act on them immediately without back-and-forth.
  • Help build, expand and maintain our automated test suite in collaboration with developers.
  • Actively participate in the release management process.
  • Track and analyze quality KPIs (defect discovery stages, reopen rates, automation coverage, etc.) to drive data-informed retrospectives.
  • Share best practices with other QAAs to maintain consistent approaches across projects.
  • Empower all team members to work autonomously and take ownership of quality.

 

What You Bring

  • College diploma or university degree, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience working on complex web and mobile application development projects.
  • Strong hands-on experience with shift-left QA practices (e.g., drafting acceptance criteria and test cases prior to development).
  • Deep understanding of application life cycles across iOS, Android and web environments.
  • Solid grasp of test pyramid concepts (unit, integration, snapshot, E2E, smoke and regression testing).
  • Experience writing BDD test scenarios (Gherkin syntax) in TestRail.
  • Proficiency with API testing and payload validation tools (Postman, Playwright API or equivalent).
  • Ability to interpret CI/CD build results and diagnose pipeline failures.
  • Experience conducting structured exploratory testing.
  • Confidence in making data-driven go/no-go release decisions.
  • Strong collaborative approach when working alongside developers and product owners.
  • A proactive mindset with a knack for asking the right questions to resolve ambiguities before they turn into defects.
  • High attention to detail and self-direction skills.
  • Experience working within Agile environments.
  • Fluency in French (required).
  • Working knowledge of spoken and written English an asset.
  • Experience with mobile E2E automation frameworks (Appium, Detox or equivalent) an asset.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted testing tools (Copilot, MCP TestRail, agentic AI) an asset.
  • Proficiency with browser diagnostic tools (Chrome DevTools) an asset.
  • Understanding of digital accessibility standards (A11Y) an asset.

 

Please note this is a 12-month contract position, renewable annually. This regular position is not a consulting role but a long-term opportunity with competitive CBC/Radio-Canada employee benefits.

In this role, you will work closely with the host of CBC Morning Live on daily and longer-term projects. Working with the senior producer and other program leaders, you identify, develop and produce daily responsive video segments that run within live programming, while ensuring they’re optimized for people to watch on-demand on mobile. You will also liaise with other CBC News platforms to plan the rollout of host content and identify coverage opportunities. job.title: Promotions Director
job.description:
Promotions Director

Federated Media | Fort Wayne, IN
Stations: 92.3 FM/1190 AM WOWO, 97.3 WMEE, 98.9 The Bear, K105, 1380 The Fan

Position Overview

Federated Media Fort Wayne is seeking a Promotions Director to lead and execute all station promotions, events, contesting, and community engagement initiatives across five market-leading radio brands.

This is a hands-on role focused on planning, coordination, and execution, with additional operational and logistical support provided by a Promotions Coordinator. The Promotions Director owns the full promotions lifecycle from concept, through execution and recap, while providing clear direction, approvals, and oversight across on-air, online, and on-site platforms.

The role serves as the strategic and operational hub connecting Programming, Sales, Digital, on-air staff, and the Promotions Coordinator to ensure promotions are executed at a high level and on schedule.

Key Responsibilities

Promotions Strategy & Execution

  • Develop, plan, and execute station promotions aligned with each brand’s identity and audience.
  • Serve as the project manager for all promotions across on-air, web, social, email, and live events.
  • Plan and oversee major tentpole events, live broadcasts, charity initiatives, concerts, and station appearances.
  • Maintain strong working relationships with venues, promoters, sponsors, and community partners.


Contesting & Compliance

  • Design and manage contest structures, timelines, rules, and prize fulfillment.
  • Ensure all contesting and promotions are FCC-compliant and follow company guidelines.
  • Oversee ticket inventories, prize distribution, waivers, and winner documentation.


Event & Remote Management

  • Oversee all station events, remotes, and on-site activations from planning to execution.
  • Coordinate logistics including staffing, station vehicles, equipment, signage, and branding.
  • Serve as lead on-site representative at major station events.


Collaboration with Programming & Sales

  • Work closely with Program Directors to ensure promotions align with station strategy and on-air execution.
  • Collaborate with Sales to develop promotions that support client initiatives while protecting station brands.
  • Evaluate promotional proposals to ensure brand fit, execution feasibility, and audience value.


Digital & On-Air Support

  • Oversee promotional messaging across social media, websites, email, and on-air platforms.
  • Write or approve promotional copy including liners, social posts, web content, and text/email messaging.
  • Ensure accuracy, consistency, and brand alignment across all platforms.


Leadership & Team Management

  • Directly supervise and provide direction to the Promotions Coordinator and part-time promotions staff.
  • Assign and prioritize tasks, timelines, and execution details through established workflows.
  • Lead promotions meetings, assign tasks, and manage timelines and expectations.
  • Serve as final approval point for promotional concepts, messaging, and execution plans.


Reporting & Recaps

  • Produce promotional recaps including photos, documentation, and sponsor deliverables.
  • Track execution performance and provide post-promotion summaries to internal teams.


Qualifications

  • Prior experience in radio promotions, events, or related fields is preferred but not required.
  • Strong organizational, project management, and leadership skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple promotions simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work nights, weekends, and holidays as needed for events.
  • Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record.


What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunity to lead promotions for four highly visible radio brands.
  • A collaborative, fast-moving radio environment with strong community presence.
  • Supportive leadership and clear operational structure.

Federated Media is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Spanish Broadcasting System, Inc. (“SBS”), a leading Hispanic media and entertainment company, is seeking an experienced Chief Financial Officer to lead the Company’s finance organization and serve as a strategic partner to senior management.

Reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, the CFO will oversee the Company’s financial strategy and operations, including accounting and financial reporting, treasury, budgeting and forecasting, financial planning and analysis, internal controls, audit, tax oversight, and financial systems.

job.title: Senior Manager, Customer Engagement Analytics
job.description:
Fan Engagement Data Science turns fan behavior into the strategies that shape how millions of fans experience the NFL. In this role, you'll sit at the center of that work, partnering with our NYC team and stakeholders across Marketing, DTC, and Consumer Insights, while leading a distributed offshore delivery team to turn ambiguous ideas into sharp, high-impact analytics. You’ll work end-to-end, from framing the right question to presenting the answer to Director- and VP-level leaders, on a fast-moving team delivering against one of the NFL's biggest fan engagement programs.

Responsibilities

  • Translate ambiguous business questions from Marketing, DTC, and Consumer Insights stakeholders into scoped, high-impact analytical work.
  • Lead and coach a distributed offshore delivery team, keeping quality, pace, and prioritization on track across a compressed daily overlap window.
  • Own your work end-to-end — from framing a hypothesis to presenting recommendations directly to Director- and VP-level stakeholders.
  • Build strong partnerships across marketing, technology, BI, and data engineering as a trusted analytics voice in the room.
  • Design segmentation, predictive models, and experiments (A/B tests) that convert fan behavior into targeted, actionable marketing strategies.
  • Apply GenAI/LLM-assisted analytics tools, within governed workflows, to move faster from data to insight.
  • Define and manage KPIs for fan engagement, partnering with the BI Center of Excellence to expand access to insight across the org.
  • Champion data quality and integrity across every initiative you touch

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years in customer or fan data analytics, with a strong track record of translating data into marketing strategy.
  • Experience turning ambiguous business questions into scoped, delivery-ready analytical work.
  • Experience leading or closely partnering with distributed or offshore teams.
  • A confident, clear communicator — comfortable presenting directly to senior stakeholders.
  • Advanced SQL and Python; working knowledge of ML frameworks and GenAI/LLM-based analytics tools.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Economics, Statistics, or a related field.
  • Understanding of data management principles, including identity resolution and marketing consent.
  • Hands-on experience with a modern cloud data stack (e.g., AWS, Snowflake, or Databricks).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with customer data platforms (Adobe Experience Platform, or similar).
  • Familiarity with PII management and data privacy practices.
  • Experience with governed AI-assisted analytics workflows.
  • Familiarity with data observability tooling (e.g., Monte Carlo, Atlan).

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics

  • Bias to Ownership: Treats an ambiguous or stalled workstream as something to unblock and drive forward, not something to report status on and wait for direction.
  • Leadership Excellence: Strong leadership skills with a history of managing diverse, distributed, and cross-functional teams effectively.
  • Communication Mastery: Excellent ability to simplify complex data insights into strategic actions and communicate these clearly to both business and technical stakeholders, including in contested or high-pressure settings.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist, KRTV
job.description:
At KRTV, we tell the stories that matter most to the communities we serve. As a Multimedia Journalist, you'll research, report, shoot, write, edit, and deliver compelling local news content across multiple platforms. You'll be at the center of breaking news, community events, and impactful storytelling, helping viewers stay informed and connected.


This role offers the opportunity to build strong relationships throughout the Great Falls community while developing engaging content for broadcast, digital, and social audiences. If you're a passionate storyteller who thrives in a fast-paced newsroom, we'd love to hear from you.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Research, develop, and pitch story ideas from news leads, tips, and community sources.
  • Gather and verify information through interviews, observation, and independent research.
  • Write clear, accurate, and engaging stories that meet broadcast and digital editorial standards.
  • Capture high-quality video and still photography to support storytelling efforts.
  • Edit video content for television broadcasts, websites, social media channels, and other multimedia platforms.
  • Deliver live reports from the scene of breaking news, community events, and special coverage.
  • Appear on-air for interviews, narrations, and news presentations.
  • Collaborate with photographers, producers, and newsroom colleagues to create compelling content.
  • Assist producers with newscast preparation and content development.
  • Partner with digital teams to publish and promote stories across multiple platforms.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • Bachelor's degree in Journalism, Communications, or a related field preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Three or more years of journalism, reporting, multimedia, or related experience preferred.
  • Valid driver's license, strong driving record, and the ability to provide proof of insurance that meets company requirements.
  • Ability to travel locally for assignments and drive company or personal vehicles as needed.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Strong broadcast writing skills with knowledge of AP Style.
  • Experience with videography and non-linear editing systems preferred.
  • Working knowledge of broadcast-quality camera equipment.
  • Experience editing video using Final Cut Pro or similar editing platforms.
  • Proficiency with newsroom computer systems and digital publishing tools.
  • Ability to post and manage content across websites and digital platforms.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and storytelling skills.
  • A self-starter mindset with the ability to work independently and collaboratively.
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, deadline-driven news environment.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.

OUR TEAM:


At KRTV, you'll join a passionate team of journalists, storytellers, content creators, and community advocates dedicated to delivering trusted local news. We value collaboration, curiosity, innovation, and integrity. Our newsroom brings together people with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives who share a commitment to serving viewers and making a meaningful impact across north-central Montana.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:


Great Falls offers an exceptional quality of life with easy access to some of the most breathtaking landscapes in the American West. Situated along the Missouri River and surrounded by Montana's natural beauty, the area provides endless opportunities for outdoor recreation, including hiking, fishing, camping, skiing, and wildlife exploration.


Whether you're enjoying local restaurants, exploring nearby state parks, visiting cultural attractions, or taking in panoramic mountain views, Great Falls combines small-town friendliness with big outdoor adventure. It's an ideal place for journalists who enjoy connecting with their communities while experiencing all that Montana has to offer.

job.title: SVP, Sports Podcast Revenue
job.description:
AMP Sports is seeking a visionary, commercially minded Senior Vice President of Sports Podcast Revenue to lead revenue strategy, advertiser partnerships, sponsorship development, and commercial performance across its growing sports podcast portfolio. This executive will identify, develop, and scale high-value revenue opportunities across podcasts, digital video, social-first programming, talent-led franchises, and multi-platform sports experiences.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the sales strategy, client growth plan, and revenue performance for AMP Sports’ podcast and audio portfolio.
  • Develop and grow direct advertiser, agency, sponsorship, branded-content and strategic-partnership revenue opportunities.
  • Identify high-potential sports franchises, talent-led properties, audience segments, and cultural moments that can be transformed into scalable commercial offerings.
  • Partner with AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions to create compelling sales narratives, sponsorship packages, integrated marketing programs, and advertiser solutions.
  • Work alongside Sports Partnerships & Activations to develop premium partnership opportunities involving athletes, teams, leagues, live events, and brand activations.
  • Establish revenue targets, forecasts, pipeline discipline, pricing strategy, inventory models, and performance reporting for the business.
  • Build commercially viable packaging across podcast, video, social, digital, live, broadcast, and other relevant Sinclair platforms.
  • Develop relationships with senior brand marketers, agencies, media buyers, sports partners, platforms, talent representatives, and other strategic partners.
  • Identify new revenue streams, including branded content, custom programs, affiliate opportunities, licensing, commerce, events, subscriptions, and emerging platform monetization.
  • Partner with content, audience, analytics, legal, finance, and business affairs teams to ensure commercial opportunities are executable, brand-safe, and aligned with rights obligations.
  • Use audience data, market intelligence, advertiser feedback, and revenue performance to inform commercial strategy, product development, and investment priorities.
  • Recruit, lead, and develop a high-performing commercial team with clear accountability, strong collaboration, and a results-oriented culture.

  • Represent AMP Sports externally with clients, agencies, platforms, partners, and industry leaders.

     

What You’ll Bring

  • 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in sports media, podcasting, audio, digital media, advertising, sponsorship, partnerships, or a related commercial media business.
  • 8+ years leading senior sales, revenue, partnerships, business development, or commercial strategy teams.
  • Demonstrated success growing revenue for sports, audio, podcast, video, social, streaming, television, or talent-led media properties.
  • Deep understanding of advertising sales, sponsorship development, branded content, agency relationships, media monetization, and evolving sports-media consumption habits.
  • Experience developing multi-platform commercial packages across audio, video, social, digital, live events, and traditional media.
  • Strong financial and business judgment, including forecasting, pricing, inventory management, revenue planning, and performance analysis.
  • Proven ability to build and maintain senior-level relationships with brands, agencies, platforms, sports properties, talent, and strategic partners.
  • Experience negotiating or overseeing complex advertising, sponsorship, distribution, licensing, talent, or partnership agreements in partnership with legal and business affairs.
  • Exceptional executive presence, communication, negotiation, decision-making, and stakeholder-management skills.

  • High integrity and sound judgment in matters involving brand safety, rights, talent relationships, advertiser commitments, and audience trust.

     

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience monetizing a sports podcast, audio, digital-video, social, streaming, or multi-platform media portfolio.
  • Established relationships with national advertisers, media agencies, sports marketers, leagues, teams, talent representatives, and platform partners.
  • Experience launching new commercial products, scaling a revenue organization, or building monetization infrastructure during a period of rapid growth.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience; advanced degree is a plus.

     

How Success Will Be Measured

  • Revenue growth, profitability, forecast accuracy, and achievement of annual commercial targets.
  • Growth of advertiser, agency, sponsorship, and strategic-partner relationships.
  • Development of scalable, differentiated sponsorship and advertising products.
  • Expansion of revenue across podcasts, video, social, digital, live, and other Sinclair platforms.
  • Strength and health of the revenue pipeline, renewals, client retention, and long-term partnership value.

  • Recruitment, development, and retention of a high-performing commercial team.

     

About AMP Sports

AMP Sports creates distinctive sports storytelling and fan experiences across podcasts, digital video, social, creator-led content, and emerging platforms. As part of Sinclair, the group combines an entrepreneurial approach with broad reach, strategic relationships, and the resources to build meaningful audiences and scalable media properties.

The base salary compensation range for this role is $250,000 to $325,000. In addition, this role may be eligible for a discretionary quarterly and annual bonus which would be awarded based on individual and company performance. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors such as a candidates’ relevant work experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location. Full time positions are eligible for benefits that include participation in a retirement plan, life and disability insurance, health, dental and vision plans, flexible spending accounts, sick leave, vacation time, personal time, parental leave and employee stock purchase plan.

Overview:

If you thrive at the intersection of dealmaking, financial analysis, and creative judgment, this role is for you. We’re hiring a Director, Acquisitions to help shape Paramount Picture’s film slate. This role sits at the center of the studio’s acquisitions strategy, structuring and negotiating deals while partnering closely with finance and legal to evaluate opportunities across the global marketplace. You’ll build deep familiarity with the studio’s output and licensing deals, and use that knowledge to identify commercial opportunities that align with our broader strategy.   You will be the studio’s presence at major festivals and markets, including Sundance, Cannes, TIFF, and AFM, leading internal prep, briefing the EVP, and representing Paramount directly in conversations with filmmakers, producers, and sales agents. Beyond the deal, you’ll stay involved through post-production, offering creative feedback on cuts, and you’ll drive cross-departmental coordination through mastering, marketing, distribution, and publicity to ensure a successful launch.   This role requires someone who can move fluidly between financial rigor and creative instinct, with the relationships and market fluency to spot opportunities.  

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to: 

  • Structure, negotiate, and execute acquisitions deals, utilizing financial analysis and strategic insight in partnership with finance and legal teams
  • Lead financial evaluation of acquisition opportunities, partnering with finance to build and analyze P&L models to inform valuation and overall deal strategy
  • Maintain deep familiarity with the studio’s global output and licensing deals and leveraging them effectively in the evaluation of acquisition opportunities worldwide
  • Lead sourcing, tracking, and evaluation of packages across the global marketplace, identifying commercial opportunities aligned with the overall acquisition strategy
  • Maintain and cultivate strong relationships across agencies, financiers, filmmakers, producers, and international sales companies to gain access to high-level acquisition opportunities
  • Lead internal preparation for major film festivals and markets (e.g., Sundance, Cannes, TIFF, AFM), including identifying priority titles, coordinating team coverage, and preparing the EVP with relevant materials and market intelligence to align internal stakeholders around acquisition targets
  • Represent the studio in market-facing conversations at festivals and markets, attending screenings and meetings with filmmakers, producers, and sales agents to evaluate opportunities and communicate the studio’s acquisition priorities
  • Provide strategic guidance and creative feedback to filmmakers and producers on acquired projects, including reviewing cuts during post-production and collaborating with creative stakeholders to help shape the final film
  • Maintain deep familiarity with the domestic and international sales landscape, sourcing market intelligence on upcoming projects and monitoring buyer sentiment
  • Oversee the lifecycle of acquired titles from acquisition through release, driving cross-departmental coordination across mastering, marketing, distribution, publicity, and legal to ensure timely delivery, optimal windowing strategy, and successful launch
 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in film, Business, Media, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in film acquisitions, distribution, or sales, preferably with a major studio or agency

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Strong analytical and financial modeling literacy, with the ability to interpret P&L projections and apply financial insights to acquisition decision-making
  • Established industry relationships across the creative and sales communities
  • Strong understanding of the global film marketplace and distribution landscape
  • Proven ability to evaluate material, talent packages, and market dynamics through both a creative and commercial lens
  • Exemplary written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to interface effectively with senior leadership as well as external partners

job.title: Engineering Manager, Privacy & Governance Services
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

About the Role

The New York Times is looking for an Engineering Manager to join the Data Platform mission to lead the Privacy & Governance Services team. The team builds and maintains technical solutions that enable the NYT to stay in compliance with complex and rapidly changing domestic and international privacy laws. The team also enables data producers to own the quality of their data and data consumers to discover available high-quality data for their needs. You will report to the Senior Engineering Manager of Data Platform.

This is a hybrid role based in our New York City headquarters 3 days per week.

Responsibilities:

  • Coach engineers, helping them make an impact while growing in their careers.
  • Experience building a practice of automation for operational needs including running processes, SLAs, and escalation paths.
  • Oversee the execution of roadmap items and increase productivity and delivery.
  • Collaborate with product managers and partners to define product requirements and roadmaps.
  • Guide technical decisions and architectural design for the team's projects.
  • Monitor and report on initiative progress and risks.
  • Develop and maintain budgets, forecasts, and a cost attribution model for your team's cloud solutions
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 1+ years of experience as an engineering manager and 4+ years of experience in a technical leadership role working with cross-functional partners
  • 5+ years of experience in full-stack software engineering designing and developing scalable, high-performance systems that handle large volumes of traffic
  • Strong technical fluency and experience guiding architecture discussions
  • Experience developing a high-performing team and growing engineering competencies over time
  • Experience fostering a culture of high trust and productivity within the immediate team and cross-functionally

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience running engineering operations and technical projects that spans multiple teams.
  • Understanding of Privacy regulations and solutions for managing and respecting user consent and DSRs
  • Experience working with legal, compliance, and security teams to align privacy needs for product delivery

Position Title:

English (Reading - C - Advanced), English (Speaking - C - Advanced), English (Writing - B - Intermediate), French (Reading - C - Advanced), French (Speaking - C - Advanced), French (Writing - B - Intermediate)

Work at CBC/Radio-Canada

At CBC/Radio-Canada, we create content that informs, entertains and connects Canadians on multiple platforms. Our successes and accomplishments are driven by embodying and upholding values, which include creativity, integrity, inclusiveness and relevance. 
 
Do you think you have the ability and drive to keep up with this exciting, ever-changing industry? Whether it be in front of the camera, on air, online or behind the scenes, you would be joining a team that thrives on making connections and telling stories that are important to Canadians.

Unposting Date:

2026-10-12 11:59 PM

Behind the scenes, but ahead of the curve: help us develop the next-generation public service media.

 

The Technology & Infrastructure (T&I) team is the backbone and the future-forward arm of CBC/Radio-Canada. Our purpose is to constantly innovate to evolve and maintain the Corporation's technologies and infrastructure, enabling the creation and continued delivery of quality content across all platforms. We are the people that make stuff work. We make connections between media content, systems, people, and places. We are the space in between.

 

A place with purpose. CBC/Radio-Canada has always been a highly regarded pioneer of media technology—not just in Canada, but around the world. Today, we are transforming ourselves into a modern and agile public service media organization. Technology is the driving force and we are the team making it happen.

 

This is a hybrid role with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines and operational needs.

 

The Opportunity

 

Are you passionate about technology transformation, evolving operating models and shaping new ways of working from concept through to adoption? In this key role, you will serve as a strategic technology transformation adviser to leaders and teams, helping diagnose challenges, define and structure change initiatives, and drive operational implementation and adoption across the organization.

 

Reporting to the Director of the Operational Excellence Office within Technology & Infrastructure (T&I), you will join the team leading the Daily Content initiative in Innovation & Delivery. You will be joining us at a pivotal moment as CBC/Radio-Canada undergoes a major overhaul to modernize its content creation platforms. This transformation goes beyond software and tools — it redefines how production platforms are designed, delivered and used within an organizational model focused on product management, agile at scale, and continuous value creation.

 

In this role, you will combine a strategic consulting mindset with hands-on execution across all stages of the transformation. You will analyze complex issues, challenge established ways of working and provide actionable recommendations while actively driving their implementation by designing and producing the strategies, plans, frameworks, tools and other deliverables needed to execute and adopt the transformation.

 

Key areas of focus include transitioning to a product management model, modernizing collaboration with partners and contributors, and driving user adoption of new production tools. You will help define, structure and roll out the transformation and change management strategies required across all levels of the organization.

 

You will also play a central role in bringing together and aligning diverse teams and stakeholders across CBC/Radio-Canada around a shared vision and common goals. Your ability to grasp and navigate a complex organizational ecosystem, balance operational constraints and competing priorities, and exert influence without direct authority will be essential to align perspectives, build consensus, streamline decision-making and remove roadblocks.

 

Working alongside key stakeholders, you will support the organization in preparing for and implementing changes — including by developing and rolling out effective engagement and communications strategies — and by preparing and supporting end users in tandem with our Learning & Development partners.

 

You will work closely with operational and strategic leaders, as well as with the Daily Content Director, to structure challenges, shape recommendations and guide the evolution of work practices and production tools.

Beyond the Daily Content initiative, you will also help build the Office’s methods, practices and capabilities as well as nurture a transformation community of practice across CBC/Radio-Canada to share lessons learned and scale high-impact practices.

 

This position can be based in Toronto or Montreal, with occasional travel required.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Advise leaders and teams on defining and implementing technology transformations, engaging early in the life cycle to analyze needs, diagnose challenges, identify required changes and deliver recommendations aligned with the organization's vision and goals.
  • Guide departments and divisions in evolving their operating models and ways of working, advising on process design, governance, roles and responsibilities, and team collaboration structures.

  • Design and execute change management and adoption strategies and plans, incorporating impact assessments, organizational readiness, risk mitigation and stakeholder support.
  • Define and lead engagement, communication and capacity-building strategies — including user training and the preparation of delivery teams and change agents — in partnership with Learning & Development.
  • Proactively identify and resolve risks, resistance and operational roadblocks that could hinder transformation and adoption.
  • Define and track metrics to measure the progress, adoption and effectiveness of new ways of working, using data and insights to continuously refine strategies.
  • Actively participate in key transformation forums and events, including strategic and alignment meetings, sprint reviews, program demos and quarterly planning sessions.

 

What You Bring

  • Undergraduate degree in business administration, technology or a field relevant to organizational transformation (or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience).
  • Seven to 10 years' experience leading large-scale technology transformations, including evolving technology operating models, processes, governance structures, roles and responsibilities, and ways of working within complex, matrixed environments.
  • Proven track record as a strategic transformation adviser, with strong skills in analyzing and diagnosing complex issues, challenging current practices, formulating actionable recommendations and guiding execution.
  • Solid understanding of product management models and agile practices at scale, with hands-on experience applying them to tech transformations. Expertise in SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework), Scrum or other scaled agile frameworks required.
  • Experience with Lean and iterative transformation approaches, alongside the ability to adapt strategies and solutions based on key insights, data and frontline needs.
  • Demonstrated experience in end-to-end change management and adoption, including impact analysis, stakeholder engagement, strategic communications and capability building.
  • Knowledge of media production, broadcasting workflows and related technologies (e.g., audio/video editing, publishing, distribution, graphics generation) a major asset.
  • Proven ability to navigate complex organizational dynamics (including labour relations), manage resistance, resolve conflict and build trust-based relationships with stakeholders at all levels.

  • Exceptional facilitation and active listening skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, plain language.
  • Bilingualism in English and French (written and spoken) required.

Position Overview

WPXI Pittsburgh TV is seeking a Director of Engineering to lead the station’s technical operations, broadcast infrastructure, facilities systems, regulatory compliance, and technology modernization efforts. This role is responsible for ensuring reliable on-air operations, protecting the station license, maintaining studio and transmitter facilities, and partnering with News, Production, Sales, Traffic, Master Control, IT, and station leadership to support high-quality local journalism and business continuity. The Director of Engineering leads the technical team, oversees capital and operating budgets, manages vendor relationships, and drives continuous improvement across broadcast, IT, RF transmission, automation, production, network, cloud, and facility systems.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Lead all technical operations for the station, including studio production systems, newsroom technology, master control workflows, automation, media storage, signal distribution, ENG, remote production, and transmission facilities.
  • Ensure reliable, compliant operation of transmitters, towers, RF systems, satellite and microwave systems, EAS equipment, monitoring systems, generators, UPS systems, HVAC, and other critical infrastructure.
  • Protect the station license by maintaining compliance with federal, state and local regulatory agencies, including required documentation, inspections, testing, and corrective actions.

FOX Entertainment consists of three core business units. Through these strategic initiatives, the company is investing earlier in emerging ideas and new forms of audience engagement, while maintaining the ability to grow successful concepts into premium franchises across broadcast, streaming and global platforms. This role will drive revenue growth through the strategic licensing and distribution of FOX content across TVOD, electronic sell-through, and revenue-share business models.

  • Analyze account performance, title-level results, revenue trends, pricing, and promotional effectiveness to inform commercial recommendations
  • Manage promotional strategy, including content selection, pricing economics, merchandising opportunities, release timing, and marketing support
  • Evaluate and optimize content availability, rights, and windowing to maximize revenue across transactional and revenue-share opportunities
  • Partner with internal teams to coordinate title setup, product information, materials, pricing, availability, promotions, and other launch requirements
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Finance, Marketing, Operations, Content Planning, and Distribution teams to execute deals and account plans
  • Review and apply licensing agreements, deal terms, revenue-share structures, and other commercial arrangements to ensure accurate and effective execution
  • Support negotiations and deal structuring, balancing partner needs with FOX’s financial, rights, and strategic objectives
  • Track account commitments, timelines, deliverables, and workflows to ensure projects are completed accurately and on schedule
  • Monitor industry trends, competitive activity, platform changes, and emerging digital business models to inform sales strategy
  • Prepare clear account updates, sales analyses, forecasts, presentations, and recommendations for internal leadership and external partners
  • Identify and pursue new opportunities to expand distribution, improve performance, and increase the value of FOX’s content library
  • Represent FOX in relevant client meetings, industry events, and business planning discussions

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 7+ years of experience in transactional content sales, digital distribution, licensing, or account management, preferably at a major studio or media company
  • 2+ years of experience operating as a direct client-facing primary point of contact and managing day-to-day account activities
  • Experience managing promotional strategy, including content selection, pricing economics, merchandising, and marketing coordination
  • Deep understanding of licensed media rights, content availability, windowing, and digital distribution models
  • Demonstrated experience in sales analysis, performance reporting, forecasting, and joint business planning
  • Familiarity with licensing agreements, revenue-share structures, commercial terms, and deal execution; negotiation experience preferred
  • Strong critical-thinking skills and the ability to translate data, market dynamics, and client objectives into practical recommendations
  • Proven ability to lead projects and workflows across multiple teams while managing competing priorities and strict deadlines
  • Excellent communication, presentation, relationship-building, and stakeholder-management skills
  • Self-starter who takes initiative, exercises sound judgment, and is comfortable managing responsibilities with limited direction
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to manage multiple accounts, deliverables, and timelines in a fast-paced environment

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • MBA
  • Experience working with international clients, markets, or digital distribution businesses
  • Familiarity with AI tools and their practical application in professional environments

job.title: Associate Sourcing Specialist
job.description:
Working at QVC Group means joining a live social shopping company with incredible teams, ambitious projects and amazing careers. QVC Group, Inc. is a Fortune 500 company with six leading retail brands - QVC®, HSN®, Ballard Designs®, Frontgate®, Garnet Hill® and Grandin Road.

Your Opportunity, Your Team


The Associate Sourcing Specialist supports QVC, and helps bring apparel and accessories from concept through production with a focus on quality, speed, value, and on-time delivery.

In this role, you’ll support the day-to-day sourcing and product development process across multiple apparel and accessories categories. You’ll partner closely with Design, Technical Design, Buying, QA, Supply Chain, overseas offices, agents, and suppliers to keep development moving, manage costing and sample execution, and help ensure merchandise reaches the fulfillment center on time.

This is a strong opportunity for a sourcing or product development professional who enjoys working across functions, solving problems quickly, and managing details that have a direct impact on product quality, margin, and delivery. At the P2 level, this role is best suited for someone who takes ownership, communicates clearly, and can balance multiple priorities in a fast-paced retail environment.


Where You’ll Work

  • This role is on-site and will require you to be onsite at Studio Park Monday - Friday (9 am - 5 pm EST). Job seekers must reside in one of the following states to be considered: Pennsylvania, New Jersey, or Delaware. Relocation assistance is not available for this role.

What You’ll Do

  • Support product development and sourcing activities across multiple apparel and accessories categories from initial concept through delivery to the fulfillment center
  • Manage sample requests, track samples and costing in PLM, and prepare development information for review meetings
  • Partner with Design, Technical Design, Buying, QA, and Supply Chain to keep calendars on track, resolve issues, and maintain a smooth development process
  • Review cost sheets, challenge costing where appropriate, and support cost engineering to help achieve margin goals
  • Communicate daily with overseas offices, agents, and suppliers to monitor progress, maintain calendar milestones, and address production risks early
  • Track production status, identify delays or issues, and help drive solutions that support on-time delivery and uninterrupted merchandise flow
  • Support fabric development by building knowledge of fabric quality, garment construction, lead time, and cost implications
  • Maintain sourcing and vendor data in PLM, support vendor allocation activities, and contribute to reporting such as vendor scorecards, return rates, and star rating analysis
  • Identify process improvement opportunities that increase speed, accuracy, and efficiency across sourcing and product development workflows

What You’ll Bring

  • 2 to 5 years of experience in apparel merchandising, sourcing, product development, or product creation
  • Experience supporting apparel or accessories development from concept, sampling, and costing through production and delivery
  • Working knowledge of costing, margin impact, production timelines, and vendor or factory communication
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and solve problems in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong communication, organization, and follow-through skills
  • Ability to analyze data, identify patterns, and use sound judgment to support business decisions
  • Experience partnering cross-functionally with teams such as design, technical design, buying, QA, or supply chain

job.title: Product Designer II
job.description:
Sinclair Digital is seeking a Product Designer II to join the team! 

Major Goals:

Take ownership of assigned product experiences from discovery through implementation and iteration. Build a strong understanding of users, business goals, technology, and product performance. Collaborate with product, engineering, research, analytics, and stakeholders to create thoughtful, accessible solutions. Use Figma, research, data, and approved AI tools such as ChatGPT and Codex to improve design efficiency, quality, and outcomes. Share work early, communicate decisions clearly, and contribute to the growth of the Product Design team.

Key Result Areas:

Visual Design

• Demonstrates strong knowledge of layout, typography, color, visual hierarchy, responsive design, and platform

conventions.

• Creates polished experiences that support Sinclair's brand and meet user, product, and business needs.

• Produces accessible, inclusive designs with enough detail to guide implementation across platforms and screen sizes.

 

UX Design

• Creates clear information architecture, user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and interaction specifications.

• Considers the complete journey, including loading, empty, error, success, permission, and edge-case states.

• Uses research, analytics, feedback, and testing to understand problems, support decisions, and validate solutions.

 

Patterns

• Uses established design-system components and patterns to create consistent, intuitive, and scalable experiences.

• Balances shared patterns with platform conventions and the needs of each product and audience.

• Identifies gaps and helps improve, extend, and document reusable patterns across Sinclair products.

 

Product Thinking

• Understands the vision, audience, business goals, success measures, and constraints for the assigned product area.

• Connects design decisions to user needs, product objectives, technical feasibility, and measurable outcomes.

• Works with partners to clarify requirements and scope, then uses post-launch data to identify improvements.

 

Process

• Participates in discovery, exploration, validation, delivery, design QA, and post-launch evaluation.

• Explores multiple approaches, explains key decisions, and independently manages assigned work while

communicating risks and dependencies.

• Uses approved AI tools for appropriate tasks such as research synthesis, ideation, rapid prototyping,

documentation, and quality review.

• Validates AI-assisted work for accuracy, accessibility, brand alignment, bias, and technical feasibility.

• Supports implementation through organized files, clear specifications, developer walkthroughs, collaboration, and design QA.

 

Toolkit

• Demonstrates strong proficiency in Figma, including components, variables, prototypes, shared libraries, and

developer handoff.

• Uses ChatGPT and approved AI tools to support research, ideation, writing, accessibility reviews, and

documentation.

• Uses Codex and similar tools to build functional prototypes, explore feasibility, strengthen handoff, and support design QA.

• Verifies AI-generated work, maintains ownership of final decisions, and follows company requirements for privacy,

security, intellectual property, and responsible AI use.

 

Transparency

• Shares work early and regularly with design, cross-functional partners, and stakeholders.

• Communicates assumptions, unresolved questions, tradeoffs, risks, and next steps.

• Invites constructive feedback, documents important decisions, and keeps partners informed of changes.

 

Fluency

• Communicates effectively with product, engineering, research, analytics, editorial, and business partners.

• Understands different disciplines' priorities and constraints and accounts for them when developing solutions.

• Builds trust and works through scope and technical challenges while protecting the core user experience.

 

Communication

• Demonstrates strong written, verbal, visual, and presentation skills.

• Explains complex ideas and design decisions clearly, using relevant context and evidence.

• Keeps discussions focused, remains open to other perspectives, and communicates actionable next steps.

 

Mentorship

• Provides thoughtful, direct, and respectful feedback during critiques and project reviews.

• Supports less-experienced designers by sharing knowledge and constructive guidance when appropriate.

• Seeks coaching from Senior and Lead Designers to strengthen product thinking, craft, communication, and technical fluency.

 

Culture

• Identifies and supports design-led improvements within the assigned product area.

• Participates in critiques, workshops, team initiatives, and shared learning opportunities.

• Shares useful findings, patterns, templates, and AI-assisted workflows with curiosity, respect, and accountability.

 

Above the Line:

• Authentic Communication. Listen carefully, communicate directly and respectfully, and confirm shared

understanding.

• Constructive Negotiation. Address disagreements and tradeoffs collaboratively to move work forward.

• Impeccable Coordination. Keep key partners aligned on decisions, responsibilities, progress, risks, and changes.

 

 

Please note that this position is not eligible for visa sponsorship, including employer sponsorship for an H-1B visa, OPT-STEM employment, etc.
