job.title: Senior Coordinator, Business & Legal Affairs
job.description:
About ASCAP

The American Society of Composers, Authors and Publishers (ASCAP) is a membership association of more than one million songwriters, composers and music publishers, and represents some of the world’s most talented music creators. Founded and governed by songwriters, composers and publishers, it is the only performing rights organization in the U.S. that operates on a not-for-profit basis. ASCAP licenses a repertory of over 20 million musical works to hundreds of thousands of businesses that use music, including streaming services, cable television, radio and satellite radio and brick and mortar businesses such as retail stores, hotels, clubs, restaurants and bars. ASCAP collects the licensing fees; identifies, matches and processes trillions of performances every year; and returns nearly 90 cents of every dollar back to its members as royalties. The ASCAP blanket license offers an efficient solution for businesses to legally perform ASCAP music while respecting the right of songwriters and composers to be paid fairly. ASCAP puts music creators first, advocating for their rights and the value of music on Capitol Hill, driving innovation that moves the industry forward, building community and providing the resources and support that creators need to succeed in their careers. Learn more and stay in touch at www.ascap.com, on X and Instagram @ASCAP and on Facebook.

# # #

Job Overview:

The Senior Business & Legal Affairs Coordinator is responsible for documenting and recordkeeping agreements between ASCAP and its Members, along with other related tasks. This includes communicating with both internal and external stakeholders regarding the various time-sensitive aspects of Member agreements, Member transactions, or other sensitive and/or legal topics.

The ideal Senior Coordinator will be organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable using various platforms such as Microsoft Office Suite, Docusign, Salesforce, and other internal software. The Senior Coordinator must also leverage strong written and verbal communication skills when connecting with ASCAP Members and their professional representatives, which may include business managers, lawyers, and publisher representatives.

The Senior Coordinator will also work closely with other members of the department as needed to ensure that the goals of the Business and Legal Affairs team are consistently met. The role reports to the SVP, Membership and Business & Legal Affairs in the Business & Legal Affairs department. This is a hybrid position with a 3 day per week in-office requirement based out of the ASCAP New York Office.

Areas of Responsibility & Accountability:

  • Manage both the creation of and approval process for payment authorization forms.
  • Collect and verify all necessary documents and exhibits to finalize agreements.
  • Authenticate all payment information for any new payees.
  • Keep thorough records regarding all agreements, but also other high-value member documents that may be retained by BALA, Membership Creative, Distribution and Royalty departments.
  • Respond to requests from the Marketing and Events team with summaries of relevant information for members/attendees.
  • Review and confirm membership, catalog, and/or royalty information in response to urgent, legal, or otherwise sensitive requests.
  • Communicate directly with Members, their representatives, and various ASCAP staff to address complex performing rights issues, providing direct assistance and facilitating internal handoffs when appropriate.
  • Process attorney requests and implement any instructions relating to disputes or other issues such as submitting stop-payments or compiling related background data, when necessary.
  • Coordinate interdepartmental responses pertaining to issues regarding Member legal transactions (i.e., Royalty, Distribution, Repertory, Global Member Services, etc.).
  • Complete additional administrative or filing responsibilities, as needed.

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree and strong academic background required.
  • 3+ years of experience with a law firm, in-house legal department, or equivalent.
  • Proficiency in Word and Excel (incl. pivot tables) and general comfort with numbers.
  • Extraordinary work ethic with the ability to follow detailed instructions.
  • Ability to think analytically, work independently, and take direction well.
  • Comfortable handling time-sensitive matters in a fast-paced environment.
  • Able to maintain the highest level of confidentiality and discretion.
  • Superb written and oral communication skills.
  • Track record of success in a highly detail-oriented environment.
  • Analytical problem solver with a highly organized approach.
  • Experience working with legal agreements and contracts.
  • Familiarity with the music publishing business is a plus.
  • This position requires the incumbent to be in the office three days per week.

Compensation/Benefits:

Besides providing a unique and dynamic work environment, there are a few other reasons you should consider ASCAP in your career planning. We also offer generous benefit options that are comprehensive and provide the flexibility that most employees want and need. These health care and financial plan options include the following:

  • A choice of either network-only provider medical and dental plans or more flexible medical and dental plans where you can see providers in or out-of-network
  • Vision plan that offers both in and out-of-network provider options
  • 401(k) Plan that offers pre-tax, Roth, and an after-tax employee contribution option which includes a company match
  • An additional employer paid discretionary profit share contribution, regardless of your participation in the 401(k) Plan
  • Generous time-off policy

This summary is not complete and is subject to the terms of the underlying plan documents. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

About the Role, Mission or Department Overview

The Senior System Analyst is an individual contributor within Enterprise Technology responsible for the configuration, release management, and operational support of Zip, our procurement and intake platform. You will partner with multiple teams, including Sourcing, Accounts Payable, Finance, Legal, and Enterprise Applications. Your partnerships will ensure Zip remains stable, well-governed, and aligned with Workday and other SaaS financial applications.

  • Manage Zip configuration, including workflows, fields, validations, permissions, and company settings

  • 5+ years of experience administering or configuring SaaS procurement or finance applications

job.description:
Multi-Media Account Executive

*This is a full-time, in-office opportunity. * 

 

Take Your Sales Career to the Next Level:

Are you a driven, goal-oriented seller looking to grow your career in a high-impact role? At Townsquare Media Group, we’re seeking experienced Account Executives who thrive in a fast-paced environment, love building relationships, and are motivated by helping local businesses succeed. If you’re a confident closer with a passion for strategic, consultative sales—this is your opportunity to make a real impact.

 

Why Townsquare Media Group?

Townsquare is a media, entertainment, and digital marketing solutions company dedicated to serving small and mid-sized markets across the U.S. We own and operate 354 radio stations and more than 400 local websites across 74 markets—including our trusted Rockford stations.

We combine the power of local media with best-in-class digital solutions to help businesses grow—offering everything from broadcast and digital advertising to SEO, web design, and programmatic marketing.

  • Prospect, qualify, and secure new business using data-driven insights and tools
  • Conduct in-depth needs assessments and present tailored marketing strategies
  • Represent our full portfolio of solutions including broadcast, digital, programmatic, and event sponsorships

  • Exceptional presentation, interpersonal, and communication skills
  • Valid driver's license, auto insurance, and vehicle (required)
  • BA/BS degree (preferred)

 

What’s In It for You?

We know sales is a grind, but the rewards are real. Here’s what you get:

The Assistant News Director helps lead the newsroom’s daily editorial, operational and people-management responsibilities. This position works closely with the News Director to deliver accurate, impactful local journalism across broadcast, digital and social platforms.

This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, building a culture where people feel connected, inspired, and proud of the work they do.  We grow here, and we enjoy it here.

We're searching for a visionary leader — a driven, talented VP, General Manager to lead one or more of our local content centers and monetization and marketing teams. In this role, you'll be the architect of strategy, the champion of growth, a steward of culture and the heartbeat of operational excellence. If you're energized by leading high-performing teams, driving revenue, and making a lasting impact, we’d love to hear from you.

Sounds Like the Right Fit? Check Out the Checklist Below and if it sounds like you, hit “Apply Now” and let’s chat. 

 

Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook)

Help Us Thrive
You’ll lead the charge in amplifying our market presence, ensuring every team — from content creation to sales — is aligned with our strategic goals and delivering results.

Results-Driven
Maximize share of wallet across all media platforms in your marketplace. You’ll guide sales and marketing teams to hit revenue targets, grow audience engagement, and build lasting client relationships.

Strategic Planning
Develop and implement innovative business plans across departments. You’ll identify growth opportunities, analyze market trends, and ensure every team is set up for success.

Team Development
Mentor and inspire cross-functional teams while actively shaping a positive, inclusive, and high-performance culture. You’ll model our values, foster collaboration, reinforce accountability, and create an environment where people feel engaged, supported, and motivated to do their best work. Your leadership will develop future leaders and strengthen team cohesion. 

Market Analysis
Dive deep into competitive landscapes and audience data. Your insights will fuel expansion strategies and keep us ahead of the curve.

Authentic Relationships
Build strong relationships with clients, advertisers, community leaders, and industry partners. Internally and externally, you’ll be a visible culture carrier and the  face of AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions in your market, amplifying our reputation and impact.

What We're Looking For

✔ Proven Leadership

Recruiting database (RDB)

job.description:
Job Title

Manager, Data Operations

Job Description

About The Position:

The Manager, Data Operations leads the design, reliability, and day-to-day execution of the company's core data pipelines and analytics infrastructure while directly managing a team of Data Engineers and Analytics Engineers. This role combines hands-on technical leadership with people management accountability, ensuring that data systems are scalable, trusted, well-documented, and aligned with business priorities. The role is responsible for setting technical direction, prioritizing team work-streams, developing talent, and ensuring cross-functional alignment across Analytics, Product, and Technology. This is both a strategic leadership role and a hands-on operational steward for the company's data platform.

In-office Expectations: Hybrid NYC. This position is hybrid in-office, with the ability to work remotely for up to 3 days per week.

About The Position's Contributions:

Accountabilities, Actions, and Expected Measurable Results

30%

Data Engineering & Pipeline Operations

•    Own the design, reliability, and scalability of ingestion, transformation, and storage pipelines

•    Ensure ELT/ETL processes run with high uptime and strong data quality

•    Guide orchestration, monitoring, and performance optimization

•    Reduce operational fragility by promoting shared patterns and automation

30%

Analytics Engineering & Data Modeling

•    Oversee development and maintenance of clean, tested, well-documented data models (e.g., dbt)

•    Define standards for modeling and semantic consistency

•    Ensure downstream BI and analytics consumers have trusted, well-structured datasets

20%

Governance, Quality & Trust

•    Establish clear metric definitions and semantic models

•    Partner with Governance and Security teams on lineage, metadata, and access controls

•    Reduce metric inconsistencies and reporting ambiguity

•    Ensure compliance with privacy and security standards

20%

Business Partnership & Communication

•    Serve as a data advisor to Analytics, Product, and business leadership

•    Translate business priorities into technical roadmaps

•    Communicate complex technical concepts and trade-offs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences

•    Prioritize investments based on measurable business impact

What You’ll Do:

  • Manage and mentor a team of data engineers responsible for building and maintaining core data models, dashboards, and scalable data products.

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business needs, gather requirements, and deliver high-quality data solutions that support reporting and decision-making.

  • Design, implement, and optimize performant, well-documented data models that enable self-service analytics and strategic initiatives.

  • Define and champion engineering best practices around code quality, documentation, version control, and testing within analytics workflows.

  • Lead or support ad-hoc data analyses to uncover insights and drive business strategy.

  • Stay up to date on industry trends and new technologies to continuously improve our data architecture, tooling, and processes.

What You Bring:

  • 7+ years of experience building and optimizing data pipelines using Python or similar programming languages.

  • 5+ years of advanced SQL experience working with relational and distributed data systems (e.g., Hive, BigQuery).

  • Hands-on experience with dbt for data transformation and pipeline management.

  • 2+ years of experience leading or mentoring a team of data or analytics engineers, or owning end-to-end delivery of large-scale data products.

  • Strong leadership and talent-development skills

  • Excellent communication across technical and business audiences

  • Strong prioritization, decision-making, and documentation discipline

  • Familiarity with cloud data platforms such as BigQuery, Snowflake, or AWS/GCP.

  • Experience with data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or similar is a plus.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

job.title: Workplace Investigator
job.description:
At Corus Entertainment, we’re shaping the future of media in Canada—home to the country’s biggest hits, most trusted news, and greatest value. Our mission is simple: to create engaging content, connect with audiences wherever they are, and drive meaningful growth.

Guided by our values—Think Boldly, Make a Positive Impact, Win as a Team, and Own the Outcome—we bring creativity and collaboration to everything we do.

If you’re ready to make an impact, there’s a place for you at Corus.

Division: Legal, Regulatory and Governance

Work Status: Full-Time

Location: Toronto, ONT (Hybrid)

About the Role:

As a key member of Corus Entertainment’s Legal, Regulatory and Governance department, you will lead the resolution of complex and confidential respect, safety and violence in the workplace complaints in a manner that is compliant with the Canada Labour Code and applicable workplace policies. You will be responsible for conducting timely, unbiased and fair investigations or engaging in other forms of resolution, including conciliation. You will also lead complaint intake, case documentation and management, and provide regular status reporting, including annual reporting under the Canada Labour Code. You will join a talented and collegial team that works closely with business partners and will report directly to the Director, Legal Counsel, Employment and Investigations.

You’ll contribute by:

• Conducting timely and confidential workplace investigations in areas including discrimination, workplace harassment, including sexual harassment, and violence.

• Conducting interviews, gathering and analyzing evidence, assessing credibility, and writing formal investigative reports with findings.

• Providing recommendations in accordance with established legal practices, policies and any applicable collective agreement.

• Acting as a conciliator to facilitate the process for parties that elect this resolution.

• Supporting the development and interpretation of policies and delivering training.

• Conducting the intake of investigation files, case management and post-investigative reporting and tasks.

• Conducting regular reporting on workplace complaints, investigations and other resolution avenues.

Skills and experience you will bring:

• Minimum of three (3) years of related work experience managing and resolving workplace complaints and conducting complex workplace investigations, including experience in facilitating alternative dispute resolution.

• Demonstrated experience facilitating the management and resolution of workplace complaints in a manner that is compliant with the Canada Labour Code and applicable workplace policies.

• Experience documenting investigative findings and writing reports that are clear, concise, complete, and provides analysis of the evidence considered in reaching conclusions.

• Demonstrated awareness, understanding and experience identifying and addressing discrimination and harassment, including racism and systemic and intersectional forms of discrimination.

• Ability to effectively manage multiple investigations, identify risks, react to changing situations and manage multiple priorities in a timely and judicious manner.

• You are an innovator, always looking to develop and improve your approach and that of the team, in line with legislative changes and industry best practice.

• Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a team environment yet independently on assigned files.

• Excellent writing and analysis skills.

• Able to handle confidential information in a mature and professional manner.

• Strong ability to multi-task and respond effectively to changing priorities and demands.

• Develop trust and rapport and influence partners and business leaders.

• Exemplifies Corus’ values and foster an inclusive and respectful working environment.

• Excellent project management, prioritization and planning skills.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist/Anchor
job.description:
The MMJ/Anchor creates and presents original news and other interesting content across broadcast, streaming, digital, social, and emerging platforms in a manner that is clear, engaging, and meaningful to consumers.

The successful candidate is an enterprising storyteller who can develop story ideas, report, write, shoot, edit, publish, and present content that connects with audiences wherever they consume information.

This position combines strong on-air presentation skills with the ability to create compelling content that informs, engages, and serves the communities we cover.

 

Responsibilities:

• Creates original news, feature, lifestyle, consumer, and other interesting content through enterprise reporting, research, interviews, and community engagement.

• Anchors live and recorded programming across broadcast and streaming platforms.

• Develops original story ideas and content that inform, engage, and grow audiences across multiple platforms.

• Produces original content for CW39+, including live streams, interviews, feature stories, special projects, and audience-focused programming.

• Shoots, writes, edits, publishes, and presents content independently as assigned.

• Creates content for digital and social platforms, including articles, videos, live streams, and audience engagement initiatives.

• Identifies trends, issues, people, and stories that matter to local audiences and develops compelling content around them.

• Collaborates with producers, reporters, photographers, and digital teams to create impactful multi-platform coverage.

• Writes and delivers content in a clear, conversational, authentic, and audience-focused manner.

• Conducts interviews with newsmakers, community leaders, subject matter experts, and members of the public.

• Responds to breaking news and other urgent newsroom situations as required.

• Participates in promotional activities, community events, and public appearances.

• Engages with viewers and users through social media and other digital platforms.

• Ensures that all content meets company standards for journalistic integrity, accuracy, and production quality.

• Performs special projects and other duties as assigned.

 

Requirements & Skills:

• Bachelor's degree in Broadcast Journalism, Communications, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience.

• Fluency in English.

• Excellent communication skills, both oral and written, with the ability to ad lib when required.

• Minimum five years' experience in reporting, anchoring, multimedia journalism, or content creation for news and media platforms.

• Superior on-air presence and live presentation skills.

• Strong storytelling abilities across broadcast, streaming, digital, and social platforms.

• Demonstrated ability to develop original story ideas and create enterprise content.

• Experience shooting, writing, editing, and publishing content across multiple platforms.

• News judgment with a strong understanding of current events, issues, and community interests.

• Ability to create content that informs, engages, and connects with diverse audiences.

• Strong social media and audience engagement skills.

• Ability to work independently while managing multiple deadlines and priorities.

• Ability to effectively listen, understand challenges, and collaborate with a team to shape solutions.

• Proficiency with newsroom, editing, streaming, and digital publishing technologies.

• Valid driver's license with a good driving record.

• Flexibility to work any shift.

job.title: Manager, International Growth
job.description:
The Manager, International Growth is a critical strategic leader responsible for helping to shape the future of the NFL’s global business. This high-impact role is a thought partner to senior leadership, driving the evaluation, development, and execution of initiatives that accelerate the League’s expansion and deepen its influence in international markets.

This position is essential in identifying growth opportunities, aligning cross-functional stakeholders, and advancing the NFL’s strategic priorities across global territories. The ideal candidate combines sharp strategic thinking and a collaborative mindset to help unlock long-term business value on the world stage.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the design, refinement, and execution of international growth strategies that generate long-term enterprise value for the League, balancing financial return, strategic positioning, operational feasibility, and partnership alignment.
  • Act as a trusted strategic advisor by identifying new market opportunities and developing clear, data-backed recommendations for global business expansion.
  • Serve as end-to-end project lead for high-profile initiatives: developing business cases, building execution frameworks, managing cross-functional collaboration, and delivering post-launch analysis to senior leadership.
  • Own the financial modeling, KPI development, and ongoing performance monitoring of international growth initiatives.
  • Cultivate strong partnerships across key NFL departments, including Sponsorship, Consumer Products, Media, Football Development, Events, Club Business Development, Legal, Finance, and Marketing, ensuring seamless integration of global strategies.
  • Drive cross-regional collaboration and knowledge sharing between NFL territory offices and League headquarters, facilitating operational excellence and strategic alignment.
  • Develop polished, executive-ready presentations and strategic materials for senior stakeholders and NFL leadership.
  • Support the International and Events leadership teams in annual business planning.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in strategy, business development, or management consulting — ideally with exposure to global sports, media, or entertainment industries.
  • Proven ability to manage complex, cross-functional projects from ideation through execution in fast-paced, matrixed environments.
  • Advanced capabilities in financial modeling, business case development, and strategic storytelling (Excel and PowerPoint proficiency required).
  • Outstanding organizational skills, attention to detail, and a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset.
  • Exceptional communication and relationship-building abilities, with sensitivity to diverse cultural and geographic nuances.
  • Creative thinker with a passion for solving business problems and unlocking new opportunities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in international business strategy, sports management, or global brand expansion.

Salary $95,000—$120,000 USD

job.title: Senior Information Security Engineer
job.description:
The Senior Information Security Engineer will support an enterprise security program including conducting deep-dive Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) assessments, developing and delivering security awareness training campaigns, identifying, tracking, and coordinating vulnerability remediations based on threat intelligence feeds, performing litigation support and investigations, establishing policy enforcement processes, and engineering automations to improve time to deliver using Artificial Intelligence (AI) or automation platforms.

The applicant must have prior experience engineering security solutions with successful deployments in complex commercial enterprise environments. The candidate should have prior experience in a security operations or engineering role, with expertise conducting third-party, software, and vendor risk assessments. Additional required skills are, developing and enhancing security policies and standards, and hands-on knowledge of cloud (SaaS) and hybrid network infrastructure environments, establishing automations to improve accuracy and speed of outcomes, and performing disaster recovery (DR) /Continuity of Operations (COOP) assessments. The candidate will possess strong and polished communication skills, willingness and ability to present security topics to internal and external customers and thrive in a highly visible and fast-paced role. 

Responsibilities:

Process & Execution

  • Conduct high-quality and timely third-party/vendor/service provider/software risk assessments, with the ability to meet SLAs and communicate effectively with all stakeholders.
  • Contributes to the creation and maturation of information security policies and processes. 
  • Identifies opportunities to automate manual processes and successfully engineers and delivers on process improvements according to assigned timelines.
  • Develops and delivers Disaster Recovery and Continuity of Operations risk assessments to business units successfully establishing resiliency plans for the company. 
  • Assist with the governance of the enterprise Policy Exception process including stakeholder engagement, driving completion with internal teams, and providing balanced reports that will be visible to senior leaders.
  • Create, adapt, and enhance weekly metrics to measure program effectiveness.
  • Evaluate security architectures including the ability to identify risks, compensating controls, and mitigation plans.
  • Develop custom security awareness and phishing campaigns to elevate employee knowledge of current trends and threats to Sinclair.
  • Perform, and maintain litigation and data retention holds using eDiscovery and other actions to support Sinclair Legal requests.
  • Ability to multitask, prioritize, and remain organized with simultaneous assignments while remaining flexible and resilient. 
  • Maintain a high level of professionalism and integrity with the ability to effectively communicate with internal and external stakeholders. 
  • Ability to think strategically, plan methodically, and execute tactically.
  • Take ownership of personal and professional development needed to excel in the role.

Collaboration & Partnerships

  • Apply excellent communication skills to efficiently collaborate with company stakeholders and business partners.
  • Ability and prior experience delivering live training sessions to diverse audiences.
  • Evaluate and recommend new products, maintain knowledge of emerging technologies, and maximize value from existing tool sets to ensure return on investment. 
  • Demonstrate strong problem-solving skills by identifying gaps or issues and clearly formulating solutions.
  • Ensure compliance with Sinclair policies and standards by communicating requirements to internal stakeholders.
  • Proactively respond to information security tickets and requests according to team SLA.
  • Collaborate with third parties to remediate risks to effectively minimize attack surface.
  • Operating with a strong sense of teamwork and personal accountability.

Performance Improvement

  • Identify areas of improvement within the security team to maintain a level of excellence.
  • Design, document, and implement procedures for analyzing and evaluating risk. 
  • Proactively and effectively look for ways to improve and optimize processes and techniques. 
  • Research emerging technologies and provide options to leadership for problem solving. 
  • Champion collaboration amongst teams, quality execution on assignments, and take personal accountability for deliverables.
  • Thrive within fast-paced operational environment requiring priority adjustments, multi-tasking, and a high-level of communication skills.
  • Ability to self-motivate and go the extra mile to ensure team success. 
  • Maintain a positive and customer-oriented approach to daily operations.         
  • Comfortable working directly with other teams such as Legal, Privacy, and IT.

 

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Information Technology, or related discipline. 
  • 7 years of relevant work experience or a combined background in the following areas: third-party risk management, security operations, security engineering, risk management, vulnerability management.
  • Experience with enterprise threat intelligence and third-party risk management platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience leveraging artificial intelligence (AI) and automation tools to streamline workflows, improve operational efficiency, and enhance decision-making.
  • Understanding of SOC-2, ISO-27001, and NIST SP 800 “series” frameworks with the ability to identify and mitigate control gaps.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with an ability to present complex information to audiences of varying subject knowledge. 
  • Solid technical background with the ability to understand network and systems architectures. 
  • Prior experience working in commercial multi-cloud provider environments.
  • Industry certification required in one of the following areas: (e.g., CISSP, CISM, CRISC, Security+, CISA, or equivalent).
  • Basic knowledge of current data privacy laws (CCPA/CPRA, GDPR).
  • Prior experience in the broadcast/media entertainment industries preferred.
  • Experience conducting litigation holds, retention requests, and eDiscovery is a big plus.
  • Commercial enterprise experience is required.

job.title: Product Owner
job.description:
At Sinclair, the Product Owner is accountable for maximizing the value, reliability, and continuous improvement of established SaaS platform(s) used by internal teams. The role balances product enhancements with production stability, incident-driven priorities, technical health, vendor coordination, and evolving user needs. Working closely with business stakeholders, support, operations, and external providers, the Product Owner establishes clear product goals, orders the backlog, evaluates outcomes, and ensures that changes deliver measurable value.

Required Experience & Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 3+ years of Product Ownership experience, including Agile Scrum practices.

Demonstrated ability to:

  • Lead through influence, facilitate decisions, resolve competing priorities, and align business, technical, operational, and vendor stakeholders.
  • Analyze complex software behavior, reproduce issues, assess business impact, and coordinate diagnosis and resolution with technical, support, and vendor teams.
  • Create clear, appropriately scaled product artifacts, including goals, roadmap outcomes, user stories, acceptance criteria, nonfunctional requirements, defects, operational improvements, and decision records.
  • Prioritize and organize customer feedback, product data, support cases, incident trends, and operational metrics to guide product and service performance.
  • Customer-focused mindset with empathy, curiosity, sound judgment, and a commitment to continuous learning and improvement.
  • Proactive, adaptable, and effective when working through ambiguity, change, and deadline pressure.


Responsibilities:

Business Intake and Prioritization:

  • Build relationships across departments to understand business processes, user needs, pain points, and desired outcomes.
  • Gather and clarify requirements with stakeholders, end users, and subject matter experts; organize requests for prioritization based on business value, user impact, risk, dependencies, and organizational objectives.

Backlog and Roadmap Management:

  • Maintain a clear backlog and roadmap covering enhancements, defects, operational improvements, and support-driven needs.
  • Communicate priorities, requirements, constraints, and expected outcomes to stakeholders and vendor(s).

Vendor Governance, Delivery, and Validation:

  • Review vendor solutions, plans, estimates, dependencies, delivery progress, commitments, and service-level obligations; escalate gaps and risks.
  • Coordinate QA and UAT for release readiness, including defect resolution, business impacts, communications, training, and support readiness

Production Health and Continuous Improvement:

  • Monitor service performance, incidents, recurring defects, user feedback, and operational metrics to identify risks and improvement opportunities.
  • Review major incidents, root causes, corrective actions, and delivered outcomes with support, operations, and the vendor.

Product Knowledge and Documentation:

  • Maintain product knowledge and essential documentation, including goals, requirements, decisions, roadmap outcomes, and release notes.
  • Other duties as assigned.

job.title: Finance Manager, Digital, Record to Report
job.description:
TelevisaUnivision is seeking a highly motivated Manager, Record to Report (Digital) to support the Digital Finance organization. This role is responsible for overseeing key accounting activities related to the monthly close process, general ledger management, account reconciliations, and financial reporting for the Digital business. The position partners closely with Digital Finance leadership to ensure accurate and timely financial results while driving process improvements, maintaining strong internal controls, and leading a team of accounting professionals. The position reports to the Vice President, Record to Report.

ABOUT YOU:

You are a collaborative and detail-oriented accounting professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment. You excel at managing competing priorities, solving complex problems, and partnering with leaders across the organization to deliver accurate financial results, strengthen internal controls, and drive continuous process improvements. You are an effective communicator and team player who can build strong relationships and lead accounting professionals to achieve shared goals.

YOUR DAY-DAY: (aka Responsibilities)

Financial Close and Reporting

  • Oversee the monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes to ensure timely and accurate financial reporting.
  • Review and approve journal entries, ensuring compliance with company accounting policies and close calendar deadlines.
  • Review account reconciliations and ensure they are prepared, reviewed, and certified in accordance with company policies and internal control requirements.
  • Prepare and review quarterly flux analysis packages, providing meaningful explanations of financial results and variances.
  • Partner with the Digital CFO and Finance team to ensure the accuracy and integrity of financial statements.

Accounting and General Ledger Management

  • Manage day-to-day general ledger activities for the Digital business.
  • Ensure compliance with U.S. GAAP, company accounting policies, and internal control requirements.
  • Oversee accounting for specialized contractual arrangements and obligations.
  • Review accounting treatment related to digital content licensing, produced content, programming rights, obligations, and related cash flow schedules.
  • Interpret and analyze contracts to determine appropriate accounting treatment and financial impact.
  • Lead Oracle ERP Record-to-Report processes, including financial consolidations, allocations, data interfaces, journal posting, period open/close activities, foreign currency exchange rate maintenance, revaluation and translation processes, cash management, subledger-to-ledger reconciliations, intercompany accounting, and governance of cross-validation rules to ensure accurate and compliant financial reporting.

Team Leadership and Process Improvement

  • Lead, develop, and mentor accounting staff, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
  • Monitor team performance and service levels, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Escalate significant issues, disputes, and risks to management in a timely manner.
  • Maintain and enhance accounting procedures, process documentation, and internal controls.
  • Collaborate with Enterprise Technology Services (ETS) and cross-functional stakeholders to identify and implement process and system improvements.

Audit and Compliance

  • Coordinate and support internal and external audit requests, ensuring timely delivery of required documentation and analysis.
  • Assist in maintaining compliance with SOX and internal control requirements.
  • Ensure supporting documentation is complete, accurate, and audit-ready.

Projects and Initiatives

  • Support system implementations, integrations, and other finance transformation initiatives.
  • Participate in special projects and ad hoc analyses as requested by Finance leadership.
  • Drive automation and standardization efforts to improve the efficiency of Record-to-Report processes.

YOU HAVE: (aka Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s degree in accounting
  • 5+ yrs. accounting experience
  • Strong PC Skills with moderate knowledge of Excel
  • Certified Public Accountant is a plus
  • Ability to speak/write/understand Spanish is preferred.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, as there will be work weeks that require more than 40 hours to ensure the Company’s reporting requirements are met.

New Jersey Salary Range: $90,000 - $110,000.Salary ranges for other locations may differ based on local market conditions and candidate qualifications

OUR BENEFITS:

TelevisaUnivision believes that a happy, well-balanced employee is what makes our culture thrive. We offer a wide selection of perks and benefits including PTO; tuition reimbursement; wellness and employee support programs; 401K; and life and other insurance plans. This is all in addition to our comprehensive and competitive health benefits package featuring medical, dental and vision coverage options.

job.title: Cloud Platform Engineering Intern
job.description:
Job Title

Cloud Platform Engineering Intern

Job Description

About People Inc:
People Inc. is America’s largest digital and print publisher. Our 40+ iconic and fast-growing brands harness the best intent-driven content, the fastest sites, and the fewest ads to help nearly 200 million people every month, including 95 percent of US women, make decisions, take action, and find inspiration. People Inc. brands include PEOPLE, Better Homes & Gardens, Verywell, FOOD & WINE, The Spruce, Allrecipes, Byrdie, REAL SIMPLE, Investopedia, Southern Living and more.

About The Role:

We are seeking a Cloud Platform Engineering Intern to help build, automate, and validate infrastructure across Amazon Web Services (AWS), Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and Kubernetes environments.

This role is ideal for someone interested in cloud engineering, platform automation, and the emerging use of AI in infrastructure operations. The intern will work alongside Cloud Platform engineers to build tools that interact with infrastructure, collect and analyze operational data, validate configurations, and produce actionable reports.

The position will have a strong focus on Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code, Configuration as Code, and AI-assisted infrastructure management. The intern will gain practical experience working with production-oriented cloud platforms while learning how to build automation that is secure, observable, repeatable, and safe to operate.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop tools and scripts that query, inspect, and report on AWS, GCP, and Kubernetes resources.

  • Build infrastructure inventory, configuration validation, compliance reporting, and operational health-check utilities.

  • Help automate cloud and Kubernetes infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code tools such as Terraform.

  • Contribute to Configuration as Code using tools such as Helm, Kustomize, Ansible, and declarative YAML.

  • Develop AI-assisted workflows for infrastructure analysis, troubleshooting, configuration generation, and validation.

  • Implement safeguards for AI-enabled infrastructure workflows, including schema validation, policy checks, dry-run capabilities, approval gates, and human review.

  • Integrate infrastructure tools with cloud APIs, Kubernetes APIs, CI/CD pipelines, Git repositories, and observability platforms.

  • Assist with validating Kubernetes manifests, Terraform plans, deployment configurations, and cloud resource settings.

  • Build reports and dashboards that identify configuration drift, resource usage, security risks, operational issues, and optimization opportunities.

  • Write unit and integration tests for infrastructure automation and validation tools.

  • Document tools, workflows, configuration standards, and operational procedures.

  • Participate in code reviews, technical design discussions, and platform engineering planning.

  • Work with engineers to investigate infrastructure issues and identify opportunities for automation.

Required Qualifications:

  • Currently pursuing a degree or equivalent training in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

  • Foundational programming or scripting experience in one or more languages such as Python, Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Bash.

  • Basic understanding of Linux, networking, APIs, source control, and software development practices.

  • Familiarity with containers and an interest in Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure.

  • Familiarity with Git and collaborative development workflows.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to learn unfamiliar technologies and ask effective technical questions.

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.

  • Interest in automation, developer platforms, and reliable infrastructure operations.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience with any of the following is helpful but not required:

  • AWS or Google Cloud Platform.

  • Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, or Kustomize.

  • Terraform or another Infrastructure as Code framework.

  • Ansible or other configuration-management tools.

  • CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Argo CD, or Argo Workflows

  • REST APIs, cloud SDKs, or Kubernetes client libraries.

  • Data collection, reporting, dashboards, or observability tools.

  • Large language models, AI agents, tool-calling systems, or Model Context Protocol (MCP).

  • Automated testing, policy-as-code, or configuration validation.

  • Cloud security concepts such as IAM, workload identity, secrets management, and least-privilege access.

Inside Sales Representative – Events

Community Choice | Inside Sales | Uncapped Earning Potential

Company: LocaliQ, powered by the USA TODAY Network

Brand: Community Choice

Work Arrangement: Inside Sales

About Community Choice

At Community Choice, we connect local businesses with the people and communities they want to reach through exciting events, sponsorships, and promotional opportunities.

Powered by LocaliQ and the USA TODAY Network, we combine local connections with the resources and expertise of a nationally recognized media organization. Our team helps businesses get in front of their ideal customers while creating memorable experiences within their communities.

As an Inside Sales Representative, you’ll play a key role in bringing those partnerships to life. You’ll connect with business owners and decision-makers, uncover their goals, introduce sponsorship and advertising opportunities, and help create partnerships that deliver visibility and value.

If you’re energized by competition, motivated by results, and enjoy the thrill of turning a cold prospect into a new client, this could be the opportunity for you.

About the Role

This is a full-cycle, high-energy sales role where you’ll own the process from the first conversation through the close.

You’ll spend your day prospecting for new business, connecting with small and medium-sized businesses, presenting event sponsorship and advertising opportunities, and building relationships with decision-makers.

You’ll manage your own pipeline, work toward monthly revenue and activity goals, and use Salesforce CRM to stay organized and keep opportunities moving forward.

The role is built for someone who enjoys having clear goals, wants their effort to directly impact their earnings, and thrives in an environment where activity, persistence, and results matter.

With strong training, sales tools, marketing resources, and leadership support behind you, you’ll have the opportunity to build your sales skills while growing your book of business.

Why This Role Stands Out

• $19.24/hour base pay + uncapped commission

• On-Target Earnings of approximately $65K

• Top performers earning $100K+ annually

• Opportunity to own the full sales cycle, from prospecting through close

• Sell exciting event sponsorships, advertising, and promotional partnerships

• Work with local businesses and help them increase their visibility in the community

• Comprehensive onboarding, training, and ongoing sales development

• Access to Salesforce, marketing resources, lead support, and sales tools

• Clear opportunities for career growth and advancement

• Collaborative, high-energy team environment with strong leadership support

• Backed by LocaliQ and the USA TODAY Network

What You Will Do

• Own the full sales cycle by prospecting, qualifying, presenting, negotiating, and closing new business

• Conduct consistent daily outbound outreach to small and medium-sized businesses

• Build relationships with business owners and key decision-makers

• Identify business goals and recommend event sponsorship and advertising opportunities that align with those needs

• Build, manage, and maintain a strong sales pipeline using Salesforce CRM

• Conduct sales presentations and confidently communicate the value of Community Choice opportunities

• Consistently work toward and exceed monthly revenue and activity goals

• Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling additional solutions

• Maintain accurate CRM notes, activity tracking, pipeline information, and forecasting

• Stay persistent and engaged throughout the sales process to turn opportunities into new partnerships

Qualifications

• 2–5 years of proven sales experience, with B2B, outbound, or account acquisition experience preferred

• Demonstrated ability to consistently meet or exceed sales goals or quotas

• Experience with consultative or solution-based selling

• Confident communicator with a strong phone presence

• Comfortable making frequent outbound calls and initiating conversations with new prospects

• Strong closing and negotiation skills

• Highly self-motivated, organized, and competitive

• Comfortable working in a performance-based, commission-driven environment

• Ability to manage multiple opportunities and maintain consistent follow-up

• Experience with Salesforce or another CRM is a plus

• Bachelor’s degree or media/advertising sales experience is a plus

Who Thrives Here

The people who succeed in this role are competitive, persistent, confident, and motivated by results. They enjoy picking up the phone, starting conversations, overcoming objections, and finding a way to move an opportunity forward.

You don’t need to be an events expert on day one. What matters most is your ability to build relationships, ask good questions, handle rejection, stay organized, and keep pushing toward the next opportunity.

If you enjoy a fast pace, clear goals, and the opportunity to directly influence your earnings through your own performance, you’ll find plenty of room to grow here.

What Success Looks Like

First 3 Months:

Complete onboarding and product training, build your prospecting habits, learn the Community Choice event portfolio, and begin developing a strong sales pipeline.

6 Months:

Consistently prospect, manage a healthy pipeline, conduct confident sales conversations, and establish steady performance against revenue and activity goals.

12 Months:

Own your sales cycle with confidence, consistently deliver against revenue goals, build a strong book of business, and identify opportunities to expand your impact and earnings.

Benefits & Growth

We want our sales team to have the tools, training, and opportunity to build a successful career.

• $19.24/hour base pay

• Uncapped commission

• ~$65K OTE

• Top performers earning $100K+ annually

• Comprehensive onboarding and sales training

• Ongoing coaching and professional development

• Salesforce and industry-leading sales tools

• Marketing resources and lead support

• Career progression and advancement opportunities

• Collaborative, high-energy sales culture

• Leadership support focused on helping you succeed

Make an Impact. Build Relationships. Get Rewarded.

Community Choice gives you the opportunity to sell something businesses can get excited about—events and experiences that put them directly in front of their communities and customers.

If you’re ready to build relationships, chase big goals, and turn your sales ability into uncapped earning potential, we want to meet you.

The hourly rate for this role will range between $17.00 and $19.24. Base compensation is reflective of many factors, including, but not limited to, the market in which one lives/works, individual education level, skills, certifications and experience. Note: variable compensation is not reflected in these figures and based on the role, may be applicable.

Program Director


R0153633
University of Nevada, Reno - Main Campus

The University of Nevada, Reno (UNR) appreciates your interest in employment at our growing institution. We want your application process to go smoothly and quickly. Final applications must be submitted prior to the close of the recruitment.

If you need assistance or have questions regarding the application process, please contact our recruitment helpline at (775) 784-1495 or jobs@unr.edu.

Job Description

Reporting to the General Manager of KUNR/KNCJ Public Radio, the Program Director provides strategic and day-to-day leadership for the broadcast programming and on-air operations of KUNR Public Radio, KNCJ Nevada's Classical and Jazz, and KNCC Elko. This position plays a central role in shaping the station's sound, programming strategy, audience experience, and overall broadcast quality while ensuring that programming meets professional public media standards and FCC requirements. The Program Director leads, coaches, and develops KUNR's full-time and part-time on-air talent and works closely with newsroom and station leadership to strengthen local programming and storytelling across platforms. The position oversees programming systems, broadcast automation, program schedules, network content, and technical audio quality to ensure reliable and seamless service to listeners. The Program Director also serves as an on-air host and participates in fundraising, community events, and other activities that advance KUNR's mission and connection with its audience. This position is well suited for a public media professional who combines strong editorial and programming judgment with leadership, technical aptitude, journalistic integrity, creativity, and a passion for developing people and serving audiences.

The successful candidate will have the opportunity to:
• Shape KUNR's sound and programming strategy while balancing local storytelling with high-quality national public media content.
• Develop and mentor on-air talent, helping broadcasters grow professionally and strengthening the overall quality of the station.
• Champion local programming and help identify opportunities for new programs, podcasts, partnerships, and content distribution.
• Work across departments with newsroom, engineering, development, and station leadership to advance KUNR's mission.
• Engage with the community through events, partnerships, interviews, and public media initiatives.
• Help guide the station's future, using audience information, emerging technologies, and evolving public media practices to improve the listener experience.
• Be part of a university environment that connects public media, journalism, education, and service to the Northern Nevada community.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's Degree and four years of professional work experience; OR a Master's Degree and two years of professional work experience

Related experience: On-air broadcasting, news collection, reporting, radio programming, or a closely related media field.

Schedule



- Regular schedule will generally be Monday through Friday and will be determined in part by assigned on-air programming. Current anticipated schedules may include approximately 6:00 a.m.-2:00 p.m. or 10:00 a.m.-7:00 p.m.

The University of Nevada, Reno is a leading public research university committed to the promise of a future powered by knowledge. The University's physical infrastructure is expanding with ongoing construction of the newly named John Tullock Business Building, set to open in fall 2025. Groundbreaking is also planned for a new State Public Health Laboratory Building on campus, alongside the recent acquisition of 16 parcels near campus, known as "University Village," to provide affordable housing for graduate students and early career faculty.

Through its commitment to high-impact education, world-improving research and creative activity, and outreach that's transforming Nevada's communities and businesses, the University continues its 150-year tradition of benefitting our state, nation and world.

job.title: Creative Content Producer
job.description:
ONSITE ON LOCATION - Clearwater, Florida

Office Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00AM - 6:00PM

This is a full-time, in-office position. Remote or hybrid work is not available.


PLEASE INCLUDE A PORTFOLIO OR DEMO REELSHOWCASING YOUR PREVIOUS WORK WITH YOUR APPLICATION.


Valor Real Estate Development is a boutique luxury developer creating community-transforming real estate icons in emerging cities. Our portfolio is anchored by prestigious brand partnerships, including Aston Martin and Roche Bobois, with additional luxury collaborations planned as our company continues to grow. 


We are looking for a Creative Content Producer to join our team. If you're the type of creative who naturally shifts from filming with a gimbal, to editing in Premiere Pro, to designing in InDesign, to brainstorming the next social campaign, you'll fit right in. Industry professionals sometimes call this a "Preditor" meaning a producer, videographer, photographer, and editor wrapped into one versatile creative professional.


You'll work directly alongside our Deputy Marketing & Promotion Manager and collaborate with executive leadership on projects that define the public image of our company. From luxury property launches and exclusive events to cinematic marketing films and digital campaigns, your work will help shape how thousands of people experience the Valor brand.


If you're passionate about storytelling, obsessed with quality, embrace AI as a creative force multiplier, and want to build work you're genuinely proud to put your name on, we'd love to meet you.


Primary Responsibilities

As a Creative Content Producer, you'll help create the visual identity of Valor Real Estate Development across every stage of our marketing efforts. This is a production role requiring versatility, creativity, and a passion for producing work that reflects the quality of our luxury brand.


Video Production & Post-Production (Primary Focus)

  • Assist in planning, filming, and producing cinematic marketing videos, property walkthroughs, promotional campaigns, and event coverage.
  • Operate professional camera systems, gimbals, lighting, and audio equipment during productions.
  • Edit short and long-form video content using Adobe Premiere Pro, including color correction, audio mixing, motion graphics, and final delivery.
  • Collaborate with executive leadership on high-end marketing films and brand storytelling.
  • Organize, archive, and manage digital media libraries, project files, and production assets.
  • Export and optimize video content for social media, websites, presentations, digital advertising, and broadcast applications.
  • Continue developing the skills necessary to independently plan, film, and produce complete marketing projects from concept to final delivery.

Photography & Visual Content

  • Capture professional photography for luxury properties, events, construction milestones, executive profiles, and marketing campaigns.
  • Photograph interiors, architecture, amenities, lifestyle imagery, and brand experiences.
  • Perform professional image selection, retouching, and color correction.
  • Maintain organized photo libraries and digital asset management.
  • Assist with drone productions as ground crew or second camera operator. FAA Part 107 certification is highly desirable.

Social Media & Digital Content

  • Create engaging content for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, and emerging platforms.
  • Plan, schedule, and publish content while maintaining a consistent luxury brand voice.
  • Produce reels, stories, carousels, and other platform-specific content.
  • Repurpose photography and long-form video into engaging digital content.
  • Monitor engagement metrics and recommend improvements based on performance analytics.

Graphic Design & Brand Development

  • Design premium marketing collateral including brochures, presentations, invitations, signage, advertisements, sales materials, and digital assets.
  • Produce graphics for social media, email marketing, presentations, websites, and events.
  • Prepare artwork for professional print production and vendor delivery.
  • Ensure strict adherence to Valor's luxury brand standards and those of our strategic partners, including Aston Martin, Roche Bobois, and future collaborations.

Content Writing & Marketing Communications

  • Write compelling copy for websites, email campaigns, advertisements, brochures, presentations, and social media.
  • Assist with scripting marketing videos and planning production storyboards.
  • Utilize modern AI tools to enhance content development, creative workflows, and production efficiency.
  • Support long-form marketing initiatives that strengthen Valor's reputation and brand authority.

Digital Marketing Support

  • Update company websites with new content, imagery, property information, and campaign assets.
  • Build and maintain landing pages for new developments, events, and marketing campaigns.
  • Design and distribute email marketing campaigns while maintaining mailing lists and reporting.
  • Assist with basic HTML email template updates and digital asset optimization.

Events, Production & Vendor Coordination

  • Support luxury sales events, grand openings, project launches, media events, and promotional campaigns.
  • Capture creative content during live events while coordinating with vendors and production partners.
  • Assist with print vendors, promotional suppliers, signage, mailing campaigns, and production logistics.
  • Track purchase orders, vendor invoices, marketing budgets, and project timelines.
  • Coordinate with external agencies, freelancers, and creative vendors to ensure projects are delivered on schedule and to Valor's standards.


Technical Qualifications

Applicants should possess strong working knowledge of most of the following:

  • Adobe Premiere Pro
  • Adobe After Effects
  • Adobe Photoshop
  • Adobe Illustrator
  • Adobe InDesign
  • Professional photography and camera operation
  • Professional video production and post-production
  • Color grading and audio editing
  • Social media content production and management
  • Copywriting and brand storytelling
  • AI-powered creative tools such as ChatGPT, Midjourney, Runway, Claude, and similar platforms


What We’re Looking For

  • • 4+ years of experience in creative marketing, content production, multimedia production, or comparable role.
  • •A portfolio or demo reel demonstrating exceptional video production, photography, and creative design work.
  • Excellent visual judgment and meticulous attention to detail.
  • Passion for luxury brands, architecture, design, hospitality, or premium lifestyle marketing.
  • Strong understanding of current social media trends and digital storytelling.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and meet demanding deadlines.
  • Comfortable receiving creative direction while also contributing original ideas and innovative solutions.
  • Enthusiastic about adopting emerging technologies, including AI powered creative workflows, to improve quality and efficiency.
  • Professional camera experience required.
  • FAA Part 107 Drone License preferred
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the U.S.
  • Occasional evenings and weekends required (for launches and events)
  • Ability to lift and transport camera equipment 25–40 lbs.


Compensation & Benefits

Salary ranges for this position vary by experience and role, typically starting from $60,000 and scaling based on qualifications up to $70,000. We proudly offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, as well as paid time off. Please note: Valor Real Estate Development is conducting this search internally and is not partnering with recruiting agencies, staffing firms, headhunters, or independent subcontractors for this position. Unsolicited candidate submissions, recruiting services, or sales solicitations will not be reviewed or considered. By submitting your resume, you acknowledge that your application is voluntary and does not constitute a binding agreement or obligation on behalf of either party.

job.title: Operations Engineer III
job.description:
Who We Are:
SiriusXM and its brands (Pandora, Stitcher, SXM Media, AdsWizz, Simplecast, and SiriusXM Connected Vehicle Services) are leading a new era of audio entertainment and services by delivering the most compelling subscription and ad-supported audio entertainment experience for listeners -- in the car, at home, and anywhere on the go with connected devices.

 

Our vision is to shape the future of audio, where everyone can be effortlessly connected to the voices, stories and music they love wherever they are.
 

We are proud to be launching a new state-of-the-art technology facility in Dublin, Ireland. The Dublin-based team will play a critical role in our continued digital transformation and will function as a centre of excellence for SiriusXM’s global Product and Technology organization.
 

SiriusXM’s new Dublin facility will comprise a workforce primarily focused on software development, automotive technology and engineering, AdTech, data science, and analytics. Talent based in the new technology hub will be charged with developing and implementing best-in-class standards for high-quality, scalable software deliveries for SiriusXM’s streaming and in-vehicle audio entertainment platforms.

 

How you’ll make an impact:
The Production Services Operations Team is made up of a dynamic group of technicians that handle production operations and support for the billing, supply chain and identity systems that support our 150 million listeners. The technician role will not only operate these systems but will analyse complex incidents for resolution and look for automation opportunities across the systems.
 

What you’ll do:

job.description: About Suno We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world. Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA). About the role The Lead Corporate Security Engineer will be our domain expert for securing our Corporate IT environment. You’ll work closely with colleagues in IT, Business Systems, Security, and Engineering to ensure that our corporate systems are implemented and maintained securely. As a senior member of the team, your impact will be split between building your team, enabling others, and doing hands-on work to mature our systems, processes, and behaviors. You'll lead the corporate security domain end to end: identity and access governance, endpoint and vulnerability management, detection and response, third-party integration risk, vendor assessment, and SaaS posture. You'll set the standard, own the roadmap, and be accountable for the outcome. IT Engineering runs the platforms day to day and are your closest partners. How this role works with IT Ownership splits by layer, not by system. IT Engineering owns the run; you own the standard and the direction. You set the corporate security roadmap. What we secure, in what order, to what bar with buy-in from leadership and XFN stakeholders IT engineering owns platform operations. Our SaaS portfolio is administered and integrated by them. You define what those platforms must enforce You raise the bar around you. You make your reasoning explicit so that partners make good security calls without you in the room, and you build the tooling and defaults that make the secure path the default path What you'll own Identity and access governance Own the access model at Suno: the RBAC and entitlement design, least-privilege defaults, and the governance layer in Lumos that enforces them Set the standard for what access review, certification, and approval should look like here — then build toward it rather than importing someone else's framework Drive access lifecycle automation so joiner/mover/leaver is correct by default and exceptions are visible Get ahead of non-human identity: service accounts, agents, and automations are a growing share of what holds access at Suno, and we need a model for them before it's urgent Endpoint security and vulnerability management Own the security standard for our fleet: hardening baseline, compliance signals, device trust, and how endpoint posture feeds access decisions Own third-party vulnerability management as a program — coverage, risk-based remediation SLAs, reporting, and the negotiation with teams whose tools are the problem Partner with the IT engineer who owns Kandji so the standard becomes deployed policy without degrading how people work Detection and response Own our EDR deployment and maintenance Collaborate with Detection and Response on corporate security incidents to closure Third-party and integration risk Own how Suno evaluates third-party access: integration and OAuth review for Slack, Google Workspace and the rest of the portfolio, plus vendor security assessment at purchase and renewal Define our risk appetite in practice and make it legible enough that others apply it without you Turn recurring decisions into policy, scope guidance, and tooling so the review queue shrinks as the company grows SaaS security posture Build and own the program: the bar for our SaaS applications, the assessment cadence, and the remediation that follows Improve tenant-level configuration across the portfolio — SSO and SCIM coverage, MFA and session policy, admin role hygiene, OAuth grant and token management, data sharing defaults Cross-functional leadership Work with IT, Security, Engineering, AI Enablement, and Legal to shape how Suno builds and buys Influence the scope of what comes next: how our GRC function plugs in, what we automate versus staff, where the next investment goes Mentor and raise the technical bar for people around you, including partners who aren't security specialists What success looks like First 90 days: you've formed your own view of our security posture, built working relationships with the IT engineers the broader Security team, and told us the three things we're wrong about First 6 months: a corporate security roadmap exists that IT and the CISO are aligned behind, with the sequencing and the tradeoffs made explicit; the highest-risk items are already moving First year: entitlement sprawl and vulnerability backlog are measurably down, detection reflects our real risks, third-party review is fast enough that nobody routes around it, and the standard holds because it's built into tooling and shared judgment rather than into you What you'll bring ~8+ years in corporate/enterprise security or security engineering, including having owned identity, endpoint, or SaaS security as a domain rather than as a set of tickets Deep hands-on expertise with a modern IdP and with IGA or access-governance tooling (Lumos, Veza, ConductorOne, Opal, or similar) You've designed an entitlement or RBAC model across a large SaaS portfolio and lived with the consequences long enough to know what breaks Endpoint security depth in a macOS-primary fleet: MDM-delivered hardening, compliance and device trust, third-party patch and vulnerability management at scale Strong command of OAuth, SAML, OIDC, and SCIM, and of the risk model behind third-party integrations A track record of setting a security standard that other people applied without you enforcing it — written policy, tooling, defaults, or all three Experience influencing engineering and business teams who don't report to you, early enough in their process to change the outcome Automation fluency: Python or TypeScript, REST APIs, and a habit of building integrations and internal tooling as a normal part of the job Excellent writing and judgment under ambiguity. You can hold a position with an executive and change it when the evidence says to A calibrated sense of risk and how to communicate likelihood, impact, and tradeoffs Helpful, not required: insider risk or DLP programs, zero-trust network access, SOC 2 or ISO program ownership, just-in-time access patterns or identity-as-code, securing AI agent and non-human identity access, prior experience as the first or second security hire at a fast-growing company. iHeartMedia
