The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service.  In fact, we have:

  • More #1 rated markets than the next two largest radio companies combined;

  • We’re the largest podcast publisher, with more monthly downloads than the second- and third-largest podcast publishers combined. Podcasting, the fastest-growing new media, today has more monthly users than streaming music services or Netflix;

  • iHeart is the home of many of the country’s most popular and trusted on-air personalities and podcast influencers, who build important connections with hundreds of communities across America;

  • We create and produce some of the most popular and well-known branded live music events in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour;

  • iHeartRadio is the #1 streaming radio digital service in America;

  • Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and

  • We have the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio, from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale.  As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.

Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!

If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

The Communications Coordinator supports the Communications team in the day-to-day operation of employee communications and department administration efforts. This role is responsible for the execution and distribution of internal communications across the company, ensuring messages are delivered accurately and formatted properly across all platforms and devices. The coordinator will manage distribution lists, communication calendars, email deployments, testing and quality checks, while providing administrative support for company-wide communications initiatives.

The coordinator also manages the company's daily media coverage report, compiling and distributing relevant news stories and press coverage about iHeartMedia to employees across the organization.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

  • Execute company-wide email distributions for executive messages and key communications from departments including Leadership, HR, IT, Legal, Finance and Corporate Communications.
  • Maintain employee distribution lists and mailing groups to ensure communications reach the appropriate audiences.
  • Support the scheduling and distribution of internal communications according to established calendars and timelines.
  • Review and test communications prior to distribution to ensure proper formatting and functionality across desktop, mobile and email platforms.
  • Coordinate with Communications, HR, IT and other departments to prepare and distribute employee communications related to benefits, compliance programs, policies and other company initiatives.
  • Compile, produce and distribute the company's daily media coverage report. Monitor news coverage and relevant stories throughout the day involving iHeartMedia, its brands, talent, executives and key business initiatives, assessing the sentiment of each article and sharing relevant clips in real time.
  • Responsible for yearly impressions reports and any other impressions analytics.
  • Develop and maintain key media contacts, lists and editorial calendars (national, local and trade press, etc.) for use in day-to-day pitching and media coordination.
  • Assist department with coordinating and scheduling business meetings and arranging travel for the Communications division as well as submit monthly expense reports.
  • Assist department with timely processing of all incoming invoices.
  • Support communications during company events, emergencies and special projects.

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • 1-3 years of experience in communications, marketing, administration, project coordination or a related field.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint and Word.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience working with media software including Adobe Photoshop, Research – Cision, Meltwater, Burrelles, TV Eyes, etc. a plus.
  • Bilingual English/Spanish proficiency preferred.
  • Strong work ethic, ability to work well in meeting deadlines and multi-task.
  • Ability to work a flexible schedule with an 8 a.m. Eastern Standard start time.
  • BA/BS in Public Relations, Communications, Marketing, or related field.

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Ability to perform work and resolve straightforward problems within established procedures with moderate supervision
  • Understanding of when to seek guidance for unforeseen problems
  • Close attention to detail, following up until issues are resolved

Description:  

Herman Weissker, Inc. is a leading company in the underground construction and engineering industry. We have an exciting opportunity for a Safety Specialist based in Riverside, Ca.

The Safety Specialist is responsible for administering the Company safety/health and accident prevention program and to ensure all employees have a safe environment in which to work.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Administer and audit the company Environmental Health and Safety Program

Conduct announced and unannounced occupational safety and health inspections of company facilities, equipment, materials, operations and job sites to ensure compliance with corporate safety policy, and all federal, state and local regulations.

Conduct incident investigations by root cause analysis of all accidents and near-misses involving company or sub-contract employees

Develop and Implement Corrective Actions identified in Investigations from Near Misses, Accidents or Incidents

Maintain records of training or certification(s) for project specific training requirements

Collect and maintain Safety Data Sheets for all chemicals brought onsite

Conduct monthly inspections on all safety equipment as required by company or client procedure

Maintain site PPE inventory and safety related equipment

Develop site or job specific safety plans as needed

Present daily site safety meeting as needed

Audit job safety analysis documents for each crew, each day.

Attend daily, weekly, or monthly safety leadership meetings or joint audit walks held by the customer

Stop any unsafe acts or processes that are dangerous or unhealthy

EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE:

 

Associates or Bachelor’s degree in Safety, or a combination of education and experience providing equivalent knowledge (examples include but are not limited to 5 Years Journeyman experience with 3 years safety program experience or Advanced Safety Certificate through National Safety Council, etc.).  Recognized safety certification (CUSA, CSP, etc) preferred.  Minimum 3 years safety related experience in the construction industry.  OSHA 10 Construction required.

LICENSE:

Possession of or ability to obtain a valid class C California driver's license

SKILLS, PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS AND WORKING CONDITIONS:

Thorough understanding of and ability to enforce federal, state, local and company regulations.

Ability to recognize hazardous situation and implement corrective measures essential.

Good interpersonal and communication skills required.

Must have extensive knowledge of applicable safety regulations, regulatory requirement and industry standards for construction and general industry; knowledge of EPA, DOT and NEPA standards.

Ability to maintain confidentiality, possess good organizational and problem-solving skills.

Must be proficient in Microsoft Word & Excel and have knowledge of spreadsheet applications.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, talk and hear. The employee is frequently required to use hands to finger, handle or feel and reach with hands and arms. The employee frequently is required to walk; stand and sit for prolong periods. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Must be able to operate a motor vehicle.

Working conditions consists of a temperature-controlled office, outside elements such as rain, cold, and heat when driving from jobsite to jobsite or attending meetings, etc. Noise levels are moderate to loud depending on jobsite.

job.description:

This role will assist in managing partner relationships, supporting e-commerce and retail programs, coordinating marketing and product development activities, and contributing to revenue-generating initiatives across key categories and channels.   • Support the day-to-day management of consumer products and licensing partners across product development, marketing, retail, and business operations.
  • Assist in the execution of initiatives that support annual revenue and business growth objectives across Europe.

job.title: DC Bureau Producer
job.description:
Sinclair's DC Bureau is seeking a highly organized, editorially driven Producer to support coverage of the nation’s most important political stories in Washington and in the field.

The DC Bureau Producer will work closely with bureau correspondents on daily stories, including occasional scriptwriting. This role also will coordinate interviews, logistics, and editorial elements for daily bureau stories in and around Washington, while also helping coordinate coverage of political campaigns, conventions and debates.

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced environment, demonstrates strong political news judgment, and anticipates coverage needs while managing multiple priorities under tight deadlines.

Responsibilities include:

  • Work closely with reporters, photographers, the DC Bureau Chief, and control room teams to execute live and taped coverage.
  • Produce packages, live elements, and social/digital content as needed. Occasionally conduct interviews with lawmakers and other officials.
  • Monitor political developments, daily Washington coverage, campaign activity, legislation, and breaking news to help shape daily coverage plans.
  • Build and maintain relationships with Capitol Hill, White House, and other federal press offices; political organizations and campaign staff.
  • Research candidates, policy issues, events, and key political players to support accurate, compelling storytelling.
  • Identify, pitch, and help secure relevant political guests, sources, and interview opportunities.
  • Plan logistics for live shots, interviews, reporter travel, credentials, equipment, and transmission paths.
  • Travel, including on short notice, to support major political events and breaking news coverage.
  • Maintain a high standard for accuracy, fairness, urgency, and editorial integrity.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communications, Political Science, or a related field preferred.
  • Previous experience producing political, national, or breaking news coverage in a television, digital, or multiplatform news environment.
  • Experience working directly with national news correspondents and writing broadcast news packages is required.
  • Strong knowledge of national politics, Congress, the electoral process, and current events.
  • Experience covering Congress and/or the White House is preferred.
  • Excellent editorial judgment, communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work flexible hours, including early mornings, evenings, weekends, holidays, and extended shifts during major news events.
  • Ability to work independently in the field while collaborating effectively with remote and in-studio teams.
  • Experience coordinating live television production, field logistics, and/or satellite transmission is preferred.

job.title: Senior Content Creator
job.description:
Are you an experienced creative storyteller who can lead high-quality production from idea through final delivery? Do you strive for “Excellence in Everything” while helping shape stronger creative, support teammates, and keep production moving?

Join Sinclair, Inc. and the Agile Creative Content Engagement Team (ACCET) as a Senior Content Creator based in our Asheville, NC TV station group. This senior hands-on production role is focused on writing, producing, shooting, editing, and delivering high-impact creative content across multiple markets and platforms.

As a Senior Content Creator, you will own complex client, market, regional, and national creative projects while helping guide creative execution, strengthen production quality, and support the development of other Content Creators. This role is ideal for someone with strong production judgment, advanced hands-on skills, and the ability to lead by example without losing connection to the work.

This is a senior creative role for someone who can step into the most important projects, shape scripts and concepts, produce shoots, solve edits, protect quality standards, and help bring priority work across the finish line.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As an ACCET Senior Content Creator, you will create and help lead commercial, branded, digital, promotional, and multi-platform content for assigned markets while supporting strong creative quality, clear communication, and reliable delivery.

Lead High-Quality Creative Production

  • Write, produce, shoot, edit, and deliver commercial spots, branded content, digital campaigns, promotional creative, and other client deliverables.

  • Own high-profile, complex, or priority projects from concept through final delivery, including scripting, pre-production, field production, editing, graphics, audio, revisions, approvals, and exports.

  • Develop creative that is clear, compelling, strategically aligned, and appropriate for the audience, platform, client, and market need.

  • Maintain high standards for storytelling, visual quality, brand consistency, pacing, sound, graphics, and overall production value.

  • Use strong creative judgment to solve production challenges, improve creative outcomes, and protect the quality of the final product.

 

Support Market, Regional, and National Production Needs

  • Produce creative work for multiple assigned markets while balancing deadlines, priorities, revisions, and client expectations.

  • Support high-profile, priority, multi-market, regional, or national productions as business needs require.

  • Coordinate production details with Client Services Managers, Strategists, Project Managers, Sales teams, clients, and market stakeholders.

  • Help keep production moving during urgent deadlines, high-volume periods, priority campaigns, or complex client deliverables.

  • Adapt quickly to changing production needs, shifting priorities, production constraints, and time-sensitive requests.

 

Provide Creative Leadership and Team Support

  • Serve as a senior creative resource for Content Creators, helping support quality, clarity, creative direction, and production problem-solving.

  • Provide constructive feedback, practical guidance, and creative support to help teammates strengthen scripts, shoots, edits, graphics, audio, and final delivery.

job.title: Analyst, Privacy Operations
job.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE & TEAM:


The TU Legal team is looking for a Privacy Operations Analyst to join our team.

TelevisaUnivision is committed to embedding privacy by design into our products and building a world-class privacy team to enable our business strategy. In accordance with privacy laws and regulations internationally, TelevisaUnivision’s Privacy Team is responsible for helping to ensure compliance with applicable legal requirements, including honoring individual privacy rights requests and providing appropriate opt out or other consent mechanisms for the sale or sharing of personal data. The role will report into the Law, Policy and Integrity team and will work closely with engineering and product teams across TelevisaUnivision.


ABOUT YOU: 

A successful candidate will have proven experience supporting privacy operations, including individual privacy rights, consent management, and data requests. The role will interface directly with legal, business, product, and engineering teams, requiring strong organizational and technology skills. Experience with privacy management platforms, including but not limited to OneTrust, and translating legal requirements into operational processes is strongly preferred.


YOUR DAY-TO-DAY: (aka Responsibilities)

  • Document and optimize the company’s Privacy Operations processes, such as individual requests, including step-by-step process flows, e-mail templates, and response timelines
  • Manage Privacy Operations platforms and tooling, including but not limited to OneTrust, that implement access, deletion, opt-out, and consent
  • Review, triage, and respond to internal and external inquiries, such as those received via email and in tickets
  • Maintain and update inventory of the company’s data partners and contracts involving the handling of personal data
  • Serve as liaison between Legal and Technical teams handling Privacy Operations, including translating legal requirements into technical classifications for data, processes, and tools
  • Ensure timely handling of all individual requests, and approving/processing or rejecting each request in accordance with laws, deadlines, and internal processes
  • Partner with business and technical owners to implement changes necessary to comply with privacy law, such as access, deletion, opt-out, and consent
  • Prepare weekly/monthly reports
  • Partner with legal resources to understand various requirements and the global privacy landscape
  • Research options for automating and/or streamlining compliance tasks, including leveraging technology tools
  • Maintain and enhance playbooks and contract templates
  • Serve as a liaison between Legal and Procurement teams, on the one hand, and external vendors and other business partners, on the other hand, to update data provisions of contracts.
  • Assist with other privacy-related tasks, such as data inventory, discovery, or mapping

 

YOU HAVE: (aka Qualifications)

  • Bachelor’s degree or comparable experience in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or related field
  •  1-2 years of professional experience in data privacy, security risk management, or compliance
  • IAPP certification such CIPM or CIPT is preferred
  • Strong project management skills, project planning methodologies
  • Experience in managing digital platforms
  • Experience with Privacy Operations platforms, such as OneTrust, TrustArc, ServiceNow, Ethyca, DataGrail, Osano, or Ketch
  • General knowledge of compliance processes
  • Fluent in English/Spanish

job.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE AND TEAM

TelevisaUnivision is the leading Spanish-language media company in the world! We’re investing in our content, our people, and our properties, which span digital, streaming, social, audio, linear and live events. We’re growing our offerings, building on the recent launch of our successful streaming platform, ViX. We were the fastest growing major media company in the U.S.


The Sales Operations Analyst supports the management, analysis, and optimization of linear advertising inventory across the portfolio. Working closely with Planning, Sales, Programming, Traffic, and other internal partners, the Analyst helps ensure inventory is accurately maintained, effectively utilized, and aligned with revenue and client-delivery objectives. The role combines day-to-day inventory management with analytical problem solving and will increasingly leverage AI, automation, and data-driven tools to identify inventory risks, recommend actions, and improve yield.


ABOUT YOU

The successful Sales Operations Analyst will move beyond simply reporting on inventory conditions to understanding why they exist and recommend what the business should do about them. Over time, as reporting and transactional work become increasingly automated, the role will place greater emphasis on analysis, exception management, validation of AI-generated recommendations, and improving inventory utilization and yield.

You are an Excel rock star, who enjoys analyzing numbers and data to provide insights into our sales organization. For you, every challenge is an opportunity to find a solution.


YOUR DAY TO DAY

· Monitor inventory availability, capacity, sellout levels, and utilization across networks, dayparts, programs, and high-profile events.

· Identify inventory risks and opportunities and recommend actions to improve utilization, protect revenue, and support client delivery.

· Partner closely with Planning teams to ensure proposals, allocations, stewardship decisions, and inventory changes reflect current availability and business priorities.

· Support management of oversold inventory, preemptions, underdelivery, liability, and other inventory exceptions.

· Analyze supply and demand trends and provide actionable recommendations to Planning and Sales leadership.

· Maintain and validate inventory-related data, including capacities, format grids, ratecards, program information, and other inputs used in planning and inventory systems.

· Support inventory requirements for tentpoles, live sports, and other high-profile programming.

· Partner with Programming, Traffic, Planning, and Sales Operations to resolve inventory issues and execute approved changes.

· Use WideOrbit and related systems to manage inventory and support transactional workflows.

· Leverage reporting, analytics, AI, and automation tools to improve inventory decision-making and reduce manual processes.

· Review and validate AI-generated inventory recommendations as new optimization capabilities are introduced.

· Help define business rules and identify exceptions that should inform future automated inventory workflows.

· Develop a strong understanding of inventory economics and the relationship between pricing, demand, capacity, client commitments, and yield.

· Document processes and contribute to consistent inventory operating procedures and team knowledge.

· Support ad hoc analyses and special projects as needed.


YOU HAVE

· Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience.

· 2+ years of experience in media, advertising, sales operations, inventory, planning, analytics, or a related field preferred.

· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate data into actionable recommendations.

· Strong Excel skills; experience with reporting or data-visualization tools is preferred.

· Experience with WideOrbit or other advertising sales/traffic systems is a plus.

· Comfort working with data, emerging technology, AI, and automated workflows.

· Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

· Strong written and verbal communication skills.

· Ability to collaborate effectively across Planning, Sales, Programming, Traffic, Finance, and other functions.

· Intellectual curiosity and willingness to learn both the commercial and technical aspects of inventory management.

NBC News is looking for an Associate Editor, Social to bring our journalism to life across social platforms. You’ll also be responsible for the day-to-day distribution of NBC News stories across Facebook, X, Threads, Bluesky, LinkedIn, Reddit and Instagram, making sure our journalism reaches audiences wherever they are. 

This is a hands-on role for someone who follows the news closely and understands what makes people stop scrolling and engage, and you’ll have a desire to experiment with how NBC News’ journalism can connect with different audiences on social platforms. You’ll work across a wide range of stories and formats and social storytelling, audience engagement and distribution strategies. 

The role is best suited for a creative thinker who has a deep understanding of the native languages of various social media platforms. You should also have some experience in graphic design and light video editing. 

The position can be based in New York or Los Angeles and is five days a week, Monday-Friday, starting at 1pm ET. You will report to the Senior Editor, Social. 

This position is represented by the News Guild – NY CWA. 

Responsibilities:

  • Distribute original reporting and breaking news on NBC News’ social accounts
  • Work with the art, photo and data graphics teams to create bespoke social graphics
  • Write accurate and compelling headlines and social copy
  • Work with the social video teams to distribute original video content
  • Select strong visuals for story promotion and live event coverage
  • Identify zeitgeisty stories and shareable moments on social media and surface them to the news teams
  • Repackage content for distribution on different social platforms
  • Track audience behavior to help inform promotion and overall strategy
  • Occasionally help curate NBCNews.com homepage and app owned platforms
  • At least 1 year of experience working in social media
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent and comparable work experience
  • Excellent writing skills, solid news judgment and a creative eye
  • Experience creating shareable content
  • Basic knowledge of graphic design
  • Experience using newsroom tools such as TrueAnthem or Social Flow and Chartbeat or Parse.ly
  • The position can be located in New York, NY or Los Angeles, CA

  • Basic knowledge of Premiere Pro and video editing

NBCUniversal’s Ad Sales One Platform Ad Products team builds and operates the systems that power NBCUniversal’s $10B+ advertising business, including core ad serving, programmatic, and activation capabilities across CTV and digital.

Within AP&S, the Programmatic Demand team is responsible for product strategy and development of demand-side capabilities across NBCU’s programmatic ecosystem.

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager, Programmatic Demand to drive the evolution of how programmatic demand is optimized, scaled, and productized across NBCU’s streaming footprint.

Role Overview

This role focuses on developing scalable products, systems, and workflows that improve programmatic demand performance across NBCU’s ad tech stack.

You will identify inefficiencies in auction dynamics, platform behavior, and partner integrations—and translate those insights into durable product solutions rather than one-off optimizations.

A key focus area will be live event monetization, where concurrency, DSP behavior, and system constraints introduce complex demand-side challenges that require structured, product-led solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Auction Performance & Optimization Systems

  • Design and build scalable solutions (tools, workflows, automation) to analyze and optimize auction performance across bid rate, win rate, fill, pacing, and timeouts
  • Translate performance insights into productized capabilities (e.g., automated optimization frameworks, configuration layers, or decisioning logic)
  • Partner with Engineering to implement systems that continuously improve demand efficiency and revenue outcomes

Live Event Monetization (CTV Focus)

  • Identify performance gaps and system constraints in live event auctions (e.g., scaling limits, DSP throttling, timeout behavior)
  • Drive development of product solutions to increase stability, scalability, and performance in high-concurrency environments
  • Partner cross-functionally and externally to ensure platform and partner readiness for tentpole events

Platform Configuration & Deal Strategy

  • Define product-driven approaches to deal structure, configuration standards, and optimization across PG and PMP
  • Improve how platform settings (e.g., in FreeWheel and partner DSPs) translate into predictable demand performance
  • Productize best practices to reduce inefficiencies and variability in deal execution

Partner Integrations & Performance

  • Identify systemic partner performance issues and drive long-term solutions (vs. one-off fixes)
  • Inform product strategy based on partner capabilities, limitations, and evolving DSP behavior

Additional Responsibilities

  • Product Development & Testing: Own requirements and validation for demand optimization features and experiments
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Align Product, Engineering, Ad Ops, Sales, and Strategy on priorities and outcomes
  • Issue Resolution: Lead root cause analysis and improve systems/processes to prevent recurring issues
  • Documentation & Enablement: Translate product functionality into clear internal guidance and GTM alignment
  • Market Insights: Monitor industry trends and inform product direction

Qualifications

  • Strong understanding of programmatic advertising ecosystems, including digital ad serving, measurement frameworks, identity signals, and privacy controls—and how these components work together to enable scalable, addressable advertising across CTV and digital environments
  • Experience implementing and validating measurement and data pipelines, with a focus on ensuring consistency and accuracy across platforms (e.g., bid requests, attribution, viewability, IVT, and delivery metrics)
  • Solid working knowledge of privacy regulations and industry signals (e.g., CCPA, GDPR, GPP, ATT, COPPA), and their implications for data usage, identity resolution, targeting, and measurement in a programmatic context
  • Experience understanding identity and user signals (e.g., device IDs, platform identifiers, consent signals) to enable privacy-compliant audience targeting and optimization
  • Proven ability to translate complex technical, business, and regulatory requirements into scalable, productized solutions - particularly within programmatic demand, auction dynamics, or partner integrations
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience diagnosing performance gaps, data discrepancies, and system inefficiencies, and driving root-cause resolution in production environments
  • Experience developing or leveraging automation and/or AI-driven approaches to monitor, validate, and improve the stability, quality, and performance of demand systems and measurement capabilities
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to operate effectively across Product, Engineering, Ad Ops, Sales, Strategy, and external partners to drive aligned outcomes
  • Demonstrated ability to operate in high-scalability, high-concurrency environments (e.g., CTV and live events), with a product mindset focused on building durable, system-level solutions rather than one-off fixes
  • Minimum of 3+ years of product management experience, preferably within digital advertising, ad tech, or data-driven platforms; experience in CTV, streaming, or programmatic demand strongly preferred

  • Define the end-to-end architecture for ingestion, processing, and routing of operational telemetry (metrics, logs, traces).

  • Establish metrics for automation impact and report results to studio leadership on a regular cadence.
  • Champion a culture of continuous improvement and surface new automation opportunities as workflows evolve.

  • 10+ years building production systems, with 2+ years building AI/ML systems for real workflows.
  • Hands-on experience deploying enterprise software in AI, data, or integration environments.
  • Expertise with containerization, orchestration, Python, TypeScript, React, and AI frameworks such as LangGraph, Spring AI and MCP.
  • Deep understanding of LLM model integration and tuning.
  • Experience with designing automation that reduces manual work in complex, multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Proven ability to influence senior engineers without authority and to be the person others learn from.
  • History of building and supporting durable artifacts: frameworks, templates, training, open source that extend to other projects.
  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to translate fluently between artists, production management, and engineers.
  • Genuine passion for animation, storytelling, or creative production.

We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

We are looking for a Systems Engineer to join the Technology team in Tampa, FL, supporting WRMD. As a Systems Engineer, you will be primarily responsible for implementing and supporting technology and users within our mission critical, media production and enterprise IT environment. If you love challenges, enjoy working with people, and want to make a positive impact while being a part of a high performing team working at the leading edge of media technology, you could be the perfect match for our team.

Job Responsibilities

  • Gather requirements, plan, and implement technical and workflow solutions for News, Production, and Creative Services partners.
  • Administration of media production applications, systems and infrastructure, ensuring reliability of technology and operations.
  • Develop and maintain system documentation for operational and troubleshooting purposes.
  • Provide technical support, incident response, and customer communication.
  • Ensure compliance with NBCUniversal cyber security policies and standards.
  • All other duties as assigned.
  • Required onsite: This position is required to be performed full time onsite from an NBCUniversal designated work site.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 3 years relevant experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, radio, television & film, related fields or equivalent experience.
  • Ability to support a 24/7/365 operation.

Skills & Experience we are looking for:

  • Support of mid-to-major market news or live event production operations & 24x7 mission critical technology facilities.
  • Expertise in planning, implementation and support of media technology including SDI, NDI and ST-2110 video infrastructures, contribution & distribution encoding, live production systems, news gathering tools, NRCS, NLE, media asset management, and transmission systems.
  • Expertise in core IT fundamentals including administration of physical / virtualized / cloud compute & storage, networking, domain & identity management.
  • History of successfully leading complex projects resulting in satisfied stakeholders.

Eligibility Requirements:

  • Interested candidate must submit a resume/CV through www.nbcunicareers.com to be considered.
  • Must be willing to work in Tampa, FL
  • Willingness to travel and work outside standard hours, and on weekends with short notice.
  • You must possess a valid driver's license.
  • Must be willing to submit to a background investigation.
  • Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be 18 years or older.
  • Ability to lift and carry 50+ pounds of gear.
  • Ability to communicate and interact effectively with diverse audiences across different departments, ranging from non-technical clients to technical professionals and operations staff.
  • You must be able to process large amounts of information, analyze this information and make sound decisions, sometimes under intense deadline pressure.
  • Ability to work on your own initiative.
  • Excellent organization, collaboration and communication skills.
  • Must possess strong multitasking skills and the ability to prioritize tasks.

The Graphics Coordinator at TODAY with Jenna & Sheinelle is the primary graphics contact for producers, directors, artists and playback operators. The Coordinator reviews and modifies graphic orders, assigns uncompleted requests, and produces additional elements to enhance segments. The Coordinator serves as the final evaluator of prepared graphics, ensuring elements are accurate, error-free, and made in accordance with the producers’ visions and the show’s look and feel. The Coordinator plays an integral role in the control room, alerting the director when elements should be inserted and producing last-minute requests.

Responsibilities will include, but not be limited to:

  • Manage graphics from conception to completion, including animations, monitors, photographs, text panels and lower thirds
  • Review, proof and assign existing graphics requests, generate additional elements to enhance stories
  • Load and traffic all elements into the daily rundown for playback.
  • Compose a daily list of supers and transfer the information to lower third graphics
  • Direct graphics from the control room during live broadcast
  • Forward ongoing rundown changes to a variety of team contributors
  • Review producers’ notes to develop in-depth knowledge of all segments
  • Provide rights and clearances guidance to producers and flag any content that needs additional review to senior leadership
  • Develop and lead initiatives to improve graphics ordering, creation and playback processes
  • Track previous orders to streamline workflow for recurring segments
  • Maintain the “Graphics How-To” guide for staff reference.
  • 1+ years of experience in production at the network or daytime television level
  • 1+ years of experience working with graphics at the network or cable news level
  • Bachelor’s degree in Journalism, Communication, English or a related field of study
  • Must be willing to work in New York, NY
  • Willingness to work overtime and on weekends with short notice
  • Interested candidates must submit a resume/CV through www.nbcunicareers.com to be considered

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously in fast-paced environment
  • Strong grammar, punctuation, spelling and written communication skills
  • Demonstrated strong knowledge and interest in pop culture and current events
  • Self-starter with advanced technical skills
  • Strong journalistic research skills and editorial judgment
  • Knowledge of NBC News policies and guidelines and practices

Job Description

We’re looking for a Product Designer to create intuitive, engaging, and user-centered digital experiences across our web and mobile products. You’ll collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Researchers, and other stakeholders to solve complex problems through thoughtful design and data-informed decision making.

This role requires a strong understanding of UX and UI design principles, exceptional communication skills, and expert proficiency in Figma.

This is a role in our audience development digital marketing group and will focus on platforms that include the Bravo, NBC Insider, Peacock Blog consumer facing web platforms along with our B2B NBC Affiliate Marketing application. This is an onsite role in our New York or LA Office where expectations are being in Office Monday through Thursday and remote day on Fridays.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end design process from discovery through final implementation.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineering and Stakeholders to define product requirements and user experiences.
  • Create user flows, journey maps, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs.
  • Design responsive experiences across desktop, tablet, and mobile platforms.
  • Develop and maintain design systems, component libraries, and interaction patterns.
  • Conduct competitive analysis and incorporate user research and usability findings into design decisions.
  • Develop interactive prototypes to communicate concepts and validate solutions.
  • Work within and contribute to the company’s design system to ensure consistency and scalability.
  • Present design concepts and rationale to cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Partner with developers during implementation to ensure design quality and accuracy.
  • Iterate on designs based on user feedback, analytics, experimentation, and business goals.
  • Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in product design.

Basic Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience designing digital products for web and/or mobile applications.
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma is required, including:
    • Auto Layout
    • Components and Variants
    • Variables
    • Design Systems
    • Interactive Prototyping
    • Dev Mode and developer handoff
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design work and problem-solving skills.
  • Solid understanding of UX principles, interaction design, information architecture, accessibility, and visual design.
  • Experience creating wireframes, user flows, mockups, and prototypes.
  • Ability to communicate design decisions clearly and present work to stakeholders.
  • Experience working within Agile product development teams.
  • Strong collaboration, organization, and time management skills.
  • Required Skills
    • Figma (required)
    • User Experience (UX) Design
    • User Interface (UI) Design
    • Wireframing
    • Interactive Prototyping
    • Design Systems
    • Information Architecture
    • Visual Design
    • Responsive Design
    • Accessibility (WCAG)
    • Cross-functional Collaboration
    • Problem Solving
    • Communication and Presentation

Desired Characteristics:

  • Experience maintaining or contributing to a design system.
  • Experience conducting usability testing or working with UX research.
  • Familiarity with A/B testing and data-informed product decisions.
  • Understanding of front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
  • Experience designing subscription, B2B, or content-driven digital products is a plus.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Delivers polished, user-centered designs that solve customer and business needs.
  • Collaborates effectively across Product, Engineering, and Design teams.
  • Produces high-quality Figma files that are organized, scalable, and developer-friendly.
  • Uses research, analytics, and user feedback to continuously improve product experiences.
  • Contributes to the evolution of the design system and overall design quality.

Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

job.title: Product Manager
job.description:
NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

NBCUniversal’s Enterprise Product Team builds products that provide essential capabilities to organizations throughout NBCUniversal. The team leverages deep relationships with our business engagement and engineering counterparts to build cohesive, end-to-end solutions for their clients or users. The product portfolio is aligned around critical NBCU functions such as Content/Title Management, Data & Analytics, Scheduling & Distribution, Media Asset Management and Content Sales.

As a part of the Product team, you will be responsible for several products in your department.  You will be in constant communication with clients on anything product related, including development progress, deliverables, and timelines. You will lead grooming sessions, and execute product demos, and walkthroughs.  You are an expert in your area’s product features, capabilities, and functionality.  You will be a consultant on new multi-product initiatives or programs.  You will be a mentor to Product Specialists. 

Essential Responsibilities

Product Lifecycle Management

  • Manage the end-to-end life cycle of products, from ideation through delivery and ongoing optimization.
  • Define and own overall product vision, strategy, and success metrics for key initiatives, including data warehouse and business intelligence platforms.

Roadmap & Backlog Ownership

  • Develop and maintain feature roadmaps, prioritizing capabilities based on business needs and strategic goals.
  • Lead grooming sessions to ensure a consistently up-to-date backlog of clearly defined features and user stories.
  • Fully document product features and capabilities in JIRA, including measurable acceptance criteria.

Stakeholder Engagement & Requirements Gathering

  • Collaborate across functions (Engineering, Ad Sales, Programming, Operations, Product, Architecture) to capture and analyze requests, define data needs, and align priorities.
  • Translate complex business requirements into actionable product features and conceptual models.

Technical Collaboration & Solution Design

  • Partner with architecture and solutions leaders to identify optimal technical solutions that meet client and business needs.
  • Work closely with engineering teams and vendors to implement automation and workflow optimizations.

Data-Driven Product Development

  • Perform hands-on data exploration and analysis of large datasets to inform product decisions and enable data-driven features.
  • Continually leverage business insights and analytics to refine platform strategy and solve high-impact problems.

Quality Assurance & Compliance

  • Define and execute user acceptance testing for new features and integrations.
  • Ensure all workflows and vendor deliverables adhere to NBCUniversal standards and industry regulations.

Incident & Change Management

  • Coordinate resolution of operational issues promptly to minimize disruption.
  • Manage change requests effectively to maintain stability in live environments.

Reporting & Analytics

  • Track and report on vendor performance metrics (uptime, error rates, turnaround times).
  • Provide actionable insights and recommendations to improve service quality and operational efficiency.

Documentation & Governance

  • Maintain comprehensive documentation for processes, integrations, and SLAs.
  • Ensure all product and vendor workflows comply with internal standards and regulatory requirements.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience required.
  • Minimum 5+ years of relevant work experience in the technology or media industry.
  • Minimum 3+ years’ experience in a role demonstrating strong technical, quantitative, and analytical skills.
  • Minimum 3+ years’ experience in a role exhibiting excellent written and oral communications, effective interpersonal skills, project management, and strong formal presentation abilities.
  • Expertise in the SDLC process, with a focus on scoping, iteration planning, user story and acceptance criteria writing, rollout management.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills - capable of assessing ambiguous situations, evaluating diverse factors, and adapting existing approaches to devise effective solutions.
  • Proven ability to influence and collaborate with senior stakeholders - including those unfamiliar with the subject matter, by tailoring communication style and providing guidance on challenging issues.
  • Experience working on problems of diverse scope - requiring sound judgment, interpretation, and decision-making with minimal supervision.

 

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 3+ years Product management experience in media, gathering client requirements, writing product and/or technical specifications, working with development teams, and managing product roadmaps as well as launches
  • At least 2 years of direct client engagement experience
  • Experience in Television/Broadcast, Media, Technology, or related field
  • Experience with Agile methodology
  • Experience with using Jira or a similar system to track and maintain feature requirements and development progress
  • Natural problem solver, who is adaptable in a fast-paced environment and is highly collaborative
  • Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time
  • This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $110,000 - $145,000

As part of our selection process, external candidates may be required to attend an in-person interview with an NBCUniversal employee at one of our locations prior to a hiring decision. Product Lifecycle Management

  • Track and report on vendor performance metrics (uptime, error rates, turnaround times).

  • Maintain comprehensive documentation for processes, integrations, and SLAs.

NBC News is seeking a seasoned, driven Producer to support newsgathering, storytelling, and live production across all platforms. The ideal candidate is a creative journalist with sharp editorial judgment, strong writing and research skills, and the confidence to thrive under pressure. This producer should be equally at home in the field, on location, or in the control room, and adept at delivering both live and taped segments that meet NBC’s highest editorial standards. The ideal candidate is a news junkie who can’t wait to get out the door and, on the road, to cover that next story. This producer should also enjoy storytelling for morning television, an evening newscast and everything in between. The ability to shoot and edit is a plus, along with a sense of what does well on social media or in vertical video formats.

This role is right for you if you’re a versatile storyteller who thrives on urgency and impact. You move seamlessly between producing, reporting, and writing, and you’re as comfortable leading coverage during breaking news as you are crafting enterprise stories. You’re highly organized, competitive, and relentless about accuracy and detail—yet collaborative, adaptable, and energized by working with correspondents and teams under tight deadlines. Most importantly, you’re passionate about journalism that informs, engages, and makes a difference.

  • Ability to travel at a moment’s notice to cover a story and commit to staying on the road as long as the story takes.
  • Collaborate with control rooms, senior producers, and editorial teams to build rundowns, write intros, and produce live and taped segments.
  • Oversee field operations, including live shots, remote anchor setups, and breaking news coverage.
  • Track and manage correspondent’s schedule when working with them closely. 
  • Work closely with editors to ensure high-quality video packages, graphics, and sound.
  • Partner with Standards & Legal to ensure all content adheres to editorial and corporate guidelines.
  • Maintain strong communication between the Correspondent, senior leadership, assignment desk and production teams.
  • Contribute ideas for a wide range of content including news-of-day, lifestyle features, celebrity interviews, and human-interest stories.

Basic Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism, communications, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • Minimum 5 years’ experience in network news, cable, or talk show production, including live and taped segments.
  • Strong journalistic writing, research, and editorial judgment skills.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of U.S. politics, current events, pop culture, and lifestyle trends.
  • Experience shooting (DSLR or iPhone) and editing (Avid and/or Adobe Premiere).

Together, we’re committed to getting customers to content they love, faster and more easily. 

 

What You’ll Do:

As a Sr. Product Design Manager on the Discovery & Playback Experience team, you will lead, grow, and mentor a small team of designers while remaining hands-on as a senior individual contributor. You’ll have the unique opportunity to define the vision, strategy, and design direction for how audiences find and watch content on Peacock. You’ll strike a balance between guiding your team's work with owning high-priority projects yourself — ensuring alignment with our organization's goals, design principles, and long-term product vision.

Our team is focused on delivering best-in-class discovery and playback experiences with a strong emphasis on TV, alongside mobile and web. From helping viewers find their next favorite show to crafting intuitive playback, live events, replays, and lean-back viewing, you'll help build experiences that meet viewers where they are and elevate how they watch.

This role calls for a true player-coach: someone who can translate user needs into elegant, cross-platform experiences while also coaching a small team of designers to do the same. You'll drive innovation, foster collaboration across disciplines, and shape the future of how audiences discover and connect with content on Peacock — all while staying close to the craft.

  • Deliver production-ready UX designs aligned with overarching business and UX goals for domestic and international audiences.
  • Manage, coach, and grow a small team of product designers — running critiques, weighing cross-functional priorities, supporting career development, and defining patterns and practices for the team and the product.
  • Drive stakeholder and leadership alignment around research insights and design decisions.
  • Collaborate with the larger UX team around ideation and concept explorations throughout project lifecycles; facilitate and drive UX solutions, discussions, and planning while maintaining project oversight.
  • Identify actionable insights and ensure they align with long-term design and product strategies.
  • Balance people leadership with hands-on design work, staying close enough to the details to lead by example.
  • Maintain a critical eye and an obsessive attention to detail.

You're a seasoned designer and recognized people leader with relentlessly high standards and deep operational knowledge across every aspect of UX and product design — especially in crafting intuitive discovery and playback experiences for TV, mobile, and web.

You're thoughtful and curious, always learning from both viewers and teammates. You stay fully versed in consumer digital product trends, emerging technologies, and interaction models shaping the future of how audiences find and watch content.

You listen to the voice of the viewer and let data guide your decisions — blending qualitative insights with performance metrics to design experiences that resonate.

You identify the most impactful ideas and push them through a rigorous course of evaluation, experimentation, and release — from early concept to launch.

You're fluid and adaptable — able to pivot seamlessly between managing your team and contributing as a seasoned designer, across projects and priorities.

You're a storyteller and strong communicator, able to articulate design rationale and rally cross-functional partners around a shared vision — and to coach your team to do the same.

You can speak confidently to industry best practices, evolving viewer behaviors, market strategies, and competitor standards in the streaming space.

You're scrappy, driven, and the natural owner of both bold ideas and practical, high-quality output — equally comfortable managing a team, defining the big picture, or jumping into the details yourself.

You thrive in a fast-paced environment where iteration is constant and collaboration is key

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Producer (Pillar) in AAA game development to support delivery across a large-scale project. You will partner closely with the Product Owner, and pod leads to translating priorities into clear plans, facilitating key Scrum rituals, removing blockers, managing dependencies, and supporting team health across the pillar. 

This role combines game production experience, agile facilitation, and day-to-day team leadership. You will help create a collaborative, transparent, and accountable environment where teams can deliver high-quality work with focus and clarity. If it sounds like you, we’d love to meet you! 

Key Responsibilities: 

  • Translate pillar priorities into sprint plans, team commitments, and clear delivery expectations.  
  • Facilitate planning, refinement, reviews, retrospectives, and cross-pod coordination rituals.  
  • Maintain visibility on progress, risks, dependencies, capacity, and delivery confidence.  
  • Keep backlogs clear, prioritized, and actionable in partnership with the Product Owner, pod leads, and craft directors.  
  • Identify blockers early and help teams resolve or escalate them effectively.  
  • Support communication across pods so teams have the context they need to make decisions.  
  • Improve workflows, rituals, and delivery habits through retrospectives and team feedback.  
  • Coordinate execution against production pipelines, milestones, and broader project goals.  
  • Reinforce a culture of collaboration, transparency, ownership, adaptability, and shared responsibility for quality. 

Nous recherchons un(e) Senior Producer expérimenté(e) (Pilier), dans le développement de jeux AAA afin de soutenir la livraison d’un projet à grande échelle. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec le Product Owner et les leads de pods afin de traduire les priorités en plans clairs, d’animer les principaux rituels Scrum, de lever les blocages, de gérer les dépendances et de soutenir la santé des équipes au sein du pilier. 

Ce rôle combine une expérience en production de jeux, en facilitation agile et en leadership opérationnel au quotidien. Vous contribuerez à créer un environnement collaboratif, transparent et responsable, où les équipes peuvent livrer un travail de haute qualité avec concentration et clarté. Si ce poste vous correspond, nous serions ravis de vous rencontrer ! 

Responsabilités Principales:

  • Traduire les priorités du pilier en plans de sprint, engagements des équipes et attentes de livraison claires.  
  • Animer les rituels agiles clés : planification, refinement, revues, rétrospectives et coordination inter‑pods.  
  • Maintenir une visibilité sur l’avancement, les risques, les dépendances, la capacité et le niveau de confiance de la livraison.  
  • Maintenir des backlogs clairs, priorisés et exploitables en partenariat avec le Product Owner, les leads de pods et les directeurs de discipline.  
  • Identifier les blocages en amont et aider les équipes à les résoudre ou à les escalader efficacement.  
  • Soutenir la communication entre les pods afin que les équipes disposent du contexte nécessaire à la prise de décision.  
  • Améliorer les flux de travail, les rituels et les habitudes de livraison grâce aux rétrospectives et aux retours des équipes.  
  • Coordonner l’exécution en lien avec les pipelines de production, les jalons et les objectifs globaux du projet.  
  • Renforcer une culture de collaboration, de transparence, de responsabilisation, d’adaptabilité et de responsabilité collective en matière de qualité. 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in AAA game production, content production, asset production, or related production roles. Proven experience in game production, ideally on complex AAA or large-scale projects.  
  • Experience operating as a Scrum Master, agile producer, delivery lead, or senior producer supporting multiple teams.  
  • Strong understanding of Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid production approaches.  
  • Ability to partner effectively with Product Owners, pod leads, craft directors, and multidisciplinary development teams.  
  • Strong facilitation skills, with the ability to run productive meetings, clarify decisions, and drive alignment.  
  • Experience with sprint planning, backlog refinement, retrospectives, risk tracking, dependency management, and delivery follow-up.  
  • Experience with milestone planning, sprint execution, production gates, and hybrid agile models. 
  • Ability to manage cross-team dependencies, identify risks early, and create transparency around delivery confidence.  
  • Excellent communication, problem-solving, and collaboration skills.  
  • Ability to manage ambiguity and help teams break complex goals into executable plans.  
  • Experience working with JIRA or similar project management tools.  
  • Demonstrated ability to build trust and support a positive, collaborative development culture.

  • Experience with live service development, platform development, UGC systems, or large-scale online games.

Job Description

We’re looking for a Product Designer to create intuitive, engaging, and user-centered digital experiences across our web and mobile products. You’ll collaborate closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Researchers, and other stakeholders to solve complex problems through thoughtful design and data-informed decision making.

This role requires a strong understanding of UX and UI design principles, exceptional communication skills, and expert proficiency in Figma.

This is a role in our audience development digital marketing group and will focus on platforms that include the Bravo, NBC Insider, Peacock Blog consumer facing web platforms along with our B2B NBC Affiliate Marketing application. This is an onsite role in our New York or LA Office where expectations are being in Office Monday through Thursday and remote day on Fridays.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end design process from discovery through final implementation.
  • Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineering and Stakeholders to define product requirements and user experiences.
  • Create user flows, journey maps, wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI designs.
  • Design responsive experiences across desktop, tablet, and mobile platforms.
  • Develop and maintain design systems, component libraries, and interaction patterns.
  • Conduct competitive analysis and incorporate user research and usability findings into design decisions.
  • Develop interactive prototypes to communicate concepts and validate solutions.
  • Work within and contribute to the company’s design system to ensure consistency and scalability.
  • Present design concepts and rationale to cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
  • Partner with developers during implementation to ensure design quality and accuracy.
  • Iterate on designs based on user feedback, analytics, experimentation, and business goals.
  • Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices in product design.

Basic Requirements:

  • 3+ years of experience designing digital products for web and/or mobile applications.
  • Advanced proficiency in Figma is required, including:
    • Auto Layout
    • Components and Variants
    • Variables
    • Design Systems
    • Interactive Prototyping
    • Dev Mode and developer handoff
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end product design work and problem-solving skills.
  • Solid understanding of UX principles, interaction design, information architecture, accessibility, and visual design.
  • Experience creating wireframes, user flows, mockups, and prototypes.
  • Ability to communicate design decisions clearly and present work to stakeholders.
  • Experience working within Agile product development teams.
  • Strong collaboration, organization, and time management skills.
  • Required Skills
    • Figma (required)
    • User Experience (UX) Design
    • User Interface (UI) Design
    • Wireframing
    • Interactive Prototyping
    • Design Systems
    • Information Architecture
    • Visual Design
    • Responsive Design
    • Accessibility (WCAG)
    • Cross-functional Collaboration
    • Problem Solving
    • Communication and Presentation

Desired Characteristics:

  • Experience maintaining or contributing to a design system.
  • Experience conducting usability testing or working with UX research.
  • Familiarity with A/B testing and data-informed product decisions.
  • Understanding of front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
  • Experience designing subscription, B2B, or content-driven digital products is a plus.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Delivers polished, user-centered designs that solve customer and business needs.
  • Collaborates effectively across Product, Engineering, and Design teams.
  • Produces high-quality Figma files that are organized, scalable, and developer-friendly.
  • Uses research, analytics, and user feedback to continuously improve product experiences.
  • Contributes to the evolution of the design system and overall design quality.

Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website.

The Director, Media Experimentation & Engagement leads NBCU’s incrementality and engagement measurement program for Performance and Device media. Experimentation is the causal calibration source for Growth Media Analytics’ measurement triangle: the function that keeps Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) and Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA) decision-grade. You own the learning agenda, set the standard for rigor, and translate test results into clear budget guidance leaders can act on with speed and confidence. You define how NBCU measures media’s effect on subscriber value and engagement, a critical causal measurement practice for the business. You manage a team to high-quality execution and train the next set of analytic leaders, and you are the face of Growth Media Analytics to Performance Media, Device Media, Growth Strategy, and Decision Sciences leadership on experimentation methodology. 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Own and scale the experimentation roadmap. Grow structured testing from roughly 15 to 75 panels per year while raising rigor on budget-grade decisions. Define the learning agenda, decision questions, hypotheses, success metrics, guardrails, and power thresholds, and approve or reject vendor designs against those standards. 
  • Define and lead engagement measurement. Build NBCU’s forward approach to measuring media’s effect on subscriber engagement and retention, in partnership with Growth Strategy and Decision Sciences. This includes variance reduction techniques for low-signal continuous outcomes, and the translation from measured lift to revenue and retention value. 
  • Own always-on holdouts. Lead holdout design and execution across Performance and Device media, including persistent engagement holdouts. 
  • Collaborate with Media Partners. Direct how NBCU uses conversion-lift (CLS) programs and clean room environments (Meta Advanced Analytics, Google ADH, Amazon AMC) for exposure mapping and lift measurement and set the standard for what partners can and cannot answer. 
  • Own measurement calibration. Serve as the source of truth for calibrating MMM and MTA, keeping media measurement consistent and decision-grade across the portfolio. 
  • Lead experimentation vendor relationships. Manage relationships across incrementality vendors, including new vendor onboarding, data transfer, validating methodology and result, and ensuring critical deliverables are shared to the business.  
  • Represent the team at the executive level. Own measurement-methodology relationships with Performance Media and Device Media leadership, Growth Strategy, Finance, and Decision Sciences. Challenge entrenched measurement beliefs and drive adoption of decision-grade testing. 
  • Build and develop the pod. Directly manage and develop a Manager and an Analyst, and uplevel cross-functional partner teams on test design, statistical power, and common pitfalls. 
  • Drive AI-enabled scale. Use agentic AI and automated analytics workflows to expand testing throughput, insight generation, and decisioning. 
  • 8+ years of relevant experience in media measurement and analytics, including experience at measurement vendors or agencies, and including direct people management and a track record of building and developing teams
  • 5+ years expertise in experimentation design and causal inference for media (structured testing, geo experiments, difference-in-differences, platform holdouts), with the ability to evaluate vendor assumptions and methods.
  • Strong foundation across the measurement triangle of MMM, MTA, and experimentation, with proven ability to reconcile and calibrate across them and translate results into business decisions.
  • Fluent in SQL and Excel, and proficient in at least one of R or Python for data analysis.

Desired Characteristics

  • Demonstrated experience presenting insights to executive audiences, with ability to create process/governance and ability to answer difficult questions in high pressure situations.
  • 2+ years of experience partnering with (or working at) incrementality measurement vendors (e.g., Haus, Measured, or similar) and managing media, agency, and vendor relationships.
  • Platform experience across Google, Meta, and TikTok incrementality, and at least one CTV or Device environment (e.g., Roku, Samsung, Vizio).
  • Working knowledge of clean room environments, with a clear point of view on where they produce decision-grade evidence and where they do not.
  • Demonstrated ability to measure and optimize multiple KPIs, including acquisition, engagement, and performance outcomes.
  • Experience leveraging, or strong interest in adopting, agentic AI and automated analytics workflows to scale experimentation and decisioning.
  • Excellent communication skills and executive presence, with the ability to influence in a highly matrixed environment.
  • Strong interest in the media industry, specifically television and streaming.
  • Strong sense of accountability, curiosity, and an innovative mindset, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Additional Requirements

  • Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time. 
  • This position is eligible for company sponsored benefits, including medical, dental and vision insurance, 401(k), paid leave, tuition reimbursement, and a variety of other discounts and perks. Learn more about the benefits offered by NBCUniversal by visiting the Benefits page of the Careers website. Salary range: $135,000 - $180,000 (bonus and long-term incentive eligible).

The Human Resources Director is responsible for providing strategic and operational HR leadership, direction, and expertise for the Corporate Finance organization and broader finance function.  In collaboration with the Finance HR team, this person will provide day to day client support and strategic HR solutions for the Corporate Controllership, Tax, Treasury, and Procurement teams.

This role will partner closely with business leaders in the areas of talent acquisition, performance management, change management, employee coaching, compensation strategies, succession planning, training & development, rewards & recognition, organizational effectiveness, and employee communication.          

  • Drive key HR initiatives including but not limited to staffing, performance management, compensation strategies, succession planning, training and development, rewards & recognition, recruitment and retention, organizational effectiveness, and employee communication.
  • Partner and collaborate with the Corporate Finance leadership team to align and execute HR strategies in support of business initiatives.
  • Mentor and provide guidance to Finance professionals related to career development and goals.  Build bench strength within the functions by identifying training and development opportunities for finance talent throughout NBCUniversal.
  • Work with managers and talent acquisition to focus on recruitment and retention of internal and external talent.
  • Manage employee relations issues including organizational structures and investigations.
  • Work with leaders and employees to establish and maintain a positive work environment, acting as an employee advocate.
  • Provide direction and support for our various pipeline and talent development programs ensuring its visibility and utilization across the Finance community .
  • Work closely and partner effectively with business HR leaders to ensure consistent HR practices across the Finance organization and function.
  • Develop strong relationships with HR partners and across NBCU
  • Build relationships with leaders and employees across the finance function
  • Other responsibilities and projects as assigned.

Basic Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources or related field of study
  • 7+ years relevant professional level HR experience

Desired Characteristics:

  • Proven HR leader with the ability to generate a vision and strategy to guide the organization through change, rethinking the way they look at decisions
  • Possess a natural ease working with and relating to employee needs in a fast-paced, ever-changing matrixed environment
  • Demonstrated ability to interact with a range of styles and be able to establish effective relationships at all levels, responding effectively and timely to internal clients
  • Trusted business partner with strong communication, interpersonal, organizational, and critical thinking skills; easily earns trust and credibility with employees
  • Experience supporting client groups through business reorganization and transformation
  • Takes ownership; able to establish self as “go to” HR resource
  • Excellent leadership, problem solving, project management, and presentation skills
  • Extremely flexible, highly organized and able to easily shift priorities and work independently
  • Ability to analyze data and use data to tell a story 
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills; strong interpersonal, facilitation and presentation skills
  • Effective influencing capability and established executive presence
  • Demonstrated ability to translate 'big picture' business strategy into an executable HR plan
