We are seeking a Reinforcement Learning Engineer with experience manipulating virtual environments to train autonomous agents. This role focuses on the design of robust simulation environments, reward structures, and policy architectures that can navigate complex, multi-sensor landscapes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Work with partner ML and Annotation engineers and TPMs to spec out data, simulation, and training requirements.
  • Environment Design: Build and maintain high-fidelity 2D/3D simulation environments (using tools like Unity, Unreal, or Isaac Sim) that serve as the training ground for RL agents.
  • Reward Engineering: Design and tune complex reward functions that align agent behavior with product goals and safety constraints.
  • Algorithm Implementation: Develop and optimize RL algorithms (e.g., PPO, SAC, or Offline RL) capable of handling high-dimensional 3D observation spaces.
  • Sim-to-Real Strategy: Analyze the "reality gap" and implement domain randomization or adaptation techniques to ensure models perform reliably in real-world scenarios.

Nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) ingénieur(e) en apprentissage par renforcement ayant de l’expérience dans la création et l’exploitation d’environnements virtuels pour l’entraînement d’agents autonomes. Ce rôle consiste à concevoir des environnements de simulation robustes, des structures de récompense et des architectures de politiques capables d’évoluer dans des contextes complexes et multi-capteurs.

Vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le rapprochement entre simulation et performance réelle en développant des systèmes RL évolutifs et en garantissant un comportement fiable des agents dans des conditions variées.

  • Collaboration interfonctionnelle : Travailler avec les ingénieurs ML, les équipes d’annotation et les TPM afin de définir les besoins en données, en simulation et en entraînement.
  • Conception d’environnements : Développer et maintenir des environnements de simulation 2D/3D à haute fidélité à l’aide d’outils tels que Unity, Unreal ou Isaac Sim.
  • Ingénierie des récompenses : Concevoir et optimiser des fonctions de récompense afin d’aligner le comportement des agents avec les objectifs produit et les contraintes de sécurité.
  • Implémentation d’algorithmes : Développer et optimiser des algorithmes d’apprentissage par renforcement (ex. : PPO, SAC, RL hors ligne) adaptés à des espaces d’observation à haute dimension.
  • Stratégie sim-to-real : Réduire l’écart entre simulation et réalité à l’aide de techniques comme la randomisation de domaine et l’adaptation afin d’assurer des performances fiables en conditions réelles.
  • Education: Graduate degree (Master’s or PhD) in Robotics, Computer Science, AI, or a related field with a focus on Reinforcement Learning, Imitation Learning, or other Online Machine Learning fields.
  • Professional Experience: Proven experience as an RL Engineer or Research Engineer in a fast-paced environment.
  • Industry Context: Prior experience in industries with complex multi-disciplinary teams such as robotics, smart grids, precision agriculture, game development, or aerospace.

Technical Proficiency:

  • Core Tools: Fluency with Python, Git, and the Unix shell.
  • RL Frameworks: Deep familiarity with frameworks like Ray Rllib, Stable Baselines3, or CleanRL.
  • Physics & 3D Engines: Experience with physics engines (MuJoCo, Bullet) or 3D game engines.
  • Ecosystem: Familiarity with collaborative tools such as Jira/Confluence, Slack, a Git server, and an experiment tracking framework.

Attributes:

  • Strong Mathematical Background: Essential for understanding Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) and gradient-based optimization.
  • High Attention to Detail: Critical for debugging non-deterministic agent behaviors and ensuring environment parity.

 

  • Formation : Maîtrise ou Doctorat en robotique, informatique, intelligence artificielle ou domaine connexe avec une spécialisation en apprentissage par renforcement, imitation ou apprentissage en ligne.

  • Serve as a digital correspondent within newscasts, providing insight and context around stories, conversations, trends and topics gaining attention online.
  • Collaborate with reporters, anchors, producers, photographers, editors and digital and social teams while also being capable of independently taking a story from idea to publication.

  • Experiment with emerging storytelling formats, tools and platform features as technology and audience habits evolve.

Must submit a portfolio or reel demonstrating a proven body of work across both broadcast reporting and digital/social journalism. Submissions should include examples of traditional television reporting as well as original social-first content that the candidate has produced.

  • Several years of professional journalism experience, with a demonstrated track record of reporting for broadcast television and producing original digital and social journalism.
  • Strong on-camera reporting and presentation skills, with demonstrated experience reporting live and from the field.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently report, shoot, write, edit, produce and present a television news story from start to finish
  • Proven experience producing original social-first video content.
  • Strong knowledge of Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and YouTube, including the storytelling styles, audience expectations and best practices unique to each platform.
  • Strong news judgment and knowledge of journalistic standards, ethics, sourcing and verification.
  • Excellent writing skills and the ability to write effectively for broadcast, digital and social audiences.
  • Experience shooting and editing video using mobile devices and professional editing tools.
  • Ability to work quickly, accurately and independently under tight deadlines.

  • A social-native journalist who actively follows how audiences discover, consume, share and engage with news across platforms.
  • A creative storyteller who understands the difference between producing content for social platforms and simply repurposing television content for social.
  • Strong ability to translate complicated topics into clear, compelling and accessible journalism without oversimplifying them.
  • Comfortable shifting between traditional broadcast presentation and the more conversational, direct-to-camera style often used on social and digital platforms.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to juggle multiple stories, platforms and deadlines.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving newsroom where priorities can change quickly.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Product Management, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in a role requiring strong technical, quantitative, and analytical skills.
  • Experience working within a privacy-focused, compliance-driven, or regulated product environment.
  • Strong ability to translate business and legal requirements into clear technical specifications.
  • Proven ability to manage competing priorities, resolve conflicts, and drive consensus across teams without direct authority.

KTAZ Telemundo in Phoenix, AZ, is seeking a Multimedia News Producer who can create news that appeals to both traditional Broadcast and new media audiences. The Multimedia News Producer will be responsible for successfully coordinating and executing newscasts, special programs, and digital content. 

Functions/Responsibilities

  • Responsible for the overall production of the news of the day, special coverage, in-depth stories, and other news-related content of each newscast and online platforms
  • For a successful newscast, the producer must be able to select, assign, write, and organize the flow of stories in the rundown. Write headlines, cold opens, teasers, and edit reporter lead-ins, as necessary. 
  • Responsible for being a key communicator in the newsroom- talking with each team member who will participate or provide content for that newscast. 
  • You must select stories, understand all the elements, and design a newscast to provide our audiences with the most relevant content, following the NBC/Telemundo Standards and Guidance in Journalism.
  • Communicate effectively with control room staff and field crew to execute live, fast-paced shows that include live shots and Satellite Remotes during newscasts inside the control room.
  • Leadership: take responsibility for your actions and be a team player.
  • Respond to breaking news promptly and accurately and have good time-management skills.
  • Knowledgeable of daily news events, keeping up with current events, being aware of past news events that provide context to the story, and learning about the Latino audience in Arizona.
  • Coordinate and plan future community and social story development.
  • Possess skills to shoot, edit, and publish video clips. 
  • This position has a dual role for broadcast and digital platforms. The ideal candidate is responsible for publishing content on multiple digital platforms, including web, mobile, and online social networks.
  • Work closely with fellow producers, the Executive Producer, the Managing Editor, and the News Director on story and sweeps planning and coordination, assisting them in coaching our talent after their on-air performances.
  • Contribute story ideas; participate in daily coverage decisions and editorial meetings.
  • Bring creativity into every aspect of the newscast and use Telemundo's arsenal of tools and equipment to provide the most current information that is geographically diverse and maximizes viewer benefits.
  • Complete discrepancy reports with detail and accuracy to help prevent future problems.
  • File additional reports related to the production of the newscasts. 
  • Understand and follow all Telemundo News standards and ethics.

Basic Qualifications

  • Fluency in Spanish and English, with exceptional written and verbal communication skills in both languages.
  • 2 to 4 years of News Producer experience. 
  • Excellent news judgment, creative ideas, and writing skills are necessary.

Eligibility Requirements

  • Must have unrestricted work authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must be 18 years or older. 
  • Must have a valid driver’s license and clean driving record.
  • Interested candidates must submit a resume/CV through www.nbcunicareers.com to be considered. 
  • Must be able to work a flexible schedule to cover other shifts and breaking news, including holidays and weekends.
  • Must be willing to work in the Phoenix area and travel as needed for special assignments.
  • Must be willing to work long hours, varying shifts (including nights and weekends), and report to work in emergencies depending upon news coverage when necessary.

Desired Qualifications

  • Highly collaborative and creative attitude
  • Demonstrable organizational and time management skills and working well under deadline pressure.
  • Strong interest in innovative video storytelling and strategic thinking around social media
  • Experience working with newsroom software, show rundowns, and scripts. 
  • Ability to adapt to the priorities of the news industry and the vision of the local news leadership so that we can connect with the audience more effectively through the content. 
  • Anticipate problems, address them throughout the shift, and eliminate all factual/spelling/other errors in the show. If a problem arises, address it immediately. Follow up issues with those involved and the newsroom manager.
  • Highly competitive nature. 
  • Ability to perform under tight deadlines.

Additional Job Requirements

As our Senior Data Engineer, you’ll join the Content Delivery Engineering team (CDE) within NBCUniversal’s Global Video Engineering organization in New York City, USA. The Senior Data Engineer will be responsible for implementing and maintaining systems that ingest, process, and store vast amounts of data from internal systems and external partner systems. These data systems must be scalable, robust, and within budget. In this role, Senior Data Engineer will work with a variety of technologies that support the building of meaningful models, alerts, reports, and visualizations from vast quantities of data. 

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop & maintain new and existing data systems and pipelines, with a focus on reliability, testability and ease of use.  
  • Assist in cleansing, discretization, imputation, selection, generalization etc. to create high quality features for the modeling process
  • Work with business stakeholders to define business requirements including KPI and acceptance criteria
  • Use big data, relational and non-relational data sources, to access data at the appropriate level of granularity for the needs of specific analytical projects
  • Maintain up to date knowledge of the relevant data set structures and participate in defining necessary upgrades and modifications
  • Collaborate with software and data architects in building real-time and automated batch implementations of the data science solutions and integrating them into the streaming service architecture
  • Ensure a consistent, diligent approach to peer review of code and configuration change within sensible, maintained repository structures and CI/CD pipelined deployment.
  • Participate in, or lead design reviews, architectural discussions and team knowledge‑sharing sessions with peers and stakeholders.
  • Make best use of our observability systems & advanced analytics to surface issues, drive diagnosis and develop fixes.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information technology, or a relevant field is required.
  • 5+ years of experience in working with big data: ETL, pipeline building, analysis and code, with expertise in at least one programming language
  • Experience implementing scalable, distributed, highly available, and resilient systems using industry standard data platforms (Snowflake, Databricks, GCP, AWS, etc.)
  • Skilled with using software repositories, CI/CD pipelines and test automation.
  • Experience with data visualization tools and techniques
  • Strong skills in data processing using SQL
  • Experience with Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices for ensuring scalability and reliability in cloud environments.
  • Familiarity with Agile methodologies (Scrum and Kanban).  
  • A flair for communicating clearly via design document, text, voice and code to a wide variety of nationalities.
  • Knowledge and/or production exposure to using CDNs to deliver streaming media is advantageous or full training can be provided.

Desired Characteristics

  • Experience with Snowflake or similar data service
  • Experience with data visualizations
  • Experience with multi-billion record datasets and leading projects that span the disciplines of data science and data engineering
  • Knowledge of enterprise-level digital analytics platforms
  • Team oriented and collaborative approach with a demonstrated aptitude and willingness to learn new methods and tools
  • Pride and ownership in your work and confident representation of your team to other parts of NBCUniversal

Hybrid: This position currently has a hybrid schedule, which requires contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week. The Company reserves the right to change in-office requirements at any time.

job.title: Technical Product Manager, Live Services Automation
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview:

 

Paramount+ streams some of the biggest live sports and events in the world, and our Live Services Product (LSP) oversees the backend platform that makes it possible. LSP provides operators with one experience through our Live Events CMS. The live services automations team supports this. They create specialized services to manage provider integrations. They also oversee orchestration, automation, and distribution. Each of these services is separate.

 

We're hiring a Technical Product Manager to expand the Live Services Automation area within LSP. This includes systems that automatically process incoming live signal inputs. You will set up and manage channel infrastructure. You will also make sure that each live show element is checked and ready before it goes on air. Finally, you will consistently distribute live content to our target destinations for the Paramount+ experience.

 

This is a deeply technical, backend-first role. The Live Events CMS owns the operator-facing surface, and you own the domain logic underneath it that extends its functionality through automation with 1st party/3rd part integrations. You'll partner closely with the CMS product owner to make sure the workflows you build surface cleanly through the CMS, and you'll report to the Live Services lead on platform strategy and vision.

 

Experience with live streaming, broadcast, or real-time systems is strongly preferred. We want someone who understands the ecosystem and its challenges. They should know what works and what might fail during a live event. This knowledge will help them build systems that work well and can recover automatically. 

 

Responsibilities:

 

Own Backend Platform Strategy

 

  • Shape and ship the roadmap for the Live Services Platform. Focus on automation, workflows, and links between systems.

  • Build services that scale with every live event. Cover the full path from scheduling to playback and monitoring.

 

Drive Automation & Orchestration

 

  • Design automation that removes manual steps from live event setup.

  • Build "self-healing" workflows that boost reliability and cut extra   work.

 

Lead Integrations Across Systems

 

  • Own the links between Summit and other systems. This covers scheduling, channels, listings, signal acquisition, and monitoring.

  • Keep data flowing smoothly across internal platforms and third-party services.

 

Translate Operations into Systems

 

  • Partner with Live Operations and Engineering. Turn real-time needs into backend  solutions that scale.

  • Spot bottlenecks and design systems that run better at scale.

 

Define Technical Solutions

 

  • Write clear product docs with senior engineering and product leads. This covers API contracts, workflows, sequence diagrams, and system designs.

  • Give engineering teams clear direction on architecture, dependencies, and      integration patterns.

 

Agile Product Ownership

 

  • Act as Product Owner for a devoted engineering team.

  • Manage the backlog, set priorities, and ship deeply technical platform features.

 

Cross-Functional Management

 

  • Align stakeholders across product, engineering, and operations on backend      platform strategy and delivery.

  • Support big live event launches with systems that never miss a beat!

 

Basic Qualifications:

 

  • 2-4 years in Technical Product Management or a closely related engineering role, with hands-on depth in backend systems, APIs, and/or platform products.

  • A track record of shipping automation, orchestration, or distributed integrations.

  • You should have a solid knowledge of event-driven architecture. You should also know about workflow orchestration and contracts between services.

  • Comfort living in APIs, system links, and data flows; UI experience is not needed.

  • Well-developed technical writing: API specs, sequence diagrams, system workflows.

  • Experience owning a backlog and leading technical delivery on an Agile team.

 

Additional Qualifications:

 

  • Live streaming, live sports, or broadcast operations experience — you understand the stakes of a live event and how automation reduces them.

  • Experience integrating third-party data providers (stats, scheduling, listings, or similar feeds) into a platform via versioned contracts.

  • Knowledge of reliability patterns: retries, reconciliation and observability at scale.

 

 

Paramount Skydance Corporation (NASDAQ: PSKY) is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Driven by iconic studios, networks and streaming services, Paramount's portfolio of consumer brands includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, and Pluto TV, among others. Paramount delivers the largest share of the U.S. television audience and boasts one of the industry's most important and extensive libraries of TV and film titles. job.title: Commercial Production Manager
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

We are looking for an experienced Commercial Production Manager to lead a distributed team of commercial producers and oversee the delivery of high-quality commercial video content across multiple TEGNA markets. This role will directly manage approximately 8–10 commercial producers located in different markets, providing leadership, coaching, prioritization, and operational support to ensure the team consistently delivers strong work for our clients and sales partners.

The Commercial Production Manager will be a key partner to local sales leadership and sales teams, helping create effective workflows between sales and production, balance client needs with production resources, and continuously improve how commercial creative is developed and delivered. The ideal candidate combines strong production expertise with people leadership, practical problem-solving, collaboration, and change management skills. This person should be comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment, introducing new processes and technologies, and finding pragmatic solutions that improve both quality and efficiency.

Responsibilities: 

  • Team Leadership & Development: Lead, coach, and develop a distributed team of approximately 8–10 commercial producers across multiple TEGNA markets. Establish clear expectations, provide regular feedback, support professional development, and foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, creativity, and high performance.
  • Production Leadership: Provide oversight and direction for commercial production from concept through final delivery, ensuring work is completed efficiently, on time, within budget, and to established quality standards.
  • Sales Partnership: Build strong, collaborative relationships with local sales leaders and sales teams. Serve as a trusted production partner who understands business priorities, client needs, and market realities and helps teams develop practical solutions that support revenue and client retention.
  • Sales & Production Workflow: Develop, implement, and continuously improve systems and processes that create seamless collaboration between sales and production. Establish clear expectations, roles, timelines, and communication practices across teams.
  • Resource & Workload Management: Manage production capacity and priorities across multiple markets, balancing workloads and deploying resources effectively to meet client and business needs.
  • Change Management: Lead teams through evolving production processes, organizational changes, and new technologies and tools, including AI-enabled capabilities. Help producers and sales partners understand the rationale for change, adopt new ways of working, and translate new processes into practical day-to-day execution.
  • Operational Improvement: Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, improve turnaround times, increase consistency, and scale best practices across markets. Take a pragmatic approach to solving problems, balancing ideal creative solutions with business needs, available resources, timelines, and budgets.
  • Client Experience: Ensure production teams understand client objectives and deliver a professional, responsive experience throughout the production process. Step in as needed to help resolve complex client or production issues.
  • Quality Control: Establish and maintain strong creative and technical standards across the team, providing guidance and feedback to ensure commercial content meets both client expectations and TEGNA standards.
  • Production Planning: Ensure effective production planning across markets, including scheduling, budgeting, location needs, talent coordination, equipment, and other production resources.
  • Budget & Vendor Management: Oversee production budgets and the effective use of external vendors, freelancers, and contractors. Ensure resources are used responsibly and projects remain within financial parameters.
  • Problem Solving & Escalation: Anticipate and resolve production, staffing, workflow, and client challenges. Exercise sound judgment and provide practical solutions that keep work moving while maintaining strong relationships with internal and external partners.
  • Compliance: Ensure production activities comply with applicable legal, safety, contractual, rights, and clearance requirements.
  • Performance & Reporting: Monitor team workload, production performance, timelines, quality, and other key measures. Provide visibility to leadership on performance, opportunities, and areas requiring attention.

Requirements: 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Film Production, Media Studies, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in commercial video production, production management, creative operations, or a related field.
  • Extensive experience with the Adobe Creative Cloud suite, specifically Premiere and After Effects.
  • Demonstrated experience leading and developing teams, preferably including employees working across multiple locations or markets.
  • Strong understanding of video production workflows, including pre-production, shooting, post-production, and delivery.
  • Proven ability to build strong partnerships with sales teams, business leaders, creative teams, and other cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Experience leading teams through process, technology, or organizational change, with the ability to build adoption and maintain momentum during periods of transition.
  • Strong organizational and operational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities, allocate resources, and make sound decisions in a fast-paced environment.
  • A pragmatic, solutions-oriented mindset with the judgment to balance creative quality, client expectations, business priorities, timelines, and available resources.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, including the ability to navigate challenging conversations, resolve conflicts, and build credibility across different functions and levels of the organization.
  • Experience managing production budgets and external vendors or contractors.
  • Comfort working with evolving production technologies and tools, including AI-enabled creative and production capabilities.

job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

TEGNA is seeking an Entry-Level Digital Ad Operations Specialist to support local broadcast stations with their digital advertising operations. This role offers an excellent opportunity for individuals looking to launch their career in digital ad operations within a collaborative and fast-paced environment.



Location: Hybrid role – work from home with Tuesdays and Thursdays in the downtown Dallas office.



About the Role:

As a Digital Ad Operations Specialist, you will work exclusively with TEGNA properties across various ad-serving platforms and order management systems. You’ll help manage CTV (Connected TV) and digital ad campaigns from setup to delivery, ensuring they run smoothly and meet performance goals.

This position involves troubleshooting, campaign optimization, and quality assurance, making it ideal for individuals with strong technical skills and attention to detail.



This role includes being part of an on-call rotation after proper training.

Responsibilities:

  • Digital Workflow & Execution: Master the digital workflow between business units and Ad Operations.
  • Become proficient in ad servers and order management systems, with a focus on CTV campaign execution. 
  • Campaign Scheduling & Creative Management: 
  • Set up and schedule digital ad campaigns accurately, including CTV-specific ad formats and delivery methods. 
  • Ensure proper execution of creative assets by understanding ad specs, templates, and ad tags (e.g., VAST/VPAID tags, dynamic ad insertion). 
  • Support & Troubleshooting: 
  • Provide urgent support to broadcast stations and internal stakeholders, particularly for CTV ad delivery issues. 
  • Identify and resolve ad performance issues through detailed troubleshooting and quality assurance (QA). 
  • Email & Workflow Management: 
  • Send daily reports to stations, communicate technical information clearly, and manage service-level agreements (SLAs). 
  • Consistently monitor email inboxes and respond to requests promptly. 
  • Campaign Monitoring & Optimization: 
  • Track campaign delivery and apply optimization strategies, such as CTV fill rate management, frequency capping, and ad podding.

job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. The FAST Workflow Analyst is responsible for supporting the day-to-day operation, monitoring, troubleshooting, and distribution of live and linear content feeds for TEGNA to Free Ad-Supported Television (FAST) platforms and other streaming partners. This role serves as a key point of contact between internal streaming and technology teams, local stations, FAST partners, vendors, and development teams to ensure feeds are available, reliable, correctly configured, and delivered according to established distribution requirements.

Responsibilities:
•    Monitor and operate FAST distribution and 24/7 streaming workflows to ensure feeds remain available, content plays as scheduled, and streams are delivered reliably to FAST partners and digital platforms. Monitor stream health, content continuity, audio/video quality, slates, interruptions, and other issues that may impact the viewer experience. – 25%
•    Troubleshoot, triage, and manage streaming and FAST distribution incidents from initial detection through resolution. Investigate issues across station, cloud, streaming, distribution, and partner environments; determine scope and impact; coordinate escalation; communicate status; and ensure incidents are resolved within established service expectations. – 25%
•    Support FAST distribution operations and partner relationships, including onboarding new feeds, testing and validating feeds, coordinating configuration changes, troubleshooting partner delivery issues, supporting feed migrations, and working directly with FAST partners and vendors to resolve service-impacting issues. – 15%
•    Implement and maintain monitoring, alerting, and operational tools across streaming and FAST distribution platforms to proactively identify failures and performance issues. Analyze monitoring data and recurring alerts to improve detection, reduce mean time to detect (MTTD), and reduce mean time to restore (MTTR). – 10%
•    Partner with station engineering, digital, streaming, application, and infrastructure teams to support end-to-end workflows from content origination through streaming and FAST distribution. Assist with capacity planning, workflow changes, platform migrations, technology implementations, and projects that improve reliability and scalability. – 10%
•    Document end-to-end streaming and FAST distribution workflows, including feed configurations, partner requirements, troubleshooting procedures, escalation paths, and operational runbooks. Maintain knowledge base articles and enable effective Service Desk escalation and self-service where appropriate. – 5%
•    Maintain accurate inventories and operational information for streaming feeds, FAST channels, applications, services, integrations, configurations, and versions within the ServiceNow CMDB or other designated systems to support reporting, lifecycle management, troubleshooting, and incident response. – 5%
•    Analyze incidents, operational trends, and partner feedback to identify recurring issues and opportunities for process, workflow, tooling, automation, or architecture improvements that increase reliability and improve the viewer and partner experience.
•    Support special projects, major events, new technology implementations, and evolving streaming initiatives as assigned. Participate in testing and validation of new workflows and constructively challenge existing processes to improve reliability, efficiency, and scalability. – 2%

Requirements:
•    College degree, relevant certifications, or equivalent practical experience in broadcast, media technology, or IT operations.
•    Hands-on experience supporting broadcast, newsroom, and streaming technologies, such as Cuez, AWS media services, including AWS Elemental MediaConnect and MediaLive.
•    Working knowledge of cloud and hybrid environments supporting media workflows (e.g., cloud-based contribution, streaming, monitoring, or playout).
•    Strong understanding of IT service management concepts and tooling, including ITIL practices, incident/problem management, knowledge management, CMDBs, and ServiceNow.
•    Proven ability to manage multiple operational priorities simultaneously, particularly in live production or time-sensitive environments.
•    Clear communicator who can translate technical issues into business and operational impact for engineers, newsroom staff, digital teams, vendors, and leadership.
•    Analytical, methodical problem solver with the ability to diagnose complex issues across systems, networks, applications, and workflows.

KWES sales organization.

and follow-up. • Support preparation for weekly sales meetings, revenue discussions
and sales initiatives.

sponsorship opportunities and other department resources.

opportunities.

outstanding items.

accountability for prospecting activity, opportunities and pipeline
management.

than being permanently assigned to any individual Account Executive.

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

WBIR-TV Knoxville, TN the TEGNA-owned affiliate in Knoxville, is looking for a Story Desk Manager to lead the newsroom’s Story Management Desk and oversee daily news coverage across streaming, digital, social and linear platforms. 

The successful candidate will guide our team of content creators in story development and presentation across all platforms. This person will manage coverage throughout the day, bring experience with the best practices of both assignment desk and digital operations, and coach others to excel at developing local contacts, responding to breaking news and delivering timely updates to our audiences.  

As part of the newsroom leadership team, the Story Desk Manager will oversee breaking news, developing stories and enterprise reporting, ensuring coverage is continuously updated and presented effectively across streaming, website, mobile app, social media and linear television. 

The ideal candidate is an experienced journalist with strong news judgment who knows how to lead coverage in a fast-moving newsroom. They can identify stories that are urgent, impactful and newsworthy, respond calmly to breaking news, pivot quickly as priorities change, solve problems creatively and keep a multiplatform newsroom focused and moving forward.

Responsibilities: 

  • Oversee daily coverage decisions and reporter assignments, with the goal of owning the biggest and most important stories of the day across platforms. 
  • Determine the best format and platform for each story and establish clear expectations and timelines for coverage, publishing and updates. 
  • Ensure breaking and developing stories are published quickly and updated continuously across digital platforms as new information becomes available. 
  • Identify opportunities for live and continuous streaming coverage, particularly during breaking news, developing stories and major events. 
  • Ensure stories are presented effectively for each platform, including strong headlines, video, images, live content and other elements that improve the audience experience. 
  • Look ahead and plan coverage for upcoming events and news cycles. 
  • Lead regular story check-ins throughout the day and adjust coverage as stories develop. 
  • Use audience insights, analytics and social listening to inform coverage decisions, identify opportunities and improve audience reach. 
  • Ensure competitive, engaging and impactful content across streaming, website, mobile app, social media and linear television. 
  • Provide editorial guidance to ensure content is accurate, fair and meets journalistic standards across platforms. 
  • Uphold TEGNA’s journalistic standards across all platforms. 

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism or communications, or at least 3-5 years of journalism experience in a local newsroom, digital production or related role. 
  • Superior news judgment and the ability to make fast, sound editorial decisions under pressure. 
  • Proven success handling breaking news and developing coverage across platforms. 
  • Experience managing or leading journalists in a fast-paced newsroom. 
  • Demonstrated knowledge of digital and newsroom operations. 
  • Strong understanding of digital publishing, streaming and linear news production and how audiences consume news across platforms. 
  • Experience using audience data and insights to inform coverage decisions. 
  • Experience helping transform and manage newsgathering systems and workflows. 
  • Strong organizational skills with a keen eye for detail. 
  • Demonstrated success as both a team leader and team player. 
  • Effective communication and problem-solving skills. 
  • Familiarity with the local market is a plus.

TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

WOI/KCWI, TEGNA’s ABC and CW affiliates serving the Des Moines–Ames DMA, has an opening for a Story Desk Manager. As the Story Desk Manager, you will lead the Story Management Desk (SMD), a unified desk that brings together the traditional functions of the assignment and digital desks.

The SMD model creates a single, streamlined workflow for discovering, planning, producing and curating stories across platforms. This position will play a central role in coordinating news coverage across the Des Moines–Ames market and communities throughout central Iowa.

Position Overview:

The Story Desk Manager works alongside the News Director and other newsroom leaders to oversee daily editorial decisions while helping set the newsroom's broader content and audience strategy.

You will guide our team of journalists in story discovery, development and presentation across all platforms with a strong digital- and streaming-first mindset. The Story Desk Manager oversees breaking news coverage across platforms and helps lead strategy for WeAreIowa.com, the Local 5 mobile app, We Are Iowa+ streaming platforms and social media.

This role is about more than managing the daily assignment file. The Story Desk Manager helps determine which stories we pursue, how we tell them, where they should be published or streamed, and how we can maximize their reach and impact.

We're looking for an exceptional, people-focused leader who can coach journalists, develop coverage plans and help grow audiences across platforms while maintaining a relentless focus on stories that matter to Iowans. Analyzing audience data, identifying trends and translating those insights into actionable guidance for the newsroom are also critical parts of the role.

The ability to identify and pursue stories that are urgent, impactful and distinctly local is essential. This leader should be able to respond quickly to breaking news, calmly manage rapidly changing situations, pivot coverage when necessary, solve problems creatively and guide a multi-platform newsroom through both the daily news cycle and major breaking stories.

Responsibilities:

  • Oversee daily coverage decisions and reporter assignments with the goal of owning the biggest and most important stories in the Des Moines–Ames DMA.
  • Lead the Story Management Desk and ensure strong coordination among Story Desk Editors, reporters, MSJs, photojournalists, producers and newsroom managers.
  • Determine the best format and platform for each story — including broadcast, web, mobile, streaming, social and vertical video — and establish reasonable timelines for delivery of those elements.
  • Work closely with the News Director to program and grow We Are Iowa+, identifying opportunities for live coverage, breaking news, weather, special programming and original streaming content.
  • Look beyond the daily news cycle and develop coverage plans for upcoming events, enterprise stories and major news opportunities across central Iowa.
  • Lead regular story check-ins throughout the day to evaluate reporting progress, sharpen story focus and ensure content is being delivered effectively across platforms.
  • Analyze and actively use audience data and performance metrics to inform editorial decisions, identify opportunities and create accountability for results.
  • Help develop and execute strategies to grow audiences across WeAreIowa.com, the Local 5 mobile app, We Are Iowa+, social media and emerging platforms.
  • Ensure competitive, engaging and impactful content across broadcast and digital platforms.
  • Identify opportunities to extend major stories beyond a single newscast or article through follow-up reporting, streaming coverage, vertical video, explainers and other platform-specific storytelling.
  • Collaborate with other departments to identify opportunities to grow and monetize the success of our digital and streaming platforms while maintaining editorial independence.
  • Alongside Story Desk Editors, provide editorial support for MSJs, producers and photojournalists, including reviewing scripts, videos and digital content for accuracy, grammar, AP style, digital best practices, fairness and ethical considerations.
  • Lead and communicate newsroom coverage during breaking news and severe weather, ensuring teams are coordinated across broadcast, digital, streaming and social platforms.
  • Maintain strong awareness of developing stories throughout the Des Moines metro, Ames and communities across the DMA, ensuring our coverage reflects the entire market we serve.
  • Foster a newsroom culture that values urgency, enterprise reporting, collaboration, experimentation and audience-focused storytelling.
  • Uphold TEGNA's journalistic standards and values across all platforms.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in journalism, communications or a related field, or 3-5 years of journalism experience in a local newsroom, digital production or related role.
  • Superior news judgment and the ability to make fast, sound editorial decisions under pressure.
  • Proven record of successfully coordinating breaking news and major developing stories.
  • Experience managing, coaching or leading a team of journalists.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of assignment desk, digital desk or content desk operations.
  • Strong understanding of digital journalism, streaming, social media and multi-platform storytelling.
  • Experience analyzing audience data and identifying behavioral and content-performance trends. Experience with Google Analytics or similar audience measurement tools is a major plus.
  • Experience helping transform newsroom workflows, systems or news-gathering operations.
  • Impeccable organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple stories, crews and platforms simultaneously.
  • Demonstrated success as both a team leader and collaborative newsroom partner.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, conflict-resolution and interpersonal skills.
  • Familiarity with Iowa and the Des Moines–Ames DMA is a plus.
  • Ability to work a variety of shifts, including nights, early mornings, weekends, overtime and breaking news situations as needed.
  • Knowledge of AP Style is a plus.

job.title: Technology Product Manager
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

We are seeking a Product Manager to lead the enhancement of TEGNA's internal CMS/digital publishing platform and a native mobile collaboration application. In this role, you will partner with editorial leaders, newsroom teams, and engineering organizations to translate complex workflows into intuitive, high-impact solutions that help journalists and producers plan coverage, create stories, collaborate in real time, and publish content across multiple channels.

This is a unique opportunity to own products that sit at the heart of how modern newsrooms operate—connecting storytellers, editors, photographers, producers, and leadership through integrated publishing and collaboration tools. You'll work at the intersection of product strategy, software development, and creative editorial workflows. You'll be equally comfortable defining system architecture with engineers, discussing user experience with designers, validating workflows with editorial teams, and making pragmatic tradeoff decisions that balance customer needs, technical reality, and business strategy.

Responsibilities
●    Own end-to-end product discovery, definition, and lifecycle for the internal enterprise CMS and mobile collaboration platform. Gather requirements from newsrooms, business stakeholders, and technical teams; translate them into clear, testable epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria ready for development.
●    Maintain a healthy, prioritized backlog across both products. Lead refinement sessions to ensure stories are well-defined, dependencies are identified, and technical constraints are understood before engineering begins.
●    Build strong partnerships with Editorial leadership, business stakeholders, and newsroom teams to deeply understand current-state workflows, pain points, controls, and desired outcomes. Spend regular time observing how journalists, editors, photographers, and producers work to inform product decisions.
●    Collaborate closely with Engineering teams throughout sprint cycles—from refinement through delivery. Develop a strong understanding of the software development process; communicate feature requirements clearly in developer-friendly language; and work pragmatically within technical constraints and dependencies.
●    Lead agile planning, sprint execution, backlog refinement, and release planning using agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban) to establish predictable delivery cadence. Focus on agile principles and workflow efficiency rather than rigid ceremony adherence.
●    Manage scope, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations—balancing internal customer value with technical debt, platform constraints, and risk considerations.
●    Establish traceability from customer requirements through delivery and release. Support UAT, demos, and acceptance sign-off to validate that shipped features meet intended outcomes.
●    Monitor post-release feedback, adoption metrics, and operational KPIs. Drive continuous improvement cycles to reduce rework, improve user satisfaction, and enhance system performance.
●    Lead stakeholder communications covering roadmap priorities, release plans, dependencies, tradeoffs, risks, and post-launch performance across editorial, engineering, and business teams.

Requirements: 
●    4+ years of Product Management or Product Owner experience with demonstrated ownership of customer-facing products or internal platform systems.
●    Familiarity with content management systems, digital publishing platforms, media asset management systems (MAM), or collaborative editing tools.
●    Strong understanding of the software development process and lifecycle. Comfortable discussing technical constraints, dependencies, and design trade-offs with engineers. Ability to write clear, testable user stories and acceptance criteria that developers can act on.
●    Experience working with Agile/Scrum delivery teams and managing backlogs in Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar tools. Familiarity with agile frameworks and workflow principles.
●    Demonstrated success gathering requirements from diverse stakeholders, translating them into actionable product requirements, and validating solutions with customers.
●    Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences—from engineers to editorial leadership.
●    Strong analytical, prioritization, and decision-making skills. Comfortable making tradeoff decisions in ambiguous, cross-functional environments.
●    Data-informed decision maker with experience defining, measuring, and improving product outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications
●    Knowledge of newsroom operations, editorial workflows, journalism, or media technology.
●    Experience with analytics platforms (e.g., Amplitude) to measure adoption, engagement, and feature success.
●    Familiarity with enterprise integration concepts (APIs, data flows, identity/access management).
●    Experience with governance, risk, and compliance requirements (audit readiness, data privacy).
●    Proficiency with tools like Confluence, Figma, Visio/Lucid, and Microsoft Suite.

Key Competencies
●    Stakeholder facilitation and influence without authority
●    Process-oriented mindset (current-state analysis, future-state design)
●    Technical acumen and ability to translate between engineering and business languages
●    Customer empathy and user-centric product thinking
●    Clarity in defining requirements and acceptance criteria
●    Pragmatic prioritization and tradeoff management
●    Organized, proactive ownership with strong accountability
●    Comfort working in fast-paced, iterative, cross-functional environments

Success Measures
●    Requirements are consistently captured, validated, and translated into clear epics and user stories with well-defined acceptance criteria.
●    Backlog health improves across both platforms (fewer clarifications mid-sprint, reduced rework, clear prioritization).
●    Internal stakeholders report improved alignment, transparency, and predictability of delivery.
●    Delivered features improve newsroom workflow efficiency and user satisfaction metrics.
●    Engineering team reports clear requirements, fewer blocking dependencies, and efficient sprint execution.

Pay Range$100,000—$150,000 USD

Premion, a leading “Over-the-Top” advertising and media business seeks a talented and dedicated Revenue Operations and Monetization Analyst

The Team

This position is part of a larger global Revenue Operations and Monetization team and is responsible for digital programmatic campaign management, maximizing revenue, margin profits, and minimizing liability through inventory control and strategic ad placements. Management members and traders are located in our New York, New York and Phoenix, AZ offices.

The Position

We are seeking a strategic and data-driven digital campaign trader who is responsible for the execution of optimizations for digital campaigns assigned to them. The ideal candidate has a strong understanding of digital campaign management, reading performance analytics with the ability to translate insights into high-impact campaign strategies. The right person for this role must thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced collaborative environment, want an opportunity to make a significant impact and jump at the opportunity to take on new challenges. 

Location

Premion is a high growth division of TEGNA with services within Phoenix, AZ, New York City, NY and India. This is a full-time position located in Phoenix, AZ.

THIS DESCRIBES YOU

  • You have a positive approach to challenges and like to collaborate and create with others on our team.
  • You enjoy being strategic and problem-solving.
  • You can leverage quantitative thinking to manage campaign success.
  • You have excellent attention to detail, set high standards and hold yourself accountable.
  • You have a passion for online advertising, media, and music.
  • You have a positive approach to challenges.

Responsibilities: 

  • A digital programmatic trader is responsible for managing and optimizing online ad campaigns using our proprietary automated bidding platform (SDP) known as PRISM to ensure maximum performance and return on investment (ROI) for clients. This role is a blend of analytical thinking, data analysis, and campaign management.
  • This candidate will be tasked with the monitoring of day-to-day programmatic buys across various channels including connected TV (CTV), display, video, and audio.

job.description:
Application Instructions

Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Washington Post is seeking a creative, collaborative and visually sophisticated designer to help shape how audiences experience our journalism across digital platforms.


News Design is a team of visual journalists who elevate The Post’s reporting through compelling, reader-centered storytelling. Working across digital formats and platforms, news designers collaborate with journalists throughout the newsroom to create presentations that deepen understanding, capture attention and make our journalism distinctive.


We are looking for a designer with exceptional visual instincts, strong editorial judgment and a passion for solving storytelling problems. The ideal candidate understands how typography, composition, color, imagery and interaction can work together to make journalism clearer and more powerful. They should be equally energized by creating an ambitious custom presentation for a major enterprise story and finding smart, elegant solutions on a tight news deadline.


This is a highly collaborative role. News designers work alongside reporters, editors, photographers, graphics journalists, illustrators and developers, contributing ideas from the earliest stages of a story through publication. We are looking for someone eager to experiment, take thoughtful creative risks and help evolve the visual identity of The Washington Post.


This position is based in our Washington, D.C., newsroom and will require some night and weekend work.


What Motivates You:

  • You believe thoughtful design can fundamentally improve how audiences understand and experience journalism.
  • You enjoy finding the right visual approach for a story through typography, imagery, color, composition and interaction.
  • You are energized by solving complicated storytelling problems and turning them into intuitive reader experiences.
  • You thrive on collaborating with journalists from different disciplines.
  • You enjoy balancing ambitious long-term projects with the urgency of breaking and developing news.
  • You are curious about new technologies, formats and approaches to digital storytelling.

How You’ll Support the Mission:

  • Collaborate with reporters, editors and visual journalists to conceive and build distinctive digital storytelling experiences.
  • Identify stories that would benefit from enhanced visual presentation and help develop the right design approach for each.
  • Create engaging, content-driven designs, illustrations and visual packages that are smart, original and reader-centered.
  • Guide the visual storytelling process from initial concept through publication, incorporating feedback and maintaining a high level of craft throughout.
  • Design experiences that work effectively across desktop, mobile, newsletters, social platforms and other digital surfaces.
  • Partner with developers and other visual journalists on interactive and custom storytelling projects.
  • Contribute to breaking and major news coverage, developing sophisticated visual solutions on tight deadlines.
  • Use art direction, illustration, animation and other techniques when they can strengthen a story.
  • Review work carefully for visual consistency, accessibility and accuracy before publication.
  • Contribute ideas that help evolve The Post’s visual identity and push our digital storytelling forward.

The Skills and Experiences You Bring:

  • A strong portfolio demonstrating excellent visual design, creative thinking, initiative and curiosity.
  • Experience designing digital editorial experiences, interactive applications or other content-rich products.
  • Sophisticated understanding of typography, composition, color, visual hierarchy and information design.
  • Strong editorial instincts and a passion for using design in service of storytelling.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with an ability to build productive relationships across disciplines.
  • A demonstrated ability to manage multiple short- and long-term projects and deliver refined work under deadline pressure.
  • A thoughtful, ethical approach to incorporating new technologies including AI-assisted tools into the design brainstorming process, with sound judgment about where they strengthen the work but knowing human craft and editorial judgment must lead.
  • Experience with art direction, animation, illustration, original artwork or maintaining a cohesive visual identity is a plus.
  • Fluency with design tools such as Figma, Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator.
  • Experience with HTML, CSS or JavaScript and familiarity with modern web frameworks such as React, Svelte, Angular or Vue is a plus.
  • A commitment to accessibility, accuracy and the highest standards of visual journalism.

Interested candidates should upload a résumé, cover letter and portfolio highlighting representative work to our jobs portal. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled, but those received by Oct. 9 will be prioritized. The cover letter should be addressed to News Design Director Christine Ashack and Head of Visuals Soo-Jeong Kang.


The salary range for this position is: $85,100 - $127,700. The actual salary within this range will depend on individual skills, experience and qualifications as they relate to specific job requirements


 

Collaboration makes us stronger. That’s why our offices are designed with open layouts, modern technology, and easy access to transportation. With certain exceptions for newsgathering and business travel, we work on-site five days a week.

Compensation and Benefits

Wherever you are in your life or career, The Washington Post offers comprehensive and inclusive benefits for every step of your journey:

  • Company-paid pension and 401(k) match

  • Three weeks of vacation and up to three weeks of paid sick leave

  • Gender affirming services

  • Leadership and career development programs

Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.


About Our Team


The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning News and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.


Why This Role Matters

 

The Washington Post is seeking an experienced, imaginative and highly collaborative Senior Photo Assignment Editor to help lead photographic coverage across the newsroom.


We are looking for a visual journalist with exceptional news judgment, sophisticated visual taste and a deep understanding of how photography can distinguish and elevate journalism. This editor will help shape coverage from the earliest stages — identifying stories with strong visual potential, commissioning photographers with distinctive perspectives and ensuring that photography is integral to how our journalism is conceived, reported and presented.


The ideal candidate understands that powerful photography depends not only on what we commission and publish, but also on how audiences experience that work. They will think critically about image selection, sequencing, cropping and presentation and understand how those choices should evolve across mobile and desktop experiences, social platforms, newsletters and other destinations.


This editor should be equally comfortable directing photographic coverage of a major breaking-news event, developing an ambitious visual enterprise project and collaborating across disciplines to determine the strongest form for a story. As a senior member of the Photo department, they will also provide leadership and mentorship to photo editors, helping elevate the ambition, creativity and quality of The Post’s visual journalism.


This position is based in our Washington, D.C., newsroom and will include some evening and weekend shifts to meet deadlines and respond to breaking news.


What Motivates You:

  • You believe photography can reveal dimensions of a story that words alone cannot capture.
  • You have a sophisticated visual sensibility and are constantly looking for original approaches to familiar subjects.
  • You thrive on the urgency of breaking news as well as the opportunity to develop ambitious visual enterprise.
  • You enjoy working closely with photographers and helping them produce distinctive, surprising work.
  • You think deeply about how audiences experience photography across different platforms and formats.
  • You are energized by mentoring visual journalists and helping raise the creative ambition of a team.

How You’ll Support the Mission:

  • Assign, commission and edit photography for breaking news, daily coverage, features, investigations and ambitious visual enterprise.
  • Develop and pitch original photographic story ideas, including journalism conceived from the outset around the strengths of photography.
  • Identify visual opportunities early in the reporting process and work with reporters and editors across the newsroom to develop strong approaches.
  • Direct photographers in the field, providing clear editorial guidance while creating the conditions for distinctive and original work.
  • Apply exceptional visual and news judgment to image selection, sequencing, cropping and presentation.
  • Make thoughtful decisions about how photography should be experienced across mobile, desktop, social platforms, newsletters and other digital destinations.
  • Cultivate a broad and diverse network of freelance photographers and match photographers to assignments based on subject matter, geography, approach and visual sensibility.
  • Research, source and license photography when commissioned work is not appropriate, applying rigorous standards around accuracy, context, copyright, provenance and ethics.
  • Collaborate with News Design, Graphics, Audience, Product and other teams to determine the most effective visual form and presentation for major journalism.
  • Help develop visual approaches to breaking and planned coverage that take advantage of photography alongside video, graphics, text and other forms.
  • Stay current with changes in photography, visual culture, digital publishing, technology and audience behavior and apply that knowledge thoughtfully to coverage.
  • Experiment with new approaches to photographic storytelling and presentation while maintaining rigorous standards for accuracy, ethics and craft.
  • Mentor photo editors and photographers, providing constructive feedback and helping colleagues develop their editorial judgment and visual storytelling skills.
  • Contribute to department-wide coverage planning and help shape The Post’s broader approach to photography and visual journalism.

The Skills and Experiences You Bring:

  • At least seven years of professional journalism experience, including substantial experience assigning and editing photography in a fast-paced newsroom.
  • Exceptional visual and editorial judgment and a demonstrated record of producing distinctive photographic journalism.
  • Deep knowledge of contemporary photography and a broad network of staff and freelance photographers.
  • Experience directing visual coverage of breaking news as well as developing longer-term enterprise and feature photography.
  • Strong understanding of digital storytelling and how photography should be selected, edited and presented for different platforms and audiences.
  • A generous, curious and collaborative editing style, with an openness to experimentation and new approaches.
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate across disciplines and to mentor and develop visual journalists.
  • Strong understanding of photographic ethics, sourcing, copyright and image provenance.
  • Ability to make confident decisions under deadline pressure while maintaining rigorous standards for accuracy and visual quality.
  • Fluency with professional photo-editing tools, including Photoshop and Photo Mechanic; familiarity with video and other digital publishing tools is a plus.
  • Flexibility to work some nights and weekends as news demands.

About Our Team

Why This Role Matters

 

The Washington Post’s Finance Department is seeking an experienced Senior Accountant to join our Financial Accounting and Reporting team. This role is pivotal in ensuring the integrity of financial data that enables our leaders to make informed, strategic decisions. You will thrive here if you are adaptable to evolving business priorities, curious about the bigger picture, and eager to apply your accounting expertise to enhance processes and deliver high-quality results.
 

What Motivates You

  • You take pride in producing accurate, high-quality financial information that supports strategic decision-making.

  • You have a keen eye for detail and maintain efficiency without sacrificing accuracy.

  • You adapt quickly to shifting priorities and balance speed with precision in your daily work.

  • You enjoy applying your technical accounting knowledge to complex scenarios, researching new guidance, and finding practical solutions.

  • You are energized by opportunities to improve processes, introduce automation, and drive innovation.

  • You appreciate working independently while providing timely updates, managing competing priorities, and collaborating with stakeholders across the organization.

How You'll Support the Mission

  • Execute general ledger accounting functions, including journal entries, month-end and year-end close activities, and preparation of accurate financial statements.

  • Conduct detailed variance analyses for income statement and balance sheet accounts, identifying trends and insights for leadership.

  • Interpret and apply GAAP accounting standards in collaboration with Financial Accounting management, ensuring compliance and accuracy.

  • Develop and maintain clear, up-to-date process documentation for accounting procedures, outlining both task execution and business purpose.

  • Identify opportunities for automation, recommend innovative process improvements to enhance efficiency and accuracy, and utilize tools to build automations for your areas of responsibility.

  • Prepare documentation for annual financial statements, tax and compliance filings, and audit requirements.

Join the future of news

We’re on a mission to deliver riveting storytelling for all of America. At The Washington Post, you’ll help reinvent news. Our work is driven by a deep investigative spirit and enhanced by innovation to bring audiences closer to the stories that matter most.

About Our Team

The Washington Post is powered by the passion and talent of our people. It takes all of us to reinvent news. Beyond our award-winning Newsroom and Opinions teams, we work across many departments, including Brand & Events, Communications, Customer Care, Engineering & Product, Finance, Human Resources, Legal, Marketing & Advertising, Print Operations, and Sales.

Why This Role Matters

 

The Washington Post is seeking an entrepreneurial, creative and highly energetic editor to lead The 7 Live, which showcases what Post journalists are seeing, hearing and discovering in real time.

The 7 Live is a prominent new feature of The Post’s Home experience on web and app, delivering a steady stream of short-form, stand-alone journalism throughout the day. It will draw on the breadth and expertise of our newsroom to surface breaking developments, reporter analysis, explainers and context, revealing quotes, data discoveries, cultural moments and other timely observations that help readers understand what is happening now.

We are looking for an editor who can turn this new concept into a distinctive, habit-forming destination. The successful candidate will lead The 7 Live from launch through daily execution, establishing its editorial voice, rhythms and workflows while maintaining a consistently high level of freshness and output. They will work across the newsroom to identify opportunities, assign and edit contributions and find creative ways to translate the expertise of Post journalists into concise, compelling storytelling.

This role requires exceptional news judgment, sharp editing skills and an instinct for what audiences find useful, surprising or worth sharing. The ideal candidate is both a journalist and a builder — someone excited by experimentation, comfortable using audience data to iterate quickly and adept at rallying colleagues around a new way of telling stories.

This position is based in our Washington, D.C., newsroom and reports to Senior Editor Annah Aschbrenner.

What Motivates You:

  • You are energized by the constant movement of the news and have a sharp instinct for what matters right now.

  • You enjoy building new editorial products and turning promising ideas into successful daily habits.

  • You love finding the revealing detail, smart observation or piece of context that helps readers see a story differently.

  • You believe great journalism can be authoritative and rigorous without always being long.

  • You are curious about audience behavior and eager to use data and experimentation to make journalism more useful and engaging.

  • You thrive on collaborating with journalists across subjects, disciplines and teams.

How You’ll Support the Mission:

  • Lead the daily editorial operation of The 7 Live, establishing its voice, standards, workflows and programming rhythms.

  • Ensure a consistent flow of timely, distinctive and high-value journalism throughout the day.

  • Identify, assign and edit short-form stories and updates drawing on reporting and expertise from across The Post.

  • Work closely with reporters, editors and visual journalists to identify observations, discoveries and reporting that can be quickly transformed into compelling stand-alone journalism.

  • Develop creative formats for news, analysis, explainers, quotes, data, cultural moments and other forms of timely storytelling.

  • Build efficient workflows that make it easy for journalists across the newsroom to contribute while maintaining high standards for accuracy, quality and presentation.

  • Partner closely with the News Hub and Digital Desk to identify opportunities and ensure The 7 Live reflects the breadth and urgency of The Post’s report.

  • Use real-time audience data to make programming decisions, evaluate performance and continuously refine the product.

  • Collaborate with Product, Visuals and Content Strategy colleagues to improve the reader experience and develop new capabilities for The 7 Live.

  • Experiment with story formats, presentation, cadence and programming to build reader habit and engagement.

  • Champion The 7 Live across the newsroom, cultivating contributors and helping journalists understand what makes a successful contribution.

The Skills and Experiences You Bring:

  • At least five years of editing experience at a major news organization or digital publication.

  • Exceptional news judgment and a strong instinct for stories, angles and observations that will resonate with broad audiences.

  • Excellent editing and headline-writing skills, particularly the ability to distill complex subjects into concise, engaging presentations.

  • Experience managing a fast-moving digital report and making confident editorial decisions under deadline pressure.

  • An entrepreneurial mindset and experience launching or developing new editorial products, verticals, formats or audience initiatives.

  • Strong understanding of audience behavior across web and mobile platforms.

  • Experience using real-time analytics and performance data to inform editorial decisions and improve products.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to build relationships across a large newsroom.

  • A willingness to experiment, learn quickly and adjust strategy based on results.

Interested candidates should upload a résumé, cover letter and up to three relevant work samples — such as edited stories, product launches or new editorial initiatives — to our jobs portal. The cover letter should be addressed to Senior Editor Annah Aschbrenner and Deputy Managing Editor Mark W. Smith.

The salary range for this position is $109,200 - $182,000. The actual starting salary within this range will depend on individual skills, experience and qualifications as they relate to specific job requirements.
