job.title: Director, Privacy & Data Protection
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

Director, Privacy & Data Protection

Job Category: Business & Legal Affairs


How We LEAD:

The Director, Privacy & Data Protection will be an experienced privacy attorney supporting Universal Music Group's global privacy and data protection program. Working closely with the Senior Vice President, Privacy & Data Protection, this role will provide practical, hands-on legal support across privacy contracting, data subject rights, cybersecurity incidents, digital marketing and other matters involving the collection, use, sharing and protection of personal data.


As the world leader in music-based entertainment, UMG operates across a broad range of labels, artist businesses, digital platforms, e-commerce experiences, marketing initiatives and fan-facing services. The Director will work with colleagues across Legal, Information Security, Technology, Digital, Marketing, E-Commerce and the business to help UMG use data responsibly while supporting artists, creators and fans around the world.


The ideal candidate will combine strong privacy law fundamentals with excellent drafting and negotiation skills, sound judgment and a practical, business-oriented approach. This role requires an attorney who is comfortable managing a significant volume of day-to-day matters, can independently handle work within established frameworks, and recognizes when novel, sensitive or higher-risk issues require escalation.


How You'll CREATE:

  • Draft, review and negotiate data protection and privacy terms in commercial agreements, including data processing agreements, data-sharing arrangements, international data transfer provisions, information security terms and other privacy-related contractual provisions.
  • Partner with UMG's Business & Legal Affairs teams on privacy issues arising in artist, vendor, technology, platform, licensing, e-commerce, marketing and other commercial arrangements involving personal data.
  • Handle UMG's day-to-day legal work relating to data subject and consumer privacy rights requests, including assessing request scope and applicable legal requirements, advising on exemptions and response obligations, coordinating with privacy operations and relevant business teams, reviewing and drafting responses, and escalating complex or sensitive matters as appropriate.
  • Support the privacy-law aspects of cybersecurity and data security incidents, working closely with Information Security, Legal and other stakeholders to assess incident facts and affected data, analyze applicable notification and regulatory requirements, document legal assessments, and draft or review incident-related communications.
  • Assist with investigations of potential privacy and data security issues, including gathering relevant facts, evaluating legal obligations and coordinating with outside counsel where appropriate.
  • Advise business and legal teams on privacy requirements affecting UMG's websites, applications, digital platforms, artist and fan experiences, e-commerce operations, advertising and marketing activities.
  • Provide practical guidance on online advertising and tracking technologies, marketing communications, consent and preference management, and related privacy and consumer protection requirements.
  • Advise on compliance with U.S. federal and state privacy laws, GDPR and other applicable international privacy and data protection requirements.
  • Support privacy reviews of new and evolving business initiatives, technologies, vendors, products and uses of data, including privacy impact assessments where appropriate.
  • Assist with third-party privacy and data protection matters, including vendor diligence, data-transfer requirements, privacy questionnaires and remediation of identified issues.
  • Help maintain and improve privacy policies, procedures, templates, playbooks and other resources that support consistent and scalable privacy practices across UMG's labels, territories and business units.
  • Work with privacy operations, Information Security and business teams to identify recurring issues and improve processes for contract review, rights requests, incident response and other recurring privacy matters.
  • Support responses to regulatory inquiries, audits and other privacy or data protection matters as needed.
  • Monitor relevant developments in privacy, data protection, cybersecurity, digital marketing and consumer protection law and provide clear, practical guidance regarding developments relevant to UMG's businesses.
  • Provide privacy guidance and training to Legal, business and operational teams as needed.
  • Support privacy issues arising from emerging technologies and new uses of data as appropriate.
  • Collaborate effectively with colleagues across UMG's labels, business units and territories, handling routine and moderately complex matters independently and escalating novel, sensitive or significant matters as appropriate.

Bring Your VIBE:

  • J.D. from an accredited law school and active membership in good standing in at least one U.S. state bar.
  • 8+ years of relevant legal experience, with substantial experience in privacy, data protection, cybersecurity, technology transactions or a closely related field, gained at a law firm, in-house legal department or a combination of both.
  • Experience drafting and negotiating data processing agreements and privacy, data use and security provisions in commercial agreements.
  • Strong working knowledge of U.S. federal and state privacy laws, including CCPA/CPRA and other comprehensive state privacy laws, and meaningful familiarity with GDPR and international data protection requirements.
  • Experience advising on data subject and consumer privacy rights requests, including access, deletion, correction and related requests.
  • Experience advising on privacy issues arising from websites, digital advertising, online tracking technologies, e-commerce, marketing and other consumer-facing data practices.
  • Familiarity with consumer protection and marketing requirements relevant to digital and direct-to-consumer activities.
  • Meaningful experience supporting cybersecurity or data security incident response, including familiarity with breach-notification requirements and experience working with information security or technical teams during investigations.
  • Strong legal research, analytical, drafting and negotiation skills, with the ability to identify the issues that matter and provide clear, practical and business-oriented advice.
  • Ability to understand technical and operational facts sufficiently to identify relevant privacy, cybersecurity and digital marketing legal issues.
  • Sound judgment and the ability to handle a significant volume of matters independently while recognizing when an issue warrants escalation.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple matters and competing priorities in a fast-moving, global and highly collaborative environment.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to explain complex privacy and data protection requirements clearly to lawyers and non-lawyers.
  • CIPP/US, CIPP/E or another relevant privacy certification preferred.
  • Experience in entertainment, music, digital media, technology, e-commerce, advertising or another consumer-facing and data-intensive industry is a plus.

job.title: Senior / Staff Behavioral Engineer
job.description: About Suno We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. Music is for everyone: Our users include everyone from grandmothers creating songs for their loved ones, to Grammy winners using Suno Studio, our power tool, to make the most popular hits in the world. Building the future of entertainment requires ambition. The pace is fast, the problems are hard, and the work demands ownership and intensity. For the right people, it’s incredibly rewarding: a chance to shape a new medium, work with a small team that cares deeply about quality, make music, drink too much coffee, and build something that millions of people use to express themselves in ways that were never before possible. Suno is the fastest growing consumer entertainment company and the leader in AI music. We are backed by leading investors including Bond Capital, Menlo Ventures, Lightspeed Venture Partners, IVP, Forerunner, Union Square Ventures, Alkeon, Quiet, Matrix Partners, Schroders Capital and, NVentures (venture arm of NVIDIA). ABOUT THE ROLE We're looking for a Senior / Staff Behavioral Engineer to make safe behavior the path of least resistance at Suno. Instead of only catching abuse after it happens, you'll work upstream. You'll study how bad actors exploit our product and where well-intentioned employees fall into risky shortcuts. Then you'll redesign the flows, defaults, friction points, and incentives underneath so that harmful behavior is structurally harder to carry out. Working at the intersection of behavioral science, product design, and security and trust & safety, you'll partner closely with Product and Engineering to build risk-reducing changes directly into their roadmaps. This work will help lay the foundation for Suno's security programs and strengthen our overall risk posture across security, trust & safety, fraud, and privacy. WHAT YOU'LL DO Investigate how abuse and risk actually happen on our platform and inside the company. That includes reading logs, interviewing support and ops teams, and reconstructing user and employee journeys to find the easy paths to harm. Design concrete changes to signup flows, permission defaults, rate limits, approval steps, and verification gates, working alongside PMs and designers. Get your recommendations onto other teams' roadmaps by making the case in planning meetings, writing proposals, and negotiating trade-offs, all without owning the roadmap yourself. Measure changes in real behavior, not just detection rates. You'll define success metrics before a change ships and run before/after comparisons to prove impact. Lead cross-functional root-cause reviews after incidents and near-misses by asking what about the design made risky behavior the easy option, then turning the answers into concrete backlog items. Stay ahead of new attack patterns by tracking industry incidents and behavioral science research. You'll design targeted awareness and training only where it's the best lever, and make sure people actually find it useful. Help make safe, trustworthy experiences part of how Suno builds every product, in service of making creative fulfillment a daily reality for everyone. WHAT YOU'LL NEED MUST-HAVES 6+ years of experience in trust & safety, security, fraud, anti-abuse, or risk-focused product work, with the technical fluency to dig into logs and data yourself and to work credibly with engineers on implementation. A track record of reducing risky behavior through product and process design (flows, defaults, friction, incentives), with measurable before/after results. Strong influence skills, including a history of getting changes prioritized on roadmaps you didn't own by building trust with Product, Engineering, and Design partners. NICE-TO-HAVES Formal background in behavioral science, behavioral economics, human factors, or UX research. Experience at a consumer tech company at scale, especially one with user-generated content, creator platforms, or payments. Experience supporting security compliance programs (e.g. SOC 2), or being an early or founding hire in a trust, safety, or security function. Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
Account Executive

Position Summary

As an Account Executive, you will serve as a trusted marketing consultant to local businesses and advertising agencies, helping clients achieve their business goals through innovative advertising and marketing solutions. This role combines prospecting, relationship building, strategic planning, and revenue generation across Beasley Media Group's portfolio of broadcast, digital, streaming, event, and experiential marketing assets.

The ideal candidate is a motivated self-starter with a passion for sales, strong communication skills, and the ability to develop long-term client partnerships while driving new business growth.

Key Qualifications

  • Self-motivated, goal-oriented professional who thrives both independently and in a collaborative team environment.
  • Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Strong organizational and time management abilities with attention to detail.
  • Effective negotiator with a customer-focused, consultative sales approach.
  • Ability to identify client needs, develop strategic recommendations, and deliver impactful marketing solutions.
  • Proficiency with CRM systems and sales pipeline management.
  • Passion for building relationships and creating measurable results for clients.
  • Valid driver's license, proof of insurance, and reliable transportation required.
  • Employment is contingent upon successful completion of an MVR check

Essential Responsibilities

Business Development & Sales

  • Generate new business opportunities through prospecting, networking, referrals, and outreach efforts.
  • Maintain and grow existing account relationships while increasing revenue and market share.
  • Develop integrated marketing solutions utilizing Beasley Media Group's full suite of advertising platforms.
  • Create and deliver compelling sales presentations and marketing proposals to local businesses and advertising agencies.
  • Identify client business challenges and recommend customized advertising and marketing strategies.
  • Secure sponsorships, promotional partnerships, experiential marketing opportunities, and digital advertising campaigns.
  • Consistently achieve or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue goals.

Client Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key decision-makers, stakeholders, and business owners.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned accounts, ensuring exceptional customer service and responsiveness.
  • Regularly communicate with clients regarding campaign performance, marketing initiatives, sponsorships, and business objectives.
  • Identify opportunities to expand partnerships through upselling and cross-selling solutions.

Strategic Planning & Market Research

  • Prepare thoroughly for all client interactions by researching industries, market conditions, business objectives, and competitive trends.
  • Analyze client needs, target audiences, and historical advertising investment to develop effective recommendations.
  • Stay informed on emerging advertising, media, digital marketing, and consumer behavior trends.
  • Utilize market insights and audience data to enhance client outcomes and sales effectiveness.

Product & Industry Expertise

  • Maintain comprehensive knowledge of Beasley Media Group's products, platforms, pricing, audience insights, and marketing capabilities.
  • Continuously expand expertise in radio, digital advertising, streaming audio, video, events, promotions, and experiential marketing.
  • Understand competitive offerings and effectively position Beasley Media Group's advantages in the marketplace.

Administrative & Reporting Responsibilities

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer records, activity logs, and sales opportunities within the company CRM.
  • Effectively manage schedules, appointments, account plans, and follow-up activities.
  • Provide timely sales forecasts, pipeline updates, and performance reports as requested by management.
  • Document client interactions and strategic account activities to support business growth and customer retention.

Collaboration & Communication

  • Maintain regular communication with leadership regarding sales activity, pipeline development, client opportunities, and business needs.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure successful execution of advertising campaigns and client initiatives.
  • Support client events, promotions, and experiential marketing activities as needed.
  • Contribute positively to a culture of teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently meeting or exceeding revenue goals.
  • Developing strong client relationships that result in long-term partnerships.
  • Generating new business opportunities and expanding existing accounts.
  • Delivering strategic marketing solutions that help clients achieve measurable business results.
  • Serving as a knowledgeable and trusted advisor within the local advertising community.

Beasley Media Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
iHeartMedia Markets

                                                                             

Current employees and contingent workers click here to apply and search by the Job Posting Title.

                                                                             

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service. And we were just recognized as one of the Top Media Sales Organizations by The Myers Report! 

In fact, iHeart has: More #1 rated markets than the next two largest radio companies combined;

  • We’re the largest podcast publisher, with more monthly downloads than the second- and third-largest podcast publishers combined. Podcasting, the fastest-growing new media, today has more monthly users than streaming music services or Netflix;

  • iHeart is the home of many of the country’s most popular and trusted on-air personalities and podcast influencers, who build important connections with hundreds of communities across America;

  • We create and produce some of the most popular and well-known branded live music events in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour;

  • iHeartRadio is the #1 streaming radio digital service in America;

  • Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and

  • We have the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio, from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale.  As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.

Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!

If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

Looking for a new challenge? Join us as an Account Executive and leverage your proven goal-driven mindset, fast-paced work ethic, and exceptional client service skills. The ideal candidate is ready to hit the ground running and will successfully take advantage of all iHeart’s platforms to exceed their clients’ expectations.

                                                                             

What You'll Do:

As an Account Executive at iHeart, you'll learn the ins and outs of our Broadcast + Digital Marketing Products, identify and develop new business opportunities through in-person meetings with clients and research, consistent daily cold-calling, and cultivate existing business using our full suite of products. You will collaborate with internal partners to drive revenue, create effective marketing campaigns, and use your storytelling skills to deliver compelling sales presentations fueled by data to best meet your clients’ expectations.   

                                                                             

What You'll Need:

  • You should be self-motivated (a very “go-getter” attitude!), have excellent relationship-building and problem-solving skills, and communicate persuasively. When people describe you, goal-oriented, expert negotiator and proactive should be at the top of the list.  

  • You should be able to plan and multi-task in a fast-paced environment.  

  • Comfortable with cold-calling and initiating outreach to prospective clients as part of lead generation efforts.

  • A valid driver's license, auto insurance, and a High School Diploma (College Degree preferred) are required.  

  • You should also be skilled in Salesforce, Microsoft Office and social networking platforms.  

  • Strong problem-solving skills; by exercising these skills, you help business grow to the fullest potential.

  • Digital/Media Sales experience are a plus but not required. 

  • The natural ability to organize and prioritize day-to-day depending on where the biggest priorities may be

  • Additional nice-to-haves include experience managing complex, multi-platform campaigns, analytics experience, iHeart and/or audio advertising background, and are well-connected in the market.  

What you’ll get  

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.  


Interested in learning more about iHeart and our platforms? Visit us at www.iHeartMedia.com to learn more about our company, www.iHeartRadio.com to access all your favorite music, radio, and podcasts, and download the free iHeartRadio app!  

                                                                             

What You'll Bring:

  • Respect for others and a strong belief that others should do this in return

  • General understanding of business principles and sales environment

  • Interest in developing knowledge of business operations and sales concepts and techniques

  • Individual accountability and understanding of when to seek guidance

  • Skills managing assigned projects to completion

  • Understanding to resolve problems using established guidelines and professional judgement

  • Ability to communicate information about iHeart products in a digestible manner and to apply active listening skills to validate understanding of customer needs

  • Understanding of impact of your own decisions

  • Goal orientation and the ability to focus and prioritize

                                                                             

Location:

Augusta, GA: 2743 Perimeter Parkway, Bldg 1, 30909

                                                                             

Position Type:                                                                                             

Regular

                                                                             

Time Type:

Full time

                                                                                 

Pay Type:

Salaried

                                                                                 

Benefits:

iHeartMedia’s benefits offering is flexible and offers a variety of choices to meet the diverse needs of our changing workforce, including the following:

  • Employer sponsored medical, dental and vision with a variety of coverage options

  • Company provided and supplemental life insurance

  • Paid vacation and sick time

  • Paid company holidays

  • A Spirit day to encourage and allow our employees to more easily volunteer in their community

  • A 401K plan

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP) at no cost – services include telephonic counseling sessions, consultation on legal and financial matters, emotional well-being, family and caregiving

  • ​A range of additional voluntary programs, such as spending accounts, student loan refinancing, accident insurance and more!

                                                                             

We are accepting applications for this role on an ongoing basis.

The Company is an equal opportunity employer and will not tolerate discrimination in employment on the basis of race, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, disability, ethnicity, national origin, marital status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected classification or status.

Non-Compete will be required for certain positions and as allowed by law.

job.description:
Promotions Director

Federated Media | South Bend, IN (Mishawaka-based)
Stations: 103.9 The Bear, B100, Froggy 102.7, 95.3 MNC

Position Overview

Federated Media South Bend is seeking a Promotions Director to lead and execute all station promotions, events, contesting, and community engagement initiatives across four market-leading radio brands: 103.9 The Bear, B100, Froggy 102.7, and 95.3 MNC.

This is a hands-on role focused on planning, coordination, and execution, with additional operational and logistical support provided by a Promotions Coordinator. The Promotions Director owns the full promotions lifecycle from concept, through execution and recap, while providing clear direction, approvals, and oversight across on-air, online, and on-site platforms.

The role serves as the strategic and operational hub connecting Programming, Sales, Digital, on-air staff, and the Promotions Coordinator to ensure promotions are executed at a high level and on schedule.

 

Key Responsibilities

Promotions Strategy & Execution

  • Develop, plan, and execute station promotions aligned with each brand’s identity and audience.
  • Serve as the project manager for all promotions across on-air, web, social, email, and live events.
  • Plan and oversee major tentpole events, live broadcasts, charity initiatives, concerts, and station appearances.
  • Maintain strong working relationships with venues, promoters, sponsors, and community partners.


Contesting & Compliance

  • Design and manage contest structures, timelines, rules, and prize fulfillment.
  • Ensure all contesting and promotions are FCC-compliant and follow company guidelines.
  • Oversee ticket inventories, prize distribution, waivers, and winner documentation.

 

Event & Remote Management

  • Oversee all station events, remotes, and on-site activations from planning to execution.
  • Coordinate logistics including staffing, station vehicles, equipment, signage, and branding.
  • Serve as lead on-site representative at major station events.


Collaboration with Programming & Sales

  • Work closely with Program Directors to ensure promotions align with station strategy and on-air execution.
  • Collaborate with Sales to develop promotions that support client initiatives while protecting station brands.
  • Evaluate promotional proposals to ensure brand fit, execution feasibility, and audience value.


Digital & On-Air Support

  • Oversee promotional messaging across social media, websites, email, and on-air platforms.
  • Write or approve promotional copy including liners, social posts, web content, and text/email messaging.
  • Ensure accuracy, consistency, and brand alignment across all platforms.


Leadership & Team Management

  • Directly supervise and provide direction to the Promotions Coordinator and part-time promotions staff.
  • Assign and prioritize tasks, timelines, and execution details through established workflows.
  • Lead promotions meetings, assign tasks, and manage timelines and expectations.
  • Serve as final approval point for promotional concepts, messaging, and execution plans.


Reporting & Recaps

  • Produce promotional recaps including photos, documentation, and sponsor deliverables.
  • Track execution performance and provide post-promotion summaries to internal teams.

 

Qualifications

  • Prior experience in radio promotions, events, or related fields is preferred but not required.
  • Strong organizational, project management, and leadership skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple promotions simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to work nights, weekends, and holidays as needed for events.
  • Valid driver’s license with a clean driving record.

 

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunity to lead promotions for four highly visible radio brands.
  • A collaborative, fast-moving radio environment with strong community presence.
  • Supportive leadership and clear operational structure.

Federated Media is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

job.title: Project Manager - FoxNXT
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

FOX Entertainment

With a legacy spanning nearly 40 years, FOX Entertainment is one of the world’s most recognizable media brands and a leading global creator of multi-genre content across broadcast, streaming, digital and emerging platforms. Known for its independent, innovative spirit and bold storytelling, the company is committed to reaching audiences where they are through a platform- and format-agnostic approach to developing, testing and scaling intellectual property worldwide. FOX Entertainment consists of three core business units. The FOX Television Network, which encompasses its flagship linear platform and streaming partnerships with Hulu and FOX One, is home to hit series including The Simpsons, The Masked Singer, Doc, Memory of a Killer, Fear Factor: House of Fear, The Floor and Hell’s Kitchen. FOX Entertainment Studios, operates the in-house scripted and unscripted studios behind series such as Animal Control, Best Medicine, The Faithful, and The Way Home, as well as Bento Box Entertainment with animated hits such as Hazbin Hotel and Krapopolis; Studio Ramsay Global with Next Level Chef, Gordon Ramsay’s Secret Service and Knife Edge: Chasing Michelin Stars; entertainment studio TMZ; and the independent film label Tideline. FOX Entertainment Global is the company’s worldwide content sales and distribution arm. As part of its evolution into a modern next-gen studio, FOX Entertainment is expanding its digital storytelling ecosystem with investments across vertical video with Holywater, Chain’s experiential storytelling, podcasting with Meet Cute, a two-way content pipeline with HarperCollins Publishing, and creator-led formats through the newly formed FOX Creator Studios. Through these strategic initiatives, the company is investing earlier in emerging ideas and new forms of audience engagement, while maintaining the ability to grow successful concepts into premium franchises across broadcast, streaming and global platforms. A prolific content creator and production partner, FOX Entertainment collaborates with leading studios, creators, and platforms worldwide to produce and distribute premium content at scale across broadcast, streaming, and digital ecosystems, while continuing to grow its portfolio of owned IP and next-generation storytelling formats.

JOB DESCRIPTION

FoxNXT is FOX Entertainment’s next-generation technology studio, built to expand what our creative teams can achieve and put more of every production dollar on screen. Our work spans four pillars: R&D, Production, Talent, and Education.

We turn emerging technology into practical tools and workflows across scripted, unscripted, animation, and marketing. We test in real productions, learn what works, and make those lessons useful across the business. We also develop talent and help our creative and production teams build the skills to use these tools confidently.

Our approach starts with people and craft. We work with creative partners to solve real production problems, protect creative intent, and use AI responsibly, with respect for rights, the creative community, and the resources production consumes.


The Project Manager turns priorities into coordinated action. You will manage intake, establish clear plans and ownership, track delivery, and make sure the right decisions happen at the right time. Working across creative, production, technical, and business teams, you will keep an accurate picture of what is moving, what is blocked, and what needs attention.


We are looking for someone who is organized, curious, direct, and comfortable working through ambiguity. You ask good questions, follow through, and raise problems early with a recommendation. You know when to resolve an issue yourself and when to bring others in. You build enough structure to help talented people do their best work as the business grows.


Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace for a minimum of four (4) days per week is an essential function of the position. The selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own project intake and help translate requests into clear objectives, scope, deliverables, owners, and timelines
  • Maintain a reliable, current view of active projects, priorities, dependencies, and team capacity
  • Coordinate across R&D, production, talent, education, and business teams to align resources and move work forward
  • Identify risks, conflicting priorities, and resource constraints early. Recommend solutions and escalate decisions with clear options and trade-offs
  • Drive follow-through on commitments, approvals, and next steps, with clear accountability for each
  • Give leadership and project teams concise, useful updates on progress, blockers, decisions needed, and outcomes
  • Track schedules, agreed budgets, and scope changes. Make the impact of changes visible before commitments are made
  • Capture requirements, decisions, workflows, and lessons learned so each project makes the next one stronger
  • Track meaningful measures of success, including delivery time, cost, adoption, and production impact
  • Improve how the team works, using practical processes and AI tools to reduce administrative work and keep information accurate

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • 7+ years of project management experience in media, entertainment, technology, or a closely related field
  • Track record of delivering complex projects across teams with different priorities and areas of expertise
  • Working understanding of television and film production, with the ability to connect creative requirements to technical and operational execution
  • Practical experience using AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini, including checking outputs and applying judgment to their use
  • Strong organizational skills and sound judgment about priorities, dependencies, risks, and when to escalate
  • Clear, concise communication. You can explain what matters, what needs to happen, and who owns the next step
  • The ability to build trust and hold people accountable across functions and levels of seniority
  • Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools such as Jira, Notion, and Google Workspace
  • Comfort working in a growing team where priorities evolve, and some processes still need to be built
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Experience moving emerging technology from experimentation into production use.
  • Experience working directly with creative teams, production crews, or technical artists.
  • PMP or equivalent certification.

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable law.

Pursuant to state and local pay disclosure requirements, the pay rate/range for this role, with final offer amount dependent on education, skills, experience, and location is $80,000.00-130,000.00 annually. This role is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus, various benefits, including medical/dental/vision, insurance, a 401(k) plan, paid time off, and other benefits in accordance with applicable plan documents. job.title: Senior Video Producer, Long-Form & YouTube - Freelance
job.description:
Tennis Channel is looking for a freelance Senior Video Producer to help lead our long-form and YouTube content. You'll partner directly with the Head of Social and our two other video leads to shape and execute video strategy toward our team's growth goals, with a particular focus on long-form programming and the YouTube channel. This is a producer role, not a pure editor role: you'll concept and create content, direct shoots, and jump into edits yourself when needed — while also directing post producers/editors to bring bigger projects to finish.

This freelance role is expected to be approximately 30-40 hours per week, with schedules aligned to tournament coverage needs. Flexibility to work weekends may be required during key tournaments and high-volume event periods. This freelance engagement is anticipated to run through December 2026, with the potential to be extended through the end of 2027 based on business needs and performance.

This is a freelance role and onsite located in Santa Monica, CA. 

In this role, you will...

  • Partner with the Head of Social and the social video leads to shape and execute video strategy toward the team's shared goals, with a particular focus on long-form content and YouTube channel strategy.

  • Concept and pitch long-form and serialized video ideas and formats for YouTube, and help build out the plans to ship them.

  • Produce content start to finish — concept, shoot/direct shoots, and edit hands-on when needed.

  • Direct and collaborate with post producers/editors on longer or higher-lift projects — set creative direction, give cut feedback, and see projects through to finish.

  • Build and manage timelines — post-production schedules and on-site content/shoot plans — to keep projects and deliverables on track.

  • Cover live tournament action, reactive/trend-driven content, and other short-form needs as they come up alongside long-form priorities.

  • Bring recommendations on YouTube performance and long-form content opportunities to the Head of Social and video leads.

  • Maintain Tennis Channel's brand voice and visual quality bar across every deliverable.

Key Qualifications:

  • 5+ years in video production, including experience concepting and producing long-form or serialized content.

  • A track record contributing to YouTube channel strategy and growth, not just producing video for it.

  • Experience directing and collaborating with post producers/editors — comfortable giving creative direction and cut feedback, not only cutting everything yourself.

  • Project management experience — able to build and own timelines, post-production schedules, and on-site content plans, and keep multiple projects moving at once.

  • Strong hands-on shooting and editing skills (Adobe Premiere Pro) to jump into edits when needed.

  • Comfortable working on-site at live tennis events, capturing courtside and behind-the-scenes footage.

  • Sports or live-event production experience a plus.

job.title: Producer - Start Here, ABC News
job.description:

Since its launch, the show has become one of the nation’s most successful daily news podcasts, earning recognition from the Edward R. Murrow Awards, Signal Awards, Webbys, and more for its excellence in journalism, storytelling, and innovation.


Start Here is entering a defining new chapter—transforming into a daily news video podcast that reaches audiences wherever and however they choose to engage, while continuing to deliver the trusted podcast its dedicated audience relies on each day.   • Be part of the overall editorial and production strategy for Start Here, being a part of daily content creation and guiding the show’s evolution into a daily news video podcast and multi-platform news franchise.

  • Work with the editors who cut and produce the show’s segments and episodes, collaborating with the host and editor throughout the production process.
  • Opportunity to be a core member of a high-performing team, fostering a collaborative newsroom culture while ensuring every episode delivers exceptional journalism, storytelling, and visual execution.
  • Be a key voice to help drive the creative vision, visual identity, and audience growth strategy for the franchise, developing platform-specific content and distribution approaches that maximize engagement across YouTube, social media, streaming, and emerging platforms.
  • Collaborate across editorial, production, graphics, audience development, Legal, Standards, and Rights & Clearances teams to deliver high-quality content, ensure compliance with company policies, and expand the show’s reach through original and social-first storytelling.

Basic Qualifications

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience producing network-level television news, with a strong portfolio spanning daily programming and long-form storytelling.
  • Proven success leading productions and teams and driving editorial decision-making in a fast-paced newsroom, with exceptional news judgment and a deep understanding of the daily news cycle.
  • Strong visual storytelling instincts, with experience developing and producing high-quality news packages and multi-platform content.
  • Experience writing and producing scripts for a video podcast news program, including familiarity with Avid editing.
  • Experience collaborating with a podcast host on editorial direction, scripting, conducting interviews, and tracking—and with editors to cut and produce segments of a video podcast.
  • Experience launching, growing, or transforming streaming, digital, or video-first news products is strongly preferred.
  • Deep understanding of YouTube, social media platforms, audience development, and engagement strategies.
  • Outstanding organizational, project management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to thrive under deadline pressure.
  • A flexible, growth-oriented mindset and a collaborative leadership style with exceptional communication and interpersonal skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Awareness of digital formats and trends across emerging platforms.

Required Education

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.

Overview:

 

We are the Global Content and Lifecycle Analytics team, part of the Paramount Streaming, Data & Insights Group (DIG) team. DIG is a key connector among the Paramount Streaming verticals. The group consists of subject matter experts that prototype, build, and scale data infrastructure and products; assess, aggregate, and analyze data; and shape qualitative and quantitative based narratives and insights, providing stakeholders with decision support, performance clarity and business driving recommendations.

The User Lifecycle Analytics team works closely with Lifecycle Marketing, Product, Finance, and DTC Executives to drive subscriber growth and retention.

 

The Senior Director will report into the VP of User Lifecycle Analytics, and will support a wide range of initiatives, partnering with the Lifecycle Marketing and Product teams, DTC executives and Finance. This role requires the ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights and strategic recommendations.

The ideal candidate will possess strong communication skills, an inquisitive nature, attention to detail, and a passion for media, ideally with experience in analyzing user journeys and advanced causal inference frameworks.

This role owns two core business questions:

 

  1. What drives long-term subscriber health, and how do we use our levers (lifecycle, product, pricing, promotions) to encourage it? 
  2. How are optimization efforts across content and the subscriber journey impacting the bottom line?

 

Responsibilities:

 

  • Design and lead causal inference frameworks (quasi-experimental methods, uplift modeling, instrumental variables, matching, diff-in-diff). Find what truly drives retention and value.
  • Work with Lifecycle Marketing and Product to turn causal findings into clear levers. These span content, onboarding, pricing, and promos to improve subscriber health.
  • Own how we link content and journey optimization to outcomes like ARPU, survival, and LTV.
  • Design, launch, and analyze A/B tests across the subscriber journey (acquisition, onboarding, involvement, win-back). Use sound design. Deliver clear results.
  • Build and keep LTV and survival models with the causal drivers above. Finance and DTC teams can then use them.
  • Lead subscriber journey mapping. Find where levers (lifecycle, product, pricing, promos) drive the most causal impact on retention and monetization.
  • Run pricing and promo analyses to shape pricing and promo design. Weigh short-term conversion against long-term value.
  • Explain technical findings clearly to non-technical teams, like DTC leaders and Finance.
  • Manage, mentor, and grow a team of data scientists and analysts. Set technical standards and review methods.
  • Work with Data Engineering and Product Analytics. Keep the data systems for causal analysis (experiment platforms, behavioral and billing data) reliable.
  • Share findings with senior leaders to shape the roadmap. Guide where we invest across Marketing, Product, and Finance.

 

 

Basic Qualifications:

 

  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Data Science, or Computer Science).
  • 10+ years in data science/analytics. This covers hands-on and team-leading work. It spans causal inference methods (diff-in-diff, propensity matching, instrumental variables, uplift modeling, synthetic control).
  • Experience designing and analyzing A/B tests and experiments at scale, handling common pitfalls (novelty and network effects, selection bias).
  • Built or run LTV, survival, or churn models. Turned them into financial metrics (ARPU, retention curves).
  • Strong SQL skills and a stats language (Python or R) for causal modeling.
  • A proven track record leading and growing a team of data scientists or analysts.
  • A clear communicator who can present complex work to senior leaders and shape decisions.
  • Experience working across Marketing, Product, and Finance teams.

 

Additional Qualifications:

 

  • Know pricing awareness/elasticity work. Design smart promos.
  • Skilled in subscriber/customer journey mapping.
  • Skilled in Bayesian or ML-based causal techniques (e.g., double machine learning, causal forests).
  • Familiarity with cloud data warehousing/BI tools (e.g., BigQuery, Databricks, Looker, Tableau).

job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Principal Machine Learning Engineer, Content Engineering (45445) 

 

 

Overview:

 

We are seeking a Senior Lead / Principal Machine Learning Engineer to lead our ShortForm & Video Intelligence pod. This team is in charge of a critical mission: the automated transformation of our massive long-form content library into "ShortForm" assets—high-impact clips, "gists," and social-ready highlights. You will lead the development of the models that "watch" our content to identify narrative hooks, emotional climaxes, and key characters to create compelling bite-sized experiences.

 

This is a deeply technical leadership role requiring mastery of multi-modal machine learning. You will oversee the creation of intelligence layers that perform video safety analysis (nudity/profanity detection), spoiler detection, and sophisticated narrative comprehension. Your work ensures that our ShortForm content is not only engaging but also safe, contextually precise, and optimized for discovery across the Paramount ecosystem.

 

The ShortForm pod unlocks the value of our entire catalog. In this role, you will directly shape:

 

  • The "Gist" Ecosystem: Building the engine that generates short-form previews, allowing users to "snack" on content before committing to a full watch.
  • Platform Safety & Integrity: Owning the "Video Intelligence" filters that protect our brand and users through automated detection of sensitive or restricted content.
  • Narrative AI: Transitioning beyond simple metadata to a world where AI understands story arcs, character importance, and "viral" moments within a film or episode. 

 

Responsibilities:

 

  • Lead the ShortForm Pod: Define the technical roadmap for automated clip generation and video insight, managing a high-performing pod of ML engineers.
  • Architect Multi-Modal Models: Design and deploy models that synthesize signals across video (pixels), audio (speech/music), and text (transcripts/scripts) to understand content context.
  • Own Video Intelligence: Develop and scale robust computer vision and audio classifiers for nudity, profanity, and sensitive content detection.
  • Advance Narrative Understanding: Build models that can identify "hooks," "climax points," and "narrative summaries" to automate the creation of trailers and highlights.
  • Spoiler & Context Detection: Create intelligence layers that identify plot-critical "spoilers" to ensure ShortForm assets don't ruin the viewing experience for new users.
  • Scalable Content Pipelines: Partner with Content Engineering to integrate these models into petabyte-scale video processing workflows.

 

Basic Qualifications:

 

  • 6-8+ years of experience in machine learning, with a heavy focus on Computer Vision (CV) and Multi-Modal architectures.
  • Deep Learning Expertise: Mastery of PyTorch or TensorFlow, specifically for video-based tasks (e.g., Video Transformers, 3D CNNs). Video Intelligence: Proven experience building safety/moderation models (Nudity, Profanity, Hate Speech) or content-tagging systems.
  • Leadership: Experience leading senior technical teams and translating complex "creative" goals into engineering requirements.
  • Video Tech Stack: Knowledge of video processing frameworks (FFmpeg) and handling various codecs/resolutions at scale.

 

Additional Qualifications:

 

  • Experience with Generative AI for Video (automated editing or style transfer).
  • Background in NLP/Speech for sync-ing transcripts with video frames.
  • Knowledge of Narrative Theory or experience in the media/entertainment industry.
  • Experience deploying large-scale models in Cloud Environments (AWS/GCP/Azure) with high GPU utilization efficiency.

job.title: Product Manager, Product Analytics & Experimentation
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

We're looking for a Product Manager, Product Analytics & Experimentation to help TEGNA measure, learn from, and continuously improve our digital products. This role sits at the intersection of product analytics and experimentation, partnering with Product Managers to transform customer behavior into actionable insights that improve our websites, mobile apps, notifications, and personalization capabilities.

You'll help evolve TEGNA's analytics and experimentation capabilities, enabling product teams to measure outcomes, validate hypotheses, and make confident, data-informed decisions throughout the product lifecycle. Working across Product, Engineering, Design, Data, QA, and Editorial, you'll help build a culture where analytics and experimentation are integral to how we discover, deliver, and continuously improve our products.

Who You Are

You are passionate about understanding customer behavior and using data to improve products. You enjoy digging into analytics, identifying opportunities, designing experiments, and translating complex findings into practical recommendations.

You're equally comfortable partnering with Product Managers to define success metrics, collaborating with Engineering on instrumentation requirements, working with Data teams to ensure analytics quality, partnering with UX Research and Design to better understand customer behavior, building dashboards, and helping stakeholders interpret the impact of new features, experiments, and customer journeys.

You have a strong analytical mindset but understand that data is only valuable when it leads to better decisions. You're curious, collaborative, and eager to develop expertise in product analytics and experimentation while helping teams build better products.

You're organized, proactive, and motivated by TEGNA's mission to connect and serve local communities everywhere.

Scope of Responsibility

Partner with Product Managers across TEGNA's Consumer Products organization to define success metrics, measure product performance, identify opportunities, and support experimentation initiatives.

Help evolve TEGNA's analytics and experimentation capabilities by establishing best practices for instrumentation, dashboard development, experimentation, and product analysis.

Support product teams throughout the product lifecycle by helping define measurement plans, analyze product performance, and communicate actionable insights that improve customer outcomes.

Top Key Activities

  • Product Analytics - Partner with Product Managers to define success metrics, develop dashboards, analyze customer behavior, and identify opportunities to improve product performance.
  • Analytics Enablement - Develop dashboards, reports, and reusable measurement frameworks that make product performance visible and actionable across the organization.
  • Instrumentation - Partner with Product Managers and Engineering to define analytics requirements, document event tracking, validate instrumentation, and improve the consistency and quality of product data.
  • Product Analysis - Analyze product performance, feature adoption, customer journeys, conversion funnels, engagement trends, and experiment results to generate actionable recommendations.
  • Experimentation - Support the design, execution, and measurement of A/B tests and feature rollouts, partnering with product teams to validate hypotheses and measure customer impact.
  • Communications - Present dashboards, findings, experiment results, and recommendations to product teams and stakeholders through clear written and verbal communication.

Domain Acumen

  • Experience working with digital product analytics platforms such as Amplitude (preferred) or Google Analytics.
  • Experience supporting A/B testing, experimentation, feature flagging, or progressive delivery using LaunchDarkly or similar platforms.
  • Strong understanding of product metrics including adoption, engagement, retention, conversion, funnels, and customer behavior analysis.
  • Experience partnering with Engineering to define or validate analytics instrumentation.
  • Ability to translate business questions into meaningful product insights.
  • Strong understanding of agile software development and how analytics supports continuous product improvement.
  • Experience with SQL, visualization tools, or business intelligence platforms is a plus.
  • Experience with digital media, publishing, consumer products, or content platforms is desirable.

Key Professional Traits and Requirements

  • 2-5 years of experience in Product Analytics, Digital Analytics, Product Management, Business Analysis, or a related field
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Experience partnering with Product Managers and Engineering teams
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong planning, prioritization, and organizational skills
  • Comfortable collaborating across Product, Design, Engineering, QA, Data, and Editorial teams
  • Data-informed decision maker with experience measuring product outcomes
  • Curious, collaborative, and eager to learn
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability
  • Comfortable working in fast-paced, iterative environments

Tools

Deep knowledge and proficiency with the following:

  • Analytics: Amplitude or equivalent

Inside Sales Representative – Recruitment Specialist

Inside Sales | Remote | Uncapped Earnings | Recruitment Marketing

Company: LocaliQ, powered by the USA TODAY Network

Work Arrangement: Remote

About LocaliQ

At LocaliQ, part of the USA TODAY Network, we help businesses grow through powerful marketing technology, trusted audience reach, and the expertise to turn it into results.

In this role, you’ll help small and mid-sized businesses solve one of their biggest challenges: finding and hiring the right talent. You’ll connect businesses with recruitment marketing and advertising solutions designed to help them reach qualified candidates and build stronger teams.

You’ll combine sales expertise with marketing solutions across channels such as SEO, SEM, Social Media, OTT/CTV, Display Advertising, and more to help clients attract the people they need to grow.

About the Role

Our Inside Sales Representative – Recruitment Specialist role is a high-energy, consultative sales position for someone who loves building relationships, uncovering business needs, and turning opportunities into results.

You’ll work with businesses nationwide, prospecting for new clients while also managing and growing your own book of business. From the first cold call or virtual meeting through the close and campaign launch, you’ll own the client relationship and serve as a trusted partner throughout the sales process.

You’ll work closely with Client Success Managers to launch and optimize recruitment campaigns, giving you the opportunity to stay connected to the client beyond the initial sale and help ensure their recruitment marketing efforts deliver results.

This is a role where your activity, consistency, and ability to build relationships directly impact your success and earning potential.

Why This Role Stands Out

• $41,000 base salary + uncapped commission

• $55K–$60K On-Target Earnings

• 100% remote work environment with a collaborative, energized team

• Opportunity to sell recruitment marketing and advertising solutions that solve real business challenges

• Full sales-cycle ownership, from prospecting and discovery through close and account growth

• Four weeks of immersive onboarding plus ongoing digital skills development

• Comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, 401(k), parental leave, tuition assistance, pet insurance, volunteer time off, and more

• PTO, floating holidays, and 8 paid holidays

• Career development and opportunities to grow within the organization

• Backed by the resources, marketing expertise, and reach of LocaliQ and the USA TODAY Network

What You Will Do

• Drive new business through consistent prospecting, cold calling, email outreach, and virtual meetings

• Build relationships with small and mid-sized businesses nationwide

• Uncover client hiring challenges and recommend recruitment marketing solutions aligned to their needs

• Sell solutions across SEO, SEM, Social Media, OTT/CTV, Display Advertising, and more

• Manage your own book of business, including closing new business, upselling, and re-engaging past clients

• Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline and consistently work toward revenue goals

• Partner with Client Success Managers to launch, support, and optimize recruitment campaigns

• Deliver a strong client experience from the initial conversation through ongoing partnership

• Track activity, opportunities, pipeline, and performance using Salesforce

• Consistently work toward and exceed sales and activity goals

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree OR 2+ years of inside sales experience, with B2B sales preferred

• Strong prospecting and cold-calling skills with confidence initiating conversations with new prospects

• Ability to uncover client needs and recommend consultative, solution-based offerings

• Strong communication, relationship-building, and closing skills

• Comfortable working toward sales goals in a performance-driven environment

• Experience with digital marketing or recruitment is a plus

• Tech-savvy with experience using Salesforce or another CRM

• Competitive, resilient, self-motivated, and highly organized

• Strong follow-through and ability to manage multiple opportunities

• Team-oriented and comfortable balancing individual accountability with collaboration

Who Thrives Here

The people who succeed in this role are competitive, resilient, curious, and motivated by results. They aren't afraid to pick up the phone, start conversations with new businesses, and work through rejection to find the next opportunity.

You’ll thrive if you enjoy building relationships, asking thoughtful questions, solving business challenges, and seeing your effort translate into results.

You’ll also have the support of a collaborative team. While you’ll own your pipeline and performance, you’ll work closely with Client Success Managers and other internal partners to create strong experiences for your clients.

What Success Looks Like

First 3 Months:

Complete immersive onboarding, build your product and recruitment marketing knowledge, develop strong prospecting habits, and begin building a healthy pipeline.

6 Months:

Consistently prospect, manage a growing book of business, conduct confident consultative sales conversations, and establish steady performance against revenue goals.

12 Months:

Own your sales cycle with confidence, consistently deliver against quota, grow existing client relationships, and identify opportunities to expand your book of business.

Benefits & Growth

We believe strong performance should be supported with competitive compensation, development opportunities, and the tools needed to build a successful career.

• $41,000 base salary + uncapped commission

• $55K–$60K OTE

• 401(k)

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage

• PTO and floating holidays

• 8 paid holidays

• Four-week immersive onboarding program

• Ongoing training and digital skills development

• Remote work flexibility

• Career growth and advancement opportunities

• Collaborative team environment with strong leadership support

Help Businesses Find the People They Need

Businesses can’t grow without great people. In this role, you’ll help them solve that challenge while building valuable sales, marketing, and recruitment expertise of your own.

If you’re ready to build relationships, close deals, help businesses hire great talent, and be rewarded for your results, we encourage you to apply.

The hourly rate for this role will range between $12.55 and $19.24. Base compensation is reflective of multiple factors, including market location, education level, skills, certifications, and experience. Variable compensation is not reflected in these figures and may apply based on the role.

As a Database Engineer, you will help operate and improve the database systems that power LOCALiQ, running primarily in the cloud across MySQL, PostgreSQL, and BigQuery. You will partner closely with software engineers, data engineers, analysts, and data scientists to keep our data platforms fast, safe, and available as our products scale.

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who is curious about data challenges, comfortable operating production systems, and motivated to automate the work that shouldn't be done by hand. You'll have the support of a senior team while owning meaningful pieces of the platform yourself.

We are a fast-paced, product-led engineering organization building the next generation of digital marketing management systems in partnership with Google, Bing, Yahoo, Facebook, and Snap. If you are technical, analytical, and eager to build solutions that directly impact the business, we want to talk to you.

What You'll Do

· Design, build, and operate database systems on MySQL, PostgreSQL, and BigQuery, primarily on Google Cloud Platform.

· Maintain performance, availability, and security across LOCALiQ's production database estate.

· Ensure data safety and data integrity, including backup, recovery, and disaster recovery validation.

· Perform routine database operations such as upgrades, patching, schema changes, replication management, and capacity planning.

· Tune and troubleshoot slow queries, blocking, and replication issues alongside application teams.

· Review database changes to minimize deployment risk, and help teams design schemas and access patterns that scale.

· Automate recurring operational work through scripting, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD pipelines.

· Participate in a scheduled 24x7 on-call rotation shared with other team members.

Required Skills

· 3+ years of experience in a Database Engineer, Database Administrator, or similar role.

· Hands-on experience managing production database infrastructure in a cloud environment (GCP, AWS, or Azure).

· Working knowledge of relational databases — MySQL and/or PostgreSQL — including administration, replication, and backup/recovery.

· Strong SQL skills, including the ability to read, write, and optimize non-trivial queries.

· Programming experience in at least one language — Python preferred, but Go, Java, Ruby, or similar are all valuable.

· Experience with Git version control and working on code as part of a team.

· Sound judgment around change management, risk, and data integrity in production systems.

· BS or MS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

· Curiosity, self-direction, and a bias toward automating repetitive work.

Preferred Skills

· Experience with Google Cloud Platform, particularly Cloud SQL, BigQuery, GKE, and Pub/Sub (equivalent AWS experience with RDS, Redshift, EKS, and SQS is welcome).

· Experience with BigQuery or another cloud data warehouse, including cost and performance optimization.

· Experience data modeling and data transformation tools like Dataform or DBT

· Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform), containers, and CI/CD practices such as test automation and automated deployments.

· Comfort working in an Agile/Scrum environment.

· Exposure to digital marketing or online advertising data (SEO/SEM) is an advantage.

Gannett Publishing Services

Rockaway, NJ

The Rockaway Facility is looking for a full time Press Operator to assist with daily production on our double wide presses. Gannett Publishing Services

Rockaway, NJ

The Rockaway Facility is looking for a full time Press Operator to assist with daily production on our double wide presses. Optimum quality of printed products.

Observance of all scheduled start and stop times.

Conservation of material resources, especially newsprint.

A clean and safe working environment.

General Assignment Reporter – Midland Daily News

Be the voice of a community. Report with purpose. Grow with Hearst.

Make a Real Impact with Every Story

Join a newsroom where your reporting truly matters. At the Midland Daily News, we don’t just chase headlines — we shine a light on what matters most to our community. This is more than a job. It’s your chance to be part of a fast-paced, collaborative newsroom that values storytelling, integrity, and innovation — and yes, we like to have fun while doing it.

job.title: Product Manager, Strategic Programs
job.description:
Job Description:


The New York Post is looking for a Product Manager, Strategic Programs to join our newly created Product Innovation and Strategy team.


This is a chance to help shape what comes next for one of the most recognizable media brands in the country. You will work on new products, AI, emerging technology, and ideas that can actually make their way into the hands of our audience. Think websites, apps, new digital experiences, internal tools, automation, and entirely new ways of doing things.


This is a highly visible role with direct access to stakeholders and C Suite leadership. Our team is here to experiment, move quickly, and take ideas from “what if?” to something real. You will have room to test new technology, try things that have never been done before, figure out what works, and run with the ideas that have potential.


We are looking for someone who is scrappy, curious, self motivated, and genuinely excited about product and innovation. Someone who does not need to be told what to do next, is comfortable with ambiguity, and enjoys figuring out solutions when there is no obvious playbook. If you are excited by AI, constantly experimenting with new tools, and want your work to have a visible impact, this is a role where you can do that.


What You Will Do:


  • Own strategic product and innovation initiatives from idea through launch, keeping projects moving and turning concepts into real products and experiences.
  • Work directly with stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Editorial, Design, Data, Commercial, and other teams to understand opportunities and build solutions.
  • Experiment with AI tools, emerging technologies, and new platforms to identify ways we can improve our products, workflows, audience experience, and business.
  • Take an idea, figure out what is possible, test it, learn from it, and determine whether it should move forward.
  • Turn business needs into clear product requirements, user stories, project plans, priorities, and next steps.
  • Be hands on. Jump into the work, solve problems, test solutions, and do whatever is needed to keep an initiative moving.
  • Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to make our teams more efficient and our products better.
  • Partner with technical teams to help turn concepts and experiments into practical, scalable solutions.
  • Define success metrics and KPIs, track results, gather feedback, and use what you learn to improve or rethink an initiative.
  • Coordinate testing and launch activities and make sure new products and experiences are ready for our audiences.
  • Keep up with what is happening across AI, technology, media, and the broader product landscape and bring new ideas to the table.
  • Manage multiple initiatives and know when to prioritize, reprioritize, push something forward, or change direction.

What We Are Looking For:


  • 3 to 4 years of experience in Product Management, Product Innovation, Strategic Programs, Project Management, or a similar role is the sweet spot for this position.
  • Someone who genuinely cares about product and wants to build things, not simply manage timelines.
  • Genuine enthusiasm for AI and emerging technology, with hands on experience experimenting with Generative AI tools and an interest in learning what is coming next.
  • A self starter who can take an ambiguous problem and figure out where to start without needing constant direction.
  • Someone who is scrappy and resourceful and enjoys finding creative solutions when the obvious answer does not exist.
  • Strong project and product management skills, including the ability to prioritize, organize, manage competing deadlines, and drive work through completion.
  • Excellent communication skills and the confidence to work directly with stakeholders, senior leaders, and C Suite executives.
  • Someone who can move comfortably between strategy and execution and is willing to roll up their sleeves and do the work.
  • Strong problem solving skills and the ability to work across technical and non technical teams.
  • Experience defining product requirements, managing projects, and using data and feedback to measure success.
  • Experience with tools such as Jira, Airtable, Monday.com, or similar platforms.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Media, news, publishing, entertainment, or another fast moving consumer facing industry is highly preferred.
  • Experience working on digital products, emerging technology, AI, automation, or innovation initiatives.
  • Strong understanding of current AI tools and a genuine curiosity about how AI can change products and workflows.
  • Familiarity with content management systems, publishing technology, video, advertising technology, personalization, recommendation systems, or other high traffic digital products.
  • Basic understanding of APIs, software development, or cloud platforms.
  • Familiarity with Agile or Scrum methodologies.
  • Experience presenting ideas, projects, or recommendations to senior management.

Why This Role?


  • Build things people actually see. Your work can show up across NYPost.com, our apps, digital products, and other experiences used by millions of people.
  • Experiment with AI and new technology. We want people who are excited to try new things and figure out how they can actually benefit the business.
  • Work with senior leadership. This is a high visibility team with direct communication and exposure to C Suite executives.
  • Have the freedom to run with ideas. This is a newly created team built around innovation, experimentation, and finding what comes next.
  • Work across the business. You will collaborate with Product, Engineering, Editorial, Design, Data, Commercial, and other teams rather than operating in a silo.
  • Make an impact. You will not just create roadmaps or manage projects. You will help decide what we build, test new ideas, and see those ideas become real.
  • Be part of something new. This team is at the forefront of NYP's innovation and startup initiatives, with the opportunity to help shape both the products and the way we work.

Note: The New York Post follows a hybrid work model. This position is expected to be in the office a minimum of 3 days per week, subject to change based on business needs.
