job.title: Director of Data & Analytics
job.description:
Job Description:


The New York Post provides readers with the best in News, Sports, Pop Culture, Fashion and Entertainment – with signature wit, irreverence and authority, averaging 90 million unique viewers a month. Over the past 223 years, The Post has evolved into a multi-platform media company spanning print, digital, video, audio, app, television and commerce.


We are seeking an experienced, highly hands-on Director of Data & Analytics to join our Data Science & Analytics team. Reporting into our Vice President of Data Science & Analytics, this is a high-impact leadership role responsible for turning data into actionable insights that shape how The New York Post operates, grows its audience, and drives commercial performance.


The ideal candidate is both a strategic leader and a hands-on analytics expert; someone who can set direction and lead a team, but is equally comfortable rolling up their sleeves, digging into data, building analyses, and delivering answers themselves. You will work closely with leaders and stakeholders across Editorial, Commercial, Product, Marketing, Affiliate/E-Commerce, Data Engineering, and Product, helping teams understand what the data is telling us and, more importantly, what they should do with it.


This is an opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-moving media environment where priorities evolve quickly, questions don't always come neatly defined, and the ability to deliver high-quality insights on a tight timeline is critical. Working closely with our newsroom means being comfortable with urgency and quick turnaround while maintaining a high standard of analytical rigor.


The right person will be energized by the pace and variety of The New York Post, is someone who doesn't need every question defined for them, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity while seeing changing priorities as an opportunity to solve new problems. Most importantly, you should be passionate about using data not simply to report what happened, but to help people across the organization make smarter, faster, more informed decisions.


Responsibilities:


  • Lead and develop a high-performing analytics team, managing a team of 3+ Data/Business Analysts and providing mentorship, prioritization, coaching, and professional development.
  • Establish the strategy, priorities, and operating model for analytics across the organization, ensuring the team is focused on the highest-impact business and editorial opportunities.
  • Serve as a trusted data and analytics partner to senior stakeholders across Editorial and Commercial, translating business questions into clear analytical approaches and actionable recommendations.
  • Partner closely with newsroom leadership and editorial teams to develop insights that support audience growth, content strategy, engagement, performance, and decision-making.
  • Work with Commercial, Advertising, Marketing, and other business teams to analyze campaign performance, audience behavior, revenue opportunities, and media performance.
  • Act as a hands-on analytics leader who can independently investigate complex questions, work directly with large datasets, build analyses, and deliver insights — not simply manage work from above.
  • Develop and maintain automated reporting, dashboards, and data products that give stakeholders timely, reliable visibility into the metrics that matter most.
  • Champion a data-driven culture by helping stakeholders understand not only what is happening in the business, but why it is happening and what actions the data supports.
  • Lead the development and integration of advanced analytics models and methodologies to improve media performance, audience engagement, campaign effectiveness, and business outcomes.
  • Analyze campaign and media performance across platforms and channels, identifying trends, opportunities, and areas for optimization.
  • Partner with Data Engineering and Data Science teams to integrate, structure, and leverage data from marketing clean rooms and other internal and external data sources.
  • Collaborate with Product, Technology, and Data teams to improve data accessibility, quality, and usability and to identify opportunities to build scalable data products.
  • Partner with senior management to develop and refine business and media strategies based on data-driven insights.
  • Help establish analytics best practices, standards, and methodologies across the organization, including approaches to measurement, experimentation, attribution, and media effectiveness.
  • Support the development of sports analytics capabilities and identify new opportunities to leverage data across The Post's sports business and editorial operations.
  • Translate complex analytical findings into clear, compelling narratives that can be understood and acted upon by both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Operate effectively in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment, where priorities can shift quickly and new analytical questions emerge regularly.
  • Balance longer-term strategic initiatives with urgent, high-priority requests, maintaining quality and accuracy while delivering against tight newsroom and business timelines.
  • Identify opportunities to proactively use data to answer questions stakeholders may not yet be asking and surface insights that can create meaningful business impact.

Requirements:


  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Economics, Statistics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field preferred.
  • 6–10+ years of progressive experience in data, analytics, business intelligence, or a related discipline, preferably within media, entertainment, sports, digital publishing, advertising, or another fast-paced consumer business.
  • Previous experience leading and developing a team of analysts, with the ability to balance people leadership with hands-on individual contribution; You should be equally comfortable presenting insights to senior leadership, partnering with an editor on an urgent newsroom question, coaching an analyst through a complex project, or opening up SQL and figuring out the answer yourself.
  • Strong track record of partnering with senior stakeholders across multiple functions and using data to influence business decisions.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting both commercial/business and editorial or content-oriented stakeholders is strongly preferred.
  • Extensive experience with BI and visualization tools such as Looker, Power BI, or Tableau.
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and experience working with Python and large, complex datasets.
  • Proven ability to independently scope, execute, and communicate complex analytical projects from start to finish.
  • Experience driving data and analytics initiatives within digital media, direct-to-consumer, marketing, advertising, sports, or other high-volume digital environments.
  • Strong understanding of modern cloud data architectures, including data warehouses, data marts, lakehouse environments, multi-cloud architectures, real-time data, and data productization.
  • Expertise in media measurement methodologies and technologies, including experimentation, attribution, and Media Mix Modeling (MMM).
  • Strong understanding of campaign analytics, audience measurement, data extraction, media optimization, and performance reporting.
  • Experience applying advanced analytical and research techniques to solve complex business problems.
  • Ability to translate complex technical or analytical concepts into clear, actionable business recommendations.
  • Advanced understanding of media, audience, engagement, and commercial metrics and their application to business decision-making.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify meaningful patterns and insights within large datasets and communicate those findings effectively.
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills, intellectual curiosity, and attention to detail.
  • Ability to thrive in a highly collaborative, fast-moving, and sometimes ambiguous environment where priorities and business needs can change quickly.
  • Strong project management and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders and deliver against tight deadlines.
  • A roll-up-your-sleeves mentality — you are comfortable getting into the data yourself, challenging assumptions, troubleshooting an analysis, and doing the work when needed.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with everyone from data scientists and engineers to newsroom editors and commercial executives.

Note: This position will be expected to adhere to our hybrid work model, requiring three (3) days per week in the office. This schedule is subject to change based on business needs.

job.description:
Job Description:


The New York Post is one of America’s most iconic and recognizable news brands: delivering bold journalism, industry-leading entertainment coverage, and innovative digital experiences to millions of readers every day. With a legacy built on fearless reporting and a distinctly New York attitude, The Post has evolved far beyond its print roots to become a modern media powerhouse. Today, the New York Post Digital Network reaches millions of readers each month across an expansive portfolio of brands, including NYPost.com, PageSix.com, Decider.com, and The California Post.


We are seeking an experienced and strategic Director of Product to lead the vision, strategy, and execution of digital product initiatives across the New York Post Media Group. Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer (CTO), this highly collaborative leadership role will oversee a small team of Product Managers while remaining hands-on in the development and execution of product strategy.


This is a highly visible, stakeholder-facing role for a product leader who understands both product and the business. The Director will partner closely with Editorial, Audience Development, Engineering, Design, Data, Revenue, Marketing, and Executive Leadership to identify opportunities, establish priorities, and build digital experiences that grow audiences, deepen engagement, and drive measurable business impact.


The ideal candidate is both a strategic product leader and a hands-on, scrappy operator; someone who can think big and define long-term product vision while also rolling up their sleeves to write user stories, prioritize backlogs, analyze performance metrics, solve problems creatively, and partner closely with engineering teams to move ideas from concept to market. They are equally comfortable presenting product strategies, roadmaps, and recommendations to senior stakeholders as they are working directly with their team to bring ideas to life. They thrive in a fast-paced environment, are comfortable navigating ambiguity and competing priorities, and know how to find practical, resourceful ways to get things done without losing sight of the bigger picture.


Responsibilities


Product Strategy & Execution

  • Own the end-to-end product lifecycle across a portfolio of digital products, from discovery and prioritization through launch, optimization, and continuous improvement.
  • Develop and execute product strategies and roadmaps aligned with company objectives and audience growth initiatives.
  • Translate business needs into detailed product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical specifications.
  • Prioritize initiatives using customer insights, analytics, market research, and business impact.
  • Partner closely with Engineering, Design, Data, Editorial, and key stakeholders throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Define success metrics, measure product performance, and continuously iterate based on user feedback and data.

Audience Growth & User Experience

  • Collaborate with Editorial, Audience Development, Marketing, and Analytics teams to create engaging digital experiences that increase user acquisition, engagement, retention, and loyalty.
  • Drive product innovation across key consumer touchpoints, including:
    • Homepage
    • Article experiences
    • Mobile applications
    • Newsletters
    • AI-powered products and experiences
    • Search and content discovery
    • Registration and subscription experiences
    • Video products
    • Emerging platforms

Hands-On Product Leadership

  • Actively manage product delivery through agile methodologies, ensuring timely and high-quality execution.
  • Lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, prioritization sessions, and product grooming.
  • Review prototypes, user flows, and design concepts to ensure exceptional user experiences.
  • Partner closely with developers to remove blockers and facilitate efficient product delivery.
  • Perform quality assurance and user acceptance testing prior to product launches.
  • Monitor product performance and KPIs following releases and identify opportunities for ongoing optimization.

Product Management Excellence

  • Establish and champion best practices for product management across the organization.
  • Introduce scalable product processes and frameworks that improve prioritization, collaboration, and execution.
  • Advocate for user-centered design principles and data-driven decision-making.
  • Foster a culture of experimentation, continuous learning, and rapid iteration.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Lead complex initiatives across Product, Engineering, Editorial, Audience Development, Design, Data, Advertising, Marketing, and Executive Leadership.
  • Align cross-functional teams around shared objectives while balancing business priorities with technical feasibility.
  • Build strong relationships across the organization to ensure successful execution of strategic initiatives.

Innovation & Industry Leadership

  • Stay current on emerging trends across digital publishing, consumer technology, artificial intelligence, and media.
  • Evaluate opportunities in areas including:
    • Artificial Intelligence
    • Personalization
    • Search and discovery
    • News consumption trends
    • Mobile experiences
    • Subscription products
    • Creator platforms
    • Audience engagement technologies
  • Bring innovative ideas that help keep the New York Post at the forefront of digital media.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of deep, progressive experience in digital product management, with significant ownership of consumer-facing digital products throughout the full product lifecycle, preferably within media, publishing, or consumer technology.
  • Strong understanding of digital publishing, audience development, and media business models.
  • Proven success leading consumer-facing web and mobile product initiatives end-to-end, from discovery and business case development through launch, measurement, and continuous optimization.
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Engineering, Editorial, Design, Data, and Revenue teams, with an understanding of how product decisions can support audience monetization, advertising performance, subscriptions, and broader business objectives.
  • Strong hands-on experience with CMS, content publishing workflows, newsletters, push notifications, or similar audience engagement products.

  • Experience managing and developing Product Managers, while providing strategic direction and maintaining a hands-on approach to product leadership.
  • Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and project management skills.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels.
  • Passion for building innovative products that delight users and drive measurable business results.
  • Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and take a scrappy, solutions-oriented approach to getting things done.

Technical Experience


Experience with many of the following is preferred:

  • A/B and multivariate testing
  • UX research methodologies

Success in the First Year

Founded in 2010, ONErpm is a global music solutions company with 43 offices and studios in 28 countries with over 500 staff members across the world, with significant presence in Brazil, the U.S., Europe, and other markets. job.title: Assistant Creative Manager
job.description:
The Assistant Creative Manager will be primarily responsible for leading local creative marketing, content production, and artist campaign execution for Sony Music's international repertoire in Hong Kong. In addition to driving the Hong Kong market, this position will provide expanded creative support for campaign initiatives across Taiwan and Southeast Asia (SEA).

This position will play a key role in various creative marketing functions — assisting with pitch development, coordinating agency deliverables, maintaining release timelines, supporting in-market promotional visits, and creating assets (social media, short-form video, photo, and digital marketing materials) to craft engaging fan experiences on behalf of some of the biggest international artists in the world. 

The role is based in Hong Kong and covers Hong Kong, Taiwan and Southeast Asia (SEA). You will sit within Hong Kong, Taiwan and Southeast Asia (SEA) International Marketing community, reporting to the Director, International Marketing in Hong Kong and working closely with the Head of Creative, Southeast Asia, ensuring regional creative alignment while executing tailored campaigns locally.

What you'll do:

  • Campaign Ideation & Execution: Be a creative visionary, developing and implementing innovative marketing and superfan campaigns that enhance Sony Music artists’ presence and engage fans across Hong Kong, Taiwan, and Southeast Asia.
  • Vendor & Agency Coordination: Manage relationships with external creative partners such as agencies, photographers, and production teams to deliver high-quality content and assets on time and within budget.
  • Workflow & Asset Management: Assist with the end-to-end creative workflow—from routing concepts for approval to monitoring production schedules—ensuring asset alignment with artist and company brand guidelines.
  • Trend & Platform Research: Monitor music, pop culture, events, TikTok, digital marketing, and emerging tech trends to provide actionable ideas for creative asset production.
  • Data & Insights Application: Collaborate with the data and insights team to pull audience analytics, assisting in applying performance metrics to optimize asset design and content formats.
  • Content Calendar & Delivery: Build and maintain the master content calendar for campaign launches, promotional schedules, and artist activities across the company’s international releases.
  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Support cross-functional integration across digital, audience development, catalogue, local PR, and content teams to ensure messaging alignment.
  • Post-Campaign Reporting: Gather feedback, compile post-campaign performance data, and draft summary reports to help refine future creative strategies.
  • Asset Production & Collaboration: Develop and produce engaging creative outputs that reflect the artist's unique identity, story, and vision across multiple platforms. Coordinate with graphic designers, videographers, and editors to produce visually compelling content. while remaining adaptable to artist management feedback.

Who you are:

Technical capabilities

  • 3–5 years of experience executing creative marketing campaigns within music, entertainment, media, or agency environments.
  • Passionate about the music and entertainment industry with a strong desire to grow your creative career.
  • Highly organized multi-taskers with strong communication skills and experience supporting cross-functional teams.
  • Curious, proactive, eager to learn, and attuned to the unique cultural trends across Hong Kong, Taiwan, Southeast Asian markets.
  • Skilled at translating artistic concepts into practical, engaging digital and social assets.
  • Solid understanding of modern digital platforms, music streaming mechanics, and short-form video creation.
  • Analytical mindset with basic proficiency in reviewing campaign analytics and key performance metrics.
  • Excellent written English and Chinese, with fluent spoken English & Cantonese. Fluent spoken Mandarin is an advantage.

Behavioural capabilities

  • Ownership and agility: takes complete responsibility for assigned artists and markets, and adapts quickly to shifting timelines, artist priorities and market trends.
  • Execution excellence: delivers high-quality work with meticulous attention to detail, timing and cross-functional coordination.
  • Curiosity and innovation: proactively explores new creator trends, media hooks, platform features and commercial opportunities beyond assigned tasks.
  • Collaboration and problem solving: works effectively with cross-border teams and external partners across different markets, time zones and working cultures, bringing practical solutions to complex challenges

What we give you:

job.title: Accounting Manager
job.description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses: 

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 

  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

A little bit about our team:
The U.S. Shared Services organization is based in WMG’s Center of Excellence for Shared Services. The Center consists of five departments: Analysis, Finance, Legal, Licensing, and Reporting. Employees of the Center provide
services to all of WMG’s U.S. and LATAM record labels, Warner Chappell Music Publishing, WEA Corp. and Alternative Distribution Alliance (WMG’s distribution companies), and WMG’s other U.S. business units. The Finance Department will be responsible for managing all the center's accounting and cash management functions. As a critical component of the Finance department, the Accounting Operations Group will provide accounting services and support to WMG's LATAM Recorded Music and Music Publishing businesses.

Your role:
The Accounting Manager for Accounting is responsible for overseeing the general ledger monthly close process and all aspects of Revenue and Royalty accounting for WMG LATAM businesses. They will liaise with internal and external auditors to
ensure compliance with SOX requirements as well as managing and developing a team of offshore and on-shore Accountants.

Here you’ll get to:

  • Manage the monthly close process including analysis, general ledger entries, and reconciliation review, with a focus on Revenue and Royalty related functions for our LATAM businesses.
  • Support recorded music label finance and Music Publishing finance by answering questions and performing ad hoc requests around Revenue and Royalty related activities.
  • Act as Liaison between SSC and Local finance teams in LATAM countries
  • Work with team to complete submission to corporate and review of related schedules in submitted conjunction with the monthly/quarterly financials
  • Liaise with internal and external auditors, and ensure compliance with SOX requirements including drafting and updating process narratives, and maintenance of requirement documentation
  • Maintain strong relationships with finance personnel of affiliates/business units, internal/external auditors, 3rd party vendors, as well as other divisions within WMG
  • Perform ad-hoc tasks and special projects as required by Division and/or Directors
  • Manage, coach, and develop team members both onshore and offshore

About you:

  • Strong leadership and organizational skills
  • Demonstrated career progression, with a proven track record of stability in a leadership capacity leading month end close in a shared services environment
  • Shared Services mindset: drive efficiency, standardize processes, across different LATAM territories, and meet Service Level Agreements (SLAs)
  • Experience managing onshore and offshore teams
  • Experience with Revenue and Royalty accounting, understanding of ASC 606
  • BA/BS in Accounting/Finance
  • Bilingual English/Spanish
  • SAP S4 Experience
  • Excellent Excel/Microsoft Office skills
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills needed in interacting with internal/external parties
  • Detail oriented and ability to work under pressure/tight deadlines
  • Strong analytical skills in reviewing accounting transactions

We’d love it if you also had:

  • CPA a plus and Masters of accounting a plus
  • Royalty Systems experience a plus
  • 5+ years of experience in accounting or financial audit, preferably with Big 4 and private industry
  • Industry knowledge a plus
  • Bilingual in Portuguese a plus


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Love this job and want to apply?

Click the “Apply” link at the top of the page, or apply directly with your LinkedIn. Applying with LinkedIn will import all of the information you put in your profile, but will still allow you to upload a resume and cover letter.

 

Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.

 

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer - Anti-Abuse
job.description:
SoundCloud empowers artists and fans to connect and share through music. Founded in 2007, SoundCloud is an artist-first platform empowering artists to build and grow their careers by providing them with the most progressive tools, services, and resources. With over 400+ million tracks from 40 million artists, the future of music is SoundCloud.

SoundCloud is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our Anti-Abuse Team, with a mission to keep connections between fans and creators safe and authentic, while building and operating an abuse prevention platform at global scale. The role can be based in either our Berlin or London office.

Our services are at the heart of SoundCloud’s user journeys. We operate a substantial suite of event-based services, combining specialised and generalised detection approaches to tackle complex architectural problems where scale, adaptability and fast decision-making are critical.

You’ll join a self-sufficient team passionate about abuse prevention, building scalable and adaptable solutions that stay ahead of emerging risks. The role combines long-term platform and architecture work with rapid response to new abuse vectors, giving you the opportunity to solve both strategic and time-sensitive engineering problems.

You’ll have significant end-to-end ownership to identify problems, shape solutions and drive projects from the ground up, working directly with engineering and T&S Professionals. If you’re creative, proactive and enjoy being the expert who turns complex problems into effective solutions, you’ll have plenty of room to make an impact.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and evolve reusable platform capabilities and services that enable other teams to detect and respond to emerging abuse patterns at scale
  • Shape the platform architecture and technical strategy, balancing long-term scalability with rapid responses to emerging challenges
  • Partner with Product, Analytics, Trust & Safety professionals, and Engineering teams to identify and address abuse patterns across the organisation, driving alignment on solutions and communicating complex technical concepts clearly to diverse stakeholders.
  • Own problems end-to-end, from identifying opportunities and defining solutions to driving projects through delivery
  • Make pragmatic technical decisions, balancing cost, latency, complexity, scalability and maintainability
  • Drive architecture discussions, contribute to technical strategy, and improve engineering practices, processes and tooling.
  • Debug complex issues across data pipelines and distributed systems
  • Continuously learn and share knowledge of industry best practices in abuse prevention and detection
  • Be part of on-call rotation to ensure the reliability and availability of SoundCloud’s systems

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience designing APIs and backend services consumed by multiple client platforms
  • Strong SQL skills for massive datasets (e.g. BigQuery or similar)
  • Knowledge of different API communication patterns (e.g., gRPC, GraphQL)
  • Strong professional experience with Go; experience with Scala or another language is a plus
  • Nice to have: Experience in abuse prevention, fraud detection or Trust & Safety is a plus
  • Nice to have: Experience using AI-assisted development tools and a strong intuition for their strengths, weaknesses, and emerging opportunities

Experience and Background

  • Extensive professional software engineering experience, including significant experience designing and operating distributed, event-driven backend systems at scale.
  • Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform and cloud-native environments such as AWS or GCP
  • Experience in building distributed data processing and ETL pipelines, metrics and supporting ML infrastructure 
  • Experience with microservices, SQL and NoSQL databases, container technologies
  • You care about the craft of software engineering: continuous delivery, defensive programming, automated testing, security, clean code principles
  • You have a strong sense of ownership and are comfortable navigating ambiguity in fast-moving environments
  • You bring a humble, collaborative, team-first mindset and an eagerness to learn and support your colleagues
  • Bonus point: You love music

About us

  • We are a multinational company with offices in the US (New York and Los Angeles), Germany (Berlin), and the UK (London)
  • We provide a flexible work culture that offers the opportunity to collaborate and connect in person at our offices as well as accommodating work from home
  • We are deeply committed to ensuring diversity, equity and inclusion at all levels of our organization and fostering a community where everyone’s voice, perspective and experience is respected and heard
  • We believe a strong team is made by investing in employees through mentorship, workshops and enrichment opportunities

 

Benefits: The Recruiter will supply the benefit points based on the location

 

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at SoundCloud 

SoundCloud is for everyone. Diversity and open expression are fundamental to our organization; they help us lead what’s next in music by understanding and empowering our creators and fans, no matter their identity. We acknowledge the challenges in the music industry, and strive to influence an inclusive culture where everyone can contribute respectfully and thrive, especially the historically marginalized communities that many of our creators, fans and SoundClouders identify with. We are dedicated to creating an inclusive environment at SoundCloud for everyone, regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, migration background, national origin, age, disability status, or care-giver status.


At SoundCloud you can find your community or elevate your allyship by joining a Diversity Resource Group. Diversity Resource Groups are employee-organized groups focused on supporting and promoting the interests of a particular underrepresented community in order to build a more inclusive culture at SoundCloud. Anyone can join, whether you share the identity or strive to be an ally.

job.title: Digital Operations Specialist I
job.description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox Corporation

Under the FOX banner, we produce and distribute content through some of the world’s leading and most valued brands, including: FOX News Media, FOX Sports, FOX Entertainment, FOX Television Stations and Tubi Media Group. We empower a diverse range of creators to imagine and develop culturally significant content, while building an organization that thrives on creative ideas, operational expertise and strategic thinking.

JOB DESCRIPTION

At Fox Tech, we stand as a beacon of innovation, crafting world-class, large-scale digital products that redefine the entertainment experience. We’re seeking visionary individuals to join our Digital Operations team to shape the future of streaming. Now is your chance to contribute to delivering extraordinary digital experiences across Sports, News, and Entertainment.


ABOUT THE ROLE


Fox Technology is looking for a Digital Operations Specialist to join our Digital Operations Team in Tempe, AZ. In this role, you will ensure production services are operated consistently and at scale—delivering a high-quality experience to millions of viewers across FOX Networks, Tubi, digital platforms, mobile apps, websites, linear networks, and 3rd-party partners such as Amazon, Hulu, and Apple.


You will collaborate closely with the SRO and Tier 1 Media Control Center (MCC) Operations teams to develop procedures, monitoring patterns, and troubleshooting strategies. This is a Tier 1 role, ideal for a self-starter interested in progressive approaches to digital operations and capable of partnering effectively across teams to deliver reliable, high-quality content experiences.


A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES


  • Collaborate with Marketing and Programming teams to execute business objectives for the FOX One streaming service. This includes ensuring content is properly featured and implemented across our direct-to-consumer platform.
  • Own the end-to-end operation of content services, applications, and events, including event monitoring, incident management, and support of cloud services.
  • Create and maintain response playbooks using tools such as JIRA, PagerDuty, ServiceNow, DataMiner, Datadog, and various in-house tools within the Fox Digital Video ecosystem.
  • Support the development and reporting of key operational metrics to identify and drive continuous improvements.
  • Assist the SRO team in creating and maintaining documentation, including operational runbooks.

job.description:
At Fox Tech, we stand as a beacon of innovation, crafting world-class, large-scale digital products that redefine the entertainment experience. We’re seeking visionary individuals to join our Digital Operations team to shape the future of streaming. Now is your chance to contribute to delivering extraordinary digital experiences across Sports, News, and Entertainment.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Fox Technology is looking for a Digital Operations Specialist to join our Digital Operations Team in Tempe, AZ. In this role, you will ensure production services are operated consistently and at scale—delivering a high-quality experience to millions of viewers across FOX Networks, Tubi, digital platforms, mobile apps, websites, linear networks, and 3rd-party partners such as Amazon, Hulu, and Apple.

You will collaborate closely with the SRO and Tier 1 Media Control Center (MCC) Operations teams to develop procedures, monitoring patterns, and troubleshooting strategies. NBCUniversal is one of the world's leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. job.title: 403(g) Technician
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

 

The Media Manager is responsible for ingesting all forms of media received from photographers, producers, and field crews into designated servers and project environments. This includes media delivered on memory cards, optical discs, hard drives, and other storage formats. Attention to detail is essential, as producers and editors rely on the Media Manager to organize, label, and ingest media accurately and consistently—often under tight deadlines and during breaking news coverage. The successful candidate must be highly organized, meticulous, and capable of maintaining accuracy in a fast-paced environment. Precise labeling and proper organization of all media assets are critical to ensuring proficient editorial workflows.

 

The ideal candidate should possess a working knowledge of professional camera systems and the various file formats and codecs they produce. Equipment and formats encountered regularly include:
Camera Systems

  • Sony FX9, FX6, FX3, X400, A7S, F5
  • All Sony Prosumer cameras
  • GoPro, Sony ZV-1 (POV Cams)

Media Formats / Codecs

  • QuickTime
  • H.264 (various implementations)
  • AVCHD
  • .MTS
  •  MXF
  • Additional professional broadcast file formats as required

 

Requirements:

  • Strong knowledge with broadcast routers and patch bays. This role requires daily operation of routing systems and occasional use of patch bays. The successful candidate must be comfortable routing signals, downlinking feeds, and utilizing in-house routing and satellite tuning systems.
  • Working knowledge of Avid Interplay and Avid Media Composer (including NewsCutter). Candidates should be comfortable creating pitch reels, assembling b-roll packages, organizing media within Interplay, importing assets into projects, and editing material on a timeline.
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with producers, editors, and production teams.
  • The Media Manager must be able to manage multiple assignments simultaneously, prioritize competing deadlines, and respond effectively to the demands of live and breaking news production across broadcasts such as CBS Evening News, CBS Mornings, CBS Sunday Morning, and other network programming.
  • Comfortable operating professional audio equipment, including audio mixers, and properly wiring microphones for talent and guests during interviews, live shots, and studio productions.
  • The role also requires the ability to run and connect audio and video cabling between equipment, wall panels, and patch points while maintaining established engineering and production standards.
  • Ability to work efficiently in a high-pressure, deadline-driven newsroom while maintaining exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.

 

Union Requirement:

  • This position is represented by the International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers (IBEW). The selected candidate must meet all applicable IBEW membership requirements and will be required to join the union as a condition of employment.


CBS News and Stations, brings together the power of CBS News, 28 owned television stations in 17 major U.S. markets, the CBS News Streaming Network, CBS News Streaming local platforms, local websites and cbsnews.com, under one umbrella. CBS News and Stations is home to the nation’s #1 news program 60 MINUTES, the CBS News Streaming Network, the first 24/7 digital streaming news network, the award-winning broadcasts CBS MORNINGS, CBS SATURDAY MORNING, the CBS EVENING NEWS, CBS SUNDAY MORNING, CBS WEEKEND EVENING NEWS, 48 HOURS and FACE THE NATION WITH MARGARET BRENNAN. CBS News and Stations provides news and information for the CBS Television Network,  CBSNews.com, CBS News Radio and podcasts, Paramount +, all digital platforms, and the CBS News Streaming Network, the premier 24/7 anchored streaming news service that is available free to everyone with access to the internet. The CBS News Streaming Network is the destination for breaking news, live events, original reporting and storytelling, and programs from CBS News and Stations’ top anchors and correspondents working locally, nationally and around the globe. CBS News’ streaming services, across national and local, amassed more than 1.01 billion streams in 2021. Launched in November 2014 as CBSN, the CBS News Streaming Network is available on 30 digital platforms and apps, as well as CBSNews.com and Paramount+. The service is available live in 91 countries. CBS News and Stations is dedicated to providing the highest quality journalism under standards it pioneered and continues to set in today’s digital age. CBS News earns more prestigious journalism awards than any other broadcast news division.  

 

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

Starting pay for the successful applicant depends on a variety of job-related factors, including but not limited to geographic location, market demands, experience, training, and education.  The benefits available for this position include medical, dental, vision, 401(k) plan, life insurance coverage, disability benefits, tuition assistance program and PTO or, if applicable,  as otherwise dictated by the appropriate Collective Bargaining Agreement.

job.title: Account Executive
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven technology or digital media sales account executive to join our team. This role is responsible for driving revenue growth through the sale of digital and television media solutions, including streaming and broadcast television, digital advertising, and content partnerships. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in digital sales, business development with a deep understanding of media and marketing trends, and the ability to build and maintain strong client relationships. This role requires a strategic approach to identifying opportunities, pitching solutions, and delivering measurable results for clients.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Sales & Revenue Generation: Drive sales by identifying and securing new business opportunities across multiple digital channels, including streaming, online video and display, and content marketing solutions.
  • Client Relationship Management: Develop and nurture long-term relationships with clients, ensuring their marketing needs are met and identifying areas for upselling and cross-selling additional services.
  • Consultative Selling: Provide consultative solutions to clients by understanding their business goals, analyzing market trends, and recommending tailored marketing strategies that drive results.
  • Market Research & Lead Generation: Research industry trends and competitor offerings to develop a robust pipeline of prospective clients and stay ahead of market shifts.
  • Proposal Development & Pitching: Craft compelling sales presentations and proposals that showcase the value of our media offerings, using data and insights to communicate potential ROI.
  • Campaign Management & Optimization: Collaborate with internal teams to ensure successful campaign execution, monitoring performance, and optimizing for maximum effectiveness and client satisfaction.
  • Reporting & Analytics: Regularly review and report on sales targets, campaign performance, and key metrics to clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the account management, and product teams to align on campaign strategies, creative assets, and ad placements that meet clients’ needs.
  • Performance Management: Strategically use CRM and prospecting tools to manage and achieve quotas as it pertains to activity metrics and revenue goals.

Qualifications:

  • 3+ years of experience in digital media sales, advertising, or a related industry
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets in a competitive environment
  • Strong understanding of digital marketing channels and industry trends, including programmatic, streaming media, display, video, social, and content marketing
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills
  • Ability to interpret data and analytics to provide actionable insights
  • Self-motivated, with a passion for sales and digital media
  • Proficient in CRM software and Microsoft Office Suite; familiarity with ad management tools a plus
  • Must possess and maintain a valid driver’s license and be able to travel locally to meet with clients and business partners as needed.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience in working with business owners and/or agency clients
  • Knowledge of streaming and digital media
  • Familiarity with tools like Google Analytics, DSPs, and SSPs.

Why Join Us? We offer a collaborative, high-energy environment where your contributions make an immediate impact. Join a forward-thinking team and drive the future of media sales with access to cutting-edge tools and resources.

Job Type: Full-Time
Location: Onsite
Salary: Competitive base + commission

 

#LI-NS1

 

#LI-NS1

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year. 

* Some jobs are covered by a collective bargaining agreement and thus some or all of the benefits described herein may not apply. For example, some newsroom bargaining unit employees receive health and retirement benefits under plans administered by the union.

EEO statement:

TEGNA Inc. is a proud equal opportunity employer. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring and developing individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences to add to our collaborative culture. We value and consider applications from all qualified candidates without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, age, marital status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, family responsibilities, disability, medical condition, enrollment in college or vocational school, political affiliation, military or veteran status, citizenship status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. TEGNA will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. If you are in need of an accommodation in order to submit your application, please email askhr@tegna.com 

Recruiting Fraud Alert:

To all candidates: your personal information and online safety are important to us. Only TEGNA Recruiters or Hiring Managers will reach out to you regarding consideration of your application or background.  Communications with TEGNA employees will either come from a TEGNA email address with a domain of tegna.com or one of our affiliate station domains.  

Recruiters or Hiring Managers will never request payments, ask for financial account information or sensitive information such as social security numbers.

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

WBIR-TV Kn TEGNA's NBC affiliate, is looking for a creative Multi-Market Digital Sales Manager (MMDSM) to join a top-performing sales team. You will be responsible for growing digital revenue with core and new business. As the Multi-Market Digital Sales Manager, you will manage and develop the digital sales skills and knowledge of the Account Executives and Account Managers and build strategies to win over clients within their markets. You also oversee performance and hold your team accountable for the achievement of their individual digital goals to achieve the collective objectives.   

This position reports to the Director of Sales

Current driver's license and ability to operate news gathering vehicle to and from various locations is required.

Responsibilities:

  • Create, develop, and own strategies for generating and achieving digital revenue goals for the market.   
  • Recruit, retain, and effectively train top-performing sales and support talent on how to sell TEGNA’s large portfolio of digital products.  
  • Lead and develop a team of direct reports consisting of an Account Executive, an Account Manager, and manage dotted line reports.  
  • Supports sales staff with ride-along coaching, participating in client meetings, developing proposals, and acting as the subject matter expert on digital solutions.   
  • Identify market potential through lead generation and qualification.  
  • Analyze each account to create and maximize ideal marketing executions for clients, and complete appropriate business activity reports and forecasts as required.  
  • Develop strong relationships with local clients, manage key local accounts with your team and ensure top-shelf service is provided to all accounts.  
  • Review and adjust metrics to monitor sales/market share changes.  

Requirements: 

  • 5-7 years of successful digital sales and account engagement experience with 2 years of team management experience.   
  • Track record of successfully achieving or exceeding sales goals in digital media advertising industry, including OTT, within fast-changing, dynamic environments.    
  • Established leadership skills and demonstrated ability to develop teams with elite sales and customer service skills.   
  • Strategic thinker and disciplined executor comfortable developing and making recommendations to senior management.  
  • Strong presenter and communicator with internal and external customers and partners.   
  • Possess the ability to build an inclusive and positive work culture to foster success for the sales team.   
  • Proficiency with MS Office, Google Analytics, Wide Orbit Sales, Salesforce, Wide Orbit Traffic & Wide Orbit Analytics, ComScore, Matrix, Media Monitors, Tableau, and qualitative data. 
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks and projects effectively under deadline pressure, and able to promptly adapt to changing priorities and goals.  
  • Ability to effectively solve problems.  
  • Travel up to 10% 

The position is bonus-eligible, subject to the terms of the respective plan.

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

KFMB-TV San Diego, the TEGNA-owned CBS affiliate in San Diego, is seeking a proven, results-driven Account Executive to grow new business and manage a book of advertising clients across one of the strongest cross-screen portfolios in the market. This is a seat for a closer who can walk into a business owner's office or an agency pitch, uncover what's really driving their marketing decisions, and build the multi-platform solution that wins the budget.

job.title: Vice President, Enterprise Data Governance and Strategy
job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

How You’ll Lead:

The Vice President, Data Governance & Strategy is a senior executive leader responsible for defining and operationalizing a comprehensive enterprise data governance and data strategy across UMG. This role ensures that critical data assets—spanning music rights, royalties, digital consumption, fan engagement, e-commerce and merchandise (online and on-tour), physical products, and artist development—are accurate, trusted, compliant, and strategically leveraged.

Operating at the intersection of business strategy, technology, privacy, and partnerships, the VP champions a data-driven culture and enables scalable, compliant data usage that fuels monetization, fan growth, and innovation in a rapidly evolving global music ecosystem.

How You’ll Create:

Strategic Leadership

  • Define and drive the enterprise data strategy to support business growth, monetization of music assets, and fan engagement.

  • Identify and assess new fan data sources and partnership opportunities aligned with the enterprise data strategy, accounting for label and regional differences.

  • Align data initiatives with music industry trends, business priorities, and evolving digital platforms, including streaming, social platforms, AI-enabled services, and emerging distribution models.

  • Partner with C-level executives and senior leaders across Legal, Finance, Marketing, Commercial, HR, and Technology to integrate data insights into strategic and operational decision-making.

  • Serve as a trusted executive advisor on data value, risk, and opportunity across the organization.

Data Governance

  • Develop and implement a robust, scalable data governance framework covering:

    • Fan, CRM, and e-commerce data

    • Digital consumption and DSP reporting

    • Artist, repertoire, and product metadata

    • Financial, royalty, and rights data

  • Establish clear data ownership, stewardship, quality standards, and accountability models across business units and regions.

  • Standardize data definitions and identifiers (e.g., ISRC, ISWC, IPI) to ensure consistency, transparency, and auditability across systems and partners.

  • Ensure compliance with global music rights regulations, licensing requirements, and data privacy laws (e.g., GDPR, CCPA), in close partnership with Legal, Privacy, and Security teams.

Collaboration & Enablement

  • Work cross-functionally with legal, operations, analytics, product, and technology teams to operationalize governance standards through platforms, processes, and workflows.

  • Promote data literacy, stewardship, and accountability across departments and business units.

  • Lead organizational change to position data as a managed enterprise asset, enabling trusted insights and scalable innovation.

Technology, Innovation & Future-Readiness

  • Evaluate, select, and deploy enterprise data governance and cataloging technologies supporting discovery, classification, lineage, quality monitoring, and access controls.

  • Drive automation and scalability in data ingestion, normalization, and reconciliation from digital platforms such as Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, TikTok, and emerging channels.

AI Readiness, Responsible AI & Privacy by Design

  • Facilitate in establishing AI-ready data foundations, ensuring data used for advanced analytics, machine learning, and generative AI is accurate, well-governed, traceable, and ethically sourced.

  • Partner with Legal, Privacy, Security, and Technology teams to define and operationalize AI governance frameworks, including controls for data usage, consent, provenance, bias mitigation, explainability, and auditability.

  • Embed privacy-by-design and privacy-by-default principles into AI-enabled initiatives involving fan, artist, and partner data, ensuring compliance with global privacy regulations and contractual obligations.

  • Play an active role in defining policies and guardrails for the responsible use of generative AI across the music lifecycle, including metadata enrichment, rights identification, royalty processing, fan engagement, marketing optimization, and internal productivity tools.

  • Assess and mitigate risks related to AI-driven data sharing, automated decision-making, synthetic data, and data leakage, while enabling innovation that supports monetization, efficiency, and trust.

  • Stay informed on emerging technologies such as AI/ML, blockchain, smart contracts, NFTs, and next-generation rights management, and evaluate their implications for music data governance, licensing, and revenue models.

Bring your VIBE:

Experience & Expertise

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Data Science, Music Business, or a related field; Master’s degree or MBA preferred.

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in data governance, data strategy, information management, or digital rights management—preferably within music, media, or entertainment.

  • Deep understanding of music rights, publishing, royalties, and global distribution models.

  • Strong familiarity with industry standards and ecosystems, including DDEX, ISRC, ISWC, IPI, and global licensing organizations.

  • Hands-on experience with data governance, catalog, and rights/royalty platforms (e.g., Collibra, Informatica, SynchTank, Vistex, Revelator or similar).

Leadership & Influence

  • Proven ability to operate at the executive level, influencing across technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Track record of driving enterprise-wide data transformation and cultural change.

  • Exceptional communication, storytelling, and stakeholder-management skills.

Key Competencies

  • Visionary leadership at the intersection of data, music, and innovation

  • Strong grasp of digital music consumption, fan data, and data monetization models

  • Compliance-minded, detail-oriented, with a pragmatic business lens

  • Ability to align diverse teams and priorities in a complex, global organization

Perks Playlist:

Join an entrepreneurial, global organization where authenticity, boldness, creativity, connection, drive, and insight aren’t just values—they’re how we work every day. Here are some of the ways we support you along the way (and just a few of the benefits we offer):

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • Including 100% coverage for out-patient in-network mental health services

  • Fertility coverage for eligible medical plan participants

  • Wellbeing reimbursements for fitness classes, spa treatments, meal services, travel, and so much more (up to $720/year)

  • Student Loan Repayment Assistance and Tuition Reimbursement

  • 401(k) with 100% immediate vesting on the first 5% of your contributions, plus an additional UMG contribution

A variety of ways to prioritize much-needed time away from work including:

  • Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO) for exempt employees

  • 3-weeks PTO for non-exempt employees

  • 2-weeks paid Winter Break

  • 10 Company Holidays (including Juneteenth and Wellbeing Day)

  • Summer Fridays (between Memorial Day and Labor Day)

  • Generous paid parental leave for every type of parent

Check out our full overview of benefits on the Perks Playlist page of the career site.

job.title: Director, Digital Marketing
job.description:
At Warner Music Group, we’re a global collective of music makers and music lovers, tech innovators and inspired entrepreneurs, game-changing creatives and passionate team members. Here, we turn dreams into stardom and audiences into fans. We are guided by three core values that underpin everything we do across all our diverse businesses: 

  • Curiosity: We do our best work when we’re immersing ourselves in culture and breaking through barriers. Curiosity is the driving force behind creativity and ingenuity. It fuels innovation, and innovation is the key to our future. 

  • Collaboration: Making music and bringing it to the world is all about the power of originality amplified by teamwork. A great idea, like a great song, travels globally. We ignite passions and build connections across our diverse community of artists, songwriters, partners, and fans.

  • Commitment: We pursue excellence for our team and our talent. Everything in music starts with a leap into the unknown, and we’re committed to keeping the faith, acting with integrity, and delivering on our promises.

WMG is home to a wide range of artists, musicians, and songwriters that fuel our success. That is why we are committed to creating a work environment that actively values, appreciates, and respects everyone.  We encourage applications from people with a wide variety of backgrounds and experiences.

Consider a career at WMG and get the best of both worlds – an innovative global music company that retains the creative spirit of a nimble independent.
 

Job Title: Director, Digital Marketing 

 

A little bit about our team: 

The mission of the Warner Records Digital Marketing team is to drive fandom, music consumption, D2C purchases and social conversation/engagement using innovative digital marketing strategies. The team is responsible for all aspects of an artist’s digital presence including digital narrative development, digital advertising, social content ideation, influencer campaigns, digital advertising, CRM, social/digital partner activations, content seeding, websites, etc.  We work directly with the artists to translate the vision of their music into groundbreaking digital campaigns and provide in-depth creative consulting geared toward growing a highly engaged fanbase. 

 

Your role: 

The Director, Digital Marketing will oversee high level digital marketing campaigns at Warner Records. The position will be responsible for developing campaigns that create cultural conversation, build artist social followings and engagement, and drive music consumption. You will be a digital expert as well as know the leading industry standards for digital marketing music.  

 

Here you’ll get to: 

  • Oversee the development and execution of groundbreaking digital marketing campaigns and build growth strategies for both established and developing artists, leading to follower growth and consumption 
  • Monitor campaigns in real-time, making recommendations for continuous improvement. Create post-mortem analyses to quantify the impact of each campaign and measure effectiveness of each tactic 
  • Collaborate with internal teams including Commercial Revenue, Marketing, Brand Partnerships, Creative and Publicity, to build cohesive cross-platform campaigns 
  • Be responsible for the day-to-day social media strategy, website, and CRM strategies for a designated roster of artists and the Warner Records social accounts with a focus on driving fandom, engagement, and music consumption 
  • Use your expert-level knowledge of social platforms and social content strategies when partnering with artists and management to craft a social narrative and content strategy that elevates their brands and drives fandom, cultural conversation and music consumption 
  • Work with artist management and internal departments to develop and maintain an editorial calendar across all social platforms 
  • Partner with internal creatives and external creators to develop high-performing short-form content for Warner Records artists 
  • Partner with the VP of Paid Media Strategy, Operations and Audience Growth to develop and execute paid media campaigns and CRM strategy for each artist 
  • Work with our Insights team to profile our online audiences, building digital marketing strategies based on that demographic and psychographic data 
  • Build and maintain relationships with social media platform representatives and participate in regular update meetings 
  • Manage online marketing budget spend for each artist 

 

About you: 

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent 
  • Minimum of 6+ years professional experience in digital/social media marketing, direct to consumer marketing, and/or related fields preferably at a Record Label or music management company 
  • Outstanding organizational skills, verbal and written communication skills, and expertise in social media content strategy 
  • Innate ability to lead and mentor  
  • Passion for fan-focused digital strategies with a problem-solving attitude to see projects through completion 
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced, tight timeframe, and team-oriented environment 
  • Knowledge on  how to “move the needle” online, be it driving consumption, engagement, or growth 
  • Proven leadership experience in team discussions and client meetings 
  • Impeccable follow-up and follow-through 
  • A deep professional understanding of interactive technologies and communication tools, including: TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, Threads, Twitter, YouTube, Snapchat, Discord, Website strategy, Email/CRM strategy 

 

We’d love it if you also had: 

  • Photoshop, Illustrator, or other graphic design knowledge 
  • Experience using project management software such as Jira and Basecamp 
  • Understanding of social media analytics and posting tools such as Falcon and HootSuite 
  • Knowledge of web3, NFT’s and crypto currency marketing 
  • Record Label experience 
  • People management skills 


As the home to 10K Projects, Asylum, Atlantic Music Group, East West, FFRR, Fueled by Ramen, Nonesuch, Parlophone, Rhino, Roadrunner, Sire, Warner Records, Warner Classics, and several other of the world’s premier recording labels, Warner Music Group champions emerging artists and global superstars alike. And our renowned publishing company, Warner Chappell Music, represents genre-spanning songwriters and producers through a catalog of more than one million copyrights worldwide. Warner Music Group is also home to ADA, which supports the independent community, as well as artist services division WMX. In addition, WMG counts film and television storytelling powerhouse Warner Music Entertainment among its many brands.

Together, we are Warner Music Group: Independent Minds. Major Sound.

Love this job and want to apply?

Click the “Apply” link at the top of the page, or apply directly with your LinkedIn. Applying with LinkedIn will import all of the information you put in your profile, but will still allow you to upload a resume and cover letter.

 

Don’t be discouraged if you don’t hear from us right away. We’re taking our time to review all resumes, and to find the best people for WMG.

 

Thanks for your interest in working for WMG. We love it here, and think you will, too.
 

This position requires a minimum of 4 days per week in the office. We value in-office collaboration, which is essential for talent development and strong working relationships. #LI-Onsite Annual Rate: $105,000 to $120,000 Annually

job.title: Career-track Teaching Professor or Clinical Professor (Content Creation)
job.description:
Career-track Teaching Professor or Clinical Professor (Content Creation)

Description
The Walter Cronkite School of Journalism and Mass Communication at Arizona State University-one of the nation's premier professional mass communications programs-seeks a professor to teach and lead within the school's L.A. Content Studio and instruct courses related to media production and content creation.

Hosted in the ASU California Center in Downtown Los Angeles, the Content Studio is an immersive strategic content learning experience in which students activate their multimedia content creation skills to build their own content brands, and work with existing brands to expand their content footprints.

The L.A. Content Studio is one of the Cronkite School's signature professional immersive learning experiences, exemplifying its "teaching hospital" model of education through hands-on learning and faculty mentorship. In the Content Studio, students cultivate their media and audience development skills as independent content entrepreneurs, producing video, digital, social and immersive media content; measuring content performance; and optimizing content strategy. Students work to build (and often monetize) their own independent content brands through YouTube channels, TikTok accounts, Substack newsletters, brand partnerships and more. The program's faculty leader will nurture students' content creation skills, and develop their strategic approach, content measurement skills and audience development acumen.

The successful candidate is an experienced multimedia content creator of the highest caliber with an entrepreneurial spirit and a firm understanding of how to thrive in the creative economy. The candidate must be a creative problem solver who is comfortable in an energetic, dynamic, startup environment while demonstrating a commitment to innovation and collaboration.

As a member of the faculty, the professor will have teaching and service responsibilities within the Cronkite School. In this role, there are no research or creative activity responsibilities.

This is a full-time, benefits-eligible, 12-month appointment based in the ASU California Center in Downtown Los Angeles. It is not a tenure-track appointment. The salary range for this position is $110,000 to $120,000. The professor will hold the rank of assistant, associate or full teaching professor, or assistant, associate or full clinical professor. This is not a tenure-track position.

Essential Responsibilities



- • Teach lower-, upper- and graduate-division courses (four classes in the fall semester, and four in the spring semester)
- • Foster a culture of innovation by harnessing fresh ideas and experimenting with new tools, technologies and techniques that enhance strategic communication and client impact
- • Lead the L.A. Content Studio, an immersive incubator for video, digital and social content creators, and support undergraduate and graduate students in meeting the Content Studio course learning outcomes
- • Teach related courses for graduate and undergraduate learners (the equivalent of four courses each semester, including the Content Studio)
- • Guide students in goal-setting, content strategy and launch/growth for their own content brands, and ideate compelling content guided by those strategies
- • Supervise student content production from conception to completion, for content produced both in the field and in the ASU California Center's production studios, editing rooms and control room facilities.
- • Develop students' content measurement and analytics reporting capabilities, and lead optimization and monetization.
- • Develop and engage clients for the Content Studio across a variety of industries, and lead brand activation and strategy within the course.
- • Foster a learning culture that inspires students with relevant content, tools and techniques that enhance digital storytelling and audience connection.
- • Serve as a disciplinary thought leader, proactively staying abreast of new content creation and strategic communication techniques and technology updates; curating exemplars of superior research and professional work; and highlighting superb student work.
- • Collaborate with leadership, faculty and staff to assess, optimize and develop curriculum
- • Perform service both internally (e.g., committee assignments, student recruitment, thesis direction) and externally (e.g. professional workshops, contest judging, academic/industry leadership)
- • Perform other duties as assigned



About the ASU California Center

At ASU's flagship Los Angeles campus, students can access internships and learning

opportunities only available in a global city, and world-class faculty and innovative media projects only available at the Cronkite School. The California Center hosts the L.A. Content Studio, where students build their own content brands and produce content for existing brands; Cronkite News' L.A. Bureau, where journalism students create award-winning news and sports content; the MA in Narrative and Emerging Media, which develops storytellers specializing in AR, VR and emerging media techniques; and a growing portfolio of learning experiences.

The heart of ASU's California Center campus is the flagship Herald Examiner Building, located at 11th Street and Broadway. Commissioned by William Randolph Hearst and designed by architect Julia Morgan, the building has stood in downtown L.A. since 1914. For decades, the building housed the Hearst Corporation's Herald Examiner newspaper; now, it's home to the L.A. Content Studio, Cronkite News' L.A. Bureau, as well as video/audio editing bays, a broadcast studio, a 3D studio, classrooms, a two-story event space and more.

About the Cronkite School

The Cronkite School is widely recognized as the nation's premier mass communication school. Rooted in the time-honored values that characterize its namesake-accuracy, responsibility, integrity-the school fosters excellence and ethics among students as they master the professional skills required to succeed in the media world of today and tomorrow.

Based on ASU's Downtown Phoenix campus in the heart of the nation's fifth-largest city, the School is known for its hands-on "teaching hospital" approach to learning led by a faculty composed of Pulitzer Prize-winning professional journalists, strategic communication leaders and world-class media scholars. More than 2,500 undergraduate, master's and doctoral students regularly lead the country in national competitions as they prepare for careers in journalism, PR, marketing, strategic media and related communication fields.

About Arizona State University

Arizona State University, ranked the No. 1 "Most Innovative School" in the nation by U.S. News & World Report for 10 years in succession, has forged the model for a New American University. Repeatedly ranked No. 1, ASU has topped more than 20 lists in the last three years: No. 1 in the U.S. for global impact (Times Higher Education) and No. 1 in the U.S. for sustainable practices (Association for the Advancement of Sustainability in Higher Education). ASU is a comprehensive public research institution, measured not by whom it excludes, but by whom it includes and how they succeed; advancing research and discovery of public value; and assuming fundamental responsibility for the economic, social, cultural and overall health of the communities it serves. ASU operates on the principles that learning is a personal and original journey for each student; that they thrive on experience and that the process of discovery cannot be bound by traditional academic disciplines. Through innovation and a commitment to accessibility, ASU has drawn pioneering researchers to its faculty even as it expands opportunities for qualified students, attracting some of the highest-quality students from all 50 states and more than 130 nations.



Qualifications
Required Qualifications



- Candidates pursuing a clinical professor rank must have a master's degree at the time of appointment, and at least 7 years professional experience in strategic communication, or equivalent specialized experience.
