job.description:
Who we are

Semafor is a global news platform for an increasingly complex world in which consumers are overwhelmed by too many news sources and unsure what to trust. We are building Semafor to enable world-class journalists to deliver reporting and insights with rigor in journalistic forms that ensure a new level of transparency. Our editors and reporters distill the most important stories from all over in formats that uncover the forces shaping the stories, explain the interests behind polarizing narratives, and replenish the stock of shared facts. As a global platform, Semafor recognizes that smart people can disagree and that informed readers need to understand alternative points of view from competing centers of power and culture in a multi-polar world. Want to join us? Read on. 

About this Role

Semafor seeks recent college graduates with experience working in communications, on Capitol Hill, or within executive offices to support our flagship live journalism events in a temporary role to prepare our journalists, speakers, and attendees for participation at our flagship convening, Silicon Valley & The World. job.title: VP, Brand Marketing
job.description:
Who We Are

UnitedMasters is building a marketplace that connects artists, brands and fans - empowering artists to earn and grow. UnitedMasters has taken the bold step of building a music distribution service that, radically, puts artists first - disrupting the legacy music business by letting up-and-coming artists distribute their music directly to fans through streaming services while maintaining ownership of their master recording rights and up to 100% of royalties. Through the combination of UnitedMasters’ music distribution platform and its deep ties to brands, UnitedMasters enables independent artists and change-makers to grow and earn unlike any other platform.

The UnitedMasters team is made up of musicians, marketers, engineers, and storytellers with backgrounds from YouTube, SoundCloud, Pandora, Facebook, Uber, Dropbox, Complex, VICE, and more. We work hand in hand with the award-winning creative teams that forge those innovative partnerships at Translation (our in-house creative advertising agency).

We are looking for a VP, Marketing to join UnitedMasters!

This role is based in Brooklyn, New York with four days in-office and one day remote.

What You'll Do

Build and scale a social presence that moves at the speed of culture

  • Turn UnitedMasters' social channels into a defining advantage for the company, not a support function
  • Lead a culturally fluent, fandom-native social strategy attuned to the conversations, creators, and moments shaping music and pop culture in real time
  • Set UnitedMasters apart from category competitors: define a social presence and brand voice that legacy distributors can’t replicate, leveraging music, culture, and our deep artist relationships to build a moat that the rest of the category can’t cross.
  • Build the team, operating model, and content engine to ship at the speed culture moves
  • Partner with artist services and the music team to share artist wins consistently, turning our roster into our best storytellers

Set and execute the strategy

  • Create and execute a 360 marketing strategy to attract, retain, and engage both sides of our marketplace: artists and brands/licensors
  • Own the marketing budget across channels, hitting acquisition targets and brand-building goals while meeting CAC and marketing efficiency benchmarks
  • Develop product positioning and messaging grounded in user research, market insights, and a deep understanding of the platform

Own brand, PR, and paid marketing

  • Define and refine UnitedMasters' brand: how we present ourselves to artists, brands, and the broader culture, and find the right mix of brand and growth investment for our stage
  • Lead paid media strategy across digital, offline, and emerging channels, leveraging Translation's creative firepower as we scale
  • Own PR and communications strategy:  partner with internal and external PR resources to land earned media that amplifies our cultural moments, fuels artist and brand growth, and reinforces our differentiation in the category.
  • Partner with Brand Partnerships & Events to develop tentpole activations that showcase our artists, platform, and differentiation

Be a connective thread across the company

  • Serve as a thruline across product, engineering, data science, design, music, sales, and Translation, unifying our narrative and building efficient cross-functional processes
  • Define creative briefs and act as a key stakeholder in reviewing concepts and assets against our marketing objectives

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of marketing leadership with deep, demonstrable expertise in social media. You are a social-first marketing leader, not a generalist who happens to oversee social.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and scale social channels with cultural relevance and creative ambition
  • Experience growing consumer mobile, web, and/or enterprise-SaaS products, with clear results on business metrics and revenue growth
  • Experience managing both qualitative and quantitative customer research
  • Strong management experience leading cross-functional marketing teams; able to recruit, develop, and retain world-class talent
  • High intellectual horsepower, equally comfortable with spreadsheets and great creative
  • Extreme empathy and curiosity for our artist and brand customers
  • Startup, do-er mentality
  • Bonus:
    • Music, creator economy, or marketplace experience
    • International marketing experience
    • Experience working closely with an in-house or external creative agency

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Salary Hiring Range: $225,000 - $265,000

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. bonus, stock options, 401(k) match, etc.)

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.  We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors. 

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted.  If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for the NY/CA.  As a company, we have a location based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.

CBC Nunavut in Iqaluit delivers news and current affairs through our digital, radio and television platforms in both Inuktitut and English.

We are seeking a language specialist, assigned to Inuktitut. You will perform tasks associated with the preparation and on-air presentation of program material on television, radio and on-line.

  • Preparation of material for broadcast in Inuktitut.

  • Translate and present summaries of international news.
  • Prepare and edit Inuktitut/English “phoner boards” and other graphics for television.
  • Copy-edit written material for broadcast.
  • Carry out general presentation and voicing of station and weather breaks, announcements,  promotional and other on-air material.
  • Back up hosting or operating of CBC programs.
  • Participate in community relations activities to promote the CBC.
  • Carry out general presentation duties and the voicing of network cues, station breaks, time signals and commercial, promotional and other announcements.

We are looking for : 

  • Deep understanding of Inuit culture, history, language and cultural practices.
  • Excellent Inuktitut language skills, and good skills in English.

CBC News is designing new ways for Canadians to understand and navigate their finances, helping them make sense of a myriad of complex economic realities through expanded financial and consumer storytelling.

You play a critical role in identifying new audiences, and advising on the best strategies and tactics to reach them across CBC digital properties, FAST channels, CBC Gem, CBC linear channels, as well as on third-party platforms including Youtube and Tik Tok. You’re a collaborator, able to work with everyone from  front-line journalists and program leaders, to colleagues across CBC genres to optimize CBC’s best digital, social, and broadcast journalism into one easy-to-find audience experience.

  • Play a key role in planning and live event plans for major financial and money-related journalism. As required, verify user-generated content to ensure accuracy.
  • Coordinate work with business unit content teams currently based in Calgary and Toronto, as well as audio syndication, current affairs and podcasting to ensure a smooth workflow between platforms.
  • Aggregate, showcase and promote financial, business and consumer content from CBC News, CBC Entertainment and CBC Sports.
  • Use data and analytics to shape our headlines, thumbnails, and rollout plans.
  • Guide, coach and support colleagues on best-of-practices and through change as required, across local and network newsrooms.
  • Ensure that CBC journalistic standards are met and that our stories are fair, balanced, accurate, thoughtful, immediate and resonate with the communities we serve.

  • Substantial experience writing, editing, packaging and copy editing digital content in a compelling way. 
  • Some experience helping to launch or create new content initiatives. 
  • Experience with content management systems such as Moveable Type, Media Central, MPX/The Platform, including ability to edit, photoshop and publish within those platforms; and basic HTML/CSS
  • Advanced knowledge of social platforms, including YouTube, Tik Tok, Snapchat and WhatsApp, including their algorithms and community features. 
  • Proven ability to analyze performance metrics and audience data using  measurement tools such as Chartbeat, Adobe analytics, Google Analytics. 
  • Strong visualization skills, including experience in using graphics, charts and explainers to distill complex financial data into easily digestible and actionable content.

job.title: Major Gifts Officer-West Region
job.description:
Overview

Called to K-LOVE

 

Inspiring People to Move Closer to Jesus

 

At K-LOVE, every role is ministry.

 

We hire first for ministry alignment and a shared commitment to our faith, mission, vision, and values. We then seek talented professionals who can use their God-given gifts, skills, and experience to serve with excellence.

 

If you love Jesus and are called to be part of a ministry that places Christ at the center of everything we do, we invite you to explore this opportunity. If your heart aligns with our mission and you possess the knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for the role, please keep reading.

 

 

The Major Gifts Officer builds trusted, ministry-centered relationships with major gift donors and prospective partners, helping them connect their God-given passions with opportunities to advance K-LOVE’s mission. This role guides donors through meaningful engagement—identifying, cultivating, soliciting, stewarding, and closing  philanthropic gifts—while developing thoughtful strategies that deepen long-term partnership and transformational generosity.

 

In addition, a VALUES FIT is top priority. Do our values align with yours?  Mission, Beliefs & Values. If so, please read on.

 

Travel required. West Coast Region.

 

Here’s just some of what you will be doing daily…

 

  • Serve as the primary relationship steward for an assigned portfolio of major gift donors and prospective partners, fostering trust, prayerful engagement, and alignment with the ministry’s mission.
  • Develop and execute donor strategies that invite transformational philanthropy, including five-, six-, and seven-figure gifts and planned giving opportunities that advance K-LOVE ministries.
  • Plan, coordinate, and travel to regularly visit donors and prospective partners in person, cultivating meaningful relationships through face-to-face engagement that supports donor strategy, stewardship, solicitation, and long-term ministry partnership.
  • Guide donors through the full major gift cycle, including identification, qualification, cultivation, solicitation, closing, stewardship, recognition, and ongoing engagement.
  • Create individualized engagement plans that reflect each donor’s interests, values, giving history, and desire to make a lasting ministry impact.
  • Prepare and present compelling gift opportunities in a timely, donor-centered manner that honors the donor’s relationship with the ministry and invites generous partnership.
  • Provide thoughtful stewardship that keeps donors informed of ministry impact, celebrates their generosity, and encourages continued engagement in sharing the hope of Christ.
  • Collaborate with Donor Engagement, Program, and ministry teams to align donor interests with strategic initiatives, meaningful experiences, and opportunities for deeper partnership.
  • Participate in portfolio review and planning processes, maintaining accurate donor records, contact reports, stewardship notes, and next steps to support coordinated relationship management.
  • Represent the ministry at donor meetings, regional gatherings, national events, and other engagement opportunities that strengthen relationships and advance mission partnership.
  • Adhere to guidelines and administrative procedures including submitting expense reimbursements, invoices, and contact report.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

We are looking for a very specific skill set. If you can say yes to each of these requirements, then we want to meet you! 

 

  • Bachelors’ degree; or a combination of education/training with relevant experience required
  • Fundraising certification a plus.
  • A minimum of 5 years of donor development, major gift, planned giving, or transferable relationship-development experience, with demonstrated ability to cultivate, solicit, steward, and close significant philanthropic gifts.
  • Demonstrated ability to listen well, discern donor motivations, and translate donor passions into meaningful ministry partnership opportunities.
  • Strong understanding of major gift fundraising practices, planned giving concepts, donor strategy, stewardship, and ethical relationship management.
  • Ability to travel and attend events and donor meetings that may occur in the evenings and/or on weekends.Operate successfully with a high degree of autonomy
  • Experience using Microsoft Office Suite; and CRM experience in Salesforce is a plus.
  • Ability to think strategically, set priorities, define desired outcomes, and guide donor engagement plans from initial cultivation through long-term stewardship.
  • Excellent organization, follow-through, and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple donor relationships, strategies, and administrative responsibilities with care.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to build trusted relationships with individuals, families, foundations, corporations, and ministry partners.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to engage philanthropic leaders through authentic, gracious, mission-centered conversations.
  • Commitment to accuracy, transparency, confidentiality, accountability, and ethical fundraising in all donor communications, reporting, and internal collaboration.
  • Ability to mentor Team Members and help them grow spiritually and professionally, leading by example.

 

Why work for K-LOVE?

 

K-LOVE is a nonprofit, multi-platform media company on a mission to draw people closer to Christ. Founded in 1982 in Santa Rosa, CA, with a singular radio station, K-LOVE today owns and operates the nation's two largest Christian music radio networks (K-LOVE and Air1) with over 1,000 broadcast signals across all 50 states, streaming audio reaching around the world, and a growing family of media ministries including podcasts, books, films, concerts, and events. K-LOVE employs nearly 500 team members in Franklin, TN, Rocklin, CA, and field locations around the country. You can view our mission and values here Mission, Beliefs & Values. 

 

What can we offer you?

  • Industry leading Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
  • Short/long term disability and life insurance
  • Robust 401K with company match
  • Parental leave with Baby Bonding pay
  • Generous PTO, holiday and sick pay
  • Unique company culture that includes exclusive access to concerts, movie premieres, media industry events, and more
  • Leadership and Career Development Programs 

 

“As an Equal Opportunity Employer, K-LOVE makes employment decisions based on merit and other legitimate reasons. The Company is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment and equal employment opportunities regardless of protected class, characteristic or status. However, K-LOVE is a religious non-profit organization where all team members contribute to the Company’s mission of encouraging our audiences “to have a meaningful relationship with Christ.” Therefore, pursuant to the Civil Rights Act of 1964, Section 702 (42 U.S.C. 2000e I(a)), K-LOVE has the right to hire only candidates who agree with the Company’s Statement of Faith, Mission, Vision, and Values. Also, as a religious non-profit organization, the Company is not governed by the CA Fair Employment and Housing Act.”

job.title: Donor Advisor II
job.description:
Description

Hope Media Group is a multi-brand ministry. Every story we share, every event we host, and every song we play is done to engage people to love Jesus, serve others, and spread Hope. Hope Media Group the home of KSBJ, WayFM, Worship 24/7, Vida Unida, NGEN radio. Way Loud, Way New, Way Back, Gospel 24/7, God Listens Prayer App and Hope Events. We invite you to apply and become a part of our growing ministry to Love Jesus, Serve Others, and Spread Hope. Our team describes our environment as fun, encouraging, collaborative, engaging, caring, family-oriented, and friendly. We would love for you to join us and be part of what God is doing in our ministry!  


Job Summary

The Donor Advisor II cultivates a portfolio of about 150 - 200 donors with major gift capacity for all Hope Media Group brands. The Donor Advisor II plans and implements Individual Development Plans (IDPs) with each portfolio donor. IDPs include matching donors’ passions and interests with brands, projects, and initiatives at Hope Media Group. They will support donor communications and impact reporting; gift solicitations with individual donors, foundations, and corporations – all while nurturing a life of generosity in each donor. The Donor Advisor II is attentive to donor’s spiritual needs. The Donor Advisor II prays with donors as needed.


Essential Functions

Portfolio Stewardship:

  • Engages, shepherds, and solicits a portfolio of qualified major donors in support of all Hope Media Group brands and programs
  • Creates annual Individual Development Plans to cultivate portfolio donors and integrating moves management strategies to upgrade gifts and eventually motivate transformational giving
  • Builds and stewards relationships with portfolio donors
  • Identifies, cultivates and solicits prospective planned giving and endowment donors
  • Creates, maintains, and updates complete donor data in CRM 
  • Engages with donors with in person visits, phone calls, handwritten notes, personal emails, and texts to identify specific donor HMG brand interest(s) and to build connection to other HMG brands
  • Promptly and professionally responds to and resolves donor requests and inquiries 
  • Provides ongoing spiritual care to portfolio, including praying with donors on phone calls and in-person as appropriate
  • Works with Chief of Donor Engagement, Senior Vice President of Donor Engagement and leadership team members to coordinate meetings with major donors
  • Seeks and creates opportunities to deepen donor experiences with Hope Media Group brands
  • Inspires donors during experiences such as tours of Hope Media Group campus and studios
  • Attends events such as breakfasts, galas, sports competitions, rodeos, vision trips, and pre-concert dinners to engage with donors as needed (requires early mornings, some evenings and some weekends.)

Demonstrated Faith 

  • Committed to a personal relationship with Jesus Christ
  • Grounded spiritually and biblically literate
  • Comfortable praying for co-workers in team meetings, leading spoken prayer, and participating in ministry prayer meetings and Bible studies
  • Live Christian principles defined by the ministry’s Statement of Faith & Biblical Beliefs
  • Participate in on-air fundraisers and prays for donors as needed
  • Passion for leveraging the HMG’s media platforms for evangelism and discipleship
  • Exhibit a strong moral character
  • Active member of a Bible believing local church


Non-Essential Functions:

  • Other responsibilities as assigned to support the mission of HMG


Requirements

Education:

  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred, but not required if has customer service experience

Experience :

  • Minimum of 3-5 years of experience in development/fundraising for non-profit organizations
  • Demonstrated success in securing major gifts
  • Knowledge of local or regional environments a plus but not required

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Demonstrated understanding of the major gift fundraising process, principles, methods, and practices including prospect research; and the ability to develop successful donor relationships through cultivation and stewardship
  • Demonstrated experience in developing and executing strategy
  • Prioritizes and task-switches with a fluctuating workload and competing priorities
  • Organizes and manages time with frequent interruptions
  • Attention to detail regarding writing, data entry and numerical accuracy, with a focus on data integrity 
  • Listens and quickly picks up on verbal/tonal cues
  • Clearly communicates both verbally and in writing with constituents and corporate partners by telephone, letter, e-mail, and in person
  • Takes initiative, works independently, and collaborates with team members
  • Shows initiative and consistently hungers for continuous improvement
  • Discerns and elicits the interests and concerns of others, meeting needs and discovering ways to improve engagement with donors
  • Natural ability to quickly build rapport and trust with ministry stakeholders
  • Able to process analytically and think strategically regarding managing a portfolio of donors and upgrading gifts.
  • Skilled at positioning a funding offer and making the ask 
  • Demonstrates strong moral, ethical and relational skills
  • Desires and shows willingness to pray for others
  • Sound understanding of the theology of fundraising and fundraising ethics
  • Bilingual in English/Spanish a plus 
  • Proficiency using Microsoft Word, Excel & Teams. Ability to be trained on CRM 

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • None

Working Conditions and Environment

Travel:

  • Travel as needed


Nights/Weekends/Holidays:

  • Occasional participant at donor events, concerts, and experiences. 
  • Occasional participant at conferences or retreats.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. The worker is required to have strong visual acuity.

Full-Time Benefits Offerings:

  • Medical
  • Dental

  • Health Savings Account w/employer contribution
  • Flexible Savings Accounts

  • Three (3) Paid Mission Days
  • Twelve (12) Company-Paid Holidays

  • Group Life Insurance
  • Legal Shield/Identity Theft Protection
  • Access to Marketplace Ministry Chaplains

job.description:
Description

Job Summary

  • The Senior Accountant serves as a member of the Accounting Department and will report directly to the Controller. The Senior Accountant is responsible for preparation and accuracy of the financial statements, performing analysis of financial results, providing explanation of variances and ensuring compliance with internal policies and generally accepted accounting principles and all other applicable accounting standards for HMG.

Essential Functions

Accounting:

  • Prepare, maintain, and reconcile accounting records, financial statements, and financial reports
  • Reconcile balance sheet accounts
  • Perform various activities to support the month-end close process
  • Prepare and verify journal entries to the general ledger
  • Assist with annual audit and budgeting process
  • Support Financial, Planning & Analysis team with determining financial details and drivers of reporting results
  • Make monthly expense accrual entries and ensure the accuracy of expense coding and reporting
  • Adhere to internal controls, policies and procedures for financial management; and oversight for the organizations
  • Record and report on capital expenditure, project and fixed assets accounting and financial implications 
  • Maintain financial elements of the fixed asset sub-ledger (including additions and disposals)
  • Record and ensure accuracy of monthly capitalization and depreciation entries and roll forward schedules
  • Any other duties as assigned

Financial:

  • Study financial trends to identify potential impact to the organization and identify drivers, root causes of results to share with management in monthly close reporting 
  • Assist with monthly financial reports by drafting comments and collecting, analyzing and summarizing financial data and trends
  • Advise budget managers on their functional and brand results to assist them in understanding, managing, forecasting and budgeting their departmental expenses
  • Support ROI evaluations
  • Any other duties as assigned

  • You'll have the opportunity for uncapped commission, and the ability to grow business across all categories on a local, regional, and national level no matter where you live

  • A 7-week onboarding program to immerse you in the suite of tools and products available to you 

  • The potential to be recognized in our annual iHeartMedia CEO’s Club and iHeartMedia President’s Club programs 

  • Access to competitive benefits including paid vacation and sick time, paid company holidays, a Spirit day to encourage the opportunity to more easily volunteer in their communities, company-paid mental health and financial education resources, 401(k) matching, learning and development resources, and career navigation support.

  • Access to additional perks include pet (they’re part of the family!), disaster, and legal insurance, student loan refinancing, and discounts on merchandise, tickets to events, and more.

  • The support of fellow team members invested in your success.

Envision your first 30 days  

  • Week 1: Complete our onboarding journey for a deep understanding of our company, job-specific trainings and spend time with your team. 

  • Week 2: Spend more time with your manager to ensure you are aligned on work and communication styles, priorities, and any other expectations. 

  • Week 3: Start “owning” your role and leaning into the real day-to-day, of course with your manager’s support and advocacy! 

  • Week 4: Prioritize a 30-day check-in to see what else you might need to be most successful in your new role.

  • Individual accountability and understanding of when to seek guidance
  • Skills managing assigned projects to completion
  • Understanding to resolve problems using established guidelines and professional judgement
  • Ability to communicate information about iHeart products in a digestible manner and to apply active listening skills to validate understanding of customer needs

The successful candidate will play a pivotal role with senior management, hiring managers, compensation, finance, and HR Business Partners in driving hiring and employee retention efficiencies that support the NFL's vision, mission, and values. 

Please note this role is in-person/office five days a week based in Mount Laurel, NJ. Up to seven months of anticipated engagement (subject to change based on business needs).

Responsibilities 

  • Manage 40 to 50+ open seasonal requisitions at once across multiple departments and locations during peak hiring periods 
  • Execute full-cycle, high volume recruitment including screening, interviewing, and extending offers 
  • Support Early Career recruitment efforts during non-peak seasonal hiring times 
  • Build strong working relationships with HR and hiring managers to understand business needs, seasonal headcount planning, and job requirements 
  • Identify, and recruit candidates for a wide range of temporary roles across media, production, and game operations 
  • Maintain accurate and organized data in the applicant tracking system (Greenhouse) for all candidates and requisitions 
  • Create and deliver regular search status updates to hiring managers and partners 
  • Ensure equitable hiring processes in line with NFL standards and policies 
  • Build and maintain talent pipelines to support recurring seasonal staffing needs 
  • Represent the NFL at in person or virtual hiring events, job fairs, and recruiting programs as needed 
  • Manage offer processes including recommendations, drafting and extending offers, and negotiations as permitted 
  • Ensure onboarding requirements are completed, including background checks, offer letters, new hire paperwork, and start date coordination 
  • Partner with HR teams to support smooth onboarding experiences 
  • Ensure compliance with EEO, ADA, and all applicable federal and state employment laws 

Required Qualifications 

  • Bachelor’s degree with 4+ years of high‑volume recruitment experience, or an equivalent combination of education and experience 
  • Demonstrated ability to efficiently manage 40 to 50+ high‑volume requisitions simultaneously 
  • Experience working with various recruitment platforms including, but not limited to Greenhouse, LinkedIn, and HireVue. 
  • Strong working knowledge of federal and state employment law as well as corporate recruitment processes 
  • Superior candidate management experience 
  • Excellent project management skills  

Other Key Attributes / Characteristics 

  • Ability to work in a fast-paced environment 
  • Experience supporting large‑scale, fast‑turnaround staffing initiatives 
  • Strong business acumen and the ability to quickly learn operational needs across multiple departments 
  • Ability to work both collaboratively and independently with minimal supervision 
  • Detail‑oriented with the ability to manage competing priorities and tight deadlines 
  • Consistent follow‑through, strong initiative, and proactive problem‑solving skills 

Terms /Expected Hours of Work 

  • Up to seven months of anticipated engagement (subject to change based on business needs) 
  • NFL employees are required to work 40 hours per week and at times, this role may require overtime (time worked in excess of 40 hours) and/or weekends.  
  • FLSA non-exempt  
  • Please note that this job posting is for a position with one of the NFL’s third-party agency partners that provides services to the NFL.

job.title: Meteorologist, KGUN
job.description:
At KGUN 9, we know weather is more than a forecast. It helps our viewers plan their days, stay safe during severe conditions, and stay connected to the community they call home. As our Morning Meteorologist, you'll be a trusted voice delivering accurate, engaging, and impactful weather coverage across multiple platforms. You'll analyze data from advanced weather technology, provide critical updates when conditions change, and help viewers understand the stories behind the forecast. This is an exciting opportunity to join a collaborative newsroom committed to serving Southern Arizona with urgency, accuracy, and innovation.



WHAT YOU'LL DO:


  • Analyze weather data from radar, satellite, and other forecasting tools to create accurate forecasts and weather stories.
  • Prepare and deliver compelling daily weathercasts for morning newscasts.
  • Provide urgent weather updates and breaking weather coverage when severe conditions impact the community.
  • Create and present weather content across television, digital, radio, and social media platforms.
  • Evaluate weather developments and identify story opportunities that impact local audiences.
  • Report live from the field, community events, and weather-related locations as needed.
  • Produce weather graphics and visual presentations using modern weather technology and newsroom systems.
  • Write and produce weather and news content for multiple platforms under daily deadlines.
  • Collaborate with photographers, producers, reporters, and newsroom leadership to deliver comprehensive coverage.
  • Research, gather, and verify information through interviews, observation, and data analysis to create informative weather storytelling.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:


  • Bachelor's degree in Meteorology preferred.
  • Generally 3+ years of meteorology, weather broadcasting, or related experience preferred.
  • Valid driver's license, good driving record, and ability to provide proof of insurance meeting company-required limits are required for this driving role.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:


  • Strong understanding of meteorology, forecasting principles, and weather presentation techniques.
  • Proficiency with weather systems, newsroom technology, and computer-based forecasting tools.
  • Knowledge of broadcast-quality camera equipment and field reporting workflows.
  • Experience with video editing systems and digital content production.
  • Strong broadcast writing skills and knowledge of AP Style.
  • Ability to create and publish engaging content across websites, social media, and digital platforms.
  • Excellent communication and on-air presentation skills.
  • Strong news judgment and storytelling ability.
  • Self-motivation and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and breaking-weather situations simultaneously.

OUR TEAM:


At KGUN 9, you'll join a passionate team of journalists, storytellers, and weather professionals who are dedicated to serving Southern Arizona. We value collaboration, curiosity, creativity, and community connection. Our newsroom brings together people with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, creating an environment where great ideas thrive and meaningful local journalism makes a difference every day.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:


Tucson offers a unique blend of desert beauty, vibrant culture, and outdoor adventure. Surrounded by stunning mountain ranges and blessed with more than 300 days of sunshine each year, the region provides endless opportunities for hiking, cycling, golf, and exploring the outdoors.


You'll also enjoy Tucson's rich culinary scene, thriving arts community, historic neighborhoods, and welcoming atmosphere. From breathtaking sunsets in the Sonoran Desert to world-class festivals and cultural attractions, Tucson is a place where both career and lifestyle can flourish.

job.title: Senior Manager, Media & Technical Operations
job.description:
Drive Auto is seeking a collaborative, hands-on Senior Manager, Media & Technical Operations to lead the teams responsible for paid-media execution and technical support. This role is ideal for an experienced digital advertising leader who combines deep paid media expertise with strong operational judgment, people leadership, and a commitment to high-quality client delivery.

The Senior Manager will lead the Drive Auto Media and Tech Support Managers, providing direction, coaching, and accountability across both teams. This person will ensure campaigns and technical work are delivered accurately and efficiently; maintain strong support and service standards; and keep the organization prepared for changes across advertising platforms and emerging channels.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and coach the Drive Auto Media and Tech Support teams, fostering a collaborative, accountable, and high-performing culture.

  • Oversee the Drive Auto Media team’s execution of paid campaigns, including campaign builds, optimization practices, quality standards, testing, and performance analysis.

  • Provide subject matter expertise and leadership across Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, and other platforms, including emerging advertising platforms, ensuring teams remain current on meaningful platform changes, new capabilities, and evolving best practices.

  • Evaluate the operational impact of platform updates and new advertising products; determine when the team should test, adopt, document, or train on new capabilities.

  • Oversee the Tech Support team’s work across platform configuration, technical setup, QA, implementations, migrations, troubleshooting, projects, and escalations.

  • Monitor and improve service-level expectations, customer service, workflow consistency, and operational processes across the Tech Support function.

  • Partner closely with the Drive Auto Onboarding, Customer Support, and Account Management teams to deliver media campaigns, issue resolution, and platform deliverables on time and with accuracy.

  • Confidently represent Drive Auto in client-facing conversations, presenting recommendations clearly, making decisive calls when needed, and guiding stakeholders toward the solution that best serves the client and the business.

  • Collaborate with Sales, leadership, and other internal teams to align on operational needs, resolve escalations, and support a strong client experience.

  • Mentor and develop team members through regular feedback, coaching, recognition, and training opportunities.

  • Lead by example through professionalism, adaptability, sound judgment, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in digital advertising, paid media, automotive marketing, or automotive technology

  • 2+ years of experience leading and developing a team

  • Hands-on experience building and optimizing paid search and paid social campaigns

  • Deep working knowledge of Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager; experience with TikTok and other digital advertising platforms 

  • Experience overseeing campaign execution, optimization, QA, and performance analysis

  • Experience with technical support, platform implementation, configuration, migrations, troubleshooting, ticket workflows, and client escalations

  • Strong understanding of digital advertising platform changes, industry trends, and the ability to translate them into practical guidance for operational teams

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify operational issues and implement effective improvements

  • Demonstrated ability to balance established standards with thoughtful flexibility, using sound judgment to make client and business appropriate decisions

  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and leadership skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams and levels of the organization

 

This position will report into the Lafayette, LA office on a hybrid schedule. Drive Auto is a data-driven marketing and technology company helping automotive dealerships reach in-market shoppers and achieve measurable growth. Our collaborative team combines proprietary data, innovative technology, and digital marketing expertise to shape the future of automotive advertising.

job.title: Principal Program Manager
job.description:
Principal Program Manager

Strategic Programs and AI-Enabled Operations

Location: Seattle, WA — Hybrid, with two days per week in the office
Job Type: Full-time
Team: Sinclair Digital — Program Management
Reports to: Director, Program Management

The Opportunity

Sinclair Digital is seeking a highly experienced Principal Program Manager to lead complex, high-impact initiatives across digital product, technology, and business teams. Programs may include new product or business launches, platform initiatives, operational changes, and complex or first-of-kind station transitions that require an experienced, accountable program owner.

This role combines two closely connected mandates: leading ambiguous, enterprise-scale programs and strengthening the program-management practices and AI-enabled tools that help those programs succeed. An early priority will be improving planning, governance, visibility, decision tracking, and follow-through. As that foundation matures, the role will continue to lead major program delivery while applying lessons from real programs to improve how teams plan and execute work across Sinclair Digital.

This is not a status-reporting role. The right person creates clarity where the path is still forming, brings strong business-analysis and systems-thinking skills, and introduces practical structure that improves outcomes without slowing teams down. They will create leverage beyond their own programs through reusable approaches, coaching, and scalable improvements to how work is planned and delivered.

What You Will Do

Lead major programs

  • Independently lead ambiguous, high-impact initiatives across Product, Engineering, Data, Support, station teams, and other business stakeholders.
  • Translate strategic goals into clear outcomes, decision points, milestones, owners, dependencies, success measures, and integrated delivery plans.
  • Frame choices, surface tradeoffs, and bring leaders clear recommendations so decisions are made at the right time.
  • Identify and manage program risks and cross-team dependencies early, with practical mitigation and escalation plans.
  • Drive programs through launch readiness, adoption, and operational handoff with clear ownership and follow-through.
  • Provide decision-ready visibility for working teams and senior leaders without creating unnecessary reporting overhead.

 

Improve program-management practices and tools

  • Shape a more connected, AI-enabled approach to program planning and visibility by bringing roadmaps, milestones, risks, decisions, and follow-up into clearer workflows while reducing duplicated reporting.
  • Turn lessons from complex programs into reusable practices that improve execution across multiple teams.
  • Partner with the Director of Program Management and leaders across Product, Engineering, and the business to turn agreed improvements into working practices, workflows, tools, and automation.
  • Evaluate and improve the program-management tool ecosystem by connecting and extending existing platforms and introducing new capabilities where they add clear value.
  • Define, prototype, or implement AI-assisted workflows that synthesize updates, identify missing information, surface risks and dependencies, monitor follow-ups, and prepare decision-ready communications.

 

Lead through influence

  • Build trusted partnerships across a matrixed organization and align teams with competing priorities without relying on formal authority.
  • Lead focused program reviews that help teams resolve issues, make decisions, and maintain accountability for shared commitments.
  • Mentor Program Managers and Software Development Managers who provide program coverage within their teams.
  • Raise the quality of planning, decision-making, and delivery beyond a single assigned program through practical coaching and scalable operating improvements.
  • Solve systemic problems through influence, build alignment across functions, and turn agreed direction into lasting improvements.

 

Required Qualifications

  • 10+ years of program management, technical program management, product operations, business systems, or related experience.
  • Sustained success independently leading complex, high-visibility digital or software programs across multiple teams, from early definition through launch and operational adoption.
  • Strong working knowledge of digital product development and the software delivery lifecycle, including experience partnering with developers to define requirements, workflows, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and implementation plans.
  • Strong business-analysis and process-design skills, including the ability to understand current workflows, identify root problems, and distinguish valuable governance from unnecessary process.
  • Demonstrated experience improving program-management practices, governance, tools, or operating workflows across multiple teams.
  • Proven ability to influence across functions and levels without direct authority, including regular work with Director- and VP-level stakeholders.
  • Experience using AI-assisted tools, workflow automation, rapid prototyping, or similar approaches to improve how work is understood, coordinated, or delivered.
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise work-management and collaboration platforms such as Jira and Confluence, or comparable tools.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and visual communication skills, with the judgment to turn complex information into clear choices and recommendations.
  • Ability to operate independently, move between strategy and detail, and deliver results with limited oversight.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in digital media, local news, sports, streaming, content platforms, or another multi-brand consumer environment.
  • Experience improving program-management systems, governance practices, internal platforms, or operating workflows at scale.
  • Experience working with developers to translate business and operating needs into requirements, workflows, prototypes, and delivery plans.
  • Experience with AI agents, no-code or low-code tools, analytics, and workflow automation.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, Smartsheet, dashboarding tools, or comparable work-management platforms.

job.description:
As a Digital Journalist you will join the team behind LiveNOW from FOX, FOX TV Stations’ national live streaming news channel. We are a team of passionate content creators seamlessly moving between the biggest live events and stories as they happen to keep our viewers informed. LiveNOW is always raw, live and unfiltered, with limited commentary and no opinion. Our Digital Journalists watch with viewers as breaking news unfolds, leveraging the latest newsroom technologies to help the audience understand what is occurring and answering their questions.

Reporting to the Executive Producer you will curate, produce, and host live coverage of breaking news and important events as they happen. You will be responsible for giving our audience an in-the-moment view of what’s going on right now. If you are a self-professed news junkie who always knows what’s going on around the world looking for an opportunity that blends being a host, reporter, and producer, look no further than LiveNOW!

This position is based in LiveNOW’s west coast newsroom at FOX 10 Phoenix.

Schedule: Tuesday - Saturday, 4PM-12:30AM (local timezone)

**Only applications with a reel will be considered for this position. Reels may be submitted in your application as a link or attachment.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Gather, produce, and present original content live for breaking news and major news events, on digital, social, streaming and broadcast platforms nationwide.
  • Simultaneously manage content and live video production, including video switching and graphics.
  • Monitor live video feeds, newsgathering tools and social media for the latest information and content.
  • Maintain constant communication with FOX O&O stations as well as other internal and external partners to coordinate receiving video and new information.
  • Stay up-to-date on news and current events.
  • Pitch story ideas and contribute to the editorial process while adhering to journalistic standards
  • Assist in editorial planning and monitor real-time analytics.
  • Support other Digital Journalists in producing content.
  • Other duties assigned as deemed appropriate and necessary.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • At least 3 years of experience reporting and hosting live news coverage.
  • BA/BS degree preferably in Journalism, Communications or related field.
  • Strong knowledge of current events with a deep understanding of how viewers are consuming news in this media landscape.
  • Excellent live communicator with the ability to host continuous coverage over extended periods of time.
  • Proven ability to guide viewers through live breaking news and major events happening around the world in an easy-to-follow manner.
  • Great research skills and editorial judgment with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced breaking news environment.
  • Familiarity and curiosity for newsroom technologies (TriCaster).
  • Understanding of digital production and live video workflows.
  • Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
  • Flexibility to work early mornings, nights, weekends, and holidays

At LiveNOW, you’ll be part of a team redefining how news is delivered in the digital era. We bring audiences live, unfiltered breaking and events from around the country in real time—no scripts, no anchors, just the story as it unfolds. With millions of viewers tuning in across multiple platforms, this is your chance to help shape the future of live digital journalism.

job.title: News Anchor
job.description:
FOX6 is reimagining local news, and we’re looking for a morning anchor who brings more than polished prompter skills. We’ve moved away from formulaic rundowns and traditional scripting in favor of authentic, unscripted, high-impact local journalism centered on live, breaking, and evolving stories. We need an active journalist and high-energy content creator.

We're also looking for a true newsroom leader - someone who demonstrates and inspires initiative, curiosity, empathy, and accountability.

This role requires a dedicated morning person comfortable with a 2:30 a.m. start time. You’ll kick off your shift steering fast-paced, streaming-first coverage. You'll spend the early morning news hours sourcing original stories and engaging in real-time reporting from the newsroom; you'll then co-anchor late-morning hours. This role isn't about showing up to present the content; it's about actively building it.

If you love becoming the subject matter expert for the stories you cover, thrive in fluid on-air conversation, and seek out real-time engagement with teammates and audiences across TV and streaming platforms, this is your opportunity to help shape the future of local news.

In return, FOX provides a stellar benefits package including 3 weeks’ vacation to start, amazing healthcare benefits, and a very generous 401(k) match.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead with courage, serving as a collaborative newsroom culture setter who fosters an environment of trust and open communication.
  • Drive fair, accurate, unscripted, and dynamic morning news coverage on-air and across digital and streaming platforms.
  • Pitch, research, and create original story content throughout the morning shift, seamlessly integrating your reporting into live coverage via newsroom hits and anchor-desk coverage.
  • Guide viewers through live, breaking news without relying on a teleprompter, acting as a well-informed authority on local, regional, and national stories.
  • Conduct meaningful, extended Q&As with field reporters and guests, asking insightful questions that add context to live stories.
  • Collaborate with producers, photojournalists, reporters, and digital team members to build a continuous stream of live and active morning content.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Minimum of five years of on-camera journalism experience; previous anchoring and/or streaming experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated track record of leading with curiosity and accountability, with the ability to offer and receive direct, constructive feedback.
  • Proven ability to anchor and ad-lib comfortably in an unscripted format.
  • Strong news judgement, sharp journalistic instincts, and a track record of enterprise story creation.
  • High comfort level with digital platforms, streaming tech, and social media for gathering news and engaging audiences.
  • Journalism degree or a closely related field preferred.
  • Must be a genuine early riser ready for a 2:30 a.m. call time.

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Producer in AAA game development to lead production strategy and delivery planning for a product pillar.

Partnering closely with the Product Owner, craft directors, pod leads, and production leadership, you will ensure the pillar goals are translated into a clear, executable delivery plan aligned with project milestones and production gates. You will maintain the broader view across the pillar, connecting work across pods, validating dependencies and integration points with other pillars, identifying delivery risks and gaps, and ensuring teams are collectively progressing toward agreed outcomes.

This role requires someone who can move comfortably between strategic planning and execution oversight: you will focus on ensuring that the overall pillar plan is coherent, realistic, integrated with the broader project, and on track for delivery.

· Own the pillar delivery plan, translating product priorities into clear milestone and gate commitments.
· Partner with the Product Owner and craft leadership on scope, sequencing, priorities, and delivery expectations.
· Guide Associate Producers across pods to keep pod plans aligned with pillar outcomes, dependencies, and commitments.
· Align with other Senior Producers and project leadership on cross-pillar dependencies and the broader project roadmap.
· Represent the pillar in executive and stakeholder reviews, presenting plans, progress, risks, trade-offs, and key decisions.
· Track progress against milestone and gate objectives, identifying risks, gaps, and misalignment early.
· Maintain visibility on scope, capacity, dependencies, risks, and delivery confidence across the pillar.
· Challenge plans and assumptions to ensure commitments remain achievable and aligned with project priorities.
· Assess the impact of scope or priority changes on dependencies, milestones, and gate deliverables.
· Ensure deliverables and validation criteria are clear ahead of gates and key reviews.
· Support resolution and escalation of issues affecting broader pillar delivery.
· Improve pillar-level planning, coordination, and delivery practices while reinforcing accountability and collaboration.

RESPONSABILITÉS

Nous recherchons une personne possédant une solide expérience à titre de producteur senior en développement de jeux AAA afin de piloter la stratégie de production et la planification de la livraison pour un pilier du produit.

En étroite collaboration avec le Product Owner, les directions des disciplines, les responsables de pods et la direction de la production, vous veillerez à ce que les objectifs du pilier soient traduits en un plan de livraison clair et réalisable, aligné sur les jalons du projet et les gates de production. Vous maintiendrez une vue d’ensemble du pilier en reliant le travail entre les différents pods, en validant les dépendances et les points d’intégration avec les autres piliers, en repérant les risques et les écarts liés à la livraison et en veillant à ce que les équipes progressent collectivement vers les résultats convenus.

Ce rôle exige une personne capable de passer aisément de la planification stratégique au suivi de l’exécution. Vous veillerez principalement à ce que le plan global du pilier soit cohérent, réaliste, intégré à l’ensemble du projet et en bonne voie d’être livré.

· Prendre en charge le plan de livraison du pilier en traduisant les priorités du produit en engagements clairs pour les jalons et les gates.
· Collaborer avec le Product Owner et la direction des disciplines sur la portée, le séquencement, les priorités et les attentes en matière de livraison.
· Guider les producteurs associés des différents pods afin que leurs plans demeurent alignés sur les résultats, les dépendances et les engagements du pilier.
· S’aligner avec les autres producteurs seniors et la direction du projet sur les dépendances entre les piliers et la feuille de route globale du projet.

Overview
Paramount: A Skydance Corporation is seeking a Media Operations Senior Manager to join the Editorial Post Production Operations (EPPO) Media Management & Archives team within Production Technology and Operations. This role carries end-to-end ownership of media infrastructure, access, and workflow decisions supporting high-volume, multi-brand production across Paramount's global ecosystem. Based in LA, the position sets and enforces storage and archive policy, provisions and secures editorial and production access, manages vendor tools and relationships, and serves as an escalation point for the technical issues that most directly affect production continuity. The role partners daily with production, editorial, engineering, content security, and network stakeholders across coasts, and coordinates directly with the NYC and Hollywood Post Support teams.
Responsibilities
•    Responsible for storage and archive strategy for on-premises storage and cloud environments, including capacity planning and coordination of data migrations
•    Provision, audit, and secure access to media environments; work with clients to determine what requires restricted access for sensitive materials versus open access for a group of users
•    Set up and support live and near-live production and streaming workflows (e.g., WildMoka ingest, movie recorder routing) and troubleshoot encoding and routing issues in partnership with engineering
•    Coordinate media transfer, transit, and delivery workflows across internal teams and external vendors/post houses using enterprise tools (e.g., Signiant/Media Shuttle, Aspera)
•    Manage relationships with media technology vendors, including feature evaluation and usage guidance for shared services and tools
•    Serve as the first point of contact for cross-brand client groups for media needs, archive/retrieval, and workflow troubleshooting
•    Maintain and audit reference data supporting media operations, such as personnel/location directories and workflow documentation
•    Manage a team of media coordinators, including scheduling, time-off and overtime approvals, training, and client communication
Qualifications
•    5+ years of experience in media management, post-production operations, or media infrastructure/IT roles supporting production, with prior coordinator-level experience preferred
•    Demonstrated experience managing storage systems, Active Directory security groups, and access provisioning in a production or enterprise media environment
•    Strong working knowledge of editorial workflows, media formats/codecs, and professional editing platforms (Avid, Adobe Premiere, DaVinci Resolve)

  • Partner with University Recruiting to define target schools, candidate profile, and selection criteria for each incoming cohort — including evaluating candidates' comfort and curiosity with AI and data tools as part of the selection criteria.

  • Represent the program at campus recruiting events, info sessions, and case competitions as needed.
  • Own program metrics and reporting (retention, performance, promotion/placement rates, participant satisfaction) and use data to continuously improve the program.

 

Program Operations
  • Manage program budget, vendor relationships (training providers, assessment tools, AI/tech platform vendors), and logistics.
  • Establish program governance, policies, and processes (rotation timing, performance review cadence, escalation paths).
  • Build the program's employer brand internally and externally as a flagship talent pipeline known for producing tech-fluent finance leaders.

job.title: Digital Campaign Specialist
job.description:
About TEGNA

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

TEGNA is seeking a Digital Campaign Specialist to support local broadcast stations with their digital advertising operations. This role offers an excellent opportunity for individuals looking to grow their career in digital ad operations within a collaborative and fast-paced environment.

Location:

This role may be based at any TEGNA market location. Candidates should be located within commuting distance of a TEGNA market office and will follow the hybrid work schedule applicable to their local TEGNA location.

About the Role

As a Digital Campaign Specialist, you will work exclusively with TEGNA properties across various ad-serving platforms and order management systems. You’ll help manage CTV (Connected TV) and digital advertising campaigns from setup through delivery, ensuring they launch accurately, run smoothly, and meet performance goals.

This position involves campaign trafficking, troubleshooting, optimization, reporting, and quality assurance, making it ideal for individuals with strong technical aptitude, attention to detail, and an interest in digital advertising technology.

This role includes participation in an on-call rotation after appropriate training.

Responsibilities:

  • Master the digital workflow between business units and Ad Operations.
  • Develop expertise in ad servers and order management systems, with an emphasis on CTV campaign execution.
  • Set up, schedule, and manage digital advertising campaigns accurately, including CTV-specific formats and delivery methods.
  • Ensure proper deployment of creative assets by understanding ad specifications, templates, and ad-tag technologies, including VAST/VPAID tags and dynamic ad insertion.
  • Provide timely support to TEGNA stations and internal stakeholders, particularly for CTV and digital campaign delivery issues.
  • Troubleshoot campaign performance concerns and conduct quality assurance reviews to ensure campaign accuracy and effectiveness.
  • Send campaign reports, communicate technical information clearly, and manage service-level agreement expectations.
  • Monitor shared inboxes and workflow systems consistently and respond to requests in a timely manner.
  • Track campaign performance and implement optimization strategies, including fill-rate management, frequency capping, and ad podding.
  • Ensure campaigns meet applicable rate-card requirements and revenue-margin standards.
  • Collaborate effectively with vendors, stations, and internal teams while maintaining a customer-focused approach.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college in a related discipline required.
  • 1–2 years of experience with ad-serving platforms, digital advertising, campaign management, or ad trafficking preferred.
  • 3–5 years of practical experience in digital technology or advertising may be accepted in lieu of a degree.
  • Hands-on experience with CTV ad trafficking, Server-Side Ad Insertion (SSAI), and VAST/VPAID tags is preferred.
  • Strong technical aptitude and the ability to work effectively in a technical environment.
  • Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to different audiences.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Outlook, and Word.
  • Basic knowledge of HTML and JavaScript is a plus.
  • Experience with CTV or digital advertising platforms such as Publica or Google Ad Manager (GAM) is preferred.
  • Quick learner with a growth mindset and collaborative approach to teamwork.


Why Join Us?

  • Hands-on training and mentorship to develop your expertise in digital ad operations.
  • Opportunity to work with digital advertising and CTV technology across TEGNA's nationwide portfolio of local markets.
  • Hybrid work environment with the ability to be based at a TEGNA market location across the country.
  • Exposure to multiple ad-serving, campaign-management, and reporting platforms.
  • Growth opportunities within TEGNA's digital advertising operations organization.


Apply now and grow your career in digital advertising with TEGNA.

Pay Range $23—$25 USD

Benefits: 

TEGNA offers comprehensive benefits designed to safeguard the physical, mental and financial health of our employees and their families. TEGNA offers two medical plan options for full and part-time employees through Blue Cross Blue Shield of Texas, as well as access to dental and eye care coverage; fertility, surrogacy and adoption assistance; disability and life insurance.

Our 401(k) program offers full, part-time and temporary employees the opportunity to contribute 1% - 80% of their pay on a pre-tax basis to TEGNA’s 401(k). Contributions made up to the first 4% of pay are eligible for a 100% match from the company and are 100% vested from day one.

Regardless of participation in TEGNA medical plans, ALL employees and their eligible family members receive nine free virtual doctor’s appointments with a physician through Teladoc, and 12 free annual therapy sessions with a licensed clinician through Spring Health.

TEGNA offers a generous Paid Time Off (PTO) benefit as well as nine paid holidays per year. 

* Some jobs are covered by a collective bargaining agreement and thus some or all of the benefits described herein may not apply. For example, some newsroom bargaining unit employees receive health and retirement benefits under plans administered by the union.

EEO statement:

TEGNA Inc. is a proud equal opportunity employer. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring and developing individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences to add to our collaborative culture. We value and consider applications from all qualified candidates without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, age, marital status, personal appearance, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, family responsibilities, disability, medical condition, enrollment in college or vocational school, political affiliation, military or veteran status, citizenship status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local law. TEGNA will reasonably accommodate qualified individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable law. If you are in need of an accommodation in order to submit your application, please email askhr@tegna.com

To all candidates: your personal information and online safety are important to us. Only TEGNA Recruiters or Hiring Managers will reach out to you regarding consideration of your application or background.  Communications with TEGNA employees will either come from a TEGNA email address with a domain of tegna.com or one of our affiliate station domains.

The Account Manager role is responsible for building, maintaining, & growing relationships with clients by managing their advertising campaigns across multiple publishers/platforms (ex. search, display, social ads, O&O digital/print media etc.). The primary focus is ensuring our clients achieve & exceed their desired marketing goals through strategic campaign planning, and data analysis. As the Account Manager, you will act as the primary point of contact for client concerns and needs post-sales.

Must possess strong expertise in existing & emerging business marketing solutions, coupled with the ability to collaborate with our sales partners, post sales optimizers to identify opportunities, and effectively deliver solutions that maximize a client's ROI; are minimum expectations. In this dynamic role, a change-minded person will be crucial for effectively navigating the ever-evolving landscape of digital and traditional marketing concepts. Seamlessly, the AM will integrate with various teams and adapt to new challenges, ensuring that strategies remain agile and responsive to client needs.

Position Requirements:

• Closely partner with sales team(s), in owning the client relationship by: building solid rapport, demonstrating transparency, & delivering results against joint business objectives

• Understand, manage, and anticipate client expectations, gain client alignment, and fully mobilize/engage partner teams against the aligned approach while maintaining a strong communicative relationship

• Create a consistent open line of communication ensuring our value story & service successes are in parallel to a client's needs/goals via performance reviews (Weekly, Monthly, etc.)

• Articulate media programs to devise appropriate strategies and campaign implementation plans

• Work alongside our sales, and post sales optimization teams to formulate and act upon appropriate digital strategies and executions. These actions will aid in meeting and exceeding our clients' business goals.

• Advise our clients on how best to leverage feasible ongoing and impending marketing strategies

• Ensure a highly consistent marketing message across paid search, organic presence, display, social media, and O&O digital/print marketing channels

• Daily proficiency in customer relationship management, online search, and display advertising techniques and LocaliQ proprietary technologies

• Review day to day campaign performance in collaboration with post sales optimization counterparts, assess digital campaign trends, facilitate client advertising performance discussions, & identify proactively creative new advertising techniques to further our client’s digital marketing needs

• Hold primary responsibility for communicating and collaborating with backend support resources including, but not limited to, various digital solutions and ad operations teams, focused on delivering and exceeding client objectives (Daily, Weekly, Monthly, As Needed)

Key Skills:

• Ability to quickly master business process, marketing, and technology concepts

• Demonstrated expertise in customer relationship management

• Mastery of key technologies and systems to review and advise on digital marketing campaigns

• Advanced capabilities to effectively understand and speak toward digital advertising campaigns –Search, Display, Marketing Management Systems, traditional marketing endeavors etc.

• Strong technical skills to recommend, assess, modify/adjust, & routinely improve marketing campaigns over their lifecycle

• Demonstrated expertise with digital marketing publishing systems & processes

• Excellent verbal & written communication skills

• Demonstrate understanding of how retail/service media, sales, and operations work together to successfully drive a business

• Proven track record in relationship building and account management

• Works efficiently and is always looking to streamline processes & workflows

• Moderate Excel and PowerPoint skills required

Key Competencies:

• Marketing Concepts & Digital Marketing Acumen: pay-per-click, programmatic display, social, email marketing, and tracking concepts (Analytics/GA4), Leads, etc.)

• Customer Focus

• Proactive Creative & Analytical Thinking

• Business Process & Technology Acumen

• Team Collaboration

• Conflict Management

• Flexible With Change Management

• Proven Success in Implementing Ideas in a Fast- Paced Environment

• Attentive To Detail

About You:

• Bachelor's degree in general business, economics, finance, marketing, advertising, public relations, journalism, or English

• 2+ years of hands-on experience managing online/digital advertising campaigns

• Must have 3+ years of client-facing service/account management experience

• Google Ads & Google Analytics Certified

About Us:

Are you looking for a company that values innovation, passion, and a healthy work/life balance? A job where you feel supported and appreciated? At LocaliQ, we know our employees drive success, and we strive to create a thriving company culture where you will enjoy coming to work every day. Here, you can walk through the halls and bump into our CEO, catch an inter-office ping pong tournament, or support a local cause with your fellow employees. Are you ready to join a company where you can have fun and work with some of brightest people in digital marketing? Our mission is to help local businesses all over the world reach more local customers online. As a leader in powering online marketing for local businesses, LocaliQ has been recognized for outstanding products and exceptional employees, having won Google’s Quality Account Champion in North America and Google’s Innovation Champion Award in Canada. LocaliQ is headquartered in Woodland Hills, CA, & Frisco, TX, with over 35 locations throughout the United States, Canada, India, Australia, New Zealand, and Brazil.

The Sales Associate is responsible for generating new business opportunities, building prospect pipelines, supporting open territories, and securing qualified meetings for the sales organization. Prospecting & Business Development

• Conduct outbound prospecting through phone, email, LinkedIn, referrals, and other lead-generation channels.

• Research local businesses and identify potential advertising and marketing opportunities.

• Schedule qualified discovery meetings for Media Specialists and Account Executives.

Sales Activity & Pipeline Management
