You will establish a vision for shaping and targeting our journalism for different platforms, and you will be responsible for understanding and developing new strategies, tools and workflows as those platforms evolve. This means you’ll be building our presence on Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, WhatsApp and emerging platforms. Engaging our readers, monitoring on-site and off-platform conversations for story ideas and integrating readers’ contributions into our report is essential. 

You will know how to adjust social programming targets and priorities amid a shifting global, 24-hour news cycle and ever-changing platform landscape.You will also work with reporters and editors across the newsroom in how social media and readers’ voices can inform our journalism, both pre- and post-publication.

This is an in-office position based in Seoul, and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance. The role will report directly to the Senior Audience Manager based in Los Angeles.

Main responsibilities:

  • Leading The Times’s social presence across our main accounts, ensuring coverage of breaking news and live events; conceiving and executing innovative social plans for enterprise projects; and leveraging videos, photography and graphics to elevate our off-platform report
  • Support the increase in video production across the newsroom by prioritizing time-sensitive projects and ensuring that our video journalism reaches a wide audience off-platform 
  • Developing and refining the voice of The Times on all of our off-platform channels, exhibiting excellent news judgment and audience-sensitive framing
  • Collaborating with Social Visuals editors and across our Video team, especially in Seoul, on developing and executing visual storytelling formats and strategies for social platforms 
  • Building creative social native content (e.g., visual cards, Instagram stories, etc.)
  • Skillfully editing, shaping and elevating headlines, copy and visual assets for social media
  • Suggesting story ideas, identifying video opportunities and partnering with desks across the Seoul newsroom to produce stories that:
    • Anticipate readers’ prospective social and search needs sparked by a Times exclusive or a news event
    • Respond to readers’ real-time social and search needs and trends
  • Developing testing strategies around medium (images, video) and message (headline, social share text), to inform a constantly updating set of best practices for engaging off-platform audiences (Social, Search, etc.)
  • Partner with editors across the newsroom to workshop on-platform framing of articles that leverage off-platform performance insights and reader interest
  • Interpreting data and signals to know what pieces are the right fit for what audiences both on and off our platforms
  • Tracking success through engagement rates, growth statistics, reader responses and other metrics, especially for video
  • Working with journalists in the newsroom on best social media practices, including framing pieces for specific audiences
  • Collaborate with other audience editors, in Seoul and around the world, on flagging coverage opportunities informed by off-platform trends and sharing performance insights and case studies with desks
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world. 

Our ideal candidate:

  • Proven experience in social media and digital journalism
  • Deep understanding of all mainstream and some emerging social channels
  • Consistent record running Facebook, Twitter/X and Instagram accounts for major media outlets
  • Demonstrated interest in visual storytelling, including through video
  • Strong editorial judgment; comfortable with experimenting and refining strategies to optimize article-sharing for different social audiences
  • A passion for news and a dedication to The Times and its journalistic mission
  • Skill at bridging specialties, including reporting, editing, product, analytics, design and user research
  • Strong writing and editing skills, and knowledge of Times style or the ability to absorb and apply it quickly

The Graphics team is a group of visual thinkers with a shared vision to creatively cover the news and develop design solutions in a collaborative setting.

  • Create and publish weekend graphics coverage using a range of visual forms. You should have experience building visual stories, and publishing maps, charts, diagrams and other quick-turn graphics.

job.title: Digital Sales Manager
job.description:
Beasley Media Group is seeking a results-driven, strategic, and digitally savvy Digital Sales Manager to lead the growth of our digital advertising business. This leadership position is responsible for driving digital revenue across a portfolio of multimedia solutions, including programmatic advertising, targeted display, social media marketing, streaming audio, video, SEO/SEM, email marketing, website sponsorships, and custom digital campaigns.

The Digital Sales Manager will partner closely with local sales leadership and account executives to develop integrated marketing solutions that help clients achieve measurable business outcomes. The ideal candidate combines strong digital media expertise, team leadership experience, consultative selling skills, and a passion for helping clients succeed.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and execute the market's digital revenue strategy to achieve and exceed budgeted goals.
  • Recruit, coach, train, and develop Account Executives on digital products, sales strategy, and client presentations.
  • Serve as the local market digital expert and consultative resource for the sales team.
  • Accompany Account Executives on client calls and presentations to support digital sales efforts.
  • Identify new business opportunities and develop strategies to increase digital market share.
  • Collaborate with market leadership to create integrated advertising solutions leveraging Beasley Media Group's audio, digital, event, and experiential assets.
  • Develop and maintain strong relationships with local business leaders, agencies, and key decision-makers.
  • Partner with digital campaign fulfillment teams to ensure successful campaign execution and client satisfaction.
  • Analyze revenue performance, sales activity, and pipeline trends to drive accountability and growth.
  • Provide ongoing market intelligence regarding competitive digital products, pricing, and industry trends.
  • Conduct regular sales meetings, training workshops, and performance coaching sessions focused on digital best practices.
  • Ensure CRM compliance, accurate forecasting, and timely reporting.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • 5+ years of digital media sales experience.
  • 2+ years of sales leadership, team development, or management experience.
  • Demonstrated success selling digital advertising solutions and achieving revenue goals.
  • Strong knowledge of:
    • Programmatic advertising
    • Display advertising
    • Streaming audio
    • Video advertising
    • Social media marketing
    • SEO/SEM
    • Audience targeting and analytics
    • CRM and sales enablement platforms
  • Excellent presentation, communication, and negotiation skills.
  • Ability to build strong relationships with both internal and external stakeholders.

Preferred

  • Experience working for a media, broadcast, radio, television, agency, or digital marketing organization.
  • Google Ads, Google Analytics, Meta, or related digital marketing certifications.
  • Experience with integrated media campaigns and multi-platform solutions.
  • Familiarity with market-level revenue forecasting and budget management.

Success Metrics

  • Achievement of monthly, quarterly, and annual digital revenue goals.
  • Growth in new digital business revenue.
  • Digital product penetration across the sales organization.
  • Sales team adoption and proficiency in digital selling.
  • Client retention and satisfaction.
  • Market share growth within the local advertising community.

Core Competencies

  • Leadership & Coaching
  • Strategic Thinking
  • Consultative Sales
  • Revenue Generation
  • Digital Marketing Expertise
  • Client Relationship Management
  • Communication & Presentation Skills
  • Problem Solving
  • Collaboration

Beasley Media Group delivers influential local content and innovative marketing solutions across radio, digital, podcasting, events, esports, and emerging media platforms. This is a hybrid position with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

You will be an important element of our over-the-top platform team.   • By being proactive, propose solutions to the challenges encountered.

  • Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and application deployments.
  • Participate in code reviews and solution deployments.

  • University degree or equivalent experience.
  • At least 3 years of experience in software development.
  • Experience in developing complex and high-performance mobile applications.

  • Experience in developing an application published on the App Store.

  • Knowledge of audio-video broadcasting on the web (streaming) is an asset.
  • Knowledge of other programming languages is an asset.
  • Knowledge of design patterns is an asset.
  • Good general knowledge and strong intellectual curiosity (to acquire and develop new knowledge and skills).
  • Critical thinking (to question and propose new ideas).
  • A keen interest in the major trends and challenges of the digital world.
  • Meticulousness, independence, and resourcefulness.
  • Excellent stress management and priority setting.
  • Analytical and conceptual thinking skills.
  • Flexibility, initiative, and dynamism.
  • Ability to work in a team, excellent communicator.
  • Bilingualism (English and French) spoken and written is mandatory.

 

Please note that due to the nature of the mandates and responsibilities of this role, all candidates will be required to work in a multilingual environment, where business will be conducted in both official languages (English and French). We believe that hiring people with different career paths and backgrounds is fundamental in our shared success and in building healthy and highly performant teams.

 

When you join our mission, you are not only shaping the vision of CBC/Radio-Canada, but the future of our country.

 

We know that commitment to equity, inclusion and diversity is essential to creating content that mirrors and resonates with the rich and evolving makeup of our country.  We’re also committed to reaching out and connecting with our audience on multiple platforms this includes creating virtual places where communities can come together.

This is a hybrid position with a mix of in-office and remote work. Work arrangements will be discussed with hiring managers per departmental guidelines.

 

Why is this role important?

 

You will be an important element of our over-the-top platform team. As such, working closely with the product owners, architects and technical managers, your role is to ensure the smooth execution of product front-end development and coordinate the technical work required to deliver requested features, while adhering to the standards and practices agreed to by the development management team.

 

The team you will be part of is in charge of an harmonized product, powering CBC Gem and ICI TOU.TV.


Perks you can look forward to:

  • Flexible work schedules, allowing you to prioritize yourself, your family and your work.
  • Work from home opportunities.
  • Competitive total rewards package.
  • Opportunities to work with cutting edge technology.
  • Opportunities for continued learning and professional development.
  • Opportunities to become a member of our Employee Resource Groups.
  • Pair programming and mentorship opportunities, where you can learn from the best in the industry and help coach new talent.
  • A creative and dynamic work environment, where your ideas and contributions can be heard, valued and respected.
  • A supportive management team committed to upholding the highest standards of diversity and inclusivity.
  • An environment which favours experimentation and an iterative approach in order to achieve the highest form of technical innovation.

 

Your responsibilities:

  • Design and/or modify reusable components for Radio-Canada's digital platforms; such as the audio/video player.
  • Ensure compliance with standards and control the quality of the product throughout the project's execution.
  • Stay informed of new trends in the various fields of digital development.
  • By being proactive, propose solutions to the challenges encountered.
  • Participate in Agile Scrum activities designed to review ongoing production projects in order to make necessary corrections and adjustments, or completed projects to measure their results.
  • Participate in the development of user stories for our various products.
  • Ensure the good performance of developed applications to handle high loads.
  • Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and application deployments.
  • Participate in code reviews and solution deployments.

We are looking for a candidate matching the following profile:

  • University degree or equivalent experience.
  • At least 3 years of experience in software development.
  • Experience in developing complex and high-performance mobile applications.
  • Proficiency in Android Studio, Git, and the Kotlin language.
  • Experience in developing an application published on Google Play.
  • Experience in developing within code review context (pull request).
  • Knowledge of programming patterns (such as MVP or MVVM).
  • Knowledge of SOLID architecture principles is an asset.
  • Ability to read, produce, and adhere to software architecture diagrams (UML, sequence diagram, etc.).
  • Interest in working on an application available on multiple form factors (mobile/tablet/TV).
  • Knowledge of Jetpack Compose, Exoplayer, Kotlin Multiplatform is an asset.
  • Knowledge of the libraries Dagger, Hilt, Koin is an asset.
  • Knowledge of Google architecture components is an asset.
  • Knowledge of Maven (including the design/maintenance of internal libraries) is an asset.
  • Knowledge of audio-video broadcasting on the web (streaming) is an asset.
  • Knowledge of other programming languages is an asset.
  • Knowledge of design patterns is an asset.
  • Good general knowledge and strong intellectual curiosity (to acquire and develop new knowledge and skills).
  • Critical thinking (to question and propose new ideas).
  • A keen interest in the major trends and challenges of the digital world.
  • Meticulousness, independence, and resourcefulness.
  • Excellent stress management and priority setting.
  • Analytical and conceptual thinking skills.
  • Flexibility, initiative, and dynamism.
  • Ability to work in a team, excellent communicator.
  • Bilingualism (English and French) spoken and written is mandatory.

 

Please note that due to the nature of the mandates and responsibilities of this role, all candidates will be required to work in a multilingual environment, where business will be conducted in both official languages (English and French). Therefore, employees working in this role will be expected to make the required efforts and adjustments to navigate this multilingual environment in a respectful manner for all.

 

Please note this is a 12-month contract position, renewable annually. This regular position is not a consulting assignment but a long-term opportunity with attractive CBC/Radio-Canada employee benefits.

job.description:
Overview

Called to K-LOVE

 

Inspiring People to Move Closer to Jesus

 

At K-LOVE, every role is ministry.

 

We hire first for ministry alignment and a shared commitment to our faith, mission, vision, and values. We then seek talented professionals who can use their God-given gifts, skills, and experience to serve with excellence.

 

If you love Jesus and are called to be part of a ministry that places Christ at the center of everything we do, we invite you to explore this opportunity. If your heart aligns with our mission and you possess the knowledge, skills, and abilities needed for the role, please keep reading.

 

 

The Donor Advisor is responsible for qualifying and building strong, ministry‑focused relationships within K-LOVE’s Annual Giving Program of mid‑level donors and prospects. This includes initial contact and qualification, relationship cultivation, gift solicitation, follow-up and ongoing stewardship of donors, keeping those donors informed of the impact of their gifts, and helping donors fulfill their passions and interests tied to K‑LOVE’s mission. This role has an emphasis on the daily, effective outreach to and qualification of leads (primarily large volumes of existing donors) to deepen their engagement and giving, as well as providing the opportunity for portfolio development.

 

Here's some of what you will do...

  • Work consistent with and in furtherance of the goals and priorities established by the Development Department.
  • Execute a strategy, reflective of our culture and values, that further engages donors to increase their giving with a specific focus on increasing gifts ranging from $1,000 - $10,000. 
  • Deliver consistently strong and comprehensive fundraising results including but not limited to your assistance with closing mid-level gifts that are unrestricted, to campaigns, for pledge drive success, planned giving, and noncash.
  • Ensure major and principal level donors are escalated to that program with an appropriate transition plan.
  • Regular, organized, and effective qualification outreach to donors, focused on early-stage discovery and assessing readiness for deeper engagement. 
  • Effectively manage and engage your own portfolio as assigned.
  • Ensure calls, events, stewardship contacts, and relevant information gathered in those activities are accurately recorded in the donor’s data record.
  • Improve the year-over-year retention (or escalation) of mid-level donors and more fully engage them as partners.
  • Meet individual activity, qualification, portfolio fundraising, and other assigned goals.
  • Build teamwork and strong working relationships with the mid-level fundraisers and work cooperatively and collaboratively with your manager and other members of the department and ministry; accept guidance and instruction well.
  • Be responsive to stakeholders of the Annual Giving (mid-level) fundraising program.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
  • Job responsibilities are subject to review and change.

 

Here's some experience and skills we are seeking...

  • Bachelor’s degree, or combination of education and training with relevant experience. 
  • Fundraising certification a plus.
  • Minimum three years of donor development and fundraising experience including regular personal contacts to qualify donors (or transferable, sales or sales development, experience).
  • High energy professional with a track record of building donor/customer relationships and closing gifts/sales.
  • Demonstrated ability to listen to and understand the goals, interests, and passions of donors.
  • Effective time and detail management, able to manage and complete several projects concurrently.
  • Ability to work strategically, set priorities, define goals and outcomes, detail tactics, and achieve results.
  • An individual who is energetic, flexible, collaborative, and proactive.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to develop strong internal and external relationships.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
  • A commitment to accuracy, transparency, and accountability both internally and externally in conversations with donors and prospects, in marketing, and reporting.
  • A passion for Christian ministry.
  • Demonstrated commitment and passion for our mission and values.

 

 

Employment Requirements

  • Must pass a pre-employment reference screen and background check.
  • Proof of legal authorization to work in the United States.
  • Must agree with K-LOVE Christ-Centered Life Covenant and Statement of Faith

 

 

What can we offer you?

Some of our benefits packages include:

  • Industry leading Medical, Dental & Vision coverage
  • Short/long term disability and life insurance
  • Robust 401K with company match
  • Parental leave with Baby Bonding pay
  • Generous PTO, holiday and sick pay
  • Unique company culture that includes exclusive access to concerts, movie premieres, media industry events, and more
  • Leadership and Career Development Programs

 

 

“As an Equal Opportunity Employer, K-LOVE makes employment decisions based on merit and other legitimate reasons. The Company is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment and equal employment opportunities regardless of protected class, characteristic or status. However, K-LOVE is a religious non-profit organization where all team members contribute to the Company’s mission of encouraging our audiences “to have a meaningful relationship with Christ.” Therefore, pursuant to the Civil Rights Act of 1964, Section 702 (42 U.S.C. 2000e I(a)), K-LOVE has the right to hire only candidates who agree with the Company’s Statement of Faith, Mission, Vision, and Values. Also, as a religious non-profit organization, the Company is not governed by the CA Fair Employment and Housing Act.”

job.title: Sr Mgr, Social Media Audience Growth
job.description:
Location: GA-Atlanta

Job Title:  Sr Mgr, Social Media Audience Growth

 

Position Overview

Cox Media Group (CMG) has an exciting opportunity for a Senior Manager of Social Media and Audience Growth. This role is responsible for helping shape and execute CMG’s enterprise social media strategy.

 

This role drives audience growth, engagement, content distribution, platform innovation, and monetization opportunities across all major social platforms. It will establish enterprise-wide social media standards, identify emerging opportunities, analyze performance trends, and partner with local stations to maximize the impact and reach of CMG journalism across social platforms.

 

This role will work closely with CMG Content Leaders, News Directors, Digital Leaders, Marketing Teams, Sales, and on-air talent to ensure social media supports CMG’s broader audience and content distribution strategy while building audience loyalty and expanding reach.

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistent audience growth across CMG social platforms
  • Increased engagement, referral traffic, and loyalty across key social platforms
  • Strong and consistent execution of social best practices across the company
  • Growth of platform-native, original, vertical, and video content
  • Growth of sustainable social revenue and partnership opportunities
  • Stronger integration of social media into daily newsroom and digital workflows
  • Expanded reach and visibility of CMG journalism and journalists
  • Successful adoption of emerging platforms, formats, and technologies
  • Increased use of data and audience insights to drive social decision-making

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Social Media & Audience Growth

  • Helps develop and execute CMG’s enterprise social media strategy
  • Serves as a subject-matter expert on social platforms, audience behavior, content distribution, and emerging trends
  • Establishes platform standards and best practices
  • Drives audience growth, engagement, and referral traffic
  • Leads innovation in vertical video, platform distribution, and emerging channels
  • Identifies external partnerships and opportunities that could enhance CMG’s social strategy, audience reach, and business objectives

Social Media Strategy & Leadership

  • Provides social platform expertise, audience insights, and recommendations to help shape and continuously refine CMG’s enterprise social media strategy
  • Establishes platform-specific standards, best practices, and publishing guidelines
  • Partners with station leadership to align social efforts with audience, content, and business objectives
  • Identifies emerging platforms, technologies, and audience opportunities

Audience Growth & Engagement

  • Drives measurable audience growth and engagement across social platforms
  • Develops strategies that increase referral traffic and platform loyalty
  • Analyzes audience behavior and engagement patterns
  • Establishes performance benchmarks, key performance indicators, and growth goals
  • Identifies opportunities to reach new audiences and expand the reach of CMG journalism
  • Uses data and audience insights to continuously refine content and distribution strategies

Essential Duties and Responsibilities (continued)

Content Distribution & Platform Optimization

  • Leads social distribution strategies for breaking news, weather, investigations, community coverage, major events, and other high-impact journalism
  • Creates frameworks that help stations maximize the value and reach of content across platforms
  • Develops best practices for audience engagement, including vertical video, platform-native storytelling, and social-first content
  • Partners with newsroom and digital leaders to integrate social strategy into daily editorial workflows
  • Ensures social content remains aligned with CMG editorial standards

Analytics, Revenue & Innovation

  • Analyzes performance metrics, trends, and audience insights
  • Identifies growth opportunities across social platforms
  • Evaluates platform changes, emerging technologies, and distribution opportunities
  • Leads testing and pilot programs for new social products and initiatives
  • Shares learnings, successful strategies, and best practices across CMG markets

Minimum Qualifications

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in social media strategy, digital audience development, or digital content distribution, preferably within a media, news, or content organization
  • Proven track record of driving measurable social media growth and high-performing content
  • Strong editorial judgment and understanding of news values, journalism, and digital storytelling
  • Experience creating and optimizing short-form vertical video content and platform-native content strategies
  • Proven ability to use data and analytics to develop strategy, identify opportunities, and measure performance
  • Demonstrated ability to work across teams, influence stakeholders, and drive adoption of enterprise initiatives
  • Deep expertise in Facebook, TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube, including platform algorithms, audience behavior, analytics, trends, and best practices
  • Strong understanding of digital audience development, content distribution, referral strategy, and platform-native storytelling
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, rapidly changing digital media environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading social media or audience strategy for a multi-market media organization
  • Experience with social media analytics, monetization, audience measurement, social listening, and publishing tools
  • Background in video editing and mobile-first production workflows
  • Experience launching or testing new platforms, products, content formats, or audience-growth initiatives
  • Understanding of SEO, referral traffic, digital analytics, and broader audience-development strategies

About Cox Media Group 

CMG Media Corporation (d/b/a Cox Media Group) is an industry-leading media company with unparalleled brands, award-winning content, and exceptional team members. CMG provides valuable local and national journalism and entertainment content to the people and communities it serves. The company's businesses encompass 17 high-quality, market-leading television brands in 9 markets; 45 top-performing radio stations delivering multiple genres of content in 9 markets; and numerous streaming and digital platforms. CMG's TV portfolio includes multiple primary affiliates of ABC, CBS, FOX, NBC, Telemundo and MyNetworkTV, as well as several valuable news and independent stations. For more information about CMG, visit www.coxmediagroup.com

  • Proactively and independently identify and connect with qualified prospects to maintain a full pipeline 
  • Identify, understand and communicate trends within client markets and industries to lead with insights and engage prospects in business conversations

job.title: News Producer
job.description:
KRQE News 13 is looking for a News Producer who brings curiosity, creativity, and solid news judgment to the control room every day.   You’ll help decide which stories lead, find the moments that make a newscast memorable, and work alongside an experienced newsroom team committed to covering New Mexico with urgency, accuracy, and purpose.    This is an opportunity to do more than stack a show.    Come help us create one!

Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Produces and executes newscasts for broadcast across all platforms

  • Writes, selects and orders news stories to create compelling, well-paced newscasts

  • Writes and approves scripts for accuracy, clarity, grammar and journalistic standards

  • Exercises strong editorial judgment in determining story placement, emphasis and coverage

  • Balances breaking news, daily news and feature content to create engaging broadcasts

  • Responds quickly to breaking news and adjusts rundowns and content as stories develop

  • Coordinates with anchors, reporters, photographers, editors and newsroom leadership throughout the production process

  • Communicates clearly with the production team before and during live newscasts

  • Times newscasts and makes real-time adjustments to ensure programs end on time

  • Identifies opportunities for live coverage, reporter involvement, graphics, video and other production elements

  • Edits video and other content as needed

  • Ensures content meets company standards for journalistic integrity, accuracy and production quality

  • Writes and publishes stories for the station’s website and other digital platforms

  • Interacts with viewers and users through social media platforms

  • Contributes story ideas and participates in editorial discussions and newsroom planning

  • Performs other duties as assigned

 Requirements & Skills:

  • Journalism degree, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and work-related experience

  • Fluency in English

  • Excellent communication skills, both oral and written

  • Minimum two years’ experience in news operations

  • Ability to meet deadlines, prioritize assignments and handle multiple tasks simultaneously

  • Flexibility to work any shift

​

Stay Ahead of Industry Trends


  • Maintain expertise in developing digital and video advertising technologies.

Sales Excellence

Advertising is evolving quickly, and video has become the dominant medium for reaching consumers across television, streaming, mobile, and connected devices. If you're motivated by building relationships, creating innovative campaigns, and helping businesses grow, this is an opportunity to build a rewarding career with a recognized industry leader.

As Local Sales Manager, you'll lead a talented team of Account Executives while developing strategies that help clients grow using the power of broadcast television, digital marketing, OTT streaming, social media, search marketing, and targeted advertising solutions. Your leadership will directly influence revenue growth, talent development, and the success of local businesses throughout Southern Colorado. This is an exciting opportunity to mentor a high-performing sales team, build meaningful client relationships, and make a lasting impact in one of the nation's most dynamic media markets.


WHAT YOU'LL DO:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of local Account Executives to achieve revenue and performance goals.
  • Collaborate with the Director of Sales and cross-functional departments to execute station objectives and maximize business growth.
  • Drive new business development across all station platforms, including broadcast, OTT, digital, mobile, social, and search solutions.
  • Utilize and champion the Scripps Sales Process (SSP), providing coaching and field support to sales team members.
  • Develop and execute strategic sales plans that help clients achieve marketing objectives while maximizing station revenue.
  • Negotiate rates, ratings, and advertising budgets to deliver value for clients and the station.
  • Create innovative packaging and pricing strategies that meet client needs and optimize inventory utilization.
  • Monitor market trends, competitive activity, and emerging advertising solutions to position KKTV as the preferred media partner.
  • Partner with traffic and operations teams to ensure efficient management of airtime inventory and campaign execution.
  • Forecast revenue accurately, manage departmental expenses, oversee accounts receivable processes, and ensure financial goals are achieved.

WHAT YOU'LL NEED:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field preferred; equivalent professional experience will be considered.
  • Seven or more years of proven success in media sales, advertising sales, or related revenue-generating roles required.
  • Experience managing strategic agency and direct accounts with a strong understanding of broadcast inventory, digital advertising, and video solutions required.
  • Valid driver's license, a satisfactory driving record, and proof of insurance meeting company requirements.
  • Ability to travel within the market as needed to support clients, business development, and team initiatives.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

  • Strong leadership, coaching, mentoring, and team development skills.
  • Ability to inspire, motivate, and influence individuals toward achieving shared goals.
  • Excellent sales, negotiation, and business development capabilities.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and translate insights into effective marketing solutions.
  • Proven ability to develop creative, client-focused advertising strategies across multiple platforms.
  • Outstanding verbal, written, and presentation skills with the confidence to engage audiences of all sizes.
  • Exceptional collaboration and relationship-building abilities across departments and with external partners.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Working knowledge of Google Workspace applications and virtual collaboration platforms such as Zoom, WebEx, Skype, and Microsoft Teams.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment while maintaining attention to detail and delivering high-quality results.

OUR TEAM:

At KKTV, you'll join a collaborative and passionate team dedicated to serving businesses and audiences throughout Southern Colorado. We value innovation, accountability, teamwork, and professional growth, and we encourage every team member to bring their unique perspectives and ideas to the table. Our sales organization combines local market expertise with industry-leading advertising solutions, creating an environment where people can learn, grow, and achieve meaningful success together.


WHERE YOU'LL LIVE, WORK, AND PLAY:

Nestled at the base of Pikes Peak, Colorado Springs offers an exceptional quality of life with breathtaking mountain views, more than 300 days of sunshine annually, and endless opportunities for outdoor adventure. Whether you enjoy hiking, biking, skiing, trail running, or simply exploring the region's natural beauty, you'll find no shortage of ways to stay active and connected to the outdoors.

Colorado Springs also features a thriving business community, vibrant dining and arts scene, family-friendly neighborhoods, and easy access to Denver and the Rocky Mountains. It's a place where professional opportunity and personal adventure come together, making it an outstanding place to build your career and enjoy your lifestyle.

SCRIPPS’ COMMITMENT TO A CULTURE THAT CREATES CONNECTION:

At Scripps, we are committed to a culture that reflects the audiences and communities we serve. We are intentional about creating an environment where employees, our audiences and other stakeholders feel valued and inspired to reach their full potential and create connections. To successfully deliver on this commitment, we must understand and reflect the values and perspectives those around us embody. That process begins by looking inward to build and celebrate a respectful workplace where everyone feels a sense of belonging and connection. By continuing to cultivate an environment where all employees have a fair chance to succeed, are included, valued, and seen, we will strengthen the connections that drive positive business impact and align with our core purpose.

The E.W. Scripps Company (NASDAQ: SSP) is a diversified media company focused on creating connection. job.title: Multimedia Journalist
job.description:
KUTV, a multi-platform media company that provides important storytelling content on YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, and a host of digital platforms, is looking for a take-charge Digital Multimedia Journalist (MMJ) to cover Southern Utah. This employee will be based in Washington County, Utah, near St. George.

We are seeking a motivated, energetic, creative, and aggressive content creator who has a passion for covering our local communities on every KUTV platform, including broadcast, KUTV.COM, YouTube, our mobile app, and social media platforms. The ideal candidate should also have sound writing skills, a great work ethic, and a can-do attitude. This Digital MMJ position is ideal for someone with at least two years of professional newsroom experience.  Applicants with a strong portfolio of student work may also be considered.

No day will look the same as a Multi-Media Journalist, however, the main responsibilities of the role will include:
 

  • Identify, pitch, create, shoot, write, and edit meaningful enterprise stories focused on advocacy and accountability
  • Work closely with newsroom managers to refine pitches and story scripts
  • Reviewing material for fairness, accuracy, and balance
  • Work as a team with all members of the newsroom
  • Develop and maintain contacts and sources in the community to enterprise story ideas
  • Produce digital versions of your reports.  This may include digital-only elements, producing unique content for YouTube, Instagram, and Facebook.  Working with the digital team to create a unique digital plan for each story.
  • Maintain an active social media presence to build your brand. 

 

Additionally, This Person Should Have:
 

  • Proven knowledge and experience working with current media creation tools
  • Storytelling abilities across multiple platforms
  • Strong writing and copy-editing skills are a must
  • Must be able to work well under pressure to meet deadlines
  • Minimum of two years professional newsroom experience

job.title: Sr. Content Creator
job.description:
ABC7 is seeking an experienced, creative, and highly motivated Senior Content Creator to join our team. This role is ideal for a versatile storyteller who can take an idea from concept to completion—producing, shooting, writing, and editing compelling short- and long-form content for both television and digital platforms. The successful candidate will bring strong creative instincts, technical expertise, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment where deadlines are tight and priorities can shift quickly. 

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

As a Senior Content Creator, you’ll be the primary videographer for all kinds of marketing projects, including promos, commercials, and lifestyle segments. You’ll edit content that stops thumbs, turns heads, and moves audiences to action. You’ll serve as a creative partner to internal and external clients, translating their goals into compelling visual stories.

You’ll collaborate with sales teams, marketers, and clients to deliver strategic storytelling that balances emotion, brand objectives, and performance.

YOUR DAILY PLAYLIST:

  • Shoot, edit, produce and write projects ranging from quick-turn social content to longer-form branded pieces 
  • Create high-quality, scroll-stopping content for client campaigns across TV, social, web, and streaming platforms 
  • Lead creative execution for branded content, commercials, promotional spots, and social-first video 
  • Serve as the creative lead, working closely with internal teams and external clients 
  • Collaborate directly with clients to develop concepts, manage expectations, and deliver polished creative solutions 
  • Manage asset distribution across the network and track deliverables through Adobe Workfront 

 

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE STAGE:

  • A passion for visual storytelling with a client-focused, marketing-driven mindset
  • Strong camera, lighting, and production skills that elevate brand storytelling 
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud, including Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, and Illustrator 
  • Confidence working directly with clients and internal stakeholders as a creative lead 
  • The ability to run a solo shoot or collaborate seamlessly as part of a team 
  • A portfolio that demonstrates strong branded content, commercial, or promotional work 

  

What skills do you need to be successful in this role?

  • Extensive video shooting experience with broadcast and DSLR cameras 
  • Ability to shoot, edit, and write content that tells a compelling story 
  • A strong understanding of fundamental design principles, color theory, typography, and composition 
  • Non-linear editing experience using Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Photoshop, and Illustrator 
  • Advanced knowledge of the post-production process, including media management and encoding video into various formats 
  • Ability to manage a variety of projects and work with varying production styles while employing strong communication skills 
  • Advanced knowledge of high-definition (HD) cameras, videography, motion graphics, and creative lighting techniques 
  • Strong interpersonal skills to navigate internal and external employee and client relationships 
  • Must maintain a valid driver’s license and good driving record 
  • Ability to routinely lift, carry, and move equipment in excess of 40 lbs. 
  • A college degree is preferred

 

WORKING HOURS AND TRAVEL:

  • Typical schedule is Monday to Friday during standard business hours.
  • Schedule flexibility may be required based on production needs, client deliverables, regional, national or international productions, or other time-sensitive projects.
  • Travel may be required.

Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales team. Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook)

Help Brands Thrive:

Join our media sales team and play a pivotal role in helping brands and companies grow. By identifying new opportunities, building strong client relationships, and delivering impactful solutions, you'll showcase how our multi-media content platforms and digital assets can drive meaningful results for our partners.

 

Your focus will be on helping clients achieve their goals, ensuring that every campaign is a success. When our clients win, we win—and we believe in celebrating those victories together!

 

Make Connections: Embrace your powers of persuasion and make every handshake and meeting count! Every interaction is a chance to build a genuine connection and show clients how we can help them succeed. You're not just selling; you're building partnerships and long-lasting relationships. You're helping businesses find the right audience in the right place at the right time. When we say One Partner, Endless Possibilities, we mean it!

 

Be A Trusted Guide: In this role, you'll connect with clients on a human level, understand their unique needs, and craft tailored sales and marketing solutions that deliver results. As their trusted advisor, you'll help them navigate the ever-evolving marketing landscape, ensuring every step of the journey is planned with care and precision.  

 

Shake Things Up: Bring your creativity and fresh ideas to the table! We're looking for someone who challenges the status quo, embraces innovation, and finds new ways to connect with our audience. Your contributions will help elevate our brand and drive meaningful results for your clients.  

 

Join us and Conquer the Media Landscape: You'll be part of a dedicated team of A1 media sales professionals, committed to achieving market leadership. Together, we amplify our impact, deliver exceptional outcomes, and help our clients succeed in ways that truly matter.

 

Identify Emerging Opportunities: It's about being able to see what others can't, anticipating market shifts, analyzing data and predicting the next big thing. Your insights will position our clients and AMP for long-term success.  

 

What We're Looking For

Proven Sales Ability and an Unstoppable Desire to Learn

You're a seasoned sales professional and we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results.

 

Strong Communication Skills: You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must.

 

A Passion for helping Others: You're committed to understanding clients' needs, providing top-notch customer service and making a difference. You're not just selling a product; you're providing a solution.  

 

A Competitive Spirit: Do you get a little boost when you achieve a goal (especially if it was a tough one)? We love that for you (and us)!  We want someone who's driven to excel but also knows how to celebrate the victories (big and small) with their team. That drive makes you a valuable part of our organization.  

 

A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.  

 

The Practical Stuff

A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community.

 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now"

 

Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.  

 

The Compensation Package: We offer a base salary, commission structure, and benefits package designed to support your success and well-being. Happy employees don't stage rebellions! ;)

 

We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales specialist isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.)

 

Top-Notch Training and Support: We're not the kind of company that hires you and then disappears into the corporate abyss. We carefully select candidates for a cohort-based training program, where you'll join a group of sales professionals from all over the country. From onboarding to ongoing mentorship, we invest in your success with training programs that set you up for long-term growth.

 

Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, providing you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.  

 

Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise.  

 

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
job.description:
Welcome to Warner Bros. Discovery… the stuff dreams are made of. Who We Are… When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next… From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive. We are the now and the next. The power behind the people building the future. We are born from the spirit of innovation. We are created from the idea that people around the world want more, need more, deserve more. We are the home of the global digital revolution. We are CNN. To see what it’s like to work at CNN, follow @WBDLife on Instagram and X! CNN is hiring a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead high-impact programs that span product, technology, design, and product operations. This is a deeply technical senior individual-contributor role for someone who can move between architecture, code, product strategy, operating models, and executive decision-making without losing the thread. The role reports directly to the Senior Director of Technical Program Management and will be trusted with ambiguous, multi-quarter programs that do not fit neatly inside one function. The programs in this portfolio often have no single functional owner, require trade-offs across several organizations, and need sustained influence with Vice Presidents, Directors, principal-level practitioners, and the teams doing the work. This is not a coordination-only position. The person in this role will define the problem, establish the program strategy, understand the underlying systems, challenge weak assumptions, create alignment, and drive measurable outcomes through delivery, launch, adoption, and iteration. WHAT YOU WILL OWN Lead a portfolio of high-priority, cross-organization technical programs from early problem framing through execution, launch, adoption, and measurable business or customer impact. Turn broad goals into clear program strategies, outcome metrics, decision rights, sequencing, governance, and executable plans across multiple teams. Build and maintain integrated plans, dependencies, critical paths, decision logs, risk views, and executive-level narratives that make the real state of the work visible. Identify the technical, product, organizational, and operational constraints that will determine success; resolve them directly or drive the right leaders to a timely decision. Work with senior leaders, including VPs, to clarify priorities, expose trade-offs, remove blockers, and create durable alignment without relying on formal authority. Move comfortably between several programs and levels of detail in the same day, while preserving context, commitments, and follow-through. Create the minimum effective operating model for each program: enough structure to move quickly and safely, without adding process that does not improve outcomes. Develop trusted relationships across Product, Engineering, Design, Product Operations, Architecture, Data, Security, Editorial, Revenue, and other partner organizations as the work requires. Raise the quality of program leadership across the organization by modeling strong judgment, direct communication, technical curiosity, and disciplined execution. TECHNICAL LEADERSHIP EXPECTATIONS This role is not a software-engineering position, but it is intentionally more technical than a traditional program-management role. The successful candidate must be able to engage engineers and architects as a credible peer and independently investigate technical questions. Read, write, review, and reason about code. Use (ai) code when it is the fastest way to validate an assumption, automate work, inspect data, reproduce a problem, or demonstrate a solution. Understand modern software-delivery practices, including source control, pull requests, testing, CI/CD, observability, incident response, release strategies, and production operations. Evaluate system architecture, service boundaries, API contracts, event flows, data models, cloud infrastructure, security constraints, reliability concerns, and integration risks well enough to shape the program plan. Lead technical discovery with engineers and architects, translate findings into decisions and sequencing, and recognize when a proposed plan is technically incomplete or unrealistic. Use data and technical evidence to distinguish symptoms from root causes and to challenge estimates, assumptions, or dependencies constructively. Communicate technical choices and consequences in language that product, design, operations, and executive stakeholders can act on. PRODUCT, DESIGN, AND OPERATING JUDGMENT Frame the customer, user, editorial, operational, or business problem before converging on a solution; connect program work to a clear value hypothesis. Partner closely with Product and Design to define intended outcomes, success measures,

experience

principles, scope boundaries, and the smallest credible path to learning or value. Pressure-test prioritization using customer impact, strategic fit, technical leverage, cost, risk, reversibility, and opportunity cost. Translate product strategy into a delivery approach that includes discovery, design, engineering, operational readiness, launch, measurement, and follow-up—not just a milestone schedule. Work with Product Operations to improve planning, decision-making, portfolio visibility, adoption, feedback loops, and repeatable ways of working across teams. Recognize when a program needs a product decision, a technical decision, an operating-model change, or an executive trade-off, and drive the correct conversation. EXECUTIVE INFLUENCE AND PROGRAM LEADERSHIP Present complex situations to senior leaders with clarity: what changed, why it matters, what choices exist, what you recommend, and what decision is needed. Escalate early and with options. Avoid status-only escalation and make it easy for leaders to take the next action. Build alignment across leaders who may have different goals, incentives, vocabulary, or operating rhythms; surface disagreement rather than allowing false consensus. Make sound decisions independently within the role's mandate and know when additional input or explicit executive sponsorship is required. Stay effective under ambiguity, organizational change, incomplete information, and shifting priorities while maintaining a high bar for quality and accountability. Create an environment in which teams can raise risks, make decisions, and move quickly without losing transparency or ownership. WHAT YOU WILL BRING

Required qualifications

At least 5 years of direct

experience

leading complex technical programs, with demonstrated principal- or senior-level scope in a matrixed organization. A strong software-engineering foundation or equivalent hands-on technical background, including the ability to complete a practical coding assessment. Demonstrated ability to understand architecture and implementation details, ask precise technical questions, and convert technical realities into an effective program strategy. Strong product judgment, including problem framing, customer or user thinking, prioritization, metrics, experimentation, and trade-off analysis. A record of driving cross-functional outcomes across Product, Engineering, Design, and Operations from ambiguity through launch and adoption.

Experience

influencing Directors, VPs, and other senior leaders through clear reasoning, evidence, strong recommendations, and persistent follow-through. Exceptional independence, ownership, context switching, and organizational awareness; able to enter a new domain quickly and determine what matters. Excellent written and verbal communication, including executive updates, decision documents, program narratives, and direct facilitation of difficult conversations. A practical approach to process: rigorous where risk and complexity demand it, lightweight where speed and learning matter more.

Preferred qualifications

Previous

experience

as a software engineer, engineering lead, architect, technical product manager, or similarly technical role.

Experience

with large-scale consumer digital products, media or publishing systems, subscriptions, advertising, data platforms, AI-enabled products, or platform modernization.

Experience

leading programs that require changes to both technology and the way teams plan, make decisions, or operate.

Experience

working across multiple time zones, business units, vendors, or shared-platform organizations. Comfort using modern development, analytics, planning, and collaboration tools to investigate work directly rather than relying only on reported status. WHAT STRONG PERFORMANCE LOOKS LIKE First 90 days — Context and trust: Build a clear map of the portfolio, systems, stakeholders, constraints, and unresolved decisions. Establish credibility with technical and product leaders and create momentum on the highest-value issues. By 6 months — Independent program leadership: Run multiple high-stakes programs with reliable visibility, strong technical and product framing, timely decisions, and fewer avoidable surprises. Senior leaders should view the role as a force multiplier, not an additional reporting layer. By 12 months — Durable outcomes: Deliver measurable program results, improve the organization's ability to execute across boundaries, and leave behind reusable decision, planning, and operating patterns that make future work faster and clearer. CANDIDATE ASSESSMENT The interview process will evaluate the complete shape of the role rather than program-management mechanics alone. Candidates should expect: A practical coding assessment focused on problem solving, code comprehension, implementation quality, debugging, automation, data handling, or API/system interaction. It is not intended to be a trick-algorithm exercise, but candidates must demonstrate genuine hands-on ability. A product-thinking component that evaluates problem framing, customer or user value, prioritization, success metrics, sequencing, trade-offs, and the ability to connect technical work to product outcomes. A technical program deep dive covering architecture, dependencies, delivery strategy, risk, decision-making, and how the candidate personally changed the outcome. A leadership and influence discussion focused on independence, ambiguity, context switching, executive communication, conflict, and driving action across organizational boundaries. You can find them at www.wbd.com/guiding-principles/ along with some insights from the team on what they mean and how they show up in their day to day. We hope they resonate with you and look forward to discussing them during your interview. Championing Inclusion at WBD Warner Bros. job.title: Principal Electrical Engineer
job.description:
Architecture & Facilities Engineering (A&FE) is seeking a Principal Electrical Engineer to serve as the Resort's foremost technical authority on electrical power distribution across the full range of voltage levels, electrical life-safety-related systems, and electrical code strategy. This role requires a current California Professional Engineer (PE) license and serves as the final technical authority in the discipline.

 

You will be regarded as an expert in electrical engineering, applying an in-depth understanding of how the specialty integrates within the broader engineering function, and solving unique and complex problems with broad impact on the business. You will plan, conduct, and direct development and/or research work on complex electrical projects requiring the origination of new and unique approaches, supply technical inspiration and consultation to professional colleagues, may represent the organization in outside discussions and technical forums, and work with wide latitude for unreviewed action. As the Principal Electrical Engineer, you will set the technical direction, standards, and long-range infrastructure strategy for electrical engineering across the Resort.

 

You will report to the Director, A&FE (or designated senior Resort engineering leadership) and sit in Anaheim, CA.

 

You Will / Job Responsibilities:

 

Leadership & Strategic Program Direction

  • Lead projects with notable risk and complexity, consistently over time, often multidisciplinary in nature; develop the strategy for project execution.
  • Serve as a mentor and technical authority for electrical engineers Resort-wide; guide, but do not formally supervise, other engineers and designers across the electrical discipline.
  • Represent A&FE's electrical engineering function in cross-functional and executive-level discussions and may represent the organization in outside discussions and technical forums.
  • Contribute to the development of functional strategy for electrical engineering across the Resort's capital and sustaining portfolios, including multi-year power distribution and infrastructure master planning.
  • Originate and set direction for engineering standards, master specifications, and design guidelines governing electrical systems Resort-wide.
  • Evaluate long-range life-cycle cost, risk, and reliability strategy across the full range of voltage levels in the Resort's electrical distribution, emergency/standby power, and electrical resiliency portfolio, including substation and switchgear master planning, microgrid feasibility, and EV charging infrastructure strategy.

 

Technical Design & Support

  • Apply in-depth, expert-level understanding of electrical engineering to solve unique and complex problems with broad impact on the business, originating and applying new and unique approaches where established methods do not apply.
  • Provide conceptual and innovative technical direction on the most complex power distribution topology, protective relaying/coordination, and arc-flash mitigation strategy Resort-wide.
  • Serve as final technical authority and PE of record on the Resort's most complex or highest-risk electrical designs and submittals.
  • Direct root cause investigations and failure analyses for the most significant or novel electrical outages, equipment failures, or safety incidents.
  • Maintain expert-level command of the California Electrical Code, IEEE electrical low voltage guidance (Brown, Buff, and Red Books), and the California Energy Code (Title 24), setting Resort-wide interpretation and application standards.

 

Relationship Management

  • Communicate complex ideas, anticipate potential objections, and persuade senior leaders, regulators, and business partners to adopt sound electrical engineering strategies.
  • Serve as the Resort's principal liaison with Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs) and utility partners on complex or precedent-setting code and interconnection matters.
  • Build and sustain executive-level relationships across Resort lines of business, Walt Disney Imagineering, Facility Asset Management, Entertainment, Food and Beverage, and Operations.
  • Represent the Resort in industry, regulatory, or codes-and-standards development activities as needed.

 

You Will Have / Required Experience:

  • 12+ years of progressive electrical engineering experience in design, construction, and/or consulting, with demonstrated expert-level depth and/or breadth of expertise.
  • Demonstrated recognized standing in the electrical engineering profession (e.g., through publications, codes-and-standards committee participation, industry recognition, or comparable achievement).
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, multidisciplinary projects and contributing to functional strategy.
  • Thorough, expert-level understanding of the California Electrical Code, IEEE electrical low voltage guidance, and the California Energy Code (Title 24), with the ability to originate Resort-wide standards and provide overall discipline stewardship.
  • Well versed in AutoCAD, Revit, SKM, and lighting design, with sound judgment for when to delegate detailed analysis versus perform it directly.
  • Experience motivating and overseeing the work of others (examples include more junior level engineers/designers, vendors, interns, etc)

 

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated, hands-on application of engineering principles in real project delivery, valued at least as much as academic credentials alone; practical field/project experience is strongly preferred over theoretical knowledge without applied context.
  • Active involvement in codes and standards development committees (e.g., NFPA, IEEE, ICC).
  • Experience with theme parks, resort hotels, and mixed-use facilities at a portfolio or program level or similar complex operating environments including experience in the field.
  • Experience with utility interconnection, microgrid, or large-scale emergency/standby power strategy.
  • Prior experience representing an organization to external regulators, AHJs, utility partners, or industry bodies.

 

Required Education:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering or related engineering field (preferred from an ABET accredited university)
  • CA Professional Engineer (License in good standing – clear and valid)

 

Preferred Education:

  • Master’s degree in electrical engineering and/or MBA.

ABC News…and many more. These products and brands – and the unmatched stories, storytellers, and events they carry – matter to millions of people globally.

Content Platforms & Operations is responsible for the development and ongoing advancement of the technical and operational functions driving the worldwide distribution and monetization of Disney’s linear networks and theatrical content. This includes Disney’s media supply chain and storage, network and theatrical distribution operations, media localization, network transmission and origination, and more. The Content Platforms & Operations team is seeking a Lead Product Manager to join the Content Intelligence group and drive the next evolution of Disney's media supply chain. In this role, you will help define and create AI-assisted products and workflows that intelligently analyze, enrich, and transform our massive catalog of global content. Bridging between business stakeholders, data science and engineering, you will guide cross-functional teams and partner with key stakeholders to deliver high-impact, scalable solutions within the media supply chain that brings Disney’s legendary storytelling to global audiences.


You will be working at the forefront of emerging technology, collaborating across global teams to blend the possible with the practical, maintaining a “dual horizon” view of delivering near-term business value in a timely fashion whilst steering the product towards longer term strategic goals.


Responsibilities and Duties of the Role:


Product Strategy & Portfolio Ownership:

Cross-Portfolio Alignment & Governance:

  • Use data storytelling and negotiation to align cross-team priorities.
  • Collaborate across organizational boundaries to deliver complex, multi-team capital initiatives, and ensure Disney’s broader strategic priorities are met.

Product Success, Technical Depth & Change Management:

  • Define, track, and measure the impact of your products using meaningful OKRs and KPIs to drive strategic business value.
  • Proactively research and propose new feature ideas, solutions, and proof of concepts that continuously push boundaries.
  • Develop a deep understanding of the underlying technologies, architectures, and data flows powering your applications to effectively collaborate with engineering and data science on technical constraints and solutions.
  • Partner directly with business units and internal client groups to ensure seamless user adoption into daily production and operational workflows.

Basic requirements:

job.description:
FOX News Media is looking for a Director, Insights & Analytics to lead data and analytics for our subscription services portfolio. Anchored today by FOX Nation, a premium subscription streaming service, this leader will own all subscription analytics across the full and growing portfolio.

This is an entrepreneurial, high-visibility role for someone who is energized by ambiguity and wants to help build a business, not just report on it. You will be equally comfortable writing complex SQL to get to the data yourself, defining a brand-new subscriber metric framework from scratch, and presenting acquisition and retention insight to senior executives.

You will own the full subscriber lifecycle covering acquisition, engagement, and retention and translating consumer and revenue data into clear, decision-ready narratives that shape content, marketing, product, and pricing strategy across our subscription products.  This role will have two direct reports who will be focused on optimizing marketing strategies, spend to drive acquisition, retention and engagement on our platforms.

  • Own end-to-end subscription analytics for FOX Nation and, as the portfolio grows, for additional subscription services across FOX News Media, spanning acquisition, onboarding, engagement, retention, churn, win-back, and lifetime value
  • Independently access, query, and interrogate data using advanced SQL, you will frequently be the one getting to the answer directly, not waiting on it

  • Manage and develop two Managers, setting priorities across business units, allocating coverage as demand shifts, and reviewing analytical work before it reaches senior stakeholders
  • Partner with Marketing, CRM, Content, Product, Finance, and Data Engineering to turn insight into action across the full subscriber lifecycle
  • Analyze cohorts, subscriber segments, pricing/packaging, promotional performance, and CRM impact to inform acquisition and retention strategy
  • Serve as a trusted analytics partner to senior stakeholders (VP/SVP/C-suite and cross-company partners), delivering concise, executive-ready narratives that drive decisions
  • Have regular strategic discussions around content spend, marketing spend, operational strategies and how they related to subscription analytics
  • Support the convergence of FOX Nation with the FOX One ecosystem, ensuring measurement consistency and a unified view of the subscriber
  • Establish and uphold strong data integrity, governance, and metric-definition standards across all subscription reporting
  • Partner with Data Engineering to influence data architecture, scalability, and reliability (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks) as the subscription business grows

job.title: Senior Manager, Experiential & Events
job.description:
At FOX Experiences + Design, boldness fuels our passion. We ignite awareness and forge meaningful connections across FOX’s diverse brands and our audiences through meticulously crafted, impactful experiences. Size isn’t our measure; we prioritize impact, meticulously planning events that resonate deeply with audiences and amplify reach beyond limits. Fueled by a relentless pursuit of excellence and unwavering audience-centricity, we cultivate a culture of fearless collaboration that transcends teams and industries. Our diverse team, architects of audacity, builds bridges, fosters innovation, and unlocks unprecedented synergy. We embrace bold risks with calculated precision, transforming potential challenges into springboards for success that propel FOX forward. We are an internal brand engagement and experience agency providing strategy, creative solutions, and measurable deliverables in events, activations, design, and technology to all divisions of FOX Corporation, including FOX Entertainment, FOX Sports, TUBI, Ad Sales, FOX News, Distribution, and FOX Corporate.

We are seeking a dependable Senior Manager, Event & Experiential with a high degree of ethical compass, who thrives on high energy, moves fast, thinks big, and LOVES ENTERTAINMENT! This individual will demonstrate strong ownership of projects, bringing original thinking, sharp execution, and creative strategy to deliver elevated, meaningful engagements that build and maintain trust with fans, stakeholders, and internal teams. They are a go-getter, specializing in big picture ideation, creative solution development, and full project ownership. This role requires anticipating stakeholder needs, providing creative solutions, and expertly leading and inspiring teams to create events and activations, sometimes with minimal oversight, ensuring stakeholder goals are brought to life.

Regular, on-site attendance at the workplace for a minimum of four (4) days per week is an essential function of the position. The selected candidate must be able to reliably meet this requirement.

A SNAPSHOT OF YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead and manage successful, on-budget small-to-midsize in-person and virtual events, corporate meetings, premiere events, presentations, and activations
  • Stay “in the know” on the hottest industry trends through research and ideation
  • Oversee and own event playbook, creating workback schedules, DACI, invoice tracking, and budget reporting
  • Communicate and collaborate clearly with FED Technology and Design teams, with an understanding of technical event needs and graphic specifications, and manage production
  • Manage all event logistics, including food and beverage, design, rentals, layouts, rooming lists, parking, budgets, and recaps
  • Lead administrative support, tech, and freelancers on mid to large sized events with minimal oversight, and lead stakeholder calls
  • Maintain strong relationships with stakeholders, effectively manage their expectations, ask thoughtful, strategic questions to inform stakeholder decisions, actively listen to understand stakeholder objectives, define key goals, and develop actionable plans that support informed decision-making and advance strategic priorities
  • Track, measure, and report on event success using data metrics and KPIs to realize business goals
  • Negotiate hotel contracts and vendor agreements
  • Provide event recaps and billing debriefs
  • Support senior business leads on larger-scale events, meetings, and hospitality programs, both domestic and international, as needed

WHAT YOU WILL NEED

  • Bachelor’s degree or other relevant events and event production experience
  • 7+ years of hands-on and supervisory experience in Entertainment and/or Corporate Events, or with an agency
  • Passion for Entertainment, broad knowledge of distribution networks, digital platforms, and streamers, and deep understanding of their businesses, fandoms, and corresponding individual cultures
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills, and can communicate event ideas and turn them into reality
  • Ability to organize, prioritize, and multitask in a fast-paced, deadline-oriented, and ever-changing environment without administrative support, and be able to make quick, reflexive decisions under pressure with grace
  • Ability to travel depending on project and business needs
  • Ability to work overtime, over many days during a project, without skipping a beat and staying sharp
  • Current knowledge of restaurants and venues, positive relationships with relevant vendors
  • Proficiency in Google Suite, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Monday.com, basic database applications, and A.I. internet searches
  • Willingness to get “hands dirty” with packing, unpacking, and lifting boxes, setting up a production office, and standing on feet for more than 4 hours at a time while on-site at events

NICE TO HAVE BUT NOT A DEALBREAKER

  • Beginner to intermediate experience with textual analysis in analytics reporting and AI

  • Maintain inventory levels and conduct full inventories.
  • Schedule and oversee necessary maintenance and repairs on kitchen appliances.

  • Partner with NBCU departments to ensure compliance and safety tasks are addressed promptly

  • Support Facility Operations and support teams with event set-ups
  • Interior & exterior painting and general carpentry tasks as needed
  • Attend bid walks and assist with project oversite when required  
  • Other duties as assigned

  • Cool Under Pressure – You handle stressful situations with ease and professionalism while juggling multiple stakeholders and competing priorities
  • Communicates with ease – You have a way with words; written and verbal
  • Tech-savvy – You are an MS Office whiz and can take on new software with ease

What You Have:

  • High school diploma or equivalent required;
  • 3+ years of experience in building engineering, facilities management or a related field or equivalent
  • Understanding of Class A commercial building operations
  • Demonstrated proficiency with HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and building automation systems (BAS)
  • Knowledge of applicable building codes, safety standards, regulatory requirements, and energy efficiency practices.
  • Valid state Class C Driver’s License

What Would Make You Stand Out:

  • Associates degree or technical certification in building systems
  • Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills
  • Relevant trade license or certifications (HVAC, electrical, plumbing, low voltage)
  • EPA Universal Certification for refrigerants
  • Understanding of Class A high rise operations and REG 4
