job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview:

Owns compensation strategy and execution for the company's AI/ML, product, and technology organizations — the highest-stakes, most competitive talent pools in the business. Partners with engineering and product leadership, recruiting, and Total Rewards leadership to design pay structures that win and retain talent in an AI labor market where comp packages move fast and get very large, very publicly.  

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Compensation strategy for tech/AI orgs: Design base, bonus, and equity structures for ML research, applied AI, and core engineering/product roles, including specialized retention and sign-on packages for high-demand AI talent
  • Market intelligence: Track fast-moving AI comp benchmarks (base salary inflation, mega equity grants, competitor offer data) and translate that into internal guidance before the market moves again
  • Leveling & career frameworks: Refine and maintain job architecture and leveling guides for technical ladders (IC and management tracks) that hold up as roles evolve quickly
  • Executive & critical-talent comp: Structure offers and retention packages for senior technical leaders and other business-critical hires, including complex negotiations
  • Equity strategy: Partner with Legal/Finance on equity plan design, refresh grant strategy, and dilution management specific to tech talent pools
  • Cross-functional partnership: Act as the trusted comp advisor to engineering/product VPs and recruiting leaders — fast turnaround on offer construction, counter-offer strategy, and internal equity checks
  • Program governance: Ensure pay equity, compliance, and consistency across the technical org as it scales, while staying flexible enough to move at hiring speed

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • 12+ years in compensation, with meaningful time designing comp for AI/ML or high-growth technical orgs at a large or high-growth tech company
  • Direct experience with the current AI talent market — comfort with unconventional, large, or fast-negotiated packages
  • Strong quantitative/analytical background; fluent in comp modeling, market data tools (Radford, Aon, etc.), and equity mechanics

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Track record advising senior technical and product leaders directly, not just running programs from a distance
  • Executive presence — able to say no to a VP or push back on a comp ask with data, not just process

 

Paramount Skydance Corporation (NASDAQ: PSKY) is a leading global media and entertainment company that creates premium content and experiences for audiences worldwide. Driven by iconic studios, networks and streaming services, Paramount's portfolio of consumer brands includes CBS, Showtime Networks, Paramount Pictures, Nickelodeon, MTV, Comedy Central, BET, Paramount+, and Pluto TV, among others. Paramount delivers the largest share of the U.S. television audience and boasts one of the industry's most important and extensive libraries of TV and film titles. In addition to offering innovative streaming services and digital video products, the company provides powerful capabilities in production, distribution and advertising solutions.

job.title: CBS Sports Assignment Editor, Golazo (Freelance)
job.description:
#WeAreParamount on a mission to unleash the power of content… you in?
We’ve got the brands, we’ve got the stars, we’ve got the power to achieve our mission to entertain the planet – now all we’re missing is… YOU! Becoming a part of Paramount means joining a team of passionate people who not only recognize the power of content but also enjoy a touch of fun and uniqueness. Together, we co-create moments that matter – both for our audiences and our employees – and aim to leave a positive mark on culture.

 

Overview 

CBS Sports seeks an Assignment Editor for a full-time freelance position that will support productions for CBS Sports Golazo Network, a year-round, 24/7 home for soccer fans with free matches, highlights, news and analysis. The Assignment Editor must stay up to date on soccer events to prioritize and anticipate needs for coverage and content acquisition, while conducting newsgathering across multiple CBS platforms, including but not limited to CBS Sports’ linear and digital productions, our partners across CBS News, Radio, and Affiliates, as well as schools, their local stations, and social platforms.  The Assignment Editor must be able to aggressively respond to breaking news and requests, and work closely with internal teams and operations to ensure all audio and video material is recorded and distributed across productions and platforms. The Assignment Editor may also be responsible for hiring ENG crews and making sure their needs are met and coordinating with remote productions providing live and taped content for all shows. The Assignment Editor will team with other desk staff on schedule and calendar planning for all soccer events, related coverage, and guests.  The Assignment Editor will maintain daily contact with studio producers to anticipate, respond to, and meet their show needs.  The Assignment Editor will meet regularly with editorial staff to discuss new ideas and content, will have close contact with Legal and Business Affairs contributors to navigate rights and clearance issues. This job will be primarily an in-person role, and shifts will include regularly working on nights and weekends.

 

Responsibilities

  • Identify and acquire content for use across Golazo Network and related productions, including news conferences, interviews and highlights. 

  • Conduct newsgathering across multiple CBS Sports platforms; React immediately to breaking news and requests to support all soccer coverage

  • Must be able to work in a fast-paced environment, and communicate with urgency and clarity to producers, on-air talent and production associates. 

  • Must be skilled at identifying news and emerging storylines; gathering ideas and content for potential storytelling to enhance and support coverage across CBS Sports platforms.

  • Use deep sports knowledge, an insatiable curiosity and sound news judgment, to support storytelling that is timely, relevant, innovative and inclusive.

  • Demonstrate an understanding of sports media production, including knowledge of successful content creation for television, digital video, social media, or similar programming  

  • Stay informed and up to date on soccer events and storylines; Provide story ideas and recommend content for use in coverage

  • Proactively identify and suggest solutions to address potential coverage  

  • Hire freelance ENG crews

  • Understand compliance with rights and clearance guidelines 

  • Must be able to handle logistics under deadline

  • Schedule and calendar planning on all soccer events

  • Communicate regularly with producers on content

  • Gather transmission information (fiber, satellite, streaming, etc.) for televised games

  • Work closely with media asset management to ensure all games and content are being recorded and archived 

 

Qualifications

  • Strong knowledge of soccer across multiple leagues

  • Demonstrated depth of knowledge in fiber, satellite, cellular, FTP, and viral newsgathering procedures

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously

  • Must have experience with variety of approaches to Internet searches and be fluent in electronic newsgathering techniques, including quickly navigating the Internet and best practices for utilizing social media.

  • Strong editorial judgment and a resourceful ability to conduct content research and a passion for discovering content and sharing information is a must.

  • Must be able to work nights, weekends, and flexible hours.

  • Able to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment under deadlines and prioritize assignments

  • Strong leadership, interpersonal and communication skills

  • Must have excellent writing and communication skills and demonstrate keen attention to detail.

  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously 

  • Must be able to work with limited supervision while also thriving in a team-oriented environment

  • History of working collaboratively across departments with peers and colleagues to advance content and coverage

  • Must have experience performing well under pressure, including a proven track record of responding effectively to feedback even up against deadlines for air. 

 

Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in a television- or digital-production related field

  • Bachelor’s degree in journalism or equivalent training and experience

  • Prior experience in sports journalism is a plus

 

 

 

 

CBS Sports, a year-round leader in cross-platform sports coverage, broadcasts a portfolio of events on the CBS Television Network, including THE NFL ON CBS; college football, including the Big Ten ON CBS; college basketball, including the NCAA Division I Men's Basketball Championship; golf, including The Masters®, PGA Championship and PGA TOUR; soccer, including the UEFA Champions League and NWSL; and CBS SPORTS SPECTACULAR. 

In addition, the division includes CBS SPORTS NETWORK, the 24-hour cable home of CBS Sports which televises live sports programming throughout the year, including college football and basketball games, UEFA Champions League and Europa League action, Italy's Serie A matches, Concacaf national team competitions, as well as a full slate of original programming and studio coverage. 

CBS Sports also delivers an extensive lineup of global soccer coverage on Paramount+, including every UEFA club competition match, all Serie A matches as well as Concacaf national team competitions, and produces INSIDE THE NFL for Paramount+. CBS Sports Digital's multi-platform offerings include CBSSports.com and the CBS Sports apps for mobile and connected TV devices; the 24/7 streaming sports news network CBS Sports HQ; 247Sports; MaxPreps; CBS Sports fantasy games; and SportsLine.

The Director of Global Title Marketing, Kids & Family is tasked with leading the development, execution, analysis, and ongoing optimization of global marketing campaigns for select Paramount+ Kids & Family titles.   This role serves as a key cross-functional leader and steward of both individual titles and broader franchises. Developing campaigns that connect with kids across different age groups while also motivating parents, caregivers, and family co-viewers.   The ideal candidate has solid marketing strategy skills and deep knowledge of kids entertainment, family viewing habits, and franchise building. They also understand how young audiences discover and engage with content as those habits keep changing. The Director must be a great leader, compelling storyteller, collaborative partner, and forward-thinking problem-solver who can manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment.   This is an onsite position at our New York or Burbank office.   

Responsibilities include but not limited to:

  • Lead the development, execution, analysis, and ongoing optimization of global go-to-market strategies
  • Translate series, film, character, and franchise attributes into differentiated campaign strategies that resonate with kids, parents, caregivers, and family co-viewers.
  • Develop audience strategies that account for distinct developmental stages, interests, viewing behaviors, and levels of parental influence across preschool, kids, tweens, teens, and family audiences.
  • Identify clear campaign objectives, audience priorities, strategic opportunities, and measures of success. Holding team members and partners accountable throughout campaign development and execution.
  • Apply a global perspective while recognizing regional differences in family dynamics, cultural relevance, content discovery, and children’s media consumption.
  • Ensure campaign strategies and executions are age-appropriate, inclusive, brand-safe, and aligned with applicable privacy, advertising, and platform guidelines.
  • Proactively identify key milestones, connect workstreams, resolve challenges, and ensure that creative and tactical executions ladder up to the overall strategy.
  • Brief cross-functional teams on campaign strategy so each discipline can develop a cohesive, audience-led plan.
  • Serve as a subject-matter expert and enthusiastic steward of assigned titles, characters, and franchises.
  • Build marketing strategies that support both the immediate title launch and long-term health, relevance, and growth
  • Partner with franchise, consumer products, licensing, retail, games, publishing, experiences, and other teams, where applicable. Creating related opportunities across the broader Paramount ecosystem.
  • Foster productive and trusting relationships with key stakeholders to ensure plans are developed and executed in a timely, collaborative, and efficient manner.
  • Maintain and build the team’s knowledge of the Kids & Family landscape, including audience behaviors, platform trends, franchise development, and responsible marketing practices.
  • Drive alignment among senior leadership and external partners. This includes: creators, executive producers, filmmakers, talent, studios, and co-production partners.
  • Clearly articulate the audience opportunity, campaign positioning, and strategic choices, behind recommendations.
  • Drive innovative thinking to develop 360-degree global stunts, partnerships, activations, and breakthrough campaign ideas that can generate excitement among kids and families.
  • Identify opportunities to bring titles and characters into the real world through family experiences, fan events, cultural moments, educational initiatives, and strategic brand partnerships.
  • Brief and lead “big idea” initiatives, managing internal teams and agency partners through execution.
  • Evaluate ideas through the distinct lenses of child appeal, parent or caregiver relevance, family participation, brand safety, and earned-media potential.
  • Partner with Media and Campaign Management teams to lead the development and execution of media campaigns across platforms that reach kids, parents, caregivers, and family audiences.
  • Understand the challenges of reaching young audiences. This includes streaming, digital video, social platforms, gaming environments, connected television, family programming, and media focused on parents.
  • Identify opportunities to reach parents and caregivers as content decision-makers while also building organic excitement and cultural relevance among young audiences.
  • Analyze audience research, campaign performance, competitive intelligence, and cultural trends to identify opportunities and inform strategy. Lead cross-functional reviews of awareness, consideration, engagement, viewing, acquisition, retention, co-viewing, repeat viewing, and franchise affinity. Turning data into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Combine quantitative data with qualitative audience knowledge. Recognizing that parents, caregivers, and children may each play different roles in content discovery and viewing decisions.

 

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
  • 7+ years of entertainment marketing experience. With demonstrated experience developing campaigns for kids & family content, family entertainment, animation, or youth-focused brands.

 

Additional Qualifications:

  • Experience leading multi-channel campaigns from strategy through execution and performance analysis.
  • Solid awareness of the distinct needs and behaviors of kids, tweens, parents, caregivers, and family co-viewing audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to market to young audiences responsibly and navigate relevant brand-safety, privacy, advertising, and platform considerations.
  • Solid interpersonal skills and a proven ability to manage relationships with senior internal stakeholders, creators, talent, filmmakers, studios, agencies, and external partners.
  • Robust strategic judgment and the ability to translate audience, cultural, creative, and business insights into actionable campaign strategies.
  • Data-driven marketer with experience analyzing campaign performance and applying learnings to optimize results.
  • Ability to manage multiple titles, priorities, and stakeholders within a dynamic and highly collaborative environment.
  • Exemplary written, verbal, and presentation skills, with solid attention to detail.
  • Experience marketing original series, films, animation, preschool content, or established Kids & Family franchises for a streaming service, studio, network, or entertainment brand.
  • Experience developing campaigns that speak to both young audiences and parents or caregivers.
  • Insight with emerging Kids & Family creators, platforms, fandoms, and digital content-discovery behaviors.
  • Experience developing global campaigns and adapting strategies for different markets and cultures.
  • Genuine affinity for Kids & Family entertainment, characters, storytelling, and fandom.
  • A collaborative spirit, creative instincts, and a great sense of humor.

 

Paramount+, a direct-to-consumer digital subscription video on-demand and live streaming service from Paramount Global, combines live sports, breaking news, and a mountain of entertainment. The premium streaming service features an expansive library of original series, hit shows and popular movies across every genre from world-renowned brands and production studios, including BET, CBS, Comedy Central, MTV, Nickelodeon, Paramount Pictures and the Smithsonian Channel. Overview:

 

We are seeking a highly skilled and proficient Manager, Application Security and Compliance to lead the design, implementation, and maintenance of our Oracle Fusion and Oracle EPM security architecture. In this role, you will serve as the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for application security and Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance across our enterprise systems. You will be in charge of ensuring strict Segregation of Duties (SoD), managing user access governance, and mitigating risk across Oracle Fusion (ERP, Procurement, and HCM), Oracle EPM, and Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC). The ideal candidate brings a blend of technical expertise in Oracle Identity and Access Management (IAM) and a deep knowledge of IT General Controls (ITGC) and compliance frameworks.


Responsibilities:

 

  • Security Architecture and Role Management Design and Maintenance: Create custom job roles and duty roles. Keep data security policies updated in Oracle Fusion (ERP, Procurement, HCM), Oracle EPM, and FDI environments.

  • Identity Management: Leverage Oracle IAM to manage user provisioning, de-provisioning, and identity lifecycles. OIC Security: Define and govern security roles, privileges, and access controls within Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC).

  • Access Governance: Oversee user access reviews and certification campaigns, with an opportunity to leverage Oracle Access Governance for automated provisioning and analytics.

  • Compliance & Risk Management SOX Compliance: Ensure all Oracle environments strictly adhere to SOX compliance, ITGCs, and internal security policies.

  • Risk Mitigation: Implement, configure, and manage Oracle Fusion Risk Management Cloud (Advanced Access Controls and Advanced Financial Controls) to continuously monitor and uphold Segregation of Duties (SoD).

  • Audit Support: Serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external auditors, providing necessary reports, evidence, and system walkthroughs.

  • Remediation: Identify security vulnerabilities or SoD conflicts and proactively design and execute remediation plans.

 

Basic Qualifications:

 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Accounting Information Systems, or a related field.

  • 5+ years of experience specializing in Oracle Application Security and IT Audit/Compliance. Strong knowledge of SOX compliance, COSO framework, and IT General Controls (ITGC).

  • Oracle Fusion Expertise: Proven experience designing and maintaining complex security roles across Oracle Fusion ERP, Procurement, and HCM.

  • Oracle EPM Security: Hands-on experience managing security matrices and user access within Oracle Enterprise Performance Management.

  • Oracle IAM: Sound knowledge and deep hands-on experience with Oracle Identity and Access Management frameworks.

  • Risk Management Cloud: Direct implementation experience with Oracle Fusion Risk Management Cloud (AAC/AFC) for SoD and transaction monitoring.

Production Editor 

Location: Remote

A production editor serves in a variety of capacities to prepare editorial content for Hearst Newspapers print editions, including:

  • Page layout and section organization
  • Wire news decision-making
  • Copy editing for print
  • Page editing, including headline and caption writing, photo selection and trimming stories to fit.
  • Proofing pages
  • Typesetting pages in time for deadline.

Depending on the size of the newspaper, depth of editing and other factors, the production editor may perform all of these tasks for a page, set of pages or a section; or play one or two of these roles on a section or set of pages. Often, production editors will serve in one or two of these roles for part of a shift, and in other sets of these roles for another part of the shift.

Being flexible, adaptable and able to flex between the roles and vary the depth of editing and finishing is a crucial part of this role.

Key qualifications

  • Page layout and section organization.
  • Copy editing, including headline writing and caption writing 
  • Savvy to finish and typeset a page on time
  • Experience in print news production
  • Ability to work with multiple products and multiple people with a customer-service focus.

Specialty Skills

  • Newspaper editing, headline writing and caption writing
  • Aptitude in sports story and page editing a plus
  • Newspaper page proofing
  • Excellent literacy in English
  • CUE/CCI experience plus.

 

Special to this role

While we are looking for editors who can work across topics, this role will primarily be focused on editing and presenting sports news in the Hearst papers throughout Texas, especially focused on Dallas, Houston, San Antonio and Austin.

As such, sports journalism is a specialty sill that is necessary for success, as will the ability to work in other parts of the operation outside of sports.

About Hearst Newspapers:

With 2,500 employees across the nation, HNP encompasses a network of 24 daily and 52 weekly publications, including the San Francisco Chronicle, Houston Chronicle, San Antonio Express-News and Albany Times Union, several top digital-only news and lifestyle sites, marketing services businesses, and entertainment businesses such as King Features Syndicate.

job.description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide. 

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Intro to Position

NPR’s Research, Archives & Data Strategy (RAD) department has a temporary 6-month position for a RAD Information Specialist I (RAD I). RAD information specialists work with all aspects of the storytelling cycle from conception to preservation. We are a cross-functional team of product owners, taxonomists, researchers, archivists, trainers and developers, and we work with everyone at NPR. 

This is a union-represented role covered under the terms of a collective bargaining agreement with SAG-AFTRA.

Responsibilities

This Information Specialist will be responsible for conducting research, producing and maintaining metadata, and delivering training. They will be an agile professional who handles tight deadlines, understands the need for accuracy at all levels, and carries out deep research, investigation and fact-checking in support of reporting and storytelling. They will contribute to multimedia preservation and access efforts, and will create metadata used in the service of the comprehensive record of NPR’s programming. They will be responsible for delivering training, and may also be detailed to work on special projects. Some scheduled weekend hours may be required.

We expect that some skills are stronger than others. We are committed to helping our future colleague expand their skills, as well as learning from the expertise they bring.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience working in a deadline-driven environment
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
  • Proficiency in knowledge and deployment of information resources and services
  • Demonstrated and ongoing awareness of current events and popular culture
  • Evidence of effective writing and verbal presentation skills 
  • Understanding of metadata theory, creation and curation
  • Experience working with audio files
  • Ability to work both independently and on group-driven projects 
  • Interest in sharing current skills and talents with colleagues
  • Ability to both fail and learn fast
  • Ability to professionally flourish alongside and collaborate with busy colleagues in a deadline-driven environment
  • Demonstrated ability to learn and deploy new skills on the job

Preferred Qualifications

  • 1-3 years of experience in the information management or archival field
  • MIS, MLS or MIM from an ALA-accredited institution
  • Experience creating and delivering training, both in person and remotely

Work Location & Requirements

  • NPR Remote-Permitted: This is a remote-permitted role. This role is based out of our Washington, D.C. office, but the employee may choose to work on a remote basis from a location that NPR approves. You will have the option of working (a) remotely from a location of your choosing within the United States that is supported by NPR; (b) on-site at an NPR facility, based on the availability of desks and approval from NPR; or (c) a combination of both. Regardless of where you choose to work from, you may be expected to travel to other locations from time to time to perform the duties of your position.

Job Type

  • This is a temporary (6-month) full-time position.

Hourly Rate:  The U.S. based anticipated hourly rate for this opportunity is $39.66 per hour. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum hourly rate NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

job.description:
We are UMG, the Universal Music Group. We are the world’s leading music company. In everything we do, we are committed to artistry, innovation and entrepreneurship. We own and operate a broad array of businesses engaged in recorded music, music publishing, merchandising, and audiovisual content in more than 60 countries. We identify and develop recording artists and songwriters, and we produce, distribute and promote the most critically acclaimed and commercially successful music to delight and entertain fans around the world.
 

The Strategic Initiatives & Investing team is a highly visible corporate development and investing team within UMG. The group partners with Virgin Music Group's executive leadership, business units, labels, and internal stakeholders to evaluate and execute opportunities across M&A, artist and business deals, catalog acquisitions, joint ventures, new business ventures, and select strategic initiatives. The team is lean and committed to a culture that is rigorous, collaborative, supportive, and fun.


How we LEAD:

The Strategic Initiatives & Investing team is looking for a full-time Senior Manager based in Los Angeles, CA. This is a hands-on corporate development role whose primary focus is financial analysis, valuation, diligence, and transaction execution across M&A, catalog acquisitions in coordination with Chord Music Partners, artist and business deals, joint ventures, and growth investments. The Senior Manager will own discrete transaction and analytical workstreams, develop clear recommendations for senior leaders, and partner with stakeholders across recorded music, publishing, merchandise, D2C, artist services, digital, technology, and marketing. The role will report to the VP, M&A and Strategic Investments, and work closely with other team members. The successful candidate is analytical, proactive, intellectually curious, and able to turn complex information into practical recommendations.


How you'll CREATE:

  • Build and own financial models, valuation analyses, and scenario assessments for potential M&A targets, artist and business deals, catalog acquisitions, joint venture partners, and other growth investments.
  • Manage discrete transaction workstreams, including data requests, financial and commercial diligence, sensitivity analyses, and synthesis of key findings.
  • Analyze deal economics and key terms, pressure-test operating assumptions, and identify value drivers, risks, and potential mitigants.
  • Coordinate with business units and cross-functional partners, including Finance, Legal, Business Affairs, Tax, Accounting, and commercial teams, to gather inputs and advance evaluations.
  • Conduct industry, market, and competitive research to inform valuation assumptions, strategic fit, and investment theses.
  • Prepare concise, executive-ready presentations and recommendations for senior management and other VMG leaders; communicate complex analyses clearly and accurately.
  • Support select strategic initiatives by structuring analyses around growth opportunities, revenue drivers, investment requirements, and business model implications.
  • Maintain transaction materials and improve models, templates, trackers, and processes to support consistent and efficient decision-making.
  • Support post-transaction reviews and performance tracking against the original investment case, where relevant.

Bring your VIBE:

  • 3+ years of relevant work experience in investment banking, corporate development, music IP or catalog investing, private equity, transaction advisory, consulting or strategy with a strong financial focus, or a similar field.
  • Direct experience with music IP, catalog investing, recorded music, publishing, or artist deal economics strongly preferred.
  • Strong financial modeling and valuation experience, including operating models, DCF, IRR, scenario and sensitivity analyses, and new venture economics.
  • Demonstrated ability to own analytical and diligence workstreams independently, with strong attention to detail and sound judgment.
  • Proven ability to synthesize complex findings into concise executive recommendations and presentations.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint; proficiency in Word required. Experience with HFM, SAP, or similar financial systems is a plus.
  • High level of intellectual curiosity, particularly around music, technology, and entertainment, with a proactive approach to identifying opportunities and risks.
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Highly collaborative and personable, with strong interpersonal and team-working skills.

job.title: Editor, The Interview
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

Over the past two years, “The Interview” has made itself a trustworthy New York Times brand and a destination, where artists (Mick Jagger, Nicolas Cage, Charlize Theron), politicians (Zohran Mamdani, Chuck Schumer), athletes (Karl-Anthony Towns), influential figures in the media (Megyn Kelly, Andrew Schulz, Tucker Carlson), at the center of a story (Scott Pelley, Gisele Pelicot) and beyond sit down for thoughtful, wide-ranging, challenging, fun, news-making video conversations about their lives and ideas.

We are seeking an experienced editor to, in collaboration with the executive producer, guide the editorial selection, writing and structure of the show. You will need to be a total omnivore — as excited about and adept at figuring out the best approach for an interview with John Fetterman as Lena Dunham — and a positive, motivating leader on the team. You need to believe in the power of good conversation to reveal subjects and illuminate ideas and also understand how to structure those conversations to be as compelling as possible — which will at times be free-wheeling and loose and at other times tighter and more targeted. You must have a keen understanding of the moment — in the news, in the culture — and know how to translate that understanding for a show that works on a few different tracks at once, with some bookings coming together far in advance and others really responding to a news moment. You must be skilled in writing for video and have a proven track record of working with hosts, embracing their approach to interviews and figuring out how to bring out their best work. The right candidate is a curious, creative thinker, a rigorous journalist who is filled with ideas, excited to build and evolve the show, and thrives in a collaborative, deadline-driven environment. You will report to the Executive Producer.

This is an in-office position, based in New York City and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance.

Responsibilities:

  • Edit episodes, with attention to pacing, framing, clarity, tone, structure and visual continuity and storytelling
  • Give final sign-off on episodes and social clips
  • Collaborate with the executive producer and hosts on setting editorial agenda and guest selection
  • Help guide the prep process with a team of talented producers to ensure episodes have clarity of thought, logical sequencing of ideas and are structured for maximum impact, while also leaving room for the best part: the surprises that come in actual conversation
  • Know how to guide a host during an interview, when things don't go as planned and the carefully prepared script needs to be thrown out the window
  • Set production schedules and drive production for a small team that is always making several episodes at once (often booking one interview, prepping two, recording two, editing one, and mixing one all in the same week)
  • Communicate notes and feedback to hosts and producers clearly, directly, quickly and compassionately
  • Work closely with producers to help them do their best work on deadline while they juggle their many responsibilities
  • Anticipate challenges in episodes and proactively solve them
  • On occasion, be able to respond to breaking news moments with a sense of urgency, while staying true to the longform, in-depth, conversational identity of the show.
  • Exercise calm under pressure and motivate the team
  • Be a true partner for the executive producer
  • May have input into staffing decisions and will be required to assess performance and provide feedback to staff
  • Welcome feedback, incorporating editorial notes quickly, working cooperatively and coming up with creative solutions when disagreements arise
  • Employ editorial judgment that's reflective of Times mission of independent journalism
  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand the world.

Basic Qualifications:

  • At least 7 years experience in audio or video production, including several as an editor
  • Highly skilled at every aspect of editing
  • Experience working with and coaching hosts
  • Experience overseeing soup-to-nuts audio or video production
  • Experience navigating a newsroom environment and solid news judgment

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Proven ability to foster an inclusive, motivating and innovative environment.
  • Collaborative spirit is a must.
  • Believes in The New York Times' mission of independence and is dedicated to being a part of our innovation and growth.
  • Able to uphold the editorial standards of The Times.

job.title: Executive Producer, The Interview
job.description:
The mission of The New York Times is to seek the truth and help people understand the world. That means independent journalism is at the heart of all we do as a company. It’s why we have a world-renowned newsroom that sends journalists to report on the ground from nearly 160 countries. It’s why we focus deeply on how our readers will experience our journalism, from print to audio to a world-class digital and app destination. And it’s why our business strategy centers on making journalism so good that it’s worth paying for. 

Over the past two years, “The Interview” has made itself a trustworthy New York Times brand and a destination, where artists (Mick Jagger, Nicolas Cage, Charlize Theron), politicians (Zohran Mamdani, Chuck Schumer), athletes (Karl-Anthony Towns), influential figures in the media (Megyn Kelly, Andrew Schulz, Tucker Carlson), at the center of a story (Scott Pelley, Gisele Pelicot) and beyond sit down for thoughtful, wide-ranging, challenging, fun, news-making conversations about their lives and ideas. And now we are looking for the next Executive Producer to lead the show.

We're looking for a senior editorial leader with strong, relevant experience running a video show, working with hosts (we have two great ones: Lulu Garcia-Navarro and David Marchese) and leading show teams made up of talented staffers with audio and video backgrounds. You will drive the show's creative and editorial direction, and work to grow The Interview's already considerable audience across Times-owned platforms, YouTube and social media. You will be responsible for setting the editorial priorities, managing the production team that delivers the show each week and communicating with stakeholders across the newsroom on timely, impactful conversations. Because you will work closely with the staff of the New York Times Magazine, having experience in an ideas-driven magazine environment is a plus.

You are a curious, creative thinker, a stylish editor, a decisive and compassionate manager, and an excellent communicator. You should be comfortable working in video, excited by an evolving media landscape and motivated by booking big guests in important moments, whether that's the the definitive conversation with a Hollywood icon, a rising political star or a newsmaker at the center of a breaking story. You should be a fan of what The Interview has built, and excited to keep building and growing and evolving the show. You will report to the editor-in-chief of the New York Times Magazine.

This is an in-office position, based in New York City and includes regular attendance in the office four days each week. There may be some flexibility to work remotely per your departmental guidance.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the overall editorial and creative strategy for The Interview, setting the editorial goals and guiding the coverage for the show

  • Oversee the editorial quality of each episode, ensuring strong structure, pacing, framing and tone that aligns with the overall strategic goals of the franchise and the standards of the Times

  • Oversee workflow to ensure that several episodes at various stages of production are being made in the smartest, most efficient and sustainable way possible

  • Work closely with the hosts, booker and editor to solicit and field pitches and book a compelling mix of guests

  • Own all expressions of the show, including onsite and off-platform, all mediums (video, audio, digital), episode packaging, titles and thumbnails, in coordination with the Audience team

  • Collaborate with video operations and the Shows team to shape the visual identity of The Interview, including set design, camera approach, clips and other media to enhance each episode

  • Collaborate with the Magazine's photo, fact-checking and copy departments

  • Cultivate relationships with Times journalists across the newsroom whose valuable perspectives can be invaluable during the prep phase for any given interview

  • Lead communication with and seek feedback from the masthead on high-profile interviews

  • Manage and mentor a team of producers (some with audio backgrounds, some with video backgrounds), setting clear expectations, supporting their growth, assessing performance and providing regular feedback

  • Work with the audience team to understand audience trends and performance analysis, translating insights into recommendations

  • Create a culture of productive experimentation, because the show should never get stuck in its ways and the environment we are publishing into is always changing

  • Demonstrate support and understanding of our value of journalistic independence and a strong commitment to our mission to seek the truth and help people understand

Basic Qualifications:

  • 15 years of experience leading editorial teams, including significant experience running a host-driven conversational audio or video show

  • Strong experience working on high profile interviews in culture and politics

  • Highly skilled at every aspect of editing at the show level, from structuring episodes (both before and after the interview) and pacing to line editing and reviewing cuts

  • Experience managing and collaborating with multidisciplinary teams, including hosts, audio or video producers, audience strategists and others

  • Comfortable interpreting platform analytics and audience insights to inform editorial decisions

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Strong organization and communication skills, with the ability to make decisions and set priorities in a fast-moving news environment

Reporting to the Senior Director, Total Compensation, the Senior Manager, Total Compensation leads a team of two Senior Specialists in the governance, strategic design, implementation, and continuous improvement of CBC/Radio-Canada's core total compensation and associated programs. ESPN LA Part-Time Digital Content Creator

(Los Angeles, CA)  

Good Karma Sports and ESPN Los Angeles seek a self-motivated and creative Part-Time Digital Content Creator to join our team. The ideal candidate will play an important role in producing social and sales content for ESPN Los Angeles and will also help develop new ideas to market our brand to our partners.  

Career responsibilities include but are not limited to: 

  • Capture, create, edit, and livestream content for show-specific, partner, social media, and digital platforms, including video, photo, and graphics across ESPN Los Angeles assets.
  • Collaborate with Marketing Consultants and the sales team to support partner-related content ideas, campaign goals, and revenue-generating opportunities.
  • Support talent during projects and shoots by helping bring creative concepts to life while following partner guidelines and campaign expectations.
  • Ensure that partner goals are met and campaign deliverables are executed.
  • Produce recaps, sizzle reels, and specs for social and sales purposes.
  • Actively participate in Digital Team Connect meetings to share ideas, best practices, and social media recommendations across Good Karma.
  • Be an integral part of a team that communicates directly with existing and potential social media fans of ESPN Los Angeles’ assets.
  • Travel to help capture events, live shows/podcasts, in-game content, and more.
  • When applicable, assist with setup, teardown, and other marketing responsibilities at our events and live remotes.
  • Integrate AI tools into daily workflows to enhance and optimize digital content, improve communication, project coordination and operational efficiency while maintaining appropriate human oversight.
  • Collaborate across departments to support organizational goals and perform other duties as assigned.
  • Be a Good Karma ambassador by demonstrating our core values: Be Honest, Work Hard, Over Deliver, Listen, Teamwork, and Follow Through.

Preferred knowledge, skills and qualifications 

  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite, including Premiere Pro, After Effects, and Photoshop, as well as Canva and PowerPoint
  • Ability to set up camera, lights, and audio equipment 
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to work within tight deadlines
  • Experience with Illustrator, Adobe Animate, vMix, CapCut, and Sway is a plus
  • Knowledge of Switcher Studio, OBS, Streamyard or livestreaming platforms
  • Ability to participate in brainstorm sessions and ideate marketing solutions
  • Valid driver's license and ability to drive station vehicles to and from events as needed.

This is a part-time, hourly position.

Pay Transparency: The anticipated starting hourly range for California-based individuals expressing interest in this position is $18.42 - $20.00 per hour. The hourly rate is to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, and location of the applicant, as well as internal and external equity.

Opportunity for Growth  

Teammates have the opportunity to continuously learn and grow within Good Karma and are responsible for representing Good Karma Sports, our story, and our core values inside and outside the workplace. Teammates are encouraged to take a proactive role in building relationships and seeking opportunities throughout the company.  

How to Apply  

Apply by submitting resume to www.goodkarmasports.com/careers. All are encouraged to apply.  

About Good Karma Sports

Good Karma Sports is a sports media and marketing company that helps brands build meaningful connections with fans in and around the game. Combining national reach, regional expertise and deep local relationships, the company develops and executes multi-platform strategies across audio, podcasts, video, digital, social, talent, live experiences and premium sports partnerships. 

For nearly 30 years, Good Karma has paired sports-first expertise and trusted relationships with best-in-class execution to deliver results for brands, publishers, leagues, teams, communities and fans. Today, Good Karma Sports has more than 500 teammates across 12 offices nationwide and has been recognized as a Best Place to Work by Front Office Sports, Sports Business Journal and USA TODAY.

## 

Good Karma Sports is an Equal Opportunity Employer.  We consistently renew our commitment to creating and maintaining an inclusive workplace for all.  We foster integrity, respect within the workplace, and believe that the foundation of our success is our collective differences and diversity of thought.  We welcome all to help us continue to build a community that embodies and promotes diversity, inclusion, and belonging for all.

The audio revolution is here – and iHeart is leading it!  iHeartMedia, the number one audio company in America, reaches 90% of Americans every month -- a monthly audience that’s twice the size of any other audio company – almost three times the size of the largest TV network – and almost 4 times the size of the largest ad-supported music streaming service.  In fact, we have:

  • More #1 rated markets than the next two largest radio companies combined;

  • We’re the largest podcast publisher, with more monthly downloads than the second- and third-largest podcast publishers combined. Podcasting, the fastest-growing new media, today has more monthly users than streaming music services or Netflix;

  • iHeart is the home of many of the country’s most popular and trusted on-air personalities and podcast influencers, who build important connections with hundreds of communities across America;

  • We create and produce some of the most popular and well-known branded live music events in America, including the iHeartRadio Music Festival, the iHeartRadio Music Awards, the iHeartCountry Festival, iHeartRadio Fiesta Latina and the iHeartRadio Jingle Ball Tour;

  • iHeartRadio is the #1 streaming radio digital service in America;

  • Our social media footprint is 7 times larger than the next largest audio service; and

  • We have the only complete audio ad technology stack in the industry for all forms of audio, from on demand to broadcast radio, digital streaming radio and podcasting, which bring data, targeting and attribution to all forms of audio at an unparalleled scale.  As a result, we’re able to combine our strong leadership position in audience reach, usage and ad tech with powerful tools and insights for our sales organizations to help them build success for their clients at a more efficient cost than any other option. 

Because we reach almost every community in America, we’re committed to providing a range of programming that reflects the diversity of the many communities we serve – and our company reflects that same kind of diversity.  Our company values stress collaboration, curiosity, welcoming dissent, accepting mistakes in the pursuit of new ideas, and respect for everyone.

Only one company in America has the #1 position in everything audio: iHeartMedia!

If you’re excited about this role but don’t feel your experience aligns perfectly with the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway.  At iHeartMedia we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace and are looking for teammates passionate about what we do!

                                                                             

What We Need:

iHeart is looking for a Mobile Growth Specialist who treats clean, accurate attribution as the foundation of their work. The ideal candidate has direct, working knowledge of mobile measurement and can own it reliably, while also running effective paid campaigns and lifecycle programs that grow downloads and usage.

job.title: Multimedia Journalist (MMJ)
job.description:
CBS Austin (KEYE) is looking for a Multimedia Journalist to gather and share impactful stories in one of the fastest-growing and most dynamic markets in the country.

Austin and Central Texas are home to major stories every day, from state government and rapid growth to education, public safety, technology, transportation, and the issues affecting families across our communities. We’re looking for a journalist who is curious, competitive and ready to be in the middle of those stories.

As an MMJ, you will enterprise original story ideas, develop sources and report, shoot, write and edit compelling stories for our audiences. You’ll have opportunities to work alongside a photographer on larger assignments and special coverage, while continuing to strengthen your skills as a self-sufficient multimedia journalist.

This position works three weekdays and weekend shifts, playing an important role in driving our weekend coverage while remaining connected to the weekday content center and major developing stories.

You should be comfortable producing content across platforms, and ready to grow your live presence. Our MMJs contribute daily to television, streaming, digital, social media and mobile, with opportunities to go live across platforms as stories develop.

Responsibilities include:

  • Enterprise and pitch original, impactful story ideas
  • Develop sources and build relationships throughout Central Texas
  • Report, shoot, write and edit daily news stories and content on multiple platforms
  • Deliver compelling live reports from the field
  • Collaborate with photographers, producers and other journalists on major stories and special coverage
  • Respond quickly and creatively to breaking news

 

Skills and Experience:

  • Sharp news judgment and a strong understanding of what matters to local audiences
  • Strong writing and storytelling skills, including knowledge of AP style
  • Ability to tell impactful stories on deadline
  • Excellent shooting, editing and technical skills
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative newsroom
  • Ability to develop sources and enterprise stories beyond the daily news cycle
  • Must have and maintain a valid driver’s license and a good driving record

 

Requirements and Qualifications:

  • A minimum of two years of professional reporting experience is required
  • Experience with LiveU is a plus
  • Experience creating content for digital and social platforms is strongly preferred

If you’re looking for an opportunity to grow as a journalist, build sources, cover consequential stories and live and work in Austin, we’d like to hear from you.

 

While applying online, please include a link to your online demo reel.

job.title: Sales and Marketing Specialist
job.description:
This Job Description May Cause Extreme Excitement and Career Growth 

At AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions, we believe a great workplace isn't just something we say — it's something you can feel when you join the team. Here, it's all about great collabs, ambition, and results but most importantly, we grow here, and we enjoy here.  We're searching for that special someone — a driven, talented individual to join our innovative media sales team. In this role, you'll engage with new and existing clients and show them how our innovative media solutions can amplify their brands and deliver measurable success. If you're energized by building relationships, closing deals, and making an impact, we'd love to hear from you. 


Sound like the right fit? Check out the checklist below and if it sounds like you, hit "Apply Now" and let's chat. 


Your Day-to-Day (aka the Playbook) 

Help Brands Thrive: 

Join our media sales team and play a pivotal role in helping brands and companies grow. By identifying new opportunities, building strong client relationships, and delivering impactful solutions, you'll showcase how our multi-media content platforms and digital assets can drive meaningful results for our partners. 


Your focus will be on helping clients achieve their goals, ensuring that every campaign is a success. When our clients win, we win—and we believe in celebrating those victories together! 

  

Make Connections: Embrace your powers of persuasion and make every handshake and meeting count! Every interaction is a chance to build a genuine connection and show clients how we can help them succeed. You're not just selling; you're building partnerships. You're helping businesses find the right audience in the right place at the right time. When we say One Partner, Endless Possibilities, we mean it! 

 

Be A Trusted Guide: In this role, you'll connect with clients on a human level, understand their unique needs, and craft tailored sales and marketing solutions that deliver results. As their trusted advisor, you'll help them navigate the ever-evolving marketing landscape, ensuring every step of the journey is planned with care and precision.  

 

Shake Things Up: Bring your creativity and fresh ideas to the table! We're looking for someone who challenges the status quo, embraces innovation, and finds new ways to connect with our audience. Your contributions will help elevate our brand and drive meaningful results for your clients.  

 

Join us and Conquer the Media Landscape: You'll be part of a dedicated team of A1 media sales professionals, committed to achieving market leadership. Together, we amplify our impact, deliver exceptional outcomes, and help our clients succeed in ways that truly matter. 

 

Identify Emerging Opportunities: It's about being able to see what others can't, anticipating market shifts, analyzing data and predicting the next big thing. Your insights will position our clients and AMP for long-term success.  

  

What We're Looking For 

Proven Sales Ability (or an Unstoppable Desire to Learn) 

Whether you're a seasoned sales professional or just getting started, we value your drive, energy, and passion for achieving results. 

 

Strong Communication Skills: You're a natural at building relationships and communicating effectively. Proficiency with digital tools and applications is a must. 

 

A Passion for helping Others: You're committed to understanding clients' needs, providing top-notch customer service and making a difference. You're not just selling a product; you're providing a solution.  


A Competitive Spirit: Do you get a little boost when you achieve a goal (especially if it was a tough one)? We love that for you (and us)!  We want someone who's driven to excel but also knows how to celebrate the victories (big and small) with their team. That drive makes you a valuable part of our organization.  


A Willingness to Grow: Do you thrive in environments where you're always learning something new? Excellent, you'll fit right in! The media world is constantly evolving, and the ability to learn, adapt, and embrace challenges in a fast-paced, digital-first environment is key.  

 

The Practical Stuff 

A valid driver's license, up-to-date insurance, and reliable transportation are necessary for connecting with clients in your community. 

 

Why Join AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions? / The Reasons You Should Hit "Apply Now" 

 

Serious Work, Seriously Cool People: Be part of a dynamic team that values creativity, collaboration, and fun! We are all for work that is rewarding.  

 

The Compensation Package: We offer a base salary, commission structure, and benefits package designed to support your success and well-being. Happy employees don't stage rebellions! ;) 

 

We Make a Real Difference (Not Just Talk About It): At AMP, we help local businesses thrive through advertising strategies that create tangible impacts. Our media sales specialist isn't just selling ads; they're the boots on the ground, making a real difference where it counts. (And yes, it feels pretty good.) 

 

Top-Notch Training and Support: We're not the kind of company that hires you and then disappears into the corporate abyss. We carefully select candidates for a cohort-based training program, where you'll join a group of sales professionals from all over the country. From onboarding to ongoing mentorship, we invest in your success with training programs that set you up for long-term growth. 

 

Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in investing in you. That's why you'll have access to training, mentorship, and career advancement opportunities to help you thrive. We are a leader in our industry, flexing our local charm and national muscle, providing you with options to amplify your career in your local market or join one of our AMP Sales & Marketing Solutions teams in another city.  

 

Comprehensive Media Education (We Are Your Power Source!): New to the industry? We've got you covered with training programs that turn curiosity into expertise.   

 

AMP is us. It's you. It isn't just a name; it's a mission. A promise to amplify our reach, amplify our innovation, and most importantly, amplify you. If you're ready to grow your career and help businesses achieve their goals, we'd love to hear from you.

job.description:
Safety Ops Manager

Job Summary

Every day at Disney Cruise Line we take pride in bringing the magic of Disney to life. We find joy in creating cherished memories and form genuine connections with our guests. We hold each other to the highest degree and always act responsibly while ensuring the safety of fellow cast, crew and guests. United by our Disney values, we work toward excellence in all we do. As a part of our team, you can work in a diverse and inclusive environment amidst a professional and supportive community. If you are ready to create unforgettable experiences and grow as a person and as a professional, apply today.

As a Safety Operations Manager, this role will be responsible for Fleet and Private Island Safety operations, ensuring compliance with all National, International Rules/Regulations, and Class requirements.

Responsibilities:

  • Collaborates with Safety Managers and shipboard.
  • Inspects vessels & Islands periodically, verifying that Company Safety Standards are respected and verify compliance with Class, statutory requirements & National Standards.
  • Review and update maintenance schedules based on Ship Survey findings and results.
  • Define and maintain review of operational requirements for riding teams under direction of the Safety Managers.
  • Assist in organizing and scheduling both the short term and long-term repair and planned maintenance work for all safety related equipment and machinery, in conjunction with the engineering operations team.
  • Responsible for organizational activities in planning, preparation and execution of the riding team and /or special projects.
  • Responsible for any special projects to be done on the run.
  • Assisting in identify new technology to be implemented based on needs and requirements.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to advance technical operating practices, procedures and standards.
  • Responsible for keeping all technical documentation (manuals, drawings, certificates, calculations and any other technical documentation) up to date and to the correct standards.
  • Assisting with the creation of AMOS (Asset Management Operating System) jobs when required and for all safety related maintenance jobs as outlined in AMOS.
  • Assisting with developing, maintaining and updating the ships assembly plans while seeing to accurate records within Fidelio and the Mobile Assembly System.
  • Assisting with developing, maintaining and updating the in Port Manning program while making improvements where necessary and partnering with on board steering committees.
  • Attending technical discussions for safety discipline, and being an active player in negotiations with builders and suppliers.
  • Attending meetings and Yard visits as required.
  • Assisting the New Build Team in reviewing technical documentation, providing expertise in the design, selection and testing of equipment and assist as required.
  • Assisting in maintaining safe operations with alternative fuel (LNG (Liquified Natural Gas) & Methanol).
  • Assisting with developing procedures under the direction of the Manager of Safety Operations.
  • Contributing to future LNG & Methanol Bunkering HAZIDs and Risk Analysis in relation new bunkering locations.
  • Assisting with coordinates, in cooperation with the Marine and Engineering Operations teams, the fleet and Island safety equipment, maintenance and service agreements seeing to the use of certified providers.
  • Where applicable, assisting to align private island safety procedures with WDW Safety and Auditing (WSA) standards in liaison with WSA leadership, leveraging as many WDW Safety programs as possible.
  • Responsible for all safety and enhancement projects related to (but not limited to) Fire Safety of the Island

Basic Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in a shipboard Deck, Engineering, or Safety Officer role, or equivalent experience as a Naval Architect or Marine Engineer working on technical projects within the cruise industry
  • Ability to influence leadership with a strategic and collaborative approach.
  • Led safety initiatives for area.
  • Demonstrated communication, presentation and public speaking skills.
  • Self-starter, recognizing when projects need to involve multiple partners and decisions need to be made at other levels within the organization.
  • Computer proficiency in Microsoft Office products including Outlook and Word.
  • Demonstrated ability to handle confidential information.

  Preferred qualifications

Today it is increasingly important for us to help Customers understand WDW, make confident choices, navigate our unique planning requirement, know the business rules, and for us to provide quality service when and how they expect.

Reporting to the Vice President of FP&A and managing a one staff in the US, this role partners with finance and business leadership to provide financial insights that support strategic decision-making. The Director is tasked with leading the annual budget, monthly forecasting, and Long-Range Planning (LRP) processes. The role also develops financial estimates supporting television series greenlight decisions and maintains 10-year Ultimate revenue forecasts for the assigned portfolio. This position regularly interfaces with senior management and collaborates across Finance, Sales, Strategy, Business Affairs, and Content teams.

•    Provide coaching, mentorship, and oversight to ensure high-quality financial analysis and planning deliverables.

TEGNA Inc. helps people thrive in their local communities by providing the trusted local news and services that matter most. With 64 television stations in 51 U.S. markets, TEGNA reaches more than 100 million people monthly across the web, mobile apps, streaming, and linear television. Together, we are building a sustainable future for local news.

 

KHOU-TV Houston, the TEGNA CBS station in Houston is looking for a highly skilled artistic Photojournalist who can create shareable and exciting content for television, social media and mobile.  We want a photojournalist who can tell great stories on their own or with a team.  Our ideal candidates are familiar with the latest photography, editing tools, and techniques. They create unique and exciting content on all platforms. They are proficient with live news-gathering tools and are able to participate in live performance on-air and on live streaming when necessary. 

Current driver's license and ability to operate news gathering vehicle to and from various locations is required.

  • Passion for capturing video & audio elements that produce compelling and engaging news, sports, features and documentary-style stories in a daily deadline environment.
  • Operate an ENG truck or IP video-based live unit (TVU) when assigned.

About Community Choice

At Community Choice, we connect local businesses with the people and communities they want to reach through exciting events, sponsorships, and promotional opportunities.

Powered by LocaliQ and the USA TODAY Network, we combine local connections with the resources and expertise of a nationally recognized media organization. Our team helps businesses get in front of their ideal customers while creating memorable experiences within their communities.

As an Inside Sales Representative, you’ll play a key role in bringing those partnerships to life. You’ll connect with business owners and decision-makers, uncover their goals, introduce sponsorship and advertising opportunities, and help create partnerships that deliver visibility and value.

If you’re energized by competition, motivated by results, and enjoy the thrill of turning a cold prospect into a new client, this could be the opportunity for you.

This is a full-cycle, high-energy sales role where you’ll own the process from the first conversation through the close.

You’ll spend your day prospecting for new business, connecting with small and medium-sized businesses, presenting event sponsorship and advertising opportunities, and building relationships with decision-makers.

You’ll manage your own pipeline, work toward monthly revenue and activity goals, and use Salesforce CRM to stay organized and keep opportunities moving forward.

The role is built for someone who enjoys having clear goals, wants their effort to directly impact their earnings, and thrives in an environment where activity, persistence, and results matter.

With strong training, sales tools, marketing resources, and leadership support behind you, you’ll have the opportunity to build your sales skills while growing your book of business.

• Access to Salesforce, marketing resources, lead support, and sales tools

• Conduct consistent daily outbound outreach to small and medium-sized businesses

• Build relationships with business owners and key decision-makers

• Identify business goals and recommend event sponsorship and advertising opportunities that align with those needs

• Build, manage, and maintain a strong sales pipeline using Salesforce CRM

• Conduct sales presentations and confidently communicate the value of Community Choice opportunities

• Consistently work toward and exceed monthly revenue and activity goals

• Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling additional solutions

• Maintain accurate CRM notes, activity tracking, pipeline information, and forecasting

• Stay persistent and engaged throughout the sales process to turn opportunities into new partnerships

• Demonstrated ability to consistently meet or exceed sales goals or quotas

• Experience with consultative or solution-based selling

• Confident communicator with a strong phone presence

• Comfortable making frequent outbound calls and initiating conversations with new prospects

• Strong closing and negotiation skills

• Highly self-motivated, organized, and competitive

• Comfortable working in a performance-based, commission-driven environment

• Ability to manage multiple opportunities and maintain consistent follow-up

• Experience with Salesforce or another CRM is a plus

• Bachelor’s degree or media/advertising sales experience is a plus

Who Thrives Here

The people who succeed in this role are competitive, persistent, confident, and motivated by results. They enjoy picking up the phone, starting conversations, overcoming objections, and finding a way to move an opportunity forward.

You don’t need to be an events expert on day one. What matters most is your ability to build relationships, ask good questions, handle rejection, stay organized, and keep pushing toward the next opportunity.

If you enjoy a fast pace, clear goals, and the opportunity to directly influence your earnings through your own performance, you’ll find plenty of room to grow here.

Complete onboarding and product training, build your prospecting habits, learn the Community Choice event portfolio, and begin developing a strong sales pipeline.

6 Months:

Consistently prospect, manage a healthy pipeline, conduct confident sales conversations, and establish steady performance against revenue and activity goals.

12 Months:

Own your sales cycle with confidence, consistently deliver against revenue goals, build a strong book of business, and identify opportunities to expand your impact and earnings.

Benefits & Growth

We want our sales team to have the tools, training, and opportunity to build a successful career.

• $19.24/hour base pay

• Top performers earning $100K+ annually

• Salesforce and industry-leading sales tools

Make an Impact. Build Relationships. Get Rewarded.

Community Choice gives you the opportunity to sell something businesses can get excited about—events and experiences that put them directly in front of their communities and customers.

If you’re ready to build relationships, chase big goals, and turn your sales ability into uncapped earning potential, we want to meet you.

job.title: Senior Reporter (Courts & Crime), California Post
job.description:
Job Description :

As part of our bold expansion, we are seeking a driven Senior Reporter (Courts & Crime Focus) to join the California Post team.
 

Reporting to the Deputy News Editor, this reporter will react quickly to major breaking news across the San Francisco Bay Area while bringing a strong background in courts, crime, and public safety. This role requires flexibility, sharp instincts, and a high-velocity reporting style—whether you’re covering a high-profile trial, responding to an emergency scene, or breaking down a rapidly developing regional story. You will be on the front lines of one of the nation’s most dynamic news environments, turning fast-moving events into clear, authoritative reporting.

Responsibilities:

  • Cover real-time breaking events across the San Francisco Bay Area with speed, accuracy, and urgency for the California Post.

  • Lead coverage on major criminal and civil court cases, law enforcement agency accountability, and high-impact crime trends shaping the region.

  • Pivot seamlessly between spot news, trending digital stories, public safety incidents, and broader regional enterprise assignments as news breaks.

  • Spot local stories with viral potential or national resonance and deliver exclusive angles before the competition.

  • Cultivate strong relationships across law enforcement, city agencies, legal communities, emergency services, and local neighborhoods.

  • File rapid updates across web, mobile, social media, and video platforms, continuously updating developing stories in real time.

  • Actively monitor court filings, police blotters, public records, and social media feeds to spot scoops and emerging trends.

  • Travel regularly to courthouses across the Bay Area to cover hearings, arraignments, trials, and major verdict announcements in person. 

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience reporting for a fast-paced digital or print newsroom, with a strong background in general assignment, breaking news, or public safety beats.

  • Superior news judgment with a proven ability to write fast, clean, and compelling copy on tight deadlines while managing multiple assignments.

  • Strong familiarity with legal documents, court filings, and police operations, with the ability to translate complex legal jargon into clear, accessible prose.

  • A relentless approach to newsgathering and a track record of building trusted sources across public safety and municipal agencies.

  • Proficiency with CMS platforms (e.g., WordPress), SEO best practices, and social media distribution tools.

  • Strong preference for candidates comfortable discussing their stories on camera or presenting short-form video updates for digital platforms.

  • A desire to be first and best on major breaking stories while maintaining the highest standards of journalistic integrity and accuracy.

Preferred Qualifications:
